    convert_to(p_existence_disclosure, 'UTF8') || decode('00', 'hex') ||
    convert_to(p_payload_disclosure, 'UTF8') || decode('00', 'hex') ||
    convert_to(p_evidence_class, 'UTF8')
  )
$function$
resources text[], target text, action text, participant uuid, principal uuid, authenticated_session uuid

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.administration_resource_permits(resources text[], target text, action text, participant uuid, principal uuid, authenticated_session uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(target=ANY(resources) OR '*'=ANY(resources) OR (
   action IN('ACT-IDENTITY_UPDATE_STEP_UP-V1','ACT-IDENTITY_DELETE_SESSION-V1')
   AND authenticated_session IS NOT NULL AND target=authenticated_session::text
   AND ('urn:openpc:self-session:'||principal::text)=ANY(resources)
   AND openpc.matches_participant(participant)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.session s WHERE s.participant_id=participant
     AND s.session_id=authenticated_session AND s.principal_id=principal AND s.state='ACTIVE'
     AND s.idle_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND s.absolute_expires_at>clock_timestamp()
     AND ((s.context_mode='PARTICIPANT' AND openpc.matches_privacy(s.privacy_domain_id))
       OR (s.context_mode='PLATFORM' AND s.privacy_domain_id IS NULL AND EXISTS(
         SELECT 1 FROM control.participant p WHERE p.participant_id=participant
           AND openpc.matches_privacy(p.root_privacy_domain_id)))))
 ),false)
$function$
resources text[], target text, action text, participant uuid, principal uuid, authenticated_session uuid, selected_envelope uuid

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.administration_resource_permits(resources text[], target text, action text, participant uuid, principal uuid, authenticated_session uuid, selected_envelope uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE selected control.authority_envelope;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO selected FROM control.authority_envelope e WHERE e.participant_id=participant AND e.authority_envelope_id=selected_envelope;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF selected.representation<>'RECOVERY_V1' THEN
  RETURN openpc.administration_resource_permits(resources,target,action,participant,principal,authenticated_session);
 END IF;
 IF selected.principal_id IS DISTINCT FROM principal OR NOT (action=ANY(selected.action_intent_ids))
  OR NOT (resources<@selected.resource_ids) OR NOT openpc.platform_recovery_envelope_current(selected_envelope) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF openpc.administration_resource_permits(resources,target,action,participant,principal,authenticated_session) THEN RETURN true; END IF;
 -- The consumed preparation remains immutable provenance of this exact
 -- continuation. Its approval can be read, never resumed or decided again.
 IF action='ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1' AND EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_recovery_case fresh
   JOIN control.platform_recovery_enrollment source ON source.participant_id=fresh.participant_id
    AND source.privacy_domain_id=fresh.privacy_domain_id AND source.enrollment_id=fresh.enrollment_id
   JOIN control.platform_scope_replacement replacement ON replacement.participant_id=fresh.participant_id
    AND replacement.privacy_domain_id=fresh.privacy_domain_id
    AND replacement.replacement_id::text=fresh.intent#>>'{continuation,replacementId}'
   JOIN control.mutation_candidate prepared ON prepared.participant_id=replacement.participant_id
    AND prepared.privacy_domain_id=replacement.privacy_domain_id
    AND prepared.mutation_candidate_id=replacement.prepare_candidate_id
   JOIN control.authority_envelope issuing ON issuing.participant_id=prepared.participant_id
    AND issuing.authority_envelope_id=prepared.maker_authority_envelope_id
   JOIN control.approval_request approval ON approval.participant_id=prepared.participant_id
    AND approval.privacy_domain_id=prepared.privacy_domain_id
    AND approval.approval_request_id=replacement.prepare_approval_id
    AND approval.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE' AND approval.subject_id=prepared.mutation_candidate_id
    AND approval.subject_digest=prepared.candidate_digest AND approval.subject_version=prepared.expected_revision
   WHERE fresh.participant_id=participant AND openpc.matches_privacy(fresh.privacy_domain_id)
    AND fresh.recovery_id=selected.recovery_case_id AND fresh.intent->>'schema'='pc.identity.platform-recovery-intent'
    AND fresh.intent ? 'continuation'
    AND source.source_purpose='ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY_CONTINUATION' AND source.document->>'schemaVersion'='3'
    AND source.document->>'schema'='pc.identity.platform-recovery-enrollment'
    AND issuing.representation='RECOVERY_V1'
    AND issuing.recovery_case_id::text=fresh.intent#>>'{continuation,recoveryId}'
    AND principal::text IN(fresh.intent#>>'{preparation,administrators,0,principalId}',fresh.intent#>>'{preparation,administrators,1,principalId}')
    AND target=fresh.intent#>>'{continuation,preparationApprovalId}' AND approval.approval_request_id::text=target
    AND replacement.replacement_id::text=ANY(resources) AND replacement.state='WITHDRAWING' AND replacement.row_version=1
    AND prepared.mutation_candidate_id::text=fresh.intent#>>'{continuation,preparationCandidateId}'
    AND prepared.state='CONSUMED' AND prepared.consumed_operation_id=replacement.prepare_operation_id
    AND prepared.consumed_operation_id::text=fresh.intent#>>'{continuation,preparationOperationId}'
    AND prepared.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-PLATFORM-SCOPE-PREPARE' AND prepared.expected_revision=0
    AND prepared.action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1' AND approval.action_intent_id=prepared.action_intent_id
    AND prepared.resource_id=replacement.replacement_id AND prepared.candidate_document=fresh.intent->'preparation'
    AND prepared.candidate_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(prepared.candidate_document),'UTF8'))
    AND approval.state='APPROVED' AND approval.maker_principal_id=prepared.maker_principal_id
    AND approval.maker_principal_id::text=fresh.intent#>>'{preparation,administrators,0,principalId}'
    AND approval.checker_principal_id::text=fresh.intent#>>'{preparation,administrators,1,principalId}'
    AND approval.maker_principal_id<>approval.checker_principal_id
 ) THEN RETURN true; END IF;
 IF action IN ('ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1')
  AND target ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  AND (openpc.discovery_approval_resume_subject_visible(participant,openpc.current_privacy_domain_id(),principal,selected_envelope,target::uuid)
    OR openpc.platform_recovery_approval_resume_subject_visible(participant,openpc.current_privacy_domain_id(),principal,selected_envelope,target::uuid))
 THEN RETURN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.approval_request approval JOIN control.mutation_candidate candidate
   ON candidate.participant_id=approval.participant_id AND candidate.privacy_domain_id=approval.privacy_domain_id
    AND candidate.mutation_candidate_id=approval.subject_id AND approval.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE'
    AND approval.subject_digest=candidate.candidate_digest AND approval.subject_version=candidate.expected_revision
    AND approval.action_intent_id=candidate.action_intent_id AND approval.maker_principal_id=candidate.maker_principal_id
   WHERE approval.participant_id=participant AND openpc.matches_privacy(approval.privacy_domain_id)
    AND approval.approval_request_id=target::uuid AND candidate.maker_principal_id=principal
    AND candidate.resource_id::text=ANY(resources)); END IF;
 IF action IN ('ACT-POLICY_APPROVE_REQUEST-V1','ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-OPERATIONS_READ_OPERATION-V1') THEN
  RETURN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_candidate candidate
   JOIN control.authority_envelope maker ON maker.authority_envelope_id=candidate.maker_authority_envelope_id AND maker.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
   LEFT JOIN control.approval_request approval ON approval.participant_id=candidate.participant_id AND approval.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id
    AND approval.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE' AND approval.subject_id=candidate.mutation_candidate_id
    AND approval.subject_digest=candidate.candidate_digest AND approval.subject_version=candidate.expected_revision
    AND approval.maker_principal_id=candidate.maker_principal_id
   WHERE candidate.participant_id=participant AND openpc.matches_privacy(candidate.privacy_domain_id)
    AND maker.representation='RECOVERY_V1' AND maker.recovery_case_id=selected.recovery_case_id
    AND ((candidate.catalog_operation_id IN ('ID-OP-PLATFORM-SCOPE-PREPARE','ID-OP-PLATFORM-SCOPE-COMMIT',
      'ID-OP-ENVELOPE-CREATE','ID-OP-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATE','ID-OP-ASSIGNMENT-CREATE')
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_recovery_case c WHERE c.recovery_id=selected.recovery_case_id
       AND c.participant_id=participant AND c.intent->>'schema'='pc.identity.platform-recovery-intent'))
     OR (candidate.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE'
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_recovery_case c WHERE c.recovery_id=selected.recovery_case_id
       AND c.participant_id=participant AND c.intent->>'schema'='pc.identity.discovery-certificate-recovery-intent'
       AND candidate.resource_id::text=c.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorCredentialId}'
       AND candidate.expected_revision=(c.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorRevision}')::numeric
       AND candidate.candidate_document=jsonb_build_object('replacedCredentialId',c.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorCredentialId}',
        'credentialId',c.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,successorCredentialId}',
        'publicKeySpkiDer',c.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,successorPublicKeySpkiDer}'))))
    AND candidate.resource_id::text=ANY(resources)
    AND ((action='ACT-OPERATIONS_READ_OPERATION-V1' AND target=candidate.consumed_operation_id::text)
      OR (action<>'ACT-OPERATIONS_READ_OPERATION-V1' AND target=approval.approval_request_id::text)))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_proposal proposal
    JOIN control.authority_envelope maker ON maker.authority_envelope_id::text=proposal.issuer_authority#>>'{binding,authorityEnvelopeId}'
     AND maker.participant_id=proposal.participant_id
     AND (maker.recovery_case_id=selected.recovery_case_id
       OR openpc.platform_recovery_proposal_history_current(participant,openpc.current_privacy_domain_id(),selected_envelope,proposal.envelope_id))
    JOIN control.platform_recovery_case c ON c.participant_id=maker.participant_id AND c.recovery_id=selected.recovery_case_id
     AND c.intent->>'schema'='pc.identity.platform-recovery-intent'
    WHERE proposal.participant_id=participant AND openpc.matches_privacy(proposal.privacy_domain_id)
     AND proposal.envelope_id::text=ANY(resources) AND action<>'ACT-OPERATIONS_READ_OPERATION-V1'
     AND proposal.submission_approval_id::text=target);
 END IF;
 RETURN false;
END $function$
wire bytea, nonce bytea, mac bytea

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.advance_policy_set_generation_revision()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
  IF NOT (NEW.active AND NEW.state='ACTIVE') THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 ELSIF (NEW.active AND NEW.state='ACTIVE') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM
       (OLD.active AND OLD.state='ACTIVE') AND NEW.policy_version_id=OLD.policy_version_id THEN
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 UPDATE control.policy SET row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp()
  WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
    AND policy_id IN (SELECT policy_id FROM control.policy_version
      WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
        AND (policy_version_id=NEW.policy_version_id OR
             (TG_OP='UPDATE' AND policy_version_id=OLD.policy_version_id)));
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
payload bytea, cose bytea, key_id text, schema_id integer, purpose integer

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.assert_discovery_approval_resume(n control.mutation_candidate)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE old_attempt control.mutation_candidate; previous control.platform_recovery_case;
 fresh control.platform_recovery_case; old_enrollment control.platform_recovery_enrollment;
 new_enrollment control.platform_recovery_enrollment; old_envelope control.authority_envelope; new_envelope control.authority_envelope;
 lineage_ids uuid[]; original_floor timestamptz; proof_count integer; proofs jsonb[]; proof_deadline timestamptz;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF openpc.current_action_intent_id() IS DISTINCT FROM 'ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(n.resume_request) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR jsonb_typeof(n.resume_request->'discoveryReceivingProof') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 IF n.resume_request->'discoveryReceivingProof' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(
    'mfaChallengeId',n.resume_request#>'{discoveryReceivingProof,mfaChallengeId}',
    'verificationOperationId',n.resume_request#>'{discoveryReceivingProof,verificationOperationId}',
    'evidenceDigest',n.resume_request#>'{discoveryReceivingProof,evidenceDigest}')
  OR jsonb_typeof(n.resume_request#>'{discoveryReceivingProof,mfaChallengeId}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR jsonb_typeof(n.resume_request#>'{discoveryReceivingProof,verificationOperationId}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR jsonb_typeof(n.resume_request#>'{discoveryReceivingProof,evidenceDigest}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR (n.resume_request#>>'{discoveryReceivingProof,mfaChallengeId}') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  OR (n.resume_request#>>'{discoveryReceivingProof,verificationOperationId}') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  OR (n.resume_request#>>'{discoveryReceivingProof,evidenceDigest}') !~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT old_attempt FROM control.mutation_candidate
  WHERE mutation_candidate_id=n.predecessor_candidate_id FOR UPDATE;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT old_envelope FROM control.authority_envelope
  WHERE participant_id=old_attempt.participant_id AND authority_envelope_id=old_attempt.maker_authority_envelope_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT previous FROM control.platform_recovery_case
  WHERE participant_id=old_attempt.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=old_attempt.privacy_domain_id
   AND recovery_id=old_envelope.recovery_case_id;
 SELECT c.* INTO STRICT fresh FROM control.platform_recovery_case c JOIN control.authority_envelope e
  ON e.participant_id=c.participant_id AND e.recovery_case_id=c.recovery_id
  WHERE e.participant_id=n.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
   AND e.authority_envelope_id=n.maker_authority_envelope_id AND e.principal_id=n.maker_principal_id
   AND e.representation='RECOVERY_V1' AND e.authority_epoch=n.maker_authority_epoch
   AND e.delegation_epoch=n.maker_delegation_epoch AND openpc.platform_recovery_envelope_current(e.authority_envelope_id);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT new_envelope FROM control.authority_envelope WHERE participant_id=n.participant_id AND authority_envelope_id=n.maker_authority_envelope_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT old_enrollment FROM control.platform_recovery_enrollment WHERE enrollment_id=previous.enrollment_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT new_enrollment FROM control.platform_recovery_enrollment WHERE enrollment_id=fresh.enrollment_id;
 WITH RECURSIVE lineage AS (
  SELECT c.*,ARRAY[c.mutation_candidate_id] path FROM control.mutation_candidate c WHERE c.mutation_candidate_id=old_attempt.mutation_candidate_id
  UNION ALL SELECT parent.*,child.path||parent.mutation_candidate_id FROM lineage child
   JOIN control.mutation_candidate parent ON parent.mutation_candidate_id=child.predecessor_candidate_id
   WHERE NOT parent.mutation_candidate_id=any(child.path)
 ) SELECT array_agg(mutation_candidate_id),min(created_at) INTO lineage_ids,original_floor FROM lineage;
 IF lineage_ids IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_candidate c WHERE c.mutation_candidate_id=any(lineage_ids)
    AND c.predecessor_candidate_id IS NULL AND c.attempt=1)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_candidate c WHERE c.mutation_candidate_id=any(lineage_ids)
    AND (row(c.participant_id,c.privacy_domain_id,c.action_intent_id,c.catalog_operation_id,c.resource_id,
      c.candidate_digest,c.candidate_document,c.expected_revision,c.idempotency_key,c.maker_principal_id)
      IS DISTINCT FROM row(n.participant_id,n.privacy_domain_id,n.action_intent_id,n.catalog_operation_id,n.resource_id,
        n.candidate_digest,n.candidate_document,n.expected_revision,n.idempotency_key,n.maker_principal_id)
      OR c.resource_type<>n.resource_type OR c.operation_class<>n.operation_class
      OR c.state NOT IN ('PROPOSED','APPROVAL_REQUESTED','APPROVED') OR c.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL
      OR (c.predecessor_candidate_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_candidate parent
        WHERE parent.mutation_candidate_id=c.predecessor_candidate_id AND parent.mutation_candidate_id=any(lineage_ids) AND parent.attempt=c.attempt-1))
      OR (c.predecessor_candidate_id IS NULL AND c.attempt<>1)))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 SELECT count(*),array_agg(jsonb_build_object('mfaChallengeId',m.mfa_challenge_id::text,
   'verificationOperationId',verification.operation_id::text,'evidenceDigest','sha256:'||encode(verification.evidence_digest,'hex'))),
   min(least(m.expires_at,
     case when proof_session.step_up_mfa_challenge_id is null then m.consumed_at+interval '5 minutes'
       else coalesce(openpc.session_step_up_valid_until(m.participant_id,m.session_id,m.principal_id),'-infinity'::timestamptz) end,
     coalesce(credential.valid_until,'infinity'::timestamptz)))
  INTO proof_count,proofs,proof_deadline FROM control.mfa_challenge m
 JOIN control.session proof_session ON proof_session.participant_id=m.participant_id
  AND proof_session.session_id=m.session_id AND proof_session.principal_id=m.principal_id
 JOIN control.credential credential ON credential.participant_id=m.participant_id AND credential.credential_id=m.signer_credential_id
  AND credential.principal_id=m.principal_id AND credential.kind='WEBAUTHN' AND credential.state='ACTIVE'
  AND credential.credential_epoch=m.signer_credential_epoch AND credential.valid_from<=clock_timestamp()
  AND (credential.valid_until IS NULL OR credential.valid_until>clock_timestamp())
  AND sha256(credential.public_key_spki_der)=credential.public_key_digest
 JOIN control.mutation_evidence verification ON verification.participant_id=m.participant_id
  AND verification.mfa_challenge_id=m.mfa_challenge_id AND verification.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
  AND verification.principal_id=n.maker_principal_id AND verification.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WEBAUTHN-VERIFY'
  AND verification.action_intent_id='ACT-IDENTITY_UPDATE_STEP_UP-V1'
  AND verification.aggregate_type='webauthn-verification' AND verification.aggregate_id=n.maker_session_id
  AND verification.signer_credential_id=m.signer_credential_id AND verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest IS NOT NULL
  AND verification.evidence_digest=sha256(verification.evidence_cbor) AND verification.occurred_at>=greatest(fresh.activated_at,new_envelope.valid_from)
  AND verification.occurred_at>=m.consumed_at AND verification.occurred_at<=clock_timestamp()
  AND verification.bound_participant_epoch=n.maker_participant_epoch AND verification.bound_principal_epoch=n.maker_principal_epoch
  AND verification.bound_authority_envelope_id=n.maker_authority_envelope_id AND verification.bound_envelope_epoch=n.maker_authority_epoch
  AND verification.bound_assignment_id=n.maker_assignment_id
 JOIN control.idempotency_record committed ON committed.participant_id=verification.participant_id
  AND committed.privacy_domain_id=verification.privacy_domain_id AND committed.operation_id=verification.operation_id
  AND committed.principal_id=verification.principal_id AND committed.action_intent_id=verification.action_intent_id
  AND committed.catalog_operation_id=verification.catalog_operation_id
  AND committed.input_digest=verification.candidate_digest AND committed.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
  AND committed.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
 JOIN control.outbox_event event ON event.participant_id=verification.participant_id AND event.privacy_domain_id=verification.privacy_domain_id
  AND event.aggregate_type=verification.aggregate_type AND event.aggregate_id=verification.aggregate_id
  AND event.event_type='openpc.identity.webauthn-verification.mutation.committed.v1'
  AND event.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
  AND event.payload_cbor=verification.evidence_cbor AND event.payload_digest=verification.evidence_digest AND event.cose_sign1=verification.cose_sign1
 WHERE m.participant_id=n.participant_id AND m.principal_id=n.maker_principal_id AND m.session_id=n.maker_session_id
  AND m.action_intent_id='ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1' AND m.resource_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(n.resume_request-'discoveryReceivingProof'),'UTF8')) AND m.resource_id=n.predecessor_approval_id::text
  AND m.created_at>=greatest(fresh.activated_at,new_envelope.valid_from) AND m.consumed_at>=greatest(fresh.activated_at,new_envelope.valid_from)
  AND (CASE WHEN proof_session.step_up_mfa_challenge_id IS NULL
    THEN m.consumed_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '5 minutes'
    ELSE proof_session.step_up_mfa_challenge_id=m.mfa_challenge_id
      AND openpc.session_step_up_valid_until(m.participant_id,m.session_id,m.principal_id)>clock_timestamp() END)
  AND m.consumed_at<=clock_timestamp()
  AND m.expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND ((m.used_at IS NULL AND m.used_operation_id IS NULL) OR (m.used_at IS NOT NULL AND m.used_operation_id=n.resume_operation_id));
 IF proof_count<>1 OR n.resume_request->'discoveryReceivingProof' IS DISTINCT FROM proofs[1] THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 IF current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'serializable'
  OR current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true) IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
  OR old_enrollment.document->>'assurance' IS DISTINCT FROM 'LOCAL_QA_VIRTUAL_AUTHENTICATOR'
  OR old_enrollment.document_digest<>previous.enrollment_digest OR old_enrollment.row_version<>previous.enrollment_revision
  OR new_enrollment.document_digest<>fresh.enrollment_digest OR new_enrollment.row_version<>fresh.enrollment_revision
  OR new_enrollment.document->>'assurance' IS DISTINCT FROM 'LOCAL_QA_VIRTUAL_AUTHENTICATOR'
  OR old_attempt.catalog_operation_id<>'ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE'
  OR old_attempt.action_intent_id<>'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
  OR old_attempt.resource_type<>'participant' OR old_attempt.operation_class<>'UPDATE'
  OR old_attempt.state NOT IN ('APPROVAL_REQUESTED','APPROVED') OR old_attempt.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL
  OR n.state NOT IN ('PROPOSED','APPROVAL_REQUESTED') OR n.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL
  OR n.predecessor_approval_id IS NULL OR n.resume_operation_id IS NULL
  OR fresh.intent->>'schemaVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM '2'
  OR n.attempt<>old_attempt.attempt+1 OR n.expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
  OR n.expires_at>least(clock_timestamp()+interval '30 minutes',fresh.valid_until,new_envelope.valid_until,
    (SELECT least(s.idle_expires_at,s.absolute_expires_at) FROM control.session s WHERE s.participant_id=n.participant_id AND s.session_id=n.maker_session_id),
    (SELECT upper(a.valid_during) FROM control.assignment a WHERE a.participant_id=n.participant_id AND a.assignment_id=n.maker_assignment_id))
  OR row(n.participant_id,n.privacy_domain_id,n.action_intent_id,n.catalog_operation_id,n.resource_type,
    n.operation_class,n.resource_id,n.candidate_digest,n.candidate_document,n.expected_revision,n.idempotency_key,n.maker_principal_id)
   IS DISTINCT FROM row(old_attempt.participant_id,old_attempt.privacy_domain_id,old_attempt.action_intent_id,
    old_attempt.catalog_operation_id,old_attempt.resource_type,old_attempt.operation_class,old_attempt.resource_id,
    old_attempt.candidate_digest,old_attempt.candidate_document,old_attempt.expected_revision,old_attempt.idempotency_key,old_attempt.maker_principal_id)
  OR old_envelope.representation<>'RECOVERY_V1' OR old_envelope.principal_id<>n.maker_principal_id
  OR old_enrollment.source_purpose<>'ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY' OR new_enrollment.source_purpose<>'ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY'
  OR old_enrollment.document->>'schemaVersion'<>'2' OR new_enrollment.document->>'schemaVersion'<>'2'
  OR previous.state<>'EXPIRED' OR previous.valid_until>clock_timestamp() OR previous.completion_operation_id IS NOT NULL OR previous.completion_result IS NOT NULL
  OR fresh.state<>'ACTIVE' OR fresh.recovery_id=previous.recovery_id OR fresh.valid_until<=clock_timestamp()
  OR previous.intent->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'pc.identity.discovery-certificate-recovery-intent'
  OR fresh.intent->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM previous.intent->>'schema'
  OR fresh.intent->'certificateRecovery' IS DISTINCT FROM previous.intent->'certificateRecovery'
  OR ((fresh.intent#>'{administrators,0}')-'principalEpoch') IS DISTINCT FROM ((previous.intent#>'{administrators,0}')-'principalEpoch')
  OR ((fresh.intent#>'{administrators,1}')-'principalEpoch') IS DISTINCT FROM ((previous.intent#>'{administrators,1}')-'principalEpoch')
  OR fresh.intent#>>'{administrators,0,principalId}' IS DISTINCT FROM n.maker_principal_id::text
  OR openpc.discovery_approval_resume_enrollments_compatible(old_enrollment.enrollment_id,new_enrollment.enrollment_id) IS DISTINCT FROM true
  OR n.resume_request IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_object('command','RESUME',
    'actionIntentId','ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1','actionIntentDigest','sha256:'||encode(action.semantic_digest,'hex'),
    'approvalRequestId','urn:openpc:resource:'||prior.approval_request_id::text,'expectedRevision',prior.row_version::text,
    'predecessorCandidateId',old_attempt.mutation_candidate_id::text,'expectedAttempt',old_attempt.attempt::text,
    'candidateDigest','sha256:'||encode(old_attempt.candidate_digest,'hex'),
    'reason','Resume the retained Discovery certificate rotation with fresh custody and independent approval.',
    'discoveryReceivingProof',proofs[1]) FROM control.approval_request prior JOIN control.action_intent action
      ON action.action_intent_id='ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
    WHERE prior.participant_id=n.participant_id AND prior.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
     AND prior.approval_request_id=n.predecessor_approval_id AND prior.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE'
     AND prior.subject_id=old_attempt.mutation_candidate_id AND prior.subject_digest=n.candidate_digest
     AND prior.subject_version=n.expected_revision AND prior.action_intent_id=n.action_intent_id
     AND prior.maker_principal_id=n.maker_principal_id AND prior.checker_principal_id<>n.maker_principal_id
     AND prior.checker_principal_id::text=fresh.intent#>>'{administrators,1,principalId}'
     AND prior.state IN ('OPEN','APPROVED','EXPIRED'))
  OR n.candidate_document IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('replacedCredentialId',fresh.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorCredentialId}',
    'credentialId',fresh.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,successorCredentialId}',
    'publicKeySpkiDer',fresh.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,successorPublicKeySpkiDer}')
  OR n.expected_revision::text IS DISTINCT FROM fresh.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorRevision}'
  OR n.resource_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM fresh.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorCredentialId}'
  OR n.candidate_digest IS DISTINCT FROM sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(n.candidate_document),'UTF8'))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_candidate child WHERE child.predecessor_candidate_id=old_attempt.mutation_candidate_id
    AND child.mutation_candidate_id<>n.mutation_candidate_id)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.participant p JOIN control.principal principal ON principal.participant_id=p.participant_id
    JOIN control.session s ON s.participant_id=p.participant_id AND s.principal_id=principal.principal_id
    JOIN control.assignment a ON a.participant_id=p.participant_id AND a.principal_id=principal.principal_id
    WHERE p.participant_id=n.participant_id AND p.state='ACTIVE' AND p.authority_epoch=n.maker_participant_epoch
     AND principal.principal_id=n.maker_principal_id AND principal.state='ACTIVE' AND principal.kind='PLATFORM_OPERATOR'
     AND principal.authority_epoch=n.maker_principal_epoch AND s.session_id=n.maker_session_id AND s.state='ACTIVE'
     AND s.session_epoch=n.maker_session_epoch AND s.participant_epoch=n.maker_participant_epoch
     AND s.authority_epoch=n.maker_principal_epoch AND s.delegation_epoch=n.maker_delegation_epoch
     AND s.context_mode='PLATFORM' AND s.privacy_domain_id IS NULL
     AND s.idle_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND s.absolute_expires_at>clock_timestamp()
     AND a.assignment_id=n.maker_assignment_id AND a.row_version=n.maker_assignment_row_version
     AND a.authority_envelope_id=n.maker_authority_envelope_id AND a.state='ACTIVE' AND a.valid_during @> clock_timestamp()
     AND a.delegation_epoch=n.maker_delegation_epoch AND a.maker_checker_required
     AND n.action_intent_id=any(a.action_intent_ids) AND n.privacy_domain_id::text=any(a.privacy_domain_ids)
     AND (n.resource_id::text=any(a.resource_ids) OR '*'=any(a.resource_ids)))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 PERFORM * FROM openpc.lock_discovery_certificate_recovery_source(fresh.enrollment_id,fresh.recovery_id);
 -- No state/time/currentness filter may hide a prior provider claim or effect.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mfa_challenge m WHERE m.participant_id=n.participant_id
    AND m.principal_id=n.maker_principal_id AND m.action_intent_id=n.action_intent_id AND m.resource_digest=n.candidate_digest
    AND (m.used_at IS NOT NULL OR m.used_operation_id IS NOT NULL)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.idempotency_record history WHERE history.participant_id=m.participant_id
      AND history.operation_id=m.used_operation_id AND history.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
      AND history.action_intent_id IN ('ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-POLICY_APPROVE_REQUEST-V1','ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'))
    AND m.session_id IN(SELECT c.maker_session_id FROM control.mutation_candidate c WHERE c.mutation_candidate_id=any(lineage_ids)))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.discovery_certificate_issuance i WHERE i.participant_id=n.participant_id
    AND (i.predecessor_credential_id=n.resource_id OR i.successor_credential_id::text=n.candidate_document->>'credentialId'))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.discovery_certificate_issuer_attempt a WHERE a.participant_id=n.participant_id
    AND a.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id AND a.idempotency_key=n.idempotency_key)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.idempotency_record r WHERE r.participant_id=n.participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
    AND (r.idempotency_key=n.idempotency_key
     OR (r.input_digest=n.candidate_digest AND r.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE')))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_evidence e WHERE e.participant_id=n.participant_id AND e.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
    AND (e.candidate_digest=n.candidate_digest OR e.aggregate_id::text=n.candidate_document->>'credentialId'))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.audit_occurrence a WHERE a.participant_id=n.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
    AND (a.candidate_digest=n.candidate_digest OR a.aggregate_id::text=n.candidate_document->>'credentialId'))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event e WHERE e.participant_id=n.participant_id AND e.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
    AND (e.aggregate_id::text=n.candidate_document->>'credentialId'
      OR (e.aggregate_id=n.resource_id AND e.created_at>=original_floor)))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.receipt_signing_attempt a JOIN control.business_transition_profile profile USING(profile_digest)
    WHERE a.participant_id=n.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
     AND profile.catalog_operation_id=n.catalog_operation_id AND a.reserved_at_ns>=extract(epoch from original_floor)*1000000000
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.idempotency_record committed WHERE committed.participant_id=a.participant_id
       AND committed.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND committed.operation_id=a.operation_id AND committed.terminal_state='COMMITTED'))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_candidate c WHERE c.participant_id=n.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
    AND c.candidate_digest=n.candidate_digest AND (c.state NOT IN ('PROPOSED','APPROVAL_REQUESTED','APPROVED') OR c.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL OR (c.mutation_candidate_id<>n.mutation_candidate_id AND NOT c.mutation_candidate_id=any(lineage_ids))))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 -- Reselect the SAME strict native proof after every local absence scan. The
 -- final invoker trigger repeats this after the private cross-privacy scan and
 -- again at deferred success; crypto never becomes a writable verified flag.
 SELECT count(*),array_agg(jsonb_build_object('mfaChallengeId',m.mfa_challenge_id::text,
   'verificationOperationId',verification.operation_id::text,'evidenceDigest','sha256:'||encode(verification.evidence_digest,'hex'))),
   min(least(m.expires_at,
     case when proof_session.step_up_mfa_challenge_id is null then m.consumed_at+interval '5 minutes'
       else coalesce(openpc.session_step_up_valid_until(m.participant_id,m.session_id,m.principal_id),'-infinity'::timestamptz) end,
     coalesce(credential.valid_until,'infinity'::timestamptz)))
  INTO proof_count,proofs,proof_deadline FROM control.mfa_challenge m
 JOIN control.session proof_session ON proof_session.participant_id=m.participant_id
  AND proof_session.session_id=m.session_id AND proof_session.principal_id=m.principal_id
 JOIN control.credential credential ON credential.participant_id=m.participant_id AND credential.credential_id=m.signer_credential_id
  AND credential.principal_id=m.principal_id AND credential.kind='WEBAUTHN' AND credential.state='ACTIVE'
  AND credential.credential_epoch=m.signer_credential_epoch AND credential.valid_from<=clock_timestamp()
  AND (credential.valid_until IS NULL OR credential.valid_until>clock_timestamp())
  AND sha256(credential.public_key_spki_der)=credential.public_key_digest
 JOIN control.mutation_evidence verification ON verification.participant_id=m.participant_id
  AND verification.mfa_challenge_id=m.mfa_challenge_id AND verification.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
  AND verification.principal_id=n.maker_principal_id AND verification.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WEBAUTHN-VERIFY'
  AND verification.action_intent_id='ACT-IDENTITY_UPDATE_STEP_UP-V1'
  AND verification.aggregate_type='webauthn-verification' AND verification.aggregate_id=n.maker_session_id
  AND verification.signer_credential_id=m.signer_credential_id AND verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest IS NOT NULL
  AND verification.evidence_digest=sha256(verification.evidence_cbor) AND verification.occurred_at>=greatest(fresh.activated_at,new_envelope.valid_from)
  AND verification.occurred_at>=m.consumed_at AND verification.occurred_at<=clock_timestamp()
  AND verification.bound_participant_epoch=n.maker_participant_epoch AND verification.bound_principal_epoch=n.maker_principal_epoch
  AND verification.bound_authority_envelope_id=n.maker_authority_envelope_id AND verification.bound_envelope_epoch=n.maker_authority_epoch
  AND verification.bound_assignment_id=n.maker_assignment_id
 JOIN control.idempotency_record committed ON committed.participant_id=verification.participant_id
  AND committed.privacy_domain_id=verification.privacy_domain_id AND committed.operation_id=verification.operation_id
  AND committed.principal_id=verification.principal_id AND committed.action_intent_id=verification.action_intent_id
  AND committed.catalog_operation_id=verification.catalog_operation_id
  AND committed.input_digest=verification.candidate_digest AND committed.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
  AND committed.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
 JOIN control.outbox_event event ON event.participant_id=verification.participant_id AND event.privacy_domain_id=verification.privacy_domain_id
  AND event.aggregate_type=verification.aggregate_type AND event.aggregate_id=verification.aggregate_id
  AND event.event_type='openpc.identity.webauthn-verification.mutation.committed.v1'
  AND event.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
  AND event.payload_cbor=verification.evidence_cbor AND event.payload_digest=verification.evidence_digest AND event.cose_sign1=verification.cose_sign1
 WHERE m.participant_id=n.participant_id AND m.principal_id=n.maker_principal_id AND m.session_id=n.maker_session_id
  AND m.action_intent_id='ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1' AND m.resource_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(n.resume_request-'discoveryReceivingProof'),'UTF8')) AND m.resource_id=n.predecessor_approval_id::text
  AND m.created_at>=greatest(fresh.activated_at,new_envelope.valid_from) AND m.consumed_at>=greatest(fresh.activated_at,new_envelope.valid_from)
  AND (CASE WHEN proof_session.step_up_mfa_challenge_id IS NULL
    THEN m.consumed_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '5 minutes'
    ELSE proof_session.step_up_mfa_challenge_id=m.mfa_challenge_id
      AND openpc.session_step_up_valid_until(m.participant_id,m.session_id,m.principal_id)>clock_timestamp() END)
  AND m.consumed_at<=clock_timestamp()
  AND m.expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND ((m.used_at IS NULL AND m.used_operation_id IS NULL) OR (m.used_at IS NOT NULL AND m.used_operation_id=n.resume_operation_id));
 IF proof_count<>1 OR n.resume_request->'discoveryReceivingProof' IS DISTINCT FROM proofs[1] THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 -- Run again at the actual end boundary, including after the private claim scan.
 PERFORM * FROM openpc.lock_discovery_certificate_recovery_source(fresh.enrollment_id,fresh.recovery_id);
 IF NOT openpc.platform_recovery_envelope_current(n.maker_authority_envelope_id)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.idempotency_record resume WHERE resume.participant_id=n.participant_id
    AND resume.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id AND resume.operation_id=n.resume_operation_id
    AND resume.principal_id=n.maker_principal_id AND resume.action_intent_id='ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
    AND resume.catalog_operation_id='LEGACY' AND resume.input_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(n.resume_request-'discoveryReceivingProof'),'UTF8'))
    AND ((resume.terminal_state IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mfa_challenge unused
      WHERE unused.mfa_challenge_id::text=proofs[1]->>'mfaChallengeId' AND unused.participant_id=n.participant_id
       AND unused.used_at IS NULL AND unused.used_operation_id IS NULL))
      OR (resume.terminal_state='COMMITTED' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mfa_challenge used
       WHERE used.mfa_challenge_id::text=proofs[1]->>'mfaChallengeId' AND used.participant_id=n.participant_id
        AND used.used_at IS NOT NULL AND used.used_operation_id=n.resume_operation_id))))
  OR proof_deadline<=clock_timestamp() OR fresh.valid_until<=clock_timestamp() OR n.expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.session s WHERE s.participant_id=n.participant_id AND s.session_id=n.maker_session_id
    AND s.principal_id=n.maker_principal_id AND s.state='ACTIVE' AND s.authority_epoch=n.maker_principal_epoch
    AND s.session_epoch=n.maker_session_epoch AND s.participant_epoch=n.maker_participant_epoch
    AND s.delegation_epoch=n.maker_delegation_epoch AND s.idle_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND s.absolute_expires_at>clock_timestamp())
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.assert_discovery_preapproval_continuation(n control.mutation_candidate)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE old_attempt control.mutation_candidate; previous control.platform_recovery_case;
 fresh control.platform_recovery_case; old_enrollment control.platform_recovery_enrollment;
 new_enrollment control.platform_recovery_enrollment; old_envelope control.authority_envelope; new_envelope control.authority_envelope;
 lineage_ids uuid[]; original_floor timestamptz; proof_count integer; proofs jsonb[]; proof_deadline timestamptz;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF openpc.current_action_intent_id() IS DISTINCT FROM n.action_intent_id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT old_attempt FROM control.mutation_candidate
  WHERE mutation_candidate_id=n.predecessor_candidate_id FOR UPDATE;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT old_envelope FROM control.authority_envelope
  WHERE participant_id=old_attempt.participant_id AND authority_envelope_id=old_attempt.maker_authority_envelope_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT previous FROM control.platform_recovery_case
  WHERE participant_id=old_attempt.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=old_attempt.privacy_domain_id
   AND recovery_id=old_envelope.recovery_case_id;
 SELECT c.* INTO STRICT fresh FROM control.platform_recovery_case c JOIN control.authority_envelope e
  ON e.participant_id=c.participant_id AND e.recovery_case_id=c.recovery_id
  WHERE e.participant_id=n.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
   AND e.authority_envelope_id=n.maker_authority_envelope_id AND e.principal_id=n.maker_principal_id
   AND e.representation='RECOVERY_V1' AND e.authority_epoch=n.maker_authority_epoch
   AND e.delegation_epoch=n.maker_delegation_epoch AND openpc.platform_recovery_envelope_current(e.authority_envelope_id);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT new_envelope FROM control.authority_envelope WHERE participant_id=n.participant_id AND authority_envelope_id=n.maker_authority_envelope_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT old_enrollment FROM control.platform_recovery_enrollment WHERE enrollment_id=previous.enrollment_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT new_enrollment FROM control.platform_recovery_enrollment WHERE enrollment_id=fresh.enrollment_id;
 WITH RECURSIVE lineage AS (
  SELECT c.*,ARRAY[c.mutation_candidate_id] path FROM control.mutation_candidate c WHERE c.mutation_candidate_id=old_attempt.mutation_candidate_id
  UNION ALL SELECT parent.*,child.path||parent.mutation_candidate_id FROM lineage child
   JOIN control.mutation_candidate parent ON parent.mutation_candidate_id=child.predecessor_candidate_id
   WHERE NOT parent.mutation_candidate_id=any(child.path)
 ) SELECT array_agg(mutation_candidate_id),min(created_at) INTO lineage_ids,original_floor FROM lineage;
 IF lineage_ids IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_candidate c WHERE c.mutation_candidate_id=any(lineage_ids)
    AND c.predecessor_candidate_id IS NULL AND c.attempt=1)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_candidate c WHERE c.mutation_candidate_id=any(lineage_ids)
    AND (row(c.participant_id,c.privacy_domain_id,c.action_intent_id,c.catalog_operation_id,c.resource_id,
      c.candidate_digest,c.candidate_document,c.expected_revision,c.idempotency_key,c.maker_principal_id)
      IS DISTINCT FROM row(n.participant_id,n.privacy_domain_id,n.action_intent_id,n.catalog_operation_id,n.resource_id,
        n.candidate_digest,n.candidate_document,n.expected_revision,n.idempotency_key,n.maker_principal_id)
      OR c.resource_type<>n.resource_type OR c.operation_class<>n.operation_class
      OR c.state<>'PROPOSED' OR c.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL
      OR (c.predecessor_candidate_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_candidate parent
        WHERE parent.mutation_candidate_id=c.predecessor_candidate_id AND parent.mutation_candidate_id=any(lineage_ids) AND parent.attempt=c.attempt-1))
      OR (c.predecessor_candidate_id IS NULL AND c.attempt<>1)))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 SELECT count(*),array_agg(jsonb_build_object('mfaChallengeId',m.mfa_challenge_id::text,
   'verificationOperationId',verification.operation_id::text,'evidenceDigest','sha256:'||encode(verification.evidence_digest,'hex'))),
   min(least(m.expires_at,m.consumed_at+interval '5 minutes',coalesce(credential.valid_until,'infinity'::timestamptz)))
  INTO proof_count,proofs,proof_deadline FROM control.mfa_challenge m
 JOIN control.credential credential ON credential.participant_id=m.participant_id AND credential.credential_id=m.signer_credential_id
  AND credential.principal_id=m.principal_id AND credential.kind='WEBAUTHN' AND credential.state='ACTIVE'
  AND credential.credential_epoch=m.signer_credential_epoch AND credential.valid_from<=clock_timestamp()
  AND (credential.valid_until IS NULL OR credential.valid_until>clock_timestamp())
  AND sha256(credential.public_key_spki_der)=credential.public_key_digest
 JOIN control.mutation_evidence verification ON verification.participant_id=m.participant_id
  AND verification.mfa_challenge_id=m.mfa_challenge_id AND verification.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
  AND verification.principal_id=n.maker_principal_id AND verification.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WEBAUTHN-VERIFY'
  AND verification.action_intent_id='ACT-IDENTITY_UPDATE_STEP_UP-V1'
  AND verification.aggregate_type='webauthn-verification' AND verification.aggregate_id=n.maker_session_id
  AND verification.signer_credential_id=m.signer_credential_id AND verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest IS NOT NULL
  AND verification.evidence_digest=sha256(verification.evidence_cbor) AND verification.occurred_at>=greatest(fresh.activated_at,new_envelope.valid_from)
  AND verification.occurred_at>=m.consumed_at AND verification.occurred_at<=clock_timestamp()
  AND verification.bound_participant_epoch=n.maker_participant_epoch AND verification.bound_principal_epoch=n.maker_principal_epoch
  AND verification.bound_authority_envelope_id=n.maker_authority_envelope_id AND verification.bound_envelope_epoch=n.maker_authority_epoch
  AND verification.bound_assignment_id=n.maker_assignment_id
 JOIN control.idempotency_record committed ON committed.participant_id=verification.participant_id
  AND committed.privacy_domain_id=verification.privacy_domain_id AND committed.operation_id=verification.operation_id
  AND committed.principal_id=verification.principal_id AND committed.action_intent_id=verification.action_intent_id
  AND committed.catalog_operation_id=verification.catalog_operation_id
  AND committed.input_digest=verification.candidate_digest AND committed.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
  AND committed.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
 JOIN control.outbox_event event ON event.participant_id=verification.participant_id AND event.privacy_domain_id=verification.privacy_domain_id
  AND event.aggregate_type=verification.aggregate_type AND event.aggregate_id=verification.aggregate_id
  AND event.event_type='openpc.identity.webauthn-verification.mutation.committed.v1'
  AND event.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
  AND event.payload_cbor=verification.evidence_cbor AND event.payload_digest=verification.evidence_digest AND event.cose_sign1=verification.cose_sign1
 WHERE m.participant_id=n.participant_id AND m.principal_id=n.maker_principal_id AND m.session_id=n.maker_session_id
  AND m.action_intent_id=n.action_intent_id AND m.resource_digest=n.candidate_digest AND m.resource_id=n.resource_id::text
  AND m.created_at>=greatest(fresh.activated_at,new_envelope.valid_from) AND m.consumed_at>=greatest(fresh.activated_at,new_envelope.valid_from)
  AND m.consumed_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '5 minutes' AND m.consumed_at<=clock_timestamp()
  AND m.expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND m.used_at IS NULL AND m.used_operation_id IS NULL;
 IF proof_count<>1 OR n.resume_request->'receivingProof' IS DISTINCT FROM proofs[1] THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 IF current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'serializable'
  OR current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true) IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
  OR old_enrollment.document->>'assurance' IS DISTINCT FROM 'LOCAL_QA_VIRTUAL_AUTHENTICATOR'
  OR new_enrollment.document->>'assurance' IS DISTINCT FROM 'LOCAL_QA_VIRTUAL_AUTHENTICATOR'
  OR old_attempt.catalog_operation_id<>'ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE'
  OR old_attempt.action_intent_id<>'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
  OR old_attempt.resource_type<>'participant' OR old_attempt.operation_class<>'UPDATE'
  OR old_attempt.state<>'PROPOSED' OR old_attempt.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL
  OR n.state<>'PROPOSED' OR n.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL
  OR n.predecessor_approval_id IS NOT NULL OR n.resume_operation_id IS NOT NULL
  OR n.attempt<>old_attempt.attempt+1 OR n.expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
  OR n.expires_at>least(clock_timestamp()+interval '30 minutes',fresh.valid_until)
  OR row(n.participant_id,n.privacy_domain_id,n.action_intent_id,n.catalog_operation_id,n.resource_type,
    n.operation_class,n.resource_id,n.candidate_digest,n.candidate_document,n.expected_revision,n.idempotency_key,n.maker_principal_id)
   IS DISTINCT FROM row(old_attempt.participant_id,old_attempt.privacy_domain_id,old_attempt.action_intent_id,
    old_attempt.catalog_operation_id,old_attempt.resource_type,old_attempt.operation_class,old_attempt.resource_id,
    old_attempt.candidate_digest,old_attempt.candidate_document,old_attempt.expected_revision,old_attempt.idempotency_key,old_attempt.maker_principal_id)
  OR old_envelope.representation<>'RECOVERY_V1' OR old_envelope.principal_id<>n.maker_principal_id
  OR previous.state<>'EXPIRED' OR previous.valid_until>clock_timestamp() OR previous.completion_operation_id IS NOT NULL OR previous.completion_result IS NOT NULL
  OR fresh.state<>'ACTIVE' OR fresh.recovery_id=previous.recovery_id OR fresh.valid_until<=clock_timestamp()
  OR previous.intent->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'pc.identity.discovery-certificate-recovery-intent'
  OR fresh.intent->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM previous.intent->>'schema'
  OR fresh.intent->'certificateRecovery' IS DISTINCT FROM previous.intent->'certificateRecovery'
  OR ((fresh.intent#>'{administrators,0}')-'principalEpoch') IS DISTINCT FROM ((previous.intent#>'{administrators,0}')-'principalEpoch')
  OR ((fresh.intent#>'{administrators,1}')-'principalEpoch') IS DISTINCT FROM ((previous.intent#>'{administrators,1}')-'principalEpoch')
  OR fresh.intent#>>'{administrators,0,principalId}' IS DISTINCT FROM n.maker_principal_id::text
  OR row(new_enrollment.participant_id,new_enrollment.privacy_domain_id,new_enrollment.platform_context_id,
    new_enrollment.source_purpose,new_enrollment.root_epoch,new_enrollment.root_revision,new_enrollment.root_digest)
   IS DISTINCT FROM row(old_enrollment.participant_id,old_enrollment.privacy_domain_id,old_enrollment.platform_context_id,
    old_enrollment.source_purpose,old_enrollment.root_epoch,old_enrollment.root_revision,old_enrollment.root_digest)
  OR new_enrollment.document->'source' IS DISTINCT FROM old_enrollment.document->'source'
  OR n.resume_request IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('command','DISCOVERY_PREAPPROVAL_CONTINUE',
    'predecessorCandidateId',old_attempt.mutation_candidate_id::text,'expectedAttempt',old_attempt.attempt::text,
    'candidateDigest','sha256:'||encode(old_attempt.candidate_digest,'hex'),
    'predecessorRecoveryId',previous.recovery_id::text,'recoveryId',fresh.recovery_id::text,'receivingProof',proofs[1])
  OR n.candidate_document IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('replacedCredentialId',fresh.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorCredentialId}',
    'credentialId',fresh.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,successorCredentialId}',
    'publicKeySpkiDer',fresh.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,successorPublicKeySpkiDer}')
  OR n.expected_revision::text IS DISTINCT FROM fresh.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorRevision}'
  OR n.resource_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM fresh.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorCredentialId}'
  OR n.candidate_digest IS DISTINCT FROM sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(n.candidate_document),'UTF8'))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_candidate child WHERE child.predecessor_candidate_id=old_attempt.mutation_candidate_id
    AND child.mutation_candidate_id<>n.mutation_candidate_id)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.participant p JOIN control.principal principal ON principal.participant_id=p.participant_id
    JOIN control.session s ON s.participant_id=p.participant_id AND s.principal_id=principal.principal_id
    JOIN control.assignment a ON a.participant_id=p.participant_id AND a.principal_id=principal.principal_id
    WHERE p.participant_id=n.participant_id AND p.state='ACTIVE' AND p.authority_epoch=n.maker_participant_epoch
     AND principal.principal_id=n.maker_principal_id AND principal.state='ACTIVE' AND principal.kind='PLATFORM_OPERATOR'
     AND principal.authority_epoch=n.maker_principal_epoch AND s.session_id=n.maker_session_id AND s.state='ACTIVE'
     AND s.session_epoch=n.maker_session_epoch AND s.participant_epoch=n.maker_participant_epoch
     AND s.authority_epoch=n.maker_principal_epoch AND s.delegation_epoch=n.maker_delegation_epoch
     AND s.context_mode='PLATFORM' AND s.privacy_domain_id IS NULL
     AND s.idle_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND s.absolute_expires_at>clock_timestamp()
     AND a.assignment_id=n.maker_assignment_id AND a.row_version=n.maker_assignment_row_version
     AND a.authority_envelope_id=n.maker_authority_envelope_id AND a.state='ACTIVE' AND a.valid_during @> clock_timestamp()
     AND a.delegation_epoch=n.maker_delegation_epoch AND a.maker_checker_required
     AND n.action_intent_id=any(a.action_intent_ids) AND n.privacy_domain_id::text=any(a.privacy_domain_ids)
     AND (n.resource_id::text=any(a.resource_ids) OR '*'=any(a.resource_ids)))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 PERFORM * FROM openpc.lock_discovery_certificate_recovery_source(fresh.enrollment_id,fresh.recovery_id);
 -- No state/time/currentness filter may hide a prior provider claim or effect.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mfa_challenge m WHERE m.participant_id=n.participant_id
    AND m.principal_id=n.maker_principal_id AND m.action_intent_id=n.action_intent_id AND m.resource_digest=n.candidate_digest
    AND (m.used_at IS NOT NULL OR m.used_operation_id IS NOT NULL)
    AND m.session_id IN(SELECT c.maker_session_id FROM control.mutation_candidate c WHERE c.mutation_candidate_id=any(lineage_ids)))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.approval_decision_record d WHERE d.participant_id=n.participant_id
    AND d.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id AND d.candidate_digest=n.candidate_digest)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.approval_request a WHERE a.participant_id=n.participant_id
    AND a.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id AND a.subject_digest=n.candidate_digest)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.discovery_certificate_issuance i WHERE i.participant_id=n.participant_id
    AND (i.predecessor_credential_id=n.resource_id OR i.successor_credential_id::text=n.candidate_document->>'credentialId'))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.discovery_certificate_issuer_attempt a WHERE a.participant_id=n.participant_id
    AND a.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id AND a.idempotency_key=n.idempotency_key)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.idempotency_record r WHERE r.participant_id=n.participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
    AND (r.idempotency_key IN(n.idempotency_key,n.idempotency_key||'-request')
     OR (r.input_digest=n.candidate_digest AND r.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE')))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_evidence e WHERE e.participant_id=n.participant_id AND e.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
    AND (e.candidate_digest=n.candidate_digest OR e.aggregate_id::text=n.candidate_document->>'credentialId'))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.audit_occurrence a WHERE a.participant_id=n.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
    AND (a.candidate_digest=n.candidate_digest OR a.aggregate_id::text=n.candidate_document->>'credentialId'))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event e WHERE e.participant_id=n.participant_id AND e.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
    AND (e.aggregate_id::text=n.candidate_document->>'credentialId'
      OR (e.aggregate_id=n.resource_id AND e.created_at>=original_floor)))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.receipt_signing_attempt a JOIN control.business_transition_profile profile USING(profile_digest)
    WHERE a.participant_id=n.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
     AND profile.catalog_operation_id=n.catalog_operation_id AND a.reserved_at_ns>=extract(epoch from original_floor)*1000000000
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.idempotency_record committed WHERE committed.participant_id=a.participant_id
       AND committed.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND committed.operation_id=a.operation_id AND committed.terminal_state='COMMITTED'))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_candidate c WHERE c.participant_id=n.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
    AND c.candidate_digest=n.candidate_digest AND (c.state<>'PROPOSED' OR c.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 -- Reselect the SAME strict native proof after every local absence scan. The
 -- final invoker trigger repeats this after the private cross-privacy scan and
 -- again at deferred success; crypto never becomes a writable verified flag.
 SELECT count(*),array_agg(jsonb_build_object('mfaChallengeId',m.mfa_challenge_id::text,
   'verificationOperationId',verification.operation_id::text,'evidenceDigest','sha256:'||encode(verification.evidence_digest,'hex'))),
   min(least(m.expires_at,m.consumed_at+interval '5 minutes',coalesce(credential.valid_until,'infinity'::timestamptz)))
  INTO proof_count,proofs,proof_deadline FROM control.mfa_challenge m
 JOIN control.credential credential ON credential.participant_id=m.participant_id AND credential.credential_id=m.signer_credential_id
  AND credential.principal_id=m.principal_id AND credential.kind='WEBAUTHN' AND credential.state='ACTIVE'
  AND credential.credential_epoch=m.signer_credential_epoch AND credential.valid_from<=clock_timestamp()
  AND (credential.valid_until IS NULL OR credential.valid_until>clock_timestamp())
  AND sha256(credential.public_key_spki_der)=credential.public_key_digest
 JOIN control.mutation_evidence verification ON verification.participant_id=m.participant_id
  AND verification.mfa_challenge_id=m.mfa_challenge_id AND verification.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
  AND verification.principal_id=n.maker_principal_id AND verification.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WEBAUTHN-VERIFY'
  AND verification.action_intent_id='ACT-IDENTITY_UPDATE_STEP_UP-V1'
  AND verification.aggregate_type='webauthn-verification' AND verification.aggregate_id=n.maker_session_id
  AND verification.signer_credential_id=m.signer_credential_id AND verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest IS NOT NULL
  AND verification.evidence_digest=sha256(verification.evidence_cbor) AND verification.occurred_at>=greatest(fresh.activated_at,new_envelope.valid_from)
  AND verification.occurred_at>=m.consumed_at AND verification.occurred_at<=clock_timestamp()
  AND verification.bound_participant_epoch=n.maker_participant_epoch AND verification.bound_principal_epoch=n.maker_principal_epoch
  AND verification.bound_authority_envelope_id=n.maker_authority_envelope_id AND verification.bound_envelope_epoch=n.maker_authority_epoch
  AND verification.bound_assignment_id=n.maker_assignment_id
 JOIN control.idempotency_record committed ON committed.participant_id=verification.participant_id
  AND committed.privacy_domain_id=verification.privacy_domain_id AND committed.operation_id=verification.operation_id
  AND committed.principal_id=verification.principal_id AND committed.action_intent_id=verification.action_intent_id
  AND committed.catalog_operation_id=verification.catalog_operation_id
  AND committed.input_digest=verification.candidate_digest AND committed.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
  AND committed.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
 JOIN control.outbox_event event ON event.participant_id=verification.participant_id AND event.privacy_domain_id=verification.privacy_domain_id
  AND event.aggregate_type=verification.aggregate_type AND event.aggregate_id=verification.aggregate_id
  AND event.event_type='openpc.identity.webauthn-verification.mutation.committed.v1'
  AND event.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
  AND event.payload_cbor=verification.evidence_cbor AND event.payload_digest=verification.evidence_digest AND event.cose_sign1=verification.cose_sign1
 WHERE m.participant_id=n.participant_id AND m.principal_id=n.maker_principal_id AND m.session_id=n.maker_session_id
  AND m.action_intent_id=n.action_intent_id AND m.resource_digest=n.candidate_digest AND m.resource_id=n.resource_id::text
  AND m.created_at>=greatest(fresh.activated_at,new_envelope.valid_from) AND m.consumed_at>=greatest(fresh.activated_at,new_envelope.valid_from)
  AND m.consumed_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '5 minutes' AND m.consumed_at<=clock_timestamp()
  AND m.expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND m.used_at IS NULL AND m.used_operation_id IS NULL;
 IF proof_count<>1 OR n.resume_request->'receivingProof' IS DISTINCT FROM proofs[1] THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 -- Run again at the actual end boundary, including after the private claim scan.
 PERFORM * FROM openpc.lock_discovery_certificate_recovery_source(fresh.enrollment_id,fresh.recovery_id);
 IF NOT openpc.platform_recovery_envelope_current(n.maker_authority_envelope_id)
  OR proof_deadline<=clock_timestamp() OR fresh.valid_until<=clock_timestamp() OR n.expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.session s WHERE s.participant_id=n.participant_id AND s.session_id=n.maker_session_id
    AND s.principal_id=n.maker_principal_id AND s.state='ACTIVE' AND s.authority_epoch=n.maker_principal_epoch
    AND s.session_epoch=n.maker_session_epoch AND s.participant_epoch=n.maker_participant_epoch
    AND s.delegation_epoch=n.maker_delegation_epoch AND s.idle_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND s.absolute_expires_at>clock_timestamp())
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.assert_evidence_deletion_accounting(old_stream control.evidence_stream, new_stream control.evidence_stream)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF old_stream.participant_id<>current_setting('openpc.participant_id')::uuid
  OR old_stream.privacy_domain_id<>current_setting('openpc.privacy_domain_id')::uuid
  OR (to_jsonb(old_stream)-'used_bytes') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(new_stream)-'used_bytes')
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.deletion_job j JOIN control.evidence_deletion_item i
   USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,deletion_job_id)
   WHERE j.participant_id=old_stream.participant_id AND j.privacy_domain_id=old_stream.privacy_domain_id
    AND j.stream_id=old_stream.stream_id AND j.operation_id=current_setting('openpc.operation_id')::uuid
    AND j.state='EXECUTING' AND old_stream.used_bytes=j.before_used_bytes
    AND new_stream.used_bytes=old_stream.used_bytes-i.ciphertext_bytes
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.evidence_segment_payload p WHERE p.participant_id=j.participant_id
     AND p.privacy_domain_id=j.privacy_domain_id AND p.segment_id=j.segment_id)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.assert_evidence_deletion_receipt(receipt control.audit_occurrence)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.deletion_job j WHERE j.participant_id=receipt.participant_id
  AND j.privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND j.deletion_job_id=receipt.aggregate_id
  AND j.operation_id=receipt.operation_id AND j.state='SUCCEEDED' AND j.revision=1
  AND receipt.catalog_operation_id=openpc.evidence_deletion_operation(j.selection) AND receipt.before_existence=0 AND receipt.before_revision=0
  AND receipt.profile_version=openpc.evidence_deletion_profile_version(j.selection)
  AND receipt.after_existence=1 AND receipt.after_revision=1
  AND openpc.business_cbor(receipt.after_state_preimage)->8=openpc.evidence_deletion_state_projection(j))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-RECEIPT-ACTUAL-DELETION-STATE'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.assert_evidence_hold_receipt(receipt control.audit_occurrence)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.retention_hold h WHERE h.participant_id=receipt.participant_id
  AND h.privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND h.retention_hold_id=receipt.aggregate_id
  AND h.revision=receipt.after_revision AND receipt.after_existence=1
  AND coalesce(h.release_operation_id,h.creation_operation_id)=receipt.operation_id
  AND receipt.catalog_operation_id=CASE WHEN h.selector_type='PARTICIPANT' THEN CASE WHEN h.state='ACTIVE' THEN 'CFG-OP-CREATE-PARTICIPANT-EVIDENCE-HOLD' ELSE 'CFG-OP-RELEASE-PARTICIPANT-EVIDENCE-HOLD' END ELSE CASE WHEN h.state='ACTIVE' THEN 'CFG-OP-CREATE-EVIDENCE-HOLD' ELSE 'CFG-OP-RELEASE-EVIDENCE-HOLD' END END
  AND openpc.business_cbor(receipt.after_state_preimage)->8=openpc.evidence_hold_state_projection(h))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-RECEIPT-ACTUAL-HOLD-STATE'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.assert_fleet_quarantine_atomic()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.fleet_fact_quarantine q
   JOIN control.fleet_fact_delivery d USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,event_id)
   JOIN control.fleet_fact_failure_outbox o USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,receipt_id)
   JOIN control.work_item w ON w.participant_id=q.participant_id AND w.privacy_domain_id=q.privacy_domain_id AND w.work_item_id=q.work_item_id
   WHERE q.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND q.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND q.event_id=NEW.event_id
    AND q.state='COMMITTED' AND d.state='QUARANTINED' AND q.material_digest=d.material_digest
    AND o.receipt_digest=q.receipt_digest AND w.kind='FLEET_FAILURE' AND w.state='OPEN' AND w.row_version=1
    AND w.resource_ref='urn:openpc:resource:'||d.candidate_id::text AND w.payload_digest=d.material_digest
    AND w.reason='Fact delivery quarantined (PC-DATA-6005).' AND w.created_by_principal_id=(q.claims->>'workloadPrincipalId')::uuid
    AND w.assignee_principal_id IS NULL AND w.claimed_by_principal_id IS NULL AND w.completed_by_principal_id IS NULL)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.assert_handover_admission_candidate(candidate_row control.mutation_candidate)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE candidate_material jsonb:=candidate_row.candidate_document; source_document jsonb; generation_document jsonb;
 owner_row control.workload_signing_handover; generation_row control.workload_signing_handover_generation;
 proof_document jsonb; key_document jsonb; selection_document jsonb; actual_count bigint;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'serializable'
  OR NOT openpc.matches_participant(candidate_row.participant_id) OR NOT openpc.matches_privacy(candidate_row.privacy_domain_id)
  OR candidate_row.catalog_operation_id<>'ID-OP-WORKLOAD-SIGNING-HANDOVER-ADMIT' OR candidate_row.action_intent_id<>'ACT-WORKLOAD_SIGNING_HANDOVERS_ACTIVATE_RESOURCE-V1'
  OR candidate_row.resource_type<>'workload-signing-handover' OR candidate_row.operation_class<>'ACTIVATE'
  OR candidate_row.expected_revision<>1
  OR candidate_material-ARRAY['schema','participantId','privacyDomainId','environmentId','handoverId','makerPrincipalId','workloadId','catalogOperationId','expectedRevision','validityPolicy','request','preparedAtNs','expiresAtNs','source','generation','predecessorTrusts','proofs']<>'{}'::jsonb
  OR NOT candidate_material ?& ARRAY['schema','participantId','privacyDomainId','environmentId','handoverId','makerPrincipalId','workloadId','catalogOperationId','expectedRevision','validityPolicy','request','preparedAtNs','expiresAtNs','source','generation','predecessorTrusts','proofs']
  OR candidate_material->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'pc.identity.workload-signing-handover.admission-candidate.v1'
  OR candidate_material->>'participantId' IS DISTINCT FROM candidate_row.participant_id::text
  OR candidate_material->>'privacyDomainId' IS DISTINCT FROM candidate_row.privacy_domain_id::text
  OR candidate_material->>'handoverId' IS DISTINCT FROM candidate_row.resource_id::text
  OR candidate_material->>'makerPrincipalId' IS DISTINCT FROM candidate_row.maker_principal_id::text
  OR candidate_material->>'catalogOperationId' IS DISTINCT FROM candidate_row.catalog_operation_id
  OR candidate_material->>'expectedRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
  OR candidate_material->>'validityPolicy' IS DISTINCT FROM 'FROM_ATOMIC_ADMISSION_TO_EARLIEST_KEY_OR_CREDENTIAL_EXPIRY'
  OR candidate_material->'request'->>'actionIntentId' IS DISTINCT FROM candidate_row.action_intent_id
  OR candidate_material->'request'->>'actionIntentDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM
    (SELECT 'sha256:'||encode(semantic_digest,'hex') FROM control.action_intent WHERE action_intent_id=candidate_row.action_intent_id)
  OR candidate_row.candidate_digest<>sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(candidate_material),'UTF8'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-ADMISSION-CANDIDATE'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT owner_row FROM control.workload_signing_handover WHERE participant_id=candidate_row.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=candidate_row.privacy_domain_id AND handover_id=candidate_row.resource_id
  AND maker_principal_id=candidate_row.maker_principal_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT generation_row FROM control.workload_signing_handover_generation WHERE participant_id=candidate_row.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=candidate_row.privacy_domain_id AND handover_id=owner_row.handover_id
  AND generation_id=(candidate_material->'request'->>'generationId')::uuid AND maker_principal_id=candidate_row.maker_principal_id;
 source_document:=owner_row.source; generation_document:=generation_row.document;

 IF source_document->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'pc.identity.workload-signing-handover.source.v1'
  OR source_document->>'participantId' IS DISTINCT FROM candidate_row.participant_id::text
  OR source_document->>'privacyDomainId' IS DISTINCT FROM candidate_row.privacy_domain_id::text
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.credential credential JOIN control.principal principal USING(participant_id,principal_id)
   JOIN control.participant participant USING(participant_id)
   WHERE credential.participant_id=candidate_row.participant_id AND credential.credential_id=(source_document->'issuer'->>'workloadCredentialId')::uuid
    AND credential.principal_id=(source_document->'issuer'->>'workloadPrincipalId')::uuid
    AND credential.state='ACTIVE' AND credential.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND principal.state='ACTIVE' AND principal.kind='WORKLOAD'
    AND participant.state='ACTIVE' AND credential.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND (credential.valid_until IS NULL OR credential.valid_until>clock_timestamp())
    AND credential.credential_epoch::text=source_document->'issuer'->>'workloadCredentialEpoch'
    AND principal.authority_epoch::text=source_document->'issuer'->>'workloadPrincipalEpoch'
    AND participant.authority_epoch::text=source_document->'issuer'->>'workloadParticipantEpoch')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-CURRENT-ISSUER'; END IF;


 FOR key_document IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(generation_document->'keys') LOOP
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.workload_signing_handover_attempt a
   JOIN control.workload_signing_handover_dispatch d USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,attempt_id)
   WHERE a.participant_id=candidate_row.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=candidate_row.privacy_domain_id
    AND a.handover_id=(generation_document->>'handoverId')::uuid AND a.stage='PREPARATION'
    AND a.attempt_id=(key_document->'attempt'->'request'->>'attemptId')::uuid
    AND a.binding=key_document->'binding' AND a.attempt=key_document->'attempt'
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.workload_signing_handover_observation o
     WHERE o.participant_id=a.participant_id AND o.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND o.attempt_id=a.attempt_id
      AND o.result->>'state'='OBSERVED' AND o.result->'observation'=key_document->'observation')
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.workload_signing_handover_observation o
     WHERE o.participant_id=a.participant_id AND o.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND o.attempt_id=a.attempt_id
      AND o.result->>'state'='OBSERVED' AND o.result->'observation' IS DISTINCT FROM key_document->'observation'))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-GENERATION-PREPARATION-CONFLICT'; END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF candidate_material->'source' IS DISTINCT FROM source_document OR candidate_material->'generation' IS DISTINCT FROM generation_document
  OR candidate_material->>'environmentId' IS DISTINCT FROM owner_row.environment_id
  OR candidate_material->'request'->>'generationDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(generation_row.document_digest,'hex')
  OR candidate_material->>'expiresAtNs' IS DISTINCT FROM generation_document->>'expiresAtNs'
  OR candidate_material->>'preparedAtNs' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$' OR mod((candidate_material->>'preparedAtNs')::numeric,1000)<>0
  OR (candidate_material->>'preparedAtNs')::numeric<(generation_document->>'issuedAtNs')::numeric
  OR (candidate_material->>'preparedAtNs')::numeric>floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000
  OR (candidate_material->>'expiresAtNs')::numeric<=floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000
  OR candidate_row.expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
  OR extract(epoch from candidate_row.expires_at)*1000000000>(generation_document->>'expiresAtNs')::numeric
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.workload_signing_handover_generation WHERE participant_id=candidate_row.participant_id
   AND privacy_domain_id=candidate_row.privacy_domain_id AND supersedes_generation_id=generation_row.generation_id)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.credential credential WHERE credential.participant_id=candidate_row.participant_id
    AND credential.credential_id=owner_row.successor_credential_id AND credential.audience=candidate_material->>'workloadId')
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.credential credential WHERE credential.participant_id=candidate_row.participant_id
    AND credential.credential_id=owner_row.predecessor_credential_id AND credential.principal_id=owner_row.workload_principal_id
    AND credential.audience=candidate_material->>'workloadId' AND credential.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND credential.state='REVOKED'
    AND credential.credential_epoch::text=source_document->'issuer'->>'workloadCredentialEpoch')
  OR jsonb_typeof(candidate_material->'proofs') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR jsonb_typeof(candidate_material->'predecessorTrusts') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR jsonb_array_length(candidate_material->'proofs')<>jsonb_array_length(source_document->'keys')
  OR jsonb_array_length(candidate_material->'predecessorTrusts')<>jsonb_array_length(source_document->'keys')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-ADMISSION-CURRENT'; END IF;
 FOR key_document IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_document->'keys') LOOP
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.business_signing_key key JOIN control.business_signing_key_state lifecycle USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,signer_id)
    WHERE key.participant_id=candidate_row.participant_id AND key.privacy_domain_id=candidate_row.privacy_domain_id
     AND key.signer_id=key_document->>'oldFingerprint' AND key.environment_id=owner_row.environment_id
     AND key.workload_credential_id=owner_row.predecessor_credential_id AND key.key_epoch::text=key_document->>'expectedKeyEpoch'
     AND key.trust_digest=decode(substr(key_document->>'oldTrustDigest',8),'hex')
     AND key.trust_preimage=decode(key_document->>'oldTrustPreimageBase64','base64') AND lifecycle.state='ACTIVE')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-ADMISSION-OLD-TRUST'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 FOR proof_document IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(candidate_material->'proofs') LOOP
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.workload_signing_handover_attempt command
    JOIN control.workload_signing_handover_dispatch dispatch USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,attempt_id)
    WHERE command.participant_id=candidate_row.participant_id AND command.privacy_domain_id=candidate_row.privacy_domain_id
     AND command.handover_id=owner_row.handover_id AND command.generation_id=generation_row.generation_id AND command.stage='POSSESSION'
     AND command.attempt=proof_document->'attempt'
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.workload_signing_handover_observation observed WHERE observed.participant_id=command.participant_id
       AND observed.privacy_domain_id=command.privacy_domain_id AND observed.attempt_id=command.attempt_id
       AND observed.result->>'state'='OBSERVED' AND observed.result->'observation'=proof_document->'observation'
       AND observed.result->'observation'->>'outcome'='SUCCEEDED')
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.workload_signing_handover_observation observed WHERE observed.participant_id=command.participant_id
       AND observed.privacy_domain_id=command.privacy_domain_id AND observed.attempt_id=command.attempt_id
       AND observed.result->>'state'='OBSERVED' AND observed.result->'observation' IS DISTINCT FROM proof_document->'observation'))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-ADMISSION-PROOF'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF (SELECT count(DISTINCT value->'attempt'->'request'->>'attemptId') FROM jsonb_array_elements(candidate_material->'proofs'))<>jsonb_array_length(source_document->'keys')
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.business_signing_key key JOIN jsonb_array_elements(generation_document->'keys') prepared
    ON key.signer_id=prepared->'observation'->'descriptor'->>'fingerprint'
    WHERE key.participant_id=candidate_row.participant_id AND key.privacy_domain_id=candidate_row.privacy_domain_id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-ADMISSION-KEY-SET'; END IF;
 FOR selection_document IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_document->'receiptSelections') LOOP
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.business_signing_selection selection WHERE selection.participant_id=candidate_row.participant_id
    AND selection.privacy_domain_id=candidate_row.privacy_domain_id AND selection.environment_id=owner_row.environment_id
    AND selection.signer_id=selection_document->>'signerId' AND selection.profile_digest=decode(substr(selection_document->>'profileDigest',8),'hex')
