    AND selection.row_version::text=selection_document->>'rowVersion' AND selection.admission_version::text=selection_document->>'admissionVersion'
    AND selection.fence_generation::text=selection_document->>'fenceGeneration' AND selection.fenced_operation_id IS NULL)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-ADMISSION-SELECTION'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 FOR selection_document IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_document->'envelopeSelections') LOOP
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_signing_selection selection WHERE selection.participant_id=candidate_row.participant_id
    AND selection.privacy_domain_id=candidate_row.privacy_domain_id AND selection.environment_id=owner_row.environment_id
    AND selection.signer_id=selection_document->>'signerId' AND selection.profile_digest=decode(substr(selection_document->>'profileDigest',8),'hex')
    AND selection.admission_version::text=selection_document->>'admissionVersion')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-ADMISSION-ENVELOPE-SELECTION'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 SELECT count(*) INTO actual_count FROM control.business_signing_selection selection JOIN control.business_signing_key key USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,signer_id)
  JOIN control.credential credential ON credential.participant_id=key.participant_id AND credential.credential_id=key.workload_credential_id
  WHERE selection.participant_id=candidate_row.participant_id AND selection.privacy_domain_id=candidate_row.privacy_domain_id
   AND selection.environment_id=owner_row.environment_id AND credential.principal_id=owner_row.workload_principal_id AND credential.audience=candidate_material->>'workloadId';
 IF actual_count<>jsonb_array_length(source_document->'receiptSelections') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-ADMISSION-COMPLETE-SELECTIONS'; END IF;
 SELECT count(*) INTO actual_count FROM control.identity_envelope_signing_selection selection JOIN control.business_signing_key key USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,signer_id)
  JOIN control.credential credential ON credential.participant_id=key.participant_id AND credential.credential_id=key.workload_credential_id
  WHERE selection.participant_id=candidate_row.participant_id AND selection.privacy_domain_id=candidate_row.privacy_domain_id
   AND selection.environment_id=owner_row.environment_id AND credential.principal_id=owner_row.workload_principal_id AND credential.audience=candidate_material->>'workloadId';
 IF actual_count<>jsonb_array_length(source_document->'envelopeSelections') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-ADMISSION-COMPLETE-ENVELOPE'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.workload_renewal_signing_selection selection JOIN control.business_signing_key key USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,signer_id)
  JOIN control.credential credential ON credential.participant_id=key.participant_id AND credential.credential_id=key.workload_credential_id
  WHERE selection.participant_id=candidate_row.participant_id AND selection.privacy_domain_id=candidate_row.privacy_domain_id
   AND selection.environment_id=owner_row.environment_id AND credential.principal_id=owner_row.workload_principal_id AND credential.audience=candidate_material->>'workloadId')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-ADMISSION-UNDISCLOSED-RENEWAL'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.assert_mutation_resume_no_effect(candidate_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE c control.mutation_candidate%ROWTYPE; selected jsonb; retirement_selection jsonb; source record; projection jsonb; resource_registration boolean;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM control.mutation_candidate WHERE mutation_candidate_id=candidate_id;
 IF c.catalog_operation_id IN('ID-OP-PLATFORM-SCOPE-PREPARE','ID-OP-PLATFORM-SCOPE-COMMIT') THEN
  IF c.action_intent_id<>'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1' OR c.resource_type<>'participant'
   OR c.operation_class<>'UPDATE' OR c.state NOT IN('PROPOSED','APPROVAL_REQUESTED','APPROVED')
   OR c.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL
   OR c.candidate_document->>'replacementId' IS DISTINCT FROM c.resource_id::text
   OR c.expected_revision<>(CASE WHEN c.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-PLATFORM-SCOPE-PREPARE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
   OR c.candidate_document->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN c.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-PLATFORM-SCOPE-PREPARE'
      THEN 'pc.identity.platform-scope-replacement' ELSE 'pc.identity.platform-scope-replacement-commit' END)
   OR current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'serializable'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
  IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('platform-scope-replacement:'||(c.candidate_document->>'platformContextId'),0))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
  SELECT p.* INTO source FROM openpc.lock_platform_scope_context((c.candidate_document->>'platformContextId')::uuid) p
   WHERE p.owner_participant_id=c.participant_id AND p.state='ACTIVE'
    AND p.authority_epoch::text=c.candidate_document->>'predecessorEpoch'
    AND p.row_version::text=c.candidate_document->>'expectedRootRevision';
  IF source.platform_context_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
  IF c.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-PLATFORM-SCOPE-PREPARE' THEN
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_scope_replacement r WHERE r.platform_context_id=source.platform_context_id
      AND (r.replacement_id=c.resource_id OR (r.state='WITHDRAWING' AND
        c.candidate_document->'supersedes' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('replacementId',r.replacement_id::text,
          'expectedRevision',r.row_version::text,'successorDigest','sha256:'||encode(r.successor_digest,'hex')))))
    OR (c.candidate_document ? 'supersedes' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_scope_replacement r
      WHERE r.platform_context_id=source.platform_context_id AND r.state='WITHDRAWING'
        AND r.replacement_id::text=c.candidate_document#>>'{supersedes,replacementId}'))
    OR (c.candidate_document#>>'{successorScope,validUntilNs}')::numeric<=extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000000
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_scope_replacement r WHERE r.participant_id=c.participant_id
     AND r.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND r.replacement_id=c.resource_id AND r.state='WITHDRAWING' AND r.row_version=1
     AND r.platform_context_id=source.platform_context_id AND r.predecessor_epoch=source.authority_epoch
     AND r.expected_root_revision=source.row_version
     AND (r.candidate#>>'{successorScope,validUntilNs}')::numeric>extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000000)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.idempotency_record r WHERE r.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND r.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND r.principal_id=c.maker_principal_id
    AND r.action_intent_id=c.action_intent_id AND r.catalog_operation_id=c.catalog_operation_id AND r.idempotency_key=c.idempotency_key)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_evidence e WHERE e.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND e.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND e.aggregate_type='platform-scope-replacement'
    AND e.aggregate_id=c.resource_id AND e.catalog_operation_id=c.catalog_operation_id)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event e WHERE e.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND e.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND e.aggregate_type='platform-scope-replacement' AND e.aggregate_id=c.resource_id
    AND c.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-PLATFORM-SCOPE-COMMIT' AND e.aggregate_sequence>1)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
  RETURN;
 END IF;
 IF c.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-QUALIFY-PROVIDER-PROFILE' THEN
  -- Qualification approves an existing provider. Its reset/probe history is
  -- required input, not an effect of this unsubmitted qualification intent.
  IF c.action_intent_id<>'ACT-PROVIDER_APPROVE_QUALIFICATION-V1'
   OR c.resource_type<>'provider-profile' OR c.operation_class<>'APPROVE' OR c.expected_revision<1
   OR c.state NOT IN ('PROPOSED','APPROVAL_REQUESTED','APPROVED') OR c.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL
   OR c.candidate_document->>'targetRef' IS DISTINCT FROM 'urn:openpc:resource:'||c.resource_id::text
   OR c.candidate_document->>'expectedRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM c.expected_revision::text
   OR current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'serializable'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(openpc.signing_canonical_json(jsonb_build_array(
   'mutation-intent',c.participant_id::text,c.privacy_domain_id::text,c.maker_principal_id::text,
   c.action_intent_id,c.catalog_operation_id,c.idempotency_key)),0));
  -- The actual qualification UPDATE takes this same row lock. NOWAIT avoids
  -- reversing its provider/reference lock order; SERIALIZABLE rejects a tuple
  -- newer than this transaction's snapshot before any successor can be issued.
  BEGIN
   SELECT p.* INTO source FROM control.provider_profile p
    WHERE p.participant_id=c.participant_id AND p.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
     AND p.provider_profile_id=c.resource_id FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;
  EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='PC-DATA-6007';
  END;
  IF source.provider_profile_id IS NULL OR source.revision<>c.expected_revision
   OR source.state<>'SHADOW' OR source.qualification_observation_id IS NOT NULL
   OR source.behavior_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM c.candidate_document->>'inputDigest'
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.idempotency_record r WHERE r.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND r.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND r.principal_id=c.maker_principal_id
    AND r.action_intent_id=c.action_intent_id AND r.catalog_operation_id=c.catalog_operation_id
    AND r.idempotency_key=c.idempotency_key)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.configuration_work w WHERE w.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND w.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND w.resource_id=c.resource_id
    AND (w.state NOT IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED') OR w.created_at>=c.created_at))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.provider_probe_observation o WHERE o.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND o.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND o.provider_profile_id=c.resource_id
    AND (o.observed_revision>c.expected_revision OR (o.observed_revision=c.expected_revision AND o.state<>'OBSERVED')))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.audit_occurrence a WHERE a.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND a.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND a.aggregate_id=c.resource_id
    AND (a.after_revision>c.expected_revision OR a.candidate_digest=c.candidate_digest))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_evidence e WHERE e.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND e.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND e.aggregate_id=c.resource_id
    AND (e.aggregate_version>c.expected_revision OR e.candidate_digest=c.candidate_digest))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event e WHERE e.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND e.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND e.aggregate_id=c.resource_id AND e.created_at>=c.created_at)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.receipt_signing_attempt a JOIN control.business_transition_profile p USING(profile_digest)
    WHERE a.participant_id=c.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
     AND p.catalog_operation_id=c.catalog_operation_id AND NOT EXISTS(
      SELECT 1 FROM control.idempotency_record r WHERE r.participant_id=a.participant_id
       AND r.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND r.operation_id=a.operation_id AND r.terminal_state='COMMITTED'))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
  RETURN;
 END IF;
 IF c.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-ADMIT-INDEXER-PROFILE' THEN
  IF c.action_intent_id<>'ACT-INDEXER_APPROVE_PROFILE-V1'
   OR c.resource_type<>'indexer-profile' OR c.operation_class<>'APPROVE' OR c.expected_revision<1
   OR c.state NOT IN ('PROPOSED','APPROVAL_REQUESTED','APPROVED') OR c.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL
   OR c.candidate_document->>'targetRef' IS DISTINCT FROM 'urn:openpc:resource:'||c.resource_id::text
   OR c.candidate_document->>'expectedRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM c.expected_revision::text
   OR current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'serializable'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(openpc.signing_canonical_json(jsonb_build_array(
   'mutation-intent',c.participant_id::text,c.privacy_domain_id::text,c.maker_principal_id::text,
   c.action_intent_id,c.catalog_operation_id,c.idempotency_key)),0));
  BEGIN
   SELECT i.* INTO source FROM control.indexer_profile i
    WHERE i.participant_id=c.participant_id AND i.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
     AND i.indexer_profile_id=c.resource_id FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;
  EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='PC-DATA-6007';
  END;
  IF source.indexer_profile_id IS NULL OR source.revision<>c.expected_revision
   OR source.state<>'REGISTERED'
   OR source.method_profile_digest IS DISTINCT FROM c.candidate_document->>'inputDigest'
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.idempotency_record r WHERE r.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND r.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND r.principal_id=c.maker_principal_id
    AND r.action_intent_id=c.action_intent_id AND r.catalog_operation_id=c.catalog_operation_id
    AND r.idempotency_key=c.idempotency_key)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.configuration_work w WHERE w.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND w.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND w.resource_id=c.resource_id
    AND w.work_kind='INDEXER_ADMISSION')
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.audit_occurrence a WHERE a.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND a.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND a.aggregate_id=c.resource_id
    AND (a.after_revision>c.expected_revision OR a.candidate_digest=c.candidate_digest))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_evidence e WHERE e.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND e.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND e.aggregate_id=c.resource_id
    AND (e.aggregate_version>c.expected_revision OR e.candidate_digest=c.candidate_digest))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event e WHERE e.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND e.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND e.aggregate_id=c.resource_id AND e.created_at>=c.created_at)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.receipt_signing_attempt a JOIN control.business_transition_profile p USING(profile_digest)
    WHERE a.participant_id=c.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
     AND p.catalog_operation_id=c.catalog_operation_id AND NOT EXISTS(
      SELECT 1 FROM control.idempotency_record r WHERE r.participant_id=a.participant_id
       AND r.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND r.operation_id=a.operation_id AND r.terminal_state='COMMITTED'))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
  RETURN;
 END IF;
 IF c.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-ENVELOPE-CREATE' THEN
  -- Qualified only for an inert same-Participant ordinary Platform-root intent.
  -- Preserve its original bounded scopes; resumption never extends business expiry.

   OR coalesce((c.candidate_document#>>'{grantable,validUntilNs}')::numeric,0)<=extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000000

    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.idempotency_record r WHERE r.participant_id=a.participant_id

 IF c.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATE' THEN

   OR c.operation_class<>'CREATE' OR c.expected_revision<>1
   OR c.state NOT IN ('PROPOSED','APPROVAL_REQUESTED','APPROVED') OR c.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL
   OR c.candidate_document->>'targetRef' IS DISTINCT FROM 'urn:openpc:resource:'||c.resource_id::text
   OR c.candidate_document->>'expectedRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM c.expected_revision::text
   OR current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'serializable'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(openpc.signing_canonical_json(jsonb_build_array(
   'mutation-intent',c.participant_id::text,c.privacy_domain_id::text,c.maker_principal_id::text,

    AND i.module_installation_id=c.resource_id FOR UPDATE OF i;

   OR source.lifecycle_evaluation_digest IS NOT NULL
   OR c.candidate_document->>'inputDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(

   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.audit_occurrence a WHERE a.participant_id=c.participant_id

   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_evidence e WHERE e.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND e.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND (e.candidate_digest=c.candidate_digest
     OR (e.aggregate_id=c.resource_id AND (e.aggregate_version>c.expected_revision OR e.catalog_operation_id=c.catalog_operation_id))))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event e WHERE e.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND e.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND e.aggregate_id=c.resource_id AND e.aggregate_sequence>c.expected_revision)

    WHERE a.participant_id=c.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
     AND p.catalog_operation_id=c.catalog_operation_id AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.idempotency_record r

 resource_registration:=(c.catalog_operation_id,c.action_intent_id,c.resource_type,c.operation_class) IN (

      OR (c.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-ASSIGNMENT-CREATE' AND c.action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANT_CREATE_MEMBER-V1' AND c.resource_type='principal')
      OR (c.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-CREATE-EVIDENCE-HOLD' AND c.action_intent_id='ACT-EVIDENCE_HOLDS_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1'

      OR (c.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-CREATE-PARTICIPANT-EVIDENCE-HOLD' AND c.action_intent_id='ACT-EVIDENCE_HOLDS_CREATE_PARTICIPANT-V1'
          AND c.resource_type='evidence-holds' AND c.candidate_document->'selector'->>'type'='PARTICIPANT')
      OR (c.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-ACTIVATE-RETENTION-POLICY'
          AND c.action_intent_id='ACT-RETENTION_POLICIES_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1' AND c.resource_type='retention-policies')

      OR (c.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-DELETE-RUNTIME-ARTIFACT-BATCH'

 IF c.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-DELETE-RUNTIME-ARTIFACT-BATCH' AND NOT

       AND c.candidate_document->>'targetRevision' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,18}$'

     'configurationBytes',(openpc.runtime_artifact_input_information(i.runtime_configuration_input_id)->>'byteLength')::integer,
     'resourceBindingsDigest','sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(i.resource_bindings),'UTF8')),'hex'),
     'createdAt',to_char(i.created_at at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'))
    AND openpc.runtime_artifact_input_information(i.runtime_configuration_input_id)->'bytesMatch'='true'::jsonb)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_artifact_retirement r WHERE r.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND r.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND (r.deletion_job_id=c.resource_id
     OR r.runtime_configuration_input_id::text=retirement_selection->'source'->>'runtimeConfigurationInputId'
     OR r.configuration_digest=retirement_selection->'source'->>'configurationDigest'))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.deletion_job j WHERE j.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND j.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND (j.deletion_job_id=c.resource_id
     OR (j.target_data_class='RUNTIME_ARTIFACT' AND
      (j.selection->'source'->>'runtimeConfigurationInputId'=retirement_selection->'source'->>'runtimeConfigurationInputId'
       OR j.selection->'source'->>'configurationDigest'=retirement_selection->'source'->>'configurationDigest'))))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF c.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-ADMIT-STORE-RETIREMENT' THEN
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('evidence-lifecycle:'||c.participant_id::text,0));
  -- An admitted UNKNOWN outcome must reconcile its original dispatch; absence
  -- of a terminal native receipt never permits fresh approval or re-dispatch.
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM control.store_retirement_admission a
    WHERE a.participant_id=c.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
      AND (a.attempt_id=c.resource_id OR a.approval_request_id IN
        (SELECT r.approval_request_id FROM control.approval_request r
          WHERE r.participant_id=c.participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
            AND r.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE' AND r.subject_id=c.mutation_candidate_id)))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF c.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-DELETE-PROJECTION-BATCH' THEN
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('evidence-lifecycle:'||c.participant_id::text,0));
  selected:=c.candidate_document->'selection';
  IF (selected->>'version'='OPENPC_PROJECTION_DELETION_BATCH_V1'
    AND selected->>'participantId'='urn:openpc:participant:'||c.participant_id::text
    AND selected->>'privacyDomainId'=c.privacy_domain_id::text
    AND selected->>'targetDatabase'='openpc_control' AND selected->>'deletionMode'='PROJECTION_DELETE'
    AND ((selected->>'dataClass'='SEARCH_PROJECTION' AND selected->>'sourceKind' IN ('AUTHENTICATION_CATALOGUE','RETENTION_POLICY_CATALOGUE'))
      OR (selected->>'dataClass'='NORMALIZED_JSON_PROJECTION'
        AND selected->>'sourceKind' IN ('RPC_PRE_ADMISSION_DENIAL','RPC_CLOSED_TRANSITION','FACT_PROVENANCE','DEPLOYMENT_PROVENANCE')))) IS NOT TRUE
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM control.deletion_job j WHERE j.participant_id=c.participant_id
     AND j.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND (j.deletion_job_id=c.resource_id OR j.selection=selected))
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM control.evidence_projection_retirement r WHERE r.participant_id=c.participant_id
     AND r.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND r.data_class=selected->>'dataClass'
     AND 'urn:openpc:resource:'||r.evidence_id::text=selected->>'evidenceId')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
  -- Recovery proves absence of this local effect without borrowing the raw
  -- source-disclosure authority of a deletion execution. Full source, retention,
  -- hold, finality and continuation admission still runs at actual execution.
  SELECT * INTO source FROM control.evidence_catalogue e WHERE e.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND e.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND 'urn:openpc:resource:'||e.evidence_id::text=selected->>'evidenceId'
    AND e.stream_id=selected->>'streamId' AND e.record_id=selected->>'recordId'
    AND e.segment_id::text=selected->>'segmentId' AND e.sequence::text=selected->>'sequence'
    AND e.receipt_digest=selected->>'sourceReceiptDigest';
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
  IF (selected->>'sourceKind'='AUTHENTICATION_CATALOGUE' AND source.source_format='OPENPC_AUTHENTICATION_OCCURRENCE_V1'
    AND source.evidence_class='AUTHENTICATION') OR (selected->>'sourceKind'='RETENTION_POLICY_CATALOGUE'
    AND source.evidence_class='BUSINESS_TRANSITION') THEN
   SELECT openpc.evidence_catalogue_projection(e) INTO projection FROM control.evidence_catalogue e
    WHERE e.participant_id=c.participant_id AND e.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND e.evidence_id=source.evidence_id;
  ELSIF selected->>'sourceKind'='FACT_PROVENANCE' AND source.source_format='OPENPC_CANONICAL_FACT_V1' AND source.evidence_class='EFFECT' THEN
   SELECT p.projection INTO projection FROM control.evidence_fact_provenance p WHERE p.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND p.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND p.stream_id=source.stream_id AND p.record_id=source.record_id
    AND p.projection_digest=selected->>'projectionDigest';
  ELSIF selected->>'sourceKind'='DEPLOYMENT_PROVENANCE' AND source.source_format='PC-DEPLOYMENT-JOURNAL-PROJECTION-1' AND source.evidence_class='EFFECT' THEN
   SELECT p.projection INTO projection FROM control.evidence_deployment_provenance p WHERE p.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND p.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND p.stream_id=source.stream_id AND p.record_id=source.record_id
    AND p.projection_digest=selected->>'projectionDigest';
  ELSIF selected->>'sourceKind' IN ('RPC_PRE_ADMISSION_DENIAL','RPC_CLOSED_TRANSITION')
    AND source.source_format='OPENPC_RPC_DECISION_TRANSITION_V1' AND source.evidence_class='EFFECT' THEN
   SELECT p.projection INTO projection FROM control.evidence_rpc_provenance p WHERE p.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND p.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND p.stream_id=source.stream_id AND p.record_id=source.record_id
    AND p.projection_digest=selected->>'projectionDigest';
  END IF;
  IF projection IS NULL OR ('sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(projection),'UTF8')),'hex'))
      IS DISTINCT FROM selected->>'projectionDigest'
    OR octet_length(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(projection),'UTF8'))::text IS DISTINCT FROM selected->>'projectionBytes'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM control.idempotency_record r WHERE r.participant_id=c.participant_id
      AND r.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND r.principal_id=c.maker_principal_id
      AND r.action_intent_id=c.action_intent_id AND r.catalog_operation_id=c.catalog_operation_id
      AND r.idempotency_key=c.idempotency_key)
 OR (c.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-ASSIGNMENT-CREATE' AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM control.assignment a WHERE a.participant_id=c.participant_id AND a.assignment_id=c.resource_id))
 OR (c.catalog_operation_id='MOD-OP-REGISTER' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM control.module_installation i JOIN control.module_version v USING(module_version_id)
      WHERE i.participant_id=c.participant_id AND i.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
      AND (i.module_installation_id=c.resource_id OR (v.module_id=c.candidate_document->>'name'
        AND v.semantic_version=c.candidate_document->>'semanticVersion'))))
 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM control.configuration_work w WHERE w.participant_id=c.participant_id
      AND w.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND (w.resource_id=c.resource_id OR w.input_digest='sha256:'||encode(c.candidate_digest,'hex')))
 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM control.audit_occurrence a WHERE a.participant_id=c.participant_id
      AND a.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND (a.aggregate_id=c.resource_id OR a.candidate_digest=c.candidate_digest))
 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_evidence e WHERE e.participant_id=c.participant_id
      AND e.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND (e.aggregate_id=c.resource_id OR
        (e.catalog_operation_id=c.catalog_operation_id AND e.candidate_digest=c.candidate_digest)))
 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event e WHERE e.participant_id=c.participant_id
      AND e.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND e.aggregate_id=c.resource_id)
 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM control.receipt_signing_attempt a JOIN control.business_transition_profile p USING(profile_digest)
      WHERE a.participant_id=c.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
        AND p.catalog_operation_id=c.catalog_operation_id AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM control.idempotency_record r WHERE r.participant_id=a.participant_id
            AND r.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND r.operation_id=a.operation_id AND r.terminal_state='COMMITTED'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.assert_notification_async_worker_owner()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF NOT pg_has_role(current_user,'openpc_control_runtime','USAGE')
 OR current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed' OR current_setting('row_security')<>'on'
 OR current_setting('session_replication_role')<>'origin'
 OR openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-EVIDENCE_EXPORT_RECORDS-V1'
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user AND (rolsuper OR rolbypassrls))
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_class WHERE oid='control.notification_async_work'::regclass AND relrowsecurity AND relforcerowsecurity)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_class WHERE oid='control.notification_async_work_transition'::regclass AND relrowsecurity AND relforcerowsecurity)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (VALUES
 ('control.notification_async_work'::regclass,'notification_async_work_guard','openpc.guard_notification_async_work()',31),
 ('control.notification_async_work'::regclass,'notification_async_work_retain','openpc.retain_notification_async_work_transition()',21),
 ('control.notification_async_work'::regclass,'notification_async_work_no_truncate','openpc.deny_notification_async_truncate()',34),
 ('control.notification_async_work_transition'::regclass,'notification_async_transition_guard','openpc.guard_notification_async_transition()',31),
 ('control.notification_async_work_transition'::regclass,'notification_async_transition_no_truncate','openpc.deny_notification_async_truncate()',34)) required(rel,name,fn,kind)
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgrelid=required.rel AND t.tgname=required.name
 AND t.tgfoid=to_regprocedure(required.fn) AND t.tgtype=required.kind AND t.tgenabled='O' AND NOT t.tgisinternal))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIFICATION-ASYNC-OWNER'; END IF;
 IF to_regprocedure('openpc.assert_notification_async_work_current(control.notification_async_work)') IS NULL
 OR to_regprocedure('openpc.publish_notification_async_work_proof(uuid,numeric)') IS NULL
 OR to_regprocedure('openpc.check_notification_async_work_proof(uuid,numeric)') IS NULL
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OPS_NOTIFICATION_ASYNC_PROOF_OWNER_UNBOUND'; END IF;
END $function$

 -- cryptographically verified observation before either replay or mutation.

 PERFORM openpc.check_notification_completion_receipt_admission(event,''PUBLISH'',signing.observation);
 PERFORM openpc.check_notification_completion_disposition_signed(event,d.transition);

 SELECT * INTO STRICT e FROM control.outbox_event WHERE participant_id=d.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=d.privacy_domain_id AND event_id=event;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.assert_notification_delivery_budget_owner()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed' OR current_setting('row_security')<>'on'
 OR current_setting('session_replication_role')<>'origin'
 OR NOT pg_has_role(current_user,'openpc_control_runtime','USAGE')
 OR current_setting('openpc.action_intent_id')<>'ACT-EVIDENCE_EXPORT_RECORDS-V1'
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user AND (rolsuper OR rolbypassrls))
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_class WHERE oid='control.notification_delivery'::regclass AND relrowsecurity AND relforcerowsecurity)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='control.notification_delivery'::regclass
   AND tgname='notification_delivery_budget_guard' AND tgenabled IN ('O','A')
   AND tgfoid='openpc.guard_notification_delivery_budget()'::regprocedure)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='control.notification_delivery'::regclass
   AND tgname='notification_delivery_budget_truncate_guard' AND tgenabled IN ('O','A')
   AND tgfoid='openpc.deny_notification_delivery_effect()'::regprocedure)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIFICATION-DELIVERY-BUDGET-UNAVAILABLE'; END IF;
 -- Installation-only checks avoid atomic -> signing -> preparation -> budget recursion.
 PERFORM openpc.assert_notification_delivery_start_atomic_guards();
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.assert_notification_delivery_cancellation_owner()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE lock_name text;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed' OR current_setting('row_security')<>'on'
 OR current_setting('session_replication_role')<>'origin' OR NOT pg_has_role(current_user,'openpc_control_runtime','USAGE')
 OR current_setting('openpc.action_intent_id',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'ACT-EVIDENCE_EXPORT_RECORDS-V1'
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user AND (rolsuper OR rolbypassrls))
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_class WHERE oid='control.notification_delivery_cancellation'::regclass AND relrowsecurity AND relforcerowsecurity)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_class WHERE oid='control.notification_cancellation_signing'::regclass AND relrowsecurity AND relforcerowsecurity)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='control.notification_cancellation_signing'::regclass AND tgname='notification_cancel_signing_guard' AND tgenabled IN ('O','A') AND tgtype=23 AND tgfoid='openpc.guard_notification_cancellation_signing()'::regprocedure)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='control.notification_cancellation_signing'::regclass AND tgname='notification_cancel_signing_immutable' AND tgenabled IN ('O','A') AND tgtype=42 AND tgfoid='openpc.deny_notification_delivery_cancellation_mutation()'::regprocedure)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='control.notification_delivery_cancellation'::regclass AND tgname='notification_cancellation_insert' AND tgenabled IN ('O','A') AND tgtype=7 AND tgfoid='openpc.guard_notification_delivery_cancellation()'::regprocedure)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='control.notification_delivery_cancellation'::regclass AND tgname='notification_cancellation_immutable' AND tgenabled IN ('O','A') AND tgtype=58 AND tgfoid='openpc.deny_notification_delivery_cancellation_mutation()'::regprocedure)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='control.notification_delivery_cancellation'::regclass AND tgname='notification_cancellation_complete' AND tgenabled IN ('O','A') AND tgtype=5 AND tgdeferrable AND tginitdeferred)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIFICATION-CANCELLATION-OWNER'; END IF;
 FOREACH lock_name IN ARRAY ARRAY['evidence-lifecycle:'||openpc.current_participant_id()::text,
 'notification-worker:'||openpc.current_participant_id()::text||':'||openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()::text] LOOP
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_locks l WHERE l.pid=pg_backend_pid() AND l.locktype='advisory' AND l.granted
   AND l.database=(SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database())
   AND l.classid=((hashtextextended(lock_name,0)>>32)&4294967295)::oid AND l.objid=(hashtextextended(lock_name,0)&4294967295)::oid AND l.objsubid=1
   AND l.mode=CASE WHEN lock_name LIKE 'evidence-lifecycle:%' THEN 'ExclusiveLock' ELSE 'ShareLock' END)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIFICATION-CANCELLATION-FENCE'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.assert_notification_endpoint_persistence(p_operation text, p_profile bytea)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE required record; admitted control.business_transition_profile%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 IF p_operation NOT IN ('CFG-OP-CREATE-NOTIFICATION-ENDPOINT','CFG-OP-UPDATE-NOTIFICATION-ENDPOINT','CFG-OP-VERIFY-NOTIFICATION-ENDPOINT')
  OR NOT pg_has_role(current_user,'openpc_control_runtime','MEMBER')
  OR has_table_privilege(current_user,'control.installed_notification_channel','INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-INTEGRATION-5001'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT admitted FROM control.business_transition_profile WHERE catalog_operation_id=p_operation AND profile_version=1
  AND profile_digest=p_profile AND aggregate_type='notification-endpoint' AND action_intent_id=current_setting('openpc.action_intent_id');
 IF admitted.profile_digest<>sha256(admitted.definition_canonical_json) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-INTEGRATION-5001'; END IF;
 FOR required IN SELECT * FROM (VALUES
  ('control.notification_endpoint','notification_endpoint_mutation_guard','openpc.guard_notification_endpoint_mutation()',false),
  ('control.notification_endpoint','notification_endpoint_effect_receipt','openpc.check_notification_endpoint_effect_receipt()',true),
  ('control.installed_notification_channel','notification_channel_installation_guard','openpc.guard_notification_channel_installation()',false),
  ('control.audit_occurrence','business_receipt_typed','openpc.guard_business_receipt()',false),
  ('control.audit_occurrence','business_receipt_complete','openpc.check_business_receipt_completion()',true),
  ('control.outbox_event','business_outbox_payload','openpc.guard_business_outbox()',false)
 ) v(table_name,trigger_name,function_name,deferred)
 LOOP
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_proc f ON f.oid=t.tgfoid
   WHERE c.oid=to_regclass(required.table_name) AND t.tgname=required.trigger_name AND t.tgenabled IN ('O','A')
    AND f.oid=to_regprocedure(required.function_name) AND t.tgdeferrable=required.deferred AND t.tginitdeferred=required.deferred
    AND c.relrowsecurity AND c.relforcerowsecurity AND NOT f.prosecdef)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-INTEGRATION-5001'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF p_operation='CFG-OP-UPDATE-NOTIFICATION-ENDPOINT' AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='control.notification_endpoint_candidate'::regclass
    AND tgname='notification_candidate_guard' AND tgfoid='openpc.guard_notification_candidate()'::regprocedure AND tgenabled IN ('O','A'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-INTEGRATION-5001'; END IF;
 IF p_operation='CFG-OP-VERIFY-NOTIFICATION-ENDPOINT' THEN
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='control.notification_verification_attempt'::regclass
      AND tgname='notification_verification_attempt_guard' AND tgfoid='openpc.guard_notification_verification_attempt()'::regprocedure AND tgenabled IN ('O','A'))
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='control.notification_verification_attempt'::regclass
      AND tgname='notification_verification_attachment' AND tgfoid='openpc.check_notification_verification_attachment()'::regprocedure AND tgenabled IN ('O','A') AND tgdeferrable AND tginitdeferred)
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='control.notification_endpoint_verification'::regclass
      AND tgname='notification_verification_row_guard' AND tgfoid='openpc.guard_notification_verification_row()'::regprocedure AND tgenabled IN ('O','A'))
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='control.notification_verification_attempt'::regclass
      AND conname='notification_verification_attachment_operation_fk' AND condeferrable AND condeferred AND convalidated)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-INTEGRATION-5001'; END IF;
 END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.assert_notification_endpoint_receipt(receipt control.audit_occurrence)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE item control.notification_endpoint%ROWTYPE; before_projection jsonb; after_projection jsonb; registration control.installed_notification_channel%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 IF receipt.profile_version<>1 OR receipt.aggregate_type<>'notification-endpoint' OR receipt.catalog_operation_id NOT IN
  ('CFG-OP-CREATE-NOTIFICATION-ENDPOINT','CFG-OP-UPDATE-NOTIFICATION-ENDPOINT','CFG-OP-VERIFY-NOTIFICATION-ENDPOINT')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-NOTIFICATION-ENDPOINT-PROFILE'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT item FROM control.notification_endpoint WHERE participant_id=receipt.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND endpoint_id=receipt.aggregate_id;
 -- The repository retains this scope fence before its SERIALIZABLE snapshot.
 -- Reacquire nonblocking through COMMIT; do not request runtime UPDATE privilege.
 IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock_shared(hashtextextended('notification-installation:'||item.participant_id::text||':'||item.privacy_domain_id::text,0))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT registration FROM control.installed_notification_channel n
   WHERE n.participant_id=item.participant_id AND n.privacy_domain_id=item.privacy_domain_id
    AND n.credential_ref=item.credential_ref AND n.channel=item.channel AND n.destination_ref=item.destination_ref
    AND n.channel_profile_digest=item.channel_profile_digest AND n.state='ACTIVE';
 IF (openpc.business_cbor(decode(registration.channel_signed->>'payloadHex','hex'))->>'6')::numeric>floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000)
   OR (openpc.business_cbor(decode(registration.channel_signed->>'payloadHex','hex'))->>'7')::numeric<=floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000)
   OR registration.credential->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ACTIVE'
   OR (registration.credential->>'validFromMs')::numeric>floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000)
   OR (registration.credential->>'validUntilMs')::numeric<=floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000)
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.credential c JOIN control.principal p ON p.participant_id=c.participant_id AND p.principal_id=c.principal_id
     WHERE c.participant_id=item.participant_id AND c.credential_id=registration.workload_credential_id
       AND c.principal_id=registration.principal_id AND c.credential_epoch=registration.workload_epoch
       AND c.state='ACTIVE' AND c.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND c.audience=registration.workload_id
       AND c.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND c.valid_until>clock_timestamp() AND p.state='ACTIVE' AND p.kind='WORKLOAD')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-NOTIFICATION-CURRENT-REGISTRATION'; END IF;
 before_projection:=openpc.business_cbor(receipt.before_state_preimage)->8;
 after_projection:=openpc.business_cbor(receipt.after_state_preimage)->8;
 IF receipt.after_existence<>1 OR receipt.after_revision<>item.revision OR item.arbitrary_egress
  OR after_projection IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.notification_endpoint_business_projection(item)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-NOTIFICATION-ENDPOINT-ACTUAL-STATE'; END IF;
 IF receipt.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-CREATE-NOTIFICATION-ENDPOINT' THEN
  IF receipt.before_existence<>0 OR receipt.before_revision<>0 OR receipt.after_revision<>1
    OR item.state<>'DISABLED' OR item.verification_id IS NOT NULL
    OR item.candidate_digest IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(receipt.candidate_digest,'hex')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-NOTIFICATION-ENDPOINT-CREATE'; END IF;
 ELSE
  IF receipt.before_existence<>1 OR receipt.after_revision<>receipt.before_revision+1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-NOTIFICATION-ENDPOINT-REVISION'; END IF;
  IF receipt.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-UPDATE-NOTIFICATION-ENDPOINT' THEN
   IF before_projection->>'1'='RETIRED' OR item.verification_id IS NOT NULL
     OR item.state IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN before_projection->>'1'='QUARANTINED' THEN 'QUARANTINED' ELSE 'DISABLED' END)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-NOTIFICATION-ENDPOINT-REPLACEMENT'; END IF;
   IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.notification_endpoint_candidate c
     JOIN control.idempotency_record i ON i.participant_id=c.participant_id AND i.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND i.principal_id=c.principal_id
     WHERE c.participant_id=item.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=item.privacy_domain_id AND c.endpoint_id=item.endpoint_id
       AND c.replacement_digest=item.candidate_digest AND i.operation_id=receipt.operation_id
       AND c.expires_at_ms>floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000)
       AND (c.predecessor->>'revision')::numeric=receipt.before_revision
       AND c.predecessor->>'channel'=before_projection->>'0'
       AND c.predecessor->>'destinationRef'=before_projection->>'2'
       AND openpc.business_bytes(decode(substr(c.predecessor->>'channelProfileDigest',8),'hex'))=before_projection->'3'
       AND c.predecessor->>'credentialRef'=before_projection->>'4'
       AND c.construction->'credential'=registration.credential
       AND c.construction->'binding'=jsonb_build_object('participantId',item.participant_id,'privacyDomainId',item.privacy_domain_id,
         'endpointId',item.endpoint_id,'revision',item.revision::text,'channel',item.channel,'destinationRef',item.destination_ref,
         'channelProfileDigest',item.channel_profile_digest,'credentialRef',item.credential_ref))

 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_class WHERE oid='control.notification_delivery_outcome_signing'::regclass AND relrowsecurity AND relforcerowsecurity)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='control.notification_delivery_outcome_signing'::regclass AND tgname='notification_outcome_signing_guard' AND tgenabled IN ('O','A') AND tgtype=23 AND tgfoid='openpc.guard_notification_outcome_signing()'::regprocedure)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='control.notification_delivery_outcome_signing'::regclass AND tgname='notification_outcome_signing_immutable' AND tgenabled IN ('O','A') AND tgtype=42 AND tgfoid='openpc.deny_notification_delivery_outcome_mutation()'::regprocedure)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIFICATION-OUTCOME-SIGNING-OWNER'; END IF;
 FOREACH lock_name IN ARRAY ARRAY['evidence-lifecycle:'||openpc.current_participant_id()::text,
 'notification-worker:'||openpc.current_participant_id()::text||':'||openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()::text] LOOP
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_locks l WHERE l.pid=pg_backend_pid() AND l.locktype='advisory' AND l.granted
   AND l.database=(SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database())
   AND l.classid=((hashtextextended(lock_name,0)>>32)&4294967295)::oid AND l.objid=(hashtextextended(lock_name,0)&4294967295)::oid AND l.objsubid=1
   AND l.mode=CASE WHEN lock_name LIKE 'evidence-lifecycle:%' THEN 'ExclusiveLock' ELSE 'ShareLock' END)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIFICATION-OUTCOME-SIGNING-FENCE'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.assert_notification_receipt_signer_owner()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF current_setting('session_replication_role')<>'origin' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_class WHERE oid='control.notification_receipt_signer_installation'::regclass AND relrowsecurity AND relforcerowsecurity)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='control.notification_receipt_signer_installation'::regclass AND tgname='notification_receipt_signer_installation_guard' AND tgenabled IN ('O','A') AND NOT tgisinternal)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='control.notification_receipt_signer_installation'::regclass AND tgname='notification_receipt_signer_truncate_guard' AND tgenabled IN ('O','A') AND NOT tgisinternal)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIFICATION-RECEIPT-SIGNER-OWNER'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.assert_platform_recovery_approval_resume(n control.mutation_candidate)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE old_attempt control.mutation_candidate; fresh control.platform_recovery_case;
 new_envelope control.authority_envelope; new_enrollment control.platform_recovery_enrollment;
 proof_count integer; proofs jsonb[]; proof_deadline timestamptz; expected_request jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'serializable'
  OR current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true) IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
  OR openpc.current_action_intent_id() IS DISTINCT FROM 'ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
  OR jsonb_typeof(n.resume_request) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR jsonb_typeof(n.resume_request->'platformReceivingProof') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR n.resume_request->'platformReceivingProof' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(
   'mfaChallengeId',n.resume_request#>'{platformReceivingProof,mfaChallengeId}',
   'verificationOperationId',n.resume_request#>'{platformReceivingProof,verificationOperationId}',
   'evidenceDigest',n.resume_request#>'{platformReceivingProof,evidenceDigest}')
  OR jsonb_typeof(n.resume_request#>'{platformReceivingProof,mfaChallengeId}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR jsonb_typeof(n.resume_request#>'{platformReceivingProof,verificationOperationId}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR jsonb_typeof(n.resume_request#>'{platformReceivingProof,evidenceDigest}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR (n.resume_request#>>'{platformReceivingProof,mfaChallengeId}') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  OR (n.resume_request#>>'{platformReceivingProof,verificationOperationId}') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  OR (n.resume_request#>>'{platformReceivingProof,evidenceDigest}') !~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT old_attempt FROM control.mutation_candidate
  WHERE mutation_candidate_id=n.predecessor_candidate_id FOR UPDATE;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT new_envelope FROM control.authority_envelope
  WHERE participant_id=n.participant_id AND authority_envelope_id=n.maker_authority_envelope_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT fresh FROM control.platform_recovery_case
  WHERE participant_id=n.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
   AND recovery_id=new_envelope.recovery_case_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT new_enrollment FROM control.platform_recovery_enrollment
  WHERE enrollment_id=fresh.enrollment_id;
 IF new_enrollment.source_purpose IS DISTINCT FROM 'ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY_CONTINUATION'
  OR new_enrollment.document->>'schemaVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM '3'
  OR new_enrollment.document->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'pc.identity.platform-recovery-enrollment'
  OR new_enrollment.document->>'assurance' IS DISTINCT FROM 'LOCAL_QA_VIRTUAL_AUTHENTICATOR'
  OR new_enrollment.document_digest IS DISTINCT FROM fresh.enrollment_digest
  OR new_enrollment.row_version IS DISTINCT FROM fresh.enrollment_revision
  OR fresh.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'ACTIVE' OR fresh.activated_at IS NULL
  OR fresh.intent->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'pc.identity.platform-recovery-intent'
  OR NOT fresh.intent ? 'continuation'
  OR fresh.intent ? 'completionSourceDigest'
  OR new_enrollment.document#>'{source}' ? 'activatedHandoff'
  OR openpc.platform_recovery_continuation_current(n.participant_id,fresh.enrollment_id,
    fresh.intent->'continuation',fresh.intent->'preparation') IS DISTINCT FROM true
  OR new_envelope.representation IS DISTINCT FROM 'RECOVERY_V1'
  OR new_envelope.principal_id IS DISTINCT FROM n.maker_principal_id
  OR new_envelope.authority_epoch IS DISTINCT FROM n.maker_authority_epoch
  OR new_envelope.delegation_epoch IS DISTINCT FROM n.maker_delegation_epoch
  OR openpc.platform_recovery_envelope_current(new_envelope.authority_envelope_id) IS DISTINCT FROM true
  OR openpc.platform_recovery_approval_resume_subject_visible(n.participant_id,n.privacy_domain_id,
    n.maker_principal_id,n.maker_authority_envelope_id,n.predecessor_approval_id) IS DISTINCT FROM true
  OR n.catalog_operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'ID-OP-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATE'
  OR n.action_intent_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'ACT-PARTICIPANT_ACTIVATE_CONTEXT-V1'
  OR n.resource_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'participant' OR n.operation_class IS DISTINCT FROM 'ACTIVATE'
  OR n.expected_revision IS DISTINCT FROM 3 OR n.attempt IS DISTINCT FROM old_attempt.attempt+1
  OR n.state NOT IN ('PROPOSED','APPROVAL_REQUESTED') OR n.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL
  OR old_attempt.state NOT IN ('APPROVAL_REQUESTED','APPROVED') OR old_attempt.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL
  OR n.predecessor_approval_id IS NULL OR n.resume_operation_id IS NULL
  OR row(n.participant_id,n.privacy_domain_id,n.action_intent_id,n.catalog_operation_id,n.resource_type,
     n.operation_class,n.resource_id,n.candidate_digest,n.candidate_document,n.expected_revision,n.idempotency_key,n.maker_principal_id)
   IS DISTINCT FROM row(old_attempt.participant_id,old_attempt.privacy_domain_id,old_attempt.action_intent_id,
     old_attempt.catalog_operation_id,old_attempt.resource_type,old_attempt.operation_class,old_attempt.resource_id,
     old_attempt.candidate_digest,old_attempt.candidate_document,old_attempt.expected_revision,old_attempt.idempotency_key,old_attempt.maker_principal_id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 PERFORM openpc.assert_mutation_resume_no_effect(old_attempt.mutation_candidate_id);
 -- A receiving proof must be durably verified after this new case's activation.
 SELECT count(*),array_agg(jsonb_build_object('mfaChallengeId',m.mfa_challenge_id::text,
   'verificationOperationId',verification.operation_id::text,'evidenceDigest','sha256:'||encode(verification.evidence_digest,'hex'))),
   min(least(m.expires_at,
     case when proof_session.step_up_mfa_challenge_id is null then m.consumed_at+interval '5 minutes'
       else coalesce(openpc.session_step_up_valid_until(m.participant_id,m.session_id,m.principal_id),'-infinity'::timestamptz) end,
     coalesce(credential.valid_until,'infinity'::timestamptz)))
  INTO proof_count,proofs,proof_deadline FROM control.mfa_challenge m
 JOIN control.session proof_session ON proof_session.participant_id=m.participant_id
  AND proof_session.session_id=m.session_id AND proof_session.principal_id=m.principal_id
 JOIN control.credential credential ON credential.participant_id=m.participant_id AND credential.credential_id=m.signer_credential_id
  AND credential.principal_id=m.principal_id AND credential.kind='WEBAUTHN' AND credential.state='ACTIVE'
  AND credential.credential_epoch=m.signer_credential_epoch AND credential.valid_from<=clock_timestamp()
  AND (credential.valid_until IS NULL OR credential.valid_until>clock_timestamp())
  AND sha256(credential.public_key_spki_der)=credential.public_key_digest
 JOIN control.mutation_evidence verification ON verification.participant_id=m.participant_id
  AND verification.mfa_challenge_id=m.mfa_challenge_id AND verification.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
  AND verification.principal_id=n.maker_principal_id AND verification.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WEBAUTHN-VERIFY'
  AND verification.action_intent_id='ACT-IDENTITY_UPDATE_STEP_UP-V1'
  AND verification.aggregate_type='webauthn-verification' AND verification.aggregate_id=n.maker_session_id
  AND verification.signer_credential_id=m.signer_credential_id AND verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest IS NOT NULL
  AND verification.evidence_digest=sha256(verification.evidence_cbor) AND verification.occurred_at>=greatest(fresh.activated_at,new_envelope.valid_from)
  AND verification.occurred_at>=m.consumed_at AND verification.occurred_at<=clock_timestamp()
  AND verification.bound_participant_epoch=n.maker_participant_epoch AND verification.bound_principal_epoch=n.maker_principal_epoch
  AND verification.bound_authority_envelope_id=n.maker_authority_envelope_id AND verification.bound_envelope_epoch=n.maker_authority_epoch
  AND verification.bound_assignment_id=n.maker_assignment_id
 JOIN control.idempotency_record committed ON committed.participant_id=verification.participant_id
  AND committed.privacy_domain_id=verification.privacy_domain_id AND committed.operation_id=verification.operation_id
  AND committed.principal_id=verification.principal_id AND committed.action_intent_id=verification.action_intent_id
  AND committed.catalog_operation_id=verification.catalog_operation_id
  AND committed.input_digest=verification.candidate_digest AND committed.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
  AND committed.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
 JOIN control.outbox_event event ON event.participant_id=verification.participant_id AND event.privacy_domain_id=verification.privacy_domain_id
  AND event.aggregate_type=verification.aggregate_type AND event.aggregate_id=verification.aggregate_id
  AND event.event_type='openpc.identity.webauthn-verification.mutation.committed.v1'
  AND event.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
  AND event.payload_cbor=verification.evidence_cbor AND event.payload_digest=verification.evidence_digest AND event.cose_sign1=verification.cose_sign1
 WHERE m.participant_id=n.participant_id AND m.principal_id=n.maker_principal_id AND m.session_id=n.maker_session_id
  AND m.action_intent_id='ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1' AND m.resource_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(n.resume_request-'platformReceivingProof'),'UTF8')) AND m.resource_id=n.predecessor_approval_id::text
  AND m.created_at>=greatest(fresh.activated_at,new_envelope.valid_from) AND m.consumed_at>=greatest(fresh.activated_at,new_envelope.valid_from)
  AND (CASE WHEN proof_session.step_up_mfa_challenge_id IS NULL
    THEN m.consumed_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '5 minutes'
    ELSE proof_session.step_up_mfa_challenge_id=m.mfa_challenge_id
      AND openpc.session_step_up_valid_until(m.participant_id,m.session_id,m.principal_id)>clock_timestamp() END)
  AND m.consumed_at<=clock_timestamp()
  AND m.expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND ((m.used_at IS NULL AND m.used_operation_id IS NULL) OR (m.used_at IS NOT NULL AND m.used_operation_id=n.resume_operation_id));
 IF proof_count<>1 OR n.resume_request->'platformReceivingProof' IS DISTINCT FROM proofs[1]
  OR proof_deadline<=clock_timestamp()
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('command','RESUME',
  'actionIntentId','ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1','actionIntentDigest','sha256:'||encode(action.semantic_digest,'hex'),
  'approvalRequestId','urn:openpc:resource:'||prior.approval_request_id::text,'expectedRevision',prior.row_version::text,
  'predecessorCandidateId',old_attempt.mutation_candidate_id::text,'expectedAttempt',old_attempt.attempt::text,
  'candidateDigest','sha256:'||encode(old_attempt.candidate_digest,'hex'),
  'reason','Resume the original unconsumed Platform administrator handoff under fresh independent recovery custody.',
  'platformReceivingProof',proofs[1]) INTO expected_request
 FROM control.approval_request prior JOIN control.action_intent action
  ON action.action_intent_id='ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
 WHERE prior.participant_id=n.participant_id AND prior.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
  AND prior.approval_request_id=n.predecessor_approval_id AND prior.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE'
  AND prior.subject_id=old_attempt.mutation_candidate_id AND prior.subject_digest=n.candidate_digest
  AND prior.subject_version=n.expected_revision AND prior.action_intent_id=n.action_intent_id
  AND prior.maker_principal_id=n.maker_principal_id AND prior.checker_principal_id<>n.maker_principal_id
  AND prior.checker_principal_id::text=fresh.intent#>>'{preparation,administrators,1,principalId}'
  AND prior.state IN ('OPEN','APPROVED','EXPIRED');
 IF expected_request IS NULL OR n.resume_request IS DISTINCT FROM expected_request
  OR n.expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
  OR n.expires_at>least(clock_timestamp()+interval '30 minutes',fresh.valid_until,new_envelope.valid_until,proof_deadline,
    (SELECT least(s.idle_expires_at,s.absolute_expires_at) FROM control.session s
      WHERE s.participant_id=n.participant_id AND s.session_id=n.maker_session_id),
    (SELECT upper(a.valid_during) FROM control.assignment a
      WHERE a.participant_id=n.participant_id AND a.assignment_id=n.maker_assignment_id))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 -- Recheck live source and proof consumption at the actual commit/replay boundary.
 IF openpc.platform_recovery_approval_resume_subject_visible(n.participant_id,n.privacy_domain_id,
    n.maker_principal_id,n.maker_authority_envelope_id,n.predecessor_approval_id) IS DISTINCT FROM true
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.idempotency_record resume
   WHERE resume.participant_id=n.participant_id AND resume.privacy_domain_id=n.privacy_domain_id
    AND resume.operation_id=n.resume_operation_id AND resume.principal_id=n.maker_principal_id
    AND resume.action_intent_id='ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1' AND resume.catalog_operation_id='LEGACY'
    AND resume.input_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(n.resume_request-'platformReceivingProof'),'UTF8'))
    AND ((resume.terminal_state IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mfa_challenge unused
      WHERE unused.participant_id=n.participant_id AND unused.mfa_challenge_id::text=proofs[1]->>'mfaChallengeId'
       AND unused.used_at IS NULL AND unused.used_operation_id IS NULL))
     OR (resume.terminal_state='COMMITTED' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mfa_challenge used
      WHERE used.participant_id=n.participant_id AND used.mfa_challenge_id::text=proofs[1]->>'mfaChallengeId'
       AND used.used_at IS NOT NULL AND used.used_operation_id=n.resume_operation_id))))
  OR proof_deadline<=clock_timestamp() OR fresh.valid_until<=clock_timestamp() OR n.expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.session s JOIN control.principal p
    ON p.participant_id=s.participant_id AND p.principal_id=s.principal_id
   JOIN control.participant participant ON participant.participant_id=s.participant_id
   JOIN control.assignment a ON a.participant_id=s.participant_id AND a.assignment_id=n.maker_assignment_id
    AND a.principal_id=s.principal_id AND a.authority_envelope_id=n.maker_authority_envelope_id
   WHERE s.participant_id=n.participant_id AND s.session_id=n.maker_session_id AND s.principal_id=n.maker_principal_id
    AND s.state='ACTIVE' AND p.state='ACTIVE' AND participant.state='ACTIVE'
    AND p.authority_epoch=n.maker_principal_epoch AND participant.authority_epoch=n.maker_participant_epoch
    AND s.authority_epoch=n.maker_principal_epoch AND s.session_epoch=n.maker_session_epoch
    AND s.participant_epoch=n.maker_participant_epoch AND s.delegation_epoch=n.maker_delegation_epoch
    AND s.context_mode='PLATFORM' AND s.privacy_domain_id IS NULL
    AND s.idle_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND s.absolute_expires_at>clock_timestamp()
    AND a.state='ACTIVE' AND a.row_version=n.maker_assignment_row_version
    AND a.delegation_epoch=n.maker_delegation_epoch AND a.valid_during @> clock_timestamp())
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.assert_retention_policy_receipt(receipt control.audit_occurrence)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.retention_policy p WHERE p.participant_id=receipt.participant_id
  AND p.privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND p.retention_policy_id=receipt.aggregate_id
  AND p.revision=receipt.after_revision AND receipt.after_existence=1
  AND coalesce(p.retirement_operation_id,p.activation_operation_id)=receipt.operation_id
  AND receipt.catalog_operation_id=CASE WHEN p.active_until IS NULL THEN 'CFG-OP-ACTIVATE-RETENTION-POLICY' ELSE 'CFG-OP-RETIRE-RETENTION-POLICY' END
  AND openpc.business_cbor(receipt.after_state_preimage)->8=openpc.retention_policy_state_projection(p))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-RECEIPT-ACTUAL-RETENTION-STATE'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.assert_runtime_artifact_disposition_receipt(receipt control.audit_occurrence)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF receipt.profile_id<>'pc.control.runtime-artifact.disposition' OR receipt.profile_version<>1 OR receipt.catalog_operation_id<>'CFG-OP-DISPOSE-RUNTIME-ARTIFACT-SOURCE'
  OR receipt.action_intent_id<>'ACT-EVIDENCE_DELETIONS_DISPOSE_RUNTIME_SOURCE-V1' OR receipt.aggregate_type<>'runtime-artifact-disposition'
  OR receipt.before_existence<>0 OR receipt.before_revision<>0 OR receipt.after_existence<>1 OR receipt.after_revision<>1
  OR openpc.business_cbor(receipt.before_state_preimage)->8 IS DISTINCT FROM '{}'::jsonb
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_artifact_source_disposition a WHERE a.participant_id=receipt.participant_id
   AND a.privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND a.disposition_id=receipt.aggregate_id AND a.operation_id=receipt.operation_id
   AND openpc.business_cbor(receipt.after_state_preimage)->8=openpc.runtime_artifact_disposition_state(a))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-RECEIPT-ACTUAL-SOURCE-DISPOSITION'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.assert_runtime_artifact_materialization_boundary()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 -- Traverse actual membership rather than superuser's implicit pg_has_role
 -- answer. A product login becoming an owner is a bypass, not an installer to
 -- exclude from the ordinary grant audit below.
 IF EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE product_role(oid) AS (
  SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN ('openpc_control_runtime','openpc_control_worker','openpc_control_reader')
  UNION SELECT m.member FROM pg_auth_members m JOIN product_role p ON p.oid=m.roleid)
  SELECT 1 FROM product_role p JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=p.oid WHERE r.rolcanlogin AND (
   r.rolsuper OR r.rolbypassrls OR r.rolcreaterole OR r.rolcreatedb OR r.rolreplication
   OR pg_has_role(r.oid,'openpc_control_owner','MEMBER')
   OR pg_has_role(r.oid,'openpc_control_key_governor','MEMBER')))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RUNTIME-ARTIFACT-SOURCE-READ-ROLE-UNAVAILABLE'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles r WHERE NOT r.rolsuper
  AND NOT pg_has_role(r.oid,'openpc_control_owner','MEMBER')
  AND (r.rolcanlogin OR r.rolname IN ('openpc_control_runtime','openpc_control_worker','openpc_control_reader')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles login WHERE login.rolcanlogin AND NOT login.rolsuper
  AND NOT pg_has_role(login.oid,'openpc_control_owner','MEMBER') AND pg_has_role(login.oid,r.oid,'SET'))) AND has_column_privilege(r.oid,'control.runtime_configuration_input','configuration_cbor','SELECT'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RUNTIME-ARTIFACT-SOURCE-READ-GRANT-UNAVAILABLE'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=c.relowner
  WHERE c.oid='control.runtime_configuration_input'::regclass AND c.relkind='r' AND c.relrowsecurity
   AND NOT c.relispartition AND r.rolname='openpc_control_owner')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RUNTIME-ARTIFACT-SOURCE-READ-OWNER-UNAVAILABLE'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_depend d JOIN pg_rewrite rule ON rule.oid=d.objid
  JOIN pg_class view ON view.oid=rule.ev_class
  WHERE d.classid='pg_rewrite'::regclass AND d.refclassid='pg_class'::regclass
   AND d.refobjid='control.runtime_configuration_input'::regclass
   AND (view.oid<>'control.runtime_configuration_input_current_metadata'::regclass
    OR d.refobjsubid=(SELECT attnum FROM pg_attribute
     WHERE attrelid='control.runtime_configuration_input'::regclass AND attname='configuration_cbor')
    OR rule.ev_action::text LIKE '%:varattno 0 %'
    OR NOT coalesce(view.reloptions @> ARRAY['security_invoker=true']::text[],false))
   AND view.relkind IN ('v','m') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles r WHERE NOT r.rolsuper
    AND NOT pg_has_role(r.oid,'openpc_control_owner','MEMBER')
    AND (r.rolcanlogin OR r.rolname IN ('openpc_control_runtime','openpc_control_worker','openpc_control_reader')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles login WHERE login.rolcanlogin AND NOT login.rolsuper
  AND NOT pg_has_role(login.oid,'openpc_control_owner','MEMBER') AND pg_has_role(login.oid,r.oid,'SET'))) AND has_any_column_privilege(r.oid,view.oid,'SELECT')))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RUNTIME-ARTIFACT-SOURCE-READ-PROJECTION-UNAVAILABLE'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (VALUES ('openpc.runtime_artifact_database_identity()','
BEGIN
 RETURN (SELECT jsonb_build_object(''system_identifier'',s.system_identifier::text,''database_oid'',d.oid::text)
