CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.candidate_archive_hold_metadata(source control.evidence_catalogue)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE identity jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT a.manifest->'identity' INTO STRICT identity FROM control.evidence_candidate_archive a
  JOIN control.evidence_candidate_archive_part part ON part.participant_id=a.participant_id AND part.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id
   AND part.stream_id=a.stream_id AND part.manifest_record_id=a.record_id
  JOIN control.evidence_catalogue c ON c.participant_id=part.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=part.privacy_domain_id
   AND c.stream_id=part.stream_id AND c.record_id=part.record_id
  WHERE c IS NOT DISTINCT FROM source AND a.manifest_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(a.manifest),'UTF8')),'hex');
 -- This owner proves only its direct projection/block. Missing cross-store
 -- ancestry stays UNKNOWN; candidate generation is not canonical Fact generation.
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('projections',jsonb_build_array('urn:openpc:resource:'||(identity->>'projectionId')),
  'blocks',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('chainId',identity->>'chainId','genesisDigest',identity->>'genesisDigest',
   'blockNumber',identity->'block'->>'number')),'unresolvedReferences',true);
EXCEPTION WHEN no_data_found OR too_many_rows OR insufficient_privilege THEN RETURN NULL;
END $function$
policy_id uuid, selection_wire bytea, record_refs jsonb

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_authentication_occurrence()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'openpc', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE s record; c record; source record; expected_proof bytea;
BEGIN
 IF NEW.operation_id<>openpc.current_operation_id() OR NOT openpc.matches_participant(NEW.participant_id)
  OR NEW.occurred_at>clock_timestamp()+interval '5 seconds'
  OR NEW.occurred_at<clock_timestamp()-interval '5 minutes' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'IDENTITY-1004-AUTHENTICATION-OCCURRENCE-CONTEXT'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO c FROM control.credential WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND credential_id=NEW.credential_id;
 IF NEW.method='TLS13_MTLS' THEN
  SELECT principal.*,participant.root_privacy_domain_id,participant.state participant_state INTO s
   FROM control.principal principal JOIN control.participant participant USING(participant_id)
   WHERE principal.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND principal.principal_id=NEW.principal_id;
  IF c.credential_id IS NULL OR s.principal_id IS NULL OR c.principal_id<>NEW.principal_id
   OR c.kind<>'WORKLOAD_MTLS' OR c.state<>'ACTIVE' OR s.kind<>'WORKLOAD' OR s.state<>'ACTIVE' OR s.participant_state<>'ACTIVE'
   OR NEW.session_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.context_mode<>'WORKLOAD' OR NEW.source_id<>NEW.operation_id
   OR NEW.occurred_at<>c.last_used_at OR c.valid_from>NEW.occurred_at OR c.valid_until<=NEW.occurred_at
   OR NEW.privacy_domain_id IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(nullif(current_setting('openpc.privacy_domain_id',true),'')::uuid,s.root_privacy_domain_id)
   OR openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-POLICY_READ_EFFECTIVE_ACCESS-V1' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'IDENTITY-1006-AUTHENTICATION-MTLS-SOURCE'; END IF;
  expected_proof:=NEW.proof_digest;
 ELSE
 SELECT session.*,p.root_privacy_domain_id INTO s FROM control.session session
  JOIN control.participant p USING(participant_id)
  WHERE session.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND session.session_id=NEW.session_id;
 IF s.session_id IS NULL OR c.credential_id IS NULL OR s.principal_id<>NEW.principal_id
  OR c.principal_id<>NEW.principal_id OR s.context_mode::text<>NEW.context_mode
  OR NEW.privacy_domain_id IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(s.privacy_domain_id,s.root_privacy_domain_id)
  OR s.state<>'ACTIVE' OR c.state<>'ACTIVE' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'IDENTITY-1004-AUTHENTICATION-OCCURRENCE-SCOPE'; END IF;
 IF NEW.method='OIDC_CODE_PKCE_S256' THEN
  SELECT * INTO source FROM control.oidc_transaction WHERE transaction_id=NEW.source_id;
  IF source.transaction_id IS NULL OR source.consumed_at IS NULL OR source.purpose<>'SESSION'
   OR c.kind<>'OIDC_SUBJECT' OR c.issuer<>source.issuer OR c.audience<>source.client_id
   OR (source.selected_participant_id IS NOT NULL AND source.selected_participant_id<>NEW.participant_id)
   OR NEW.context_mode<>'PLATFORM' OR NEW.occurred_at<>s.issued_at
   OR openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-IDENTITY_CREATE_SESSION-V1' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'IDENTITY-1004-AUTHENTICATION-OIDC-SOURCE'; END IF;
  expected_proof:=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(jsonb_build_object(
   'version','OPENPC_OIDC_VERIFIED_V1','sourceId',source.transaction_id::text,'credentialId',NEW.credential_id::text,
   'stateDigest',encode(source.state_digest,'hex'),'nonceDigest',encode(source.nonce_digest,'hex'),
   'pkceDigest',encode(source.code_verifier_digest,'hex'),'browserDigest',encode(source.browser_session_digest,'hex'))),'UTF8'));
 ELSE
  SELECT challenge.* INTO source FROM control.mfa_challenge challenge
   WHERE challenge.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND challenge.mfa_challenge_id=NEW.source_id;
  IF source.mfa_challenge_id IS NULL OR source.consumed_at IS NULL
   OR source.session_id<>NEW.session_id OR source.principal_id<>NEW.principal_id OR c.kind<>'WEBAUTHN'
   OR source.signer_credential_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.credential_id
   OR source.signer_credential_epoch IS DISTINCT FROM c.credential_epoch
   OR s.step_up_mfa_challenge_id IS DISTINCT FROM source.mfa_challenge_id
   OR s.step_up_verified_at IS DISTINCT FROM source.consumed_at
   OR NEW.occurred_at IS DISTINCT FROM source.consumed_at
   OR openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-IDENTITY_UPDATE_STEP_UP-V1' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'IDENTITY-1004-AUTHENTICATION-WEBAUTHN-SOURCE'; END IF;
  SELECT evidence.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest INTO expected_proof FROM control.mutation_evidence evidence
   WHERE evidence.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND evidence.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
    AND evidence.operation_id=NEW.operation_id AND evidence.principal_id=NEW.principal_id
    AND evidence.aggregate_id=NEW.session_id AND evidence.mfa_challenge_id=NEW.source_id
    AND evidence.signer_credential_id=NEW.credential_id AND evidence.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WEBAUTHN-VERIFY';
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF expected_proof IS NULL OR NEW.proof_digest<>expected_proof
  OR NEW.receipt<>openpc.authentication_occurrence_receipt(NEW.occurrence_id,NEW.participant_id,NEW.privacy_domain_id,
    NEW.principal_id,NEW.session_id,NEW.operation_id,NEW.method,NEW.source_id,NEW.credential_id,NEW.context_mode,
    NEW.proof_digest,NEW.occurred_at) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'IDENTITY-1004-AUTHENTICATION-OCCURRENCE-INTEGRITY'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_business_head_completion()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event e WHERE e.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
  AND e.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND e.sequence_namespace=NEW.sequence_namespace
  AND e.aggregate_type=NEW.aggregate_type AND e.aggregate_id=NEW.aggregate_id
  AND e.business_sequence=NEW.last_sequence AND e.proof_kind='BUSINESS_RECEIPT_REFERENCE') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-ORPHAN-BUSINESS-SEQUENCE'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_business_receipt_completion()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE receipt control.audit_occurrence%ROWTYPE; event_refs jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT receipt FROM control.audit_occurrence WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND receipt_id=NEW.receipt_id;
 SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('0',openpc.business_uuid(e.event_id),'1',e.event_type,'2',e.data_schema_uri,
   '3',e.source,'4',e.subject,'5',e.business_sequence,'6',floor(extract(epoch FROM e.occurred_at)*1000000)*1000,
   '7',openpc.business_uuid(e.correlation_id),'9',openpc.business_bytes(e.payload_digest)) ||
   CASE WHEN e.causation_id IS NULL THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_object('8',openpc.business_uuid(e.causation_id)) END ||
   CASE WHEN e.authority_generation IS NULL THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_object('10',openpc.business_bytes(e.authority_generation)) END
   ORDER BY e.business_sequence) INTO event_refs FROM control.outbox_event e
  WHERE e.participant_id=receipt.participant_id AND e.privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id
    AND e.receipt_id=receipt.receipt_id AND e.proof_kind='BUSINESS_RECEIPT_REFERENCE';
 IF coalesce(event_refs,'[]'::jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM (openpc.business_cbor(receipt.receipt_cbor)->'21') OR
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event e WHERE e.participant_id=receipt.participant_id
      AND e.privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND e.receipt_id=receipt.receipt_id
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.business_outbox_head h WHERE h.participant_id=e.participant_id
        AND h.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id AND h.sequence_namespace=e.sequence_namespace
        AND h.aggregate_type=e.aggregate_type AND h.aggregate_id=e.aggregate_id AND h.last_sequence>=e.business_sequence)) OR
    NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.evidence_record e WHERE e.participant_id=receipt.participant_id
      AND e.privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND e.receipt_id=receipt.receipt_id
      AND e.recorded_at_ns=receipt.recorded_at_ns) OR
    NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.idempotency_record i WHERE i.participant_id=receipt.participant_id
      AND i.privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND i.operation_id=receipt.operation_id
      AND i.terminal_state='COMMITTED' AND i.result_digest IS NOT NULL AND i.result_payload IS NOT NULL) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-INCOMPLETE-BUSINESS-COMMIT'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_business_signing_trust()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE key_row control.business_signing_key%ROWTYPE; grants jsonb; renewal_grant jsonb; actual jsonb; expected jsonb; schema_digest text; schema_count integer; receipt_version integer;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT key_row FROM control.business_signing_key
 WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND signer_id=NEW.signer_id;
 IF NOT pg_has_role(current_user,'openpc_control_key_governor','MEMBER') AND
    NOT pg_has_role(current_user,'openpc_control_owner','MEMBER') AND key_row.admission_kind<>'GOVERNED' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-SIGNING-BOOTSTRAP-AUTHORITY';
 END IF;
 IF key_row.signing_purpose_code=371 THEN
  SELECT jsonb_build_array(p.profile_id,p.profile_version,openpc.business_bytes(p.profile_digest),
    'ACT-PARTICIPANT_ACTIVATE_CONTEXT-V1','ID-OP-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATE') INTO STRICT grants
   FROM control.identity_envelope_signing_grant g JOIN control.identity_envelope_signing_profile p USING(profile_digest)
   WHERE g.participant_id=key_row.participant_id AND g.privacy_domain_id=key_row.privacy_domain_id
     AND g.signer_id=key_row.signer_id AND g.signing_purpose_code=371
     AND p.profile_digest=decode('54d85c86019a4475f8207f375fa571565e9e6e0adb5b0bd55abc03e4beb81f74','hex');
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.business_signing_grant g WHERE g.participant_id=key_row.participant_id
    AND g.privacy_domain_id=key_row.privacy_domain_id AND g.signer_id=key_row.signer_id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-MIXED-SIGNING-PURPOSE-GRANTS';
  END IF;
  actual:=openpc.business_cbor(key_row.trust_preimage);
  expected:=jsonb_build_array('pc.identity.authority-envelope-signing-trust.v1',openpc.business_uuid(key_row.participant_id),
   openpc.business_uuid(key_row.privacy_domain_id),key_row.environment_id,key_row.signer_id,
   openpc.business_bytes(key_row.public_key_spki_der),openpc.business_uuid(key_row.workload_credential_id),
   key_row.workload_credential_epoch,key_row.envelope_workload_participant_epoch,key_row.envelope_workload_principal_epoch,
   key_row.key_epoch,key_row.valid_from_ns,key_row.valid_until_ns,
   key_row.admission_kind,key_row.admission_reference,openpc.business_bytes(key_row.admission_digest),
   key_row.secret_class,key_row.secret_reference,key_row.secret_version,24034,1,371,
   openpc.business_bytes(decode('6cf5c91789d9488014d3ec9445d5852c4aa686534305c6516d67210176ea3cc5','hex')),grants);
 ELSIF key_row.signing_purpose_code=338 THEN
 SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(p.profile_id,p.profile_version,openpc.business_bytes(p.profile_digest),
   p.action_intent_id,p.catalog_operation_id) ORDER BY convert_to(p.profile_id,'UTF8'),p.profile_version)
 INTO grants FROM control.business_signing_grant g JOIN control.business_transition_profile p USING(profile_digest)
 WHERE g.participant_id=key_row.participant_id AND g.privacy_domain_id=key_row.privacy_domain_id AND g.signer_id=key_row.signer_id;
 IF grants IS NULL OR jsonb_array_length(grants) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 64 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-INCOMPLETE-SIGNING-GRANTS'; END IF;
 SELECT count(DISTINCT p.schema_definition_digest),min(encode(p.schema_definition_digest,'hex'))
 INTO schema_count,schema_digest FROM control.business_signing_grant g JOIN control.business_transition_profile p USING(profile_digest)
 WHERE g.participant_id=key_row.participant_id AND g.privacy_domain_id=key_row.privacy_domain_id AND g.signer_id=key_row.signer_id;
 IF schema_count<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-MIXED-SIGNING-SCHEMA-GRANTS'; END IF;
 receipt_version:=CASE schema_digest
  WHEN '41a877ca7e00e74f32c8becf8daee38f26c12ab9d9dcf6ff80ed8e75608b3c1f' THEN 1
  WHEN '4e7de36861819909275bdec8103d1df04984c03b34cb593437dfe68f5c2c1d9a' THEN 2 END;
 IF receipt_version IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-UNADMITTED-SIGNING-SCHEMA'; END IF;
 actual:=openpc.business_cbor(key_row.trust_preimage);
 expected:=jsonb_build_array('pc.control.business-signing-trust.v1',openpc.business_uuid(key_row.participant_id),
   openpc.business_uuid(key_row.privacy_domain_id),key_row.environment_id,key_row.signer_id,
   openpc.business_bytes(key_row.public_key_spki_der),openpc.business_uuid(key_row.workload_credential_id),
   key_row.workload_credential_epoch,key_row.key_epoch,key_row.valid_from_ns,key_row.valid_until_ns,
   key_row.admission_kind,key_row.admission_reference,openpc.business_bytes(key_row.admission_digest),
   key_row.secret_class,key_row.secret_reference,key_row.secret_version,24001,receipt_version,338,grants);

 ELSIF key_row.signing_purpose_code=376 THEN
  SELECT to_jsonb(g) INTO STRICT renewal_grant FROM control.workload_renewal_signing_grant g
   JOIN control.workload_renewal_signing_profile p USING(profile_digest)
   WHERE g.participant_id=key_row.participant_id AND g.privacy_domain_id=key_row.privacy_domain_id AND g.signer_id=key_row.signer_id
    AND g.signing_purpose_code=376 AND p.profile_digest=decode('bba6435c44c28f630d498d0d43cb4968fb2cef2828fb831908b7e7bff5cf39df','hex');
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.business_signing_grant g WHERE g.participant_id=key_row.participant_id
    AND g.privacy_domain_id=key_row.privacy_domain_id AND g.signer_id=key_row.signer_id)
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_signing_grant g WHERE g.participant_id=key_row.participant_id
    AND g.privacy_domain_id=key_row.privacy_domain_id AND g.signer_id=key_row.signer_id) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-MIXED-SIGNING-PURPOSE-GRANTS';
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.credential c JOIN control.principal p USING(participant_id,principal_id)
   JOIN control.workload_credential_family f ON f.participant_id=c.participant_id AND f.privacy_domain_id=key_row.privacy_domain_id
    AND f.family_id=(renewal_grant->>'family_id')::uuid
   WHERE c.participant_id=key_row.participant_id AND c.credential_id=key_row.workload_credential_id
    AND c.principal_id=(renewal_grant->>'principal_id')::uuid AND c.audience=renewal_grant->>'workload_id'
    AND f.principal_id=c.principal_id AND f.workload_id=c.audience AND p.kind='WORKLOAD') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-SIGNING-WORKLOAD-BINDING';
  END IF;
  actual:=openpc.business_cbor(key_row.trust_preimage);
  expected:=jsonb_build_array('pc.identity.workload-renewal-signing-trust.v2',openpc.business_uuid(key_row.participant_id),
   openpc.business_uuid(key_row.privacy_domain_id),key_row.environment_id,openpc.business_uuid((renewal_grant->>'principal_id')::uuid),
   renewal_grant->>'workload_id',openpc.business_uuid((renewal_grant->>'family_id')::uuid),
   (renewal_grant->>'family_security_epoch')::numeric,(renewal_grant->>'participant_security_invalidation_epoch')::numeric,
   (renewal_grant->>'key_security_generation')::numeric,openpc.business_bytes(decode(substring(key_row.signer_id from 8),'hex')),
   openpc.business_bytes(key_row.public_key_spki_der),key_row.key_epoch,key_row.valid_from_ns,key_row.valid_until_ns,
   openpc.business_bytes(decode(substring(renewal_grant->>'provider_qualification_digest' from 3),'hex')),
   key_row.admission_kind,key_row.admission_reference,openpc.business_bytes(key_row.admission_digest),
   key_row.secret_class,key_row.secret_reference,key_row.secret_version,24039,1,376,
   openpc.business_bytes(decode('0d9bb7686dc932fc17b4ccfb8700f600b9a46e765cef61e93d68b8e1d7efc10d','hex')),
   'pc.identity.workload-renewal.policy-authorization.v1',2,openpc.business_bytes(decode('bba6435c44c28f630d498d0d43cb4968fb2cef2828fb831908b7e7bff5cf39df','hex')),
   'POLICY_AUTHORIZED','ACT-IDENTITY_RENEW_WORKLOAD_CREDENTIAL-V1','ID-OP-WORKLOAD-RENEWAL-ADMIT');

 ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-UNADMITTED-SIGNING-PURPOSE'; END IF;
 IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-SIGNING-TRUST-BINDING'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.credential c JOIN control.principal p USING(participant_id,principal_id)
  WHERE c.participant_id=key_row.participant_id AND c.credential_id=key_row.workload_credential_id
    AND p.kind='WORKLOAD' AND c.kind IN ('WORKLOAD_OIDC','WORKLOAD_MTLS')
    AND c.credential_epoch=key_row.workload_credential_epoch
    AND c.public_key_digest IS DISTINCT FROM sha256(key_row.public_key_spki_der)) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-SIGNING-WORKLOAD-BINDING';
 END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_consumed_signing_continuation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE context jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF NEW.state<>'CONSUMED' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 context:=convert_from(NEW.context_preimage,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF context->>'resultDisposition'='NO_EFFECT_RETRYABLE' THEN
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_rotation_operation_evidence e JOIN control.signing_rotation_command c USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,operation_id)
   WHERE e.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND e.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND e.operation_id=NEW.operation_id
    AND e.continuation_assertion_id=NEW.assertion_id AND e.kind='NO_EFFECT_RETRYABLE' AND c.state='FAILED' AND c.result_kind=e.kind)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-CONTINUATION-ATOMIC-NO-EFFECT'; END IF;
 ELSIF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_rotation_command c JOIN control.signing_provider_attempt p
  ON p.participant_id=c.participant_id AND p.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND p.operation_id=c.operation_id
  JOIN control.audit_occurrence a ON a.participant_id=c.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND a.operation_id=c.operation_id
  WHERE c.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND c.operation_id=NEW.operation_id
   AND c.state IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED') AND p.attempt_id=NEW.provider_attempt_id AND p.state IN ('ACCEPTED','REJECTED')
   AND a.receipt_id=NEW.consumed_receipt_id AND a.aggregate_type='signing-key-rotation' AND a.before_revision=(context->>'rotationRevision')::bigint
   AND convert_from(a.authority_snapshot,'UTF8')::jsonb->>'continuationAssertionId'=NEW.assertion_id::text)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-CONTINUATION-ATOMIC-EFFECT'; END IF;
 IF context->>'currentAuthorityStatus'='CHANGED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_rotation_authority_hold h
  WHERE h.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND h.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND h.operation_id=NEW.operation_id
   AND h.continuation_assertion_id=NEW.assertion_id AND h.reason='AUTHORITY_CHANGED_AFTER_DISPATCH')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-CONTINUATION-AUTHORITY-HOLD'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_evidence_export_completion_event(event control.outbox_event)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE completion control.evidence_export_completion%ROWTYPE; claims jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF NOT pg_has_role(current_user,'openpc_control_runtime','USAGE')
  OR event.participant_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_participant_id()
  OR event.privacy_domain_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
  OR openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-EVIDENCE_EXPORT_RECORDS-V1'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT completion FROM control.evidence_export_completion
 WHERE participant_id=event.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=event.privacy_domain_id AND event_id=event.event_id;
 claims:=completion.claims;
 IF completion.state NOT IN ('OBSERVED','PUBLISHED') OR completion.cose_sign1 IS NULL
  OR event.proof_kind<>'EVIDENCE_EXPORT_COMPLETION_REFERENCE'
  OR event.sequence_namespace<>'EVIDENCE_EXPORT_COMPLETION_V1'
  OR event.aggregate_type<>'evidence-export' OR event.aggregate_id<>completion.evidence_export_id
  OR event.aggregate_sequence IS NOT NULL OR event.business_sequence IS DISTINCT FROM 1::numeric
  OR event.receipt_id IS NOT NULL OR event.cose_sign1 IS NOT NULL
  OR event.authority_generation IS NOT NULL OR event.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest IS NOT NULL
  OR event.event_type<>'io.openpc.evidence.export.completed.v1'
  OR event.data_schema_uri IS DISTINCT FROM 'https://schemas.openpc.local/event-payloads.schema.json#/$defs/EvidenceExportCompleted'
  OR event.source IS DISTINCT FROM 'urn:openpc:service:'||(claims->>'sourceId')
  OR event.subject IS DISTINCT FROM 'urn:openpc:resource:'||completion.evidence_export_id::text
  OR event.correlation_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM claims->>'startOperationId'
  OR event.causation_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM claims->>'causationId'
  OR floor(extract(epoch from event.occurred_at)*1000000)*1000 IS DISTINCT FROM (claims->>'recordedAtNs')::numeric
  OR event.payload_cbor IS DISTINCT FROM completion.source_data
  OR event.payload_digest IS DISTINCT FROM sha256(completion.source_data)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-EXPORT-COMPLETION-OUTBOX'; END IF;
 PERFORM openpc.archive_cose_binding(completion.receipt_payload,completion.cose_sign1,claims->>'signerKeyId',24013,350);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_governed_configuration_receipt(receipt control.audit_occurrence)
 RETURNS control.mutation_candidate
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE actual jsonb; approval control.approval_decision_record%ROWTYPE;
 evidence control.mutation_evidence%ROWTYPE; verification control.mutation_evidence%ROWTYPE;
 candidate control.mutation_candidate%ROWTYPE; request control.approval_request%ROWTYPE; challenge control.mfa_challenge%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 IF receipt.catalog_operation_id NOT IN ('ID-OP-WORKLOAD-RENEWAL-POLICY-CREATE','ID-OP-WORKLOAD-RENEWAL-POLICY-REVISE','ID-OP-WORKLOAD-RENEWAL-POLICY-SUSPEND','ID-OP-WORKLOAD-RENEWAL-POLICY-REVOKE','MOD-OP-REGISTER','MOD-OP-INSTALL','MOD-OP-ENABLE','MOD-OP-DISABLE','CFG-OP-CREATE-EVIDENCE-HOLD','CFG-OP-RELEASE-EVIDENCE-HOLD','CFG-OP-CREATE-PARTICIPANT-EVIDENCE-HOLD','CFG-OP-RELEASE-PARTICIPANT-EVIDENCE-HOLD','CFG-OP-DELETE-LOCAL-EVIDENCE','CFG-OP-DELETE-LOCAL-EVIDENCE-BATCH','CFG-OP-DELETE-RAW-PROOF-BATCH','CFG-OP-DELETE-PROJECTION-BATCH','CFG-OP-ADMIT-STORE-RETIREMENT','CFG-OP-DISPOSE-RUNTIME-ARTIFACT-SOURCE','CFG-OP-DELETE-RUNTIME-ARTIFACT-BATCH','CFG-OP-ACTIVATE-RETENTION-POLICY','CFG-OP-RETIRE-RETENTION-POLICY') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-UNADMITTED-GOVERNED-RECEIPT'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT candidate FROM control.mutation_candidate c WHERE c.participant_id=receipt.participant_id
  AND c.privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND c.catalog_operation_id=receipt.catalog_operation_id
  AND c.action_intent_id=receipt.action_intent_id AND c.resource_id=receipt.aggregate_id
  AND c.candidate_digest=receipt.candidate_digest AND c.state='CONSUMED' AND c.consumed_operation_id=receipt.operation_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT evidence FROM control.mutation_evidence e WHERE e.participant_id=receipt.participant_id
  AND e.privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND e.operation_id=receipt.operation_id
  AND e.catalog_operation_id=receipt.catalog_operation_id AND e.action_intent_id=receipt.action_intent_id
  AND e.aggregate_id=receipt.aggregate_id AND e.principal_id=candidate.maker_principal_id
  AND e.candidate_digest=receipt.candidate_digest;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT request FROM control.approval_request r WHERE r.participant_id=receipt.participant_id
  AND r.privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND r.approval_request_id=evidence.approval_request_id
  AND r.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE' AND r.subject_id=candidate.mutation_candidate_id
  AND r.subject_digest=candidate.candidate_digest AND r.subject_version=candidate.expected_revision
  AND r.action_intent_id=receipt.action_intent_id AND r.maker_principal_id=candidate.maker_principal_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT approval FROM control.approval_decision_record d WHERE d.participant_id=receipt.participant_id
  AND d.privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND d.approval_request_id=request.approval_request_id
  AND d.decision='APPROVE' AND d.approver_principal_id=evidence.checker_principal_id
  AND d.approver_principal_id<>evidence.principal_id AND d.candidate_digest=receipt.candidate_digest
  AND d.aggregate_version=candidate.expected_revision AND d.evidence_cbor=evidence.evidence_cbor
  AND sha256(d.evidence_cbor)=evidence.evidence_digest
  AND d.decision_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(jsonb_build_object(
   'actionIntentId','ACT-POLICY_APPROVE_REQUEST-V1',
   'approvalRequestId','urn:openpc:resource:'||request.approval_request_id::text,
   'candidateDigest','sha256:'||encode(candidate.candidate_digest,'hex'),
   'decision','APPROVE','expectedRevision','1')),'UTF8'))
  AND d.cose_sign1=evidence.cose_sign1;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT challenge FROM control.mfa_challenge c WHERE c.participant_id=receipt.participant_id
  AND c.principal_id=evidence.principal_id AND c.mfa_challenge_id=evidence.mfa_challenge_id
  AND c.action_intent_id=receipt.action_intent_id AND c.resource_digest=receipt.candidate_digest
  AND c.used_operation_id=receipt.operation_id AND c.used_at IS NOT NULL;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT verification FROM control.mutation_evidence v WHERE v.participant_id=receipt.participant_id
  AND v.privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND v.principal_id=evidence.principal_id
  AND v.mfa_challenge_id=challenge.mfa_challenge_id AND v.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WEBAUTHN-VERIFY'
  AND v.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=evidence.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
  AND v.evidence_digest=sha256(v.evidence_cbor);
 actual:=openpc.business_cbor(receipt.receipt_cbor);
 IF actual->'20' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array(
  jsonb_build_object('0',3,'1',approval.approval_decision_id::text,'2',openpc.business_bytes(sha256(approval.evidence_cbor))),
  jsonb_build_object('0',4,'1',verification.mutation_evidence_id::text,'2',openpc.business_bytes(verification.evidence_digest)))
  OR receipt.actor_key_digest<>sha256(convert_to('pc.identity.actor-key.v2','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||
    int4send(octet_length(convert_to(receipt.participant_id::text,'UTF8')))||convert_to(receipt.participant_id::text,'UTF8')||
    int4send(octet_length(convert_to(evidence.principal_id::text,'UTF8')))||convert_to(evidence.principal_id::text,'UTF8'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-GOVERNED-EVIDENCE'; END IF;
 RETURN candidate;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_governed_initial_completion()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'openpc', 'control'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.governed_initial_profile_digest IS NOT NULL AND NEW.consumed_at IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.governed_initial_enrollment_result result
    WHERE result.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND result.principal_id=NEW.principal_id
     AND result.session_id=NEW.session_id AND result.enrollment_id=NEW.enrollment_id
     AND result.credential_id=NEW.credential_id AND result.profile_digest=NEW.governed_initial_profile_digest) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'IDENTITY-1004-INITIAL-COMPLETION-RECEIPT'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_governed_initial_result()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'openpc', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE source record;
BEGIN
 SELECT enrollment.enrollment_id INTO source FROM control.webauthn_enrollment enrollment
 JOIN control.credential credential ON credential.participant_id=enrollment.participant_id
  AND credential.credential_id=enrollment.credential_id AND credential.principal_id=enrollment.principal_id
 JOIN control.governed_initial_enrollment_profile profile ON profile.participant_id=enrollment.participant_id
  AND profile.profile_digest=enrollment.governed_initial_profile_digest AND profile.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
 JOIN control.outbox_event event ON event.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND event.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
  AND event.event_id=NEW.event_id AND event.aggregate_type='credential' AND event.aggregate_id=NEW.credential_id
  AND event.event_type='openpc.identity.webauthn.governed-initial-enrollment.completed.v1'
  AND event.payload_cbor=NEW.evidence_cbor AND event.payload_digest=NEW.evidence_digest AND event.cose_sign1=NEW.cose_sign1
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(profile.document->'accounts') account
 WHERE enrollment.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND enrollment.principal_id=NEW.principal_id
  AND enrollment.session_id=NEW.session_id AND enrollment.enrollment_id=NEW.enrollment_id
  AND enrollment.credential_id=NEW.credential_id AND enrollment.consumed_at IS NOT NULL
  AND profile.profile_digest=NEW.profile_digest AND account=NEW.document->'account'
  AND profile.state='ACTIVE' AND profile.valid_from<=NEW.committed_at AND profile.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
  AND NEW.committed_at<=clock_timestamp()+interval '5 seconds'
  AND NEW.committed_at>=clock_timestamp()-interval '1 minute'
  AND NEW.committed_at<enrollment.expires_at
  AND credential.kind='WEBAUTHN' AND credential.state='ACTIVE'
  AND NEW.document->>'origin'=enrollment.origin AND NEW.document->>'rpId'=enrollment.rp_id
  AND NEW.document->>'authenticatorPublicKeyDigest'='sha256:'||encode(credential.public_key_digest,'hex')
  AND NEW.document->>'attestationDigest'='sha256:'||encode(enrollment.attestation_digest,'hex');
 IF NOT FOUND OR NEW.operation_id<>openpc.current_operation_id() THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'IDENTITY-1004-INITIAL-RESULT-SOURCE'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_identity_envelope_recovery_rotation_creation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE recovery control.platform_recovery_case;
BEGIN
 IF NEW.recovery_case_id IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT recovery FROM control.platform_recovery_case c WHERE c.recovery_id=NEW.recovery_case_id
  AND c.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_key_rotation r WHERE r.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
    AND r.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND r.rotation_id=NEW.rotation_id AND r.state<>'REQUESTED'
    AND r.approved_operation_id::text=recovery.lease_bindings->>'activationOperationId')
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event event WHERE event.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
    AND event.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND event.aggregate_type='signing-key-rotation'
    AND event.aggregate_id=NEW.rotation_id AND event.aggregate_sequence=1
    AND event.event_id::text=recovery.lease_bindings->>'creationOperationId'
    AND event.event_type='openpc.identity.envelope-rotation.created.v1'
    AND octet_length(event.payload_cbor)>0 AND event.payload_digest=sha256(event.payload_cbor)
    AND octet_length(event.cose_sign1)>0)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ROTATION-CREATION'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_identity_envelope_recovery_trust_admission(p_key control.business_signing_key)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE rotation control.signing_key_rotation; step control.identity_envelope_rotation_step;
 old_key control.business_signing_key; descriptor jsonb; issuer jsonb; expected_digest bytea; proofs integer;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
  OR p_key.signing_purpose_code<>371 OR p_key.admission_kind<>'GOVERNED'
  OR NOT openpc.matches_participant(p_key.participant_id) OR NOT openpc.matches_privacy(p_key.privacy_domain_id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-TRUST-ADMISSION'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT rotation FROM control.signing_key_rotation r WHERE r.participant_id=p_key.participant_id
  AND r.privacy_domain_id=p_key.privacy_domain_id AND r.recovery_case_id IS NOT NULL
  AND p_key.admission_reference='urn:openpc:resource:'||r.rotation_id::text AND r.new_signer_id=p_key.signer_id
  AND r.state='VERIFIED' AND r.revision=5 AND r.approval_request_id IS NULL;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT step FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_step s WHERE s.operation_id=openpc.current_operation_id()
  AND s.participant_id=rotation.participant_id AND s.privacy_domain_id=rotation.privacy_domain_id
  AND s.rotation_id=rotation.rotation_id AND s.recovery_id=rotation.recovery_case_id
  AND s.from_revision=4 AND s.from_state='DISTRIBUTED' AND s.to_state='VERIFIED' AND s.state='COMMITTED';
 IF NOT coalesce(openpc.identity_envelope_rotation_step_current(step),false)
  OR step.result->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'VERIFIED' OR step.result->>'admissionState' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ADMITTED'
  OR step.result->>'signerId' IS DISTINCT FROM p_key.signer_id
  OR step.result->>'trustDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(p_key.trust_digest,'hex')
  OR step.evidence_digest IS DISTINCT FROM sha256(step.evidence_cbor) OR step.cose_sign1 IS NULL
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-TRUST-PROVENANCE'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT old_key FROM control.business_signing_key k WHERE k.participant_id=rotation.participant_id
  AND k.privacy_domain_id=rotation.privacy_domain_id AND k.signer_id=rotation.old_signer_id AND k.signing_purpose_code=371;
 SELECT a.observation->'descriptor' INTO STRICT descriptor FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_step prepared
  JOIN control.identity_envelope_rotation_attempt a USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,rotation_id,operation_id)
  WHERE prepared.participant_id=rotation.participant_id AND prepared.privacy_domain_id=rotation.privacy_domain_id
   AND prepared.rotation_id=rotation.rotation_id AND prepared.recovery_id=rotation.recovery_case_id
   AND prepared.state='COMMITTED' AND prepared.from_revision=2 AND prepared.to_state='PREPARED'
   AND a.slot='new' AND a.state='OBSERVED';
 issuer:=step.authority_binding#>'{lease,issuer}';
 expected_digest:=sha256(convert_to('pc.identity.envelope-key-recovery-admission.v1','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||
  convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(step.authority_binding||jsonb_build_object('issuer',issuer,
    'newFingerprint',descriptor->>'fingerprint','newReference',descriptor->>'reference','newVersion',descriptor->>'version')),'UTF8'));
 IF old_key.trust_digest<>rotation.old_trust_digest OR p_key.key_epoch<>old_key.key_epoch+1
  OR NOT ((p_key.workload_credential_id=old_key.workload_credential_id AND p_key.workload_credential_epoch=old_key.workload_credential_epoch)
   OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM control.credential predecessor
    JOIN control.credential successor ON successor.participant_id=predecessor.participant_id
      AND successor.rotated_from_credential_id=predecessor.credential_id
      AND successor.principal_id=predecessor.principal_id AND successor.audience=predecessor.audience
    JOIN control.mutation_candidate candidate ON candidate.participant_id=predecessor.participant_id
      AND candidate.privacy_domain_id=p_key.privacy_domain_id
      AND candidate.resource_id=predecessor.credential_id
      AND candidate.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE'
      AND candidate.action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
      AND candidate.state='CONSUMED' AND candidate.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL
      AND candidate.candidate_document=jsonb_build_object('replacedCredentialId',predecessor.credential_id::text,
        'credentialId',successor.credential_id::text,
        'publicKeySpkiDer',replace(encode(successor.public_key_spki_der,'base64'),E'\n',''))
      AND candidate.candidate_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(candidate.candidate_document),'UTF8'))
    JOIN control.approval_request approval ON approval.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
      AND approval.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id AND approval.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE'
      AND approval.subject_id=candidate.mutation_candidate_id AND approval.subject_digest=candidate.candidate_digest
      AND approval.maker_principal_id=candidate.maker_principal_id AND approval.state='APPROVED'
      AND approval.subject_version=candidate.expected_revision AND approval.action_intent_id=candidate.action_intent_id
    JOIN control.approval_decision_record decision ON decision.participant_id=approval.participant_id
      AND decision.privacy_domain_id=approval.privacy_domain_id AND decision.approval_request_id=approval.approval_request_id
      AND decision.decision='APPROVE' AND decision.candidate_digest=candidate.candidate_digest
      AND decision.approver_principal_id<>approval.maker_principal_id AND decision.cose_sign1 IS NOT NULL
      AND decision.aggregate_version=approval.subject_version
    JOIN control.mutation_evidence evidence ON evidence.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
      AND evidence.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id AND evidence.operation_id=candidate.consumed_operation_id
      AND evidence.action_intent_id=candidate.action_intent_id AND evidence.catalog_operation_id=candidate.catalog_operation_id
      AND evidence.aggregate_type='workload-credential' AND evidence.aggregate_id=predecessor.credential_id
      AND evidence.candidate_digest=candidate.candidate_digest AND evidence.principal_id=approval.maker_principal_id
      AND evidence.checker_principal_id=decision.approver_principal_id AND evidence.approval_request_id=approval.approval_request_id
      AND evidence.evidence_digest=sha256(evidence.evidence_cbor) AND evidence.cose_sign1 IS NOT NULL
      AND evidence.evidence_cbor=decision.evidence_cbor AND evidence.cose_sign1=decision.cose_sign1
      AND evidence.signer_credential_id=decision.signer_credential_id
      AND evidence.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest IS NOT NULL AND evidence.mfa_challenge_id IS NOT NULL
    JOIN control.idempotency_record committed ON committed.participant_id=evidence.participant_id
      AND committed.privacy_domain_id=evidence.privacy_domain_id AND committed.operation_id=evidence.operation_id
      AND committed.action_intent_id=evidence.action_intent_id AND committed.catalog_operation_id=evidence.catalog_operation_id
      AND committed.principal_id=evidence.principal_id
      AND committed.terminal_state='COMMITTED' AND committed.input_digest=evidence.candidate_digest
      AND committed.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=evidence.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
      AND committed.result_payload->>'credentialId'=successor.credential_id::text
      AND committed.result_payload->>'replacedCredentialId'=predecessor.credential_id::text
      AND committed.result_payload->>'principalId'=successor.principal_id::text
      AND committed.result_payload->>'workloadId'=successor.audience
      AND committed.result_payload->>'workloadEpoch'=successor.credential_epoch::text
      AND committed.result_payload->>'state'='ACTIVE'
    JOIN control.outbox_event event ON event.participant_id=evidence.participant_id
      AND event.privacy_domain_id=evidence.privacy_domain_id AND event.aggregate_type=evidence.aggregate_type
      AND event.aggregate_id=evidence.aggregate_id AND event.payload_cbor=evidence.evidence_cbor
      AND event.event_type='openpc.identity.workload-credential.mutation.committed.v1'
      AND event.payload_digest=evidence.evidence_digest AND event.cose_sign1=evidence.cose_sign1
      AND event.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=evidence.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
    WHERE predecessor.participant_id=p_key.participant_id
      AND predecessor.credential_id=old_key.workload_credential_id AND successor.credential_id=p_key.workload_credential_id
      AND predecessor.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND predecessor.state='REVOKED'
      AND successor.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND successor.state='ACTIVE'
      AND predecessor.credential_epoch=old_key.workload_credential_epoch+1
      AND successor.credential_epoch=predecessor.credential_epoch
      AND successor.credential_epoch=p_key.workload_credential_epoch
      AND successor.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND successor.valid_until>clock_timestamp()

  ))
  OR p_key.environment_id<>old_key.environment_id OR p_key.environment_id<>rotation.environment_id
  OR p_key.workload_credential_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM issuer->>'workloadCredentialId'
  OR p_key.workload_credential_epoch::text IS DISTINCT FROM issuer->>'workloadCredentialEpoch'
  OR p_key.envelope_workload_participant_epoch::text IS DISTINCT FROM issuer->>'workloadParticipantEpoch'
  OR p_key.envelope_workload_principal_epoch::text IS DISTINCT FROM issuer->>'workloadPrincipalEpoch'
  OR p_key.admission_digest<>expected_digest OR p_key.secret_class<>'SECRET-SIGNING-KEY'
  OR p_key.secret_reference IS DISTINCT FROM descriptor->>'reference' OR p_key.secret_version IS DISTINCT FROM descriptor->>'version'
  OR p_key.signer_id IS DISTINCT FROM descriptor->>'fingerprint' OR encode(p_key.public_key_spki_der,'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM descriptor->>'publicKeySpkiHex'
  OR p_key.valid_from_ns::text IS DISTINCT FROM descriptor->>'validFromNs' OR p_key.valid_until_ns::text IS DISTINCT FROM descriptor->>'validUntilNs'
  OR p_key.valid_from_ns>floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000
  OR p_key.valid_until_ns<=floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-TRUST-BINDING'; END IF;
 SELECT count(*) INTO proofs FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_attempt a WHERE a.operation_id=step.operation_id
  AND a.participant_id=step.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=step.privacy_domain_id AND a.rotation_id=step.rotation_id
  AND a.slot IN('old','new') AND a.state='OBSERVED' AND a.observation=a.first_observation
  AND a.request->>'method'='PROVE' AND a.request->>'challengeHex'=encode(p_key.trust_digest,'hex')
  AND a.request->>'expectedFingerprint'=CASE a.slot WHEN 'old' THEN old_key.signer_id ELSE p_key.signer_id END
  AND a.request->'recoveryPredecessor' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM
    (CASE WHEN a.slot='old' THEN jsonb_build_object('purpose','IDENTITY_ENVELOPE_SIGNER_REPAIR_ONLY',
    'enrollmentId',step.authority_binding#>>'{lease,enrollmentId}',
    'enrollmentDigest',step.authority_binding#>>'{lease,enrollmentDigest}',
    'recoveryId',step.authority_binding#>>'{lease,recoveryId}',
    'activationOperationId',step.authority_binding#>>'{lease,activationOperationId}',
    'leaseDigest','sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(step.authority_binding->'lease'),'UTF8')),'hex'),
    'oldTrustDigest',step.authority_binding#>>'{lease,oldTrustDigest}') ELSE NULL END)
  AND a.observation->>'outcome'='SUCCEEDED' AND a.observation->>'resultHex' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{128}$'
  AND a.observation->>'attemptId'=a.attempt_id::text AND a.observation->>'operationId'=step.operation_id::text
  AND a.observation->>'requestDigest'='sha256:'||encode(a.request_digest,'hex')
  AND a.observation_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(a.observation),'UTF8'))
  AND a.first_observation_digest=a.observation_digest
  AND (a.request->>'challengeIssuedAtNs')::numeric<=(a.observation->>'recordedAtNs')::numeric
  AND (a.observation->>'recordedAtNs')::numeric<=floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000
  AND (a.request->>'challengeExpiresAtNs')::numeric>floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000
  AND (a.request->>'challengeExpiresAtNs')::numeric>(a.observation->>'recordedAtNs')::numeric
  AND a.observation#>>'{descriptor,state}'='ACTIVE'
  AND a.observation#>>'{descriptor,participantId}'=p_key.participant_id::text
  AND a.observation#>>'{descriptor,privacyDomainId}'=p_key.privacy_domain_id::text
  AND a.observation#>>'{descriptor,environmentId}'=p_key.environment_id
  AND a.observation#>>'{descriptor,workloadCredentialId}'=CASE a.slot WHEN 'old' THEN old_key.workload_credential_id::text ELSE p_key.workload_credential_id::text END
  AND a.observation#>>'{descriptor,workloadCredentialEpoch}'=CASE a.slot WHEN 'old' THEN old_key.workload_credential_epoch::text ELSE p_key.workload_credential_epoch::text END
  AND a.observation#>>'{descriptor,publicKeySpkiHex}'=CASE a.slot WHEN 'old' THEN encode(old_key.public_key_spki_der,'hex') ELSE encode(p_key.public_key_spki_der,'hex') END
  AND a.observation#>>'{descriptor,fingerprint}'=CASE a.slot WHEN 'old' THEN old_key.signer_id ELSE p_key.signer_id END
  AND a.observation#>>'{descriptor,reference}'=CASE a.slot WHEN 'old' THEN old_key.secret_reference ELSE p_key.secret_reference END
  AND a.observation#>>'{descriptor,version}'=CASE a.slot WHEN 'old' THEN old_key.secret_version ELSE p_key.secret_version END
  AND a.observation#>>'{descriptor,validFromNs}'=CASE a.slot WHEN 'old' THEN old_key.valid_from_ns::text ELSE p_key.valid_from_ns::text END
  AND a.observation#>>'{descriptor,validUntilNs}'=CASE a.slot WHEN 'old' THEN old_key.valid_until_ns::text ELSE p_key.valid_until_ns::text END
  AND a.observation#>'{descriptor,revokedAtNs}'='null'::jsonb AND a.observation#>'{descriptor,retiredAtNs}'='null'::jsonb
  AND (a.slot='old' OR a.observation->'descriptor'=descriptor);
 IF (SELECT count(DISTINCT a.request->>'challengeIssuedAtNs') FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_attempt a WHERE a.operation_id=step.operation_id)<>1
  OR step.result->>'observationsDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(
    (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('slot',a.slot,'request',a.request,'observation',a.observation) ORDER BY CASE a.slot WHEN 'old' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
     FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_attempt a WHERE a.operation_id=step.operation_id)),'UTF8')),'hex')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-TRUST-PROOF-BINDING'; END IF;
 IF proofs<>2 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_attempt a WHERE a.operation_id=step.operation_id)<>2
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-TRUST-DUAL-PROOF'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_identity_envelope_rotation_step_effect()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.state NOT IN ('COMMITTED','FAILED') THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_key_rotation r WHERE r.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
   AND r.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND r.rotation_id=NEW.rotation_id
   AND r.recovery_case_id=NEW.recovery_id AND r.revision=NEW.from_revision+1 AND r.state=NEW.result->>'state')
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event event WHERE event.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
    AND event.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND event.aggregate_type='signing-key-rotation'
    AND event.aggregate_id=NEW.rotation_id AND event.event_id=NEW.operation_id
    AND event.event_type='openpc.identity.envelope-rotation.phase.v1'
    AND event.payload_cbor=NEW.evidence_cbor AND event.payload_digest=NEW.evidence_digest AND event.cose_sign1=NEW.cose_sign1)
  OR (NEW.state='COMMITTED' AND NEW.to_state IN('OLD_REVOKED','OLD_RETIRED','COMPLETE') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_step consumer
 JOIN control.signing_key_rotation r ON r.participant_id=consumer.participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=consumer.privacy_domain_id AND r.rotation_id=consumer.rotation_id AND r.recovery_case_id=consumer.recovery_id
 JOIN control.identity_envelope_signing_selection selection ON selection.participant_id=r.participant_id AND selection.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND selection.environment_id=r.environment_id AND selection.signer_id=r.new_signer_id
 JOIN control.business_signing_key next ON next.participant_id=selection.participant_id AND next.privacy_domain_id=selection.privacy_domain_id AND next.signer_id=selection.signer_id
 JOIN control.identity_envelope_signing_grant next_grant ON next_grant.participant_id=next.participant_id AND next_grant.privacy_domain_id=next.privacy_domain_id AND next_grant.signer_id=next.signer_id AND next_grant.profile_digest=selection.profile_digest AND next_grant.signing_purpose_code=371
 JOIN control.business_signing_key_state next_life ON next_life.participant_id=next.participant_id AND next_life.privacy_domain_id=next.privacy_domain_id AND next_life.signer_id=next.signer_id
 JOIN control.business_signing_key old_key ON old_key.participant_id=r.participant_id AND old_key.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND old_key.signer_id=r.old_signer_id
 JOIN control.business_signing_key_state old_life ON old_life.participant_id=old_key.participant_id AND old_life.privacy_domain_id=old_key.privacy_domain_id AND old_life.signer_id=old_key.signer_id
 JOIN control.identity_envelope_activation a ON a.participant_id=consumer.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=consumer.privacy_domain_id AND a.operation_id=consumer.consumer_activation_operation_id
 WHERE consumer.operation_id=NEW.consumer_observation_operation_id AND consumer.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND consumer.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
 AND consumer.rotation_id=NEW.rotation_id AND consumer.recovery_id=NEW.recovery_id AND consumer.principal_id=NEW.principal_id
 AND consumer.from_revision=6 AND consumer.from_state='CUTOVER_FENCED' AND consumer.to_state='OBSERVING' AND consumer.state='COMMITTED'
 AND consumer.authority_binding=NEW.authority_binding AND consumer.authority_digest=NEW.authority_digest
 AND consumer.evidence_digest=sha256(consumer.evidence_cbor) AND octet_length(consumer.cose_sign1)>0
 AND a.state='COMMITTED' AND a.row_version=4 AND a.payload_digest=sha256(a.payload_cbor)
 AND a.operation_id::text=consumer.result->>'consumerActivationOperationId' AND a.envelope_id::text=consumer.result->>'consumerEnvelopeId'
 AND 'sha256:'||encode(a.payload_digest,'hex')=consumer.result->>'consumerPayloadDigest'
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.business_signing_grant ordinary WHERE ordinary.participant_id=next.participant_id AND ordinary.privacy_domain_id=next.privacy_domain_id AND ordinary.signer_id IN(next.signer_id,old_key.signer_id))
 AND next_life.state='ACTIVE' AND next.signing_purpose_code=371 AND old_key.signing_purpose_code=371
 AND selection.profile_digest=decode('54d85c86019a4475f8207f375fa571565e9e6e0adb5b0bd55abc03e4beb81f74','hex')
 AND selection.admission_version=(NEW.authority_binding#>>'{lease,selectionAdmissionVersion}')::numeric+1
 AND selection.admission_version::text=consumer.result->>'selectionAdmissionVersion'
 AND 'sha256:'||encode(next.trust_digest,'hex')=consumer.result->>'trustDigest' AND next.signer_id=consumer.result->>'signerId'
 AND old_key.trust_digest=decode(substr(NEW.authority_binding#>>'{lease,oldTrustDigest}',8),'hex')
 AND old_life.state=(CASE WHEN NEW.from_state='OBSERVING' AND false THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'REVOKED' END)
 AND (NEW.result IS NULL OR (NEW.result->>'consumerObservationOperationId'=consumer.operation_id::text
 AND NEW.result->>'consumerActivationOperationId'=consumer.result->>'consumerActivationOperationId'
 AND NEW.result->>'consumerEnvelopeId'=consumer.result->>'consumerEnvelopeId' AND NEW.result->>'consumerPayloadDigest'=consumer.result->>'consumerPayloadDigest'
 AND NEW.result->>'consumerReceiptDigest'=consumer.result->>'consumerReceiptDigest' AND NEW.result->>'signerId'=consumer.result->>'signerId'
 AND NEW.result->>'trustDigest'=consumer.result->>'trustDigest' AND NEW.result->>'selectionAdmissionVersion'=consumer.result->>'selectionAdmissionVersion'
 AND NEW.result->>'predecessorSignerId'=old_key.signer_id AND NEW.result->>'permissionEffect'='NONE'))))
  OR (NEW.state='COMMITTED' AND NEW.to_state='OBSERVING' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_key_rotation r
 JOIN control.identity_envelope_activation a ON a.participant_id=r.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND a.operation_id=NEW.consumer_activation_operation_id
 JOIN control.identity_envelope_proposal p ON p.participant_id=a.participant_id AND p.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND p.envelope_id=a.envelope_id
 JOIN control.authority_envelope e ON e.participant_id=a.participant_id AND e.authority_envelope_id=a.envelope_id
 JOIN control.identity_envelope_signing_selection selection ON selection.participant_id=r.participant_id AND selection.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND selection.environment_id=r.environment_id AND selection.signer_id=r.new_signer_id
 JOIN control.business_signing_key k ON k.participant_id=selection.participant_id AND k.privacy_domain_id=selection.privacy_domain_id AND k.signer_id=selection.signer_id
 JOIN control.identity_envelope_signing_grant g ON g.participant_id=k.participant_id AND g.privacy_domain_id=k.privacy_domain_id AND g.signer_id=k.signer_id
 JOIN control.business_signing_key_state life ON life.participant_id=k.participant_id AND life.privacy_domain_id=k.privacy_domain_id AND life.signer_id=k.signer_id
 JOIN control.mutation_candidate candidate ON candidate.participant_id=a.participant_id AND candidate.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND candidate.mutation_candidate_id=a.candidate_id
 JOIN control.idempotency_record idem ON idem.participant_id=a.participant_id AND idem.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND idem.operation_id=a.operation_id AND idem.idempotency_record_id=a.idempotency_record_id
 JOIN control.mutation_evidence receipt ON receipt.participant_id=a.participant_id AND receipt.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND receipt.operation_id=a.operation_id AND receipt.aggregate_id=a.envelope_id
 JOIN control.outbox_event event ON event.participant_id=receipt.participant_id AND event.privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND event.aggregate_type='authority-envelope' AND event.aggregate_id=a.envelope_id AND event.event_type='openpc.authority-envelope.mutation.committed.v1'
  AND event.payload_cbor=receipt.evidence_cbor AND event.payload_digest=receipt.evidence_digest AND event.cose_sign1=receipt.cose_sign1
 WHERE r.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND r.rotation_id=NEW.rotation_id AND r.recovery_case_id=NEW.recovery_id
  AND selection.admission_version=(NEW.authority_binding#>>'{lease,selectionAdmissionVersion}')::numeric+1 AND selection.profile_digest=decode('54d85c86019a4475f8207f375fa571565e9e6e0adb5b0bd55abc03e4beb81f74','hex')
  AND k.signing_purpose_code=371 AND g.signing_purpose_code=371 AND g.profile_digest=selection.profile_digest AND life.state='ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.business_signing_grant ordinary WHERE ordinary.participant_id=k.participant_id AND ordinary.privacy_domain_id=k.privacy_domain_id AND ordinary.signer_id=k.signer_id)
  AND a.state='COMMITTED' AND a.row_version=4 AND a.reserved_at_ns>=r.cutover_at_ns AND a.committed_at<=NEW.created_at
  AND a.payload_digest=sha256(a.payload_cbor) AND a.request->>'expectedFingerprint'=k.signer_id AND a.request->>'trustContextDigest'='sha256:'||encode(k.trust_digest,'hex')
  AND a.request->>'reference'=k.secret_reference AND a.request->>'version'=k.secret_version AND a.request->>'callerWorkloadCredentialId'=k.workload_credential_id::text
  AND candidate.state='CONSUMED' AND candidate.consumed_operation_id=a.operation_id AND candidate.candidate_digest=a.candidate_digest AND candidate.resource_id=a.envelope_id
  AND candidate.action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANT_ACTIVATE_CONTEXT-V1' AND candidate.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATE'
  AND idem.terminal_state='COMMITTED' AND idem.action_intent_id=candidate.action_intent_id AND idem.catalog_operation_id=candidate.catalog_operation_id
  AND e.representation='TYPED_V1' AND e.state='ACTIVE' AND e.row_version=4 AND e.last_mutation_operation_id=a.operation_id
  AND e.cose_sign1=a.cose_sign1 AND e.semantic_cbor=p.proposal_cbor AND e.semantic_digest=p.proposal_digest
  AND receipt.action_intent_id=candidate.action_intent_id AND receipt.catalog_operation_id=candidate.catalog_operation_id AND receipt.aggregate_version=3
  AND receipt.evidence_digest=sha256(receipt.evidence_cbor) AND octet_length(receipt.cose_sign1)>0
  AND (NEW.result IS NULL OR (NEW.result->>'consumerActivationOperationId'=a.operation_id::text
   AND NEW.result->>'consumerEnvelopeId'=a.envelope_id::text AND NEW.result->>'consumerPayloadDigest'='sha256:'||encode(a.payload_digest,'hex')
   AND NEW.result->>'consumerReceiptDigest'='sha256:'||encode(receipt.evidence_digest,'hex') AND NEW.result->>'signerId'=k.signer_id
   AND NEW.result->>'trustDigest'='sha256:'||encode(k.trust_digest,'hex') AND NEW.result->>'selectionAdmissionVersion'=selection.admission_version::text
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_attempt proof WHERE proof.operation_id=NEW.operation_id
    AND proof.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND proof.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND proof.rotation_id=NEW.rotation_id
    AND proof.slot='effective' AND proof.state='OBSERVED' AND proof.request->>'method'='PROVE' AND proof.observation->>'outcome'='SUCCEEDED'

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_module_admission_receipt(receipt control.audit_occurrence)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE projection jsonb; candidate control.mutation_candidate%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 IF receipt.catalog_operation_id NOT IN ('MOD-OP-REGISTER','MOD-OP-INSTALL','MOD-OP-ENABLE','MOD-OP-DISABLE') OR receipt.aggregate_type<>'module-registration'
  OR receipt.after_existence<>1 OR (receipt.catalog_operation_id='MOD-OP-REGISTER' AND
   (receipt.before_existence<>0 OR receipt.before_revision<>0 OR receipt.after_revision<>1))
  OR (receipt.catalog_operation_id<>'MOD-OP-REGISTER' AND
   (receipt.before_existence<>1 OR receipt.before_revision<1 OR receipt.after_revision<>receipt.before_revision+1))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-MODULE-TRANSITION'; END IF;
 candidate:=openpc.check_governed_configuration_receipt(receipt);
 projection:=openpc.business_cbor(receipt.after_state_preimage)->8;
 IF receipt.catalog_operation_id<>'MOD-OP-REGISTER' THEN
  PERFORM openpc.check_module_lifecycle_state(receipt);
  RETURN;
 END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.module_installation m JOIN control.module_version v USING(module_version_id)
  JOIN control.module_configuration_generation c USING(module_installation_id)
  WHERE m.participant_id=receipt.participant_id AND m.privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id
   AND m.module_installation_id=receipt.aggregate_id AND c.participant_id=m.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=m.privacy_domain_id
   AND m.state='ADMITTED' AND m.aggregate_version=1 AND m.active_manifest_digest IS NULL
   AND c.generation=1 AND c.active=false AND v.release_payload_cbor IS NOT NULL
   AND v.module_id=candidate.candidate_document->>'name'
   AND v.semantic_version=candidate.candidate_document->>'semanticVersion'
   AND 'sha256:'||encode(v.manifest_digest,'hex')=candidate.candidate_document->>'manifestDigest'
   AND projection=jsonb_build_object('0',v.module_id,'1',v.semantic_version,'2',openpc.business_bytes(v.manifest_digest),
    '3',openpc.business_bytes(m.admission_dependency_digest),'4',openpc.business_bytes(c.configuration_digest),
    '5','ADMITTED','6',0,'7',1,'8',0))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-MODULE-DURABLE-STATE'; END IF;
END $function$

 ELSE
  IF previous.last_sequence IS DISTINCT FROM 0 OR previous.last_event_id IS NOT NULL OR previous.last_data_digest IS NOT NULL OR previous.revision IS DISTINCT FROM 1
  OR item.revision IS DISTINCT FROM 2
  OR to_jsonb(previous)-ARRAY['last_sequence','last_event_id','last_data_digest','revision'] IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(item)-ARRAY['last_sequence','last_event_id','last_data_digest','revision']
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPLETION-SHARED-CURSOR-TRANSITION'; END IF;
 END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_notification_completion_effect_binding(event uuid, phase text, installation text, authority text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE admitted record;
BEGIN
 IF event IS NULL OR phase IS NULL OR phase NOT IN ('SOURCE','CLAIM','LIMIT','FINISH','PREPARE','SIGN_CLAIM','OBSERVE','PUBLISH')
 OR (installation ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$') IS DISTINCT FROM true
 OR (authority ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$') IS DISTINCT FROM true
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPLETION-EFFECT-BINDING'; END IF;
 -- STRICT proves cardinality. The native owner verifies MAC, exact login,
 -- backend/transaction/event/phase, live identity and current installed worker.
 SELECT * INTO STRICT admitted FROM openpc.notification_completion_phase_binding(event,phase);
 IF admitted.installation_digest IS DISTINCT FROM installation OR admitted.authority_digest IS DISTINCT FROM authority
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPLETION-EFFECT-BINDING'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_notification_completion_inbox_effect(item control.notification_source_inbox, previous control.notification_source_inbox)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE d control.notification_completion_disposition%ROWTYPE;s control.notification_completion_source%ROWTYPE;e control.outbox_event%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 d:=openpc.check_notification_completion_shared_publication(item.event_id);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT s FROM control.notification_completion_source WHERE participant_id=d.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=d.privacy_domain_id AND event_id=d.event_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT e FROM control.outbox_event WHERE participant_id=d.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=d.privacy_domain_id AND event_id=d.event_id;
 IF item.participant_id IS DISTINCT FROM d.participant_id OR item.privacy_domain_id IS DISTINCT FROM d.privacy_domain_id
 OR item.subscription_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'SUB-NOTIFICATIONDELIVERYCOMPLETED-CONTROL_WORK-V1'
 OR item.source IS DISTINCT FROM e.source OR item.partition IS DISTINCT FROM 'urn:openpc:resource:'||e.aggregate_id::text
 OR item.source_sequence IS DISTINCT FROM e.business_sequence OR item.data_digest IS DISTINCT FROM s.source->'reference'->>'dataDigest'
 OR item.envelope_digest IS DISTINCT FROM s.source->'reference'->>'envelopeDigest'
 OR item.envelope IS DISTINCT FROM convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(s.source->'envelope'),'UTF8')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPLETION-SHARED-INBOX-BINDING'; END IF;
 IF previous.participant_id IS NOT NULL THEN
  -- Generated operation columns are computed after BEFORE triggers. They are
  -- independently fixed by their expressions and operation-specific FKs.
  IF previous.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'PENDING' OR previous.admission_operation_id IS NOT NULL OR previous.safe_problem_code IS NOT NULL
   OR to_jsonb(previous)-ARRAY['state','safe_problem_code','admission_operation_id','occurrence_admission_operation_id','completion_admission_operation_id']
    IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(item)-ARRAY['state','safe_problem_code','admission_operation_id','occurrence_admission_operation_id','completion_admission_operation_id']
   OR item.state IS DISTINCT FROM d.disposition
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPLETION-SHARED-INBOX-TRANSITION'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF item.state='PENDING' THEN
  IF item.admission_operation_id IS NOT NULL OR item.safe_problem_code IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPLETION-SHARED-INBOX-PENDING'; END IF;
 ELSE
  IF item.state IS DISTINCT FROM d.disposition OR item.admission_operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM d.operation_id
   OR item.safe_problem_code IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE d.disposition WHEN 'QUARANTINED' THEN 'PC-OPS-9001' ELSE NULL END)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPLETION-SHARED-INBOX-RESULT'; END IF;
 END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_notification_completion_phase_proof(proof jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE now_ms numeric; p uuid; privacy uuid; installation record;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_notification_completion_admission_owner();
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 now_ms:=floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000);
 IF current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed'
  OR openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-POLICY_READ_EFFECTIVE_ACCESS-V1'
  OR jsonb_typeof(proof) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR proof IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('version',2,'receiptBinding',proof->'receiptBinding','transactionId',pg_current_xact_id()::text,
   'backendPid',pg_backend_pid(),'databaseRole',session_user,
   'participantId',openpc.current_participant_id()::text,'privacyDomainId',openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()::text,
   'eventId',proof->'eventId','phase',proof->'phase','installationDigest',proof->'installationDigest',
   'authorityDigest',proof->'authorityDigest','principalId',proof->'principalId','credentialId',proof->'credentialId',
   'participantEpoch',proof->'participantEpoch','principalEpoch',proof->'principalEpoch','workloadEpoch',proof->'workloadEpoch',
   'workloadId',proof->'workloadId','uriSan',proof->'uriSan','keyId',proof->'keyId',
   'issuedAtMs',proof->'issuedAtMs','expiresAtMs',proof->'expiresAtMs')
  OR coalesce(proof->>'phase','') NOT IN ('SOURCE','CLAIM','LIMIT','FINISH','PREPARE','SIGN_CLAIM','OBSERVE','PUBLISH')
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (VALUES('eventId'),('principalId'),('credentialId')) f(name)
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(proof->f.name) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR coalesce(proof->>f.name,'') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (VALUES('installationDigest'),('authorityDigest'),('keyId')) f(name)
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(proof->f.name) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR coalesce(proof->>f.name,'') !~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$')
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (VALUES('participantEpoch'),('principalEpoch'),('workloadEpoch')) f(name)
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(proof->f.name) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR coalesce(proof->>f.name,'') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$')
  OR jsonb_typeof(proof->'issuedAtMs') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
  OR jsonb_typeof(proof->'expiresAtMs') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
  OR (proof->>'issuedAtMs')::numeric<>trunc((proof->>'issuedAtMs')::numeric)
  OR (proof->>'expiresAtMs')::numeric<>trunc((proof->>'expiresAtMs')::numeric)
  OR (proof->>'issuedAtMs')::numeric>now_ms OR (proof->>'issuedAtMs')::numeric<now_ms-5000
  OR (proof->>'expiresAtMs')::numeric<=now_ms
  OR (proof->>'expiresAtMs')::numeric>(proof->>'issuedAtMs')::numeric+5000
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIFICATION-COMPLETION-NATIVE-PROOF'; END IF;
 IF proof->'receiptBinding' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb THEN
  IF proof->>'phase' NOT IN ('OBSERVE','PUBLISH') OR jsonb_typeof(proof->'receiptBinding') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
   OR proof->'receiptBinding' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(
    'schema','pc.notification.completion-verified-receipt.v1','purpose','pc.cose.notification-completion-disposition-receipt.v1',
    'requestDigest',proof->'receiptBinding'->'requestDigest','preparationDigest',proof->'receiptBinding'->'preparationDigest',
    'payloadDigest',proof->'receiptBinding'->'payloadDigest','coseDigest',proof->'receiptBinding'->'coseDigest',
    'observationDigest',proof->'receiptBinding'->'observationDigest','signerInstallationDigest',proof->'receiptBinding'->'signerInstallationDigest',
    'signerKeyId',proof->'receiptBinding'->'signerKeyId','originalWorkerInstallationDigest',proof->'receiptBinding'->'originalWorkerInstallationDigest',
    'producerTrustDigest',proof->'receiptBinding'->'producerTrustDigest','environmentId',proof->'receiptBinding'->'environmentId')
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (VALUES('requestDigest'),('preparationDigest'),('payloadDigest'),('coseDigest'),('observationDigest'),
     ('signerInstallationDigest'),('signerKeyId'),('originalWorkerInstallationDigest'),('producerTrustDigest')) f(name)
     WHERE jsonb_typeof(proof->'receiptBinding'->f.name) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR coalesce(proof->'receiptBinding'->>f.name,'') !~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$')
   OR jsonb_typeof(proof->'receiptBinding'->'environmentId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   OR length(proof->'receiptBinding'->>'environmentId') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 160
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIFICATION-COMPLETION-NATIVE-RECEIPT'; END IF;
 END IF;
 p:=openpc.current_participant_id(); privacy:=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id();
 -- The Identity callback holds the authority fences. These exact row locks
 -- also prevent a direct verifier invocation racing a committed withdrawal.
 PERFORM 1 FROM control.participant x WHERE x.participant_id=p AND x.state='ACTIVE'
  AND x.authority_epoch::text=proof->>'participantEpoch' FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIFICATION-COMPLETION-NATIVE-CURRENT'; END IF;
 PERFORM 1 FROM control.privacy_domain x WHERE x.participant_id=p AND x.privacy_domain_id=privacy
  AND x.state='ACTIVE' FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIFICATION-COMPLETION-NATIVE-CURRENT'; END IF;
 PERFORM 1 FROM control.principal x WHERE x.participant_id=p AND x.principal_id=(proof->>'principalId')::uuid
  AND x.kind='WORKLOAD' AND x.state='ACTIVE' AND x.authority_epoch::text=proof->>'principalEpoch' FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIFICATION-COMPLETION-NATIVE-CURRENT'; END IF;
 PERFORM 1 FROM control.credential x WHERE x.participant_id=p AND x.credential_id=(proof->>'credentialId')::uuid
  AND x.principal_id=(proof->>'principalId')::uuid AND x.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND x.state='ACTIVE'
  AND x.credential_epoch::text=proof->>'workloadEpoch' AND x.audience=proof->>'workloadId'
  AND x.subject=proof->>'uriSan' AND x.public_key_digest=decode(substring(proof->>'keyId' from 8),'hex')
  AND x.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND x.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
  AND extract(epoch from x.valid_until)*1000>=(proof->>'expiresAtMs')::numeric FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIFICATION-COMPLETION-NATIVE-CURRENT'; END IF;
 IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock_shared(hashtextextended('notification-completion-worker:'||p::text||':'||privacy::text,0))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 PERFORM openpc.assert_notification_completion_worker_installation_owner();
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installation FROM control.installed_notification_completion_worker x
  WHERE x.participant_id=p AND x.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND x.installation_digest=proof->>'installationDigest'
   AND x.state='ACTIVE' AND x.principal_id=(proof->>'principalId')::uuid
   AND x.workload_credential_id=(proof->>'credentialId')::uuid
   AND x.service_id='LS-CONTROL-WORK' AND x.subscription_id='SUB-NOTIFICATIONDELIVERYCOMPLETED-CONTROL_WORK-V1' FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 IF installation.installation->'pins'->>'workloadEpoch' IS DISTINCT FROM proof->>'workloadEpoch'
  OR installation.installation->'pins'->>'workloadId' IS DISTINCT FROM proof->>'workloadId'
  OR installation.installation->'pins'->>'workloadKeyDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM proof->>'keyId'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIFICATION-COMPLETION-NATIVE-WORKER'; END IF;
EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007';
END $function$
event uuid, phase text, observation jsonb

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_notification_completion_receipt_admission(event uuid, phase text, observation jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE verified jsonb;expected jsonb;q jsonb;
 s control.notification_completion_disposition_signing%ROWTYPE;
 signer control.notification_completion_disposition_signer_installation%ROWTYPE;
 worker control.installed_notification_completion_worker%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 IF event IS NULL OR phase IS NULL OR phase NOT IN ('OBSERVE','PUBLISH') OR observation IS NULL
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPLETION-RECEIPT-ADMISSION'; END IF;
 verified:=openpc.notification_completion_verified_receipt(event,phase);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT s FROM control.notification_completion_disposition_signing WHERE participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id()
  AND privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id() AND event_id=event;
 q:=s.preparation->'request';
 SELECT * INTO STRICT signer FROM control.notification_completion_disposition_signer_installation WHERE participant_id=s.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=s.privacy_domain_id AND trust_digest=s.signer_installation_digest;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT worker FROM control.installed_notification_completion_worker WHERE participant_id=s.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=s.privacy_domain_id AND installation_digest=signer.worker_installation_digest;
 IF verified IS NULL OR s.state NOT IN ('DISPATCHED','OBSERVED') OR observation->>'outcome' IS DISTINCT FROM 'SIGNED'
 OR (phase='PUBLISH' AND s.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'OBSERVED')
 OR (s.state='OBSERVED' AND observation IS DISTINCT FROM s.observation)
 OR s.preparation_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(s.preparation),'UTF8')
 OR s.preparation_digest IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(s.preparation_bytes),'hex')
 OR s.request_digest IS DISTINCT FROM s.preparation->>'requestDigest'
 OR s.request_digest IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to('pc.notification.completion-disposition-provider-request.v1','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(q),'UTF8')),'hex')
 OR q->>'signerInstallationDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM signer.trust_digest
 OR q->>'signerKeyId' IS DISTINCT FROM signer.trust->>'signerKeyId'
 OR q->>'workerInstallationDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM worker.installation_digest
 OR q->>'environmentId' IS DISTINCT FROM worker.installation->'pins'->>'environmentId'
 OR q->>'dispositionPreparationDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(s.preparation->'preparation'),'UTF8')),'hex')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPLETION-RECEIPT-ADMISSION'; END IF;
 expected:=jsonb_build_object(
  'schema','pc.notification.completion-verified-receipt.v1',
  'purpose','pc.cose.notification-completion-disposition-receipt.v1',
  'requestDigest',s.request_digest,
  'preparationDigest',q->>'dispositionPreparationDigest',
  'payloadDigest','sha256:'||encode(sha256(decode(q->>'payloadHex','hex')),'hex'),
  'coseDigest','sha256:'||encode(sha256(decode(observation->>'coseHex','hex')),'hex'),
  'observationDigest','sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(observation),'UTF8')),'hex'),
  'signerInstallationDigest',signer.trust_digest,'signerKeyId',signer.trust->>'signerKeyId',
  'originalWorkerInstallationDigest',worker.installation_digest,
  'producerTrustDigest',worker.producer_trust_digest,'environmentId',worker.installation->'pins'->>'environmentId');
 IF verified IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPLETION-RECEIPT-ADMISSION'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_notification_delivery_completed_event(e control.outbox_event)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE o control.notification_delivery_outcome%ROWTYPE;r jsonb;data jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT o FROM control.notification_delivery_outcome WHERE participant_id=e.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id AND operation_id=e.correlation_id;
 PERFORM openpc.check_notification_outcome_publication_receipt(o);r:=o.transition->'receipt';
 data:=jsonb_build_object('0','urn:openpc:resource:'||o.notification_occurrence_id::text,'1',r->>'afterDeliveryState','2',(r->>'attemptCount')::numeric,'3',openpc.business_bytes(decode(substr(r->>'gatewayCoseDigest',8),'hex')));
 IF (r->>'afterDeliveryState' IN ('DELIVERED','FAILED')) IS DISTINCT FROM true
 OR e.event_id<>o.receipt_id OR e.event_type<>'io.openpc.notification.delivery.completed.v1' OR e.aggregate_type<>'notification-occurrence' OR e.aggregate_id<>o.notification_occurrence_id
 OR e.proof_kind<>'NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_COMPLETION_REFERENCE' OR e.sequence_namespace<>'NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_COMPLETED_V1' OR e.business_sequence IS DISTINCT FROM 1
 OR e.aggregate_sequence IS NOT NULL OR e.receipt_id IS NOT NULL OR e.cose_sign1 IS NOT NULL OR e.authority_generation IS NOT NULL OR e.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest IS NOT NULL
 OR e.source IS DISTINCT FROM 'urn:openpc:service:LS-NOTIFICATION' OR e.subject IS DISTINCT FROM 'urn:openpc:resource:'||o.notification_occurrence_id::text
 OR e.data_schema_uri IS DISTINCT FROM 'https://schemas.openpc.local/event-payloads.schema.json#/$defs/NotificationDeliveryCompleted'
 OR e.causation_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM o.transition->'input'->'observation'->'original'->'source'->>'eventId'
 OR extract(epoch from e.occurred_at)*1000 IS DISTINCT FROM (r->>'recordedAtMs')::numeric
 OR e.payload_digest IS DISTINCT FROM sha256(e.payload_cbor) OR openpc.business_cbor(e.payload_cbor) IS DISTINCT FROM data
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIFICATION-OUTCOME-PUBLICATION-EVENT'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_notification_delivery_dispatch_intent_original(item control.notification_delivery_dispatch_intent)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE start control.notification_delivery_start%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT start FROM control.notification_delivery_start WHERE participant_id=item.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=item.privacy_domain_id AND operation_id=item.operation_id;

 IF item.attempt_id IS DISTINCT FROM start.attempt_id OR item.notification_occurrence_id IS DISTINCT FROM start.notification_occurrence_id OR item.payload_digest IS DISTINCT FROM start.payload_digest
 OR item.delivery_revision IS DISTINCT FROM start.delivery_revision+1 OR item.receipt_digest IS DISTINCT FROM start.receipt_digest
 OR ((item.state='PENDING' AND item.claim_token IS NULL AND item.claimed_at_ms IS NULL)
  OR (item.state='CLAIMED' AND item.claim_token IS NOT NULL AND item.claim_token ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND item.claimed_at_ms IS NOT NULL AND item.claimed_at_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991
   AND item.claimed_at_ms >= (start.transition->'attempt'->>'startedAtMs')::numeric AND item.claimed_at_ms < (start.transition->'attempt'->>'deadlineAtMs')::numeric)) IS DISTINCT FROM true
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIFICATION-START-INTENT'; END IF;
