CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_notification_delivery_requested_event(event control.outbox_event)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE prep control.notification_occurrence_preparation%ROWTYPE;
 proof control.notification_occurrence_observation%ROWTYPE;
 original control.notification_occurrence_observation%ROWTYPE;
 occurrence control.notification_occurrence%ROWTYPE; metadata control.notification%ROWTYPE;
 payload control.notification_payload_object%ROWTYPE;
 reference control.notification_payload%ROWTYPE;
 source control.evidence_export_completion%ROWTYPE;
 key_prep control.notification_key_preparation%ROWTYPE; cipher control.notification_key_ciphertext%ROWTYPE; route control.installed_notification_routing%ROWTYPE;
 m jsonb; o jsonb; occurrence_id uuid; payload_id uuid; source_id uuid;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF NOT pg_has_role(current_user,'openpc_control_runtime','USAGE')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user AND (rolsuper OR rolbypassrls))
 OR event.participant_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_participant_id()
 OR event.privacy_domain_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()

 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 SELECT p.* INTO STRICT prep FROM control.notification_occurrence_preparation p
 JOIN control.notification_occurrence_observation r USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,preparation_id)
 WHERE p.participant_id=event.participant_id AND p.privacy_domain_id=event.privacy_domain_id
 AND p.family='NotificationDeliveryRequestedReceiptV1' AND p.state='OBSERVED'
 AND openpc.business_cbor(r.receipt_payload)->'26'=openpc.business_uuid(event.event_id);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT proof FROM control.notification_occurrence_observation
 WHERE participant_id=prep.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=prep.privacy_domain_id AND preparation_id=prep.preparation_id;
 SELECT r.* INTO STRICT original FROM control.notification_occurrence_preparation p
 JOIN control.notification_occurrence_observation r USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,preparation_id)
 WHERE p.participant_id=prep.participant_id AND p.privacy_domain_id=prep.privacy_domain_id
 AND p.key_preparation_id=prep.key_preparation_id AND p.family='NotificationOccurrenceReceiptV1' AND p.state='OBSERVED';
 m:=openpc.business_cbor(proof.receipt_payload);o:=openpc.business_cbor(original.receipt_payload);
 PERFORM openpc.archive_cose_binding(proof.receipt_payload,proof.cose_sign1,'sha256:'||(m->'24'->>'bytes'),24020,357);
 PERFORM openpc.archive_cose_binding(original.receipt_payload,original.cose_sign1,'sha256:'||(o->'24'->>'bytes'),24019,356);
 IF m->'25' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('bytes',encode(sha256(original.receipt_payload),'hex'))
 OR m->'1' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'1'
 OR m->'2' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'2'
 OR m->'3' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'3'
 OR m->'6' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'6'
 OR m->'7' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'7'
 OR m->'8' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'8'
 OR m->'9' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'9'
 OR m->'10' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'10'
 OR m->'11' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'11'
 OR m->'12' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'12'
 OR m->'13' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'13'
 OR m->'16' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'16'
 OR m->'17' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'17'
 OR m->'18' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'18'
 OR m->'19' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'19'
 OR m->'20' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'20'
 OR m->'21' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'21'
 OR m->'22' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'22'
 OR m->'4' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o->'4' OR m->'5' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o->'5'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIFICATION-OCCURRENCE-PUBLICATION-PAIR'; END IF;
 occurrence_id:=(m->'7'->>'bytes')::uuid;payload_id:=(m->'8'->>'bytes')::uuid;source_id:=(m->'10'->>'bytes')::uuid;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_notification_effect_receipt()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE receipt control.audit_occurrence%ROWTYPE; before_projection jsonb;
BEGIN
 -- A signed occurrence reserves its exact notification identity. This selects
 -- the proof family only; the full checker below still requires both originals,
 -- exact metadata and every payload/inbox/cursor/outbox effect. No GUC selects
 -- or skips this deferred admission, and a malformed pair never falls back.
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' AND EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM control.notification_occurrence_preparation p
  JOIN control.notification_occurrence_observation o USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,preparation_id)
  WHERE p.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND p.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
   AND p.family='NotificationOccurrenceReceiptV1'
   AND openpc.business_cbor(o.receipt_payload)->'6'=openpc.business_uuid(NEW.notification_id)
 ) THEN
  PERFORM openpc.check_notification_occurrence_metadata_effect(NEW);
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 -- Ordinary public CREATE/ACK keeps its unconditional audit receipt check.
 SELECT * INTO STRICT receipt FROM control.audit_occurrence r WHERE r.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
  AND r.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND r.aggregate_type='notification'
  AND r.aggregate_id=NEW.notification_id AND r.after_revision=NEW.revision
  AND r.catalog_operation_id=(CASE WHEN TG_OP='INSERT' THEN 'CFG-OP-CREATE-NOTIFICATION'
    ELSE 'CFG-OP-ACKNOWLEDGE-NOTIFICATION' END);
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN before_projection:='{}'::jsonb;
 ELSE before_projection:=openpc.notification_business_projection(OLD); END IF;
 IF openpc.business_cbor(receipt.before_state_preimage)->8 IS DISTINCT FROM before_projection
  OR openpc.business_cbor(receipt.after_state_preimage)->8 IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.notification_business_projection(NEW)
  OR receipt.before_revision IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN TG_OP='INSERT' THEN 0 ELSE OLD.revision END)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-NOTIFICATION-EFFECT-RECEIPT'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

 OR (jsonb_typeof(m->'21')='object' AND (m->'21')-ARRAY['bytes']='{}'::jsonb AND m->'21'->>'bytes' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') IS DISTINCT FROM true
 OR (jsonb_typeof(m->'22')='object' AND (m->'22')-ARRAY['bytes']='{}'::jsonb AND m->'22'->>'bytes' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') IS DISTINCT FROM true
 OR (jsonb_typeof(m->'24')='object' AND (m->'24')-ARRAY['bytes']='{}'::jsonb AND m->'24'->>'bytes' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') IS DISTINCT FROM true
 OR jsonb_typeof(m->'23') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR (m->>'23')::numeric<0 OR (m->>'23')::numeric>9007199254740991
 OR trunc((m->>'23')::numeric) IS DISTINCT FROM (m->>'23')::numeric
 OR jsonb_typeof(m->'18') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR (m->>'18')::numeric<1 OR (m->>'18')::numeric>18446744073709551615
 OR m->'2' IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.business_uuid(prep.participant_id)
 OR m->'3' IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.business_uuid(prep.privacy_domain_id)
 OR m->'10' IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.business_uuid(prep.source_event_id)
 OR m->'9' IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.business_uuid(prep.key_preparation_id)
 OR m->'1' IS DISTINCT FROM p->'workerProfile'->'environmentId'
 OR m->'14' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('bytes',substring(p->>'workerProfileDigest' from 8))
 OR m->'15' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('bytes',substring(p->>'workerAuthorityDigest' from 8))
 OR m->'13' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('bytes',substring(w.routing_profile_digest from 8))
 OR m->'24' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('bytes',encode(sha256(decode(p->'workerProfile'->>'receiptSignerSpki','hex')),'hex'))
 OR (m->>'23')::numeric NOT BETWEEN (p->'workerProfile'->>'validFromMs')::numeric AND (p->'workerProfile'->>'validUntilMs')::numeric-1
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIFICATION-OCCURRENCE-CLAIMS'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT k FROM control.notification_key_preparation WHERE participant_id=prep.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=prep.privacy_domain_id AND preparation_id=prep.key_preparation_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT cipher FROM control.notification_key_ciphertext WHERE participant_id=prep.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=prep.privacy_domain_id AND preparation_id=prep.key_preparation_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT source FROM control.evidence_export_completion WHERE participant_id=prep.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=prep.privacy_domain_id AND event_id=prep.source_event_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT event FROM control.outbox_event WHERE participant_id=prep.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=prep.privacy_domain_id AND event_id=prep.source_event_id;
 PERFORM openpc.check_evidence_export_completion_event(event);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT route FROM control.installed_notification_routing WHERE participant_id=prep.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=prep.privacy_domain_id AND profile_id=k.routing_profile_id;
 IF source.state<>'PUBLISHED' OR source.stream_id IS DISTINCT FROM p->'input'->'source'->'scope'->>'streamId'
 OR source.evidence_export_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM p->'input'->'source'->>'evidenceExportId'
 OR source.trust_digest IS DISTINCT FROM p->'workerProfile'->>'producerTrustDigest'
 OR k.source_event_id<>prep.source_event_id OR k.kms_installation_digest IS DISTINCT FROM p->'workerProfile'->>'kmsInstallationDigest'
 OR route.state<>'ACTIVE' OR route.installation_digest IS DISTINCT FROM k.preparation->>'routingInstallationDigest'
 OR route.signed_profile_digest IS DISTINCT FROM w.routing_profile_digest
 OR m->'7' IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.business_uuid(k.occurrence_id)
 OR m->'8' IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.business_uuid(k.payload_object_id)
 OR m->'11' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('bytes',substring(source.claims->>'dataDigest' from 8))
 OR m->'12' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('bytes',substring(source.receipt_payload_digest from 8))
 OR m->'17' IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.business_uuid(route.endpoint_id)
 OR m->'18' IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.business_cbor(decode(route.installation->'signed'->>'payloadHex','hex'))->'10'
 OR m->'19' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('bytes',substring(k.preparation->'objectIntent'->>'templateDigest' from 8))
 OR m->'20' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('bytes',substring(k.preparation->'objectIntent'->>'payloadDigest' from 8))
 OR m->'21' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('bytes',substring(cipher.encrypted_object_digest from 8))
 OR m->'22' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('bytes',substring(cipher.key_id from 8))
 OR m->'16' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('bytes',encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(jsonb_build_object('preparationDigest',k.preparation_digest,'keyId',cipher.key_id,'encryptionExchangeId',cipher.encryption_exchange_id::text,'encryptedObjectDigest',cipher.encrypted_object_digest,'encryptionContextDigest',cipher.encryption_context_digest)),'UTF8')),'hex'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIFICATION-OCCURRENCE-CUSTODY'; END IF;
 IF NOT is_occurrence THEN
  SELECT o.* INTO STRICT original FROM control.notification_occurrence_preparation op
  JOIN control.notification_occurrence_observation o USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,preparation_id)
  WHERE op.participant_id=prep.participant_id AND op.privacy_domain_id=prep.privacy_domain_id
  AND op.key_preparation_id=prep.key_preparation_id AND op.family='NotificationOccurrenceReceiptV1' AND op.state='OBSERVED';
  IF (jsonb_typeof(m->'26')='object' AND (m->'26')-ARRAY['bytes']='{}'::jsonb AND m->'26'->>'bytes' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{12}7[0-9a-f]{3}[89ab][0-9a-f]{15}$') IS DISTINCT FROM true
  OR (jsonb_typeof(m->'29')='object' AND (m->'29')-ARRAY['bytes']='{}'::jsonb AND m->'29'->>'bytes' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') IS DISTINCT FROM true
  OR NOT m ?& ARRAY['25','26','27','28','29'] OR m->'25' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('bytes',encode(sha256(original.receipt_payload),'hex'))
  OR m->'27' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('bytes',replace(p->'workerProfile'->>'sourceId','-','')) OR m->'28' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'::jsonb
  OR m->'6' IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.business_cbor(original.receipt_payload)->'6'
  OR m->'5' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM openpc.business_cbor(original.receipt_payload)->'5'
  OR m->'4' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM openpc.business_cbor(original.receipt_payload)->'4'
  OR (m->>'23')::numeric<(openpc.business_cbor(original.receipt_payload)->>'23')::numeric
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIFICATION-OCCURRENCE-ORIGINAL'; END IF;
 END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_receipt_signing_attempt_completion()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.reservation_kind='ORDINARY_ATOMIC' THEN
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.audit_occurrence r WHERE r.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
   AND r.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND r.operation_id=NEW.operation_id
   AND r.receipt_id=NEW.attempt_id AND r.receipt_cbor=NEW.payload_cbor AND r.receipt_digest=NEW.payload_digest)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-INCOMPLETE-ATOMIC-SIGNING-ATTEMPT'; END IF;
 ELSE
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_rotation_attestation a JOIN control.signing_provider_attempt p USING(attempt_id)
   WHERE a.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
    AND a.operation_id=NEW.operation_id AND a.attempt_id=NEW.attempt_id AND a.receipt_cbor=NEW.payload_cbor
    AND a.signer_id=NEW.signer_id AND a.signer_trust_digest=NEW.signer_trust_digest
    AND a.selection_version=NEW.selection_version AND p.request->>'method'='SIGN_RECEIPT'
    AND p.request->>'payloadHex'=encode(NEW.payload_cbor,'hex') AND p.request->>'attemptId'=NEW.attempt_id::text)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-INCOMPLETE-LIFECYCLE-SIGNING-ATTEMPT'; END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_rotation_history_completion()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.state IN ('REQUESTED','APPROVED') AND NEW.revision<=2 THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_rotation_attestation a
  JOIN control.signing_provider_attempt p USING(attempt_id)
  JOIN control.audit_occurrence r ON r.participant_id=a.participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND r.receipt_id=a.attempt_id
  JOIN control.evidence_record e ON e.participant_id=r.participant_id AND e.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND e.receipt_id=r.receipt_id
  WHERE a.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND a.rotation_id=NEW.rotation_id
   AND a.operation_id=NEW.operation_id AND a.attempt_id=NEW.receipt_id AND a.from_revision=NEW.revision-1 AND a.to_state=NEW.state
   AND a.history_preimage=NEW.history_preimage AND a.history_digest=NEW.history_digest AND a.receipt_ordinal=NEW.receipt_ordinal
   AND a.receipt_cbor=r.receipt_cbor AND a.event_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.event_id AND a.evidence_record_id=NEW.evidence_id
   AND e.evidence_record_id=NEW.evidence_id AND r.before_revision=NEW.revision-1 AND r.after_revision=NEW.revision
   AND p.state='ACCEPTED' AND p.observation->>'outcome'='SUCCEEDED'
   AND p.observation->>'resultHex'=encode(r.cose_sign1,'hex'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-INCOMPLETE-SIGNED-ROTATION-HISTORY'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_rotation_trust_admission()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE rotation control.signing_key_rotation%ROWTYPE; old_key control.business_signing_key%ROWTYPE; proofs integer;
BEGIN
 IF NEW.admission_kind<>'GOVERNED' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 IF NEW.signing_purpose_code=371 THEN
  PERFORM openpc.check_identity_envelope_recovery_trust_admission(NEW);
  RETURN NULL;
 END IF;
 SELECT r.* INTO STRICT rotation FROM control.signing_key_rotation r
 WHERE r.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
  AND NEW.admission_reference='urn:openpc:resource:'||r.rotation_id::text AND r.new_signer_id=NEW.signer_id
  AND r.state='VERIFIED' AND r.approval_request_id IS NOT NULL;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT old_key FROM control.business_signing_key
 WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND signer_id=rotation.old_signer_id;
 IF old_key.trust_digest<>rotation.old_trust_digest OR NEW.key_epoch<>old_key.key_epoch+1
  OR NEW.workload_credential_id<>old_key.workload_credential_id OR NEW.workload_credential_epoch<>old_key.workload_credential_epoch
  OR NEW.environment_id<>old_key.environment_id OR NEW.secret_reference<>rotation.request->>'newReference'
  OR NEW.environment_id<>rotation.environment_id OR NEW.workload_credential_id<>rotation.workload_credential_id
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_provider_attempt a WHERE a.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
    AND a.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND a.rotation_id=rotation.rotation_id AND a.to_state='PREPARED'
    AND a.state='ACCEPTED' AND a.observation->'descriptor'->>'fingerprint'=NEW.signer_id
    AND a.observation->'descriptor'->>'publicKeySpkiHex'=encode(NEW.public_key_spki_der,'hex')
    AND (a.observation->'descriptor'->>'validFromNs')::numeric=NEW.valid_from_ns
    AND (a.observation->'descriptor'->>'validUntilNs')::numeric=NEW.valid_until_ns)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-GOVERNED-TRUST-BINDING'; END IF;
 SELECT count(*) INTO proofs FROM control.signing_provider_attempt a
 WHERE a.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
  AND a.rotation_id=rotation.rotation_id AND a.to_state='VERIFIED' AND a.state='ACCEPTED'
  AND a.request->>'method'='PROVE' AND a.request->>'rotationId'=rotation.rotation_id::text
  AND a.request->>'participantId'=NEW.participant_id::text AND a.request->>'privacyDomainId'=NEW.privacy_domain_id::text
  AND a.request->>'workloadCredentialId'=NEW.workload_credential_id::text
  AND a.request->>'environmentId'=NEW.environment_id AND a.request->>'challengeHex'=encode(NEW.trust_digest,'hex')
  AND a.request->>'expectedFingerprint'=CASE a.slot WHEN 'old' THEN old_key.signer_id WHEN 'new' THEN NEW.signer_id END
  AND a.observation->>'outcome'='SUCCEEDED' AND a.observation->>'attemptId'=a.attempt_id::text
  AND a.observation->>'requestDigest'='sha256:'||encode(a.request_digest,'hex')
  AND a.observation->'descriptor'->>'publicKeySpkiHex'=CASE a.slot WHEN 'old' THEN encode(old_key.public_key_spki_der,'hex') WHEN 'new' THEN encode(NEW.public_key_spki_der,'hex') END;
 IF proofs<>2 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-GOVERNED-DUAL-PROOF'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_runtime_target_fact_proof(proof jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE custody jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF proof->>'sourceMode'='FACT_FREE' THEN
  IF proof ? 'factCustody' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-FACT-PROOF'; END IF;
  RETURN;
 END IF;
 custody:=proof->'factCustody';
 IF proof->>'sourceMode' IS DISTINCT FROM 'FACT_BOUND'
  OR jsonb_typeof(custody) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR custody IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('version',1,'capsuleDigest',custody->'capsuleDigest',
   'factStateDigest',custody->'factStateDigest','dependencyDigest',custody->'dependencyDigest',
   'originalRecordsDigest',custody->'originalRecordsDigest','validUntilNs',custody->'validUntilNs')
  OR custody->'capsuleDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM proof->'capsuleDigest'
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (VALUES('capsuleDigest'),('factStateDigest'),('dependencyDigest'),('originalRecordsDigest')) f(name)
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(custody->f.name) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR coalesce(custody->>f.name,'') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
  OR jsonb_typeof(custody->'validUntilNs') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR coalesce(custody->>'validUntilNs','') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$'
  OR jsonb_typeof(proof->'capsuleValidUntilNs') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR coalesce(proof->>'capsuleValidUntilNs','') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-FACT-PROOF'; END IF;
 IF (custody->>'validUntilNs')::numeric>18446744073709551615
  OR (proof->>'capsuleValidUntilNs')::numeric>18446744073709551615
  OR (custody->>'validUntilNs')::numeric<=extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000000
  OR (custody->>'validUntilNs')::numeric>(proof->>'capsuleValidUntilNs')::numeric
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-FACT-EXPIRY'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_session_step_up_source()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE matches bigint;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND (NEW.step_up_mfa_challenge_id,NEW.step_up_verified_at)
   IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (OLD.step_up_mfa_challenge_id,OLD.step_up_verified_at) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF NEW.step_up_mfa_challenge_id IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF openpc.current_action_intent_id() IS DISTINCT FROM 'ACT-IDENTITY_UPDATE_STEP_UP-V1'
   OR NEW.step_up_verified_at IS NULL OR NEW.state<>'ACTIVE' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-STEP-UP-SOURCE';
 END IF;
 SELECT count(*) INTO matches FROM control.mfa_challenge challenge
  JOIN control.credential credential ON credential.participant_id=challenge.participant_id
   AND credential.principal_id=challenge.principal_id AND credential.credential_id=challenge.signer_credential_id
   AND credential.credential_epoch=challenge.signer_credential_epoch
   AND credential.kind='WEBAUTHN' AND credential.state='ACTIVE'
   AND credential.valid_from<=clock_timestamp()
   AND (credential.valid_until IS NULL OR credential.valid_until>clock_timestamp())
  JOIN control.authentication_occurrence occurrence ON occurrence.participant_id=challenge.participant_id
   AND occurrence.principal_id=challenge.principal_id AND occurrence.session_id=challenge.session_id
   AND occurrence.source_id=challenge.mfa_challenge_id AND occurrence.method='WEBAUTHN_ASSERTION'
   AND occurrence.credential_id=credential.credential_id AND occurrence.occurred_at=challenge.consumed_at
   AND occurrence.operation_id=openpc.current_operation_id()
  JOIN control.mutation_evidence verification ON verification.participant_id=occurrence.participant_id
   AND verification.privacy_domain_id=occurrence.privacy_domain_id AND verification.principal_id=occurrence.principal_id
   AND verification.operation_id=occurrence.operation_id AND verification.mfa_challenge_id=challenge.mfa_challenge_id
   AND verification.aggregate_id=challenge.session_id AND verification.aggregate_type='webauthn-verification'
   AND verification.action_intent_id='ACT-IDENTITY_UPDATE_STEP_UP-V1'
   AND verification.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WEBAUTHN-VERIFY'
   AND verification.signer_credential_id=credential.credential_id
   AND verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=occurrence.proof_digest
   AND verification.evidence_digest=sha256(verification.evidence_cbor)
   AND verification.bound_participant_epoch=NEW.participant_epoch AND verification.bound_principal_epoch=NEW.authority_epoch
   AND verification.occurred_at>=challenge.consumed_at
  JOIN control.idempotency_record committed ON committed.participant_id=verification.participant_id
   AND committed.privacy_domain_id=verification.privacy_domain_id AND committed.principal_id=verification.principal_id
   AND committed.operation_id=verification.operation_id AND committed.catalog_operation_id=verification.catalog_operation_id
   AND committed.input_digest=verification.candidate_digest AND committed.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
   AND committed.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
  JOIN control.outbox_event event ON event.participant_id=verification.participant_id
   AND event.privacy_domain_id=verification.privacy_domain_id AND event.aggregate_type=verification.aggregate_type
   AND event.aggregate_id=verification.aggregate_id AND event.event_type='openpc.identity.webauthn-verification.mutation.committed.v1'
   AND event.payload_cbor=verification.evidence_cbor AND event.payload_digest=verification.evidence_digest
   AND event.cose_sign1=verification.cose_sign1 AND event.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
  WHERE challenge.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND challenge.principal_id=NEW.principal_id
   AND challenge.session_id=NEW.session_id AND challenge.mfa_challenge_id=NEW.step_up_mfa_challenge_id
   AND challenge.consumed_at=NEW.step_up_verified_at AND challenge.created_at<=challenge.consumed_at
   AND challenge.consumed_at<=clock_timestamp() AND challenge.expires_at>clock_timestamp()
   AND NEW.idle_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND NEW.absolute_expires_at>clock_timestamp()
   AND (challenge.verified_proof_max_age_ms=300000 OR
     (challenge.verified_proof_max_age_ms=3000000 AND NEW.duration_profile='LOCAL_QA_10X'));
 IF matches<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-STEP-UP-SOURCE'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_signing_continuation_context(context jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE command control.signing_rotation_command%ROWTYPE; attempt control.signing_provider_attempt%ROWTYPE;
 rotation control.signing_key_rotation%ROWTYPE; workload control.credential%ROWTYPE; snapshot jsonb;
 authority jsonb; evidence control.mutation_evidence%ROWTYPE; expected jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT attempt FROM control.signing_provider_attempt WHERE participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id()
  AND privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id() AND attempt_id=(context->>'providerAttemptId')::uuid
  AND state='OBSERVED' AND dispatched_at_ns IS NOT NULL AND request->>'method' IN ('PREPARE','DISTRIBUTE','REVOKE','RETIRE');
 authority:=openpc.signing_attempt_authority_status(attempt.attempt_id);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT command FROM control.signing_rotation_command WHERE participant_id=attempt.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=attempt.privacy_domain_id AND operation_id=attempt.operation_id AND state IN ('ACCEPTED','WRITE_AMBIGUITY')
  AND action_intent_id='ACT-SIGNING_KEY_ROTATIONS_ADVANCE_RESOURCE-V1';
 SELECT * INTO STRICT rotation FROM control.signing_key_rotation WHERE participant_id=attempt.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=attempt.privacy_domain_id AND rotation_id=attempt.rotation_id AND approval_request_id IS NOT NULL;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT workload FROM control.credential c WHERE c.participant_id=attempt.participant_id
  AND c.credential_id=rotation.workload_credential_id AND c.state='ACTIVE' AND c.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS'
  AND c.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND c.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.principal p WHERE p.participant_id=c.participant_id AND p.principal_id=c.principal_id
   AND p.kind='WORKLOAD' AND p.state='ACTIVE');
 SELECT * INTO STRICT evidence FROM control.mutation_evidence WHERE participant_id=command.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=command.privacy_domain_id AND mutation_evidence_id=command.authorization_evidence_id
  AND operation_id=command.operation_id;
 IF NOT ((rotation.revision=attempt.from_revision AND rotation.state=attempt.from_state) OR
  (rotation.state='RECOVERING' AND rotation.recovery_from_revision=attempt.from_revision AND rotation.recovery_from_state=attempt.from_state))
  OR command.from_revision<>attempt.from_revision OR command.to_state<>attempt.to_state
  OR attempt.observation->>'attemptId'<>attempt.attempt_id::text OR attempt.observation->>'operationId'<>attempt.operation_id::text
  OR attempt.observation->>'method'<>attempt.request->>'method'
  OR attempt.observation->>'requestDigest'<>'sha256:'||encode(attempt.request_digest,'hex')
  OR attempt.observation->>'outcome' NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','REJECTED')
  OR command.to_state IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE attempt.request->>'method' WHEN 'PREPARE' THEN 'PREPARED'
   WHEN 'DISTRIBUTE' THEN 'DISTRIBUTED' WHEN 'REVOKE' THEN 'OLD_REVOKED' WHEN 'RETIRE' THEN 'OLD_RETIRED' END)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_rotation_command recovery WHERE recovery.participant_id=command.participant_id
   AND recovery.privacy_domain_id=command.privacy_domain_id AND recovery.original_operation_id=command.operation_id AND recovery.state='ACCEPTED')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-CONTINUATION-EXACT-DISPATCHED-ATTEMPT'; END IF;
 snapshot:=convert_from(command.authorization_snapshot,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 expected:=jsonb_build_object('version',1,'purpose','SIGNING_ROTATION_ATTEMPT_RECONCILE_V1',
  'effect','FINALIZE_EXISTING_SIGNING_ROTATION_ATTEMPT','participantId',attempt.participant_id::text,
  'privacyDomainId',attempt.privacy_domain_id::text,'rotationId',rotation.rotation_id::text,'rotationRevision',rotation.revision::text,
  'operationId',command.operation_id::text,'actionIntentId',command.action_intent_id,'targetState',command.to_state,
  'candidateDigest','sha256:'||encode(command.approval_candidate_digest,'hex'),'approvalRequestId',command.approval_request_id::text,
  'originalActorKeyDigest','sha256:'||(openpc.business_cbor(evidence.evidence_cbor)->'1'->>'bytes'),
  'originalAuthoritySnapshotDigest','sha256:'||encode(command.authorization_snapshot_digest,'hex'),
  'originalMakerSnapshotDigest','sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to((snapshot->'authorities'->1)::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),
  'originalCheckerSnapshotDigest','sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to((snapshot->'authorities'->2)::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),
  'providerAttemptId',attempt.attempt_id::text,'providerMethod',attempt.request->>'method',
  'providerRequestDigest','sha256:'||encode(attempt.request_digest,'hex'),
  'providerObservationDigest','sha256:'||encode(attempt.observation_digest,'hex'),
  'resultDisposition',CASE WHEN attempt.observation->>'outcome'='SUCCEEDED' THEN 'APPLY_RESERVED_TARGET'
   WHEN attempt.observation->>'reason'='NOT_APPLIED' THEN 'NO_EFFECT_RETRYABLE' ELSE 'ENTER_FAILED_STATE' END,
  'workloadPrincipalId',workload.principal_id::text,'workloadCredentialId',workload.credential_id::text,
  'workloadCredentialEpoch',workload.credential_epoch::text,'workloadKeyDigest','sha256:'||encode(workload.public_key_digest,'hex'),
  'currentAuthorityStatus',CASE WHEN (authority->>'unchangedLive')::boolean THEN 'UNCHANGED_LIVE' ELSE 'CHANGED' END,
  'currentAuthorityDigest','sha256:'||encode(openpc.signing_continuation_authority_digest(authority),'hex'));
 IF context IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-CONTINUATION-CONTEXT'; END IF;
END $function$
p_snapshot bytea, p_participant uuid, p_privacy uuid, p_operation uuid, p_receipt uuid, p_recorded_ns numeric, p_consumed boolean

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_signing_continuation_snapshot(p_snapshot bytea, p_participant uuid, p_privacy uuid, p_operation uuid, p_receipt uuid, p_recorded_ns numeric, p_consumed boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE snapshot jsonb; capability control.signing_continuation%ROWTYPE; expected jsonb;
BEGIN
 snapshot:=convert_from(p_snapshot,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT capability FROM control.signing_continuation WHERE participant_id=p_participant AND privacy_domain_id=p_privacy
  AND operation_id=p_operation AND assertion_id=(snapshot->>'continuationAssertionId')::uuid
  AND state=CASE WHEN p_consumed THEN 'CONSUMED' ELSE 'ISSUED' END;
 expected:=jsonb_build_object('schema','pc.control.signing-rotation-continuation-snapshot.v1',
  'participantId',p_participant::text,'privacyDomainId',p_privacy::text,'operationId',p_operation::text,
  'recordedAtNs',snapshot->'recordedAtNs','decision','RECORD_DISPATCHED_TRUTH','continuationAssertionId',capability.assertion_id::text,
  'continuationAssertionDigest','sha256:'||encode(capability.assertion_digest,'hex'),'context',convert_from(capability.context_preimage,'UTF8')::jsonb);
 IF snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM expected OR jsonb_typeof(snapshot->'recordedAtNs') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR NOT ((snapshot->>'recordedAtNs') ~ '^[0-9]{1,20}$') OR (snapshot->>'recordedAtNs')::numeric>p_recorded_ns
  OR p_recorded_ns<capability.issued_at_ns OR p_recorded_ns>=capability.expires_at_ns
  OR (p_consumed AND (capability.consumed_receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_receipt OR capability.consumed_at_ns<p_recorded_ns))
  OR (NOT p_consumed AND capability.expires_at_ns<=floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-CONTINUATION-RECEIPT-SNAPSHOT'; END IF;
 IF NOT p_consumed THEN PERFORM openpc.check_signing_continuation_context(snapshot->'context'); END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_signing_generation_completion()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.state<>'CONSUMED' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_candidate candidate JOIN control.signing_rotation_command command
  ON command.participant_id=candidate.participant_id AND command.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id
   AND command.operation_id=candidate.consumed_operation_id JOIN control.audit_occurrence receipt
   ON receipt.participant_id=command.participant_id AND receipt.privacy_domain_id=command.privacy_domain_id AND receipt.operation_id=command.operation_id
  WHERE candidate.mutation_candidate_id=NEW.candidate_id AND candidate.state='CONSUMED' AND candidate.consumed_operation_id=NEW.consumed_operation_id
   AND command.authorization_generation_id=NEW.generation_id AND command.state IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED') AND command.result_revision=NEW.result_revision
   AND receipt.after_revision=NEW.result_revision AND receipt.before_revision=NEW.from_revision
   AND (NEW.hold_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_rotation_authority_hold h WHERE h.hold_id=NEW.hold_id
    AND h.state='CLEARED' AND h.cleared_by_operation_id=NEW.consumed_operation_id)))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-SIGNING-GENERATION-INCOMPLETE'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_signing_generation_current(p_generation uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE generation control.signing_authorization_generation%ROWTYPE; candidate control.mutation_candidate%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT generation FROM control.signing_authorization_generation WHERE participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id()
  AND privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id() AND generation_id=p_generation AND state='STAGED';
 SELECT * INTO STRICT candidate FROM control.mutation_candidate WHERE participant_id=generation.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=generation.privacy_domain_id AND mutation_candidate_id=generation.candidate_id
  AND candidate_digest=generation.candidate_digest AND state='APPROVED' AND expires_at>clock_timestamp();
 IF candidate.candidate_document->'context' IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.signing_governance_context(generation.rotation_id,generation.action_intent_id)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.approval_request a JOIN control.approval_decision_record d
   USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,approval_request_id) WHERE a.participant_id=generation.participant_id
    AND a.privacy_domain_id=generation.privacy_domain_id AND a.subject_id=generation.candidate_id AND a.subject_digest=generation.candidate_digest
    AND a.subject_version=generation.from_revision AND a.state='APPROVED' AND a.expires_at>clock_timestamp()
    AND d.decision='APPROVE' AND d.approver_principal_id<>a.maker_principal_id AND d.candidate_digest=generation.candidate_digest)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-SIGNING-GOVERNANCE-STALE'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_signing_no_effect_completion()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_rotation_command c JOIN control.idempotency_record i USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,operation_id)
  WHERE c.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND c.operation_id=NEW.operation_id
   AND c.state='FAILED' AND c.result_kind=NEW.kind AND c.result_revision=(convert_from(NEW.preimage,'UTF8')::jsonb->>'currentRevision')::bigint AND i.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
   AND i.result_payload->>'state'='FAILED' AND i.result_payload->'signingResult'->>'kind'=NEW.kind)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_rotation_history h WHERE h.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
   AND h.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND h.operation_id=NEW.operation_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.audit_occurrence a WHERE a.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
   AND a.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND a.operation_id=NEW.operation_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_provider_attempt a WHERE a.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
   AND a.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND a.operation_id=NEW.operation_id
   AND ((NEW.kind='AUTHORITY_CHANGED_BEFORE_DISPATCH' AND a.state<>'CANCELLED') OR
    (NEW.kind='NO_EFFECT_RETRYABLE' AND a.state NOT IN ('REJECTED','SUPERSEDED'))))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-NO-EFFECT-ATOMIC-COMPLETION'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_signing_rotation_receipt(receipt control.audit_occurrence)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE rotation control.signing_key_rotation%ROWTYPE; history control.signing_rotation_history%ROWTYPE;
 previous control.signing_rotation_history%ROWTYPE; attestation control.signing_rotation_attestation%ROWTYPE;
 before_new text; before_projection jsonb; after_projection jsonb; self_cutover boolean; effects jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT rotation FROM control.signing_key_rotation WHERE participant_id=receipt.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND rotation_id=receipt.aggregate_id AND revision=receipt.after_revision;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT history FROM control.signing_rotation_history WHERE participant_id=receipt.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND rotation_id=receipt.aggregate_id AND revision=receipt.after_revision
  AND receipt_id=receipt.receipt_id AND operation_id=receipt.operation_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT previous FROM control.signing_rotation_history WHERE participant_id=receipt.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND rotation_id=receipt.aggregate_id AND revision=receipt.before_revision;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT attestation FROM control.signing_rotation_attestation WHERE participant_id=receipt.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND rotation_id=receipt.aggregate_id AND operation_id=receipt.operation_id
  AND attempt_id=receipt.receipt_id AND from_revision=receipt.before_revision AND to_state=rotation.state;
 effects:=openpc.signing_transition_effects(receipt.action_intent_id,previous.state,rotation.state);
 IF effects IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6022-SIGNING-TRANSITION-MATRIX'; END IF;
 IF attestation.receipt_cbor<>receipt.receipt_cbor OR attestation.authority_snapshot<>receipt.authority_snapshot
  OR attestation.before_state_preimage<>receipt.before_state_preimage OR attestation.after_state_preimage<>receipt.after_state_preimage
  OR attestation.history_digest<>history.history_digest OR receipt.after_revision<>receipt.before_revision+1
  OR jsonb_array_length(openpc.business_cbor(receipt.receipt_cbor)->'21')<>(CASE WHEN effects->>'eventType' IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  OR (effects->>'eventType' IS NOT NULL AND
    openpc.business_cbor(receipt.receipt_cbor)->'21'->0->'0' IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.business_uuid(attestation.event_id))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-LIFECYCLE-RECEIPT-HISTORY'; END IF;
 before_new:=convert_from(previous.history_preimage,'UTF8')::jsonb->>'newFingerprint';
 before_projection:=jsonb_build_object('0',previous.state,'1',openpc.business_bytes(rotation.candidate_digest),
  '2',openpc.business_bytes(previous.history_digest),'3',rotation.request->>'signerRole',
  '4',openpc.business_bytes(decode(substring(rotation.old_signer_id from 8),'hex')),'5',CASE WHEN before_new IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
  ||CASE WHEN before_new IS NULL THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_object('6',openpc.business_bytes(decode(substring(before_new from 8),'hex'))) END;
 after_projection:=jsonb_build_object('0',rotation.state,'1',openpc.business_bytes(rotation.candidate_digest),
  '2',openpc.business_bytes(history.history_digest),'3',rotation.request->>'signerRole',
  '4',openpc.business_bytes(decode(substring(rotation.old_signer_id from 8),'hex')),'5',CASE WHEN rotation.new_signer_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
  ||CASE WHEN rotation.new_signer_id IS NULL THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_object('6',openpc.business_bytes(decode(substring(rotation.new_signer_id from 8),'hex'))) END;
 IF openpc.business_cbor(receipt.before_state_preimage)->8 IS DISTINCT FROM before_projection OR
  openpc.business_cbor(receipt.after_state_preimage)->8 IS DISTINCT FROM after_projection
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-LIFECYCLE-ACTUAL-STATE'; END IF;
 self_cutover:=rotation.request->>'signerRole'='LIFECYCLE_EVIDENCE' AND (effects->>'cutover')::boolean
  AND receipt.signer_id=rotation.old_signer_id AND receipt.recorded_at_ns=rotation.cutover_at_ns;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.receipt_signing_attempt a
  JOIN control.business_signing_key k ON k.participant_id=a.participant_id AND k.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND k.signer_id=a.signer_id
  JOIN control.business_signing_key_state ks ON ks.participant_id=a.participant_id AND ks.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND ks.signer_id=a.signer_id
  JOIN control.business_signing_selection s ON s.participant_id=a.participant_id AND s.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id
   AND s.environment_id=k.environment_id AND s.profile_digest=a.profile_digest
  JOIN control.credential c ON c.participant_id=k.participant_id AND c.credential_id=k.workload_credential_id
  JOIN control.principal p ON p.participant_id=c.participant_id AND p.principal_id=c.principal_id
  WHERE a.participant_id=receipt.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND a.attempt_id=receipt.receipt_id
   AND a.reservation_kind='LIFECYCLE_DURABLE' AND a.payload_cbor=receipt.receipt_cbor AND a.operation_id=receipt.operation_id
   AND k.trust_digest=receipt.signer_trust_snapshot_digest AND k.key_epoch=a.key_epoch AND k.environment_id=receipt.environment_id
   AND k.valid_from_ns<=receipt.recorded_at_ns AND k.valid_until_ns>receipt.recorded_at_ns
   AND c.credential_epoch=k.workload_credential_epoch AND c.state='ACTIVE' AND p.state='ACTIVE' AND p.kind='WORKLOAD'
   AND c.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND (c.valid_until IS NULL OR c.valid_until>clock_timestamp())
   AND openpc.retained_signing_admission_matches(a.participant_id,a.privacy_domain_id,a.signer_id,a.operation_id,a.admission_version,s.admission_version)
   AND s.fenced_operation_id IS NULL AND ((NOT self_cutover AND ks.state='ACTIVE' AND s.signer_id=a.signer_id
    AND s.row_version=a.selection_version AND s.fence_generation=a.fence_generation
    AND k.valid_until_ns>floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000)
    OR (self_cutover AND ks.state='RETIRED' AND s.signer_id=rotation.new_signer_id
     AND s.row_version=a.selection_version+2 AND s.fence_generation=a.fence_generation+1))
   FOR SHARE OF s,ks,c,p)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-LIFECYCLE-SIGNER-FENCE'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.check_work_item_effect_receipt()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE receipt control.audit_occurrence%ROWTYPE; before_projection jsonb;
BEGIN
 -- WHEN is evaluated when the row changes, so later context changes cannot
 -- remove the queued check. Internal source-owned effects retain their owners.
 SELECT * INTO STRICT receipt FROM control.audit_occurrence r WHERE r.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
  AND r.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND r.aggregate_type='work-item'
  AND r.aggregate_id=NEW.work_item_id AND r.after_revision=NEW.row_version
  AND r.catalog_operation_id IN ('CFG-OP-CREATE-WORK-ITEM','CFG-OP-UPDATE-WORK-ITEM',
   'CFG-OP-CLAIM-WORK-ITEM','CFG-OP-COMPLETE-WORK-ITEM');
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN before_projection:='{}'::jsonb;
 ELSE before_projection:=openpc.work_item_business_projection(OLD); END IF;
 IF openpc.business_cbor(receipt.before_state_preimage)->8 IS DISTINCT FROM before_projection
  OR openpc.business_cbor(receipt.after_state_preimage)->8 IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.work_item_business_projection(NEW)
  OR receipt.before_revision IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN TG_OP='INSERT' THEN 0 ELSE OLD.row_version END)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-WORK-ITEM-EFFECT-RECEIPT'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.cigl_profile_has_installed_lineage(p_profile uuid, p_revision bigint, p_target uuid, p_capsule text, p_policy text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM control.cigl_profile_version version
  JOIN control.cigl_analysis analysis ON analysis.analysis_id=version.analysis_id
   AND analysis.participant_id=version.participant_id AND analysis.privacy_domain_id=version.privacy_domain_id
  JOIN control.runtime_target target ON target.runtime_target_id=analysis.runtime_target_id
   AND target.participant_id=analysis.participant_id AND target.privacy_domain_id=analysis.privacy_domain_id
  WHERE version.profile_id=p_profile AND version.revision=p_revision AND version.state='COMPILED'
   AND version.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id() AND version.privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
   AND analysis.state='REVIEWED' AND analysis.revision=3 AND analysis.runtime_target_id=p_target
   AND target.active_generation_digest=p_capsule
   AND ((analysis.capsule_digest=p_capsule AND analysis.policy_generation_digest=p_policy) OR EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_activation_observation observation
    JOIN control.runtime_configuration_generation generation
     ON generation.runtime_configuration_generation_id=observation.runtime_configuration_generation_id
      AND generation.participant_id=observation.participant_id AND generation.privacy_domain_id=observation.privacy_domain_id
    JOIN control.configuration_work work ON work.configuration_work_id=observation.configuration_work_id
     AND work.participant_id=observation.participant_id AND work.privacy_domain_id=observation.privacy_domain_id
     AND work.operation_id=observation.operation_id AND work.execution_attempt_id=observation.execution_attempt_id
     AND work.runtime_configuration_generation_id=generation.runtime_configuration_generation_id
     AND work.runtime_target_id=observation.runtime_target_id AND work.xds_version_digest=observation.xds_version_digest
     AND work.generation_digest=generation.generation_digest
    WHERE observation.participant_id=version.participant_id AND observation.privacy_domain_id=version.privacy_domain_id
     AND observation.runtime_target_id=p_target AND observation.capsule_digest=p_capsule
     AND generation.runtime_target_id=p_target AND generation.policy_generation_digest=p_policy AND generation.state='ACTIVE'
     AND work.work_kind='RUNTIME_ACTIVATION' AND work.state='COMPLETED' AND work.execution_started_at IS NOT NULL
     AND work.result_receipt_digest=observation.activation_receipt_digest
     AND generation.cigl_profile_selection->'profiles' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'profileId','urn:openpc:resource:'||version.profile_id::text,'profileRevision',version.revision::text,
      'profileDigest',version.profile_digest,'compilationArtifactDigest',version.artifact_digest)))))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.configuration_step_up_receipt_input(receipt control.audit_occurrence, authorization_row control.mutation_evidence)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE verification control.mutation_evidence%ROWTYPE; snapshot jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF receipt.catalog_operation_id NOT IN ('CFG-OP-CREATE-NOTIFICATION-ENDPOINT','CFG-OP-UPDATE-NOTIFICATION-ENDPOINT') OR authorization_row.approval_request_id IS NOT NULL
  OR authorization_row.checker_principal_id IS NOT NULL OR authorization_row.mfa_challenge_id IS NULL
  OR authorization_row.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest IS NULL
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-STEP-UP-RECEIPT-ADMISSION'; END IF;
 snapshot:=convert_from(receipt.authority_snapshot,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 SELECT v.* INTO STRICT verification FROM control.mutation_evidence v
  JOIN control.mfa_challenge c ON c.participant_id=v.participant_id AND c.mfa_challenge_id=v.mfa_challenge_id
   AND c.principal_id=v.principal_id AND c.session_id=v.aggregate_id
  JOIN control.idempotency_record committed ON committed.participant_id=v.participant_id
   AND committed.privacy_domain_id=v.privacy_domain_id AND committed.principal_id=v.principal_id
   AND committed.operation_id=v.operation_id AND committed.catalog_operation_id=v.catalog_operation_id
   AND committed.input_digest=v.candidate_digest AND committed.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
   AND committed.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=v.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
  WHERE v.participant_id=receipt.participant_id AND v.privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id
   AND v.principal_id=authorization_row.principal_id AND v.mfa_challenge_id=authorization_row.mfa_challenge_id
   AND v.action_intent_id='ACT-IDENTITY_UPDATE_STEP_UP-V1' AND v.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WEBAUTHN-VERIFY'
   AND v.aggregate_type='webauthn-verification' AND v.evidence_digest=sha256(v.evidence_cbor)
   AND v.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=authorization_row.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
   AND c.action_intent_id=receipt.action_intent_id
   AND c.resource_digest=receipt.candidate_digest AND c.used_operation_id=receipt.operation_id
   AND c.used_at IS NOT NULL AND c.consumed_at IS NOT NULL
   AND extract(epoch from c.consumed_at)*1000000000<=receipt.recorded_at_ns
   AND extract(epoch from c.consumed_at)*1000000000>receipt.recorded_at_ns-300000000000
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'authorities') a
    WHERE a->>'principalId'=v.principal_id::text AND a->>'sessionId'=c.session_id::text
     AND a->>'actionIntentId'=receipt.action_intent_id AND a->>'resourceId'=receipt.aggregate_id::text)=1
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event e WHERE e.participant_id=v.participant_id
    AND e.privacy_domain_id=v.privacy_domain_id AND e.aggregate_type=v.aggregate_type AND e.aggregate_id=v.aggregate_id
    AND e.event_type='openpc.identity.webauthn-verification.mutation.committed.v1'
    AND e.payload_cbor=v.evidence_cbor AND e.payload_digest=v.evidence_digest AND e.cose_sign1=v.cose_sign1
    AND e.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=v.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest);
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('0',4,'1',verification.mutation_evidence_id::text,'2',openpc.business_bytes(verification.evidence_digest));
END $function$
p control.evidence_archive_profile, a control.evidence_remote_archive_attempt, v control.evidence_archive_receipt

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.consume_archive_commit(p control.evidence_archive_profile, a control.evidence_remote_archive_attempt, v control.evidence_archive_receipt)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE secret bytea; expected bytea; different integer:=0;
BEGIN
 IF session_user IS DISTINCT FROM p.claims->>'databaseRole'
  OR v.participant_id<>p.participant_id OR v.privacy_domain_id<>p.privacy_domain_id
  OR a.participant_id<>v.participant_id OR a.privacy_domain_id<>v.privacy_domain_id
  OR a.attempt_id<>v.attempt_id OR v.profile_digest<>p.profile_digest
  OR v.receipt_digest<>'sha256:'||encode(sha256(v.cose),'hex')
  OR octet_length(v.commit_nonce)<>32 OR octet_length(v.commit_mac)<>32
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 SELECT verifier_secret INTO STRICT secret FROM control.evidence_archive_commit_key
  WHERE participant_id=p.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=p.privacy_domain_id
   AND environment_id=p.environment_id AND sink_id=p.sink_id;
 expected:=public.hmac(convert_to('OPENPC_REMOTE_ARCHIVE_CUSTODY_COMMIT_V1','UTF8')
  ||uuid_send(v.participant_id)||uuid_send(v.privacy_domain_id)||sha256(v.cose)||sha256(v.payload)
  ||decode(substring(p.profile_digest from 8),'hex')||decode(substring(a.binding_digest from 8),'hex')||v.commit_nonce,secret,'sha256');
 FOR n IN 0..31 LOOP different:=different | (get_byte(expected,n) # get_byte(v.commit_mac,n)); END LOOP;
 IF different<>0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 INSERT INTO control.evidence_archive_commit_nonce(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,nonce,receipt_id,receipt_digest)
  VALUES(v.participant_id,v.privacy_domain_id,v.commit_nonce,v.receipt_id,v.receipt_digest);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.deployment_module_generation(participant uuid, privacy uuid)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 WITH RECURSIVE nodes AS (
  SELECT m.*,v.module_id,v.semantic_version,v.manifest_digest,c.configuration_digest,c.generation,c.active
  FROM control.module_installation m JOIN control.module_version v USING(module_version_id)
  JOIN control.module_configuration_generation c USING(module_installation_id)
  WHERE m.participant_id=participant AND m.privacy_domain_id=privacy
   AND c.participant_id=participant AND c.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND v.release_payload_cbor IS NOT NULL
 ), closure(id) AS (
  SELECT module_installation_id FROM nodes WHERE module_id IN ('pc.transaction.delivery','pc.deployment.governance')
  UNION
  SELECT provider.module_installation_id FROM closure
   JOIN nodes consumer ON consumer.module_installation_id=closure.id
   JOIN control.module_dependency d ON d.consumer_module_version_id=consumer.module_version_id
   JOIN nodes provider ON provider.module_id=d.provider_module_id AND provider.semantic_version=d.semantic_version
    AND provider.manifest_digest=d.provider_manifest_digest
 ), selected AS (SELECT nodes.* FROM nodes JOIN closure ON closure.id=nodes.module_installation_id)
 SELECT CASE WHEN
  (SELECT count(*) FROM nodes WHERE module_id IN ('pc.transaction.delivery','pc.deployment.governance'))=2
  AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT module_id) FROM nodes WHERE module_id IN ('pc.transaction.delivery','pc.deployment.governance'))=2
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM selected WHERE state<>'ENABLED' OR NOT active OR generation<>1
   OR active_manifest_digest IS DISTINCT FROM manifest_digest OR lifecycle_evaluation_digest IS NULL
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.audit_occurrence a JOIN control.evidence_record e USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,receipt_id)
    WHERE a.participant_id=participant AND a.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND a.aggregate_id=selected.module_installation_id
     AND a.operation_id=selected.lifecycle_operation_id AND a.catalog_operation_id='MOD-OP-ENABLE'
     AND a.after_revision=selected.aggregate_version AND a.after_existence=1 AND a.receipt_digest=sha256(a.receipt_cbor)
     AND e.receipt_digest=a.receipt_digest))
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM selected consumer JOIN control.module_dependency d ON d.consumer_module_version_id=consumer.module_version_id
   WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM selected provider JOIN control.module_capability capability ON capability.module_version_id=provider.module_version_id
    WHERE provider.module_id=d.provider_module_id AND provider.semantic_version=d.semantic_version
     AND provider.manifest_digest=d.provider_manifest_digest AND capability.capability_id=d.capability_id))
  THEN sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(module_id,semantic_version,
    encode(manifest_digest,'hex'),encode(configuration_digest,'hex'),generation,aggregate_version,
    encode(lifecycle_evaluation_digest,'hex'),lifecycle_operation_id) ORDER BY module_id) FROM selected)),'UTF8'))
  ELSE NULL END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.deployment_projection_retirement_blockers(source control.evidence_catalogue, p jsonb)
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE reservation control.deployment_address_reservation; latest control.deployment_result;
 claims jsonb; occurrence jsonb; blockers text[]:=ARRAY[]::text[];
BEGIN
 IF current_setting('openpc.action_intent_id')='ACT-EVIDENCE_DELETIONS_CREATE_PROJECTION_BATCH-V1' THEN
  SELECT * INTO reservation FROM control.deployment_address_reservation r
  WHERE r.participant_id=(source).participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=(source).privacy_domain_id
   AND r.command_id=split_part((source).record_id,':',2)::uuid FOR SHARE;
 ELSE
  SELECT * INTO reservation FROM control.deployment_address_reservation r
  WHERE r.participant_id=(source).participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=(source).privacy_domain_id
   AND r.command_id=split_part((source).record_id,':',2)::uuid;
 END IF;
 IF NOT FOUND OR reservation.state<>'HANDOFF' THEN RETURN ARRAY['UNRESOLVED_OPERATION']; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO latest FROM control.deployment_result r WHERE r.participant_id=reservation.participant_id
  AND r.privacy_domain_id=reservation.privacy_domain_id AND r.command_id=reservation.command_id
 ORDER BY r.sequence DESC LIMIT 1;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN ARRAY['UNRESOLVED_OPERATION']; END IF;
 claims:=convert_from(latest.signed_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb->'claims'; occurrence:=claims->'outcome'->'occurrence';
 IF claims->'outcome'->'invalidation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
  OR claims->'status'->>'state'='REORG' OR p->'historical'->>'finality' IN ('REORG','INVALIDATED')
 THEN blockers:=array_append(blockers,'REORG_FENCED'); END IF;
 IF claims->'status'->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'CONFIRMED'
  OR claims->'status'->>'truthState' IS DISTINCT FROM 'SUCCESS'
  OR occurrence->>'finality' IS DISTINCT FROM 'FINALIZED'
  OR occurrence->>'reorgStatus' IS DISTINCT FROM 'CANONICAL'
  OR occurrence->>'receiptStatus' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
  OR occurrence->>'creationGraphComplete' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
  OR occurrence->>'runtimeCodePresent' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
  OR occurrence->>'internalNativeTransfers' IS DISTINCT FROM '0'
  OR p->'historical'->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'CONFIRMED'
  OR p->'historical'->>'truthState' IS DISTINCT FROM 'SUCCESS'
  OR p->'historical'->>'finality' IS DISTINCT FROM 'FINALIZED'
 THEN blockers:=array_append(blockers,'UNRESOLVED_OPERATION'); END IF;
 IF latest.sequence::text IS DISTINCT FROM p->'historical'->>'sourceVersion'
  OR latest.result_digest IS DISTINCT FROM (source).receipt_digest
  OR latest.result_digest IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(latest.signed_bytes),'hex')
  OR p IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.evidence_deployment_projection(source)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.deployment_address_reservation successor
   WHERE successor.participant_id=reservation.participant_id AND successor.privacy_domain_id=reservation.privacy_domain_id
    AND successor.predecessor_command_id=reservation.command_id)
 THEN blockers:=array_append(blockers,'REFERENCES'); END IF;
 RETURN blockers;
END $function$
command uuid, participant uuid, privacy uuid

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.deployment_rejection_source(command uuid, participant uuid, privacy uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(signed_bytes bytea, result_digest text, created_at text, preparation_bytes bytea, publication_bytes bytea, signed_transaction text, candidate_digest text, evidence_digest text, attempt_id text, actor_principal_id text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
-- Shared immutable rejection source: signed command completion, never absence alone.
select result.signed_bytes,result.result_digest,result.created_at::text,
      intent.preparation_bytes,intent.publication_bytes,candidate.candidate_document->>'signedTransaction' signed_transaction,
      encode(candidate.candidate_digest,'hex') candidate_digest,encode(evidence.evidence_digest,'hex') evidence_digest,
      candidate.resource_id::text attempt_id,intent.actor_principal_id::text
     from control.deployment_result result
     join control.mutation_candidate candidate on candidate.participant_id=result.participant_id
      and candidate.privacy_domain_id=result.privacy_domain_id and candidate.consumed_operation_id=result.command_id
      and candidate.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-SUBMIT-DEPLOYMENT' and candidate.state='CONSUMED'
      and candidate.action_intent_id='ACT-DEPLOYMENT_SUBMISSIONS_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1'
      and candidate.resource_type='deployment-submission' and candidate.operation_class='CREATE'
     join control.idempotency_record receipt on receipt.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
      and receipt.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id and receipt.operation_id=candidate.consumed_operation_id
      and receipt.catalog_operation_id=candidate.catalog_operation_id and receipt.input_digest=candidate.candidate_digest
      and receipt.principal_id=candidate.maker_principal_id and receipt.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
     join control.mutation_evidence evidence on evidence.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
      and evidence.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id and evidence.operation_id=candidate.consumed_operation_id
      and evidence.catalog_operation_id=candidate.catalog_operation_id and evidence.candidate_digest=candidate.candidate_digest
      and evidence.aggregate_id=candidate.resource_id and evidence.aggregate_type='deployment-submission'
     join control.deployment_intent intent on intent.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
      and intent.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id and intent.actor_principal_id=candidate.maker_principal_id
      and candidate.candidate_document->>'deploymentIntentId'='urn:openpc:resource:'||intent.deployment_intent_id::text
     where result.command_id=$1 and result.participant_id=$2 and result.privacy_domain_id=$3 and result.sequence=1
      and not exists(select 1 from control.deployment_address_reservation reservation where reservation.command_id=result.command_id)

$function$
