CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.discovery_approval_resume_subject_visible(p_participant uuid, p_privacy uuid, p_principal uuid, p_envelope uuid, p_approval uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.approval_request approval
  JOIN control.mutation_candidate c ON c.participant_id=approval.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=approval.privacy_domain_id
   AND c.mutation_candidate_id=approval.subject_id AND c.candidate_digest=approval.subject_digest
   AND c.expected_revision=approval.subject_version AND c.action_intent_id=approval.action_intent_id
   AND c.maker_principal_id=approval.maker_principal_id
  JOIN control.authority_envelope old_e ON old_e.participant_id=c.participant_id AND old_e.authority_envelope_id=c.maker_authority_envelope_id
   AND old_e.principal_id=c.maker_principal_id AND old_e.representation='RECOVERY_V1'
  JOIN control.platform_recovery_case old_case ON old_case.participant_id=c.participant_id AND old_case.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
   AND old_case.recovery_id=old_e.recovery_case_id AND old_case.state='EXPIRED' AND old_case.valid_until<=clock_timestamp()
   AND old_case.completion_operation_id IS NULL AND old_case.completion_result IS NULL
  JOIN control.platform_recovery_enrollment old_source ON old_source.enrollment_id=old_case.enrollment_id
   AND old_source.participant_id=c.participant_id AND old_source.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
   AND old_source.row_version=old_case.enrollment_revision AND old_source.document_digest=old_case.enrollment_digest
  JOIN control.authority_envelope e ON e.participant_id=c.participant_id AND e.authority_envelope_id=p_envelope
   AND e.principal_id=c.maker_principal_id AND e.representation='RECOVERY_V1'
  JOIN control.platform_recovery_case fresh ON fresh.participant_id=c.participant_id AND fresh.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
   AND fresh.recovery_id=e.recovery_case_id AND fresh.recovery_id<>old_case.recovery_id AND fresh.state='ACTIVE'
   AND fresh.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND fresh.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
   AND fresh.intent->>'schema'='pc.identity.discovery-certificate-recovery-intent' AND fresh.intent->>'schemaVersion'='2'
   AND fresh.intent->'certificateRecovery'=old_case.intent->'certificateRecovery'
   AND ((fresh.intent#>'{administrators,0}')-'principalEpoch')=((old_case.intent#>'{administrators,0}')-'principalEpoch')
   AND ((fresh.intent#>'{administrators,1}')-'principalEpoch')=((old_case.intent#>'{administrators,1}')-'principalEpoch')
  JOIN control.platform_recovery_enrollment source ON source.enrollment_id=fresh.enrollment_id
   AND source.participant_id=c.participant_id AND source.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
   AND source.row_version=fresh.enrollment_revision AND source.document_digest=fresh.enrollment_digest
  WHERE c.participant_id=p_participant AND c.privacy_domain_id=p_privacy AND c.maker_principal_id=p_principal
   AND openpc.matches_participant(c.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(c.privacy_domain_id)
   AND current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true)='1'
   AND approval.approval_request_id=p_approval AND approval.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE'
   AND approval.state IN ('OPEN','APPROVED','EXPIRED') AND approval.checker_principal_id<>c.maker_principal_id
   AND approval.checker_principal_id::text=fresh.intent#>>'{administrators,1,principalId}'
   AND c.state IN ('APPROVAL_REQUESTED','APPROVED') AND c.consumed_operation_id IS NULL
   AND (c.catalog_operation_id,c.action_intent_id,c.resource_type,c.operation_class)=
     ('ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE','ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1','participant','UPDATE')
   AND old_case.intent->>'schema'='pc.identity.discovery-certificate-recovery-intent'
   AND c.resource_id::text=fresh.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorCredentialId}'
   AND c.expected_revision::text=fresh.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorRevision}'
   AND c.candidate_document=jsonb_build_object('replacedCredentialId',c.resource_id::text,
     'credentialId',fresh.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,successorCredentialId}',
     'publicKeySpkiDer',fresh.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,successorPublicKeySpkiDer}')
   AND c.candidate_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(c.candidate_document),'UTF8'))
   AND source.source_purpose='ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY' AND source.document->>'schemaVersion'='2'
   AND old_source.source_purpose=source.source_purpose AND source.document->>'assurance'='LOCAL_QA_VIRTUAL_AUTHENTICATOR'
   AND old_source.document->>'assurance'=source.document->>'assurance'
   AND source.document->'certificateRecovery'=old_source.document->'certificateRecovery'
   AND source.document->'administratorPrincipalIds'=old_source.document->'administratorPrincipalIds'
   AND openpc.discovery_approval_resume_enrollments_compatible(old_source.enrollment_id,source.enrollment_id)
   AND old_source.document_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(old_source.document),'UTF8'))
   AND source.document_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(source.document),'UTF8'))
   AND openpc.platform_recovery_envelope_current(e.authority_envelope_id)),false)
$function$
p_enrollment uuid, p_administrators jsonb, p_bindings jsonb

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.discovery_certificate_recovery_administrators_current(p_enrollment uuid, p_administrators jsonb, p_bindings jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_array_length(p_administrators)=2
  and (select count(distinct a->>'principalId') from jsonb_array_elements(p_administrators) a)=2
  and NOT EXISTS(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_administrators) administrator
   where NOT EXISTS(select 1 from control.platform_recovery_enrollment e
    left join control.platform_scope_replacement original on original.replacement_id=e.expired_replacement_id
     and original.participant_id=e.participant_id and original.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id and original.state='COMMITTED'
    join lateral jsonb_array_elements(case when e.source_purpose='ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY'
      then e.document#>'{source,originalAdministrators}' else original.candidate->'administrators' end) declared
     on declared->>'principalId'=administrator->>'principalId'
    join control.principal principal on principal.participant_id=e.participant_id and principal.principal_id::text=declared->>'principalId'
     and principal.state='ACTIVE' and principal.kind in ('USER','PLATFORM_OPERATOR')
    join control.authority_envelope expired on expired.participant_id=e.participant_id
     and expired.authority_envelope_id::text=declared->>'envelopeId' and expired.state='ACTIVE'
     and expired.platform_context_id=e.platform_context_id
     and expired.platform_authority_epoch=case when e.source_purpose='ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY'
       then (select (ancestor.document->>'rootEpoch')::numeric from control.root_expiry_recovery_enrollment ancestor
         where ancestor.participant_id=e.participant_id and ancestor.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
          and ancestor.enrollment_id::text=coalesce(e.document#>>'{source,ancestorReceipts,-1,enrollmentId}',e.document#>>'{source,enrollmentId}'))
       else e.root_epoch end
     and (e.source_purpose='ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY' or expired.valid_until<=clock_timestamp())
    join control.assignment assignment on assignment.participant_id=e.participant_id
     and assignment.assignment_id::text=declared->>'assignmentId' and assignment.authority_envelope_id=expired.authority_envelope_id
     and assignment.principal_id=principal.principal_id and assignment.state='ACTIVE'
     and (e.source_purpose='ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY' or upper(assignment.valid_during)<=clock_timestamp())
    join control.authority_role role on role.participant_id=e.participant_id and role.authority_role_id::text=declared->>'roleId'
     and role.state='ACTIVE' and role.row_version::text=declared->>'expectedRoleRevision'
    where e.enrollment_id=p_enrollment and openpc.matches_participant(e.participant_id) and openpc.matches_privacy(e.privacy_domain_id)
     and e.document->>'schema'='pc.identity.discovery-certificate-recovery-enrollment'
     and openpc.platform_recovery_source_root_current(e) and openpc.platform_recovery_original_administrators_current(e)
     and administrator->>'principalId' IN (e.document#>>'{administratorPrincipalIds,0}',e.document#>>'{administratorPrincipalIds,1}')
     and administrator->>'roleId'=declared->>'roleId' and administrator->>'roleRevision'=role.row_version::text
     and administrator->>'roleDigest'=declared->>'roleDigest'
     and administrator->>'roleDigest'='sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(jsonb_build_object(
       'domain','pc.identity.envelope-role-binding.v1','participantId',e.participant_id::text,'role',jsonb_build_object(
        'roleId',role.role_id,'version',role.row_version::text,'actions',role.action_intent_ids,'origin',role.origin,
        'createdByPrincipalId',role.created_by_principal_id::text,'creatorParticipantId',role.creator_participant_id::text,
        'bootstrapMandateId',role.bootstrap_mandate_id::text,'bootstrapPlatformParticipantId',role.bootstrap_platform_participant_id::text))),'UTF8')),'hex')
     and role.action_intent_ids @> ARRAY['ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1',
      'ACT-IDENTITY_CREATE_SESSION-V1','ACT-IDENTITY_DELETE_SESSION-V1','ACT-IDENTITY_UPDATE_STEP_UP-V1','ACT-OPERATIONS_READ_OPERATION-V1',
      'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-POLICY_APPROVE_REQUEST-V1','ACT-POLICY_READ_EFFECTIVE_ACCESS-V1']::text[]
     and (case when e.source_purpose='ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY' then declared#>'{usable,administration,actionIntentIds}'
       else original.candidate#>'{successorScope,administration,actionIntentIds}' end) @> to_jsonb(ARRAY['ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1',
      'ACT-IDENTITY_CREATE_SESSION-V1','ACT-IDENTITY_DELETE_SESSION-V1','ACT-IDENTITY_UPDATE_STEP_UP-V1','ACT-OPERATIONS_READ_OPERATION-V1',
      'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-POLICY_APPROVE_REQUEST-V1','ACT-POLICY_READ_EFFECTIVE_ACCESS-V1']::text[])
     and (e.source_purpose<>'ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY' or (declared#>'{grantable,administration,actionIntentIds}') @>
       to_jsonb(ARRAY['ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1',
        'ACT-IDENTITY_CREATE_SESSION-V1','ACT-IDENTITY_DELETE_SESSION-V1','ACT-IDENTITY_UPDATE_STEP_UP-V1','ACT-OPERATIONS_READ_OPERATION-V1',
        'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-POLICY_APPROVE_REQUEST-V1','ACT-POLICY_READ_EFFECTIVE_ACCESS-V1']::text[]))
     and (e.source_purpose='ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY' or (
       (declared#>>'{usable,validUntilNs}')::numeric<=floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000000)
       and (declared#>>'{grantable,validUntilNs}')::numeric<=floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000000)))
     and administrator->'riskClasses'=(select jsonb_agg(risk.value order by risk.ordinality)
      from jsonb_array_elements(declared#>'{usable,administration,riskClasses}') with ordinality risk(value,ordinality)
      where e.source_purpose='ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY' or
        (original.candidate#>'{successorScope,administration,riskClasses}') @> jsonb_build_array(risk.value))
     and jsonb_array_length(administrator->'riskClasses')>0
     and ((p_bindings is null and principal.authority_epoch::text=administrator->>'principalEpoch')
      or (jsonb_array_length(p_bindings)=2 and principal.authority_epoch=(administrator->>'principalEpoch')::numeric+1
       and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_bindings) binding
        where binding->>'principalId'=principal.principal_id::text and binding->>'principalEpoch'=principal.authority_epoch::text)))))
 ,false)
$function$
p_intent jsonb, p_privacy uuid, p_binding jsonb, p_activated timestamp with time zone, p_until timestamp with time zone

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.discovery_certificate_recovery_binding_current(p_intent jsonb, p_privacy uuid, p_binding jsonb, p_activated timestamp with time zone, p_until timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(EXISTS(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_intent->'administrators') administrator
  join control.authority_role role on role.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id()
   and role.authority_role_id::text=administrator->>'roleId' and role.state='ACTIVE'
   and role.row_version::text=administrator->>'roleRevision'
  where p_intent->>'schemaVersion' in ('1','2') and p_binding->>'principalId'=administrator->>'principalId'
   and (p_binding->>'principalEpoch')::numeric=(administrator->>'principalEpoch')::numeric+1
   and (p_binding#>>'{permissions,validFrom}')::timestamptz=p_activated
   and (p_binding#>>'{permissions,validUntil}')::timestamptz=p_until
   and p_binding->'permissions'=jsonb_build_object(
    'roleId',role.role_id,'validFrom',p_binding#>>'{permissions,validFrom}','validUntil',p_binding#>>'{permissions,validUntil}',
    'riskClasses',administrator->'riskClasses','privacyDomainIds',jsonb_build_array(p_privacy::text),
    'capabilityIds','[]'::jsonb,'makerCheckerRequired',true,'stepUpRequired',true,'onwardDelegationDepth',0,
    'actionIntentIds',case when p_intent->>'schemaVersion'='2' then jsonb_build_array('ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-IDENTITY_CREATE_SESSION-V1','ACT-IDENTITY_DELETE_SESSION-V1','ACT-IDENTITY_UPDATE_STEP_UP-V1','ACT-OPERATIONS_READ_OPERATION-V1','ACT-PARTICIPANTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-POLICY_APPROVE_REQUEST-V1','ACT-POLICY_READ_EFFECTIVE_ACCESS-V1') else jsonb_build_array('ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1',
     'ACT-IDENTITY_CREATE_SESSION-V1','ACT-IDENTITY_DELETE_SESSION-V1','ACT-IDENTITY_UPDATE_STEP_UP-V1','ACT-OPERATIONS_READ_OPERATION-V1',
     'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-POLICY_APPROVE_REQUEST-V1','ACT-POLICY_READ_EFFECTIVE_ACCESS-V1') end,
    'resourceIds',(select jsonb_agg(resource order by resource collate "C") from (select distinct unnest(ARRAY[
     p_intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,targetId}',p_intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,workloadPrincipalId}',
     p_intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorCredentialId}',p_intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,successorCredentialId}',
     administrator->>'principalId','urn:openpc:self-session:'||(administrator->>'principalId')]) resource) resources)))
 ,false)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.discovery_certificate_recovery_current(p_enrollment uuid, p_case uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE source jsonb; binding jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT openpc.discovery_certificate_recovery_source(p_enrollment,p_case) INTO source;
 IF source IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 SELECT e.document->'certificateRecovery' INTO binding FROM control.platform_recovery_enrollment e
  WHERE e.enrollment_id=p_enrollment and openpc.matches_participant(e.participant_id) and openpc.matches_privacy(e.privacy_domain_id);
 RETURN coalesce(source->>'participantState'='ACTIVE' and source->>'privacyState'='ACTIVE'
  and source->>'targetId'=binding->>'targetId' and source->>'targetRevision'=binding->>'targetRevision'
  and source->>'requiresAuthenticatedDiscovery'='true'
  and source->>'workloadPrincipalId'=binding->>'workloadPrincipalId' and source->>'workloadPrincipalState'='ACTIVE'
  and source->>'workloadPrincipalKind'='WORKLOAD' and source->>'workloadPrincipalEpoch'=binding->>'workloadPrincipalEpoch'
  and source->>'credentialId'=binding->>'predecessorCredentialId' and source->>'credentialState'='ACTIVE'
  and source->>'credentialKind'='WORKLOAD_MTLS' and source->>'credentialRevision'=binding->>'predecessorRevision'
  and source->>'credentialEpoch'=binding->>'predecessorEpoch' and (source->>'credentialEpoch')::numeric>0
  and source->>'certificateFingerprint'=binding->>'predecessorFingerprint'
  and source->>'certificateBytesDigest'=binding->>'predecessorFingerprint'
  and source->>'publicKeyDigest'=binding->>'predecessorPublicKeyDigest'
  and source->>'publicKeyBytesDigest'=binding->>'predecessorPublicKeyDigest' and source->>'issuer'=binding->>'issuer'
  and source->>'subject'='urn:openpc:participant:'||(source->>'participantId')||':workload:'||(binding->>'targetId')
  and source->>'audience'='urn:openpc:workload:'||(binding->>'targetId')
  and (source->>'notAfter')::timestamptz=(binding->>'predecessorNotAfter')::timestamptz
  and (source->>'notAfter')::timestamptz<=clock_timestamp()
  and (source->>'notBefore')::timestamptz<(source->>'notAfter')::timestamptz
  and (source->>'notBefore')::timestamptz<=clock_timestamp()
  and source->>'successorExists'='false' and source->>'competingSuccessor'='false',false);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.discovery_certificate_recovery_source(p_enrollment uuid, p_case uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'participantId',e.participant_id::text,'privacyDomainId',e.privacy_domain_id::text,
  'participantState',participant.state::text,'privacyState',privacy.state::text,
  'targetId',target.runtime_target_id::text,'targetParticipantId',target.participant_id::text,
  'targetPrivacyDomainId',target.privacy_domain_id::text,'targetRevision',target.revision::text,
  'requiresAuthenticatedDiscovery',target.requires_authenticated_discovery,
  'workloadPrincipalId',principal.principal_id::text,'workloadPrincipalParticipantId',principal.participant_id::text,
  'workloadPrincipalState',principal.state::text,'workloadPrincipalKind',principal.kind::text,
  'workloadPrincipalEpoch',principal.authority_epoch::text,
  'credentialId',credential.credential_id::text,'credentialParticipantId',credential.participant_id::text,
  'credentialPrincipalId',credential.principal_id::text,'credentialState',credential.state::text,
  'credentialKind',credential.kind::text,'credentialRevision',credential.row_version::text,
  'credentialEpoch',credential.credential_epoch::text,
  'certificateFingerprint','sha256:'||encode(credential.secret_fingerprint,'hex'),
  'certificateBytesDigest','sha256:'||encode(sha256(credential.certificate_der),'hex'),
  'publicKeyDigest','sha256:'||encode(credential.public_key_digest,'hex'),
  'publicKeyBytesDigest','sha256:'||encode(sha256(credential.public_key_spki_der),'hex'),
  'issuer',credential.issuer,'subject',credential.subject,'audience',credential.audience,
  'notBefore',credential.valid_from,'notAfter',credential.valid_until,'now',clock_timestamp(),
  'successorExists',exists(select 1 from control.credential successor where successor.participant_id=e.participant_id
    and successor.credential_id::text=e.document#>>'{certificateRecovery,successorCredentialId}'),
  'competingSuccessor',exists(select 1 from control.credential successor where successor.participant_id=e.participant_id
    and successor.rotated_from_credential_id=credential.credential_id)
   or exists(select 1 from control.discovery_certificate_issuance attempt where attempt.participant_id=e.participant_id
    and attempt.predecessor_credential_id=credential.credential_id and attempt.state<>'REJECTED'
    and attempt.recovery_id is distinct from p_case))
 FROM control.platform_recovery_enrollment e
 JOIN control.participant participant on participant.participant_id=e.participant_id and participant.state='ACTIVE'
 JOIN control.privacy_domain privacy on privacy.participant_id=e.participant_id and privacy.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id and privacy.state='ACTIVE'
 JOIN control.platform_context root on root.platform_context_id=e.platform_context_id and root.owner_participant_id=e.participant_id
  and root.state='ACTIVE' and root.authority_epoch=e.root_epoch and root.row_version=e.root_revision
 JOIN control.runtime_target target on target.participant_id=e.participant_id and target.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
  and target.runtime_target_id::text=e.document#>>'{certificateRecovery,targetId}'
 JOIN control.principal principal on principal.participant_id=e.participant_id
  and principal.principal_id::text=e.document#>>'{certificateRecovery,workloadPrincipalId}'
 JOIN control.credential credential on credential.participant_id=e.participant_id and credential.principal_id=principal.principal_id
  and credential.credential_id::text=e.document#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorCredentialId}'
 WHERE e.enrollment_id=p_enrollment and e.state='ACTIVE'
  and e.document->>'schema'='pc.identity.discovery-certificate-recovery-enrollment'
  and e.document#>>'{certificateRecovery,purpose}'='DISCOVERY_CERTIFICATE_REPLACEMENT'
  and openpc.platform_recovery_source_root_current(e)
  and openpc.matches_participant(e.participant_id) and openpc.matches_privacy(e.privacy_domain_id)
  and e.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() and e.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
  and (e.document->>'assurance'<>'LOCAL_QA_VIRTUAL_AUTHENTICATOR' or current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true)='1')
  and (p_case is null or exists(select 1 from control.platform_recovery_case c where c.recovery_id=p_case
   and c.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id and c.participant_id=e.participant_id and c.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
   and c.enrollment_revision=e.row_version and c.enrollment_digest=e.document_digest
   and c.intent->>'schema'='pc.identity.discovery-certificate-recovery-intent'
   and c.intent->'certificateRecovery'=e.document->'certificateRecovery'))
$function$

 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql

    OR a#>'{grantable,administration,actionIntentIds}' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_array('ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-IDENTITY_CREATE_SESSION-V1','ACT-IDENTITY_DELETE_SESSION-V1','ACT-IDENTITY_UPDATE_STEP_UP-V1','ACT-OPERATIONS_READ_OPERATION-V1','ACT-PARTICIPANTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-POLICY_APPROVE_REQUEST-V1','ACT-POLICY_READ_EFFECTIVE_ACCESS-V1'))
  AND openpc.platform_recovery_source_root_current(e) AND openpc.platform_recovery_original_administrators_current(e)),false)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.enforce_mutation_candidate_lifecycle()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001', MESSAGE = 'DATA-6020-IMMUTABLE-ROW', DETAIL = 'control.mutation_candidate';
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    IF NEW."state" <> 'PROPOSED' OR NEW."consumed_operation_id" IS NOT NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001', MESSAGE = 'DATA-6021-INCOMPLETE-SECURITY-RECORD', DETAIL = 'control.mutation_candidate initial state';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF row(NEW."mutation_candidate_id",NEW."participant_id",NEW."privacy_domain_id",
         NEW."action_intent_id",NEW."catalog_operation_id",NEW."resource_type",
         NEW."operation_class",NEW."resource_id",NEW."candidate_digest",
         NEW."candidate_document",NEW."expected_revision",NEW."idempotency_key",
         NEW."maker_principal_id",NEW."maker_session_id",NEW."maker_session_epoch",
         NEW."maker_participant_epoch",NEW."maker_principal_epoch",NEW."maker_assignment_id",
         NEW."maker_assignment_row_version",NEW."maker_authority_envelope_id",
         NEW."maker_authority_epoch",NEW."maker_delegation_epoch",NEW."expires_at",NEW."created_at")
     IS DISTINCT FROM
     row(OLD."mutation_candidate_id",OLD."participant_id",OLD."privacy_domain_id",
         OLD."action_intent_id",OLD."catalog_operation_id",OLD."resource_type",
         OLD."operation_class",OLD."resource_id",OLD."candidate_digest",
         OLD."candidate_document",OLD."expected_revision",OLD."idempotency_key",
         OLD."maker_principal_id",OLD."maker_session_id",OLD."maker_session_epoch",
         OLD."maker_participant_epoch",OLD."maker_principal_epoch",OLD."maker_assignment_id",
         OLD."maker_assignment_row_version",OLD."maker_authority_envelope_id",
         OLD."maker_authority_epoch",OLD."maker_delegation_epoch",OLD."expires_at",OLD."created_at") THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001', MESSAGE = 'DATA-6020-IMMUTABLE-ROW', DETAIL = 'control.mutation_candidate identity';
  END IF;
  IF NOT ((OLD."state" = 'PROPOSED' AND NEW."state" IN ('APPROVAL_REQUESTED','CANCELLED'))
          OR (OLD."state" = 'APPROVAL_REQUESTED' AND NEW."state" IN ('APPROVAL_REQUESTED','APPROVED','CANCELLED'))
          OR (OLD."state" = 'APPROVED' AND NEW."state" = 'CONSUMED')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001', MESSAGE = 'DATA-6022-INVALID-STATE-TRANSITION', DETAIL = 'control.mutation_candidate lifecycle';
  END IF;
  IF NEW."updated_at" <= OLD."updated_at"
     OR ((NEW."state" = 'CONSUMED') <> (NEW."consumed_operation_id" IS NOT NULL)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001', MESSAGE = 'DATA-6021-INCOMPLETE-SECURITY-RECORD', DETAIL = 'control.mutation_candidate transition';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.enforce_mutation_resume()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE old_attempt control.mutation_candidate%ROWTYPE; prior control.approval_request%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
  IF row(NEW.predecessor_candidate_id,NEW.predecessor_approval_id,NEW.resume_operation_id,NEW.resume_request,NEW.attempt)
    IS DISTINCT FROM row(OLD.predecessor_candidate_id,OLD.predecessor_approval_id,OLD.resume_operation_id,OLD.resume_request,OLD.attempt)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_candidate s WHERE s.predecessor_candidate_id=OLD.mutation_candidate_id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 IF NEW.predecessor_candidate_id IS NULL THEN
  IF NEW.resume_request IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT old_attempt FROM control.mutation_candidate
  WHERE mutation_candidate_id=NEW.predecessor_candidate_id FOR UPDATE;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.authority_envelope e JOIN control.platform_recovery_case c
  ON c.participant_id=e.participant_id AND c.recovery_id=e.recovery_case_id
  WHERE e.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND e.authority_envelope_id=NEW.maker_authority_envelope_id
   AND e.representation='RECOVERY_V1' AND c.intent ? 'continuation')
  AND NOT (NEW.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATE' AND NEW.resume_request ? 'platformReceivingProof')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 IF NEW.resume_request->>'command'='DISCOVERY_PREAPPROVAL_CONTINUE' THEN
  PERFORM openpc.assert_discovery_preapproval_continuation(NEW);
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT prior FROM control.approval_request
  WHERE approval_request_id=NEW.predecessor_approval_id FOR UPDATE;
 IF row(NEW.participant_id,NEW.privacy_domain_id,NEW.action_intent_id,NEW.catalog_operation_id,
        NEW.resource_type,NEW.operation_class,NEW.resource_id,NEW.candidate_digest,NEW.candidate_document,
        NEW.expected_revision,NEW.idempotency_key,NEW.maker_principal_id)
    IS DISTINCT FROM row(old_attempt.participant_id,old_attempt.privacy_domain_id,old_attempt.action_intent_id,
        old_attempt.catalog_operation_id,old_attempt.resource_type,old_attempt.operation_class,old_attempt.resource_id,
        old_attempt.candidate_digest,old_attempt.candidate_document,old_attempt.expected_revision,
        old_attempt.idempotency_key,old_attempt.maker_principal_id)
   OR NEW.attempt<>old_attempt.attempt+1 OR NEW.expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
   OR NEW.expires_at>clock_timestamp()+interval '30 minutes'
   OR prior.participant_id<>NEW.participant_id OR prior.privacy_domain_id<>NEW.privacy_domain_id
   OR prior.subject_type<>'CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE' OR prior.subject_id<>old_attempt.mutation_candidate_id
   OR prior.subject_digest<>NEW.candidate_digest OR prior.subject_version<>NEW.expected_revision
   OR prior.maker_principal_id<>NEW.maker_principal_id OR prior.checker_principal_id IS NULL
   OR prior.checker_principal_id=NEW.maker_principal_id
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.principal checker WHERE checker.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
      AND checker.principal_id=prior.checker_principal_id AND checker.state='ACTIVE') OR prior.state NOT IN ('OPEN','APPROVED','EXPIRED')
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_candidate s WHERE s.predecessor_candidate_id=old_attempt.mutation_candidate_id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 -- The database independently clips CREATE continuation to both original scope deadlines.
 IF NEW.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-ENVELOPE-CREATE' AND NEW.expires_at>least(
    to_timestamp((old_attempt.candidate_document#>>'{usable,validUntilNs}')::numeric/1000000000),
    to_timestamp((old_attempt.candidate_document#>>'{grantable,validUntilNs}')::numeric/1000000000))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 -- A still-live approval cannot be replaced merely to obtain another authorization.
 IF NOT (NEW.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE' AND NEW.resume_request ? 'discoveryReceivingProof')
  AND NOT (NEW.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATE' AND NEW.resume_request ? 'platformReceivingProof')
  AND old_attempt.expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND prior.expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND
    (prior.state='OPEN' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM control.approval_decision_record d
      JOIN control.mfa_challenge m ON m.participant_id=d.participant_id AND m.mfa_challenge_id=d.mfa_challenge_id
      JOIN control.session proof_session ON proof_session.participant_id=m.participant_id
        AND proof_session.session_id=m.session_id AND proof_session.principal_id=m.principal_id
        AND proof_session.session_id=d.approver_session_id AND proof_session.session_epoch=d.approver_session_epoch
      WHERE d.participant_id=prior.participant_id AND d.privacy_domain_id=prior.privacy_domain_id
        AND d.approval_request_id=prior.approval_request_id AND d.decision='APPROVE'
        AND m.principal_id=d.approver_principal_id AND m.session_id=d.approver_session_id
        AND CASE WHEN proof_session.step_up_mfa_challenge_id IS NULL
          THEN m.consumed_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '5 minutes'
          ELSE proof_session.step_up_mfa_challenge_id=m.mfa_challenge_id
            AND openpc.session_step_up_valid_until(m.participant_id,m.session_id,m.principal_id)>clock_timestamp() END
        AND m.expires_at>clock_timestamp()))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 IF NEW.resume_request IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.resume_request)<>'object' OR NEW.resume_request->>'command' IS DISTINCT FROM 'RESUME'
    OR NEW.resume_request->>'actionIntentId' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
    OR NEW.resume_request->>'approvalRequestId' IS DISTINCT FROM 'urn:openpc:resource:'||prior.approval_request_id::text
    OR NEW.resume_request->>'expectedRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM prior.row_version::text
    OR NEW.resume_request->>'expectedAttempt' IS DISTINCT FROM old_attempt.attempt::text
    OR NEW.resume_request->>'predecessorCandidateId' IS DISTINCT FROM old_attempt.mutation_candidate_id::text
    OR NEW.resume_request->>'candidateDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(old_attempt.candidate_digest,'hex')
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM control.idempotency_record r WHERE r.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
      AND r.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND r.operation_id=NEW.resume_operation_id
      AND r.principal_id=NEW.maker_principal_id AND r.action_intent_id='ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
      AND r.catalog_operation_id='LEGACY' AND r.expected_aggregate_version=prior.row_version
      AND r.input_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(CASE WHEN NEW.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE'
       AND NEW.resume_request ? 'discoveryReceivingProof' THEN NEW.resume_request-'discoveryReceivingProof'
       WHEN NEW.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATE' AND NEW.resume_request ? 'platformReceivingProof'
         THEN NEW.resume_request-'platformReceivingProof' ELSE NEW.resume_request END),'UTF8')))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 IF NEW.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE' AND NEW.resume_request->>'command'='RESUME' THEN
  PERFORM openpc.assert_discovery_approval_resume(NEW);
 ELSIF NEW.resume_request ? 'platformReceivingProof' THEN
  PERFORM openpc.assert_platform_recovery_approval_resume(NEW);
 ELSE
  PERFORM openpc.assert_mutation_resume_no_effect(old_attempt.mutation_candidate_id);
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.evidence_deletion_rejections(stream text, segment uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE item control.evidence_catalogue; source record; claims jsonb; command uuid; proofs jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 -- Lock order: evidence lifecycle, then unique command UUIDs in lexical order.
 -- Reservation, handoff and terminal rejection already use this command fence.
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('evidence-lifecycle:'||current_setting('openpc.participant_id'),0));
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.evidence_catalogue c
  WHERE c.participant_id=current_setting('openpc.participant_id')::uuid
   AND c.privacy_domain_id=current_setting('openpc.privacy_domain_id')::uuid
   AND c.stream_id=stream AND c.segment_id=segment
   AND c.evidence_class NOT IN ('AUTHENTICATION','BUSINESS_TRANSITION','EFFECT'))
 THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 FOR item IN SELECT c.* FROM control.evidence_catalogue c
  WHERE c.participant_id=current_setting('openpc.participant_id')::uuid
   AND c.privacy_domain_id=current_setting('openpc.privacy_domain_id')::uuid
   AND c.stream_id=stream AND c.segment_id=segment AND c.evidence_class='EFFECT'
  ORDER BY c.record_id,c.evidence_id
 LOOP
  IF item.source_format='OPENPC_RPC_DECISION_TRANSITION_V1' THEN
   -- The separately typed RPC proof list is mandatory in the selection. Never
   -- convert a completed read or a retirement receipt into a no-send rejection.
   IF openpc.rpc_retired_catalogue_proof(item) IS NULL OR openpc.rpc_retired_catalogue_has_references(item) THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
   CONTINUE;
  END IF;
  IF item.source_format<>'PC-DEPLOYMENT-RESERVATION-REJECTION-1'
   OR item.record_id!~'^deployment:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}:1$'
  THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  command:=split_part(item.record_id,':',2)::uuid;
  PERFORM openpc.lock_deployment_command(command);
  SELECT *,count(*) OVER() source_count INTO source
   FROM openpc.deployment_rejection_source(command,item.participant_id,item.privacy_domain_id);
  IF NOT FOUND OR source.source_count<>1 OR source.result_digest<>item.receipt_digest
   OR source.result_digest<>'sha256:'||encode(sha256(source.signed_bytes),'hex') THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  claims:=convert_from(source.signed_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;
  IF claims->>'purpose' IS DISTINCT FROM 'openpc:deployment-reservation-rejection:v1'
   OR claims->'claims'->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM item.source_format
   OR claims->'claims'->'binding'->>'commandId' IS DISTINCT FROM command::text
   OR claims->'claims'->'binding'->>'attemptId' IS DISTINCT FROM source.attempt_id
   OR claims->'claims'->'binding'->'owner'->>'participant_id' IS DISTINCT FROM item.participant_id::text
   OR claims->'claims'->'binding'->'owner'->>'privacy_domain_id' IS DISTINCT FROM item.privacy_domain_id::text
   OR claims->'claims'->>'candidateDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM source.candidate_digest
   OR claims->'claims'->>'authorizationEvidenceDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM source.evidence_digest
   OR NOT coalesce(claims->'claims'->>'reason' IN ('CUSTODY_CONFLICT','PREPARATION_EXPIRED','MODULE_GENERATION_UNAVAILABLE'),false)
  THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  proofs:=proofs||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
   'evidenceId','urn:openpc:resource:'||item.evidence_id::text,'commandId',command::text,
   'attemptId',source.attempt_id,'receiptDigest',source.result_digest,
   'candidateDigest','sha256:'||source.candidate_digest,'authorizationEvidenceDigest','sha256:'||source.evidence_digest,
   'externalAttemptState','NOT_STARTED','sourceFormat',item.source_format));
 END LOOP;
 RETURN proofs;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.evidence_deployment_lineage_projection(source control.evidence_catalogue)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE r record; claims jsonb; occurrence jsonb; invalidation jsonb; historical jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF (source).evidence_class<>'EFFECT' OR (source).source_format<>'PC-DEPLOYMENT-JOURNAL-PROJECTION-1'
  OR (source).record_id!~'^deployment:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}:[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 SELECT d.signed_bytes,d.result_digest,d.sequence,a.* INTO r
  FROM control.deployment_result d JOIN control.deployment_address_reservation a
   ON a.participant_id=d.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=d.privacy_domain_id AND a.command_id=d.command_id
  WHERE d.participant_id=(source).participant_id AND d.privacy_domain_id=(source).privacy_domain_id
   AND d.command_id=split_part((source).record_id,':',2)::uuid AND d.sequence=split_part((source).record_id,':',3)::numeric
   AND d.result_digest=(source).receipt_digest AND d.result_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(d.signed_bytes),'hex')
   AND a.state='HANDOFF';
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 claims:=convert_from(r.signed_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF claims->>'purpose' IS DISTINCT FROM 'openpc:deployment-journal-projection:v1' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 claims:=claims->'claims';
 IF claims->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM (source).source_format
  OR claims->>'sequence' IS DISTINCT FROM r.sequence::text
  OR (regexp_replace(claims->>'observedAt','([.][0-9]{6})[0-9]+',chr(92)||'1'))::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM (source).occurred_at
  OR claims->'owner'->>'participant_id' IS DISTINCT FROM (source).participant_id::text
  OR claims->'owner'->>'privacy_domain_id' IS DISTINCT FROM (source).privacy_domain_id::text
  OR claims->'status'->>'operationId' IS DISTINCT FROM 'urn:openpc:operation:'||r.command_id::text
  OR claims->'status'->>'attemptId' IS DISTINCT FROM r.attempt_id::text
  OR claims->>'targetRuntimeId' IS DISTINCT FROM replace(r.target_runtime_id,'urn:openpc:resource:','')
  OR claims->>'intentDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM substring(r.intent_digest from 8)
  OR claims->>'preparationDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM substring(r.prepared_record_digest from 8)
  OR claims->>'chainId' IS DISTINCT FROM r.chain_id
  OR claims->>'genesisDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM substring(r.genesis_digest from 8)
  OR claims->'status'->>'signedTransactionHash' IS DISTINCT FROM r.transaction_hash THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 occurrence:=claims->'outcome'->'occurrence'; invalidation:=claims->'outcome'->'invalidation';
 historical:=jsonb_build_object('sourceVersion',r.sequence::text,'receiptDigest',r.result_digest,
  'observedAt',claims->>'observedAt','state',claims->'status'->>'state','truthState',claims->'status'->>'truthState',
  'journalEvidenceDigest',claims->'status'->>'evidenceDigest',
  'finality',CASE WHEN invalidation<>'null'::jsonb THEN CASE WHEN invalidation->>'reason'='REORG' THEN 'REORG' ELSE 'INVALIDATED' END
    WHEN occurrence<>'null'::jsonb THEN 'FINALIZED' ELSE 'NOT_ESTABLISHED' END,
  'occurrence',CASE WHEN occurrence='null'::jsonb THEN 'null'::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_object(
   'occurrenceId',occurrence->>'occurrenceId','occurrenceDigest','sha256:'||(occurrence->>'semanticDigest'),
   'blockHash','sha256:'||(occurrence->>'blockHash'),'blockNumber',occurrence->>'blockNumber','reorgStatus',occurrence->>'reorgStatus') END,
  'invalidation',CASE WHEN invalidation='null'::jsonb THEN 'null'::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_object(
   'occurrenceId',invalidation->>'occurrenceId','occurrenceDigest','sha256:'||(invalidation->>'occurrenceDigest'),
   'observationDigest','sha256:'||(invalidation->>'observationDigest'),'reason',invalidation->>'reason') END);
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('chainId',r.chain_id,'genesisDigest',r.genesis_digest,'historical',historical);
EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege OR invalid_text_representation OR datetime_field_overflow THEN RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.evidence_deployment_projection(source control.evidence_catalogue)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE lineage jsonb; r record;
BEGIN
 lineage:=openpc.evidence_deployment_lineage_projection(source);
 IF lineage IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 SELECT a.*,i.deployment_intent_id,i.execution_principal_id,i.execution_workload_id INTO r
 FROM control.deployment_address_reservation a JOIN control.deployment_intent i
  ON i.participant_id=a.participant_id AND i.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id
   AND i.preparation_digest=a.prepared_record_digest AND i.intent_digest=a.intent_digest
   AND 'urn:openpc:resource:'||i.runtime_target_id::text=a.target_runtime_id
 WHERE a.participant_id=(source).participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=(source).privacy_domain_id
  AND a.command_id=split_part((source).record_id,':',2)::uuid AND a.state='HANDOFF';
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('integrity','VERIFIED_PURPOSE_SIGNATURE','authority','OBSERVATION_ONLY',
  'operationId','urn:openpc:operation:'||r.command_id::text,'attemptId',r.attempt_id::text,
  'deploymentIntentId','urn:openpc:resource:'||r.deployment_intent_id::text,'targetRuntimeId',r.target_runtime_id,
  'executionPrincipalId',r.execution_principal_id::text,'workloadId',r.execution_workload_id,
  'intentDigest',r.intent_digest,'preparationDigest',r.prepared_record_digest,
  'chainId',r.chain_id,'genesisDigest',r.genesis_digest,'transactionHash',r.transaction_hash,
  'historical',lineage->'historical');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.evidence_export_completion_source(export_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE source jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(false);
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('participantId',r.participant_id::text,'privacyDomainId',r.privacy_domain_id::text,
  'streamId',r.stream_id,'evidenceExportId',r.evidence_export_id::text,'startOperationId',r.start_operation_id::text,
  'causationId',event.event_id::text,'requestDigest',r.request_digest,'checkpoint',r.checkpoint::text,
  'outputDigest',o.output_digest,'recordCount',jsonb_array_length(s.selection->'records')::text)
 INTO STRICT source
 FROM control.evidence_export_request r
 JOIN control.evidence_export_output o USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,stream_id,evidence_export_id)
 JOIN control.evidence_export_selection s USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,stream_id,request_digest)
 JOIN control.mutation_evidence e ON e.participant_id=r.participant_id AND e.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id
  AND e.operation_id=r.start_operation_id AND e.aggregate_id=r.evidence_export_id AND e.aggregate_type='evidence-export'
  AND e.action_intent_id='ACT-EVIDENCE_EXPORT_RECORDS-V1' AND e.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-START-EVIDENCE-EXPORT'
 JOIN control.idempotency_record i ON i.participant_id=e.participant_id AND i.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
  AND i.operation_id=e.operation_id AND i.catalog_operation_id=e.catalog_operation_id AND i.action_intent_id=e.action_intent_id
  AND i.input_digest=e.candidate_digest AND i.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
 JOIN control.mutation_candidate c ON c.participant_id=e.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
  AND c.consumed_operation_id=e.operation_id AND c.candidate_digest=e.candidate_digest
  AND c.action_intent_id=e.action_intent_id AND c.catalog_operation_id=e.catalog_operation_id
  AND c.operation_class='EXPORT' AND c.state='CONSUMED' AND c.candidate_document->>'inputDigest'=r.request_digest
 JOIN control.outbox_event event ON event.participant_id=e.participant_id AND event.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
  AND event.aggregate_type=e.aggregate_type AND event.aggregate_id=e.aggregate_id
  AND event.event_type='openpc.evidence.export.started.v1'
  AND convert_from(event.payload_cbor,'UTF8')::jsonb->>'candidateDigest'='sha256:'||encode(e.candidate_digest,'hex')
  AND convert_from(event.payload_cbor,'UTF8')::jsonb->>'revision'=(i.expected_aggregate_version+1)::text
  AND convert_from(event.payload_cbor,'UTF8')::jsonb->>'authorizationEvidenceDigest'='sha256:'||encode(e.evidence_digest,'hex')
  AND event.payload_digest=sha256(event.payload_cbor)
 WHERE r.participant_id=current_setting('openpc.participant_id')::uuid
  AND r.privacy_domain_id=current_setting('openpc.privacy_domain_id')::uuid AND r.evidence_export_id=export_id
  AND r.state='SUCCEEDED' AND r.output_digest=o.output_digest
  AND r.checkpoint=(s.selection->'range'->>'throughSequence')::numeric
  AND i.result_payload->>'resourceRef'='urn:openpc:resource:'||r.evidence_export_id::text
  AND r.request_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(s.selection),'UTF8')),'hex')
  AND o.output_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(o.artifact),'hex')
  AND jsonb_array_length(convert_from(o.artifact,'UTF8')::jsonb->'records')=jsonb_array_length(s.selection->'records');
 RETURN source;
EXCEPTION WHEN no_data_found OR too_many_rows THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007-EVIDENCE-EXPORT-COMPLETION-SOURCE';
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.evidence_export_producer_authority(wanted text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE installed control.evidence_export_producer_installation; authority jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installed FROM control.evidence_export_producer_installation
 WHERE participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id() AND privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
 AND trust_digest=wanted AND state='ACTIVE';
select jsonb_build_object('schema','pc.evidence-export.producer-authority.v1',
      'installationDigest',(installed.trust_digest)::text,'participantEpoch',p.authority_epoch::text,'principalEpoch',a.authority_epoch::text,
      'workloadEpoch',c.credential_epoch::text,'workloadCredentialId',c.credential_id::text,
      'participantId',p.participant_id::text,'privacyDomainId',d.privacy_domain_id::text,
      'principalId',a.principal_id::text,'workloadId',c.audience,'certificateFingerprint',c.secret_fingerprint,
      'keyDigest','sha256:'||encode(c.public_key_digest,'hex'),
      'participantVersion',p.row_version::text,'privacyVersion',d.row_version::text,
      'principalVersion',a.row_version::text,'credentialVersion',c.row_version::text,
      'subject',c.subject,'validFrom',c.valid_from::text,'validUntil',c.valid_until::text) authority
      INTO STRICT authority
      from control.participant p join control.privacy_domain d on d.participant_id=p.participant_id
      join control.principal a on a.participant_id=p.participant_id
      join control.credential c on c.participant_id=a.participant_id and c.principal_id=a.principal_id
      where p.participant_id=(installed.participant_id) and d.privacy_domain_id=(installed.privacy_domain_id) and a.principal_id=(installed.principal_id) and c.credential_id=(installed.workload_credential_id)
      and p.state='ACTIVE' and d.state='ACTIVE' and a.state='ACTIVE' and a.kind='WORKLOAD'
      and c.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' and c.state='ACTIVE' and c.credential_epoch=(installed.workload_epoch) and c.audience=(installed.trust->>'workloadId')
      and c.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() and c.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
      and c.public_key_digest<>decode(substring((installed.signer_id)::text from 8),'hex')
      and floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000 between (installed.trust->>'validFromNs')::numeric and (installed.trust->>'validUntilNs')::numeric-1 FOR SHARE OF p,d,a,c;
 RETURN authority;
EXCEPTION WHEN no_data_found OR too_many_rows THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-EXPORT-PRODUCER';
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.evidence_fact_lineages(participant uuid, privacy uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(stream_id text, record_id text, lineage jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT p.stream_id,p.record_id,p.projection->'lineage'
 FROM control.evidence_fact_provenance p JOIN control.evidence_catalogue c USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,stream_id,record_id)
 WHERE p.participant_id=participant AND p.privacy_domain_id=privacy
  AND c.source_format='OPENPC_CANONICAL_FACT_V1' AND c.evidence_class='EFFECT'
  AND p.projection->>'receiptDigest'=c.receipt_digest AND p.projection->>'sourceSequence'=c.sequence::text
  AND (p.projection->>'admittedAt')::timestamptz=c.occurred_at
  AND p.projection_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(p.projection),'UTF8')),'hex')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT r.stream_id,r.record_id,r.preservation_metadata->'factLineage'
 FROM control.evidence_projection_retirement r JOIN control.evidence_catalogue c USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,stream_id,record_id)
 JOIN control.deletion_job j USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,deletion_job_id)
 WHERE r.participant_id=participant AND r.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND r.data_class='NORMALIZED_JSON_PROJECTION'
  AND c.source_format='OPENPC_CANONICAL_FACT_V1' AND c.evidence_class='EFFECT'
  AND r.evidence_id=c.evidence_id AND r.source_receipt_digest=c.receipt_digest AND r.sequence=c.sequence AND r.segment_id=c.segment_id
  AND j.state='SUCCEEDED' AND j.selection->>'sourceKind'='FACT_PROVENANCE'
  AND j.selection->>'projectionDigest'=r.projection_digest AND j.selection->>'sourceReceiptDigest'=r.source_receipt_digest
  AND r.retirement_digest=openpc.projection_retirement_digest(r)
  AND jsonb_typeof(r.preservation_metadata->'factLineage')='object'
$function$
selector jsonb, participant uuid, privacy uuid, stream text, segment uuid

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.evidence_hold_match_state(selector jsonb, participant uuid, privacy uuid, stream text, segment uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN bool_or(matched) THEN 'MATCH' WHEN count(*)=0 OR bool_or(matched IS NULL) THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE 'NON_MATCH' END
 FROM (SELECT CASE selector->>'type'
  WHEN 'PARTICIPANT' THEN true WHEN 'PRIVACY_DOMAIN' THEN true
  WHEN 'SEQUENCE_RANGE' THEN selector->>'streamId'=c.stream_id AND c.sequence>=(selector->>'fromSequence')::numeric
   AND (selector->'throughSequence'='null'::jsonb OR c.sequence<=(selector->>'throughSequence')::numeric)
  WHEN 'DIGEST' THEN selector->>'recordDigest'=c.receipt_digest
  ELSE openpc.evidence_hold_source_match(selector,openpc.evidence_hold_record_metadata(c)) END matched
  FROM control.evidence_catalogue c WHERE c.participant_id=participant AND c.privacy_domain_id=privacy
   AND c.stream_id=stream AND c.segment_id=segment
  UNION ALL SELECT CASE selector->>'type'
   WHEN 'PARTICIPANT' THEN true WHEN 'PRIVACY_DOMAIN' THEN true
   WHEN 'SEQUENCE_RANGE' THEN selector->>'streamId'=r.stream_id AND r.sequence>=(selector->>'fromSequence')::numeric
    AND (selector->'throughSequence'='null'::jsonb OR r.sequence<=(selector->>'throughSequence')::numeric)
   WHEN 'DIGEST' THEN selector->>'recordDigest'=r.source_receipt_digest
   ELSE openpc.evidence_hold_source_match(selector,r.preservation_metadata) END
  FROM control.evidence_projection_retirement r JOIN control.deletion_job j USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,deletion_job_id)
   WHERE r.participant_id=participant AND r.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND r.stream_id=stream AND r.segment_id=segment
    AND r.data_class='SEARCH_PROJECTION' AND j.state='SUCCEEDED'
    AND r.retirement_digest=openpc.projection_retirement_digest(r)) matches
$function$
selector jsonb, participant uuid, privacy uuid, stream text, segment uuid

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.evidence_hold_matches(selector jsonb, participant uuid, privacy uuid, stream text, segment uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.expired_activation_state_digest(wanted uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(jsonb_build_object(
  'work',to_jsonb(w),'target',to_jsonb(t),'generation',to_jsonb(g),'observation',to_jsonb(o),
  'head',to_jsonb(a),'delivery',to_jsonb(d),'acknowledgement',to_jsonb(k))),'UTF8')),'hex')
 FROM control.configuration_work w
 JOIN control.runtime_target t USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,runtime_target_id)
 JOIN control.runtime_configuration_generation g ON g.participant_id=w.participant_id
  AND g.privacy_domain_id=w.privacy_domain_id AND g.runtime_configuration_generation_id=w.runtime_configuration_generation_id
 JOIN control.runtime_activation_observation o ON o.configuration_work_id=w.configuration_work_id
  AND o.participant_id=w.participant_id AND o.privacy_domain_id=w.privacy_domain_id
 JOIN control.runtime_target_disposition_admission a ON a.participant_id=w.participant_id
  AND a.privacy_domain_id=w.privacy_domain_id AND a.runtime_target_id=w.runtime_target_id
  AND a.revision=(SELECT max(h.revision) FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission h
   WHERE h.participant_id=w.participant_id AND h.privacy_domain_id=w.privacy_domain_id AND h.runtime_target_id=w.runtime_target_id)
 JOIN control.runtime_target_disposition_delivery d ON d.participant_id=a.participant_id
  AND d.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND d.runtime_target_id=a.runtime_target_id AND d.revision=a.revision
 JOIN control.runtime_target_disposition_acknowledgement k ON k.participant_id=d.participant_id
  AND k.privacy_domain_id=d.privacy_domain_id AND k.runtime_target_id=d.runtime_target_id AND k.delivery_digest=d.delivery_digest
 WHERE w.configuration_work_id=wanted AND w.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id()
  AND w.privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
$function$
wanted_target uuid, wanted_revision bigint, wanted_digest text, wanted_worker text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.expired_credential_handover_issuance_matches(wanted_target uuid, wanted_revision bigint, wanted_digest text, wanted_worker text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE h control.runtime_expired_denial_handover;e control.runtime_expired_activation_denial;
 a control.runtime_target_disposition_admission;old control.runtime_target_disposition_admission;p record;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO h FROM control.runtime_expired_denial_handover x
 WHERE x.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id() AND x.privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
  AND x.runtime_target_id=wanted_target AND x.admission_revision=wanted_revision AND x.admission_digest=wanted_digest;
 IF NOT FOUND OR h.proof->'intent'->>'purpose' IS DISTINCT FROM 'EXPIRED_OBSERVED_CREDENTIAL_DENIAL_HANDOVER_V1'
  OR h.proof->'intent'->'custody'->>'workerId' IS DISTINCT FROM wanted_worker
  OR (h.proof->'intent'->>'issuedAtMs')::numeric>extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000
  OR (h.proof->'intent'->>'expiresAtMs')::numeric<=extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000
 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT e FROM control.runtime_expired_activation_denial x WHERE x.configuration_work_id=h.configuration_work_id
  AND x.participant_id=h.participant_id AND x.privacy_domain_id=h.privacy_domain_id AND x.runtime_target_id=h.runtime_target_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT old FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission x WHERE x.participant_id=e.participant_id
  AND x.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id AND x.runtime_target_id=e.runtime_target_id AND x.revision=e.admission_revision;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission x WHERE x.participant_id=h.participant_id
  AND x.privacy_domain_id=h.privacy_domain_id AND x.runtime_target_id=h.runtime_target_id AND x.revision=h.admission_revision;
 IF h.abandoned_revision IS DISTINCT FROM e.admission_revision OR h.abandoned_admission_digest IS DISTINCT FROM e.admission_digest
  OR h.admission_revision IS DISTINCT FROM e.admission_revision+1 OR old.admission_digest IS DISTINCT FROM e.admission_digest
  OR a.admission_digest IS DISTINCT FROM h.admission_digest OR a.binding->>'action' IS DISTINCT FROM 'Withdraw'
  OR a.binding->'source' IS DISTINCT FROM old.binding->'source' OR a.binding->'target' IS DISTINCT FROM h.proof->'target'
  OR a.binding->'cause'->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ExpiredObservedCredentialDenialHandover'
  OR a.binding->'cause'->'abandoned_target' IS DISTINCT FROM old.binding->'target'
  OR a.binding->'cause'->>'credential_rotation_operation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM h.proof->'intent'->'credentialTransition'->>'rotationOperationId'
  OR a.binding->'cause'->>'original_receipt_wire_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM e.proof->>'receiptWireDigest'
  OR a.revision IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT max(x.revision)FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission x
   WHERE x.participant_id=a.participant_id AND x.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND x.runtime_target_id=a.runtime_target_id)
 THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT p FROM openpc.expired_denial_credential_provenance(wanted_target,
  'sha256:'||(a.binding->'target'->>'certificate_digest'),(a.binding->'cause'->>'credential_rotation_operation_id')::uuid);
 RETURN p.binding->'target'=a.binding->'target' AND p.binding->'source'=a.binding->'source'
  AND p.binding->'credential_predecessor'=old.binding->'target';
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.expired_denial_credential_bootstrap(wanted_target uuid, certificate text)
 RETURNS TABLE(binding jsonb, rotation_operation_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
 SET jit TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE e control.runtime_expired_activation_denial;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_runtime_target_disposition_owner();PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT e FROM control.runtime_expired_activation_denial x WHERE x.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id()
  AND x.privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id() AND x.runtime_target_id=wanted_target;
 IF e.admission_revision IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT max(a.revision)FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission a
   WHERE a.participant_id=e.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id AND a.runtime_target_id=e.runtime_target_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_expired_denial_handover h WHERE h.configuration_work_id=e.configuration_work_id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'EXPIRED-CREDENTIAL-DENIAL-HEAD';END IF;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT p.binding,p.rotation_operation_id FROM openpc.expired_denial_credential_provenance(wanted_target,certificate,NULL)p;
END $function$
wanted_target uuid, certificate text, wanted_rotation uuid

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.expired_denial_credential_provenance(wanted_target uuid, certificate text, wanted_rotation uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(binding jsonb, rotation_operation_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
 SET jit TO 'off'
AS $function$
DECLARE pid uuid;privacy uuid;authority record;current_credential control.credential;
 original_credential control.credential;e control.runtime_expired_activation_denial;
 a control.runtime_target_disposition_admission;p control.runtime_target_disposition_admission;
 d control.runtime_target_disposition_delivery;k control.runtime_target_disposition_acknowledgement;
 w control.configuration_work;t control.runtime_target;old_target jsonb;current_target jsonb;rotations uuid[];
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_runtime_target_disposition_owner();PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-RUNTIME_CONFIGURATION_GENERATIONS_ACTIVATE_RESOURCE-V1'
  OR current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'EXPIRED-CREDENTIAL-DENIAL-CONTEXT';END IF;
 pid:=openpc.current_participant_id();privacy:=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id();
 SELECT * INTO STRICT authority FROM openpc.lock_runtime_discovery_authority(wanted_target,certificate);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT current_credential FROM control.credential c WHERE c.participant_id=pid AND c.credential_id=authority.credential_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT e FROM control.runtime_expired_activation_denial x WHERE x.participant_id=pid
  AND x.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND x.runtime_target_id=wanted_target;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT w FROM control.configuration_work x WHERE x.participant_id=pid AND x.privacy_domain_id=privacy
  AND x.configuration_work_id=e.configuration_work_id AND x.runtime_target_id=wanted_target;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT t FROM control.runtime_target x WHERE x.participant_id=pid AND x.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND x.runtime_target_id=wanted_target;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission x WHERE x.participant_id=pid
  AND x.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND x.runtime_target_id=wanted_target AND x.revision=e.admission_revision;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT p FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission x WHERE x.participant_id=pid
  AND x.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND x.runtime_target_id=wanted_target AND x.revision=e.admission_revision-1;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_delivery x WHERE x.participant_id=pid
  AND x.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND x.runtime_target_id=wanted_target AND x.revision=p.revision;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT k FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_acknowledgement x WHERE x.participant_id=pid
  AND x.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND x.runtime_target_id=wanted_target AND x.delivery_digest=d.delivery_digest;
 old_target:=a.binding->'target';
 SELECT * INTO STRICT original_credential FROM control.credential c WHERE c.participant_id=pid
  AND c.credential_id=(old_target->>'credential_id')::uuid;
 current_target:=jsonb_build_object('participant_id',pid::text,'privacy_domain_id',privacy::text,'target_id',wanted_target::text,
  'credential_id',current_credential.credential_id::text,'principal_id',current_credential.principal_id::text,
  'credential_epoch',authority.credential_epoch,'principal_epoch',authority.principal_epoch,
  'certificate_digest',substring(certificate from 8));
 IF w.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'RECONCILING' OR w.reconcile_after IS DISTINCT FROM 'infinity'::timestamptz
  OR w.work_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'RUNTIME_ACTIVATION' OR w.execution_attempt_id IS DISTINCT FROM e.execution_attempt_id
  OR w.execution_started_at IS NULL OR w.lease_owner IS NOT NULL OR w.lease_until IS NOT NULL
  OR w.result_event_id IS NOT NULL OR w.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  OR t.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'STAGING' OR t.active_generation_digest IS DISTINCT FROM w.predecessor_digest
  OR t.desired_generation_digest IS DISTINCT FROM w.generation_digest
  OR a.admission_digest IS DISTINCT FROM e.admission_digest OR a.binding->>'action' IS DISTINCT FROM 'Withdraw'
  OR a.binding->'source' IS DISTINCT FROM e.proof->'source'
  OR a.binding->'cause' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('kind','Activation','work_id',w.configuration_work_id::text,
   'operation_id',w.operation_id::text,'execution_attempt_id',w.execution_attempt_id::text)
  OR old_target->>'participant_id' IS DISTINCT FROM pid::text OR old_target->>'privacy_domain_id' IS DISTINCT FROM privacy::text
  OR old_target->>'target_id' IS DISTINCT FROM wanted_target::text
  OR old_target->>'principal_id' IS DISTINCT FROM current_credential.principal_id::text
  OR old_target->'principal_epoch' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(authority.principal_epoch)
  OR (old_target->>'credential_epoch')::numeric+1 IS DISTINCT FROM authority.credential_epoch::numeric
  OR original_credential.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'REVOKED'
  OR original_credential.kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'WORKLOAD_MTLS'
  OR original_credential.principal_id IS DISTINCT FROM current_credential.principal_id
  OR original_credential.audience IS DISTINCT FROM current_credential.audience
  OR current_credential.rotated_from_credential_id IS DISTINCT FROM original_credential.credential_id
  OR original_credential.credential_epoch IS DISTINCT FROM current_credential.credential_epoch
  OR old_target->>'certificate_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(original_credential.secret_fingerprint,'hex')
  OR original_credential.certificate_der IS NULL OR sha256(original_credential.certificate_der) IS DISTINCT FROM original_credential.secret_fingerprint
  OR current_target=old_target OR current_target->>'certificate_digest'=old_target->>'certificate_digest'
  OR a.binding->'previous_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p.revision)
  OR a.binding->>'previous_delivery_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM substring(d.delivery_digest from 8)
  OR p.binding->'target' IS DISTINCT FROM old_target OR p.binding->>'action' IS DISTINCT FROM 'Withdraw'
  OR p.binding->'cause' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('kind','Activation','work_id',w.configuration_work_id::text,
   'operation_id',w.operation_id::text,'execution_attempt_id',NULL)
  OR p.binding->'source'->>'capsule_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM substring(w.predecessor_digest from 8)
  OR a.binding->'source'->>'predecessor_capsule_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM p.binding->'source'->>'capsule_digest'
  OR d.claims IS DISTINCT FROM p.binding||jsonb_build_object('committed_admission_digest',substring(p.admission_digest from 8))
  OR d.delivery_digest IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(d.signed_delivery),'hex')
  OR k.claims->'target' IS DISTINCT FROM old_target OR k.claims->>'installed_state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'NewUseDenied'
  OR k.claims->'disposition_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(p.revision)
  OR k.acknowledgement_digest IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(k.signed_acknowledgement),'hex')
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_delivery x WHERE x.participant_id=pid AND x.privacy_domain_id=privacy
   AND x.runtime_target_id=wanted_target AND x.revision=e.admission_revision)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'EXPIRED-CREDENTIAL-DENIAL-ORIGINAL';END IF;
 SELECT array_agg(chosen_rotation.consumed_operation_id ORDER BY chosen_rotation.consumed_operation_id) INTO rotations
 FROM control.mutation_candidate chosen_rotation WHERE chosen_rotation.participant_id=pid AND chosen_rotation.privacy_domain_id=privacy
  AND chosen_rotation.resource_id=original_credential.credential_id AND chosen_rotation.state='CONSUMED'
  AND chosen_rotation.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE'AND chosen_rotation.action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
  AND (wanted_rotation IS NULL OR chosen_rotation.consumed_operation_id=wanted_rotation)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM control.credential predecessor
    JOIN control.credential successor ON successor.participant_id=predecessor.participant_id
      AND successor.rotated_from_credential_id=predecessor.credential_id
      AND successor.principal_id=predecessor.principal_id AND successor.audience=predecessor.audience
    JOIN control.mutation_candidate candidate ON candidate.participant_id=predecessor.participant_id
      AND candidate.privacy_domain_id=privacy
      AND candidate.resource_id=predecessor.credential_id
      AND candidate.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE'
      AND candidate.action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
      AND candidate.state='CONSUMED' AND candidate.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL
      AND candidate.candidate_document=jsonb_build_object('replacedCredentialId',predecessor.credential_id::text,
        'credentialId',successor.credential_id::text,
        'publicKeySpkiDer',replace(encode(successor.public_key_spki_der,'base64'),E'\n',''))
      AND candidate.candidate_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(candidate.candidate_document),'UTF8'))
    JOIN control.approval_request approval ON approval.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
      AND approval.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id AND approval.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE'
      AND approval.subject_id=candidate.mutation_candidate_id AND approval.subject_digest=candidate.candidate_digest
      AND approval.maker_principal_id=candidate.maker_principal_id AND approval.state='APPROVED'
      AND approval.subject_version=candidate.expected_revision AND approval.action_intent_id=candidate.action_intent_id
    JOIN control.approval_decision_record decision ON decision.participant_id=approval.participant_id
      AND decision.privacy_domain_id=approval.privacy_domain_id AND decision.approval_request_id=approval.approval_request_id
      AND decision.decision='APPROVE' AND decision.candidate_digest=candidate.candidate_digest
      AND decision.approver_principal_id<>approval.maker_principal_id AND decision.cose_sign1 IS NOT NULL
      AND decision.aggregate_version=approval.subject_version
    JOIN control.mutation_evidence evidence ON evidence.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
      AND evidence.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id AND evidence.operation_id=candidate.consumed_operation_id
      AND evidence.action_intent_id=candidate.action_intent_id AND evidence.catalog_operation_id=candidate.catalog_operation_id
      AND evidence.aggregate_type='workload-credential' AND evidence.aggregate_id=predecessor.credential_id
      AND evidence.candidate_digest=candidate.candidate_digest AND evidence.principal_id=approval.maker_principal_id
      AND evidence.checker_principal_id=decision.approver_principal_id AND evidence.approval_request_id=approval.approval_request_id
      AND evidence.evidence_digest=sha256(evidence.evidence_cbor) AND evidence.cose_sign1 IS NOT NULL
      AND evidence.evidence_cbor=decision.evidence_cbor AND evidence.cose_sign1=decision.cose_sign1
      AND evidence.signer_credential_id=decision.signer_credential_id
      AND evidence.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest IS NOT NULL AND evidence.mfa_challenge_id IS NOT NULL
    JOIN control.idempotency_record committed ON committed.participant_id=evidence.participant_id
      AND committed.privacy_domain_id=evidence.privacy_domain_id AND committed.operation_id=evidence.operation_id
      AND committed.action_intent_id=evidence.action_intent_id AND committed.catalog_operation_id=evidence.catalog_operation_id
      AND committed.principal_id=evidence.principal_id
      AND committed.terminal_state='COMMITTED' AND committed.input_digest=evidence.candidate_digest
      AND committed.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=evidence.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
      AND committed.result_payload->>'credentialId'=successor.credential_id::text
      AND committed.result_payload->>'replacedCredentialId'=predecessor.credential_id::text
      AND committed.result_payload->>'principalId'=successor.principal_id::text
      AND committed.result_payload->>'workloadId'=successor.audience
      AND committed.result_payload->>'workloadEpoch'=successor.credential_epoch::text
      AND committed.result_payload->>'state'='ACTIVE'
    JOIN control.outbox_event event ON event.participant_id=evidence.participant_id
      AND event.privacy_domain_id=evidence.privacy_domain_id AND event.aggregate_type=evidence.aggregate_type
      AND event.aggregate_id=evidence.aggregate_id AND event.payload_cbor=evidence.evidence_cbor
      AND event.event_type='openpc.identity.workload-credential.mutation.committed.v1'
      AND event.payload_digest=evidence.evidence_digest AND event.cose_sign1=evidence.cose_sign1
      AND event.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=evidence.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
    WHERE predecessor.participant_id=pid
      AND predecessor.credential_id=original_credential.credential_id AND successor.credential_id=current_credential.credential_id
      AND predecessor.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND predecessor.state='REVOKED'
      AND successor.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND successor.state='ACTIVE'
      AND predecessor.credential_epoch=(old_target->>'credential_epoch')::numeric+1
      AND successor.credential_epoch=predecessor.credential_epoch
      AND successor.credential_epoch=current_credential.credential_epoch
      AND successor.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND successor.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
      AND evidence.operation_id=chosen_rotation.consumed_operation_id
  );
 IF cardinality(rotations) IS DISTINCT FROM 1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'EXPIRED-CREDENTIAL-DENIAL-ROTATION';END IF;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT jsonb_build_object('target',current_target,'source',a.binding->'source','credential_predecessor',old_target),rotations[1];
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.expired_denial_handover_state_digest(wanted uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(jsonb_build_object(
 'originalDenial',to_jsonb(e),'work',to_jsonb(w),'target',to_jsonb(t),'generation',to_jsonb(g),
 'observation',to_jsonb(o),'abandoned',to_jsonb(a),'previous',to_jsonb(p),
 'previousDelivery',to_jsonb(d),'previousAcknowledgement',to_jsonb(k))),'UTF8')),'hex')
 FROM control.runtime_expired_activation_denial e
 JOIN control.configuration_work w USING(configuration_work_id,participant_id,privacy_domain_id,runtime_target_id,execution_attempt_id)
 JOIN control.runtime_target t USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,runtime_target_id)
 JOIN control.runtime_configuration_generation g ON g.participant_id=w.participant_id AND g.privacy_domain_id=w.privacy_domain_id
  AND g.runtime_configuration_generation_id=w.runtime_configuration_generation_id
 JOIN control.runtime_activation_observation o ON o.configuration_work_id=w.configuration_work_id
  AND o.participant_id=w.participant_id AND o.privacy_domain_id=w.privacy_domain_id
 JOIN control.runtime_target_disposition_admission a ON a.participant_id=e.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
  AND a.runtime_target_id=e.runtime_target_id AND a.revision=e.admission_revision AND a.admission_digest=e.admission_digest
 JOIN control.runtime_target_disposition_admission p ON p.participant_id=a.participant_id AND p.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id
  AND p.runtime_target_id=a.runtime_target_id AND p.revision=a.revision-1
 JOIN control.runtime_target_disposition_delivery d ON d.participant_id=p.participant_id AND d.privacy_domain_id=p.privacy_domain_id
  AND d.runtime_target_id=p.runtime_target_id AND d.revision=p.revision
 JOIN control.runtime_target_disposition_acknowledgement k ON k.participant_id=d.participant_id AND k.privacy_domain_id=d.privacy_domain_id
  AND k.runtime_target_id=d.runtime_target_id AND k.delivery_digest=d.delivery_digest
 WHERE e.configuration_work_id=wanted AND e.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id()
  AND e.privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
  AND a.revision=(SELECT max(h.revision)FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission h
   WHERE h.participant_id=a.participant_id AND h.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND h.runtime_target_id=a.runtime_target_id)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_delivery x WHERE x.participant_id=a.participant_id
   AND x.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND x.runtime_target_id=a.runtime_target_id AND x.revision=a.revision)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_expired_denial_handover h WHERE h.configuration_work_id=e.configuration_work_id)
$function$

  AND h.participant_id=e.participant_id AND h.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id AND h.runtime_target_id=e.runtime_target_id

  AND c.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id AND c.runtime_target_id=e.runtime_target_id

  AND w.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id AND w.runtime_target_id=e.runtime_target_id AND w.execution_attempt_id=e.execution_attempt_id
 JOIN control.runtime_activation_observation o ON o.configuration_work_id=w.configuration_work_id AND o.participant_id=w.participant_id
  AND o.privacy_domain_id=w.privacy_domain_id AND o.execution_attempt_id=w.execution_attempt_id

  AND a.runtime_target_id=e.runtime_target_id AND a.revision=coalesce(h.admission_revision,e.admission_revision)
 JOIN control.runtime_target_disposition_delivery d ON d.participant_id=a.participant_id AND d.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id
  AND d.runtime_target_id=a.runtime_target_id AND d.revision=a.revision

  AND k.runtime_target_id=d.runtime_target_id AND k.delivery_digest=d.delivery_digest
 JOIN control.outbox_event event ON event.event_id=w.result_event_id AND event.participant_id=w.participant_id
  AND event.privacy_domain_id=w.privacy_domain_id AND event.aggregate_id=w.runtime_target_id
 WHERE e.configuration_work_id=$1 AND e.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id() AND e.privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
  AND coalesce(h.intent_digest,e.intent_digest)=$2 AND coalesce(h.intent_bytes,e.intent_bytes)=$3
  AND w.state='FAILED' AND w.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND w.result_event_id=c.result_event_id
  AND w.result_receipt->>'outcome'='EXPIRED_OBSERVED_DENIED'
  AND w.result_receipt->>'capsuleDigest'=c.capsule_digest AND c.capsule_digest=e.capsule_digest
  AND w.result_receipt->>'originalReceiptDigest'=o.activation_receipt_digest
  AND w.result_receipt->>'denialDeliveryDigest'=d.delivery_digest
  AND w.result_receipt->>'denialAcknowledgementDigest'='sha256:'||encode(sha256(k.signed_acknowledgement),'hex')
  AND w.result_receipt_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(w.result_receipt),'UTF8')),'hex')
  AND event.event_type='runtime-target.activation-expired-denied.v1'
  AND event.payload_cbor=convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(w.result_receipt),'UTF8') AND event.payload_digest=sha256(event.payload_cbor)
  AND a.admission_digest=coalesce(h.admission_digest,e.admission_digest) AND a.binding->>'action'='Withdraw'
  AND c.denial_revision=a.revision AND c.delivery_digest=d.delivery_digest
  AND c.acknowledgement_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(k.signed_acknowledgement),'hex')
  AND d.delivery_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(d.signed_delivery),'hex')
  AND k.claims->>'installed_state'='NewUseDenied')
