CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_directory_group_mapping()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-IDENTITY-1002-DIRECTORY-GROUP-TOMBSTONE'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
  IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-'provider_version'-'provider_modified_at'-'source_digest'-'source_member_ids'-'observed_at'-'fresh_until'-'row_version'-'last_mutation_operation_id'-'updated_at') IS DISTINCT FROM
     (to_jsonb(OLD)-'provider_version'-'provider_modified_at'-'source_digest'-'source_member_ids'-'observed_at'-'fresh_until'-'row_version'-'last_mutation_operation_id'-'updated_at') OR
     NEW.row_version<>OLD.row_version+1 OR NEW.observed_at<OLD.observed_at OR NEW.provider_modified_at<OLD.provider_modified_at OR
     (NEW.provider_version=OLD.provider_version AND NEW.source_digest<>OLD.source_digest) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-IDENTITY-1002-DIRECTORY-GROUP-TRANSITION';
  END IF;
 ELSE
  IF NEW.row_version<>1 OR EXISTS (SELECT FROM control.authority_group_member WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND authority_group_id=NEW.authority_group_id AND state IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED'))
   OR EXISTS (SELECT FROM control.assignment WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND authority_group_id=NEW.authority_group_id AND state IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED')) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-IDENTITY-1002-DIRECTORY-GROUP-INITIAL-STATE';
  END IF;
 END IF;
 IF NEW.observed_at>clock_timestamp() OR NEW.provider_modified_at>clock_timestamp() OR
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT value) FROM unnest(NEW.source_member_ids) value)<>cardinality(NEW.source_member_ids) OR
  NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM control.directory_connector c JOIN control.authority_group g ON g.participant_id=c.participant_id
    WHERE c.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND c.connector_id=NEW.connector_id AND c.state='ACTIVE' AND c.profile_digest=NEW.profile_digest
      AND g.authority_group_id=NEW.authority_group_id AND g.state='ACTIVE'
      AND NEW.fresh_until=NEW.observed_at+make_interval(secs=>c.external_group_freshness_seconds)
      AND NEW.observed_at>=clock_timestamp()-make_interval(secs=>least(300,c.external_group_freshness_seconds))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-IDENTITY-1002-DIRECTORY-GROUP-SOURCE';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_directory_group_member()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM control.directory_group_mapping WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND authority_group_id=NEW.authority_group_id) AND
  NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM control.directory_group_mapping g JOIN control.directory_member m ON m.participant_id=g.participant_id AND m.connector_id=g.connector_id
   WHERE g.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND g.authority_group_id=NEW.authority_group_id AND m.principal_id=NEW.principal_id AND m.state='LINKED'
    AND m.external_id=ANY(g.source_member_ids) AND openpc.directory_group_permits(g.participant_id,g.authority_group_id)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-IDENTITY-1002-DIRECTORY-GROUP-MEMBER';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_discovery_approval_resume_completed()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE stored control.mutation_candidate;
BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_SCHEMA<>'control' OR TG_TABLE_NAME<>'mutation_candidate' OR TG_OP<>'INSERT'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 IF NEW.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE' AND NEW.resume_request->>'command'='RESUME' THEN
  SELECT * INTO STRICT stored FROM control.mutation_candidate WHERE mutation_candidate_id=NEW.mutation_candidate_id;
  IF (to_jsonb(stored)-ARRAY['state','updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','updated_at'])
   OR stored.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'APPROVAL_REQUESTED' OR stored.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.idempotency_record resume JOIN control.approval_request approval
    ON approval.participant_id=resume.participant_id AND approval.privacy_domain_id=resume.privacy_domain_id
     AND approval.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE' AND approval.subject_id=stored.mutation_candidate_id
    WHERE resume.participant_id=stored.participant_id AND resume.privacy_domain_id=stored.privacy_domain_id
     AND resume.operation_id=stored.resume_operation_id AND resume.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
     AND resume.expected_aggregate_version::text=stored.resume_request->>'expectedRevision'
     AND resume.principal_id=stored.maker_principal_id AND resume.action_intent_id='ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
     AND resume.catalog_operation_id='LEGACY' AND approval.state='OPEN' AND approval.row_version=1
     AND approval.subject_digest=stored.candidate_digest AND approval.subject_version=stored.expected_revision
     AND approval.action_intent_id=stored.action_intent_id AND approval.maker_principal_id=stored.maker_principal_id
     AND approval.checker_principal_id<>stored.maker_principal_id AND approval.expires_at=stored.expires_at
     AND resume.result_payload->>'resourceRef'='urn:openpc:resource:'||approval.approval_request_id::text)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
  PERFORM openpc.assert_discovery_approval_resume(stored);
 END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_discovery_approval_resume_target_claims()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE c control.platform_recovery_case; stored control.mutation_candidate;
BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_SCHEMA<>'control' OR TG_TABLE_NAME<>'mutation_candidate' OR TG_OP<>'INSERT'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 IF NEW.catalog_operation_id<>'ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE' OR NEW.resume_request->>'command' IS DISTINCT FROM 'RESUME' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF openpc.current_action_intent_id() IS DISTINCT FROM 'ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT stored FROM control.mutation_candidate WHERE mutation_candidate_id=NEW.mutation_candidate_id;
 IF (to_jsonb(stored)-ARRAY['state','updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','updated_at']) OR stored.state NOT IN ('PROPOSED','APPROVAL_REQUESTED') OR stored.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM control.platform_recovery_case
  WHERE recovery_id=(SELECT e.recovery_case_id FROM control.authority_envelope e WHERE e.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND e.authority_envelope_id=NEW.maker_authority_envelope_id AND e.principal_id=NEW.maker_principal_id AND e.representation='RECOVERY_V1') AND participant_id=NEW.participant_id
   AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND openpc.matches_participant(participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(privacy_domain_id)
   AND state='ACTIVE' AND valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND valid_until>clock_timestamp()
   AND intent->>'schema'='pc.identity.discovery-certificate-recovery-intent' AND intent->>'schemaVersion'='2';
 IF current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true) IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
  OR NEW.catalog_operation_id<>'ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE' OR NEW.action_intent_id<>'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
  OR NEW.resource_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM c.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorCredentialId}'
  OR NEW.candidate_document IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('replacedCredentialId',NEW.resource_id::text,
    'credentialId',c.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,successorCredentialId}',
    'publicKeySpkiDer',c.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,successorPublicKeySpkiDer}')
  OR NEW.expected_revision::text IS DISTINCT FROM c.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorRevision}'
  OR NEW.maker_principal_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM c.intent#>>'{administrators,0,principalId}'
  OR NEW.state NOT IN ('PROPOSED','APPROVAL_REQUESTED') OR NEW.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.predecessor_candidate_id IS NULL
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 PERFORM * FROM openpc.lock_discovery_certificate_recovery_source(c.enrollment_id,c.recovery_id);
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.discovery_certificate_issuance i WHERE i.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND (i.predecessor_credential_id::text=c.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorCredentialId}'
     OR i.successor_credential_id::text=c.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,successorCredentialId}'))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.discovery_certificate_issuer_attempt a JOIN control.discovery_certificate_issuance i
    ON i.participant_id=a.participant_id AND i.issuance_id=a.issuance_id WHERE i.participant_id=c.participant_id
     AND (i.predecessor_credential_id::text=c.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorCredentialId}'
      OR i.successor_credential_id::text=c.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,successorCredentialId}'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 -- A clock advance may have hidden all target rows through their RLS basis.
 -- Reauthenticate the SAME case/source after the scan before any success.
 PERFORM * FROM openpc.lock_discovery_certificate_recovery_source(c.enrollment_id,c.recovery_id);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_recovery_case fresh WHERE fresh.recovery_id=c.recovery_id
   AND fresh.participant_id=c.participant_id AND fresh.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND fresh.state='ACTIVE'
   AND fresh.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id AND fresh.enrollment_revision=c.enrollment_revision
   AND fresh.enrollment_digest=c.enrollment_digest AND fresh.intent=c.intent
   AND fresh.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND fresh.valid_until>clock_timestamp())
  OR NEW.expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_discovery_certificate_issuance()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE intent jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-DISCOVERY-ISSUANCE'; END IF;
 SELECT c.intent INTO intent FROM control.platform_recovery_case c WHERE c.recovery_id=NEW.recovery_id
  and c.participant_id=NEW.participant_id and c.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id;
 IF intent IS NULL or intent->>'schema'<>'pc.identity.discovery-certificate-recovery-intent'
  or NEW.request_digest<>sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(NEW.request),'UTF8'))
  or NEW.predecessor_credential_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorCredentialId}'
  or NEW.successor_credential_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,successorCredentialId}'
  or NEW.request IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('credentialId',NEW.successor_credential_id::text,
   'participantId',NEW.participant_id::text,'principalId',intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,workloadPrincipalId}',
   'workloadId','urn:openpc:workload:'||(intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,targetId}'),
   'publicKeySpkiDer',intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,successorPublicKeySpkiDer}')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-DISCOVERY-ISSUANCE'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
  IF NEW.state<>'PREPARED' or NEW.row_version<>1 or NOT EXISTS(select 1 from control.mutation_candidate candidate
    join control.approval_request approval on approval.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
     and approval.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id and approval.subject_id=candidate.mutation_candidate_id
     and approval.subject_digest=candidate.candidate_digest and approval.subject_version=candidate.expected_revision
     and approval.maker_principal_id=candidate.maker_principal_id and approval.state='APPROVED'
     and approval.expires_at>clock_timestamp() and approval.approval_request_id=NEW.approval_request_id
    join control.authority_envelope envelope on envelope.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
     and envelope.authority_envelope_id=candidate.maker_authority_envelope_id and envelope.recovery_case_id=NEW.recovery_id
     and envelope.representation='RECOVERY_V1' and openpc.platform_recovery_envelope_current(envelope.authority_envelope_id)
    where candidate.participant_id=NEW.participant_id and candidate.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
     and candidate.mutation_candidate_id=NEW.mutation_candidate_id and candidate.candidate_digest=NEW.candidate_digest
     and candidate.state='APPROVED' and candidate.expires_at>clock_timestamp()
     and candidate.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE'
     and candidate.resource_id=NEW.predecessor_credential_id
     and candidate.expected_revision=(intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorRevision}')::numeric
     and candidate.candidate_document=jsonb_build_object('replacedCredentialId',NEW.predecessor_credential_id::text,
       'credentialId',NEW.successor_credential_id::text,'publicKeySpkiDer',intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,successorPublicKeySpkiDer}'))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-DISCOVERY-ISSUANCE'; END IF;
 ELSE
  IF NEW.row_version<>OLD.row_version+1 or NEW.updated_at<=OLD.updated_at
   or (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','row_version','updated_at','certificate_der','certificate_fingerprint','failure_code','committed_operation_id'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','row_version','updated_at','certificate_der','certificate_fingerprint','failure_code','committed_operation_id'])
   or NOT ((OLD.state='PREPARED' and NEW.state IN ('ISSUING','REJECTED'))
     or (OLD.state='ISSUING' and NEW.state IN ('OBSERVED','AMBIGUOUS','REJECTED'))
     or (OLD.state='AMBIGUOUS' and NEW.state='ISSUING' and OLD.replay_profile='IMMUTABLE_REQUEST_RESPONSE')
     or (OLD.state='OBSERVED' and NEW.state='COMMITTED'))
   or (OLD.state='OBSERVED' and (NEW.certificate_der,NEW.certificate_fingerprint) IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.certificate_der,OLD.certificate_fingerprint))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-DISCOVERY-ISSUANCE'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF NEW.state='COMMITTED' and (NEW.committed_operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_operation_id()
  or NOT EXISTS(select 1 from control.credential successor join control.credential predecessor
    on predecessor.participant_id=successor.participant_id and predecessor.credential_id=NEW.predecessor_credential_id
   where successor.participant_id=NEW.participant_id and successor.credential_id=NEW.successor_credential_id
    and successor.rotated_from_credential_id=predecessor.credential_id and predecessor.state='REVOKED'
    and successor.state='ACTIVE' and successor.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' and successor.certificate_der=NEW.certificate_der
    and successor.secret_fingerprint=NEW.certificate_fingerprint)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-DISCOVERY-ISSUANCE'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_discovery_certificate_issuer_attempt()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE issuance control.discovery_certificate_issuance;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-DISCOVERY-ISSUER-ATTEMPT'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO issuance FROM control.discovery_certificate_issuance i WHERE i.issuance_id=NEW.issuance_id
  and i.participant_id=NEW.participant_id and i.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id FOR UPDATE;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-DISCOVERY-ISSUER-ATTEMPT'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
  IF NEW.state<>'ISSUING' or NEW.row_version<>1 or NEW.preparation_operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_operation_id()
   or NEW.sequence<>(select coalesce(max(a.sequence),0)+1 from control.discovery_certificate_issuer_attempt a
    where a.participant_id=NEW.participant_id and a.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id and a.issuance_id=NEW.issuance_id)
   or NEW.sequence>10 or EXISTS(select 1 from control.discovery_certificate_issuer_attempt a
    where a.participant_id=NEW.participant_id and a.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id and a.issuance_id=NEW.issuance_id and a.state='ISSUING')
   or NOT ((NEW.sequence=1 and issuance.state='PREPARED')
     or (NEW.sequence>1 and issuance.state='AMBIGUOUS' and issuance.replay_profile='IMMUTABLE_REQUEST_RESPONSE'
       and current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true)='1'))
   or NOT EXISTS(select 1 from control.mutation_candidate candidate
    join control.approval_request approval on approval.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
     and approval.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id and approval.subject_id=candidate.mutation_candidate_id
     and approval.subject_digest=candidate.candidate_digest and approval.subject_version=candidate.expected_revision
     and approval.maker_principal_id=candidate.maker_principal_id and approval.approval_request_id=issuance.approval_request_id
     and approval.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE' and approval.state='APPROVED' and approval.expires_at>clock_timestamp()
    join control.authority_envelope maker on maker.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
     and maker.authority_envelope_id=candidate.maker_authority_envelope_id and maker.representation='RECOVERY_V1'
     and maker.recovery_case_id=issuance.recovery_id and openpc.platform_recovery_envelope_current(maker.authority_envelope_id)
    join control.platform_recovery_case recovery on recovery.participant_id=maker.participant_id
     and recovery.recovery_id=maker.recovery_case_id and recovery.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id and recovery.state='ACTIVE'
    join control.session session on session.participant_id=candidate.participant_id and session.session_id=candidate.maker_session_id
     and session.principal_id=candidate.maker_principal_id and session.session_epoch=candidate.maker_session_epoch
     and session.authority_epoch=candidate.maker_principal_epoch and session.participant_epoch=candidate.maker_participant_epoch
     and session.context_mode='PLATFORM' and session.privacy_domain_id is null and session.state='ACTIVE'
     and session.idle_expires_at>clock_timestamp() and session.absolute_expires_at>clock_timestamp()
    join control.approval_decision_record decision on decision.participant_id=approval.participant_id
     and decision.approval_request_id=approval.approval_request_id and decision.decision='APPROVE'
     and decision.approver_principal_id<>candidate.maker_principal_id and decision.candidate_digest=candidate.candidate_digest
     and decision.aggregate_version=candidate.expected_revision and decision.evidence_cbor=NEW.authorization_evidence_cbor
     and decision.cose_sign1=NEW.authorization_cose
    join control.authority_envelope checker on checker.participant_id=decision.participant_id
     and checker.authority_envelope_id=decision.approver_authority_envelope_id and checker.representation='RECOVERY_V1'
     and checker.recovery_case_id=recovery.recovery_id and openpc.platform_recovery_envelope_current(checker.authority_envelope_id)
    join control.mfa_challenge challenge on challenge.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
     and challenge.principal_id=candidate.maker_principal_id and challenge.session_id=candidate.maker_session_id
     and challenge.action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1' and challenge.resource_digest=candidate.candidate_digest
     and (case when session.step_up_mfa_challenge_id is null
       then challenge.consumed_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '5 minutes'
       else session.step_up_mfa_challenge_id=challenge.mfa_challenge_id
         and openpc.session_step_up_valid_until(challenge.participant_id,challenge.session_id,challenge.principal_id)>clock_timestamp()
       end) and challenge.used_at is null
    join control.mutation_evidence verification on verification.participant_id=challenge.participant_id
     and verification.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id and verification.principal_id=candidate.maker_principal_id
     and verification.mfa_challenge_id=challenge.mfa_challenge_id and verification.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WEBAUTHN-VERIFY'
     and verification.aggregate_type='webauthn-verification' and verification.aggregate_id=challenge.session_id
     and verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=NEW.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
    join control.idempotency_record verified on verified.participant_id=verification.participant_id
     and verified.privacy_domain_id=verification.privacy_domain_id and verified.operation_id=verification.operation_id
     and verified.catalog_operation_id=verification.catalog_operation_id and verified.input_digest=verification.candidate_digest
     and verified.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest and verified.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
    join control.outbox_event event on event.participant_id=verification.participant_id and event.privacy_domain_id=verification.privacy_domain_id
     and event.aggregate_type=verification.aggregate_type and event.aggregate_id=verification.aggregate_id
     and event.event_type='openpc.identity.webauthn-verification.mutation.committed.v1'
     and event.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
     and event.payload_cbor=verification.evidence_cbor and event.payload_digest=verification.evidence_digest and event.cose_sign1=verification.cose_sign1
    where candidate.participant_id=issuance.participant_id and candidate.privacy_domain_id=issuance.privacy_domain_id
     and candidate.mutation_candidate_id=issuance.mutation_candidate_id and candidate.state='APPROVED' and candidate.expires_at>clock_timestamp()
     and candidate.candidate_digest=issuance.candidate_digest and candidate.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE'
     and candidate.idempotency_key=NEW.idempotency_key and candidate.maker_principal_id=NEW.maker_principal_id
     and candidate.maker_session_id=NEW.maker_session_id and NEW.started_at<=clock_timestamp() and NEW.deadline>clock_timestamp()
     and NEW.deadline<=least(recovery.valid_until,approval.expires_at,candidate.expires_at,challenge.expires_at,
       session.idle_expires_at,session.absolute_expires_at,
       case when session.step_up_mfa_challenge_id is null then challenge.consumed_at+interval '5 minutes'
         else coalesce(openpc.session_step_up_valid_until(challenge.participant_id,challenge.session_id,challenge.principal_id),'-infinity'::timestamptz) end)
     and (issuance.replay_profile<>'IMMUTABLE_REQUEST_RESPONSE' or (current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true)='1'
      and exists(select 1 from control.platform_recovery_enrollment enrollment where enrollment.enrollment_id=recovery.enrollment_id
       and enrollment.participant_id=recovery.participant_id and enrollment.document->>'assurance'='LOCAL_QA_VIRTUAL_AUTHENTICATOR'))))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-DISCOVERY-ISSUER-ATTEMPT'; END IF;
 ELSE
  IF OLD.state<>'ISSUING' or NEW.state NOT IN ('AMBIGUOUS','OBSERVED','REJECTED') or NEW.row_version<>OLD.row_version+1
   or (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','row_version','finished_at','certificate_fingerprint','failure_code']) IS DISTINCT FROM
     (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','row_version','finished_at','certificate_fingerprint','failure_code'])
   or (NEW.failure_code='CLAIM_EXPIRED' and OLD.deadline>clock_timestamp())
   or NEW.finished_at>clock_timestamp() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-DISCOVERY-ISSUER-ATTEMPT'; END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_discovery_certificate_recovery_case()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE source control.platform_recovery_enrollment;
BEGIN
 IF NEW.intent->>'schema'<>'pc.identity.discovery-certificate-recovery-intent' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 -- Historical closure preserves the immutable case and activation bytes under
 -- the shared guard. Completion retains its current administrator checks.
 SELECT * INTO source FROM control.platform_recovery_enrollment e WHERE e.enrollment_id=NEW.enrollment_id
  and e.participant_id=NEW.participant_id and e.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id;
 IF NOT FOUND or source.document->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'pc.identity.discovery-certificate-recovery-enrollment'
  or NEW.intent->>'schemaVersion' not in ('1','2')
  or (NEW.state NOT IN ('REVOKED','EXPIRED') and NEW.intent->>'schemaVersion'='2'
   and NOT openpc.discovery_certificate_resume_administrators_current(NEW.enrollment_id))
  or NEW.intent->'certificateRecovery' IS DISTINCT FROM source.document->'certificateRecovery'
  or NEW.intent-ARRAY['schema','schemaVersion','recoveryId','enrollmentId','enrollmentRevision','enrollmentDigest',
    'certificateRecovery','administrators','validFrom','validUntil','lifetimes']<>'{}'::jsonb
  or NOT (NEW.intent ?& ARRAY['certificateRecovery','administrators','lifetimes'])
  or NEW.planned_record_ids<>'[]'::jsonb THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-DISCOVERY-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 IF NEW.state IN ('DRAFT','REQUESTED','ACTIVE') and (NOT openpc.discovery_certificate_recovery_current(NEW.enrollment_id,null)
  or NOT openpc.discovery_certificate_recovery_administrators_current(NEW.enrollment_id,NEW.intent->'administrators',
   case when NEW.state='ACTIVE' then NEW.lease_bindings else null end)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-DISCOVERY-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 IF NEW.state='ACTIVE' and (jsonb_array_length(NEW.lease_bindings)<>2
  or (select count(distinct binding->>'principalId') from jsonb_array_elements(NEW.lease_bindings) binding)<>2
  or EXISTS(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(NEW.lease_bindings) binding where NOT
    openpc.discovery_certificate_recovery_binding_current(NEW.intent,NEW.privacy_domain_id,binding,NEW.activated_at,NEW.valid_until))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-DISCOVERY-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 IF NEW.state='COMPLETED' and (NEW.completion_operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_operation_id()
  or NOT EXISTS(select 1 from control.discovery_certificate_issuance issuance where issuance.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
   and issuance.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id and issuance.recovery_id=NEW.recovery_id and issuance.state='COMMITTED'
   and issuance.committed_operation_id=NEW.completion_operation_id
   and NEW.completion_result=jsonb_build_object('issuanceId',issuance.issuance_id::text,'operationId',issuance.committed_operation_id::text,
    'predecessorCredentialId',issuance.predecessor_credential_id::text,'successorCredentialId',issuance.successor_credential_id::text,
    'certificateFingerprint','sha256:'||encode(issuance.certificate_fingerprint,'hex')))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-DISCOVERY-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_discovery_preapproval_final()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.resume_request->>'command'='DISCOVERY_PREAPPROVAL_CONTINUE' THEN
  PERFORM openpc.assert_discovery_preapproval_continuation(NEW);
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_discovery_preapproval_target_claims()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE c control.platform_recovery_case; stored control.mutation_candidate;
BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_SCHEMA<>'control' OR TG_TABLE_NAME<>'mutation_candidate' OR TG_OP<>'INSERT'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 IF NEW.resume_request->>'command' IS DISTINCT FROM 'DISCOVERY_PREAPPROVAL_CONTINUE' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF openpc.current_action_intent_id() IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.action_intent_id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT stored FROM control.mutation_candidate WHERE mutation_candidate_id=NEW.mutation_candidate_id;
 IF to_jsonb(stored) IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM control.platform_recovery_case
  WHERE recovery_id::text=NEW.resume_request->>'recoveryId' AND participant_id=NEW.participant_id
   AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND openpc.matches_participant(participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(privacy_domain_id)
   AND state='ACTIVE' AND valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND valid_until>clock_timestamp()
   AND intent->>'schema'='pc.identity.discovery-certificate-recovery-intent';
 IF current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true) IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
  OR NEW.catalog_operation_id<>'ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE' OR NEW.action_intent_id<>'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
  OR NEW.resource_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM c.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorCredentialId}'
  OR NEW.candidate_document IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('replacedCredentialId',NEW.resource_id::text,
    'credentialId',c.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,successorCredentialId}',
    'publicKeySpkiDer',c.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,successorPublicKeySpkiDer}')
  OR NEW.expected_revision::text IS DISTINCT FROM c.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorRevision}'
  OR NEW.maker_principal_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM c.intent#>>'{administrators,0,principalId}'
  OR NEW.state<>'PROPOSED' OR NEW.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.predecessor_candidate_id IS NULL
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 PERFORM * FROM openpc.lock_discovery_certificate_recovery_source(c.enrollment_id,c.recovery_id);
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.discovery_certificate_issuance i WHERE i.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND (i.predecessor_credential_id::text=c.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorCredentialId}'
     OR i.successor_credential_id::text=c.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,successorCredentialId}'))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.discovery_certificate_issuer_attempt a JOIN control.discovery_certificate_issuance i
    ON i.participant_id=a.participant_id AND i.issuance_id=a.issuance_id WHERE i.participant_id=c.participant_id
     AND (i.predecessor_credential_id::text=c.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorCredentialId}'
      OR i.successor_credential_id::text=c.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,successorCredentialId}'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;
 -- A clock advance may have hidden all target rows through their RLS basis.
 -- Reauthenticate the SAME case/source after the scan before any success.
 PERFORM * FROM openpc.lock_discovery_certificate_recovery_source(c.enrollment_id,c.recovery_id);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_recovery_case fresh WHERE fresh.recovery_id=c.recovery_id
   AND fresh.participant_id=c.participant_id AND fresh.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND fresh.state='ACTIVE'
   AND fresh.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id AND fresh.enrollment_revision=c.enrollment_revision
   AND fresh.enrollment_digest=c.enrollment_digest AND fresh.intent=c.intent
   AND fresh.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND fresh.valid_until>clock_timestamp())
  OR NEW.expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-POLICY-2004'; END IF;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_evidence_export_producer_installation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE t jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF NOT pg_has_role(current_user,'openpc_control_owner','USAGE') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6020-EXPORT-PRODUCER-IMMUTABLE'; END IF;
 IF NEW.participant_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_participant_id()
   OR NEW.privacy_domain_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
   OR current_setting('openpc.action_intent_id')<>'ACT-EVIDENCE_EXPORT_RECORDS-V1'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 -- A direct UPDATE already has its row lock. Do not wait in reverse order.
 IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('evidence-export-producer:'||NEW.participant_id::text||':'||NEW.privacy_domain_id::text,0))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
   IF OLD.state<>'ACTIVE' OR NEW.state<>'REVOKED' OR to_jsonb(OLD)-'state' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW)-'state'
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6020-EXPORT-PRODUCER-IMMUTABLE'; END IF;
   RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 t:=NEW.trust;
 IF NEW.state<>'ACTIVE' OR jsonb_typeof(t) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
   OR t - ARRAY['schema','schemaDefinitionDigest','owner','purpose','environmentId','participantId','privacyDomainId','sourceId','principalId','workloadCredentialId','workloadEpoch','workloadId','secretClass','secretReference','secretVersion','publicKeySpkiHex','keyEpoch','validFromNs','validUntilNs','installationReference','signerKeyId'] IS DISTINCT FROM '{}'::jsonb
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(t))<>21
   OR t->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'pc.evidence-export.producer-trust.v1'
   OR t->>'schemaDefinitionDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:ee72df3cca5024c26c52c5983b15087426b4faabeb511cace227b92a04d2eb8f'
   OR t->>'owner' IS DISTINCT FROM 'LS-EVIDENCE-EXPORT'
   OR t->>'purpose' IS DISTINCT FROM 'pc.cose.evidence-export-completion-receipt.v1'
   OR t->>'secretClass' IS DISTINCT FROM 'SECRET-SIGNING-KEY'
   OR t->>'participantId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.participant_id::text
   OR t->>'privacyDomainId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.privacy_domain_id::text
   OR t->>'sourceId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.source_id::text
   OR t->>'principalId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.principal_id::text
   OR t->>'workloadCredentialId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.workload_credential_id::text
   OR t->>'workloadEpoch' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.workload_epoch::text
   OR t->>'environmentId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.environment_id
   OR t->>'signerKeyId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.signer_id
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(t) e WHERE jsonb_typeof(e.value)<>'string' OR e.value#>>'{}'<>btrim(e.value#>>'{}'))
   OR NOT coalesce(t->>'environmentId' ~ '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9:._-]{0,159}$',false)
   OR NOT coalesce(t->>'secretReference' ~ '^secret://[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,31}/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]{1,192}#[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,96}$',false)
   OR split_part(t->>'secretReference','#',2) IS DISTINCT FROM t->>'secretVersion'
   OR lower(t->>'secretVersion') IN ('latest','current')
   OR length(t->>'workloadId') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 160 OR length(t->>'installationReference') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 256
   OR NEW.trust_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(t),'UTF8')
   OR NEW.signer_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(decode(t->>'publicKeySpkiHex','hex')),'hex')
   OR NOT coalesce(t->>'publicKeySpkiHex' ~ '^3059301306072a8648ce3d020106082a8648ce3d03010703420004[0-9a-f]{128}$',false)
   OR NOT coalesce(t->>'keyEpoch' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$',false)
   OR NOT coalesce(t->>'validFromNs' ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$',false)
   OR NOT coalesce(t->>'validUntilNs' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$',false)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-EXPORT-PRODUCER-TRUST'; END IF;
 IF (t->>'keyEpoch')::numeric>18446744073709551615 OR (t->>'validUntilNs')::numeric>18446744073709551615
   OR (t->>'validFromNs')::numeric>=(t->>'validUntilNs')::numeric
   OR mod((t->>'validFromNs')::numeric,1000)<>0 OR mod((t->>'validUntilNs')::numeric,1000)<>0
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.credential c WHERE c.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
      AND c.credential_id=NEW.workload_credential_id AND c.principal_id=NEW.principal_id
      AND c.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND c.audience=t->>'workloadId'
      AND c.credential_epoch=NEW.workload_epoch
      AND c.public_key_digest<>decode(substr(NEW.signer_id,8),'hex'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-EXPORT-PRODUCER-IDENTITY'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_evidence_kms_attempt()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE installed control.evidence_kms_installation; r jsonb; o jsonb; authority jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF NOT pg_has_role(current_user,'openpc_control_runtime','USAGE')
 OR current_setting('openpc.action_intent_id')<>'ACT-POLICY_READ_EFFECTIVE_ACCESS-V1'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6020-EVIDENCE-KMS-IMMUTABLE'; END IF;
 IF NEW.participant_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_participant_id()
 OR NEW.privacy_domain_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installed FROM control.evidence_kms_installation
 WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
 AND installation_digest=NEW.installation_digest;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock_shared(hashtextextended('evidence-kms-installation:'||NEW.participant_id::text||':'||
 NEW.privacy_domain_id::text||':'||installed.installation_id::text,0));
 SELECT * INTO STRICT installed FROM control.evidence_kms_installation
 WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
 AND installation_digest=NEW.installation_digest;
 -- Current Identity authority is necessary; it does not authenticate a peer or
 -- replace the application owner using its actual TLS socket.
 authority:=openpc.evidence_export_producer_authority(installed.producer_trust_digest);
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
  IF NEW.state IN ('PROVED','REJECTED') THEN
   IF OLD.state NOT IN ('DISPATCHED','UNKNOWN') OR
     to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','result_receipt_bytes','result_receipt_digest'] IS DISTINCT FROM
     to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','result_receipt_bytes','result_receipt_digest'] OR
     NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.evidence_kms_exchange e WHERE e.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
       AND e.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND e.attempt_id=NEW.attempt_id AND e.state='PROVED'
       AND e.kind IN ('PREPARE','READ_ATTEMPT') AND e.receipt_bytes=NEW.result_receipt_bytes
       AND e.receipt_digest=NEW.result_receipt_digest
       AND openpc.evidence_kms_stored_outcome(e.receipt_bytes)=CASE WHEN NEW.state='PROVED' THEN '1' ELSE '2' END)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-EVIDENCE-KMS-RESULT-BINDING'; END IF;
   IF NEW.state='PROVED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.evidence_wrapped_key k
     WHERE k.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND k.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND k.attempt_id=NEW.attempt_id)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-EVIDENCE-KMS-RECORD-MISSING'; END IF;
   RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF to_jsonb(OLD)-'state' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW)-'state'
    OR NOT ((OLD.state='PREPARED' AND NEW.state='DISPATCHED')
      OR (OLD.state IN ('DISPATCHED','UNKNOWN') AND NEW.state='UNKNOWN'))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-EVIDENCE-KMS-TRANSITION'; END IF;
  IF NEW.state='UNKNOWN' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 ELSE
  IF NEW.state<>'PREPARED' OR NEW.result_receipt_bytes IS NOT NULL OR NEW.result_receipt_digest IS NOT NULL
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-EVIDENCE-KMS-PREPARE'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF installed.state<>'ACTIVE' OR NOT installed.pins->'permissions' ? 'ENCRYPT'
 OR floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000)<(installed.pins->>'validFromMs')::numeric
 OR floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000)>=(installed.pins->>'validUntilMs')::numeric
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OPS_SECRET_REVOKED'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF NEW.authority_digest IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(authority),'UTF8')),'hex')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-EVIDENCE-KMS-AUTHORITY'; END IF;
 r:=NEW.request; o:=r->'objectIntent';
 IF jsonb_typeof(r) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR r-ARRAY['operation','recipient','attemptId','objectIntent','challenge'] IS DISTINCT FROM '{}'::jsonb
 OR NOT r ?& ARRAY['operation','recipient','attemptId','objectIntent','challenge']
 OR r->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'PREPARE'
 OR r->'recipient' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('participantId',NEW.participant_id::text,
   'privacyDomainId',NEW.privacy_domain_id::text,'installationDigest',NEW.installation_digest,
   'producerTrustDigest',installed.producer_trust_digest)
 OR r->>'attemptId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.attempt_id::text
 OR NOT coalesce(r->>'challenge' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$',false)
 OR jsonb_typeof(o) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR o-ARRAY['environmentId','participantId','privacyDomainId','payloadObjectId','objectVersion',
   'notificationOccurrenceRef','routingProfileDigest','templateDigest','recipientSetDigest',
   'redactionProfileDigest','preferenceGeneration','payloadDigest'] IS DISTINCT FROM '{}'::jsonb
 OR NOT o ?& ARRAY['environmentId','participantId','privacyDomainId','payloadObjectId','objectVersion',
   'notificationOccurrenceRef','routingProfileDigest','templateDigest','recipientSetDigest',
   'redactionProfileDigest','preferenceGeneration','payloadDigest']
 OR o->>'environmentId' IS DISTINCT FROM installed.pins->>'environmentId'
 OR o->>'participantId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.participant_id::text
 OR o->>'privacyDomainId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.privacy_domain_id::text
 OR o->>'payloadObjectId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.object_id::text
 OR o->>'objectVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.object_version
 OR NEW.object_intent_digest IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(o),'UTF8')),'hex')
 OR NEW.request_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(r),'UTF8')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-EVIDENCE-KMS-REQUEST'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
EXCEPTION WHEN no_data_found OR too_many_rows THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005';
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_evidence_kms_installation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE p jsonb; allowed text[]; item text;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF NOT pg_has_role(current_user,'openpc_control_owner','USAGE')
 OR current_setting('openpc.action_intent_id')<>'ACT-EVIDENCE_EXPORT_RECORDS-V1'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6020-EVIDENCE-KMS-IMMUTABLE'; END IF;
 IF NEW.participant_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_participant_id()
 OR NEW.privacy_domain_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('evidence-kms-installation:'||NEW.participant_id::text||':'||
 NEW.privacy_domain_id::text||':'||NEW.installation_id::text,0)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
   IF OLD.state<>'ACTIVE' OR NEW.state<>'REVOKED'
   OR to_jsonb(OLD)-'state' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW)-'state'
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6020-EVIDENCE-KMS-IMMUTABLE'; END IF;
   RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 p:=NEW.pins;
 allowed:=ARRAY['owner','secretClass','environmentId','participantId','privacyDomainId','installationId',
 'producerTrustDigest','reference','version','keyEpoch','providerId','providerOrigin','providerTlsSpkiDigest',
 'profileIssuerSpkiHex','providerReceiptSpkiHex','recoveryAuthoritySpkiHex','providerKeyId','providerKeyVersion','wrapProfileDigest',
 'policyDigest','recoveryProfileDigest','profileDigest','permissions','validFromMs','validUntilMs'];
 IF NEW.state<>'ACTIVE' OR jsonb_typeof(p) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
 OR p-allowed IS DISTINCT FROM '{}'::jsonb OR NOT p ?& allowed
 OR p->>'owner' IS DISTINCT FROM 'LS-EVIDENCE-EXPORT'
 OR p->>'secretClass' IS DISTINCT FROM 'SECRET-EVIDENCE-VAULT'
 OR p->>'participantId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.participant_id::text
 OR p->>'privacyDomainId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.privacy_domain_id::text
 OR p->>'installationId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.installation_id::text
 OR p->>'producerTrustDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.producer_trust_digest
 OR NEW.pins_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(p),'UTF8')
 OR NEW.installation_digest IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(NEW.pins_bytes),'hex')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(p-ARRAY['permissions','validFromMs','validUntilMs']) e
   WHERE jsonb_typeof(e.value)<>'string' OR e.value#>>'{}'<>btrim(e.value#>>'{}')
   OR e.value#>>'{}' ~ '[[:cntrl:]]')
 OR NOT coalesce(p->>'reference' ~ '^secret://[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,31}/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]{1,192}#[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,96}$',false)
 OR split_part(p->>'reference','#',2) IS DISTINCT FROM p->>'version'
 OR split_part(p->>'reference','/',3) IS DISTINCT FROM p->>'providerId'
 OR p->>'reference' ~ '/(\.|\.\.)/' OR p->>'reference' ~ '/(\.|\.\.)#'
 OR p->>'reference' ~ '^secret://[^/]+//|^secret://[^/]+/[^#]*//'
 OR lower(p->>'version') IN ('latest','current')
 OR lower(p->>'providerKeyVersion') IN ('latest','current')
 OR NOT coalesce(p->>'providerOrigin' ~ '^https://[a-z0-9.-]+(:[1-9][0-9]{0,4})?$',false)
 OR NOT coalesce(p->>'environmentId' ~ '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9:._-]{0,159}$',false)
 OR length(p->>'providerKeyId') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 256
 OR length(p->>'providerKeyVersion') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 96
 OR length(p->>'providerOrigin') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 512
 OR jsonb_typeof(p->'permissions') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR NOT coalesce(p->'permissions' IN ('["ENCRYPT"]'::jsonb,'["DECRYPT"]'::jsonb,'["DECRYPT","ENCRYPT"]'::jsonb),false)
 OR NOT coalesce(p->>'keyEpoch' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$',false)
 OR jsonb_typeof(p->'validFromMs') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
 OR jsonb_typeof(p->'validUntilMs') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
 OR NOT coalesce(p->>'validFromMs' ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,15})$',false)
 OR NOT coalesce(p->>'validUntilMs' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,15}$',false)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-EVIDENCE-KMS-INSTALLATION'; END IF;
 FOREACH item IN ARRAY ARRAY['producerTrustDigest','providerTlsSpkiDigest','wrapProfileDigest','policyDigest','recoveryProfileDigest','profileDigest'] LOOP
  IF NOT coalesce(p->>item ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$',false) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-EVIDENCE-KMS-DIGEST'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 FOREACH item IN ARRAY ARRAY['profileIssuerSpkiHex','providerReceiptSpkiHex','recoveryAuthoritySpkiHex'] LOOP
  IF NOT coalesce(p->>item ~ '^3059301306072a8648ce3d020106082a8648ce3d03010703420004[0-9a-f]{128}$',false)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-EVIDENCE-KMS-TRUST'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF p->>'profileIssuerSpkiHex' IN (p->>'providerReceiptSpkiHex',p->>'recoveryAuthoritySpkiHex')
 OR p->>'providerReceiptSpkiHex'=p->>'recoveryAuthoritySpkiHex'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-EVIDENCE-KMS-ROLE-SEPARATION'; END IF;
 IF (p->>'keyEpoch')::numeric>18446744073709551615
 OR (p->>'validUntilMs')::numeric>9007199254740991
 OR (p->>'validFromMs')::numeric>=(p->>'validUntilMs')::numeric
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.evidence_export_producer_installation e
   WHERE e.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND e.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
   AND e.trust_digest=NEW.producer_trust_digest AND e.state='ACTIVE'
   AND e.environment_id=p->>'environmentId')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-EVIDENCE-KMS-PRODUCER'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_fact_admission_inbox()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE e jsonb:=NEW.envelope; d jsonb:=e->'data'; p jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6020-IMMUTABLE-ROW'; END IF;
 IF current_setting('openpc.action_intent_id')<>'ACT-EVIDENCE_EXPORT_RECORDS-V1'
  OR NEW.participant_id<>openpc.current_participant_id() OR NEW.privacy_domain_id<>openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 SELECT f.projection INTO p FROM control.evidence_fact_provenance f
  JOIN control.evidence_catalogue c USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,stream_id,record_id)
  JOIN control.evidence_segment_payload b USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,stream_id,segment_id)
  WHERE f.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND f.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
   AND f.stream_id=NEW.stream_id AND f.record_id=NEW.record_id
   AND c.source_format='OPENPC_CANONICAL_FACT_V1' AND c.receipt_digest=NEW.source_receipt_digest;
 IF p IS NULL THEN
  p:=nullif(current_setting('openpc.fact_delivery_source_projection',true),'')::jsonb;
  IF p IS NULL OR octet_length(p::text)>4096 OR NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM control.evidence_projection_retirement r
    JOIN control.deletion_job j USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,deletion_job_id)
    JOIN control.evidence_catalogue c ON c.participant_id=r.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id
      AND c.stream_id=r.stream_id AND c.record_id=r.record_id AND c.segment_id=r.segment_id
    JOIN control.evidence_segment_payload b ON b.participant_id=c.participant_id AND b.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
      AND b.stream_id=c.stream_id AND b.segment_id=c.segment_id
   WHERE r.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
    AND r.stream_id=NEW.stream_id AND r.record_id=NEW.record_id
    AND r.data_class='NORMALIZED_JSON_PROJECTION' AND j.state='SUCCEEDED'
    AND j.selection->>'sourceKind'='FACT_PROVENANCE'
    AND r.retirement_digest=openpc.projection_retirement_digest(r)
    AND r.projection_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(p),'UTF8')),'hex')
    AND r.source_receipt_digest=NEW.source_receipt_digest
    AND r.preservation_metadata=jsonb_build_object('factLineage',p->'lineage')
    AND c.source_format='OPENPC_CANONICAL_FACT_V1' AND c.receipt_digest=NEW.source_receipt_digest
    AND c.sequence::text=p->>'sourceSequence' AND c.occurred_at=(p->>'admittedAt')::timestamptz
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-FACT-INBOX-CUSTODY-BINDING'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF p->>'candidateId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.candidate_id::text
  OR p->>'receiptDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.source_receipt_digest
  OR p->'lineage'->>'factId' IS DISTINCT FROM 'urn:openpc:fact:'||NEW.event_id::text
  OR p->'lineage'->>'factType' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.fact_type
  OR e IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(
   'specversion','1.0','id',NEW.event_id::text,'source','urn:openpc:service:LS-FACT-BRIDGE',
   'type','io.openpc.fact.candidate.admitted.v1','subject','urn:openpc:resource:'||NEW.candidate_id::text,
   'time',e->>'time','datacontenttype','application/json',
   'dataschema','https://schemas.openpc.local/event-payloads.schema.json#/$defs/FactCandidateAdmitted',
   'participantid','urn:openpc:participant:'||NEW.participant_id::text,
   'privacydomainid','urn:openpc:privacy-domain:'||NEW.privacy_domain_id::text,
   'correlationid',NEW.candidate_id::text,'authoritygeneration',e->>'authoritygeneration',
   'sequence',NEW.sequence::text,'datadigest','sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(d),'UTF8')),'hex'),
   'data',d)
  OR d IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('candidateId','urn:openpc:resource:'||NEW.candidate_id::text,
   'factArtifactId','urn:openpc:resource:'||NEW.candidate_id::text,'artifactDigest',d->>'artifactDigest',
   'sourceProfileDigest',d->>'sourceProfileDigest','sourceNeutral',true)
  OR coalesce(d->>'artifactDigest','')!~'^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR coalesce(d->>'sourceProfileDigest','')!~'^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR coalesce(e->>'authoritygeneration','')!~'^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR coalesce(e->>'time','')!~'^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{6}Z$'
  OR NEW.envelope_digest<>'sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(e),'UTF8')),'hex')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-FACT-INBOX-CUSTODY-BINDING'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_fact_consumer_profile()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE c jsonb; expected jsonb; previous control.fact_consumer_profile; issuer text;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR NOT (current_user='openpc_control_owner' OR pg_has_role(current_user,'openpc_control_key_governor','USAGE'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('fact-consumer-profile:'||NEW.participant_id::text||':'||NEW.privacy_domain_id::text||':'||NEW.consumer_id,0));
 SELECT * INTO previous FROM control.fact_consumer_profile WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND consumer_id=NEW.consumer_id ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 1;
 IF NEW.revision<>coalesce(previous.revision,0)+1 OR (previous.revision IS NOT NULL AND
   (NEW.profile_id IS DISTINCT FROM previous.profile_id OR NEW.claims->>'environmentId' IS DISTINCT FROM previous.claims->>'environmentId'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 c:=NEW.claims; issuer:='sha256:'||encode(sha256(NEW.issuer_spki),'hex');
 expected:=jsonb_build_object('environmentId',c->'environmentId','participantId',NEW.participant_id::text,
  'privacyDomainId',NEW.privacy_domain_id::text,'profileId',NEW.profile_id,'revision',NEW.revision::text,
  'consumerId',NEW.consumer_id,'subscriptionId',CASE NEW.consumer_id WHEN 'LS-CONTROL-WORK' THEN 'SUB-FACTCANDIDATEADMITTED-CONTROL_WORK-V1' WHEN 'LS-FLEET-CONTROL' THEN 'SUB-FACTCANDIDATEADMITTED-FLEET_CONTROL-V1' END,
  'validFromMs',c->'validFromMs','validUntilMs',c->'validUntilMs','issuerKeyId',issuer,
  'workloadCredentialId',NEW.workload_credential_id::text,'workloadCredentialEpoch',NEW.workload_credential_epoch::text,
  'databaseRole',NEW.database_role,'maximumAttempts',c->'maximumAttempts','initialBackoffMs',c->'initialBackoffMs','maximumBackoffMs',c->'maximumBackoffMs');
 IF c IS DISTINCT FROM expected OR jsonb_typeof(c->'environmentId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
  OR coalesce(c->>'environmentId','')!~'^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9:._-]{0,159}$'
  OR NEW.profile_id!~'^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9:._-]{0,159}$'
  OR NOT (NEW.database_role~'^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$' OR (
    NEW.participant_id::text~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    AND NEW.privacy_domain_id::text~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    AND NEW.database_role='openpc_rs_login_'||translate(rtrim(encode(sha256(convert_to(
      '["openpc:runtime-source-scope:v1","'||NEW.participant_id::text||'","'||NEW.privacy_domain_id::text||'"]',
      'UTF8')),'base64'),'='),'+/','-_')))
  OR encode(NEW.issuer_spki,'hex')!~'^3059301306072a8648ce3d020106082a8648ce3d03010703420004[0-9a-f]{128}$'
  OR substring(NEW.workload_credential_id::text from 15 for 1)<>'7'
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(c) e WHERE e.key IN ('validFromMs','validUntilMs','maximumAttempts','initialBackoffMs','maximumBackoffMs')
    AND (jsonb_typeof(e.value)<>'number' OR (e.value#>>'{}')!~'^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$'))
  OR (c->>'validFromMs')::numeric<0 OR (c->>'validUntilMs')::numeric>9007199254740991
  OR (c->>'validUntilMs')::numeric<=(c->>'validFromMs')::numeric
  OR (c->>'maximumAttempts')::numeric NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
  OR (c->>'initialBackoffMs')::numeric NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 3600000
  OR (c->>'maximumBackoffMs')::numeric NOT BETWEEN (c->>'initialBackoffMs')::numeric AND 3600000
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 expected:=jsonb_build_object('0',openpc.business_bytes(decode('60c93313ff9d2ead84868b1af9d8d2b469b97f3b4eabbed3d6df6a5f4bd5395d','hex')),
  '1',c->'environmentId','2',openpc.business_uuid(NEW.participant_id),'3',openpc.business_uuid(NEW.privacy_domain_id),
  '4',NEW.profile_id,'5',NEW.revision,'6',NEW.consumer_id,'7',c->'subscriptionId',
  '8',(c->>'validFromMs')::numeric,'9',(c->>'validUntilMs')::numeric,'10',openpc.business_bytes(sha256(NEW.issuer_spki)),
  '11',openpc.business_uuid(NEW.workload_credential_id),'12',NEW.workload_credential_epoch,
  '13',NEW.database_role,'14',(c->>'maximumAttempts')::numeric,'15',(c->>'initialBackoffMs')::numeric,'16',(c->>'maximumBackoffMs')::numeric);
 IF openpc.business_cbor(NEW.payload) IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 PERFORM openpc.archive_cose_binding(NEW.payload,NEW.cose,issuer,24006,343);
 PERFORM 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname=NEW.database_role AND rolcanlogin AND NOT rolsuper AND NOT rolbypassrls
  AND pg_has_role(rolname,'openpc_control_worker','USAGE');
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 NEW.admitted_at:=clock_timestamp(); RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_fact_failure_signer()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT (current_user='openpc_control_owner' OR pg_has_role(current_user,'openpc_control_key_governor','USAGE'))
  OR TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
  IF OLD.state<>'ACTIVE' OR NEW.state<>'REVOKED'
   OR to_jsonb(NEW)-'state' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(OLD)-'state'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 ELSE
  IF NEW.state<>'ACTIVE' OR NOT (NEW.database_role~'^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$' OR (
    NEW.participant_id::text~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    AND NEW.privacy_domain_id::text~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    AND NEW.database_role='openpc_rs_login_'||translate(rtrim(encode(sha256(convert_to(
      '["openpc:runtime-source-scope:v1","'||NEW.participant_id::text||'","'||NEW.privacy_domain_id::text||'"]',
      'UTF8')),'base64'),'='),'+/','-_')))
   OR NEW.environment_id!~'^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9:._-]{0,159}$'
   OR substring(NEW.workload_credential_id::text from 15 for 1)<>'7'
   OR encode(NEW.public_key_spki,'hex')!~'^3059301306072a8648ce3d020106082a8648ce3d03010703420004[0-9a-f]{128}$'
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname=NEW.database_role AND r.rolcanlogin
     AND NOT r.rolsuper AND NOT r.rolbypassrls AND NOT r.rolcreaterole
     AND pg_has_role(r.rolname,'openpc_control_worker','USAGE')
     AND NOT pg_has_role(r.rolname,'openpc_control_owner','MEMBER')
     AND NOT pg_has_role(r.rolname,'openpc_control_key_governor','MEMBER'))
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.credential c JOIN control.principal w USING(participant_id,principal_id)
     WHERE c.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND c.credential_id=NEW.workload_credential_id
      AND c.credential_epoch=NEW.workload_credential_epoch AND c.kind IN ('WORKLOAD_MTLS','WORKLOAD_OIDC')
      AND c.state='ACTIVE' AND w.state='ACTIVE' AND w.kind='WORKLOAD'
      AND c.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND (c.valid_until IS NULL OR c.valid_until>clock_timestamp())
      AND c.public_key_digest IS DISTINCT FROM sha256(NEW.public_key_spki))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.fact_consumer_profile p WHERE p.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
     AND p.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND p.issuer_spki=NEW.public_key_spki)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_fleet_delivery_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='fleet_fact_delivery_attempt' THEN
   IF OLD.outcome<>'ACTIVE' OR NEW.outcome='ACTIVE'
    OR to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['outcome','ended_at_ms','problem'] IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['outcome','ended_at_ms','problem']
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['failed_attempts','lease_generation','state','lease_id','lease_until_ms','next_attempt_ms','last_problem','maximum_attempts']
    IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['failed_attempts','lease_generation','state','lease_id','lease_until_ms','next_attempt_ms','last_problem','maximum_attempts']
    OR NEW.maximum_attempts>OLD.maximum_attempts
    OR NEW.failed_attempts NOT BETWEEN OLD.failed_attempts AND OLD.failed_attempts+1
    OR NEW.lease_generation NOT BETWEEN OLD.lease_generation AND OLD.lease_generation+1
    OR OLD.state IN ('QUARANTINED','COMMITTED')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_governed_initial_enrollment()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'openpc', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE selected record;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND NEW.governed_initial_profile_digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.governed_initial_profile_digest THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'IDENTITY-1004-INITIAL-PROFILE-SUBSTITUTION'; END IF;
 IF NEW.governed_initial_profile_digest IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true) IS DISTINCT FROM '1' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'IDENTITY-1002-INITIAL-QA-ONLY'; END IF;
 SELECT profile.profile_digest INTO selected FROM control.governed_initial_enrollment_profile profile
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(profile.document->'accounts') account
 JOIN control.session session ON session.participant_id=profile.participant_id
  AND session.session_id=NEW.session_id AND session.principal_id=NEW.principal_id
 WHERE profile.profile_digest=NEW.governed_initial_profile_digest AND profile.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
  AND account->>'principalId'=NEW.principal_id::text AND profile.document->>'origin'=NEW.origin
  AND NEW.replaced_credential_id IS NULL
  AND session.context_mode='PLATFORM' AND session.state='ACTIVE'
  AND (TG_OP='UPDATE' OR (profile.state='ACTIVE' AND profile.valid_from<=clock_timestamp()
    AND profile.valid_until>clock_timestamp() AND session.step_up_verified_at IS NULL
    AND NEW.expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND NEW.expires_at<=NEW.created_at+interval '5 minutes'));
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'IDENTITY-1002-INITIAL-PROFILE-SOURCE'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND (OLD.state<>'ACTIVE' OR NEW.state<>'REVOKED'

  RAISE EXCEPTION 'IDENTITY-1004-INITIAL-PROFILE-IMMUTABLE'; END IF;
