CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_identity_envelope_activation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE p control.identity_envelope_proposal%ROWTYPE; c control.mutation_candidate%ROWTYPE;
 a control.approval_request%ROWTYPE; d control.approval_decision_record%ROWTYPE;
 i control.idempotency_record%ROWTYPE; k control.business_signing_key%ROWTYPE;
 payload jsonb; proposal jsonb; maker jsonb; checker jsonb; expected jsonb;
 submission_digest bytea; outer_cose jsonb; header jsonb; source_envelope uuid; now_ns numeric;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATION-HISTORY'; END IF;
 IF NEW.participant_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_participant_id()
  OR NEW.privacy_domain_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
  OR NEW.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_operation_id()
  OR openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-PARTICIPANT_ACTIVATE_CONTEXT-V1'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATION-CONTEXT'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
  IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-'state'-'observation'-'cose_sign1'-'dispatched_at'-'observed_at'-'committed_at'-'row_version')
   IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'state'-'observation'-'cose_sign1'-'dispatched_at'-'observed_at'-'committed_at'-'row_version')
   OR NEW.row_version<>OLD.row_version+1
   OR NOT ((OLD.state='PREPARED' AND NEW.state='DISPATCHED')
    OR (OLD.state='DISPATCHED' AND NEW.state='OBSERVED')
    OR (OLD.state='OBSERVED' AND NEW.state='COMMITTED'))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATION-PHASE'; END IF;
  IF OLD.state='DISPATCHED' AND NEW.dispatched_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.dispatched_at
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATION-DISPATCH'; END IF;
 ELSE
  IF NEW.state<>'PREPARED' OR NEW.row_version<>1
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATION-INITIAL'; END IF;
 END IF;
 payload:=openpc.business_cbor(NEW.payload_cbor);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT p FROM control.identity_envelope_proposal WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND envelope_id=NEW.envelope_id;
 proposal:=openpc.business_cbor(p.proposal_cbor);
 IF p.state<>'APPROVED' OR p.row_version<>3 OR p.target_participant_id<>NEW.participant_id
  OR p.proposal_digest<>NEW.proposal_digest OR proposal->>'7'<>'1'
  OR payload->'0' IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.business_bytes(decode('6cf5c91789d9488014d3ec9445d5852c4aa686534305c6516d67210176ea3cc5','hex'))
  OR payload->'1' IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.business_bytes(p.proposal_cbor)
  OR payload->'2' IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.business_bytes(p.proposal_digest)
  OR payload->>'6' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.reserved_at_ns::text
  OR NEW.reserved_at_ns>floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATION-PROPOSAL'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT i FROM control.idempotency_record WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND principal_id=NEW.principal_id
  AND action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANT_ACTIVATE_CONTEXT-V1' AND catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATE'
  AND idempotency_key=NEW.idempotency_key AND idempotency_record_id=NEW.idempotency_record_id
  AND operation_id=NEW.operation_id AND input_digest=NEW.candidate_digest AND expected_aggregate_version=3
  AND terminal_state IS NULL;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM control.mutation_candidate WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND mutation_candidate_id=NEW.candidate_id
  AND resource_id=NEW.envelope_id AND expected_revision=3 AND (NEW.state='OBSERVED' OR state='APPROVED')
  AND maker_principal_id=NEW.principal_id AND candidate_digest=NEW.candidate_digest
  AND action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANT_ACTIVATE_CONTEXT-V1' AND catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATE'
  AND candidate_document=jsonb_build_object('envelopeId',NEW.envelope_id::text);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM control.approval_request WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND approval_request_id=NEW.approval_request_id
  AND (NEW.state='OBSERVED' OR state='APPROVED') AND subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE' AND subject_id=c.mutation_candidate_id
  AND subject_digest=c.candidate_digest AND subject_version=3 AND maker_principal_id=NEW.principal_id
  AND action_intent_id=c.action_intent_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM control.approval_decision_record WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND approval_request_id=a.approval_request_id
  AND decision='APPROVE' AND candidate_digest=c.candidate_digest AND aggregate_version=3
  AND approver_principal_id<>NEW.principal_id;
 SELECT decision.decision_digest INTO STRICT submission_digest FROM control.approval_decision_record decision
  JOIN control.approval_request approved ON approved.participant_id=decision.participant_id
   AND approved.privacy_domain_id=decision.privacy_domain_id AND approved.approval_request_id=decision.approval_request_id
   AND approved.subject_type='AUTHORITY_ENVELOPE' AND approved.subject_id=p.envelope_id
   AND approved.subject_digest=p.proposal_digest AND approved.subject_version=1 AND approved.state='APPROVED'
  WHERE decision.participant_id=p.participant_id AND decision.privacy_domain_id=p.privacy_domain_id
   AND decision.approval_request_id=p.submission_approval_id AND decision.decision='APPROVE'
   AND decision.candidate_digest=p.proposal_digest AND decision.aggregate_version=1
   AND decision.approver_principal_id::text=p.submission_checker#>>'{authority,principalId}';
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('authority',NEW.maker_authority->'binding','stepUpChallengeId',challenge.mfa_challenge_id::text,
   'stepUpEvidenceDigest','sha256:'||encode(verification.evidence_digest,'hex'),
   'signerCredentialId',verification.signer_credential_id::text,'signerCredentialEpoch',challenge.signer_credential_epoch::text)
 INTO STRICT maker FROM control.mfa_challenge challenge JOIN control.mutation_evidence verification
  ON verification.participant_id=challenge.participant_id AND verification.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
   AND verification.principal_id=challenge.principal_id AND verification.mfa_challenge_id=challenge.mfa_challenge_id
   AND verification.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WEBAUTHN-VERIFY'
   AND verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=i.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
   AND verification.evidence_digest=sha256(verification.evidence_cbor)
   AND verification.signer_credential_id=challenge.signer_credential_id
 WHERE challenge.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND challenge.principal_id=NEW.principal_id
  AND challenge.mfa_challenge_id=NEW.maker_challenge_id AND challenge.resource_id=NEW.envelope_id::text
  AND challenge.resource_digest=NEW.candidate_digest AND challenge.action_intent_id=c.action_intent_id
  AND challenge.session_id=c.maker_session_id AND challenge.used_operation_id=NEW.operation_id
  AND challenge.used_at IS NOT NULL AND challenge.used_at>=challenge.consumed_at
  AND challenge.used_at<challenge.expires_at AND challenge.used_at<challenge.consumed_at+interval '5 minutes';
 checker:=jsonb_build_object('authority',NEW.checker_authority->'binding','stepUpChallengeId',d.mfa_challenge_id::text,
  'stepUpEvidenceDigest','sha256:'||encode(sha256(d.evidence_cbor),'hex'),'signerCredentialId',d.signer_credential_id::text,
  'signerCredentialEpoch',d.signer_credential_epoch::text);
 IF NEW.maker_authority#>>'{binding,principalId}' IS DISTINCT FROM c.maker_principal_id::text
  OR NEW.maker_authority#>>'{binding,sessionId}' IS DISTINCT FROM c.maker_session_id::text
  OR NEW.maker_authority#>>'{binding,sessionEpoch}' IS DISTINCT FROM c.maker_session_epoch::text
  OR NEW.maker_authority#>>'{binding,participantEpoch}' IS DISTINCT FROM c.maker_participant_epoch::text
  OR NEW.maker_authority#>>'{binding,principalEpoch}' IS DISTINCT FROM c.maker_principal_epoch::text
  OR NEW.maker_authority#>>'{binding,authorityEpoch}' IS DISTINCT FROM c.maker_authority_epoch::text
  OR NEW.maker_authority#>>'{binding,delegationEpoch}' IS DISTINCT FROM c.maker_delegation_epoch::text
  OR NEW.maker_authority#>>'{binding,assignmentId}' IS DISTINCT FROM c.maker_assignment_id::text
  OR NEW.maker_authority#>>'{binding,assignmentVersion}' IS DISTINCT FROM c.maker_assignment_row_version::text
  OR NEW.maker_authority#>>'{binding,authorityEnvelopeId}' IS DISTINCT FROM c.maker_authority_envelope_id::text
  OR NEW.checker_authority#>>'{binding,principalId}' IS DISTINCT FROM d.approver_principal_id::text
  OR NEW.checker_authority#>>'{binding,sessionId}' IS DISTINCT FROM d.approver_session_id::text
  OR NEW.checker_authority#>>'{binding,sessionEpoch}' IS DISTINCT FROM d.approver_session_epoch::text
  OR NEW.checker_authority#>>'{binding,participantEpoch}' IS DISTINCT FROM d.approver_participant_epoch::text
  OR NEW.checker_authority#>>'{binding,principalEpoch}' IS DISTINCT FROM d.approver_principal_epoch::text
  OR NEW.checker_authority#>>'{binding,authorityEpoch}' IS DISTINCT FROM d.approver_envelope_epoch::text
  OR NEW.checker_authority#>>'{binding,delegationEpoch}' IS DISTINCT FROM d.approver_delegation_epoch::text
  OR NEW.checker_authority#>>'{binding,assignmentId}' IS DISTINCT FROM d.approver_assignment_id::text
  OR NEW.checker_authority#>>'{binding,assignmentVersion}' IS DISTINCT FROM d.approver_assignment_row_version::text
  OR NEW.checker_authority#>>'{binding,authorityEnvelopeId}' IS DISTINCT FROM d.approver_authority_envelope_id::text
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATION-ACTOR'; END IF;
 expected:=jsonb_build_object('1',openpc.business_uuid(p.submission_operation_id),'2',openpc.business_uuid(p.envelope_id),
  '3',openpc.business_bytes(p.proposal_digest),'4',openpc.business_uuid(p.submission_approval_id),
  '5',openpc.business_bytes(submission_digest),'6',2,'7',3,
  '8',openpc.identity_envelope_actor_wire(p.submission_maker),'9',openpc.identity_envelope_actor_wire(p.submission_checker));
 IF payload->'3' IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATION-SUBMISSION'; END IF;
 expected:=jsonb_build_object('domain','pc.identity.authority-envelope-activation-idempotency.v1',
  'participantId',NEW.participant_id::text,'privacyDomainId',NEW.privacy_domain_id::text,'envelopeId',NEW.envelope_id::text,
  'operationId',NEW.operation_id::text,'actionIntentId',c.action_intent_id,'catalogOperationId',c.catalog_operation_id,
  'candidateDigest','sha256:'||encode(c.candidate_digest,'hex'),'expectedApprovedVersion','3',
  'recordId',i.idempotency_record_id::text,'key',i.idempotency_key,'principalId',i.principal_id::text,
  'assertionBindingDigest','sha256:'||encode(i.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest,'hex'));
 expected:=jsonb_build_object('1',openpc.business_uuid(NEW.operation_id),'2',openpc.business_uuid(c.mutation_candidate_id),
  '3',openpc.business_bytes(c.candidate_digest),'4',openpc.business_uuid(a.approval_request_id),
  '5',openpc.business_bytes(d.decision_digest),'6',3,'7',4,
  '8',openpc.business_bytes(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(expected),'UTF8'))),
  '9',1,'10',1,
  '11',openpc.identity_envelope_actor_wire(maker),'12',openpc.identity_envelope_actor_wire(checker));
 IF payload->'4' IS DISTINCT FROM expected
  OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT value) FROM (VALUES (p.submission_maker->>'stepUpChallengeId'),
   (p.submission_checker->>'stepUpChallengeId'),(maker->>'stepUpChallengeId'),(checker->>'stepUpChallengeId')) proof(value))<>4
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATION-INTENT'; END IF;
 -- Observation resolves the immutable original key, even after selection or
 -- lifecycle changes. Current selection is a separate pre-dispatch fence.
 SELECT key.* INTO STRICT k FROM control.business_signing_key key
  WHERE key.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND key.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
   AND key.environment_id=NEW.request->>'environmentId' AND key.signer_id=NEW.request->>'expectedFingerprint'
   AND key.signing_purpose_code=371;
 expected:=jsonb_build_object('1',k.environment_id,'2',openpc.business_uuid(k.participant_id),'3',openpc.business_uuid(k.privacy_domain_id),
  '4','pc.identity.authority-envelope.v1','5',1,'6',openpc.business_bytes(decode('54d85c86019a4475f8207f375fa571565e9e6e0adb5b0bd55abc03e4beb81f74','hex')),
  '7',openpc.business_bytes(decode(substr(k.signer_id,8),'hex')),'8',k.secret_version,
  '9',openpc.business_uuid(k.workload_credential_id),'10',k.workload_credential_epoch,'11',openpc.business_bytes(k.trust_digest));
 IF payload->'5' IS DISTINCT FROM expected OR payload IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('0',payload->'0','1',payload->'1',
  '2',payload->'2','3',payload->'3','4',payload->'4','5',expected,'6',NEW.reserved_at_ns)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATION-SIGNER'; END IF;
 expected:=jsonb_build_object('participantId',k.participant_id::text,'privacyDomainId',k.privacy_domain_id::text,
  'environmentId',k.environment_id,'workloadCredentialId',k.workload_credential_id::text,
  'workloadCredentialEpoch',k.workload_credential_epoch::text,'secretClass','SECRET-SIGNING-KEY','reference',k.secret_reference,
  'version',k.secret_version,'purpose','pc.cose.identity-authority-envelope.v1','purposeCode',371,'schemaId',24034,
  'schemaVersion',1,'schemaDefinitionDigest','sha256:6cf5c91789d9488014d3ec9445d5852c4aa686534305c6516d67210176ea3cc5',
  'profileId','pc.identity.authority-envelope.v1','profileVersion',1,'profileDigest','sha256:54d85c86019a4475f8207f375fa571565e9e6e0adb5b0bd55abc03e4beb81f74',
  'trustContextDigest','sha256:'||encode(k.trust_digest,'hex'),'method','SIGN_AUTHORITY_ENVELOPE',
  'callerWorkloadCredentialId',NEW.request->'callerWorkloadCredentialId','attemptId',NEW.attempt_id::text,
  'operationId',NEW.operation_id::text,'expectedFingerprint',k.signer_id,'payloadHex',encode(NEW.payload_cbor,'hex'));
 IF NEW.request IS DISTINCT FROM expected OR NEW.request_digest<>sha256(convert_to('pc.identity.authority-envelope-provider-request.v1','UTF8')
  ||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(expected),'UTF8'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATION-REQUEST'; END IF;
 IF NEW.state IN ('PREPARED','DISPATCHED') THEN
  now_ns:=floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000;
  IF (NEW.state='PREPARED' AND i.expires_at<=clock_timestamp())
   OR NOT openpc.identity_envelope_activation_intent_current(NEW.participant_id,NEW.privacy_domain_id,
    NEW.candidate_id,NEW.approval_request_id)
   OR (proposal#>>'{8,3}')::numeric>now_ns OR (proposal#>>'{8,4}')::numeric<=now_ns
   OR (proposal#>>'{9,3}')::numeric>now_ns OR (proposal#>>'{9,4}')::numeric<=now_ns
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.participant target WHERE target.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
     AND target.state='ACTIVE' AND target.authority_epoch=(proposal->>'4')::numeric
     AND target.authority_epoch=(proposal->>'5')::numeric)
   OR NOT openpc.identity_envelope_activation_authority_current(NEW.participant_id,NEW.privacy_domain_id,
    NEW.maker_authority,c.action_intent_id,NEW.envelope_id,NEW.state='PREPARED')
   OR NOT openpc.identity_envelope_activation_authority_current(NEW.participant_id,NEW.privacy_domain_id,
    NEW.checker_authority,c.action_intent_id,NEW.envelope_id,NEW.state='PREPARED')
   OR NOT ((openpc.identity_envelope_activation_authority_current(NEW.participant_id,NEW.privacy_domain_id,
    p.issuer_authority,'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1',NEW.envelope_id,false)
    AND openpc.identity_envelope_activation_authority_current(NEW.participant_id,NEW.privacy_domain_id,
    p.submission_checker_authority,'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1',NEW.envelope_id,false))
    OR (NEW.principal_id=p.maker_principal_id
      AND NEW.checker_authority#>>'{binding,principalId}'=p.submission_checker#>>'{authority,principalId}'
      AND openpc.platform_recovery_proposal_history_current(NEW.participant_id,NEW.privacy_domain_id,
      (NEW.maker_authority#>>'{binding,authorityEnvelopeId}')::uuid,NEW.envelope_id)
      AND openpc.platform_recovery_proposal_history_current(NEW.participant_id,NEW.privacy_domain_id,
      (NEW.checker_authority#>>'{binding,authorityEnvelopeId}')::uuid,NEW.envelope_id)))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATION-CURRENT-AUTHORITY'; END IF;
  FOREACH source_envelope IN ARRAY ARRAY[
   (p.issuer_authority#>>'{binding,authorityEnvelopeId}')::uuid,
   (p.submission_checker_authority#>>'{binding,authorityEnvelopeId}')::uuid,
   (NEW.maker_authority#>>'{binding,authorityEnvelopeId}')::uuid,
   (NEW.checker_authority#>>'{binding,authorityEnvelopeId}')::uuid] LOOP
   IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.authority_envelope source
     JOIN control.platform_context platform ON platform.platform_context_id=source.platform_context_id
      AND platform.authority_epoch=source.platform_authority_epoch AND platform.state='ACTIVE'
     JOIN (select platform_context_id,platform_authority_epoch,
  owner_participant_id,installation_privacy_domain_id,admission_digest from control.platform_envelope_scope
  union all select platform_context_id,platform_authority_epoch,owner_participant_id,
    installation_privacy_domain_id,admission_digest from control.platform_envelope_scope_successor
  union all select platform_context_id,platform_authority_epoch,owner_participant_id,
    installation_privacy_domain_id,admission_digest from control.root_expiry_recovery_scope) root ON root.platform_context_id=platform.platform_context_id
      AND root.platform_authority_epoch=platform.authority_epoch AND root.owner_participant_id=NEW.participant_id
     WHERE source.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND source.authority_envelope_id=source_envelope
      AND source.state='ACTIVE' AND platform.owner_participant_id=NEW.participant_id
      AND openpc.business_uuid(platform.platform_context_id)=proposal#>'{10,3}'
      AND ((to_jsonb(platform.authority_epoch)=proposal#>'{10,4}'
         AND openpc.business_bytes(root.admission_digest)=proposal#>'{10,5}')
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_scope_replacement pending
          JOIN control.mutation_candidate create_intent ON create_intent.participant_id=pending.participant_id
            AND create_intent.mutation_candidate_id=p.create_candidate_id AND create_intent.state='CONSUMED'
          CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(pending.candidate->'administrators') admin
          WHERE pending.platform_context_id=platform.platform_context_id AND pending.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
            AND pending.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND pending.state='WITHDRAWING' AND pending.row_version=1
            AND pending.predecessor_epoch=platform.authority_epoch AND pending.expected_root_revision=platform.row_version
            AND to_jsonb(pending.predecessor_epoch+1)=proposal#>'{10,4}'
            AND openpc.business_bytes(pending.successor_digest)=proposal#>'{10,5}'
            AND create_intent.candidate_document->>'platformScopeReplacementId'=pending.replacement_id::text
            AND admin->>'envelopeId'=NEW.envelope_id::text
            AND create_intent.candidate_document->'usable'=admin->'usable'
            AND create_intent.candidate_document->'grantable'=admin->'grantable'
            AND openpc.platform_scope_document_value(proposal->'8')=admin->'usable'
            AND openpc.platform_scope_document_value(proposal->'9')=admin->'grantable')))

   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATION-ROOT'; END IF;
  END LOOP;
  IF k.valid_from_ns>now_ns OR k.valid_until_ns<=now_ns
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_signing_selection selection
     JOIN control.identity_envelope_signing_grant grant_row ON grant_row.participant_id=selection.participant_id
      AND grant_row.privacy_domain_id=selection.privacy_domain_id AND grant_row.signer_id=selection.signer_id
      AND grant_row.profile_digest=selection.profile_digest AND grant_row.signing_purpose_code=371
     WHERE selection.participant_id=k.participant_id AND selection.privacy_domain_id=k.privacy_domain_id
      AND selection.environment_id=k.environment_id AND selection.signer_id=k.signer_id AND selection.admission_version>0
      AND selection.profile_digest=decode('54d85c86019a4475f8207f375fa571565e9e6e0adb5b0bd55abc03e4beb81f74','hex'))
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.business_signing_key_state lifecycle
     JOIN control.credential credential ON credential.participant_id=lifecycle.participant_id
      AND credential.credential_id=k.workload_credential_id AND credential.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS'
      AND credential.credential_epoch=k.workload_credential_epoch AND credential.state='ACTIVE'
      AND credential.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND (credential.valid_until IS NULL OR credential.valid_until>clock_timestamp())
     JOIN control.principal principal ON principal.participant_id=credential.participant_id
      AND principal.principal_id=credential.principal_id AND principal.kind='WORKLOAD' AND principal.state='ACTIVE'
      AND principal.authority_epoch=k.envelope_workload_principal_epoch
     JOIN control.participant participant ON participant.participant_id=principal.participant_id
      AND participant.state='ACTIVE' AND participant.authority_epoch=k.envelope_workload_participant_epoch
     WHERE lifecycle.participant_id=k.participant_id AND lifecycle.privacy_domain_id=k.privacy_domain_id
      AND lifecycle.signer_id=k.signer_id AND lifecycle.state='ACTIVE')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATION-CURRENT-KEY'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF NEW.state='DISPATCHED' AND (NEW.dispatched_at<NEW.created_at OR NEW.dispatched_at>clock_timestamp())
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATION-DISPATCH'; END IF;
 IF NEW.state IN ('OBSERVED','COMMITTED') THEN
  expected:=(NEW.request-ARRAY['method','callerWorkloadCredentialId','attemptId','operationId','expectedFingerprint','payloadHex'])
   ||jsonb_build_object('algorithm','ES256','publicKeySpkiHex',encode(k.public_key_spki_der,'hex'),
    'fingerprint',k.signer_id,'validFromNs',k.valid_from_ns::text,'validUntilNs',k.valid_until_ns::text,'state','ACTIVE');
  IF NEW.observed_at<NEW.dispatched_at OR NEW.observed_at>clock_timestamp()
   OR NEW.observation->>'attemptId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.attempt_id::text
   OR NEW.observation->>'operationId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.operation_id::text
   OR NEW.observation->>'requestDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(NEW.request_digest,'hex')
   OR NEW.observation->>'method' IS DISTINCT FROM 'SIGN_AUTHORITY_ENVELOPE'
   OR NEW.observation->>'coseHex' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(NEW.cose_sign1,'hex')
   OR NEW.observation->'descriptor' IS DISTINCT FROM expected
   OR NEW.observation IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('schemaVersion',1,'method','SIGN_AUTHORITY_ENVELOPE',
    'attemptId',NEW.attempt_id::text,'operationId',NEW.operation_id::text,
    'requestDigest','sha256:'||encode(NEW.request_digest,'hex'),'recordedAtNs',NEW.observation->'recordedAtNs',
    'descriptor',expected,'coseHex',encode(NEW.cose_sign1,'hex'))
   OR (NEW.observation->>'recordedAtNs')::numeric<NEW.reserved_at_ns
   OR (NEW.observation->>'recordedAtNs')::numeric>=k.valid_until_ns
   OR (NEW.observation->>'recordedAtNs')::numeric>floor(extract(epoch FROM NEW.observed_at)*1000000)*1000
   OR get_byte(NEW.cose_sign1,0)<>210
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATION-OBSERVATION'; END IF;
  outer_cose:=openpc.business_cbor_item(NEW.cose_sign1,1,0);
  IF (outer_cose->>'next')::integer<>octet_length(NEW.cose_sign1)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATION-COSE'; END IF;
  outer_cose:=outer_cose->'value';
  IF jsonb_typeof(outer_cose)<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(outer_cose)<>4 OR outer_cose->1<>'{}'::jsonb
   OR outer_cose->2 IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.business_bytes(NEW.payload_cbor) OR length(outer_cose->3->>'bytes') IS DISTINCT FROM 128
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATION-COSE'; END IF;
  header:=openpc.business_cbor(decode(outer_cose->0->>'bytes','hex'));
  IF header IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('1',-7,'2',jsonb_build_array(100,101,102,103),
   '3','application/pc+cbor','4',openpc.business_bytes(convert_to(k.signer_id,'UTF8')),'100',24034,'101',1,'102',371,'103',2)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATION-COSE-CONTEXT'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF NEW.state='COMMITTED' AND NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM control.authority_envelope envelope
   WHERE envelope.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
    AND envelope.authority_envelope_id=NEW.envelope_id
    AND envelope.state='ACTIVE' AND envelope.row_version=4
    AND envelope.last_mutation_operation_id=NEW.operation_id
    AND envelope.cose_sign1=NEW.cose_sign1)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-SEALED-ACTIVATION-REQUIRED'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_identity_envelope_proposal()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE proposal jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-HISTORY'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
  IF NEW.state<>'DRAFT' OR NEW.row_version<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-INITIAL-STATE'; END IF;
 ELSE
  IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-'state'-'submission_operation_id'-'submission_intent_digest'-'submission_approval_id'-'submission_maker'-'submission_checker'-'submission_checker_authority'-'row_version')
    IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'state'-'submission_operation_id'-'submission_intent_digest'-'submission_approval_id'-'submission_maker'-'submission_checker'-'submission_checker_authority'-'row_version')
    OR NEW.row_version<>OLD.row_version+1
    OR NOT ((OLD.state='DRAFT' AND NEW.state='SUBMITTED') OR (OLD.state='SUBMITTED' AND NEW.state='APPROVED')) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-HISTORY'; END IF;
  IF OLD.state='SUBMITTED' AND (NEW.submission_operation_id,NEW.submission_intent_digest,NEW.submission_approval_id,NEW.submission_maker)
    IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.submission_operation_id,OLD.submission_intent_digest,OLD.submission_approval_id,OLD.submission_maker) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-SUBMISSION-IMMUTABLE'; END IF;
 END IF;
 proposal:=openpc.business_cbor(NEW.proposal_cbor);
 IF jsonb_typeof(proposal) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
   OR (SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM jsonb_object_keys(proposal) key) IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['0','1','10','2','3','4','5','6','7','8','9']
   OR proposal->'0' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('bytes','6cf5c91789d9488014d3ec9445d5852c4aa686534305c6516d67210176ea3cc5')
   OR proposal->'1' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('bytes',replace(NEW.envelope_id::text,'-',''))
   OR proposal->>'2' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
   OR proposal->'3' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('bytes',replace(NEW.target_participant_id::text,'-',''))
   OR proposal#>'{10,2,1}' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('bytes',replace(NEW.participant_id::text,'-',''))
   OR proposal#>'{10,2,3}' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('bytes',replace(NEW.maker_principal_id::text,'-',''))
   OR NEW.issuer_authority#>>'{binding,participantId}' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.participant_id::text
   OR NEW.issuer_authority#>>'{binding,principalId}' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.maker_principal_id::text
   OR NEW.issuer_authority#>>'{durable,grant,privacyDomainId}' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.privacy_domain_id::text THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-PROVENANCE'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_identity_envelope_recovery_installation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE expected_schema text; record_id text;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-SIGNER-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
  IF OLD.state<>'ACTIVE' OR NEW.state<>'REVOKED' OR NEW.row_version<>OLD.row_version+1
   OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','row_version','revoked_at','revocation_reason_digest']) IS DISTINCT FROM
      (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','row_version','revoked_at','revocation_reason_digest']) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-SIGNER-RECOVERY'; END IF;
  NEW.revoked_at:=clock_timestamp();
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 IF current_user<>'openpc_control_owner' OR NOT pg_has_role(session_user,'openpc_control_owner','MEMBER')
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=session_user AND rolcanlogin AND NOT rolsuper AND NOT rolbypassrls)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-SIGNER-RECOVERY-INSTALLATION'; END IF;
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 expected_schema:=CASE TG_TABLE_NAME
  WHEN 'identity_envelope_recovery_custody_trust' THEN 'pc.installation.identity-envelope-recovery-receiving-trust'
  WHEN 'identity_envelope_recovery_enrollment' THEN 'pc.identity.identity-envelope-recovery-enrollment'
  ELSE NULL END;
 record_id:=CASE TG_TABLE_NAME
  WHEN 'identity_envelope_recovery_custody_trust' THEN to_jsonb(NEW)->>'custody_trust_id'
  ELSE to_jsonb(NEW)->>'enrollment_id' END;
 IF expected_schema IS NULL OR NEW.document->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_schema
  OR NEW.document->>'schemaVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
  OR NEW.document->>'purpose' IS DISTINCT FROM 'pc.installation.identity-envelope-repair-custody.v1'
  OR NEW.state<>'ACTIVE' OR NEW.row_version<>1
  OR NEW.document_digest<>sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(NEW.document),'UTF8'))
  OR NOT openpc.matches_participant(NEW.participant_id) OR NOT openpc.matches_privacy(NEW.privacy_domain_id)
  OR NEW.document->>'participantId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.participant_id::text
  OR NEW.document->>'privacyDomainId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.privacy_domain_id::text
  OR NEW.document->>'platformContextId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.platform_context_id::text
  OR (NEW.document->>'validFrom')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.valid_from
  OR (NEW.document->>'validUntil')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.valid_until
  OR NEW.valid_from>clock_timestamp() OR NEW.valid_until<=clock_timestamp()
  OR (CASE WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='identity_envelope_recovery_custody_trust'
    THEN NEW.document->>'custodyTrustId' ELSE NEW.document->>'enrollmentId' END) IS DISTINCT FROM record_id
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-SIGNER-RECOVERY-INSTALLATION'; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='identity_envelope_recovery_enrollment' THEN
  IF NEW.document->>'custodyTrustId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.custody_trust_id::text
   OR NEW.document->>'custodyTrustDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(NEW.custody_trust_digest,'hex')
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_recovery_custody_trust trust
    WHERE trust.custody_trust_id=NEW.custody_trust_id AND trust.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
     AND trust.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND trust.document_digest=NEW.custody_trust_digest
     AND trust.state='ACTIVE' AND trust.row_version=1 AND trust.valid_from<=NEW.valid_from AND trust.valid_until>=NEW.valid_until)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-SIGNER-RECOVERY-CUSTODY'; END IF;
 END IF;
 NEW.created_at:=clock_timestamp();
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
p_new control.signing_key_rotation, p_old control.signing_key_rotation, p_operation text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_identity_envelope_recovery_rotation(p_new control.signing_key_rotation, p_old control.signing_key_rotation, p_operation text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'

 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);

 SELECT * INTO STRICT enrollment FROM control.identity_envelope_recovery_enrollment e WHERE e.enrollment_id=recovery.signer_repair_enrollment_id
  AND e.participant_id=recovery.participant_id AND e.privacy_domain_id=recovery.privacy_domain_id;
 IF p_new.rotation_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM recovery.lease_bindings->>'rotationId'
  OR p_new.request IS DISTINCT FROM enrollment.document->'request'
  OR p_new.request->>'signerRole' IS DISTINCT FROM 'IDENTITY_ENVELOPE'
  OR p_new.request->>'purpose' IS DISTINCT FROM 'pc.cose.identity-authority-envelope.v1'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.action_intent action WHERE action.action_intent_id='ACT-SIGNING_KEY_ROTATIONS_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1'
    AND action.action_intent_id=p_new.request->>'actionIntentId' AND action.resource_type='signing-key-rotation'
    AND action.operation_class='CREATE' AND action.maker_checker_required
    AND 'sha256:'||encode(action.semantic_digest,'hex')=p_new.request->>'actionIntentDigest')

    jsonb_build_object('request',p_new.request,'lease',recovery.lease_bindings)),'UTF8'))
  OR p_new.old_trust_digest IS DISTINCT FROM decode(substr(recovery.lease_bindings->>'oldTrustDigest',8),'hex')
  OR p_new.maker_principal_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM recovery.lease_bindings->>'executorPrincipalId'
  OR p_new.old_signer_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_new.request->>'oldFingerprint'
  OR p_new.environment_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_new.request->>'environmentId'
  OR p_new.workload_credential_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM p_new.request->>'workloadCredentialId'
  OR p_new.approval_request_id IS NOT NULL
  OR (p_new.state NOT IN ('CUTOVER_FENCED','OBSERVING','OLD_REVOKED','OLD_RETIRED','COMPLETE') AND p_new.cutover_at_ns IS NOT NULL)
  OR p_new.recovery_from_state IS NOT NULL OR p_new.recovery_from_revision IS NOT NULL
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ROTATION-RESERVATION'; END IF;
 IF p_operation='INSERT' THEN
  IF p_new.state<>'REQUESTED' OR p_new.revision<>1 OR p_new.approved_operation_id IS NOT NULL OR p_new.new_signer_id IS NOT NULL
   OR openpc.current_operation_id()::text IS DISTINCT FROM recovery.lease_bindings->>'creationOperationId' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ROTATION-INITIAL'; END IF;
 ELSIF p_operation='UPDATE' THEN
  IF (p_old.state='OBSERVING' AND p_new.state='OLD_REVOKED') OR (p_old.state='OLD_REVOKED' AND p_new.state='OLD_RETIRED') OR (p_old.state='OLD_RETIRED' AND p_new.state='COMPLETE') THEN
   expected_revision:=CASE p_old.state WHEN 'OBSERVING' THEN 7 WHEN 'OLD_REVOKED' THEN 8 ELSE 9 END;
   method:=CASE p_new.state WHEN 'OLD_REVOKED' THEN 'REVOKE' WHEN 'OLD_RETIRED' THEN 'RETIRE' ELSE NULL END;
   IF p_old.revision<>expected_revision OR p_new.revision<>expected_revision+1 OR p_new.updated_at<=p_old.updated_at
    OR (to_jsonb(p_new)-ARRAY['state','revision','updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(p_old)-ARRAY['state','revision','updated_at'])
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_step step WHERE step.operation_id=openpc.current_operation_id()
      AND step.participant_id=p_new.participant_id AND step.privacy_domain_id=p_new.privacy_domain_id AND step.rotation_id=p_new.rotation_id AND step.recovery_id=recovery.recovery_id
      AND step.state='COMMITTED' AND step.from_revision=expected_revision AND step.from_state=p_old.state AND step.to_state=p_new.state
      AND step.result->>'state'=p_new.state AND openpc.identity_envelope_rotation_step_current(step) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_step consumer
 JOIN control.signing_key_rotation r ON r.participant_id=consumer.participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=consumer.privacy_domain_id AND r.rotation_id=consumer.rotation_id AND r.recovery_case_id=consumer.recovery_id
 JOIN control.identity_envelope_signing_selection selection ON selection.participant_id=r.participant_id AND selection.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND selection.environment_id=r.environment_id AND selection.signer_id=r.new_signer_id

 JOIN control.identity_envelope_signing_grant next_grant ON next_grant.participant_id=next.participant_id AND next_grant.privacy_domain_id=next.privacy_domain_id AND next_grant.signer_id=next.signer_id AND next_grant.profile_digest=selection.profile_digest AND next_grant.signing_purpose_code=371
 JOIN control.business_signing_key_state next_life ON next_life.participant_id=next.participant_id AND next_life.privacy_domain_id=next.privacy_domain_id AND next_life.signer_id=next.signer_id
 JOIN control.business_signing_key old_key ON old_key.participant_id=r.participant_id AND old_key.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND old_key.signer_id=r.old_signer_id
 JOIN control.business_signing_key_state old_life ON old_life.participant_id=old_key.participant_id AND old_life.privacy_domain_id=old_key.privacy_domain_id AND old_life.signer_id=old_key.signer_id
 JOIN control.identity_envelope_activation a ON a.participant_id=consumer.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=consumer.privacy_domain_id AND a.operation_id=consumer.consumer_activation_operation_id
 WHERE consumer.operation_id=step.consumer_observation_operation_id AND consumer.participant_id=step.participant_id AND consumer.privacy_domain_id=step.privacy_domain_id
 AND consumer.rotation_id=step.rotation_id AND consumer.recovery_id=step.recovery_id AND consumer.principal_id=step.principal_id
 AND consumer.from_revision=6 AND consumer.from_state='CUTOVER_FENCED' AND consumer.to_state='OBSERVING' AND consumer.state='COMMITTED'
 AND consumer.authority_binding=step.authority_binding AND consumer.authority_digest=step.authority_digest
 AND consumer.evidence_digest=sha256(consumer.evidence_cbor) AND octet_length(consumer.cose_sign1)>0
 AND a.state='COMMITTED' AND a.row_version=4 AND a.payload_digest=sha256(a.payload_cbor)
 AND a.operation_id::text=consumer.result->>'consumerActivationOperationId' AND a.envelope_id::text=consumer.result->>'consumerEnvelopeId'
 AND 'sha256:'||encode(a.payload_digest,'hex')=consumer.result->>'consumerPayloadDigest'
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.business_signing_grant ordinary WHERE ordinary.participant_id=next.participant_id AND ordinary.privacy_domain_id=next.privacy_domain_id AND ordinary.signer_id IN(next.signer_id,old_key.signer_id))
 AND next_life.state='ACTIVE' AND next.signing_purpose_code=371 AND old_key.signing_purpose_code=371
 AND selection.profile_digest=decode('54d85c86019a4475f8207f375fa571565e9e6e0adb5b0bd55abc03e4beb81f74','hex')
 AND selection.admission_version=(step.authority_binding#>>'{lease,selectionAdmissionVersion}')::numeric+1
 AND selection.admission_version::text=consumer.result->>'selectionAdmissionVersion'
 AND 'sha256:'||encode(next.trust_digest,'hex')=consumer.result->>'trustDigest' AND next.signer_id=consumer.result->>'signerId'
 AND old_key.trust_digest=decode(substr(step.authority_binding#>>'{lease,oldTrustDigest}',8),'hex')
 AND old_life.state=(CASE WHEN step.from_state='OBSERVING' AND true THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'REVOKED' END)
 AND (step.result IS NULL OR (step.result->>'consumerObservationOperationId'=consumer.operation_id::text
 AND step.result->>'consumerActivationOperationId'=consumer.result->>'consumerActivationOperationId'
 AND step.result->>'consumerEnvelopeId'=consumer.result->>'consumerEnvelopeId' AND step.result->>'consumerPayloadDigest'=consumer.result->>'consumerPayloadDigest'
 AND step.result->>'consumerReceiptDigest'=consumer.result->>'consumerReceiptDigest' AND step.result->>'signerId'=consumer.result->>'signerId'
 AND step.result->>'trustDigest'=consumer.result->>'trustDigest' AND step.result->>'selectionAdmissionVersion'=consumer.result->>'selectionAdmissionVersion'
 AND step.result->>'predecessorSignerId'=old_key.signer_id AND step.result->>'permissionEffect'='NONE')))
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_attempt a WHERE a.operation_id=step.operation_id)=(CASE WHEN method IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
      AND (method IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_attempt a JOIN control.business_signing_key key
        ON key.participant_id=a.participant_id AND key.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND key.signer_id=p_new.old_signer_id
        WHERE a.operation_id=step.operation_id AND a.slot='old' AND a.state='OBSERVED' AND a.request->>'method'=method

        AND (a.observation#>>ARRAY['descriptor',CASE method WHEN 'REVOKE' THEN 'revokedAtNs' ELSE 'retiredAtNs' END])::numeric>=floor(extract(epoch from a.started_at)*1000000)*1000
        AND a.observation#>>'{descriptor,revokedAtNs}'=step.result->>'oldPrivateKeyRevokedAtNs'
        AND a.observation#>>'{descriptor,retiredAtNs}' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM step.result->>'oldPrivateKeyRetiredAtNs'
        AND (a.observation->>'recordedAtNs')::numeric<=floor(extract(epoch from step.completed_at)*1000000)*1000))
      AND (p_new.state='OLD_REVOKED' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_step prior WHERE prior.participant_id=step.participant_id
        AND prior.privacy_domain_id=step.privacy_domain_id AND prior.rotation_id=step.rotation_id AND prior.recovery_id=step.recovery_id

        AND prior.result->>'oldPrivateKeyRevokedAtNs'=step.result->>'oldPrivateKeyRevokedAtNs'
        AND (p_new.state<>'COMPLETE' OR (prior.result->>'oldPrivateKeyRetiredAtNs'=step.result->>'oldPrivateKeyRetiredAtNs' AND step.result->>'postReviewRequired'='true')))))

   RETURN;
  END IF;
  IF p_old.state='CUTOVER_FENCED' AND p_new.state='OBSERVING' THEN
   IF p_old.revision<>6 OR p_new.revision<>7 OR p_new.updated_at<=p_old.updated_at
    OR (to_jsonb(p_new)-ARRAY['state','revision','updated_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(p_old)-ARRAY['state','revision','updated_at'])
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_step step WHERE step.operation_id=openpc.current_operation_id()
      AND step.participant_id=p_new.participant_id AND step.privacy_domain_id=p_new.privacy_domain_id AND step.rotation_id=p_new.rotation_id
      AND step.recovery_id=recovery.recovery_id AND step.from_revision=6 AND step.from_state='CUTOVER_FENCED' AND step.to_state='OBSERVING'
      AND step.state='COMMITTED' AND openpc.identity_envelope_rotation_step_current(step) AND step.result->>'state'='OBSERVING'
      AND step.result->>'permissionEffect'='NONE' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_key_rotation r
 JOIN control.identity_envelope_activation a ON a.participant_id=r.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND a.operation_id=step.consumer_activation_operation_id
 JOIN control.identity_envelope_proposal p ON p.participant_id=a.participant_id AND p.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND p.envelope_id=a.envelope_id
 JOIN control.authority_envelope e ON e.participant_id=a.participant_id AND e.authority_envelope_id=a.envelope_id
 JOIN control.identity_envelope_signing_selection selection ON selection.participant_id=r.participant_id AND selection.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND selection.environment_id=r.environment_id AND selection.signer_id=r.new_signer_id
 JOIN control.business_signing_key k ON k.participant_id=selection.participant_id AND k.privacy_domain_id=selection.privacy_domain_id AND k.signer_id=selection.signer_id
 JOIN control.identity_envelope_signing_grant g ON g.participant_id=k.participant_id AND g.privacy_domain_id=k.privacy_domain_id AND g.signer_id=k.signer_id
 JOIN control.business_signing_key_state life ON life.participant_id=k.participant_id AND life.privacy_domain_id=k.privacy_domain_id AND life.signer_id=k.signer_id
 JOIN control.mutation_candidate candidate ON candidate.participant_id=a.participant_id AND candidate.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND candidate.mutation_candidate_id=a.candidate_id
 JOIN control.idempotency_record idem ON idem.participant_id=a.participant_id AND idem.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND idem.operation_id=a.operation_id AND idem.idempotency_record_id=a.idempotency_record_id
 JOIN control.mutation_evidence receipt ON receipt.participant_id=a.participant_id AND receipt.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND receipt.operation_id=a.operation_id AND receipt.aggregate_id=a.envelope_id
 JOIN control.outbox_event event ON event.participant_id=receipt.participant_id AND event.privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND event.aggregate_type='authority-envelope' AND event.aggregate_id=a.envelope_id AND event.event_type='openpc.authority-envelope.mutation.committed.v1'
  AND event.payload_cbor=receipt.evidence_cbor AND event.payload_digest=receipt.evidence_digest AND event.cose_sign1=receipt.cose_sign1
 WHERE r.participant_id=step.participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=step.privacy_domain_id AND r.rotation_id=step.rotation_id AND r.recovery_case_id=step.recovery_id
  AND selection.admission_version=(step.authority_binding#>>'{lease,selectionAdmissionVersion}')::numeric+1 AND selection.profile_digest=decode('54d85c86019a4475f8207f375fa571565e9e6e0adb5b0bd55abc03e4beb81f74','hex')
  AND k.signing_purpose_code=371 AND g.signing_purpose_code=371 AND g.profile_digest=selection.profile_digest AND life.state='ACTIVE'

  AND a.state='COMMITTED' AND a.row_version=4 AND a.reserved_at_ns>=r.cutover_at_ns AND a.committed_at<=step.created_at
  AND a.payload_digest=sha256(a.payload_cbor) AND a.request->>'expectedFingerprint'=k.signer_id AND a.request->>'trustContextDigest'='sha256:'||encode(k.trust_digest,'hex')
  AND a.request->>'reference'=k.secret_reference AND a.request->>'version'=k.secret_version AND a.request->>'callerWorkloadCredentialId'=k.workload_credential_id::text
  AND candidate.state='CONSUMED' AND candidate.consumed_operation_id=a.operation_id AND candidate.candidate_digest=a.candidate_digest AND candidate.resource_id=a.envelope_id
  AND candidate.action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANT_ACTIVATE_CONTEXT-V1' AND candidate.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATE'
  AND idem.terminal_state='COMMITTED' AND idem.action_intent_id=candidate.action_intent_id AND idem.catalog_operation_id=candidate.catalog_operation_id

  AND e.cose_sign1=a.cose_sign1 AND e.semantic_cbor=p.proposal_cbor AND e.semantic_digest=p.proposal_digest
  AND receipt.action_intent_id=candidate.action_intent_id AND receipt.catalog_operation_id=candidate.catalog_operation_id AND receipt.aggregate_version=3
  AND receipt.evidence_digest=sha256(receipt.evidence_cbor) AND octet_length(receipt.cose_sign1)>0

   AND step.result->>'trustDigest'='sha256:'||encode(k.trust_digest,'hex') AND step.result->>'selectionAdmissionVersion'=selection.admission_version::text
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_attempt proof WHERE proof.operation_id=step.operation_id

    AND proof.observation#>>'{descriptor,publicKeySpkiHex}'=encode(k.public_key_spki_der,'hex') AND proof.observation#>>'{descriptor,state}'='ACTIVE'
    AND (proof.request->>'challengeExpiresAtNs')::numeric>floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000
    AND (proof.observation->>'recordedAtNs')::numeric<=floor(extract(epoch from step.completed_at)*1000000)*1000))))
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_attempt a WHERE a.operation_id=step.operation_id)=1
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_attempt a WHERE a.operation_id=step.operation_id AND a.slot='effective'
        AND a.state='OBSERVED' AND a.request->>'method'='PROVE' AND a.observation->>'outcome'='SUCCEEDED' AND a.observation=a.first_observation
        AND a.observation#>>'{descriptor,fingerprint}'=p_new.new_signer_id AND a.observation#>>'{descriptor,state}'='ACTIVE'
        AND a.request->>'challengeHex'=substr(step.result->>'trustDigest',8)))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ROTATION-CONSUMER'; END IF;
   RETURN;
  END IF;
  IF p_old.state='VERIFIED' AND p_new.state='CUTOVER_FENCED' THEN
   IF p_old.revision<>5 OR p_new.revision<>6 OR p_new.new_signer_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_old.new_signer_id OR p_old.cutover_at_ns IS NOT NULL
    OR p_new.cutover_at_ns IS NULL OR p_new.cutover_at_ns>floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000
    OR p_new.updated_at<=p_old.updated_at

      AND s.privacy_domain_id=p_new.privacy_domain_id AND s.rotation_id=p_new.rotation_id AND s.recovery_id=recovery.recovery_id
      AND s.from_revision=5 AND s.from_state='VERIFIED' AND s.to_state='CUTOVER_FENCED' AND s.state='COMMITTED'

      AND s.result->>'permissionEffect'='NONE' AND (s.result->>'selectionAdmissionVersion')::numeric=(recovery.lease_bindings->>'selectionAdmissionVersion')::numeric+1
      AND p_new.cutover_at_ns=floor(extract(epoch from s.completed_at)*1000000)*1000
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_attempt a WHERE a.operation_id=s.operation_id))

   RETURN;

    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_step step WHERE step.operation_id=openpc.current_operation_id()
      AND step.participant_id=p_new.participant_id AND step.privacy_domain_id=p_new.privacy_domain_id AND step.rotation_id=p_new.rotation_id
      AND step.recovery_id=recovery.recovery_id AND step.from_revision=4 AND step.from_state='DISTRIBUTED' AND step.to_state='VERIFIED'
      AND step.state='COMMITTED' AND openpc.identity_envelope_rotation_step_current(step)
      AND step.result->>'state'='VERIFIED' AND step.result->>'admissionState'='ADMITTED' AND step.result->>'signerId'=p_new.new_signer_id

    OR (method='PREPARE' AND p_old.new_signer_id IS NOT NULL)
    OR (method='DISTRIBUTE' AND p_new.new_signer_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_old.new_signer_id)
    OR p_new.updated_at<=p_old.updated_at
    OR (to_jsonb(p_new)-ARRAY['state','revision','updated_at','new_signer_id'])
      IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(p_old)-ARRAY['state','revision','updated_at','new_signer_id'])
    OR p_new.approved_operation_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM recovery.lease_bindings->>'activationOperationId'
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_step step
     JOIN control.identity_envelope_rotation_attempt attempt ON attempt.operation_id=step.operation_id AND attempt.rotation_id=step.rotation_id
      AND attempt.participant_id=step.participant_id AND attempt.privacy_domain_id=step.privacy_domain_id AND attempt.slot='new'
     WHERE step.operation_id=openpc.current_operation_id() AND step.rotation_id=p_new.rotation_id AND step.recovery_id=recovery.recovery_id
      AND step.participant_id=p_new.participant_id AND step.privacy_domain_id=p_new.privacy_domain_id
      AND step.from_revision=expected_revision AND step.from_state=p_old.state AND step.to_state=p_new.state AND step.state='COMMITTED'
      AND openpc.identity_envelope_rotation_step_current(step) AND step.result->>'state'=p_new.state
      AND step.result->>'signerId'=p_new.new_signer_id AND attempt.state='OBSERVED' AND attempt.request->>'method'=method
      AND attempt.observation->>'outcome'='SUCCEEDED' AND attempt.observation=attempt.first_observation
      AND attempt.observation#>>'{descriptor,fingerprint}'=p_new.new_signer_id
      AND attempt.observation#>>'{descriptor,reference}'=p_new.request->>'newReference'
      AND attempt.observation#>>'{descriptor,state}'='ACTIVE'
      AND attempt.observation#>>'{descriptor,fingerprint}'='sha256:'||encode(sha256(decode(attempt.observation#>>'{descriptor,publicKeySpkiHex}','hex')),'hex')
      AND (method='PREPARE' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_step prepared
        JOIN control.identity_envelope_rotation_attempt original USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,rotation_id,operation_id)
        WHERE prepared.participant_id=step.participant_id AND prepared.privacy_domain_id=step.privacy_domain_id AND prepared.rotation_id=step.rotation_id
          AND prepared.recovery_id=step.recovery_id AND prepared.from_revision=2 AND prepared.to_state='PREPARED'
          AND prepared.state='COMMITTED' AND original.slot='new' AND original.state='OBSERVED'
          AND original.observation->'descriptor'=attempt.observation->'descriptor'
          AND prepared.result->>'trustDigest'=attempt.request->>'trustContextDigest'
          AND prepared.result->>'trustDigest'=step.result->>'trustDigest')))
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ROTATION-PREPARE'; END IF;
   RETURN;
  END IF;
  IF p_old.state<>'REQUESTED' OR p_new.state<>'APPROVED' OR p_new.revision<>p_old.revision+1
   OR openpc.current_operation_id()::text IS DISTINCT FROM recovery.lease_bindings->>'creationOperationId'
   OR p_new.new_signer_id IS NOT NULL
   OR p_new.updated_at<=p_old.updated_at
   OR p_new.approved_operation_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM recovery.lease_bindings->>'activationOperationId'
   OR (to_jsonb(p_new)-ARRAY['state','revision','updated_at','approved_operation_id'])
      IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(p_old)-ARRAY['state','revision','updated_at','approved_operation_id']) THEN
   -- Later proof/admission/cutover remain closed until immutable
   -- trust, versioned selection and genuine consumer owners are connected.
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ROTATION-PHASE'; END IF;
 ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ROTATION-OWNER';
 END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_identity_envelope_representation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND (NEW.representation,NEW.participant_id,NEW.issuer_participant_id,NEW.issuer_privacy_domain_id,NEW.principal_id)
   IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.representation,OLD.participant_id,OLD.issuer_participant_id,OLD.issuer_privacy_domain_id,OLD.principal_id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-REPRESENTATION';
 END IF;
 IF NEW.representation IN ('LEGACY','RECOVERY_V1') THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF NEW.representation<>'TYPED_V1' OR NEW.platform_context_id IS NULL OR NEW.platform_authority_epoch IS NULL
   OR NEW.valid_until IS NULL
   OR (NEW.state='ACTIVE') IS DISTINCT FROM (octet_length(NEW.cose_sign1)>0)
   OR NEW.semantic_digest<>sha256(NEW.semantic_cbor) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-PROPOSAL'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
  IF NEW.state<>'DRAFT' OR NEW.row_version<>1 OR NEW.checker_principal_id IS NOT NULL THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-INITIAL-STATE'; END IF;
 ELSE
  IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-'creator_participant_id'-'state'-'checker_principal_id'-'last_mutation_operation_id'-'row_version'-'updated_at'-'cose_sign1')
    IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'creator_participant_id'-'state'-'checker_principal_id'-'last_mutation_operation_id'-'row_version'-'updated_at'-'cose_sign1')
    OR NEW.row_version<>OLD.row_version+1 OR NEW.last_mutation_operation_id IS NULL
    OR NOT (
      (OLD.state='DRAFT' AND NEW.state='SUBMITTED' AND NEW.checker_principal_id IS NULL
       AND NEW.cose_sign1=OLD.cose_sign1)
      OR (OLD.state='SUBMITTED' AND NEW.state='APPROVED' AND NEW.checker_principal_id IS NOT NULL
       AND NEW.cose_sign1=OLD.cose_sign1)
      OR (OLD.state='APPROVED' AND NEW.state='ACTIVE' AND NEW.checker_principal_id=OLD.checker_principal_id
       AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_activation activation
        WHERE activation.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
         AND activation.privacy_domain_id=NEW.issuer_privacy_domain_id
         AND activation.envelope_id=NEW.authority_envelope_id
         AND activation.operation_id=openpc.current_operation_id()
         AND activation.state='OBSERVED' AND activation.row_version=3
         AND activation.cose_sign1=NEW.cose_sign1))
    ) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-SEALED-ACTIVATION-REQUIRED'; END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_identity_envelope_rotation_attempt()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE step control.identity_envelope_rotation_step; rotation control.signing_key_rotation; effects jsonb; issuer jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
  OR NEW.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_operation_id()
  OR NOT openpc.matches_participant(NEW.participant_id) OR NOT openpc.matches_privacy(NEW.privacy_domain_id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ROTATION-ATTEMPT'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT step FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_step s WHERE s.operation_id=NEW.operation_id
  AND s.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND s.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND s.rotation_id=NEW.rotation_id;
 IF NOT coalesce(openpc.identity_envelope_rotation_step_bound(step),false) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ROTATION-ATTEMPT'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
  SELECT * INTO STRICT rotation FROM control.signing_key_rotation r WHERE r.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
   AND r.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND r.rotation_id=NEW.rotation_id;
  effects:=openpc.signing_transition_effects('ACT-SIGNING_KEY_ROTATIONS_ADVANCE_RESOURCE-V1',step.from_state,step.to_state);
  issuer:=step.authority_binding#>'{lease,issuer}';
  IF step.state<>'READY' OR NEW.state<>'READY' OR NEW.started_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.observation IS NOT NULL OR NEW.first_observation IS NOT NULL OR NEW.ambiguity_kind IS NOT NULL
   OR NOT coalesce(openpc.identity_envelope_rotation_step_current(step),false)
   OR NOT (effects->'providerSteps' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_array(NEW.slot,NEW.request->>'method')))
   OR NEW.request_digest<>sha256(convert_to('pc.identity.envelope-key-rotation-request.v1','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(NEW.request),'UTF8'))
   OR NEW.request->>'participantId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.participant_id::text OR NEW.request->>'privacyDomainId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.privacy_domain_id::text
   OR NEW.request->>'rotationId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.rotation_id::text OR NEW.request->>'operationId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.operation_id::text
   OR NEW.request->>'attemptId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.attempt_id::text
   OR NEW.request->>'purpose' IS DISTINCT FROM 'pc.cose.identity-authority-envelope.v1' OR NEW.request->>'purposeCode' IS DISTINCT FROM '371'
   OR NEW.request->>'schemaId' IS DISTINCT FROM '24034' OR NEW.request->>'schemaVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
   OR NEW.request->>'secretClass' IS DISTINCT FROM 'SECRET-SIGNING-KEY'
   OR NEW.request->>'schemaDefinitionDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:6cf5c91789d9488014d3ec9445d5852c4aa686534305c6516d67210176ea3cc5'
   OR NEW.request->>'profileId' IS DISTINCT FROM 'pc.identity.authority-envelope.v1'
   OR NEW.request->>'profileVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
   OR NEW.request->>'profileDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:54d85c86019a4475f8207f375fa571565e9e6e0adb5b0bd55abc03e4beb81f74'
   OR NEW.request-ARRAY['participantId','privacyDomainId','environmentId','workloadCredentialId','workloadCredentialEpoch',
    'secretClass','reference','version','purpose','purposeCode','schemaId','schemaVersion','schemaDefinitionDigest','profileId',
    'profileVersion','profileDigest','callerWorkloadCredentialId','rotationId','operationId','attemptId','issuerParticipantEpoch',
    'issuerPrincipalEpoch','governanceDigest','method','expectedFingerprint']-
      (CASE NEW.request->>'method' WHEN 'DISTRIBUTE' THEN ARRAY['trustContextDigest']
       WHEN 'PROVE' THEN ARRAY['challengeHex','challengeIssuedAtNs','challengeExpiresAtNs','recoveryPredecessor'] ELSE ARRAY[]::text[] END)<>'{}'::jsonb
   OR NEW.request->'recoveryPredecessor' IS DISTINCT FROM
     (CASE WHEN NEW.slot='old' AND NEW.request->>'method'='PROVE'
       THEN jsonb_build_object('purpose','IDENTITY_ENVELOPE_SIGNER_REPAIR_ONLY',
    'enrollmentId',step.authority_binding#>>'{lease,enrollmentId}',
    'enrollmentDigest',step.authority_binding#>>'{lease,enrollmentDigest}',
    'recoveryId',step.authority_binding#>>'{lease,recoveryId}',
    'activationOperationId',step.authority_binding#>>'{lease,activationOperationId}',
    'leaseDigest','sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(step.authority_binding->'lease'),'UTF8')),'hex'),
    'oldTrustDigest',step.authority_binding#>>'{lease,oldTrustDigest}') ELSE NULL END)
   OR NEW.request->>'environmentId' IS DISTINCT FROM rotation.environment_id
   OR NEW.request->>'workloadCredentialId' IS DISTINCT FROM issuer->>'workloadCredentialId'
   OR NEW.request->>'callerWorkloadCredentialId' IS DISTINCT FROM issuer->>'workloadCredentialId'
   OR NEW.request->>'workloadCredentialEpoch' IS DISTINCT FROM issuer->>'workloadCredentialEpoch'
   OR NEW.request->>'issuerParticipantEpoch' IS DISTINCT FROM issuer->>'workloadParticipantEpoch'
   OR NEW.request->>'issuerPrincipalEpoch' IS DISTINCT FROM issuer->>'workloadPrincipalEpoch'
   OR NEW.request->>'reference' IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN NEW.slot='old' THEN rotation.request->>'oldReference' ELSE rotation.request->>'newReference' END)
   OR NEW.request->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM split_part(NEW.request->>'reference','#',2)
   OR NEW.request->>'governanceDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(
      jsonb_build_object('domain','pc.identity.envelope-rotation-governance.v1','admission',step.authority_binding)),'UTF8')),'hex')
   OR (NEW.request->>'method'<>'PREPARE' AND NEW.request->>'expectedFingerprint' IS DISTINCT FROM
     (CASE WHEN NEW.slot='old' THEN rotation.old_signer_id ELSE rotation.new_signer_id END))
   OR (NEW.request->>'method'='PREPARE' AND NEW.request->>'expectedFingerprint' IS DISTINCT FROM rotation.request->>'newFingerprint')
   OR (NEW.request->>'method'='DISTRIBUTE' AND NOT EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_step prepared WHERE prepared.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
      AND prepared.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND prepared.rotation_id=NEW.rotation_id AND prepared.recovery_id=step.recovery_id
      AND prepared.from_revision=2 AND prepared.from_state='APPROVED' AND prepared.to_state='PREPARED' AND prepared.state='COMMITTED'
      AND prepared.result->>'signerId'=rotation.new_signer_id AND prepared.result->>'trustDigest'=NEW.request->>'trustContextDigest'))
   OR (NEW.slot='effective' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_activation consumer WHERE consumer.operation_id=step.consumer_activation_operation_id
     AND consumer.participant_id=step.participant_id AND consumer.privacy_domain_id=step.privacy_domain_id AND consumer.state='COMMITTED'
     AND floor(extract(epoch from consumer.committed_at)*1000000)*1000<=(NEW.request->>'challengeIssuedAtNs')::numeric))
   OR (NEW.request->>'method'='PROVE' AND (
      coalesce(NEW.request->>'challengeHex','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
      OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_step prepared WHERE prepared.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
        AND prepared.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND prepared.rotation_id=NEW.rotation_id AND prepared.recovery_id=step.recovery_id
        AND prepared.from_revision=3 AND prepared.to_state='DISTRIBUTED' AND prepared.state='COMMITTED'
        AND prepared.result->>'signerId'=rotation.new_signer_id AND substr(prepared.result->>'trustDigest',8)=NEW.request->>'challengeHex')
      OR
      (NEW.request->>'challengeIssuedAtNs')::numeric>floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000
      OR (NEW.request->>'challengeExpiresAtNs')::numeric<=(NEW.request->>'challengeIssuedAtNs')::numeric
      OR (NEW.request->>'challengeExpiresAtNs')::numeric>(NEW.request->>'challengeIssuedAtNs')::numeric+300000000000
      OR (NEW.request->>'challengeExpiresAtNs')::numeric>floor(extract(epoch FROM (step.authority_binding#>>'{lease,validUntil}')::timestamptz)*1000000)*1000))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ROTATION-REQUEST'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','started_at','observed_at','observation','observation_digest','first_observation','first_observation_digest','ambiguity_kind'])
   IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','started_at','observed_at','observation','observation_digest','first_observation','first_observation_digest','ambiguity_kind'])
  OR (OLD.started_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.started_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.started_at)
  OR (OLD.first_observation IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.first_observation,NEW.first_observation_digest) IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.first_observation,OLD.first_observation_digest))
  OR (OLD.observation IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.observation,NEW.observation_digest,NEW.observed_at) IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.observation,OLD.observation_digest,OLD.observed_at))
  OR (OLD.ambiguity_kind IS NOT NULL AND NEW.ambiguity_kind IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ambiguity_kind)
  OR OLD.state='OBSERVED' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6020-ENVELOPE-ROTATION-ATTEMPT'; END IF;
 IF NOT ((OLD.state='READY' AND NEW.state='STARTED') OR
   (OLD.state='STARTED' AND NEW.state IN ('STARTED','OBSERVED','WRITE_AMBIGUITY')) OR
   (OLD.state='WRITE_AMBIGUITY' AND NEW.state IN ('WRITE_AMBIGUITY','OBSERVED'))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6022-ENVELOPE-ROTATION-ATTEMPT'; END IF;
 IF OLD.state='READY' AND NEW.state='STARTED' AND (step.state<>'STARTED' OR NEW.started_at IS NULL
   OR NEW.started_at>clock_timestamp() OR NOT coalesce(openpc.identity_envelope_rotation_step_current(step),false)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_attempt sibling WHERE sibling.operation_id=NEW.operation_id AND sibling.state='WRITE_AMBIGUITY')
   OR (NEW.slot='effective' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_activation consumer WHERE consumer.operation_id=step.consumer_activation_operation_id
     AND consumer.participant_id=step.participant_id AND consumer.privacy_domain_id=step.privacy_domain_id AND consumer.state='COMMITTED'
     AND floor(extract(epoch from consumer.committed_at)*1000000)*1000<=(NEW.request->>'challengeIssuedAtNs')::numeric))
   OR (NEW.request->>'method'='PROVE' AND (NEW.request->>'challengeExpiresAtNs')::numeric<=floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ROTATION-DISPATCH'; END IF;
 IF NEW.first_observation IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.first_observation_digest IS DISTINCT FROM sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(NEW.first_observation),'UTF8'))
   OR NEW.first_observation->>'attemptId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.attempt_id::text
   OR NEW.first_observation->>'operationId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.operation_id::text
   OR NEW.first_observation->>'requestDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(NEW.request_digest,'hex')
   OR NEW.first_observation->>'method' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.request->>'method') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ROTATION-OBSERVATION'; END IF;
 IF NEW.state='OBSERVED' AND (NEW.observation IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.first_observation
   OR NEW.observation_digest IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.first_observation_digest OR NEW.observed_at>clock_timestamp()) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ROTATION-LOOKUP'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_identity_envelope_rotation_step()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE rotation control.signing_key_rotation; effects jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
  OR NEW.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_operation_id()
  OR NOT coalesce(openpc.identity_envelope_rotation_step_bound(NEW),false)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ROTATION-STEP'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT rotation FROM control.signing_key_rotation r WHERE r.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
  AND r.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND r.rotation_id=NEW.rotation_id;
 effects:=openpc.signing_transition_effects('ACT-SIGNING_KEY_ROTATIONS_ADVANCE_RESOURCE-V1',NEW.from_state,NEW.to_state);
 IF effects IS NULL OR effects->>'kind'<>'ADVANCE' OR effects->>'resumeFrom' IS NOT NULL
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ROTATION-TRANSITION'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
  IF NEW.state<>'READY' OR NEW.started_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.result IS NOT NULL
   OR NEW.from_revision<>rotation.revision OR NEW.from_state<>rotation.state
   OR (NEW.from_state='CUTOVER_FENCED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_key_rotation r
 JOIN control.identity_envelope_activation a ON a.participant_id=r.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND a.operation_id=NEW.consumer_activation_operation_id
 JOIN control.identity_envelope_proposal p ON p.participant_id=a.participant_id AND p.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND p.envelope_id=a.envelope_id
 JOIN control.authority_envelope e ON e.participant_id=a.participant_id AND e.authority_envelope_id=a.envelope_id
 JOIN control.identity_envelope_signing_selection selection ON selection.participant_id=r.participant_id AND selection.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND selection.environment_id=r.environment_id AND selection.signer_id=r.new_signer_id
 JOIN control.business_signing_key k ON k.participant_id=selection.participant_id AND k.privacy_domain_id=selection.privacy_domain_id AND k.signer_id=selection.signer_id
 JOIN control.identity_envelope_signing_grant g ON g.participant_id=k.participant_id AND g.privacy_domain_id=k.privacy_domain_id AND g.signer_id=k.signer_id
 JOIN control.business_signing_key_state life ON life.participant_id=k.participant_id AND life.privacy_domain_id=k.privacy_domain_id AND life.signer_id=k.signer_id
 JOIN control.mutation_candidate candidate ON candidate.participant_id=a.participant_id AND candidate.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND candidate.mutation_candidate_id=a.candidate_id
 JOIN control.idempotency_record idem ON idem.participant_id=a.participant_id AND idem.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND idem.operation_id=a.operation_id AND idem.idempotency_record_id=a.idempotency_record_id
 JOIN control.mutation_evidence receipt ON receipt.participant_id=a.participant_id AND receipt.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND receipt.operation_id=a.operation_id AND receipt.aggregate_id=a.envelope_id
 JOIN control.outbox_event event ON event.participant_id=receipt.participant_id AND event.privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND event.aggregate_type='authority-envelope' AND event.aggregate_id=a.envelope_id AND event.event_type='openpc.authority-envelope.mutation.committed.v1'
  AND event.payload_cbor=receipt.evidence_cbor AND event.payload_digest=receipt.evidence_digest AND event.cose_sign1=receipt.cose_sign1
 WHERE r.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND r.rotation_id=NEW.rotation_id AND r.recovery_case_id=NEW.recovery_id
  AND selection.admission_version=(NEW.authority_binding#>>'{lease,selectionAdmissionVersion}')::numeric+1 AND selection.profile_digest=decode('54d85c86019a4475f8207f375fa571565e9e6e0adb5b0bd55abc03e4beb81f74','hex')
  AND k.signing_purpose_code=371 AND g.signing_purpose_code=371 AND g.profile_digest=selection.profile_digest AND life.state='ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.business_signing_grant ordinary WHERE ordinary.participant_id=k.participant_id AND ordinary.privacy_domain_id=k.privacy_domain_id AND ordinary.signer_id=k.signer_id)
  AND a.state='COMMITTED' AND a.row_version=4 AND a.reserved_at_ns>=r.cutover_at_ns AND a.committed_at<=NEW.created_at
  AND a.payload_digest=sha256(a.payload_cbor) AND a.request->>'expectedFingerprint'=k.signer_id AND a.request->>'trustContextDigest'='sha256:'||encode(k.trust_digest,'hex')
  AND a.request->>'reference'=k.secret_reference AND a.request->>'version'=k.secret_version AND a.request->>'callerWorkloadCredentialId'=k.workload_credential_id::text
  AND candidate.state='CONSUMED' AND candidate.consumed_operation_id=a.operation_id AND candidate.candidate_digest=a.candidate_digest AND candidate.resource_id=a.envelope_id
  AND candidate.action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANT_ACTIVATE_CONTEXT-V1' AND candidate.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATE'
  AND idem.terminal_state='COMMITTED' AND idem.action_intent_id=candidate.action_intent_id AND idem.catalog_operation_id=candidate.catalog_operation_id
  AND e.representation='TYPED_V1' AND e.state='ACTIVE' AND e.row_version=4 AND e.last_mutation_operation_id=a.operation_id
  AND e.cose_sign1=a.cose_sign1 AND e.semantic_cbor=p.proposal_cbor AND e.semantic_digest=p.proposal_digest
  AND receipt.action_intent_id=candidate.action_intent_id AND receipt.catalog_operation_id=candidate.catalog_operation_id AND receipt.aggregate_version=3
  AND receipt.evidence_digest=sha256(receipt.evidence_cbor) AND octet_length(receipt.cose_sign1)>0
  AND (NEW.result IS NULL OR (NEW.result->>'consumerActivationOperationId'=a.operation_id::text
   AND NEW.result->>'consumerEnvelopeId'=a.envelope_id::text AND NEW.result->>'consumerPayloadDigest'='sha256:'||encode(a.payload_digest,'hex')
