END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_root_expiry_recovery_case()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE e control.root_expiry_recovery_enrollment;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true) IS DISTINCT FROM '1' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ROOT-EXPIRY-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
  IF NEW.intent->>'qaDurationProfile'='LOCAL_QA_10X' AND
     current_setting('openpc.local_qa_duration_profile',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'LOCAL_QA_10X' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ROOT-EXPIRY-RECOVERY'; END IF;
  IF NEW.state<>'DRAFT' OR NEW.row_version<>1 OR NEW.result IS NOT NULL OR NEW.operation_id IS NOT NULL THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ROOT-EXPIRY-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 ELSE
  IF NEW.row_version<>OLD.row_version+1 OR NEW.updated_at<=OLD.updated_at
   OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','row_version','updated_at','result','operation_id','evidence_cbor','evidence_digest','evidence_cose']) IS DISTINCT FROM
      (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','row_version','updated_at','result','operation_id','evidence_cbor','evidence_digest','evidence_cose'])
   OR NOT ((OLD.state='DRAFT' AND NEW.state IN ('REQUESTED','REVOKED','EXPIRED')) OR
      (OLD.state='REQUESTED' AND NEW.state IN ('COMPLETED','REVOKED','EXPIRED')))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ROOT-EXPIRY-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF NEW.intent->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'pc.identity.local-root-expiry-recovery-intent'
   OR NOT coalesce(((NEW.intent->>'schemaVersion'='1' AND NEW.intent->>'purpose'='LOCAL_ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY_ONLY'
      AND NOT (NEW.intent ? 'pending')) OR (NEW.intent->>'schemaVersion'='2'
      AND NEW.intent->>'purpose'='LOCAL_ROOT_EXPIRY_PENDING_RECOVERY_ONLY' AND jsonb_typeof(NEW.intent->'pending')='object')
      OR (NEW.intent->>'schemaVersion'='3' AND NEW.intent->>'purpose'='LOCAL_ROOT_EXPIRY_PENDING_ANCESTRY_RECOVERY_ONLY'
        AND jsonb_typeof(NEW.intent->'pending')='object' AND jsonb_typeof(NEW.intent->'rootAncestry')='object')),false)
   OR NEW.intent_digest<>sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(NEW.intent),'UTF8'))
   OR NEW.intent->>'recoveryId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.recovery_id::text OR NEW.intent->>'enrollmentId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.enrollment_id::text
   OR NEW.intent->>'enrollmentRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.enrollment_revision::text
   OR NEW.intent->>'enrollmentDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(NEW.enrollment_digest,'hex')
   OR (NEW.intent->>'validFrom')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.valid_from OR (NEW.intent->>'validUntil')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.valid_until
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ROOT-EXPIRY-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 IF NEW.state IN ('DRAFT','REQUESTED') THEN
  SELECT * INTO e FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_enrollment WHERE enrollment_id=NEW.enrollment_id AND participant_id=NEW.participant_id
   AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND row_version=NEW.enrollment_revision AND document_digest=NEW.enrollment_digest
   AND valid_until>=NEW.valid_until AND openpc.root_expiry_recovery_source_current(enrollment_id);
  IF NOT FOUND OR NEW.valid_until<=clock_timestamp()
   OR NEW.intent->'qaDurationProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM e.document->'qaDurationProfile'
   OR NEW.intent->>'schemaVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM e.document->>'schemaVersion'
   OR NEW.intent->'pending' IS DISTINCT FROM e.document->'pending'
   OR NEW.intent->'rootAncestry' IS DISTINCT FROM e.document->'rootAncestry'
   OR NEW.valid_until>NEW.valid_from+(CASE WHEN e.document->>'qaDurationProfile'='LOCAL_QA_10X' THEN interval '2 days' ELSE interval '15 minutes' END)
   -- Historical signed cases retain their original ceiling on continuation.
   OR (TG_OP='INSERT' AND e.document->>'qaDurationProfile'='LOCAL_QA_10X'
       AND NEW.valid_until>NEW.valid_from+interval '150 minutes')
   OR NEW.intent->>'predecessorEpoch' IS DISTINCT FROM e.document->>'rootEpoch'
   OR NEW.intent->>'predecessorRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM e.document->>'rootRevision'
   OR NEW.intent->>'predecessorDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM e.document->>'rootDigest'
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ROOT-EXPIRY-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF NEW.state='REQUESTED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_proof p
  WHERE p.recovery_id=NEW.recovery_id AND p.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND p.phase='REQUEST' AND p.intent_digest=NEW.intent_digest) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ROOT-EXPIRY-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 IF NEW.state='COMPLETED' AND (current_user<>'openpc_control_owner' OR NEW.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_operation_id()
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_scope s WHERE s.recovery_id=NEW.recovery_id
    AND s.owner_participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND s.installation_privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
    AND s.activation_operation_id=NEW.operation_id AND s.intent_digest=NEW.intent_digest AND s.enrollment_digest=NEW.enrollment_digest)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ROOT-EXPIRY-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_root_expiry_recovery_challenge()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND (OLD.consumed_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.consumed_at IS NULL OR NEW.proof_id IS NULL
   OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['consumed_at','proof_id']) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['consumed_at','proof_id'])
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_proof p WHERE p.proof_id=NEW.proof_id AND p.challenge_id=NEW.challenge_id
    AND p.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND p.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND p.recovery_id=NEW.recovery_id)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' AND (NEW.consumed_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.proof_id IS NOT NULL) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' AND NEW.verified_proof_max_age_ms IS DISTINCT FROM
   (CASE WHEN NEW.duration_profile='LOCAL_QA_10X' THEN 3000000 ELSE 300000 END) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' AND NEW.duration_profile='LOCAL_QA_10X' AND
  (current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true) IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
   OR current_setting('openpc.local_qa_duration_profile',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'LOCAL_QA_10X'
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_case r
     WHERE r.recovery_id=NEW.recovery_id AND r.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
      AND r.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND r.intent_digest=NEW.intent_digest
      AND r.intent->>'qaDurationProfile'='LOCAL_QA_10X' AND NEW.expires_at<=r.valid_until)
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.session s JOIN control.credential c
      ON c.participant_id=s.participant_id AND c.principal_id=s.principal_id AND c.credential_id=NEW.credential_id
     WHERE s.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND s.principal_id=NEW.principal_id AND s.session_id=NEW.session_id
      AND s.session_epoch=NEW.session_epoch AND s.duration_profile='LOCAL_QA_10X' AND s.state='ACTIVE'
      AND NEW.expires_at<=s.idle_expires_at AND NEW.expires_at<=s.absolute_expires_at
      AND c.kind='WEBAUTHN' AND c.state='ACTIVE' AND c.valid_from<=clock_timestamp()
      AND (c.valid_until IS NULL OR NEW.expires_at<=c.valid_until))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_root_expiry_recovery_installation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE expected_schema text; record_id text;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-SIGNER-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
  IF OLD.state<>'ACTIVE' OR NEW.state<>'REVOKED' OR NEW.row_version<>OLD.row_version+1
   OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','row_version','revoked_at','revocation_reason_digest']) IS DISTINCT FROM
      (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','row_version','revoked_at','revocation_reason_digest']) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-SIGNER-RECOVERY'; END IF;
  NEW.revoked_at:=clock_timestamp();
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 IF current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true) IS DISTINCT FROM '1' OR current_user<>'openpc_control_owner' OR NOT pg_has_role(session_user,'openpc_control_owner','MEMBER')
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=session_user AND rolcanlogin AND NOT rolsuper AND NOT rolbypassrls)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-SIGNER-RECOVERY-INSTALLATION'; END IF;
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 expected_schema:=CASE TG_TABLE_NAME
  WHEN 'root_expiry_recovery_trust' THEN 'pc.installation.local-root-expiry-recovery-receiving-trust'
  WHEN 'root_expiry_recovery_enrollment' THEN 'pc.identity.local-root-expiry-recovery-enrollment'
  ELSE NULL END;
 record_id:=CASE TG_TABLE_NAME
  WHEN 'root_expiry_recovery_trust' THEN to_jsonb(NEW)->>'custody_trust_id'
  ELSE to_jsonb(NEW)->>'enrollment_id' END;
 IF NEW.document->>'schemaVersion' IN ('2','3') THEN PERFORM openpc.lock_root_expiry_pending_source(NEW.platform_context_id); END IF;
 IF expected_schema IS NULL OR NEW.document->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_schema
  OR NOT coalesce(((NEW.document->>'schemaVersion'='1'
      AND NEW.document->>'purpose'='pc.installation.local-root-expiry-recovery-custody.v1' AND NOT (NEW.document ? 'pending')
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_scope_replacement r WHERE r.platform_context_id=NEW.platform_context_id AND r.state='WITHDRAWING'))
    OR (NEW.document->>'schemaVersion'='2'
      AND NEW.document->>'purpose'='pc.installation.local-root-expiry-pending-recovery-custody.v2'
      AND NEW.document->'pending'=openpc.read_root_expiry_pending_witness(NEW.platform_context_id))
    OR (NEW.document->>'schemaVersion'='3'
      AND NEW.document->>'purpose'='pc.installation.local-root-expiry-pending-ancestry-custody.v3'
      AND jsonb_build_object('pending',NEW.document->'pending','rootAncestry',NEW.document->'rootAncestry')=
        openpc.read_root_expiry_pending_ancestry_witness(NEW.platform_context_id))),false)
  OR NEW.document->>'profile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'LOCAL_QA'
  OR (NEW.document ? 'qaDurationProfile' AND (NEW.document->>'qaDurationProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'LOCAL_QA_10X'
      OR current_setting('openpc.local_qa_duration_profile',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'LOCAL_QA_10X'))
  OR NEW.valid_until>NEW.valid_from+(CASE WHEN NEW.document->>'qaDurationProfile'='LOCAL_QA_10X' THEN interval '10 days' ELSE interval '1 day' END)
  OR NEW.state<>'ACTIVE' OR NEW.row_version<>1
  OR NEW.document_digest<>sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(NEW.document),'UTF8'))
  OR NOT openpc.matches_participant(NEW.participant_id) OR NOT openpc.matches_privacy(NEW.privacy_domain_id)
  OR NEW.document->>'participantId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.participant_id::text
  OR NEW.document->>'privacyDomainId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.privacy_domain_id::text
  OR NEW.document->>'platformContextId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.platform_context_id::text
  OR (NEW.document->>'validFrom')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.valid_from
  OR (NEW.document->>'validUntil')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.valid_until
  OR NEW.valid_from>clock_timestamp() OR NEW.valid_until<=clock_timestamp()
  OR (CASE WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='root_expiry_recovery_trust'
    THEN NEW.document->>'custodyTrustId' ELSE NEW.document->>'enrollmentId' END) IS DISTINCT FROM record_id
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-SIGNER-RECOVERY-INSTALLATION'; END IF;
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='root_expiry_recovery_enrollment' THEN
  IF NEW.document->>'custodyTrustId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.custody_trust_id::text
   OR NEW.document->>'custodyTrustDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(NEW.custody_trust_digest,'hex')
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_trust trust
    WHERE trust.custody_trust_id=NEW.custody_trust_id AND trust.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
     AND trust.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND trust.document_digest=NEW.custody_trust_digest
     AND trust.document->'qaDurationProfile' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.document->'qaDurationProfile'
     AND trust.document->>'schemaVersion'=NEW.document->>'schemaVersion'
     AND trust.document->>'purpose'=NEW.document->>'purpose'
     AND trust.document->'pending' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.document->'pending'
     AND trust.document->'rootAncestry' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.document->'rootAncestry'
     AND trust.state='ACTIVE' AND trust.row_version=1 AND trust.valid_from<=NEW.valid_from AND trust.valid_until>=NEW.valid_until)
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-SIGNER-RECOVERY-CUSTODY'; END IF;
  IF (NEW.document->>'successorValidFrom')::timestamptz < clock_timestamp()-interval '30 seconds'
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_trust trust WHERE trust.custody_trust_id=NEW.custody_trust_id
    AND (NEW.document->>'successorValidFrom')::timestamptz>=trust.created_at-interval '30 seconds')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ROOT-EXPIRY-RECOVERY-INSTALLATION-TIME'; END IF;
 END IF;
 NEW.created_at:=clock_timestamp();
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_root_expiry_recovery_proof()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_challenge c JOIN control.root_expiry_recovery_case r
   ON r.recovery_id=c.recovery_id AND r.participant_id=c.participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
  JOIN control.root_expiry_recovery_enrollment source ON source.enrollment_id=r.enrollment_id
   AND source.participant_id=r.participant_id AND source.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id
   AND source.state='ACTIVE' AND source.row_version=r.enrollment_revision AND source.document_digest=r.enrollment_digest
   AND openpc.root_expiry_recovery_source_current(source.enrollment_id)
  JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN NEW.phase='APPROVE' THEN source.document->'custodians'
    ELSE jsonb_build_array(source.document->'recoveryPrincipal') END) signer
   ON signer->>'principalId'=NEW.principal_id::text AND signer->>'credentialId'=NEW.credential_id::text
    AND signer->>'principalEpoch'=NEW.principal_epoch::text AND signer->>'credentialEpoch'=NEW.credential_epoch::text
  JOIN control.principal p ON p.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND p.principal_id=NEW.principal_id
   AND p.state='ACTIVE' AND p.authority_epoch=NEW.principal_epoch
  JOIN control.credential credential ON credential.participant_id=p.participant_id AND credential.principal_id=p.principal_id
   AND credential.credential_id=NEW.credential_id AND credential.credential_epoch=NEW.credential_epoch
   AND credential.kind='WEBAUTHN' AND credential.state='ACTIVE' AND credential.valid_from<=clock_timestamp()
   AND (credential.valid_until IS NULL OR credential.valid_until>clock_timestamp())
  JOIN control.session session ON session.participant_id=p.participant_id AND session.principal_id=p.principal_id
   AND session.session_id=NEW.session_id AND session.session_epoch=NEW.session_epoch AND session.authority_epoch=p.authority_epoch
   AND session.context_mode='PLATFORM' AND session.privacy_domain_id IS NULL AND session.state='ACTIVE'
   AND session.idle_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND session.absolute_expires_at>clock_timestamp()
  JOIN control.participant participant ON participant.participant_id=p.participant_id AND participant.state='ACTIVE'
   AND participant.authority_epoch=session.participant_epoch
  WHERE c.challenge_id=NEW.challenge_id AND c.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
   AND c.recovery_id=NEW.recovery_id AND c.principal_id=NEW.principal_id AND c.credential_id=NEW.credential_id
   AND c.session_id=NEW.session_id AND c.session_epoch=NEW.session_epoch AND c.phase=NEW.phase
   AND c.intent_digest=NEW.intent_digest AND r.intent_digest=NEW.intent_digest
   AND ((NEW.phase='REQUEST' AND r.state='DRAFT') OR (NEW.phase IN ('APPROVE','ACTIVATE') AND r.state='REQUESTED'))
   AND c.consumed_at IS NULL AND c.expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND r.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
   AND NEW.verified_at BETWEEN c.created_at AND clock_timestamp()
   AND source.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND source.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
   AND (source.document->>'assurance'='LOCAL_QA_VIRTUAL_AUTHENTICATOR' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.hardware_authenticator h
    WHERE h.participant_id=p.participant_id AND h.principal_id=p.principal_id AND h.credential_id=credential.credential_id))
   AND NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,version}'='OPENPC_VERIFIED_WEBAUTHN_ASSERTION_V1'
   AND NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,userVerification}'='REQUIRED_VERIFIED'
   AND NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,credentialId}'=credential.credential_id::text
   AND NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,credentialPublicKeyDigest}'='sha256:'||encode(credential.public_key_digest,'hex')
   AND NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,principalId}'=NEW.principal_id::text
   AND NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,sessionId}'=NEW.session_id::text
   AND NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,actionIntentId}'='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
   AND NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,resourceDigest}'='sha256:'||encode(NEW.intent_digest,'hex')
   AND NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,challengeDigest}'='sha256:'||encode(c.challenge_digest,'hex')
   AND NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,origin}'=c.origin
   AND NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,signCount}'=NEW.authenticator_sign_count::text
   AND (NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,verifiedAt}')::timestamptz=NEW.verified_at) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 IF NEW.assertion_digest IS DISTINCT FROM sha256(convert_to(NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,version}','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,credentialId}','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,credentialPublicKeyDigest}','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,principalId}','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,sessionId}','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,actionIntentId}','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,resourceDigest}','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,challengeDigest}','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,rpIdHash}','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,origin}','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,authenticatorDataDigest}','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,clientDataJsonDigest}','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,signatureDigest}','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,signCount}','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,verifiedAt}','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(NEW.assertion_evidence#>>'{verified,userVerification}','UTF8')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_root_expiry_recovery_scope()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR current_user<>'openpc_control_owner' OR NEW.activation_operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_operation_id()
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_case c JOIN control.root_expiry_recovery_enrollment e
  ON e.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id AND e.participant_id=c.participant_id AND e.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
  JOIN control.platform_context p ON p.platform_context_id=e.platform_context_id AND p.owner_participant_id=e.participant_id
  WHERE c.recovery_id=NEW.recovery_id AND c.state='REQUESTED' AND c.intent_digest=NEW.intent_digest AND c.enrollment_digest=NEW.enrollment_digest
   AND p.authority_epoch=NEW.predecessor_epoch AND p.authority_epoch+1=NEW.platform_authority_epoch
   AND openpc.root_expiry_recovery_source_current(e.enrollment_id)
   AND openpc.root_expiry_recovery_proofs_current(c,(select proof_id from control.root_expiry_recovery_proof
     where recovery_id=c.recovery_id and participant_id=c.participant_id and phase='ACTIVATE'))
   AND NEW.predecessor_digest=decode(substring(c.intent->>'predecessorDigest' from 8),'hex')
   AND openpc.platform_scope_document(NEW.scope_cbor)=c.intent->'successorScope') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ROOT-EXPIRY-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_rpc_provenance()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE p jsonb:=NEW.projection; a jsonb:=p->'activation'; t jsonb:=p->'transition'; deleted_source control.evidence_catalogue;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN
  SELECT * INTO STRICT deleted_source FROM control.evidence_catalogue WHERE participant_id=OLD.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=OLD.privacy_domain_id
   AND stream_id=OLD.stream_id AND record_id=OLD.record_id;
  PERFORM openpc.record_projection_deletion(deleted_source,'NORMALIZED_JSON_PROJECTION',OLD.projection);RETURN OLD;
 END IF;
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6020-IMMUTABLE-ROW'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.evidence_projection_retirement r WHERE r.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
  AND r.data_class='NORMALIZED_JSON_PROJECTION' AND r.stream_id=NEW.stream_id AND r.record_id=NEW.record_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 IF current_setting('openpc.action_intent_id')<>'ACT-EVIDENCE_EXPORT_RECORDS-V1'
  OR NEW.participant_id<>current_setting('openpc.participant_id')::uuid
  OR NEW.privacy_domain_id<>current_setting('openpc.privacy_domain_id')::uuid THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 IF p-ARRAY['integrity','activationIntegrity','authority','currentAuthority','providerEffect','chainFinality',
  'decisionId','targetRuntimeId','spoolId','sourceSequence','sourceDigest','capsuleDigest','reservedAtNs','occurredAtNs','transition','activation']<>'{}'::jsonb
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(p))<>16
  OR a-ARRAY['operationId','attemptId','configurationWorkId','generationId','generationDigest','receiptDigest','signerId','verificationKeyDigest']<>'{}'::jsonb
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(a))<>8
  OR t-ARRAY['phase','traceId','requestDigest','decisionDigest','responseDigest','authorityBindingDigest','sourceScopeDigest','operationId',
   'pcCode','decisionEffect','boundary','sourceSegmentId','sourceRecordDigest','admittedAtNs']<>'{}'::jsonb
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(t))<>14
  OR p->>'integrity' IS DISTINCT FROM 'AEAD_CHAIN_VERIFIED_AT_CUSTODY'
  OR p->>'activationIntegrity' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ACTIVATION_COSE_VERIFIED_AT_CUSTODY'
  OR p->>'authority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'NONE' OR p->>'currentAuthority' IS DISTINCT FROM 'NOT_ESTABLISHED'
  OR p->>'providerEffect' IS DISTINCT FROM 'NOT_ESTABLISHED' OR p->>'chainFinality' IS DISTINCT FROM 'NOT_ESTABLISHED'
  OR NEW.projection_digest<>'sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(p),'UTF8')),'hex')
  OR NEW.record_id<>'rpc:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(jsonb_build_array(p->>'targetRuntimeId',p->>'spoolId')),'UTF8')),'hex')||':'||(p->>'sourceSequence')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.evidence_catalogue c WHERE c.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
  AND c.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND c.stream_id=NEW.stream_id AND c.record_id=NEW.record_id
  AND c.evidence_class='EFFECT' AND c.source_format='OPENPC_RPC_DECISION_TRANSITION_V1'
  AND c.receipt_digest=p->>'sourceDigest' AND c.sequence::text=p->>'sourceSequence'
  AND extract(epoch FROM c.occurred_at)*1000000=floor((p->>'occurredAtNs')::numeric/1000)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_activation_observation o JOIN control.configuration_work w
  ON w.participant_id=o.participant_id AND w.privacy_domain_id=o.privacy_domain_id AND w.configuration_work_id=o.configuration_work_id
   AND w.runtime_target_id=o.runtime_target_id AND w.runtime_configuration_generation_id=o.runtime_configuration_generation_id
   AND w.operation_id=o.operation_id AND w.execution_attempt_id=o.execution_attempt_id AND w.generation_digest=o.generation_digest AND w.state='COMPLETED'
  WHERE o.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND o.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
   AND o.runtime_target_id::text=p->>'targetRuntimeId' AND o.capsule_digest=p->>'capsuleDigest'
   AND o.operation_id::text=a->>'operationId' AND o.execution_attempt_id::text=a->>'attemptId'
   AND o.configuration_work_id::text=a->>'configurationWorkId' AND o.runtime_configuration_generation_id::text=a->>'generationId'
   AND o.generation_digest=a->>'generationDigest'
   AND 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(decode(o.activation_receipt->>'activationReceiptCoseHex','hex')),'hex')=a->>'receiptDigest') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_runtime_activation_maintenance()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ACTIVATION-MAINTENANCE-IMMUTABLE'; END IF;
 IF current_user<>session_user OR current_setting('role')<>'none'
 OR NEW.intent->>'databaseRole' IS DISTINCT FROM current_user::text
 OR NEW.intent->>'workerRole' IS DISTINCT FROM 'openpc_control_worker'
 OR NOT pg_has_role(current_user,'openpc_control_worker','USAGE')
 OR pg_has_role(current_user,'openpc_control_owner','USAGE')
 OR has_schema_privilege(current_user,'control','CREATE')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN(current_user,session_user) AND (rolsuper OR rolbypassrls))
 OR current_setting('session_replication_role')<>'origin' 
 OR current_setting('row_security')<>'on'
 OR NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM control.configuration_work w
  JOIN control.runtime_activation_observation o USING(configuration_work_id,participant_id,privacy_domain_id,operation_id,execution_attempt_id,runtime_target_id,runtime_configuration_generation_id,generation_digest,xds_version_digest)
  JOIN control.policy_activation_occurrence_target c ON c.participant_id=w.participant_id
   AND c.privacy_domain_id=w.privacy_domain_id AND c.configuration_work_id=w.configuration_work_id
   AND c.phase='FORWARD' AND c.state='ACTIVE_MATCHED'
  JOIN control.runtime_target_disposition_admission a ON a.participant_id=w.participant_id
   AND a.privacy_domain_id=w.privacy_domain_id AND a.runtime_target_id=w.runtime_target_id
   AND a.revision=(NEW.intent->>'dispositionRevision')::bigint
  JOIN control.runtime_target_disposition_delivery d ON d.participant_id=a.participant_id
   AND d.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND d.runtime_target_id=a.runtime_target_id AND d.revision=a.revision
  JOIN control.runtime_target_disposition_acknowledgement k ON k.participant_id=d.participant_id
   AND k.privacy_domain_id=d.privacy_domain_id AND k.runtime_target_id=d.runtime_target_id AND k.delivery_digest=d.delivery_digest
  WHERE w.configuration_work_id=NEW.configuration_work_id AND w.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
   AND w.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND w.operation_id=NEW.operation_id
   AND w.execution_attempt_id=NEW.execution_attempt_id AND w.result_event_id=NEW.result_event_id
   AND w.state='COMPLETED' AND w.work_kind='RUNTIME_ACTIVATION' AND w.predecessor_digest IS NULL
   AND w.attempt_count=NEW.claim_count AND w.lease_owner IS NULL AND w.lease_until IS NULL
   AND w.xmin=pg_current_xact_id()::xid
   AND NEW.intent->>'schemaVersion'='1'
   AND NEW.intent->>'occurrenceId'=c.activation_occurrence_id::text
   AND a.binding->>'action'='ConfirmActivation'
   AND a.binding->'source'->>'original_work_id'=w.configuration_work_id::text
   AND a.activation_proof->>'occurrenceId'=c.activation_occurrence_id::text
   AND NEW.intent->>'deliveryDigest'='sha256:'||encode(sha256(d.signed_delivery),'hex')
   AND NEW.intent->>'acknowledgementDigest'='sha256:'||encode(sha256(k.signed_acknowledgement),'hex')
   AND NEW.intent->>'participantId'=w.participant_id::text
   AND NEW.intent->>'privacyDomainId'=w.privacy_domain_id::text
   AND NEW.intent->>'workId'=w.configuration_work_id::text
   AND NEW.intent->>'operationId'=w.operation_id::text
   AND NEW.intent->>'executionAttemptId'=w.execution_attempt_id::text
   AND NEW.intent->>'runtimeTargetId'=w.runtime_target_id::text
   AND NEW.intent->>'generationId'=w.runtime_configuration_generation_id::text
   AND NEW.intent->>'generationDigest'=w.generation_digest
   AND NEW.intent->>'configurationDigest'=w.configuration_digest
   AND NEW.intent->>'xdsVersionDigest'=w.xds_version_digest
   AND NEW.intent->>'capsuleDigest'=o.capsule_digest
   AND NEW.intent->>'receiptDigest'=o.activation_receipt_digest
   AND NEW.intent->>'receiptDigest'=w.result_receipt_digest
   AND (NEW.intent->>'claimCount')::bigint=NEW.claim_count
 ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ACTIVATION-MAINTENANCE-ORIGINAL-REJECTED'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
operation text, old_job control.deletion_job, new_job control.deletion_job

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_runtime_artifact_lifecycle_fence()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF openpc.current_participant_id() IS NULL OR openpc.current_privacy_domain_id() IS NULL
   OR TG_OP='TRUNCATE' OR current_setting('session_replication_role')<>'origin'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='P0001',MESSAGE='PC-DATA-6004'; END IF;
 -- Producers can already own module, policy, target or occurrence locks.
 -- Never wait in the reverse order. Use the exclusive lock also used by
 -- evidence publication, avoiding shared-to-exclusive upgrade deadlocks.
 IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('evidence-lifecycle:'||
   openpc.current_participant_id()::text,0))
 -- This is a definite statement/transaction abort, not an unknown effect.
 -- Serializable public owners may retry their same operation after rollback.
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_runtime_artifact_retirement()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE source record; job control.deletion_job;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR pg_trigger_depth()<>2 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6020-IMMUTABLE-ROW'; END IF;
 PERFORM openpc.assert_runtime_artifact_retirement_context();
 IF openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-EVIDENCE_DELETIONS_CREATE_RUNTIME_BATCH-V1'
  OR NEW.participant_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_participant_id()
  OR NEW.privacy_domain_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_privacy_domain_id() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 SELECT module_installation_id,module_configuration_generation_id,configuration_digest,created_at,resource_bindings,selected,
  openpc.runtime_artifact_input_information(runtime_configuration_input_id) info INTO STRICT source
  FROM control.runtime_configuration_input WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND runtime_configuration_input_id=NEW.runtime_configuration_input_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT job FROM control.deletion_job WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
  AND deletion_job_id=NEW.deletion_job_id AND operation_id=openpc.current_operation_id()
  AND state='EXECUTING' AND revision=0 AND target_database='openpc_control' AND target_data_class='RUNTIME_ARTIFACT'
  AND external_attempt_state='NOT_STARTED';
 IF source.selected OR source.info->'bytesMatch' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
  OR NEW.module_installation_id IS DISTINCT FROM source.module_installation_id
  OR NEW.module_configuration_generation_id IS DISTINCT FROM source.module_configuration_generation_id
  OR NEW.configuration_digest IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(source.configuration_digest,'hex')
  OR NEW.configuration_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM (source.info->>'byteLength')::integer
  OR NEW.source_created_at IS DISTINCT FROM source.created_at
  OR NEW.resource_bindings_digest IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(source.resource_bindings),'UTF8')),'hex')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RUNTIME-ARTIFACT-RETIREMENT-SOURCE'; END IF;
 NEW.retirement_digest:=openpc.runtime_artifact_retirement_digest(NEW);
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_runtime_artifact_source_installation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.archive_custody IS NOT NULL AND (
  NEW.custody_root->>'consumer_profile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'openpc:local-runtime-source-consumers:v2'
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.archive_custody) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR NEW.archive_custody IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('database_role',NEW.archive_custody->'database_role','stream_id',NEW.archive_custody->'stream_id','keys',NEW.archive_custody->'keys')
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.archive_custody->'keys') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR coalesce(NEW.archive_custody->>'stream_id','') !~ '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9:._-]{0,159}$'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname=NEW.archive_custody->>'database_role' AND r.rolcanlogin
   AND NOT r.rolsuper AND NOT r.rolbypassrls AND NOT r.rolcreaterole AND NOT r.rolcreatedb AND NOT r.rolreplication
   AND pg_has_role(r.oid,'openpc_control_worker','USAGE')
   AND shobj_description(r.oid,'pg_authid')::jsonb=jsonb_build_object('installation',jsonb_build_object('participant_id',NEW.participant_id::text,
 'privacy_domain_id',NEW.privacy_domain_id::text,'source_owner_id',NEW.source_owner_id::text,
 'source_file_binding',encode(NEW.source_file_binding,'hex')),'root',NEW.custody_root,'archive',NEW.archive_custody)))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RUNTIME-ARTIFACT-ARCHIVE-INSTALLATION-UNAVAILABLE'; END IF;
 IF NEW.custody_root IS NOT NULL AND (
  NEW.custody_root IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(
   'generation_id',NEW.custody_root->>'generation_id',
   'journal_binding',NEW.custody_root->>'journal_binding',
   'retained_root_binding',NEW.custody_root->>'retained_root_binding',
   'consumer_profile',NEW.custody_root->>'consumer_profile') ||
   CASE WHEN NEW.custody_root->>'consumer_profile'='openpc:local-runtime-source-consumers:v2'
    THEN jsonb_build_object('database',openpc.runtime_artifact_database_identity()) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
  OR coalesce(NEW.custody_root->>'consumer_profile','') NOT IN ('openpc:local-runtime-source-consumers:v1','openpc:local-runtime-source-consumers:v2')
  OR coalesce(NEW.custody_root->>'generation_id','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  OR coalesce(NEW.custody_root->>'journal_binding','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR coalesce(NEW.custody_root->>'retained_root_binding','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR NEW.custody_root->>'journal_binding'=NEW.custody_root->>'retained_root_binding')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 -- Rooted custody is installed with actual first trust. Existing scopes keep
 -- legacy custody; neither this birth pin nor an empty scope proves non-use.
 IF NEW.custody_root IS NOT NULL AND (
  NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.participant p WHERE p.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
    AND p.root_privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND p.xmin=pg_current_xact_id()::xid)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.privacy_domain p WHERE p.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
    AND p.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND p.xmin=pg_current_xact_id()::xid)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_artifact_source s WHERE s.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
    AND s.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RUNTIME-ARTIFACT-SOURCE-GENESIS-REQUIRED'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname=NEW.database_role AND r.rolcanlogin
  AND NOT r.rolsuper AND NOT r.rolbypassrls AND NOT r.rolcreaterole AND NOT r.rolcreatedb
  AND pg_has_role(r.oid,'openpc_control_worker','USAGE')
  AND NOT pg_has_role(r.oid,'openpc_control_runtime','MEMBER')
  AND NOT pg_has_role(r.oid,'openpc_control_owner','MEMBER')
  AND NOT pg_has_role(r.oid,'openpc_control_key_governor','MEMBER'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_runtime_configuration_input()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control', 'openpc'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN PERFORM openpc.assert_runtime_artifact_source_import(NEW); END IF;
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN
  -- The earlier authentic BEFORE DELETE capture must already exist. Only this
  -- transaction's exact governed job can release its original input row.
  IF pg_trigger_depth()<>1 OR openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-EVIDENCE_DELETIONS_CREATE_RUNTIME_BATCH-V1'
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_artifact_retirement r JOIN control.deletion_job j
    USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,deletion_job_id) WHERE r.participant_id=OLD.participant_id
     AND r.privacy_domain_id=OLD.privacy_domain_id AND r.runtime_configuration_input_id=OLD.runtime_configuration_input_id
     AND r.configuration_digest='sha256:'||encode(OLD.configuration_digest,'hex')
     AND r.configuration_bytes=octet_length(OLD.configuration_cbor) AND j.operation_id=openpc.current_operation_id()
     AND j.state='EXECUTING' AND j.revision=0)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='P0001',MESSAGE='PC-DATA-6004'; END IF;
  RETURN OLD;
 END IF;
 IF (TG_OP='UPDATE' AND
   (to_jsonb(NEW)-'selected') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'selected')) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='P0001',MESSAGE='PC-DATA-6004';
 END IF;
 -- A new row is new use even when it starts unselected. Matching bytes under
 -- another module installation/generation cannot bypass an original retirement.
 IF (TG_OP='INSERT' OR NEW.selected) AND
  openpc.runtime_artifact_new_use_allowed(NEW.participant_id,NEW.privacy_domain_id,NEW.configuration_digest) IS DISTINCT FROM true
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='P0001',MESSAGE='PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 IF NEW.selected AND (
   NOT openpc.runtime_configuration_bindings_current(NEW.participant_id,NEW.privacy_domain_id,NEW.resource_bindings)
   OR NOT EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM control.module_configuration_generation c
       JOIN control.module_installation i ON i.module_installation_id=c.module_installation_id
       JOIN control.module_version v ON v.module_version_id=i.module_version_id
      WHERE c.generation_id=NEW.module_configuration_generation_id
        AND c.module_installation_id=NEW.module_installation_id
        AND c.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
        AND i.participant_id=c.participant_id AND i.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
        AND c.active AND i.state='ENABLED' AND i.lifecycle_operation_id IS NOT NULL
        AND v.module_id='pc.config.assets'
   )) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='P0001',MESSAGE='PC-DATA-6007';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_runtime_denied_predecessor()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DENIED-PREDECESSOR-IMMUTABLE'; END IF;
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF current_user<>session_user OR current_setting('role')<>'none'
  OR NOT pg_has_role(current_user,'openpc_control_worker','USAGE')
  OR pg_has_role(current_user,'openpc_control_owner','USAGE')
  OR current_setting('row_security')<>'on' OR current_setting('session_replication_role')<>'origin'
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user AND (rolsuper OR rolbypassrls))
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_expired_activation_denial e
   LEFT JOIN control.runtime_expired_denial_handover h ON h.configuration_work_id=e.configuration_work_id
    AND h.participant_id=e.participant_id AND h.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id AND h.runtime_target_id=e.runtime_target_id
   JOIN control.configuration_work w ON w.configuration_work_id=e.configuration_work_id AND w.participant_id=e.participant_id
    AND w.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id AND w.runtime_target_id=e.runtime_target_id AND w.execution_attempt_id=e.execution_attempt_id
   JOIN control.runtime_activation_observation o ON o.configuration_work_id=w.configuration_work_id AND o.participant_id=w.participant_id
    AND o.privacy_domain_id=w.privacy_domain_id AND o.runtime_target_id=w.runtime_target_id AND o.execution_attempt_id=w.execution_attempt_id
   JOIN control.runtime_configuration_generation g ON g.runtime_configuration_generation_id=w.runtime_configuration_generation_id
    AND g.participant_id=w.participant_id AND g.privacy_domain_id=w.privacy_domain_id
   JOIN control.runtime_target t ON t.participant_id=w.participant_id AND t.privacy_domain_id=w.privacy_domain_id
    AND t.runtime_target_id=w.runtime_target_id
   JOIN control.runtime_target_disposition_admission a ON a.participant_id=e.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
    AND a.runtime_target_id=e.runtime_target_id AND a.revision=coalesce(h.admission_revision,e.admission_revision)
   JOIN control.runtime_target_disposition_delivery d ON d.participant_id=a.participant_id AND d.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id
    AND d.runtime_target_id=a.runtime_target_id AND d.revision=a.revision
   JOIN control.runtime_target_disposition_acknowledgement k ON k.participant_id=d.participant_id AND k.privacy_domain_id=d.privacy_domain_id
    AND k.runtime_target_id=d.runtime_target_id AND k.delivery_digest=d.delivery_digest
   JOIN control.outbox_event event ON event.event_id=w.result_event_id AND event.participant_id=w.participant_id
    AND event.privacy_domain_id=w.privacy_domain_id AND event.aggregate_id=w.runtime_target_id
   JOIN control.mutation_evidence approval ON approval.participant_id=w.participant_id
    AND approval.privacy_domain_id=w.privacy_domain_id AND approval.operation_id=w.operation_id
   WHERE e.configuration_work_id=NEW.configuration_work_id AND e.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
    AND e.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND e.runtime_target_id=NEW.runtime_target_id
    AND e.proof->'intent'->'custody'->>'databaseRole'=current_user::text
    AND e.capsule_digest=NEW.capsule_digest AND e.capsule_generation=NEW.capsule_generation
    AND w.predecessor_digest=NEW.last_confirmed_capsule_digest AND w.xds_version_digest=NEW.xds_version_digest
    AND w.state='FAILED' AND w.xmin=pg_current_xact_id()::xid AND w.completed_at IS NOT NULL
    AND w.reconcile_after IS NULL AND w.lease_owner IS NULL AND w.lease_until IS NULL
    AND w.result_event_id=NEW.result_event_id AND g.state='FAILED' AND g.activated_at IS NULL
    AND t.state='FAILED' AND t.active_generation_digest=NEW.last_confirmed_capsule_digest AND t.desired_generation_digest IS NULL
    AND w.result_receipt=jsonb_build_object('outcome','EXPIRED_OBSERVED_DENIED','errorCode','PC-RUNTIME-3002',
     'observedEffect',true,'runtimeNewUse','DENIED','capsuleDigest',e.capsule_digest,
     'originalReceiptDigest',o.activation_receipt_digest,'denialDeliveryDigest',d.delivery_digest,
     'denialAcknowledgementDigest','sha256:'||encode(sha256(k.signed_acknowledgement),'hex'),
     'terminal',true,'resourceId',w.runtime_target_id::text,'workKind','RUNTIME_ACTIVATION')
    AND w.result_receipt_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(w.result_receipt),'UTF8')),'hex')
    AND event.event_type='runtime-target.activation-expired-denied.v1' AND event.aggregate_type='runtime-targets'
    AND event.payload_cbor=convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(w.result_receipt),'UTF8')
    AND event.payload_digest=sha256(event.payload_cbor) AND event.cose_sign1=approval.cose_sign1
    AND octet_length(approval.cose_sign1)>0
    AND a.revision=NEW.denial_revision AND a.admission_digest=coalesce(h.admission_digest,e.admission_digest) AND a.binding->>'action'='Withdraw'
    AND a.binding->'source'->>'original_work_id'=w.configuration_work_id::text
    AND a.binding->'source'->>'capsule_digest'=substring(e.capsule_digest from 8)
    AND ((h.configuration_work_id IS NULL AND a.binding->'cause'=jsonb_build_object('kind','Activation','work_id',w.configuration_work_id::text,
     'operation_id',w.operation_id::text,'execution_attempt_id',w.execution_attempt_id::text))
     OR (h.configuration_work_id IS NOT NULL AND h.abandoned_revision=e.admission_revision
      AND h.abandoned_admission_digest=e.admission_digest AND h.admission_revision=h.abandoned_revision+1
      AND (a.binding->'cause'->>'kind'='ExpiredObservedDenialHandover'
       OR (a.binding->'cause'->>'kind'='ExpiredObservedCredentialDenialHandover'
        AND h.proof->'intent'->>'purpose'='EXPIRED_OBSERVED_CREDENTIAL_DENIAL_HANDOVER_V1'
        AND a.binding->'target'=h.proof->'target'
        AND a.binding->'cause'->'abandoned_target'=e.proof->'target'
        AND a.binding->'cause'->>'credential_rotation_operation_id'=h.proof->'intent'->'credentialTransition'->>'rotationOperationId'))
      AND a.binding->'cause'->>'abandoned_admission_digest'=substring(e.admission_digest from 8)
      AND a.binding->'cause'->>'original_receipt_wire_digest'=e.proof->>'receiptWireDigest'))
    AND a.revision=(SELECT max(h.revision) FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission h
     WHERE h.participant_id=e.participant_id AND h.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id AND h.runtime_target_id=e.runtime_target_id)
    AND d.delivery_digest=NEW.delivery_digest AND k.claims->>'installed_state'='NewUseDenied'
    AND NEW.acknowledgement_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(k.signed_acknowledgement),'hex'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DENIED-PREDECESSOR-ORIGINAL'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_runtime_generation_retry()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE prior control.runtime_configuration_generation; work control.configuration_work;
 target control.runtime_target; payload bytea;
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_configuration_generation g
  WHERE g.runtime_target_id=NEW.runtime_target_id AND g.generation_digest=NEW.generation_digest
   AND g.predecessor_digest IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.predecessor_digest AND g.state='FAILED')
 THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF NEW.participant_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_participant_id()
  OR NEW.privacy_domain_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
  OR openpc.current_action_intent_id() NOT IN
    ('ACT-RUNTIME_TARGETS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-POLICY_ACTIVATE_RELEASE-V1')
  OR current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'serializable'
  OR NEW.state<>'ACTIVATING' OR NEW.revision<>1 OR NEW.activated_at IS NOT NULL
  OR NEW.cigl_profile_selection IS NOT NULL
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007-RUNTIME-RETRY'; END IF;
 -- Reentrant with the shared BEFORE STATEMENT reference fence. Never reverse-wait.
 IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('evidence-lifecycle:'||NEW.participant_id::text,0))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT target FROM control.runtime_target t
  WHERE t.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND t.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
   AND t.runtime_target_id=NEW.runtime_target_id FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;
 -- Public activation still checks current discovery and expected revision;
 -- this guard only proves the old attempt cannot have dispatched an effect.
 IF target.state<>'FAILED' OR openpc.runtime_installed_predecessor(target.runtime_target_id) IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.predecessor_digest
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007-RUNTIME-RETRY'; END IF;
 IF openpc.current_action_intent_id()='ACT-POLICY_ACTIVATE_RELEASE-V1' AND
  (NEW.policy_generation_digest IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM control.policy_activation_occurrence occurrence
    JOIN control.policy_activation_occurrence_target cohort
      ON cohort.activation_occurrence_id=occurrence.activation_occurrence_id
     AND cohort.participant_id=occurrence.participant_id
     AND cohort.privacy_domain_id=occurrence.privacy_domain_id
    WHERE occurrence.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
      AND occurrence.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
      AND occurrence.state='REQUESTED'
      AND cohort.runtime_target_id=NEW.runtime_target_id
      AND cohort.phase='FORWARD' AND cohort.state='REQUESTED'
      AND cohort.configuration_work_id IS NULL
      AND cohort.expected_target_revision=target.revision
      AND cohort.expected_predecessor_digest IS NOT DISTINCT FROM target.active_generation_digest
      AND NEW.policy_generation_digest='sha256:'||encode(occurrence.target_generation_digest,'hex')
  )) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007-RUNTIME-RETRY'; END IF;
 FOR prior IN SELECT g.* FROM control.runtime_configuration_generation g
  WHERE g.runtime_target_id=NEW.runtime_target_id AND g.generation_digest=NEW.generation_digest
   AND g.predecessor_digest IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.predecessor_digest
  ORDER BY g.runtime_configuration_generation_id FOR SHARE NOWAIT
 LOOP
  IF prior.participant_id<>NEW.participant_id OR prior.privacy_domain_id<>NEW.privacy_domain_id
   OR prior.state<>'FAILED' OR prior.activated_at IS NOT NULL OR prior.cigl_profile_selection IS NOT NULL
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007-RUNTIME-RETRY'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT work FROM control.configuration_work w
   WHERE w.participant_id=prior.participant_id AND w.privacy_domain_id=prior.privacy_domain_id
    AND w.runtime_configuration_generation_id=prior.runtime_configuration_generation_id FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
  payload:=openpc.runtime_generation_retry_failure_payload(prior,work);
  -- This is the existing configuration-result owner's canonical failure payload
  -- bound to its original committed authorization signature, not a new signature
  -- over a fabricated result or a new permission to execute.
  IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event e JOIN control.mutation_evidence a
    ON a.participant_id=e.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
     AND a.operation_id=work.operation_id AND a.aggregate_id=work.resource_id
     AND a.action_intent_id='ACT-RUNTIME_TARGETS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
     AND a.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-UPDATE-RUNTIME-TARGET'
    JOIN control.idempotency_record i ON i.participant_id=a.participant_id AND i.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id
     AND i.operation_id=a.operation_id AND i.input_digest=a.candidate_digest
     AND i.terminal_state='COMMITTED' AND i.result_payload->>'state'='FAILED'
     AND i.result_payload->>'truthState'='FAILED'
    WHERE e.participant_id=work.participant_id AND e.privacy_domain_id=work.privacy_domain_id
     AND e.event_id=work.result_event_id AND e.aggregate_id=work.resource_id
     AND e.aggregate_type='runtime-targets' AND e.event_type='runtime-target.activation-failed.v1'
     AND e.payload_cbor=payload AND e.payload_digest=sha256(payload)
     AND e.cose_sign1=a.cose_sign1 AND octet_length(a.cose_sign1)>0
     AND a.evidence_digest=sha256(a.evidence_cbor))
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event e
    JOIN control.idempotency_record i
      ON i.participant_id=e.participant_id AND i.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
     AND i.operation_id=work.operation_id AND i.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
     AND i.result_payload->>'state'='FAILED' AND i.result_payload->>'truthState'='FAILED'
    JOIN control.policy_activation_occurrence_target cohort
      ON cohort.configuration_work_id=work.configuration_work_id
     AND cohort.runtime_configuration_generation_id=prior.runtime_configuration_generation_id
     AND cohort.participant_id=work.participant_id AND cohort.privacy_domain_id=work.privacy_domain_id
     AND cohort.phase='FORWARD' AND cohort.state='FAILED'
    JOIN control.policy_activation_occurrence occurrence
      ON occurrence.activation_occurrence_id=cohort.activation_occurrence_id
     AND occurrence.participant_id=cohort.participant_id
     AND occurrence.privacy_domain_id=cohort.privacy_domain_id
     AND occurrence.state='FAILED'
    JOIN control.policy_activation activation
      ON activation.policy_activation_id=occurrence.activation_occurrence_id
     AND activation.participant_id=occurrence.participant_id
     AND activation.privacy_domain_id=occurrence.privacy_domain_id
     AND activation.state='FAILED_FENCED' AND activation.activated_at IS NULL
     AND activation.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest IS NOT NULL
    WHERE openpc.current_action_intent_id()='ACT-POLICY_ACTIVATE_RELEASE-V1'
      AND e.participant_id=work.participant_id AND e.privacy_domain_id=work.privacy_domain_id
      AND e.event_id=work.result_event_id AND e.aggregate_id=work.resource_id
      AND e.aggregate_type='runtime-targets' AND e.event_type='runtime-target.activation-failed.v1'
      AND e.payload_cbor=payload AND e.payload_digest=sha256(payload)
      AND octet_length(e.cose_sign1)>0))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_activation_observation o
    WHERE o.runtime_configuration_generation_id=prior.runtime_configuration_generation_id
     OR o.configuration_work_id=work.configuration_work_id)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.policy_activation_occurrence_target o
    LEFT JOIN control.policy_activation_occurrence occurrence
      ON occurrence.activation_occurrence_id=o.activation_occurrence_id
     AND occurrence.participant_id=o.participant_id
     AND occurrence.privacy_domain_id=o.privacy_domain_id
    WHERE (o.runtime_configuration_generation_id=prior.runtime_configuration_generation_id
       OR o.configuration_work_id=work.configuration_work_id)
      AND (o.phase<>'FORWARD' OR o.state<>'FAILED' OR occurrence.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'FAILED'))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission a
    WHERE a.runtime_target_id=prior.runtime_target_id AND (
     a.binding->'source'->>'original_work_id'=work.configuration_work_id::text
     OR a.binding->'source'->>'runtime_configuration_generation_id'=prior.runtime_configuration_generation_id::text
     OR (a.binding->'cause'->>'work_id'=work.configuration_work_id::text AND (
       -- The failed successor did not run. Its acknowledged withdrawal denied
       -- the predecessor, not this content generation. A fresh governed attempt
       -- keeps that denial and must issue/ACK its own handoff and activation.
       a.participant_id=prior.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=prior.privacy_domain_id
       AND a.binding->>'action'='Withdraw' AND a.activation_proof IS NULL AND a.restoration_proof IS NULL
       AND a.binding->'cause'=jsonb_build_object('kind','Activation',
         'work_id',work.configuration_work_id::text,'operation_id',work.operation_id::text,'execution_attempt_id',NULL)
       AND a.binding->'source'->>'capsule_digest'=substring(NEW.predecessor_digest from 8)
       AND a.revision=(SELECT max(head.revision) FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission head
         WHERE head.participant_id=a.participant_id AND head.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id
          AND head.runtime_target_id=a.runtime_target_id)
       AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_activation_observation original
         WHERE original.participant_id=a.participant_id AND original.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id
          AND original.runtime_target_id=a.runtime_target_id AND original.capsule_digest=NEW.predecessor_digest
          AND original.configuration_work_id::text=a.binding->'source'->>'original_work_id'
          AND original.runtime_configuration_generation_id::text=a.binding->'source'->>'runtime_configuration_generation_id'
          AND original.configuration_work_id<>work.configuration_work_id
          AND original.runtime_configuration_generation_id<>prior.runtime_configuration_generation_id)
       AND (openpc.runtime_unsigned_withdrawal_recoverable(a.runtime_target_id,a.revision::bigint,a.admission_digest)
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_delivery delivery
         JOIN control.runtime_target_disposition_acknowledgement acknowledgement
          ON acknowledgement.participant_id=delivery.participant_id AND acknowledgement.privacy_domain_id=delivery.privacy_domain_id
           AND acknowledgement.runtime_target_id=delivery.runtime_target_id AND acknowledgement.delivery_digest=delivery.delivery_digest
         WHERE delivery.participant_id=a.participant_id AND delivery.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id
          AND delivery.runtime_target_id=a.runtime_target_id AND delivery.revision=a.revision
          AND acknowledgement.claims->>'installed_state'='NewUseDenied'))
     ) IS NOT TRUE)))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007-RUNTIME-RETRY'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN NEW;
EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='PC-DATA-6007';
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_runtime_target_connection()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF NOT pg_has_role(current_user,'openpc_control_worker','MEMBER') OR
  NEW.participant_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_participant_id() OR
  NEW.privacy_domain_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_privacy_domain_id() OR
  (TG_OP='UPDATE' AND (NEW.participant_id<>OLD.participant_id OR NEW.privacy_domain_id<>OLD.privacy_domain_id OR NEW.runtime_target_id<>OLD.runtime_target_id))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6001-DISCOVERY-OWNER-INVALID'; END IF;
 IF NEW.connected AND (NEW.observed_at>clock_timestamp() OR NEW.valid_until<=clock_timestamp() OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_target t JOIN control.credential c
  ON c.participant_id=t.participant_id AND c.credential_id=NEW.credential_id
  JOIN control.principal p ON p.participant_id=c.participant_id AND p.principal_id=c.principal_id
  WHERE t.runtime_target_id=NEW.runtime_target_id AND t.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
   AND t.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND t.requires_authenticated_discovery
   AND c.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND c.state='ACTIVE' AND c.credential_epoch=NEW.credential_epoch
   AND c.subject='urn:openpc:participant:'||t.participant_id::text||':workload:'||t.runtime_target_id::text
   AND c.audience='urn:openpc:workload:'||t.runtime_target_id::text
   AND c.certificate_der IS NOT NULL AND sha256(c.certificate_der)=c.secret_fingerprint
   AND c.secret_fingerprint=decode(substring(NEW.certificate_digest from 8),'hex')
   AND c.valid_from<=NEW.observed_at AND c.valid_until>=NEW.valid_until
   AND p.kind='WORKLOAD' AND p.state='ACTIVE' AND p.authority_epoch=NEW.principal_epoch))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6001-DISCOVERY-CREDENTIAL-INVALID'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
