CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_workload_renewal_policy_head()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007-RENEWAL-HISTORY'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
  IF NEW.current_revision<>1 OR NEW.row_version<>1 OR NEW.state<>'ACTIVE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 ELSE
  IF (NEW.participant_id,NEW.privacy_domain_id,NEW.policy_id,NEW.principal_id,NEW.workload_id) IS DISTINCT FROM
   (OLD.participant_id,OLD.privacy_domain_id,OLD.policy_id,OLD.principal_id,OLD.workload_id)
   OR NEW.current_revision<>OLD.current_revision+1 OR NEW.row_version<>OLD.row_version+1 OR OLD.state='REVOKED'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007-RENEWAL-CURRENT-CAS'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.workload_renewal_policy p WHERE p.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
  AND p.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND p.policy_id=NEW.policy_id AND p.revision=NEW.current_revision
  AND p.state=NEW.state AND p.principal_id=NEW.principal_id AND p.workload_id=NEW.workload_id
  AND p.governance_operation_id=current_setting('openpc.operation_id')::uuid)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-RENEWAL-CURRENT-OWNER'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_workload_renewal_policy_insert()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE d jsonb:=NEW.definition; lifetime numeric; reserve numeric; overlap numeric;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF NEW.participant_id<>current_setting('openpc.participant_id')::uuid OR NEW.privacy_domain_id<>current_setting('openpc.privacy_domain_id')::uuid
  OR NEW.governance_operation_id<>current_setting('openpc.operation_id')::uuid
  OR current_setting('openpc.action_intent_id')<>'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
  OR NEW.definition_canonical IS DISTINCT FROM convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(d),'UTF8')
  OR (d-ARRAY['version','participantId','privacyDomainId','policyId','principalId','workloadId','issuerProfileDigest','providerQualificationDigest',
   'attestationProfileDigest','managedAttestorScopeDigest','maximumInstances','maximumEnrollmentsPerMinute','certificateLifetimeSeconds',
   'recoveryReserveSeconds','maximumOverlapSeconds','validFrom','validUntil'])<>'{}'::jsonb
  OR d->'version' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'::jsonb OR d->>'participantId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.participant_id::text
  OR d->>'privacyDomainId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.privacy_domain_id::text OR d->>'policyId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.policy_id::text
  OR d->>'principalId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.principal_id::text OR d->>'workloadId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.workload_id
  OR NEW.workload_id!~'^urn:openpc:workload:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  OR d->>'attestationProfileDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(NEW.attestation_profile_digest,'hex')
  OR d->>'issuerProfileDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(NEW.issuer_profile_digest,'hex')
  OR d->>'providerQualificationDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(NEW.provider_qualification_digest,'hex')
  OR coalesce(d->>'managedAttestorScopeDigest','')!~'^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR coalesce(d->>'validFrom','')!~'^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{3}Z$'
  OR coalesce(d->>'validUntil','')!~'^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{3}Z$'
  OR (d->>'validFrom')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.valid_from OR (d->>'validUntil')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.valid_until
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-RENEWAL-POLICY-OWNER'; END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(d->'maximumInstances') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR coalesce(d->>'maximumInstances','')!~'^[1-9][0-9]{0,3}$'
  OR (d->>'maximumInstances')::numeric NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1024
  OR jsonb_typeof(d->'maximumEnrollmentsPerMinute') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR coalesce(d->>'maximumEnrollmentsPerMinute','')!~'^[1-9][0-9]{0,3}$'
  OR (d->>'maximumEnrollmentsPerMinute')::numeric NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1024
  OR jsonb_typeof(d->'certificateLifetimeSeconds') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR coalesce(d->>'certificateLifetimeSeconds','')!~'^[1-9][0-9]{0,4}$'
  OR jsonb_typeof(d->'recoveryReserveSeconds') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR coalesce(d->>'recoveryReserveSeconds','')!~'^[1-9][0-9]{0,4}$'
  OR jsonb_typeof(d->'maximumOverlapSeconds') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR coalesce(d->>'maximumOverlapSeconds','')!~'^[1-9][0-9]{0,2}$'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6004'; END IF;
 lifetime:=(d->>'certificateLifetimeSeconds')::numeric;reserve:=(d->>'recoveryReserveSeconds')::numeric;overlap:=(d->>'maximumOverlapSeconds')::numeric;
 IF lifetime NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 86400 OR reserve NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 86400 OR overlap NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 300
  OR NOT (overlap<reserve AND reserve<lifetime-least(lifetime/2,43200) AND lifetime-least(lifetime/2,43200)<lifetime)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.principal p WHERE p.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND p.principal_id=NEW.principal_id AND p.kind='WORKLOAD'
   AND (NEW.state<>'ACTIVE' OR (p.state='ACTIVE' AND NEW.valid_until>clock_timestamp()))
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.credential c WHERE c.participant_id=p.participant_id AND c.principal_id=p.principal_id AND c.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND c.subject=NEW.workload_id))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-RENEWAL-POLICY-BOUNDS'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_workload_renewal_signing_selection()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6020-IMMUTABLE-RENEWAL-SIGNING-SELECTION'; END IF;
 IF NOT pg_has_role(current_user,'openpc_control_key_governor','MEMBER') AND NOT pg_has_role(current_user,'openpc_control_owner','MEMBER') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-RENEWAL-SIGNING-INSTALLATION-AUTHORITY';
 END IF;
 IF NEW.profile_digest<>decode('bba6435c44c28f630d498d0d43cb4968fb2cef2828fb831908b7e7bff5cf39df','hex') OR NEW.admission_version<>1
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.workload_renewal_signing_grant g
   JOIN control.business_signing_key k USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,signer_id,signing_purpose_code)
   JOIN control.business_signing_key_state state USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,signer_id)
   JOIN control.workload_credential_family f ON f.participant_id=g.participant_id AND f.privacy_domain_id=g.privacy_domain_id AND f.family_id=g.family_id
   JOIN control.credential c ON c.participant_id=f.participant_id AND c.credential_id=f.current_credential_id
   JOIN control.principal p ON p.participant_id=f.participant_id AND p.principal_id=f.principal_id
   JOIN control.privacy_domain d ON d.participant_id=f.participant_id AND d.privacy_domain_id=f.privacy_domain_id
   WHERE g.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND g.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND g.signer_id=NEW.signer_id
    AND g.profile_digest=NEW.profile_digest AND k.environment_id=NEW.environment_id AND k.signing_purpose_code=376
    AND state.state='ACTIVE' AND state.row_version=g.key_security_generation
    AND f.state='ACTIVE' AND f.principal_id=g.principal_id AND f.workload_id=g.workload_id AND f.security_epoch=g.family_security_epoch
    AND c.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND c.state='ACTIVE' AND c.principal_id=f.principal_id AND c.audience=f.workload_id
    AND c.secret_fingerprint=f.current_fingerprint AND c.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND c.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
    AND p.kind='WORKLOAD' AND p.state='ACTIVE' AND d.state='ACTIVE'
    AND k.valid_from_ns<=floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000
    AND k.valid_until_ns>floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000
    FOR SHARE OF state) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-RENEWAL-SIGNING-CURRENT-KEY';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_workload_signing_handover_observation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE dispatch control.workload_signing_handover_dispatch; command control.workload_signing_handover_attempt;
 previous control.workload_signing_handover_observation; observation jsonb; descriptor jsonb; expected jsonb;
 generation_document jsonb; key_document jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-SIGNING_KEY_ROTATIONS_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1'
  OR NOT openpc.matches_participant(NEW.participant_id) OR NOT openpc.matches_privacy(NEW.privacy_domain_id)
  OR NEW.operation_id<>openpc.current_operation_id()
  OR NEW.recorded_at_ns>floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-OBSERVATION-SCOPE'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT dispatch FROM control.workload_signing_handover_dispatch
  WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND dispatch_id=NEW.dispatch_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT command FROM control.workload_signing_handover_attempt
  WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND attempt_id=NEW.attempt_id;
 IF dispatch.attempt_id<>NEW.attempt_id OR dispatch.handover_id<>NEW.handover_id
  OR command.handover_id<>NEW.handover_id OR dispatch.attempt_digest<>command.attempt_digest
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-OBSERVATION-OWNER'; END IF;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('pc.identity.workload-signing-handover.observation:'||NEW.attempt_id::text,0));
 SELECT * INTO previous FROM control.workload_signing_handover_observation
  WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND attempt_id=NEW.attempt_id
  ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1;
 IF NEW.sequence IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(previous.sequence,0)+1
  OR NEW.previous_digest IS DISTINCT FROM previous.entry_digest
  OR (previous.recorded_at_ns IS NOT NULL AND NEW.recorded_at_ns<previous.recorded_at_ns)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-OBSERVATION-SEQUENCE'; END IF;
 expected:=jsonb_build_object('schemaVersion',1,'participantId',NEW.participant_id::text,'privacyDomainId',NEW.privacy_domain_id::text,
  'handoverId',NEW.handover_id::text,'attemptId',NEW.attempt_id::text,'dispatchId',NEW.dispatch_id::text,
  'observationId',NEW.observation_id::text,'operationId',NEW.operation_id::text,'sequence',NEW.sequence,
  'previousDigest',CASE WHEN NEW.previous_digest IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'sha256:'||encode(NEW.previous_digest,'hex') END,
  'resultDigest','sha256:'||encode(NEW.result_digest,'hex'),'recordedAtNs',NEW.recorded_at_ns::text);
 IF NEW.entry_canonical<>convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(expected),'UTF8')
  OR NEW.entry_digest<>sha256(convert_to('pc.identity.workload-signing-handover.observation-entry.v1','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||NEW.entry_canonical)
  OR NEW.result_canonical<>convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(NEW.result),'UTF8')
  OR NEW.result_digest<>sha256(convert_to('pc.identity.workload-signing-handover.provider-result.v1','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||NEW.result_canonical)
  OR jsonb_typeof(NEW.result) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR NEW.result->>'state' IS NULL
  OR NEW.result->>'via' IS NULL OR NEW.result->>'via' NOT IN('DISPATCH','LOOKUP')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-OBSERVATION-CUSTODY'; END IF;
 CASE NEW.result->>'state'
 WHEN 'UNKNOWN' THEN
  IF NEW.result-ARRAY['state','via','reason']<>'{}'::jsonb
   OR NEW.result->>'reason' IS DISTINCT FROM 'TRANSPORT_OR_PROTOCOL_UNKNOWN'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-OBSERVATION-UNKNOWN'; END IF;
 WHEN 'UNOBSERVED' THEN
  IF NEW.result-ARRAY['state','via','reason']<>'{}'::jsonb OR NEW.result->>'via'<>'LOOKUP'
   OR NEW.result->>'reason' IS NULL OR NEW.result->>'reason' NOT IN('ABSENT','NOT_FOUND','UNKNOWN')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-OBSERVATION-UNOBSERVED'; END IF;
 WHEN 'OBSERVED' THEN
  observation:=NEW.result->'observation'; descriptor:=observation->'descriptor';
  IF NEW.result-ARRAY['state','via','observation']<>'{}'::jsonb OR jsonb_typeof(observation) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
   OR observation-ARRAY['schemaVersion','providerId','attemptId','operationId','requestDigest','method','recordedAtNs','outcome','reason','descriptor','resultHex']<>'{}'::jsonb
   OR observation->>'schemaVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
   OR observation->>'providerId' IS DISTINCT FROM command.provider_id
   OR observation->>'attemptId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.attempt_id::text
   OR observation->>'operationId' IS DISTINCT FROM command.operation_id::text
   OR observation->>'requestDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM command.attempt->>'requestDigest'
   OR observation->>'method' IS DISTINCT FROM command.attempt->'request'->>'method'
   OR observation->>'recordedAtNs' IS NULL OR observation->>'recordedAtNs' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$'
   OR mod((observation->>'recordedAtNs')::numeric,1000)<>0
   OR (observation->>'recordedAtNs')::numeric>18446744073709551615
   OR observation->>'outcome' IS NULL OR observation->>'outcome' NOT IN('SUCCEEDED','REJECTED')
   OR (command.stage='PREPARATION' AND observation->'resultHex' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb)
   OR (command.stage='POSSESSION' AND observation->>'outcome'='SUCCEEDED' AND (observation->>'resultHex' IS NULL OR observation->>'resultHex' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{128}$'))
   OR (observation->>'outcome'='REJECTED' AND observation->'resultHex' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb)
   OR NOT observation ?& ARRAY['reason','descriptor']
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-OBSERVATION-BINDING'; END IF;
  IF observation->>'outcome'='REJECTED' THEN
   IF observation->>'reason' IS NULL OR observation->>'reason' NOT IN('KEY_NOT_FOUND','REVOKED','EXPIRED','WRONG_SCOPE','FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH','INVALID_REQUEST','ATTEMPT_CONFLICT','NOT_APPLIED')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-OBSERVATION-REJECTION'; END IF;
  ELSIF observation->'reason' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb OR jsonb_typeof(descriptor) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-OBSERVATION-DESCRIPTOR';
  END IF;
  IF descriptor IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb THEN
   IF descriptor->>'participantId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.participant_id::text
    OR descriptor->>'privacyDomainId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.privacy_domain_id::text
    OR descriptor->>'environmentId' IS DISTINCT FROM command.binding->>'environmentId'
    OR descriptor->>'workloadCredentialId' IS DISTINCT FROM command.binding->>'successorCredentialId'
    OR descriptor->>'reference' IS DISTINCT FROM command.attempt->'request'->>'reference'
    OR descriptor->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM command.attempt->'request'->>'version'
    OR descriptor->>'purpose' IS DISTINCT FROM command.attempt->>'purpose'
    OR descriptor->>'secretClass' IS DISTINCT FROM 'SECRET-SIGNING-KEY'
    OR descriptor->>'algorithm' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ES256'
    OR descriptor->>'publicKeySpkiHex' IS NULL OR descriptor->>'publicKeySpkiHex' !~ '^([0-9a-f]{2})+$'
    OR descriptor->>'fingerprint' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(decode(descriptor->>'publicKeySpkiHex','hex')),'hex')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-OBSERVATION-DESCRIPTOR-SCOPE'; END IF;
   IF command.attempt->>'purpose'='pc.cose.identity-authority-envelope.v1' AND (
    descriptor->>'workloadCredentialEpoch' IS DISTINCT FROM command.attempt->'request'->>'workloadCredentialEpoch'
    OR descriptor->>'purposeCode' IS DISTINCT FROM '371' OR descriptor->>'schemaId' IS DISTINCT FROM '24034'
    OR descriptor->>'schemaVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
    OR descriptor->>'schemaDefinitionDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM command.attempt->'request'->>'schemaDefinitionDigest'
    OR descriptor->>'profileId' IS DISTINCT FROM command.attempt->'request'->>'profileId'
    OR descriptor->>'profileVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
    OR descriptor->>'profileDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM command.attempt->'request'->>'profileDigest')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-OBSERVATION-ENVELOPE'; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF command.stage='POSSESSION' AND observation->>'outcome'='SUCCEEDED' THEN
   SELECT document INTO STRICT generation_document FROM control.workload_signing_handover_generation WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id
    AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND generation_id=command.generation_id;
   SELECT value INTO STRICT key_document FROM jsonb_array_elements(generation_document->'keys') WHERE value->'binding'->'replacement'->>'oldFingerprint'=command.predecessor_fingerprint;
   IF descriptor IS DISTINCT FROM key_document->'observation'->'descriptor'
    OR (observation->>'recordedAtNs')::numeric<(generation_document->>'issuedAtNs')::numeric
    OR (observation->>'recordedAtNs')::numeric>=(generation_document->>'expiresAtNs')::numeric
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-POSSESSION-OBSERVATION'; END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-OBSERVATION-STATE';
 END CASE;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.guard_workload_signing_handover_preparation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE snapshot jsonb; expected jsonb; bound jsonb; source_document jsonb;
 owner_row control.workload_signing_handover; key_document jsonb; request_document jsonb; request_domain text;
BEGIN

 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-SIGNING_KEY_ROTATIONS_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1'
  OR NOT openpc.matches_participant(NEW.participant_id) OR NOT openpc.matches_privacy(NEW.privacy_domain_id)
  OR NEW.operation_id<>openpc.current_operation_id() OR NEW.authority_snapshot_digest<>sha256(NEW.authority_snapshot)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-PREPARATION'; END IF;
 snapshot:=convert_from(NEW.authority_snapshot,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF snapshot->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'pc.control.precommit-authority-snapshot.v1'
  OR snapshot->>'participantId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.participant_id::text
  OR snapshot->>'privacyDomainId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.privacy_domain_id::text
  OR snapshot->>'operationId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.operation_id::text OR snapshot->>'decision' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ALLOW'
  OR jsonb_typeof(snapshot->'authorities') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(snapshot->'authorities')<>1
  OR (snapshot->>'recordedAtNs')::numeric>NEW.recorded_at_ns
  OR NEW.recorded_at_ns>floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-SNAPSHOT'; END IF;

 IF jsonb_typeof(snapshot->'dependencies'->'participant') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-SNAPSHOT'; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('participant_id',owner.participant_id::text,'state',owner.state::text,'authority_epoch',owner.authority_epoch::text,'row_version',owner.row_version::text) ORDER BY owner.participant_id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO expected
 FROM control.participant owner WHERE owner.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND owner.participant_id IN
 (SELECT (dependency->>'participant_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'participant') dependency);
 IF snapshot->'dependencies'->'participant' IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-SNAPSHOT-ROW'; END IF;

 IF jsonb_typeof(snapshot->'dependencies'->'privacy_domain') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-SNAPSHOT'; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('privacy_domain_id',owner.privacy_domain_id::text,'participant_id',owner.participant_id::text,'state',owner.state::text,'row_version',owner.row_version::text) ORDER BY owner.privacy_domain_id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO expected
 FROM control.privacy_domain owner WHERE owner.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND owner.privacy_domain_id IN
 (SELECT (dependency->>'privacy_domain_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'privacy_domain') dependency);
 IF snapshot->'dependencies'->'privacy_domain' IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-SNAPSHOT-ROW'; END IF;

 IF jsonb_typeof(snapshot->'dependencies'->'principal') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-SNAPSHOT'; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('principal_id',owner.principal_id::text,'participant_id',owner.participant_id::text,'kind',owner.kind::text,'state',owner.state::text,'authority_epoch',owner.authority_epoch::text,'row_version',owner.row_version::text) ORDER BY owner.principal_id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO expected
 FROM control.principal owner WHERE owner.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND owner.principal_id IN
 (SELECT (dependency->>'principal_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'principal') dependency);
 IF snapshot->'dependencies'->'principal' IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-SNAPSHOT-ROW'; END IF;

 IF jsonb_typeof(snapshot->'dependencies'->'authority_role') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-SNAPSHOT'; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('authority_role_id',owner.authority_role_id::text,'participant_id',owner.participant_id::text,'role_id',owner.role_id::text,'action_intent_ids',owner.action_intent_ids::text,'state',owner.state::text,'row_version',owner.row_version::text) ORDER BY owner.authority_role_id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO expected
 FROM control.authority_role owner WHERE owner.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND owner.authority_role_id IN
 (SELECT (dependency->>'authority_role_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'authority_role') dependency);
 IF snapshot->'dependencies'->'authority_role' IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-SNAPSHOT-ROW'; END IF;

 IF jsonb_typeof(snapshot->'dependencies'->'session') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-SNAPSHOT'; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('session_id',owner.session_id::text,'participant_id',owner.participant_id::text,'principal_id',owner.principal_id::text,'state',owner.state::text,'participant_epoch',owner.participant_epoch::text,'authority_epoch',owner.authority_epoch::text,'delegation_epoch',owner.delegation_epoch::text,'session_epoch',owner.session_epoch::text,'issued_at',owner.issued_at::text,'idle_expires_at',owner.idle_expires_at::text,'absolute_expires_at',owner.absolute_expires_at::text,'step_up_verified_at',owner.step_up_verified_at::text,'row_version',owner.row_version::text) ORDER BY owner.session_id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO expected
 FROM control.session owner WHERE owner.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND owner.session_id IN
 (SELECT (dependency->>'session_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'session') dependency);
 IF snapshot->'dependencies'->'session' IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-SNAPSHOT-ROW'; END IF;

 IF jsonb_typeof(snapshot->'dependencies'->'authority_envelope') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-SNAPSHOT'; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('authority_envelope_id',owner.authority_envelope_id::text,'participant_id',owner.participant_id::text,'principal_id',owner.principal_id::text,'maker_principal_id',owner.maker_principal_id::text,'checker_principal_id',owner.checker_principal_id::text,'authority_epoch',owner.authority_epoch::text,'delegation_epoch',owner.delegation_epoch::text,'state',owner.state::text,'valid_from',owner.valid_from::text,'valid_until',owner.valid_until::text,'semantic_digest',owner.semantic_digest::text,'privacy_domain_ids',owner.privacy_domain_ids::text,'action_intent_ids',owner.action_intent_ids::text,'runtime_capability_ids',owner.runtime_capability_ids::text,'resource_ids',owner.resource_ids::text,'risk_classes',owner.risk_classes::text,'maker_checker_required',owner.maker_checker_required::text,'step_up_required',owner.step_up_required::text,'onward_delegation_depth',owner.onward_delegation_depth::text,'row_version',owner.row_version::text) ORDER BY owner.authority_envelope_id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO expected
 FROM control.authority_envelope owner WHERE owner.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND owner.authority_envelope_id IN
 (SELECT (dependency->>'authority_envelope_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'authority_envelope') dependency);
 IF snapshot->'dependencies'->'authority_envelope' IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-SNAPSHOT-ROW'; END IF;

 IF jsonb_typeof(snapshot->'dependencies'->'assignment') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-SNAPSHOT'; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('assignment_id',owner.assignment_id::text,'participant_id',owner.participant_id::text,'principal_id',owner.principal_id::text,'authority_group_id',owner.authority_group_id::text,'role_id',owner.role_id::text,'authority_envelope_id',owner.authority_envelope_id::text,'delegation_epoch',owner.delegation_epoch::text,'scope_digest',owner.scope_digest::text,'privacy_domain_ids',owner.privacy_domain_ids::text,'action_intent_ids',owner.action_intent_ids::text,'runtime_capability_ids',owner.runtime_capability_ids::text,'resource_ids',owner.resource_ids::text,'risk_classes',owner.risk_classes::text,'maker_checker_required',owner.maker_checker_required::text,'step_up_required',owner.step_up_required::text,'onward_delegation_depth',owner.onward_delegation_depth::text,'valid_during',owner.valid_during::text,'state',owner.state::text,'created_by_principal_id',owner.created_by_principal_id::text,'row_version',owner.row_version::text) ORDER BY owner.assignment_id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO expected
 FROM control.assignment owner WHERE owner.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND owner.assignment_id IN
 (SELECT (dependency->>'assignment_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'assignment') dependency);
 IF snapshot->'dependencies'->'assignment' IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-SNAPSHOT-ROW'; END IF;

 IF jsonb_typeof(snapshot->'dependencies'->'delegation') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-SNAPSHOT'; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('delegation_id',owner.delegation_id::text,'participant_id',owner.participant_id::text,'parent_assignment_id',owner.parent_assignment_id::text,'parent_delegation_id',owner.parent_delegation_id::text,'grantor_principal_id',owner.grantor_principal_id::text,'delegate_principal_id',owner.delegate_principal_id::text,'delegation_epoch',owner.delegation_epoch::text,'scope_digest',owner.scope_digest::text,'privacy_domain_ids',owner.privacy_domain_ids::text,'action_intent_ids',owner.action_intent_ids::text,'runtime_capability_ids',owner.runtime_capability_ids::text,'resource_ids',owner.resource_ids::text,'risk_classes',owner.risk_classes::text,'maker_checker_required',owner.maker_checker_required::text,'step_up_required',owner.step_up_required::text,'onward_delegation_depth',owner.onward_delegation_depth::text,'valid_during',owner.valid_during::text,'state',owner.state::text,'row_version',owner.row_version::text) ORDER BY owner.delegation_id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO expected
 FROM control.delegation owner WHERE owner.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND owner.delegation_id IN
 (SELECT (dependency->>'delegation_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'delegation') dependency);
 IF snapshot->'dependencies'->'delegation' IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-SNAPSHOT-ROW'; END IF;

 IF jsonb_typeof(snapshot->'dependencies'->'credential') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-SNAPSHOT'; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('credential_id',owner.credential_id::text,'participant_id',owner.participant_id::text,'principal_id',owner.principal_id::text,'kind',owner.kind::text,'state',owner.state::text,'credential_epoch',owner.credential_epoch::text,'valid_from',owner.valid_from::text,'valid_until',owner.valid_until::text,'public_key_digest',owner.public_key_digest::text,'row_version',owner.row_version::text) ORDER BY owner.credential_id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO expected
 FROM control.credential owner WHERE owner.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND owner.credential_id IN
 (SELECT (dependency->>'credential_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'credential') dependency);
 IF snapshot->'dependencies'->'credential' IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-SNAPSHOT-ROW'; END IF;
 bound:=snapshot->'authorities'->0;
 IF bound->>'principalId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.maker_principal_id::text
  OR bound->>'privacyDomainId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.privacy_domain_id::text
  OR bound->>'actionIntentId' IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_action_intent_id() OR bound->>'resourceId' IS DISTINCT FROM '*'
  OR NOT (snapshot->'dependencies'->'participant' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('participant_id',NEW.participant_id::text,'state','ACTIVE','authority_epoch',bound->>'participantEpoch')))
  OR NOT (snapshot->'dependencies'->'privacy_domain' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('privacy_domain_id',NEW.privacy_domain_id::text,'state','ACTIVE')))
  OR NOT (snapshot->'dependencies'->'principal' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('principal_id',NEW.maker_principal_id::text,'state','ACTIVE','authority_epoch',bound->>'principalEpoch')))
  OR NOT (snapshot->'dependencies'->'session' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('session_id',bound->>'sessionId','principal_id',NEW.maker_principal_id::text,'state','ACTIVE','session_epoch',bound->>'sessionEpoch')))
  OR NOT (snapshot->'dependencies'->'assignment' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('assignment_id',bound->>'assignmentId','state','ACTIVE','row_version',bound->>'assignmentRowVersion')))
  OR NOT (snapshot->'dependencies'->'authority_envelope' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('authority_envelope_id',bound->>'authorityEnvelopeId','state','ACTIVE','authority_epoch',bound->>'authorityEpoch')))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-BOUND-PATH'; END IF;
 IF current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'serializable' OR NOT EXISTS(
  WITH RECURSIVE path AS (
   SELECT a.principal_id terminal_principal_id,a.delegation_epoch,a.onward_delegation_depth remaining_depth,
    null::uuid delegation_id,array[]::uuid[] delegation_ids,array[a.principal_id] principal_ids
   FROM control.assignment a WHERE a.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND a.assignment_id=(bound->>'assignmentId')::uuid
    AND a.state='ACTIVE' AND a.row_version::text=bound->>'assignmentRowVersion'
    AND a.authority_envelope_id=(bound->>'authorityEnvelopeId')::uuid AND a.valid_during @> clock_timestamp()
    AND openpc.current_action_intent_id()=any(a.action_intent_ids) AND NEW.privacy_domain_id::text=any(a.privacy_domain_ids)
    AND openpc.assignment_role_permits(a.participant_id,a.role_id,openpc.current_action_intent_id())
    AND openpc.assignment_group_permits(a.participant_id,a.authority_group_id,a.principal_id,a.valid_during)
    AND openpc.administration_resource_permits(a.resource_ids,'*',openpc.current_action_intent_id(),NEW.participant_id,NEW.maker_principal_id,(bound->>'sessionId')::uuid,(bound->>'authorityEnvelopeId')::uuid)
   UNION ALL
   SELECT d.delegate_principal_id,d.delegation_epoch,d.onward_delegation_depth,d.delegation_id,
    path.delegation_ids||d.delegation_id,path.principal_ids||d.delegate_principal_id
   FROM path JOIN control.delegation d ON d.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
    AND ((path.delegation_id IS NULL AND d.parent_assignment_id=(bound->>'assignmentId')::uuid) OR d.parent_delegation_id=path.delegation_id)
    AND d.grantor_principal_id=path.terminal_principal_id AND d.state='ACTIVE' AND d.valid_during @> clock_timestamp()
    AND openpc.current_action_intent_id()=any(d.action_intent_ids) AND NEW.privacy_domain_id::text=any(d.privacy_domain_ids)
    AND '*'=any(d.resource_ids) AND d.onward_delegation_depth<path.remaining_depth
   WHERE path.remaining_depth>0 AND cardinality(path.delegation_ids)<32 AND NOT d.delegation_id=any(path.delegation_ids)
  ) SELECT 1 FROM path JOIN control.authority_envelope e ON e.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
   AND e.authority_envelope_id=(bound->>'authorityEnvelopeId')::uuid AND e.state='ACTIVE' AND e.authority_epoch::text=bound->>'authorityEpoch'
   AND ((e.representation<>'RECOVERY_V1' or openpc.platform_recovery_envelope_current(e.authority_envelope_id)) and (e.platform_context_id is null or exists(
    select 1 from control.platform_context current_root
    where current_root.platform_context_id=e.platform_context_id
      and current_root.state='ACTIVE'
      and current_root.authority_epoch=e.platform_authority_epoch
      ))) AND e.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND (e.valid_until IS NULL OR e.valid_until>clock_timestamp())
   AND openpc.current_action_intent_id()=any(e.action_intent_ids) AND NEW.privacy_domain_id::text=any(e.privacy_domain_ids)
   AND openpc.administration_resource_permits(e.resource_ids,'*',openpc.current_action_intent_id(),NEW.participant_id,NEW.maker_principal_id,(bound->>'sessionId')::uuid,e.authority_envelope_id)
   JOIN control.principal actor ON actor.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND actor.principal_id=NEW.maker_principal_id
    AND actor.state='ACTIVE' AND actor.authority_epoch::text=bound->>'principalEpoch' AND actor.kind IN('USER','PLATFORM_OPERATOR')
   JOIN control.session session ON session.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND session.session_id=(bound->>'sessionId')::uuid
    AND session.principal_id=NEW.maker_principal_id AND session.state='ACTIVE' AND session.session_epoch::text=bound->>'sessionEpoch'
    AND session.participant_epoch::text=bound->>'participantEpoch' AND session.authority_epoch::text=bound->>'principalEpoch'
    AND session.delegation_epoch::text=bound->>'delegationEpoch' AND session.idle_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND session.absolute_expires_at>clock_timestamp()
   WHERE path.terminal_principal_id=NEW.maker_principal_id AND path.delegation_epoch::text=bound->>'delegationEpoch'
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(path.principal_ids) dependency(id) WHERE NOT EXISTS(
      SELECT 1 FROM control.principal principal WHERE principal.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND principal.principal_id=dependency.id AND principal.state='ACTIVE'))
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.recovery_principal recovery WHERE recovery.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND recovery.principal_id=NEW.maker_principal_id)
 ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-LIVE-AUTHORITY'; END IF;

 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='workload_signing_handover' THEN
  source_document:=NEW.source;
  IF NEW.request_canonical<>convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(NEW.request),'UTF8')
   OR NEW.source_canonical<>convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(NEW.source),'UTF8')
   OR NEW.request_digest<>sha256(convert_to('pc.identity.workload-signing-handover.request.v1','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||NEW.request_canonical)
   OR NEW.source_digest<>sha256(convert_to('pc.identity.workload-signing-handover.source.v1','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||NEW.source_canonical)
   OR NEW.request->>'actionIntentId' IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_action_intent_id()
   OR NEW.request->>'actionIntentDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT 'sha256:'||encode(semantic_digest,'hex') FROM control.action_intent WHERE action_intent_id=openpc.current_action_intent_id())
   OR NEW.request->>'environmentId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.environment_id
   OR NEW.request->>'predecessorCredentialId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.predecessor_credential_id::text
   OR NEW.request->>'successorCredentialId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.successor_credential_id::text
   OR source_document->'issuer'->>'workloadCredentialId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.successor_credential_id::text
   OR source_document->'issuer'->>'workloadPrincipalId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.workload_principal_id::text
   OR source_document->'provenance'->>'predecessorCredentialId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.predecessor_credential_id::text
   OR source_document->'provenance'->>'successorCredentialId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.successor_credential_id::text
   OR source_document->'provenance'->>'credentialRotationOperationId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.request->>'credentialRotationOperationId'
   OR jsonb_array_length(source_document->'keys')<>jsonb_array_length(NEW.request->'replacements')
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.request->'replacements') replacement
    WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_document->'keys') old_key
      WHERE old_key-ARRAY['oldTrustPreimageBase64','oldCredentialEpoch','oldKeyValidFromNs','oldKeyValidUntilNs']=replacement))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-REQUEST-CUSTODY'; END IF;
 ELSE
  IF NEW.stage<>'PREPARATION' OR NEW.generation_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.preparation_attempt_id IS NOT NULL
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-PREPARATION-STAGE'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT owner_row FROM control.workload_signing_handover
   WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND handover_id=NEW.handover_id
    AND maker_principal_id=NEW.maker_principal_id;
  source_document:=owner_row.source;
  SELECT value INTO STRICT key_document FROM jsonb_array_elements(source_document->'keys')
   WHERE value->>'oldFingerprint'=NEW.predecessor_fingerprint;
  request_document:=NEW.attempt->'request';
  request_domain:=CASE WHEN NEW.attempt->>'purpose'='pc.cose.identity-authority-envelope.v1'
    THEN 'pc.identity.envelope-key-rotation-request.v1' ELSE 'pc.control.signing-provider-request.v1' END;
  IF NEW.binding_canonical<>convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(NEW.binding),'UTF8')
   OR NEW.attempt_canonical<>convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(NEW.attempt),'UTF8')
   OR NEW.binding_digest<>sha256(convert_to('pc.identity.workload-signing-handover.provider-binding.v1','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||NEW.binding_canonical)
   OR NEW.attempt_digest<>sha256(convert_to('pc.identity.workload-signing-handover.provider-attempt.v1','UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||NEW.attempt_canonical)
   OR NEW.binding->>'participantId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.participant_id::text
   OR NEW.binding->>'privacyDomainId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.privacy_domain_id::text
   OR NEW.binding->>'environmentId' IS DISTINCT FROM owner_row.environment_id
   OR NEW.binding->>'handoverId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.handover_id::text
   OR NEW.binding->>'sourceDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(owner_row.source_digest,'hex')
   OR NEW.binding->>'successorCredentialId' IS DISTINCT FROM owner_row.successor_credential_id::text
   OR NEW.binding->>'successorCredentialEpoch' IS DISTINCT FROM source_document->'issuer'->>'workloadCredentialEpoch'
   OR NEW.binding->>'participantEpoch' IS DISTINCT FROM source_document->'issuer'->>'workloadParticipantEpoch'
   OR NEW.binding->>'principalEpoch' IS DISTINCT FROM source_document->'issuer'->>'workloadPrincipalEpoch'
   OR NEW.binding->>'providerId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.provider_id
   OR NEW.binding->'replacement' IS DISTINCT FROM key_document-ARRAY['oldTrustPreimageBase64','oldCredentialEpoch','oldKeyValidFromNs','oldKeyValidUntilNs']
   OR NEW.attempt->>'handoverId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.handover_id::text
   OR NEW.attempt->>'sourceDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(owner_row.source_digest,'hex')
   OR NEW.attempt->>'predecessorFingerprint' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.predecessor_fingerprint
   OR NEW.attempt->>'providerId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.provider_id
   OR NEW.attempt->>'bindingDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(NEW.binding_digest,'hex')
   OR NEW.attempt->>'signerRole' IS DISTINCT FROM key_document->>'signerRole'
   OR NEW.attempt->>'purpose' IS DISTINCT FROM key_document->>'purpose'
   OR NEW.attempt->>'requestDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(request_domain,'UTF8')||decode('00','hex')||convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(request_document),'UTF8')),'hex')
   OR request_document->>'attemptId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.attempt_id::text
   OR request_document->>'operationId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.operation_id::text
   OR request_document->>'participantId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.participant_id::text
   OR request_document->>'privacyDomainId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.privacy_domain_id::text
   OR request_document->>'environmentId' IS DISTINCT FROM owner_row.environment_id
   OR request_document->>'workloadCredentialId' IS DISTINCT FROM owner_row.successor_credential_id::text
   OR request_document->>'callerWorkloadCredentialId' IS DISTINCT FROM owner_row.successor_credential_id::text
   OR request_document->>'reference' IS DISTINCT FROM key_document->>'newReference'
   OR request_document->>'secretClass' IS DISTINCT FROM 'SECRET-SIGNING-KEY'
   OR request_document->>'purpose' IS DISTINCT FROM key_document->>'purpose'
   OR (request_document->>'reference') IS DISTINCT FROM regexp_replace(request_document->>'reference','#[^#]+$','')||'#'||(request_document->>'version')
   OR (NEW.attempt->>'purpose'='pc.cose.identity-authority-envelope.v1' AND (
     request_document->>'method' IS DISTINCT FROM 'PREPARE' OR request_document->>'rotationId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.handover_id::text
     OR request_document->>'workloadCredentialEpoch' IS DISTINCT FROM source_document->'issuer'->>'workloadCredentialEpoch'
     OR request_document->>'issuerParticipantEpoch' IS DISTINCT FROM source_document->'issuer'->>'workloadParticipantEpoch'
     OR request_document->>'issuerPrincipalEpoch' IS DISTINCT FROM source_document->'issuer'->>'workloadPrincipalEpoch'
     OR request_document->>'governanceDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(owner_row.source_digest,'hex')))
   OR (NEW.attempt->>'purpose'<>'pc.cose.identity-authority-envelope.v1' AND request_document->>'method' IS DISTINCT FROM 'INSPECT')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-HANDOVER-ATTEMPT-CUSTODY'; END IF;
 END IF;

 IF source_document->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'pc.identity.workload-signing-handover.source.v1'
  OR source_document->>'participantId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.participant_id::text
  OR source_document->>'privacyDomainId' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.privacy_domain_id::text
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.credential credential JOIN control.principal principal USING(participant_id,principal_id)
   JOIN control.participant participant USING(participant_id)
   WHERE credential.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND credential.credential_id=(source_document->'issuer'->>'workloadCredentialId')::uuid
    AND credential.principal_id=(source_document->'issuer'->>'workloadPrincipalId')::uuid
    AND credential.state='ACTIVE' AND credential.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND principal.state='ACTIVE' AND principal.kind='WORKLOAD'
    AND participant.state='ACTIVE' AND credential.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND (credential.valid_until IS NULL OR credential.valid_until>clock_timestamp())
    AND credential.credential_epoch::text=source_document->'issuer'->>'workloadCredentialEpoch'
    AND principal.authority_epoch::text=source_document->'issuer'->>'workloadPrincipalEpoch'
    AND participant.authority_epoch::text=source_document->'issuer'->>'workloadParticipantEpoch')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-HANDOVER-CURRENT-ISSUER'; END IF;

 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
p_participant uuid, p_privacy uuid, p_captured jsonb, p_action text, p_resource uuid, p_live_session boolean

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.identity_envelope_activation_authority_current(p_participant uuid, p_privacy uuid, p_captured jsonb, p_action text, p_resource uuid, p_live_session boolean)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE b jsonb:=p_captured->'binding'; d jsonb:=p_captured->'durable';
 a control.assignment%ROWTYPE; e control.authority_envelope%ROWTYPE; r control.authority_role%ROWTYPE;
 pr control.principal%ROWTYPE; privacy control.privacy_domain%ROWTYPE; role_document jsonb; expected jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF b->>'participantId' IS DISTINCT FROM p_participant::text
  OR d#>>'{grant,privacyDomainId}' IS DISTINCT FROM p_privacy::text
  OR d#>>'{grant,actionIntentId}' IS DISTINCT FROM p_action
  OR d#>>'{grant,resourceId}' IS DISTINCT FROM p_resource::text THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO a FROM control.assignment WHERE participant_id=p_participant
  AND assignment_id=(b->>'assignmentId')::uuid;
 SELECT * INTO e FROM control.authority_envelope WHERE participant_id=p_participant
  AND authority_envelope_id=(b->>'authorityEnvelopeId')::uuid;
 SELECT * INTO r FROM control.authority_role WHERE participant_id=p_participant AND role_id=b->>'roleId';
 SELECT * INTO pr FROM control.principal WHERE participant_id=p_participant
  AND principal_id=(b->>'principalId')::uuid;
 SELECT * INTO privacy FROM control.privacy_domain WHERE participant_id=p_participant AND privacy_domain_id=p_privacy;
 IF a.assignment_id IS NULL OR e.authority_envelope_id IS NULL OR r.authority_role_id IS NULL
  OR pr.principal_id IS NULL OR privacy.privacy_domain_id IS NULL
  OR a.principal_id IS DISTINCT FROM pr.principal_id OR a.authority_envelope_id IS DISTINCT FROM e.authority_envelope_id
  OR a.role_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.role_id OR a.row_version::text IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'assignmentVersion'
  OR a.delegation_epoch::text IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'delegationEpoch' OR a.state<>'ACTIVE'
  OR NOT (a.valid_during @> clock_timestamp()) OR NOT a.maker_checker_required
  OR NOT (p_action=ANY(a.action_intent_ids)) OR NOT (p_privacy::text=ANY(a.privacy_domain_ids))
  OR NOT openpc.administration_resource_permits(a.resource_ids,p_resource::text,p_action,p_participant,pr.principal_id,(b->>'sessionId')::uuid,e.authority_envelope_id)
  OR NOT openpc.assignment_group_permits(a.participant_id,a.authority_group_id,a.principal_id,a.valid_during)
  OR e.state<>'ACTIVE' OR e.valid_from>clock_timestamp() OR (e.valid_until IS NOT NULL AND e.valid_until<=clock_timestamp())
  OR NOT ((e.representation<>'RECOVERY_V1' or openpc.platform_recovery_envelope_current(e.authority_envelope_id)) and (e.platform_context_id is null or exists(
    select 1 from control.platform_context current_root
    where current_root.platform_context_id=e.platform_context_id
      and current_root.state='ACTIVE'
      and current_root.authority_epoch=e.platform_authority_epoch
      )))
  OR e.authority_epoch::text IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'authorityEpoch' OR NOT e.maker_checker_required
  OR NOT (p_action=ANY(e.action_intent_ids)) OR NOT (p_privacy::text=ANY(e.privacy_domain_ids))
  OR NOT openpc.administration_resource_permits(e.resource_ids,p_resource::text,p_action,p_participant,pr.principal_id,(b->>'sessionId')::uuid,e.authority_envelope_id)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.action_intent action WHERE action.action_intent_id=p_action
    AND action.risk_class=ANY(a.risk_classes) AND action.risk_class=ANY(e.risk_classes))
  OR NOT (e.principal_id=pr.principal_id OR (e.representation='TYPED_V1' AND e.principal_id IS NULL))
  OR r.state<>'ACTIVE' OR r.row_version::text IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'roleVersion' OR NOT (p_action=ANY(r.action_intent_ids))
  OR pr.state<>'ACTIVE' OR pr.kind<>'PLATFORM_OPERATOR' OR pr.authority_epoch::text IS DISTINCT FROM b->>'principalEpoch'
  OR privacy.state<>'ACTIVE'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.participant p WHERE p.participant_id=p_participant
    AND p.state='ACTIVE' AND p.authority_epoch::text=b->>'participantEpoch')
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 expected:=jsonb_build_object('principalId',b->'principalId','participantEpoch',b->'participantEpoch',
  'principalEpoch',b->'principalEpoch','assignmentId',b->'assignmentId','assignmentRowVersion',b->'assignmentVersion',
  'authorityEnvelopeId',b->'authorityEnvelopeId','authorityEpoch',b->'authorityEpoch','delegationEpoch',b->'delegationEpoch',
  'privacyDomainId',p_privacy::text,'actionIntentId',p_action,'resourceId',p_resource::text);
 IF (d->'grant')-'catalogOperationId' IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 expected:=jsonb_build_object('path',jsonb_build_object('delegationIds','[]'::jsonb,
   'principalIds',jsonb_build_array(pr.principal_id::text),'roleId',r.authority_role_id::text),
  'principals',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_array(pr.principal_id::text,pr.authority_epoch::text)),
  'privacy',privacy.row_version::text,'role',r.row_version::text,'delegations',NULL);
 IF d->'dependencies' IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 role_document:=jsonb_build_object('roleId',r.role_id,'version',r.row_version::text,'actions',to_jsonb(r.action_intent_ids),
  'origin',r.origin,'createdByPrincipalId',r.created_by_principal_id::text,'creatorParticipantId',r.creator_participant_id::text,
  'bootstrapMandateId',r.bootstrap_mandate_id::text,'bootstrapPlatformParticipantId',r.bootstrap_platform_participant_id::text);
 IF b->>'roleDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(
  jsonb_build_object('domain','pc.identity.envelope-role-binding.v1','participantId',p_participant::text,'role',role_document)),'UTF8')),'hex')
  OR b->>'authorityDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(
  jsonb_build_object('domain','pc.identity.envelope-authority-binding.v1','binding',b-'authorityDigest',
   'authority',(d->'grant')||jsonb_build_object('sessionId',b->'sessionId','sessionEpoch',b->'sessionEpoch'),'durable',d)),'UTF8')),'hex')
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF p_live_session AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.session s WHERE s.participant_id=p_participant
  AND s.session_id=(b->>'sessionId')::uuid AND s.principal_id=pr.principal_id AND s.context_mode='PLATFORM' AND s.privacy_domain_id IS NULL
  AND s.state='ACTIVE' AND s.session_epoch::text=b->>'sessionEpoch' AND s.participant_epoch::text=b->>'participantEpoch'
  AND s.authority_epoch::text=b->>'principalEpoch' AND s.delegation_epoch::text=b->>'delegationEpoch'
  AND s.idle_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND s.absolute_expires_at>clock_timestamp())
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN true;
END $function$
p_participant uuid, p_privacy uuid, p_candidate uuid, p_approval uuid

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.identity_envelope_activation_intent_current(p_participant uuid, p_privacy uuid, p_candidate uuid, p_approval uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_candidate c
  JOIN control.approval_request a ON a.participant_id=c.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
   AND a.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE' AND a.subject_id=c.mutation_candidate_id
   AND a.subject_digest=c.candidate_digest AND a.subject_version=c.expected_revision
   AND a.action_intent_id=c.action_intent_id AND a.maker_principal_id=c.maker_principal_id
  WHERE c.participant_id=p_participant AND c.privacy_domain_id=p_privacy
   AND c.mutation_candidate_id=p_candidate AND a.approval_request_id=p_approval
   AND c.action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANT_ACTIVATE_CONTEXT-V1' AND c.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-ENVELOPE-ACTIVATE'
   AND c.operation_class='ACTIVATE' AND c.resource_type='participant' AND c.expected_revision=3
   AND c.candidate_document=jsonb_build_object('envelopeId',c.resource_id::text)
   AND c.state='APPROVED' AND c.consumed_operation_id IS NULL AND c.expires_at>clock_timestamp()
   AND a.state='APPROVED' AND a.expires_at>clock_timestamp()
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_candidate successor
    WHERE successor.participant_id=c.participant_id AND successor.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
     AND successor.predecessor_candidate_id=c.mutation_candidate_id))
$function$
