CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.identity_envelope_recovery_binding_current(p_enrollment uuid, p_intent jsonb, p_binding jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
 SELECT p_binding->>'schema'='pc.identity.identity-envelope-recovery-lease' AND p_binding->>'schemaVersion'='1'
  AND p_binding->>'purpose'='IDENTITY_ENVELOPE_SIGNER_REPAIR_ONLY' AND p_binding->'postReviewRequired'='true'::jsonb
  AND p_binding-ARRAY['schema','schemaVersion','purpose','recoveryId','enrollmentId','enrollmentDigest','intentDigest','rotationId',
    'creationOperationId','activationOperationId','executorPrincipalId','issuer','oldTrustDigest','selectionAdmissionVersion',
    'proofIds','proofEvidenceDigest','validFrom','validUntil','postReviewRequired','lifetimes']='{}'::jsonb
  AND p_binding->'lifetimes' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_intent->'lifetimes'
  AND (NOT (p_binding ? 'lifetimes') OR p_binding#>>'{lifetimes,profile}'='LOCAL_QA_10X')
  AND p_binding->>'recoveryId'=p_intent->>'recoveryId' AND p_binding->>'enrollmentId'=p_intent->>'enrollmentId'
  AND p_binding->>'enrollmentDigest'=p_intent->>'enrollmentDigest'
  AND p_binding->>'intentDigest'='sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(p_intent),'UTF8')),'hex')
  AND p_binding->>'rotationId'=p_intent->>'rotationId' AND p_binding->>'creationOperationId'=p_intent->>'creationOperationId'
  AND p_binding->>'oldTrustDigest'=p_intent->>'oldTrustDigest' AND p_binding->>'selectionAdmissionVersion'=p_intent->>'selectionAdmissionVersion'
  AND (p_binding->>'validFrom')::timestamptz>=(p_intent->>'validFrom')::timestamptz
  AND (p_binding->>'validFrom')::timestamptz<=clock_timestamp() AND (p_binding->>'validUntil')::timestamptz>clock_timestamp()
  AND (p_binding->>'validUntil')::timestamptz<=(p_intent->>'validUntil')::timestamptz
  AND (p_binding->>'validUntil')::timestamptz<=(p_binding->>'validFrom')::timestamptz+coalesce((p_binding#>>'{lifetimes,leaseMs}')::bigint,900000)*interval '1 millisecond'
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_recovery_enrollment e
   JOIN control.principal issuer ON issuer.participant_id=e.participant_id AND issuer.principal_id::text=e.document->>'issuerPrincipalId'
    AND issuer.state='ACTIVE' AND issuer.kind='WORKLOAD' AND issuer.authority_epoch=(p_intent->>'sourceIssuerPrincipalEpoch')::numeric+1
   JOIN control.participant participant ON participant.participant_id=e.participant_id AND participant.state='ACTIVE'
    AND participant.authority_epoch=(p_intent->>'sourceParticipantEpoch')::numeric
   JOIN control.credential credential ON credential.participant_id=e.participant_id AND credential.principal_id=issuer.principal_id
    AND credential.credential_id::text=e.document#>>'{request,workloadCredentialId}' AND credential.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS'
    AND credential.state='ACTIVE' AND credential.credential_epoch=(p_intent->>'sourceIssuerCredentialEpoch')::numeric
    AND credential.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND (credential.valid_until IS NULL OR credential.valid_until>=(p_binding->>'validUntil')::timestamptz)
   WHERE e.enrollment_id=p_enrollment AND openpc.matches_participant(e.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(e.privacy_domain_id)
    AND e.enrollment_id::text=p_binding->>'enrollmentId' AND e.document_digest=decode(substr(p_binding->>'enrollmentDigest',8),'hex')
    AND e.state='ACTIVE' AND e.row_version=1 AND e.valid_until>=(p_binding->>'validUntil')::timestamptz
    AND openpc.identity_envelope_recovery_source_current(e.enrollment_id)
    AND openpc.identity_envelope_recovery_rotation_selection_current(e.enrollment_id,p_binding)
    AND p_binding->>'executorPrincipalId'=e.document#>>'{recoveryPrincipal,principalId}'
    AND p_binding->'issuer'=jsonb_build_object('participantId',e.participant_id::text,'privacyDomainId',e.privacy_domain_id::text,
      'workloadCredentialId',credential.credential_id::text,'workloadPrincipalId',issuer.principal_id::text,
      'workloadParticipantEpoch',participant.authority_epoch::text,'workloadPrincipalEpoch',issuer.authority_epoch::text,
      'workloadCredentialEpoch',credential.credential_epoch::text,'workloadPublicKeyDigest','sha256:'||encode(credential.public_key_digest,'hex'),
      'credentialValidFromNs',(floor(extract(epoch FROM credential.valid_from)*1000000)*1000)::text,
      'credentialValidUntilNs',(floor(extract(epoch FROM credential.valid_until)*1000000)*1000)::text)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.session s WHERE s.participant_id=e.participant_id AND s.principal_id=issuer.principal_id
      AND s.state IN ('ACTIVE','STEP_UP_REQUIRED') AND s.authority_epoch<= (p_intent->>'sourceIssuerPrincipalEpoch')::numeric)
    AND jsonb_array_length(p_binding->'proofIds')=4
    AND p_binding->>'proofEvidenceDigest'='sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(
      (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('proofId',proof.proof_id::text,'principalId',proof.principal_id::text,
        'principalEpoch',proof.principal_epoch::text,'credentialId',proof.credential_id::text,'credentialEpoch',proof.credential_epoch::text,
        'sessionId',proof.session_id::text,'sessionEpoch',proof.session_epoch::text,'phase',proof.phase,
        'intentDigest','sha256:'||encode(proof.intent_digest,'hex'),
        'verifiedAt',to_char(proof.verified_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'),
        'assertionDigest','sha256:'||encode(proof.assertion_digest,'hex')) ORDER BY names.ordinality)
       FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p_binding->'proofIds') WITH ORDINALITY names(proof_id,ordinality)
       JOIN control.platform_recovery_proof proof ON proof.proof_id::text=names.proof_id
        AND proof.participant_id=e.participant_id AND proof.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
        AND proof.recovery_id::text=p_binding->>'recoveryId')),'UTF8')),'hex')
    AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT value) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p_binding->'proofIds'))=4
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM control.platform_recovery_proof proof WHERE proof.participant_id=e.participant_id
      AND proof.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id AND proof.recovery_id::text=p_binding->>'recoveryId'
      AND proof.intent_digest=decode(substr(p_binding->>'intentDigest',8),'hex'))=4
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p_binding->'proofIds') supplied(proof_id)
      WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_recovery_proof proof
       JOIN control.principal human ON human.participant_id=proof.participant_id AND human.principal_id=proof.principal_id
        AND human.state='ACTIVE' AND human.authority_epoch=proof.principal_epoch
       JOIN control.credential authenticator ON authenticator.participant_id=human.participant_id AND authenticator.principal_id=human.principal_id
        AND authenticator.credential_id=proof.credential_id AND authenticator.credential_epoch=proof.credential_epoch
        AND authenticator.state='ACTIVE' AND authenticator.kind='WEBAUTHN'
       JOIN control.session s ON s.participant_id=human.participant_id AND s.principal_id=human.principal_id AND s.session_id=proof.session_id
        AND s.authority_epoch=human.authority_epoch AND s.participant_epoch=participant.authority_epoch AND s.session_epoch=proof.session_epoch
        AND s.state='ACTIVE' AND s.context_mode='PLATFORM' AND s.privacy_domain_id IS NULL
       WHERE proof.proof_id::text=supplied.proof_id AND proof.participant_id=e.participant_id AND proof.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
        AND proof.recovery_id::text=p_binding->>'recoveryId' AND proof.intent_digest=decode(substr(p_binding->>'intentDigest',8),'hex')
        AND s.idle_expires_at>=(p_binding->>'validUntil')::timestamptz AND s.absolute_expires_at>=(p_binding->>'validUntil')::timestamptz
        AND authenticator.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND (authenticator.valid_until IS NULL OR authenticator.valid_until>=(p_binding->>'validUntil')::timestamptz)
        AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(e.document->'recoveryPrincipal')||e.document->'custodians') actor
          WHERE actor->>'principalId'=human.principal_id::text AND actor->>'credentialId'=authenticator.credential_id::text
           AND actor->>'principalEpoch'=human.authority_epoch::text AND actor->>'credentialEpoch'=authenticator.credential_epoch::text)
        AND (e.document->>'assurance'='LOCAL_QA_VIRTUAL_AUTHENTICATOR' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.hardware_authenticator hardware
          WHERE hardware.participant_id=human.participant_id AND hardware.principal_id=human.principal_id AND hardware.credential_id=authenticator.credential_id)))))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.identity_envelope_recovery_installation_source_current(p_enrollment uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 RETURN current_user='openpc_control_owner'
 AND pg_has_role(session_user,'openpc_control_owner','MEMBER')
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=session_user AND rolcanlogin AND NOT rolsuper AND NOT rolbypassrls)
 AND openpc.current_action_intent_id() IN ('ACT-PARTICIPANTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1')
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_recovery_enrollment enrollment
  JOIN control.identity_envelope_recovery_custody_trust trust ON trust.custody_trust_id=enrollment.custody_trust_id
   AND trust.participant_id=enrollment.participant_id AND trust.privacy_domain_id=enrollment.privacy_domain_id
   AND trust.platform_context_id=enrollment.platform_context_id AND trust.document_digest=enrollment.custody_trust_digest
   AND trust.state='ACTIVE' AND trust.row_version=1
   AND trust.valid_from<=enrollment.valid_from AND trust.valid_until>=enrollment.valid_until
  JOIN control.platform_context root ON root.platform_context_id=enrollment.platform_context_id
   AND root.owner_participant_id=enrollment.participant_id AND root.state='ACTIVE'
   AND root.authority_epoch::text=enrollment.document->>'rootEpoch'
   AND root.row_version::text=enrollment.document->>'rootRevision'
  JOIN (
   SELECT platform_context_id,owner_participant_id,installation_privacy_domain_id,
    platform_authority_epoch,environment_id,installation_digest,admission_digest FROM control.platform_envelope_scope
   UNION ALL
   SELECT platform_context_id,owner_participant_id,installation_privacy_domain_id,
    platform_authority_epoch,environment_id,installation_digest,admission_digest FROM control.platform_envelope_scope_successor
   UNION ALL SELECT platform_context_id,owner_participant_id,installation_privacy_domain_id,platform_authority_epoch,environment_id,installation_digest,admission_digest FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_scope
  ) scope ON scope.platform_context_id=root.platform_context_id AND scope.owner_participant_id=enrollment.participant_id
   AND scope.installation_privacy_domain_id=enrollment.privacy_domain_id AND scope.platform_authority_epoch=root.authority_epoch
   AND 'sha256:'||encode(scope.admission_digest,'hex')=enrollment.document->>'rootDigest'
   AND scope.environment_id=enrollment.document->>'installationEnvironmentId'
   AND scope.installation_digest=enrollment.document->>'installationDigest'
  JOIN control.operations_installation installation ON installation.participant_id=enrollment.participant_id
   AND installation.privacy_domain_id=enrollment.privacy_domain_id AND installation.environment_id=scope.environment_id
   AND installation.installation_digest=scope.installation_digest AND installation.state='ACTIVE'
  WHERE enrollment.enrollment_id=p_enrollment AND openpc.matches_participant(enrollment.participant_id)
   AND openpc.matches_privacy(enrollment.privacy_domain_id) AND enrollment.state='ACTIVE' AND enrollment.row_version=1
   AND enrollment.document->>'schema'='pc.identity.identity-envelope-recovery-enrollment'
   AND enrollment.document->>'purpose'='pc.installation.identity-envelope-repair-custody.v1'
   AND trust.document->>'purpose'=enrollment.document->>'purpose'
   AND trust.document->>'installationEnvironmentId'=scope.environment_id
   AND trust.document->>'installationDigest'=scope.installation_digest
   AND trust.document->>'profile'=enrollment.document->>'profile'
   AND enrollment.document_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(enrollment.document),'UTF8'))
   AND trust.document_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(trust.document),'UTF8'))
   AND installation.installation_bytes=convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(installation.installation),'UTF8')
   AND installation.installation_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(installation.installation_bytes),'hex')
   AND openpc.operations_source_authentication_valid(installation.installation)
   AND enrollment.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND enrollment.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_scope_replacement replacement
    WHERE replacement.platform_context_id=root.platform_context_id AND replacement.state='WITHDRAWING'));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.identity_envelope_recovery_lease_current(p_recovery uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_recovery_case c WHERE c.recovery_id=p_recovery
  AND c.state='ACTIVE' AND c.signer_repair_enrollment_id IS NOT NULL
  AND openpc.matches_participant(c.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(c.privacy_domain_id)
  AND c.activation_operation_id::text=c.lease_bindings->>'activationOperationId'
  AND c.activation_evidence_digest=sha256(c.activation_evidence_cbor) AND octet_length(c.activation_cose)>0
  AND openpc.identity_envelope_recovery_binding_current(c.signer_repair_enrollment_id,c.intent,c.lease_bindings));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.identity_envelope_recovery_old_selection_current(p_enrollment uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_recovery_enrollment e
  JOIN control.identity_envelope_signing_selection selection ON selection.participant_id=e.participant_id
   AND selection.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id AND selection.environment_id=e.document#>>'{request,environmentId}'
   AND selection.signer_id=e.document#>>'{request,oldFingerprint}' AND selection.admission_version::text=e.document->>'selectionAdmissionVersion'
   AND selection.profile_digest=decode('54d85c86019a4475f8207f375fa571565e9e6e0adb5b0bd55abc03e4beb81f74','hex')
  JOIN control.identity_envelope_signing_grant grant_row ON grant_row.participant_id=selection.participant_id
   AND grant_row.privacy_domain_id=selection.privacy_domain_id AND grant_row.signer_id=selection.signer_id
   AND grant_row.profile_digest=selection.profile_digest AND grant_row.signing_purpose_code=371
  JOIN control.business_signing_key key ON key.participant_id=selection.participant_id AND key.privacy_domain_id=selection.privacy_domain_id
   AND key.signer_id=selection.signer_id AND key.signing_purpose_code=371 AND key.secret_reference=e.document#>>'{request,oldReference}'
   AND key.environment_id=selection.environment_id AND (
    (key.workload_credential_id::text=e.document#>>'{request,workloadCredentialId}'
     AND key.workload_credential_epoch::text=e.document->>'issuerCredentialEpoch')
    OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM control.credential predecessor
    JOIN control.credential successor ON successor.participant_id=predecessor.participant_id
      AND successor.rotated_from_credential_id=predecessor.credential_id
      AND successor.principal_id=predecessor.principal_id AND successor.audience=predecessor.audience
    JOIN control.mutation_candidate candidate ON candidate.participant_id=predecessor.participant_id
      AND candidate.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
      AND candidate.resource_id=predecessor.credential_id
      AND candidate.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE'
      AND candidate.action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
      AND candidate.state='CONSUMED' AND candidate.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL
      AND candidate.candidate_document=jsonb_build_object('replacedCredentialId',predecessor.credential_id::text,
        'credentialId',successor.credential_id::text,
        'publicKeySpkiDer',replace(encode(successor.public_key_spki_der,'base64'),E'\n',''))
      AND candidate.candidate_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(candidate.candidate_document),'UTF8'))
    JOIN control.approval_request approval ON approval.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
      AND approval.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id AND approval.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE'
      AND approval.subject_id=candidate.mutation_candidate_id AND approval.subject_digest=candidate.candidate_digest
      AND approval.maker_principal_id=candidate.maker_principal_id AND approval.state='APPROVED'
      AND approval.subject_version=candidate.expected_revision AND approval.action_intent_id=candidate.action_intent_id
    JOIN control.approval_decision_record decision ON decision.participant_id=approval.participant_id
      AND decision.privacy_domain_id=approval.privacy_domain_id AND decision.approval_request_id=approval.approval_request_id
      AND decision.decision='APPROVE' AND decision.candidate_digest=candidate.candidate_digest
      AND decision.approver_principal_id<>approval.maker_principal_id AND decision.cose_sign1 IS NOT NULL
      AND decision.aggregate_version=approval.subject_version
    JOIN control.mutation_evidence evidence ON evidence.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
      AND evidence.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id AND evidence.operation_id=candidate.consumed_operation_id
      AND evidence.action_intent_id=candidate.action_intent_id AND evidence.catalog_operation_id=candidate.catalog_operation_id
      AND evidence.aggregate_type='workload-credential' AND evidence.aggregate_id=predecessor.credential_id
      AND evidence.candidate_digest=candidate.candidate_digest AND evidence.principal_id=approval.maker_principal_id
      AND evidence.checker_principal_id=decision.approver_principal_id AND evidence.approval_request_id=approval.approval_request_id
      AND evidence.evidence_digest=sha256(evidence.evidence_cbor) AND evidence.cose_sign1 IS NOT NULL
      AND evidence.evidence_cbor=decision.evidence_cbor AND evidence.cose_sign1=decision.cose_sign1
      AND evidence.signer_credential_id=decision.signer_credential_id
      AND evidence.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest IS NOT NULL AND evidence.mfa_challenge_id IS NOT NULL
    JOIN control.idempotency_record committed ON committed.participant_id=evidence.participant_id
      AND committed.privacy_domain_id=evidence.privacy_domain_id AND committed.operation_id=evidence.operation_id
      AND committed.action_intent_id=evidence.action_intent_id AND committed.catalog_operation_id=evidence.catalog_operation_id
      AND committed.principal_id=evidence.principal_id
      AND committed.terminal_state='COMMITTED' AND committed.input_digest=evidence.candidate_digest
      AND committed.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=evidence.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
      AND committed.result_payload->>'credentialId'=successor.credential_id::text
      AND committed.result_payload->>'replacedCredentialId'=predecessor.credential_id::text
      AND committed.result_payload->>'principalId'=successor.principal_id::text
      AND committed.result_payload->>'workloadId'=successor.audience
      AND committed.result_payload->>'workloadEpoch'=successor.credential_epoch::text
      AND committed.result_payload->>'state'='ACTIVE'
    JOIN control.outbox_event event ON event.participant_id=evidence.participant_id
      AND event.privacy_domain_id=evidence.privacy_domain_id AND event.aggregate_type=evidence.aggregate_type
      AND event.aggregate_id=evidence.aggregate_id AND event.payload_cbor=evidence.evidence_cbor
      AND event.event_type='openpc.identity.workload-credential.mutation.committed.v1'
      AND event.payload_digest=evidence.evidence_digest AND event.cose_sign1=evidence.cose_sign1
      AND event.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=evidence.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
    WHERE predecessor.participant_id=e.participant_id
      AND predecessor.credential_id=key.workload_credential_id AND successor.credential_id=(e.document#>>'{request,workloadCredentialId}')::uuid
      AND predecessor.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND predecessor.state='REVOKED'
      AND successor.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND successor.state='ACTIVE'
      AND predecessor.credential_epoch=key.workload_credential_epoch+1
      AND successor.credential_epoch=predecessor.credential_epoch
      AND successor.credential_epoch=(e.document->>'issuerCredentialEpoch')::numeric
      AND successor.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND successor.valid_until>clock_timestamp()

  ))
   AND 'sha256:'||encode(key.trust_digest,'hex')=e.document->>'oldTrustDigest'
  JOIN control.business_signing_key_state lifecycle ON lifecycle.participant_id=key.participant_id
   AND lifecycle.privacy_domain_id=key.privacy_domain_id AND lifecycle.signer_id=key.signer_id AND lifecycle.state='ACTIVE'
  WHERE e.enrollment_id=p_enrollment AND openpc.matches_participant(e.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(e.privacy_domain_id)
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.business_signing_grant receipt WHERE receipt.participant_id=key.participant_id
    AND receipt.privacy_domain_id=key.privacy_domain_id AND receipt.signer_id=key.signer_id));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.identity_envelope_recovery_proofs_current(p_case control.platform_recovery_case, p_activation uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
 SELECT p_case.signer_repair_enrollment_id IS NOT NULL
 AND openpc.matches_participant(p_case.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(p_case.privacy_domain_id)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_recovery_enrollment e
  WHERE e.enrollment_id=p_case.signer_repair_enrollment_id AND e.participant_id=p_case.participant_id
   AND e.privacy_domain_id=p_case.privacy_domain_id AND e.state='ACTIVE' AND e.row_version=p_case.enrollment_revision
   AND e.document_digest=p_case.enrollment_digest AND openpc.identity_envelope_recovery_source_current(e.enrollment_id)
   AND jsonb_array_length(e.document->'custodians')=2
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM control.platform_recovery_proof proof WHERE proof.participant_id=e.participant_id
    AND proof.recovery_id=p_case.recovery_id)=4
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(
    jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('signer',e.document->'recoveryPrincipal','phase','REQUEST'),
     jsonb_build_object('signer',e.document->'recoveryPrincipal','phase','ACTIVATE')) ||
     (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signer',custodian,'phase','APPROVE')) FROM jsonb_array_elements(e.document->'custodians') custodian)) required
    WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_recovery_proof proof
     JOIN control.platform_recovery_challenge h ON h.participant_id=proof.participant_id AND h.recovery_id=proof.recovery_id
      AND h.challenge_id=proof.challenge_id AND h.proof_id=proof.proof_id AND h.consumed_at IS NOT NULL
     JOIN control.principal p ON p.participant_id=proof.participant_id AND p.principal_id=proof.principal_id
      AND p.state='ACTIVE' AND p.kind IN ('USER','PLATFORM_OPERATOR') AND p.authority_epoch=proof.principal_epoch
     JOIN control.credential c ON c.participant_id=p.participant_id AND c.principal_id=p.principal_id
      AND c.credential_id=proof.credential_id AND c.credential_epoch=proof.credential_epoch AND c.kind='WEBAUTHN' AND c.state='ACTIVE'
      AND c.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND (c.valid_until IS NULL OR c.valid_until>clock_timestamp())
     JOIN control.session s ON s.participant_id=p.participant_id AND s.principal_id=p.principal_id
      AND s.session_id=proof.session_id AND s.session_epoch=proof.session_epoch AND s.authority_epoch=p.authority_epoch
      AND s.participant_epoch=(p_case.intent->>'sourceParticipantEpoch')::numeric AND s.state='ACTIVE'
      AND s.context_mode='PLATFORM' AND s.privacy_domain_id IS NULL
      AND s.idle_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND s.absolute_expires_at>clock_timestamp()
     WHERE proof.participant_id=p_case.participant_id AND proof.privacy_domain_id=p_case.privacy_domain_id
      AND proof.recovery_id=p_case.recovery_id AND proof.intent_digest=p_case.intent_digest
      AND proof.phase=required->>'phase' AND proof.principal_id::text=required#>>'{signer,principalId}'
      AND proof.credential_id::text=required#>>'{signer,credentialId}'
      AND proof.principal_epoch::text=required#>>'{signer,principalEpoch}' AND proof.credential_epoch::text=required#>>'{signer,credentialEpoch}'
      AND (proof.phase<>'ACTIVATE' OR proof.proof_id=p_activation)
      AND proof.verified_at>=p_case.valid_from AND proof.verified_at<=clock_timestamp()
      AND proof.verified_at>clock_timestamp()-make_interval(secs=>h.verified_proof_max_age_ms/1000.0)
      AND (h.verified_proof_max_age_ms=300000 OR (h.verified_proof_max_age_ms=3000000
        AND h.duration_profile='LOCAL_QA_10X' AND s.duration_profile='LOCAL_QA_10X' AND h.expires_at>clock_timestamp()))
      AND (e.document->>'assurance'='LOCAL_QA_VIRTUAL_AUTHENTICATOR' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.hardware_authenticator hardware
        WHERE hardware.participant_id=c.participant_id AND hardware.principal_id=c.principal_id AND hardware.credential_id=c.credential_id))))
 );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.identity_envelope_recovery_rotation_selection_current(p_enrollment uuid, p_binding jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF openpc.identity_envelope_recovery_old_selection_current(p_enrollment) THEN RETURN true; END IF;
 RETURN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_recovery_enrollment e
  JOIN control.signing_key_rotation r ON r.participant_id=e.participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
    AND r.rotation_id::text=p_binding->>'rotationId' AND r.recovery_case_id::text=p_binding->>'recoveryId'
    AND r.old_signer_id=e.document#>>'{request,oldFingerprint}' AND r.approval_request_id IS NULL
    AND r.state IN('CUTOVER_FENCED','OBSERVING','OLD_REVOKED','OLD_RETIRED','COMPLETE')
  JOIN control.identity_envelope_rotation_step cutover ON cutover.participant_id=r.participant_id AND cutover.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id
    AND cutover.rotation_id=r.rotation_id AND cutover.recovery_id=r.recovery_case_id AND cutover.state='COMMITTED'
    AND cutover.from_revision=5 AND cutover.from_state='VERIFIED' AND cutover.to_state='CUTOVER_FENCED'
    AND cutover.authority_binding=jsonb_build_object('kind','IDENTITY_ENVELOPE_SIGNER_RECOVERY','enrollment',e.document,'lease',p_binding)
    AND cutover.evidence_digest=sha256(cutover.evidence_cbor) AND octet_length(cutover.cose_sign1)>0
  JOIN control.identity_envelope_signing_selection selection ON selection.participant_id=r.participant_id AND selection.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id
    AND selection.environment_id=r.environment_id AND selection.signer_id=r.new_signer_id
    AND selection.admission_version=(p_binding->>'selectionAdmissionVersion')::numeric+1
    AND selection.admission_version::text=cutover.result->>'selectionAdmissionVersion'
    AND selection.profile_digest=decode('54d85c86019a4475f8207f375fa571565e9e6e0adb5b0bd55abc03e4beb81f74','hex')
  JOIN control.business_signing_key k ON k.participant_id=selection.participant_id AND k.privacy_domain_id=selection.privacy_domain_id
    AND k.signer_id=selection.signer_id AND k.signing_purpose_code=371 AND k.environment_id=selection.environment_id
    AND 'sha256:'||encode(k.trust_digest,'hex')=cutover.result->>'trustDigest'
  JOIN control.business_signing_key_state life ON life.participant_id=k.participant_id AND life.privacy_domain_id=k.privacy_domain_id
    AND life.signer_id=k.signer_id AND life.state='ACTIVE'
  WHERE e.enrollment_id=p_enrollment AND openpc.matches_participant(e.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(e.privacy_domain_id)
    AND k.workload_credential_id::text=p_binding#>>'{issuer,workloadCredentialId}'
    AND k.workload_credential_epoch::text=p_binding#>>'{issuer,workloadCredentialEpoch}'
    AND k.envelope_workload_participant_epoch::text=p_binding#>>'{issuer,workloadParticipantEpoch}'
    AND k.envelope_workload_principal_epoch::text=p_binding#>>'{issuer,workloadPrincipalEpoch}'
    AND k.valid_from_ns<=floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000 AND k.valid_until_ns>floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.business_signing_grant ordinary WHERE ordinary.participant_id=k.participant_id AND ordinary.privacy_domain_id=k.privacy_domain_id AND ordinary.signer_id=k.signer_id));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.identity_envelope_recovery_source_current(p_enrollment uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 RETURN openpc.current_action_intent_id()='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_recovery_enrollment e
  JOIN control.identity_envelope_recovery_custody_trust t ON t.custody_trust_id=e.custody_trust_id
   AND t.participant_id=e.participant_id AND t.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
   AND t.platform_context_id=e.platform_context_id AND t.document_digest=e.custody_trust_digest
   AND t.state='ACTIVE' AND t.row_version=1 AND t.valid_from<=e.valid_from AND t.valid_until>=e.valid_until
  JOIN control.platform_context p ON p.platform_context_id=e.platform_context_id
   AND p.owner_participant_id=e.participant_id AND p.state='ACTIVE'
   AND p.authority_epoch::text=e.document->>'rootEpoch' AND p.row_version::text=e.document->>'rootRevision'
  JOIN control.operations_installation i ON i.participant_id=e.participant_id AND i.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
   AND i.environment_id=e.document->>'installationEnvironmentId' AND i.installation_digest=e.document->>'installationDigest'
   AND i.state='ACTIVE'
  WHERE e.enrollment_id=p_enrollment AND openpc.matches_participant(e.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(e.privacy_domain_id)
   AND e.state='ACTIVE' AND e.row_version=1 AND e.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND e.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
   AND e.document_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(e.document),'UTF8'))
   AND t.document_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(t.document),'UTF8'))
   AND i.installation_bytes=convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(i.installation),'UTF8')
   AND i.installation_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(i.installation_bytes),'hex')
   AND openpc.operations_source_authentication_valid(i.installation)
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_scope_replacement r WHERE r.platform_context_id=p.platform_context_id AND r.state='WITHDRAWING'));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.identity_envelope_rotation_step_bound(p_step control.identity_envelope_rotation_step)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
 SELECT openpc.matches_participant(p_step.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(p_step.privacy_domain_id)
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_key_rotation r JOIN control.platform_recovery_case c
   ON c.recovery_id=r.recovery_case_id AND c.participant_id=r.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id
   JOIN control.identity_envelope_recovery_enrollment e ON e.enrollment_id=c.signer_repair_enrollment_id
    AND e.participant_id=c.participant_id AND e.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
   WHERE r.rotation_id=p_step.rotation_id AND r.participant_id=p_step.participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=p_step.privacy_domain_id
    AND c.recovery_id=p_step.recovery_id AND c.activated_at IS NOT NULL
    AND r.request=e.document->'request' AND r.approval_request_id IS NULL
    AND r.rotation_id::text=c.lease_bindings->>'rotationId'
    AND p_step.principal_id::text=c.lease_bindings->>'executorPrincipalId'
    AND p_step.authority_binding=jsonb_build_object('kind','IDENTITY_ENVELOPE_SIGNER_RECOVERY','enrollment',e.document,'lease',c.lease_bindings)
    AND p_step.authority_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(p_step.authority_binding),'UTF8')));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.invalidate_directory_group_context()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF ((OLD.state='ACTIVE' AND NEW.state<>'ACTIVE') OR NEW.external_group_freshness_seconds<OLD.external_group_freshness_seconds)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM control.directory_group_mapping g JOIN control.assignment a ON a.participant_id=g.participant_id AND a.authority_group_id=g.authority_group_id
    WHERE g.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND g.connector_id=NEW.connector_id AND a.state IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED')) THEN
  UPDATE control.participant SET authority_epoch=authority_epoch+1,row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.is_platform_recovery_executor(p_principal uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM (
  SELECT participant_id,document FROM control.platform_recovery_enrollment
  UNION ALL SELECT participant_id,document FROM control.identity_envelope_recovery_enrollment
  UNION ALL SELECT participant_id,document FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_enrollment
 ) e WHERE openpc.matches_participant(e.participant_id) AND e.document#>>'{recoveryPrincipal,principalId}'=p_principal::text)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.lock_authority_envelope_platform_context(p_envelope_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(platform_context_id uuid, platform_authority_epoch text, delegation_epoch text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(false);
 RETURN QUERY SELECT platform.platform_context_id,platform.authority_epoch::text,envelope.delegation_epoch::text
 FROM control.authority_envelope envelope JOIN control.platform_context platform
   ON platform.platform_context_id=envelope.platform_context_id
 WHERE envelope.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id()
   AND envelope.authority_envelope_id=p_envelope_id AND envelope.state='ACTIVE'
   AND envelope.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND (envelope.valid_until IS NULL OR envelope.valid_until>clock_timestamp())
   AND platform.state='ACTIVE' AND platform.authority_epoch=envelope.platform_authority_epoch
 FOR SHARE OF platform;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.lock_cigl_invalidation_participant()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(false);
 IF openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-CIGL_ANALYSES_READ_RESOURCE-V1'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-CIGL-INVALIDATION-PARTICIPANT'; END IF;
 PERFORM 1 FROM control.participant
  WHERE participant_id=current_setting('openpc.participant_id')::uuid FOR SHARE;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-CIGL-INVALIDATION-PARTICIPANT'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.lock_cigl_publication_participant()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(false);
 IF openpc.current_action_intent_id() NOT IN ('ACT-CIGL_ANALYSES_READ_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-CIGL_ANALYSES_REVIEW_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-RUNTIME_READ_RPC-V1')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-CIGL-PUBLICATION-PARTICIPANT'; END IF;
 PERFORM 1 FROM control.participant
  WHERE participant_id=current_setting('openpc.participant_id')::uuid

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.lock_fact_contract_binding(p_binding_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(binding_revision bigint, chain_id text, network_id text, genesis_digest text, contract_address text, code_digest text, proxy_address text, implementation_address text, implementation_code_digest text, abi_artifact_id uuid, abi_version text, abi_digest text, canonical_abi_bytes bytea)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(false);
 IF openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-FACT_ARTIFACTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-FACT-CONTRACT';
 END IF;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT binding.revision,binding.chain_id,binding.network_id,binding.genesis_digest,
  binding.contract_address,binding.code_digest,binding.proxy_address,binding.implementation_address,
  binding.implementation_code_digest,binding.abi_artifact_id,binding.abi_version,abi.abi_digest,abi.canonical_abi_bytes
 FROM control.contract_runtime_binding binding
 JOIN control.abi_artifact abi ON abi.abi_artifact_id=binding.abi_artifact_id
  AND abi.participant_id=binding.participant_id AND abi.privacy_domain_id=binding.privacy_domain_id
 JOIN control.logical_contract_asset asset ON asset.logical_contract_id=binding.logical_contract_id
  AND asset.participant_id=binding.participant_id AND asset.privacy_domain_id=binding.privacy_domain_id
 WHERE binding.runtime_binding_id=p_binding_id AND binding.state='BOUND'
  AND binding.quarantined_at IS NULL AND octet_length(abi.canonical_abi_bytes) BETWEEN 2 AND 131072
  AND openpc.matches_participant(binding.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(binding.privacy_domain_id)
 FOR SHARE OF binding,abi,asset;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-FACT-CONTRACT'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.lock_indexer_dispatch_source(p_target_id uuid, p_capsule_digest text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_source_id uuid; v_plan_id uuid; v_provider_id uuid; v_configuration_digest text;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(false);
 IF openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-RUNTIME_READ_RPC-V1'
   OR p_capsule_digest !~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-INDEXER-SOURCE';
 END IF;
 PERFORM openpc.lock_cigl_publication_participant();
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock_shared(hashtextextended('module-admission:'||
   openpc.current_participant_id()::text||':'||openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()::text,0));
 SELECT generation.projection_plan_id,generation.provider_profile_id,work.configuration_digest
  INTO STRICT v_plan_id,v_provider_id,v_configuration_digest
 FROM control.runtime_target target
 JOIN control.runtime_activation_observation observation
  ON observation.runtime_target_id=target.runtime_target_id
   AND observation.participant_id=target.participant_id AND observation.privacy_domain_id=target.privacy_domain_id
   AND observation.capsule_digest=target.active_generation_digest
 JOIN control.runtime_configuration_generation generation
  ON generation.runtime_configuration_generation_id=observation.runtime_configuration_generation_id
   AND generation.participant_id=target.participant_id AND generation.privacy_domain_id=target.privacy_domain_id
   AND generation.runtime_target_id=target.runtime_target_id AND generation.generation_digest=observation.generation_digest
 JOIN control.configuration_work work ON work.configuration_work_id=observation.configuration_work_id
  AND work.participant_id=target.participant_id AND work.privacy_domain_id=target.privacy_domain_id
  AND work.runtime_target_id=target.runtime_target_id
  AND work.runtime_configuration_generation_id=generation.runtime_configuration_generation_id
  AND work.generation_digest=generation.generation_digest
  AND work.policy_generation_digest=generation.policy_generation_digest
  AND work.predecessor_digest IS NOT DISTINCT FROM generation.predecessor_digest
  AND work.xds_version_digest=observation.xds_version_digest
  AND work.operation_id=observation.operation_id AND work.execution_attempt_id=observation.execution_attempt_id
  AND work.result_receipt_digest=observation.activation_receipt_digest
 WHERE target.runtime_target_id=p_target_id
  AND openpc.matches_participant(target.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(target.privacy_domain_id)
  AND target.state='ACTIVE_MATCHED' AND target.active_generation_digest=p_capsule_digest
  AND target.desired_generation_digest=p_capsule_digest AND target.xds_version_digest=observation.xds_version_digest
  AND target.policy_generation_digest=generation.policy_generation_digest
  AND generation.state='ACTIVE' AND work.state='COMPLETED' AND work.work_kind='RUNTIME_ACTIVATION'
  AND work.execution_started_at IS NOT NULL
 FOR SHARE OF target,generation,work;
 SELECT projection.indexer_profile_id INTO STRICT v_source_id FROM control.projection_plan projection
 WHERE projection.projection_plan_id=v_plan_id
  AND openpc.matches_participant(projection.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(projection.privacy_domain_id)
 FOR SHARE;
 PERFORM 1 FROM control.indexer_profile source WHERE source.indexer_profile_id=v_source_id
  AND openpc.matches_participant(source.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(source.privacy_domain_id)
 FOR SHARE;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-INDEXER-SOURCE'; END IF;
 PERFORM 1 FROM control.provider_profile provider
 JOIN control.provider_probe_observation observation ON observation.observation_id=provider.qualification_observation_id
  AND observation.provider_profile_id=provider.provider_profile_id
  AND observation.participant_id=provider.participant_id AND observation.privacy_domain_id=provider.privacy_domain_id
 WHERE provider.provider_profile_id=v_provider_id
  AND openpc.matches_participant(provider.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(provider.privacy_domain_id)
 FOR SHARE OF provider,observation;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-INDEXER-SOURCE'; END IF;
 PERFORM 1 FROM control.runtime_configuration_input input
 WHERE openpc.matches_participant(input.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(input.privacy_domain_id)
  AND input.configuration_digest=decode(substr(v_configuration_digest,8),'hex') AND input.selected
 FOR SHARE;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-INDEXER-SOURCE'; END IF;
 RETURN v_plan_id;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.lock_indexer_qualified_provider(p_provider_id uuid, p_artifact_digest text)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE expiry_ns bigint;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(false);
 IF openpc.current_action_intent_id() NOT IN ('ACT-RUNTIME_READ_RPC-V1','ACT-CANDIDATE_WRITE-V1','ACT-FACT_ARTIFACTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1')
  OR p_artifact_digest !~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-INDEXER-PROVIDER';
 END IF;
 SELECT (extract(epoch from observation.valid_until)*1000000000)::bigint INTO STRICT expiry_ns
 FROM control.provider_profile provider
 JOIN control.provider_probe_observation observation ON observation.observation_id=provider.qualification_observation_id
  AND observation.provider_profile_id=provider.provider_profile_id
  AND observation.participant_id=provider.participant_id AND observation.privacy_domain_id=provider.privacy_domain_id
 JOIN control.configuration_work qualification ON qualification.resource_id=provider.provider_profile_id
  AND qualification.participant_id=provider.participant_id AND qualification.privacy_domain_id=provider.privacy_domain_id
  AND qualification.work_kind='PROVIDER_QUALIFICATION' AND qualification.state='COMPLETED'
 WHERE provider.provider_profile_id=p_provider_id AND provider.behavior_fingerprint=p_artifact_digest
  AND openpc.matches_participant(provider.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(provider.privacy_domain_id)
  AND provider.state IN ('QUALIFIED','ACTIVE') AND provider.revision=observation.observed_revision+2
  AND observation.state='OBSERVED' AND observation.input_digest=provider.behavior_fingerprint
  AND observation.observation_id::text=qualification.result_receipt->>'liveObservationId'
  AND observation.observation_digest=qualification.result_receipt->>'liveObservationDigest'
  AND observation.observation=qualification.result_receipt->'liveObservation'
  AND qualification.result_receipt->>'artifactDigest'=provider.behavior_fingerprint
  AND observation.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
 FOR SHARE OF provider,observation,qualification;
 RETURN expiry_ns;
EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.lock_native_value_authority(wallet_id uuid, actor_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-DEPLOYMENT_SUBMISSIONS_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1' OR pg_trigger_depth()=0 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0002-NATIVE-VALUE-CUSTODY';
 END IF;
 PERFORM 1 FROM control.wallet_binding wallet
 JOIN control.participant participant USING(participant_id)
 JOIN control.principal principal ON principal.participant_id=wallet.participant_id AND principal.principal_id=actor_id
 WHERE wallet.wallet_binding_id=wallet_id AND wallet.subject_id=actor_id
  AND openpc.matches_participant(wallet.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(wallet.privacy_domain_id)
 FOR SHARE OF wallet,participant,principal;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0002-NATIVE-VALUE-CUSTODY'; END IF;
 PERFORM 1 FROM control.credential credential WHERE openpc.matches_participant(credential.participant_id)
  AND credential.principal_id=actor_id AND credential.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' FOR SHARE;
END $function$
pid uuid, privacy uuid, actor uuid, envelope_id uuid, assignment_id uuid

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.lock_platform_recovery_completion_assignment_read(pid uuid, privacy uuid, actor uuid, envelope_id uuid, assignment_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE selected_recovery uuid; selected_until timestamptz;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF NOT openpc.matches_participant(pid) OR NOT openpc.matches_privacy(privacy)
  OR openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ADMINISTRATION-ASSIGNMENT-READ'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.authority_envelope e JOIN control.platform_recovery_case c
   ON c.participant_id=e.participant_id AND c.recovery_id=e.recovery_case_id
   WHERE e.participant_id=pid AND e.authority_envelope_id=envelope_id AND c.intent ? 'completionSourceDigest')
 THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 SELECT recovery.recovery_id,recovery.valid_until INTO selected_recovery,selected_until
 FROM control.authority_envelope envelope
 JOIN control.platform_recovery_case recovery ON recovery.participant_id=envelope.participant_id
  AND recovery.recovery_id=envelope.recovery_case_id
 JOIN control.platform_recovery_enrollment enrollment ON enrollment.participant_id=recovery.participant_id
  AND enrollment.privacy_domain_id=recovery.privacy_domain_id AND enrollment.enrollment_id=recovery.enrollment_id
 JOIN control.platform_scope_replacement replacement ON replacement.participant_id=recovery.participant_id
  AND replacement.privacy_domain_id=recovery.privacy_domain_id
  AND replacement.replacement_id::text=recovery.intent#>>'{preparation,replacementId}'
  AND replacement.state='WITHDRAWING' AND replacement.candidate=recovery.intent->'preparation'
 JOIN control.platform_context root ON root.platform_context_id=replacement.platform_context_id
  AND root.owner_participant_id=pid AND root.state='ACTIVE'
  AND root.authority_epoch=replacement.predecessor_epoch AND root.row_version=replacement.expected_root_revision
 WHERE envelope.participant_id=pid AND recovery.privacy_domain_id=privacy
  AND envelope.principal_id=actor AND envelope.authority_envelope_id=envelope_id
  AND envelope.representation='RECOVERY_V1' AND recovery.state='ACTIVE'
  AND recovery.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND recovery.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
  AND recovery.intent->>'schema'='pc.identity.platform-recovery-intent'
  AND enrollment.source_purpose='ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY_CONTINUATION'
  AND enrollment.document->>'schemaVersion'='3'
  AND enrollment.document#>>'{source,activatedHandoff,schemaVersion}'='1'
  AND recovery.intent->>'completionSourceDigest'='sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(enrollment.document#>'{source,activatedHandoff}'),'UTF8')),'hex')
  AND openpc.platform_recovery_envelope_current(envelope.authority_envelope_id)
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(recovery.intent#>'{preparation,administrators}') administrator
    WHERE administrator->>'principalId'=actor::text)
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(recovery.intent#>'{preparation,administrators}') administrator
    WHERE administrator->>'assignmentId'=assignment_id::text)
 FOR SHARE OF root,enrollment,recovery,replacement NOWAIT;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 -- Locks serialize closure and replacement commit; recheck lease freshness after acquisition.
 RETURN selected_until>clock_timestamp() AND openpc.platform_recovery_envelope_current(envelope_id);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.lock_platform_recovery_enrollment(p_enrollment_id uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF control.platform_recovery_enrollment
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 -- Recovery activation writes recipient epochs and session families. Declare the
 -- common Participant write fence first, rather than upgrading child share locks.
 PERFORM 1 FROM control.participant p WHERE p.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id() AND p.state='ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT e.* FROM control.platform_recovery_enrollment e WHERE e.enrollment_id=p_enrollment_id
  AND openpc.matches_participant(e.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(e.privacy_domain_id) FOR UPDATE OF e;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.lock_platform_scope_context(p_root_id uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF control.platform_context
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(false);
 RETURN QUERY SELECT p.* FROM control.platform_context p
 WHERE p.platform_context_id=p_root_id AND p.state='ACTIVE'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.authority_envelope e
   WHERE e.platform_context_id=p.platform_context_id
     AND e.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id())
 FOR SHARE OF p;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.lock_runtime_artifact_disposition()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed' OR current_setting('row_security')<>'on'
  OR current_setting('session_replication_role')<>'origin'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user AND NOT rolsuper AND NOT rolbypassrls)
  OR NOT pg_has_role(current_user,'openpc_control_runtime','USAGE')
  OR NOT pg_has_role(session_user,'openpc_control_runtime','USAGE')
  OR openpc.current_action_intent_id() NOT IN
   ('ACT-EVIDENCE_DELETIONS_READ_RUNTIME_SOURCE-V1','ACT-EVIDENCE_DELETIONS_DISPOSE_RUNTIME_SOURCE-V1',
    'ACT-EVIDENCE_DELETIONS_READ_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-EVIDENCE_DELETIONS_CREATE_RUNTIME_BATCH-V1')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('evidence-lifecycle:'||openpc.current_participant_id()::text,0))
  OR NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock_shared(hashtextextended('module-release-catalog',0))
  OR NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('module-admission:'||openpc.current_participant_id()::text||':'||openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()::text,0))
  OR NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock_shared(hashtextextended('openpc-policy-generations:'||openpc.current_participant_id()::text||':'||openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()::text,0))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='55P03',MESSAGE='RUNTIME-DISPOSITION-PRODUCER-CONTENTION'; END IF;
END $function$
pid uuid, privacy uuid, configuration bytea

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.lock_runtime_artifact_originals(pid uuid, privacy uuid, configuration bytea)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF pid IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_participant_id() OR privacy IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
  OR pid IS NULL OR privacy IS NULL OR configuration IS NULL OR octet_length(configuration)<>32
  OR current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'serializable'
  OR current_setting('session_replication_role')<>'origin'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('evidence-lifecycle:'||pid::text,0))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001', MESSAGE='PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 PERFORM input.runtime_configuration_input_id FROM control.runtime_configuration_input input
  WHERE input.participant_id=pid AND input.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND input.configuration_digest=configuration
  ORDER BY input.runtime_configuration_input_id FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001', MESSAGE='PC-DATA-6007';
END $function$

 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'

BEGIN

 IF current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed' OR current_setting('row_security')<>'on'

 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;

  OR NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock_shared(hashtextextended('module-release-catalog',0))
  OR NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('module-admission:'||openpc.current_participant_id()::text||':'||openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()::text,0))
  OR NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock_shared(hashtextextended('openpc-policy-generations:'||openpc.current_participant_id()::text||':'||openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()::text,0))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;

target uuid, expected_source jsonb, proof jsonb, operation text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.lock_runtime_target_current_sources(target uuid, expected_source jsonb, proof jsonb, operation text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE pid uuid; privacy uuid; original control.configuration_work;
 input control.runtime_configuration_input; binding jsonb; current_identity_expiry numeric;
 workload_principals uuid[]; workload_principal uuid; current_policy control.policy_generation;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_runtime_target_disposition_owner();
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-RUNTIME_CONFIGURATION_GENERATIONS_ACTIVATE_RESOURCE-V1'
  OR current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed' OR target IS NULL
  OR jsonb_typeof(expected_source) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR jsonb_typeof(proof) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR operation IS NULL OR operation NOT IN ('RESTORE','CONFIRM')
  OR proof->>'targetId' IS DISTINCT FROM target::text
  OR proof->>'sourceMode' IS NULL OR proof->>'sourceMode' NOT IN ('FACT_FREE','FACT_BOUND')
  OR coalesce(proof->>'capsuleValidUntilNs','') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$'
  OR (proof->>'capsuleValidUntilNs')::numeric>18446744073709551615
  OR (proof->>'capsuleValidUntilNs')::numeric<=extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000000
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-SOURCE-CONTEXT'; END IF;
 PERFORM openpc.check_runtime_target_fact_proof(proof);
 pid:=openpc.current_participant_id(); privacy:=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id();
 -- All advisory fences are fail-fast before row locks. A held competing owner
 -- produces retryable contention, never an ordinary business failure or wait cycle.
 IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock_shared(hashtextextended('module-admission:'||pid::text||':'||privacy::text,0))
  OR NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock_shared(hashtextextended('openpc-policy-generations:'||pid::text||':'||privacy::text,0))
  OR NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('evidence-lifecycle:'||pid::text,0))
  OR NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('runtime-target-disposition:'||pid::text||':'||privacy::text||':'||target::text,0))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 -- The policy workload and the target transport are different identities.
 -- Revalidate the actual policy workload; the authenticated request still needs
 -- its own concrete credential/authority checks at the runtime decision owner.
 SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT c.principal_id ORDER BY c.principal_id) INTO workload_principals
  FROM control.credential c WHERE c.participant_id=pid AND c.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS'
   AND c.audience=proof->>'workloadId' AND c.state='ACTIVE' AND c.credential_epoch>0
   AND c.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND c.valid_until>clock_timestamp();
 IF coalesce(cardinality(workload_principals),0)<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-WORKLOAD-AMBIGUOUS'; END IF;
 workload_principal:=workload_principals[1];
 PERFORM 1 FROM control.principal p WHERE p.participant_id=pid AND p.principal_id=workload_principal
  AND p.kind='WORKLOAD' AND p.state='ACTIVE' AND p.authority_epoch>0 FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-WORKLOAD-WITHDRAWN'; END IF;
 PERFORM 1 FROM control.credential c WHERE c.participant_id=pid AND c.principal_id=workload_principal
  AND c.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND c.audience=proof->>'workloadId' AND c.state='ACTIVE'
  AND c.credential_epoch>0 AND c.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND c.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
  AND c.certificate_der IS NOT NULL AND sha256(c.certificate_der)=c.secret_fingerprint
  ORDER BY c.credential_id FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-WORKLOAD-CREDENTIAL'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT original FROM control.configuration_work w
  WHERE w.participant_id=pid AND w.privacy_domain_id=privacy
   AND w.configuration_work_id=(expected_source->>'original_work_id')::uuid
   AND w.operation_id::text=expected_source->>'original_operation_id'
   AND w.execution_attempt_id::text=expected_source->>'original_execution_attempt_id'
   AND w.runtime_target_id=target AND w.work_kind='RUNTIME_ACTIVATION'
   AND (w.state='COMPLETED' OR (operation='CONFIRM' AND w.state IN ('LEASED','RECONCILING')))
   AND w.execution_started_at IS NOT NULL
   AND w.runtime_configuration_generation_id::text=expected_source->>'runtime_configuration_generation_id'
   AND w.configuration_digest='sha256:'||(expected_source->>'configuration_digest')
   AND w.xds_version_digest='sha256:'||(expected_source->>'xds_version_digest')
   AND w.predecessor_digest IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||(expected_source->>'predecessor_capsule_digest')
   AND w.policy_generation_digest='sha256:'||(proof->>'policyGenerationDigest') FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 PERFORM 1 FROM control.runtime_activation_observation o
  WHERE o.participant_id=pid AND o.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND o.configuration_work_id=original.configuration_work_id
   AND o.operation_id=original.operation_id AND o.execution_attempt_id=original.execution_attempt_id
   AND o.runtime_target_id=target AND o.runtime_configuration_generation_id=original.runtime_configuration_generation_id
   AND o.generation_digest=original.generation_digest AND o.xds_version_digest=original.xds_version_digest
   AND (original.state<>'COMPLETED' OR o.activation_receipt_digest=original.result_receipt_digest)
   AND encode(sha256(decode(o.activation_receipt->>'activationReceiptCoseHex','hex')),'hex')=proof->>'originalReceiptDigest'
   AND o.capsule_digest='sha256:'||(expected_source->>'capsule_digest')
   AND o.capsule_digest='sha256:'||(proof->>'capsuleDigest');
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-SOURCE-OBSERVATION'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT input FROM control.runtime_configuration_input i
  WHERE i.participant_id=pid AND i.privacy_domain_id=privacy
   AND i.runtime_configuration_input_id=(expected_source->>'runtime_configuration_input_id')::uuid
   AND i.configuration_digest=decode(expected_source->>'configuration_digest','hex')
   AND i.module_installation_id::text=expected_source->>'module_installation_id'
   AND i.module_configuration_generation_id::text=expected_source->>'module_configuration_generation_id'
   AND i.selected FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 -- Lock each mutable source before re-evaluating the shared canonical view.
 -- A source's signature/digest alone does not establish its current admission.
 FOR binding IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(input.resource_bindings) ORDER BY value->>'kind',value->>'id' LOOP
  CASE binding->>'kind'
   WHEN 'ProviderProfile' THEN
    PERFORM 1 FROM control.provider_profile p WHERE p.participant_id=pid AND p.privacy_domain_id=privacy
     AND p.provider_profile_id=(binding->>'id')::uuid AND p.behavior_fingerprint=binding->>'digest'
     AND p.chain_id=binding->>'chainId' AND p.state<>'RETIRED' FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
   WHEN 'ClientIndexerProfile' THEN
    PERFORM 1 FROM control.indexer_profile p WHERE p.participant_id=pid AND p.privacy_domain_id=privacy
     AND p.indexer_profile_id=(binding->>'id')::uuid AND p.method_profile_digest=binding->>'digest'
     AND p.engine_version=binding->>'engineVersion' AND p.state<>'RETIRED' FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
   WHEN 'ProjectionPlan' THEN
    PERFORM 1 FROM control.projection_plan p WHERE p.participant_id=pid AND p.privacy_domain_id=privacy
     AND p.projection_plan_id=(binding->>'id')::uuid AND p.plan_digest=binding->>'digest'
     AND p.state<>'RETIRED' FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
   WHEN 'CiglSettings' THEN
    PERFORM 1 FROM control.cigl_settings p WHERE p.participant_id=pid AND p.privacy_domain_id=privacy
     AND p.cigl_settings_id=(binding->>'id')::uuid;
   ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-SOURCE-KIND';
  END CASE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-SOURCE-RESTRICTED'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 PERFORM 1 FROM control.runtime_configuration_input_current_metadata i
  WHERE i.participant_id=pid AND i.privacy_domain_id=privacy
   AND i.runtime_configuration_input_id=input.runtime_configuration_input_id;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-SOURCE-WITHDRAWN'; END IF;
 SELECT g.* INTO STRICT current_policy FROM control.policy_generation g JOIN control.policy_version v
  ON v.participant_id=g.participant_id AND v.privacy_domain_id=g.privacy_domain_id AND v.policy_version_id=g.policy_version_id
  JOIN control.policy_artifact a ON a.participant_id=g.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=g.privacy_domain_id
   AND a.semantic_digest=v.semantic_digest AND a.payload_digest=g.artifact_digest
  WHERE g.participant_id=pid AND g.privacy_domain_id=privacy
   AND ((g.active AND g.state='ACTIVE') OR (operation='CONFIRM' AND EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM control.policy_activation_occurrence_target ot
     JOIN control.policy_activation_occurrence oc ON oc.participant_id=ot.participant_id
      AND oc.privacy_domain_id=ot.privacy_domain_id AND oc.activation_occurrence_id=ot.activation_occurrence_id
     JOIN control.policy_activation a ON a.participant_id=oc.participant_id
      AND a.privacy_domain_id=oc.privacy_domain_id AND a.policy_activation_id=oc.activation_occurrence_id
    WHERE ot.participant_id=pid AND ot.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND ot.configuration_work_id=original.configuration_work_id
     AND ((ot.phase='FORWARD' AND oc.policy_generation_id=g.policy_generation_id AND g.state='PREPARED')
       OR (ot.phase='ROLLBACK' AND a.state='ACTIVE' AND a.prior_generation_digest=g.generation_digest AND g.state='RETIRED')))))
   AND g.generation_digest=decode(proof->>'policyGenerationDigest','hex') FOR SHARE OF g NOWAIT;
 SELECT s.expires_at_ns INTO STRICT current_identity_expiry FROM control.identity_runtime_snapshot_head h
  JOIN control.identity_runtime_snapshot s ON s.snapshot_id=h.snapshot_id AND s.participant_id=h.participant_id
   AND s.privacy_domain_id=h.privacy_domain_id AND s.target_runtime_id=h.target_runtime_id
  WHERE h.participant_id=pid AND h.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND h.target_runtime_id=target
   AND s.manifest_digest=decode(proof->>'identityManifestDigest','hex')
   AND s.expires_at_ns>extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000000 FOR SHARE OF h NOWAIT;
 -- The proof may shorten, never extend, the original Identity publication.
 IF (proof->>'capsuleValidUntilNs')::numeric>current_identity_expiry
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-IDENTITY-EXPIRY'; END IF;
EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007';
END $function$
target uuid, wanted_revision bigint, wanted_digest text, worker text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.lock_runtime_target_disposition_issuance(target uuid, wanted_revision bigint, wanted_digest text, worker text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE pid uuid; privacy uuid; head control.runtime_target_disposition_admission; latest text;
 original control.configuration_work; cause control.configuration_work; current_target control.runtime_target;
 authority record; principal uuid; proof jsonb; action text;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_runtime_target_disposition_owner();
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-RUNTIME_CONFIGURATION_GENERATIONS_ACTIVATE_RESOURCE-V1'
  OR current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed' OR target IS NULL
  OR wanted_revision IS NULL OR wanted_revision<1 OR wanted_digest IS NULL
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-ISSUANCE-CONTEXT'; END IF;
 pid:=openpc.current_participant_id(); privacy:=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id();
 SELECT * INTO STRICT head FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission a
  WHERE a.participant_id=pid AND a.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND a.runtime_target_id=target
  ORDER BY a.revision DESC LIMIT 1;
 IF head.revision IS DISTINCT FROM wanted_revision OR head.admission_digest IS DISTINCT FROM wanted_digest
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-ISSUANCE-HEAD'; END IF;
 action:=head.binding->>'action';
 IF action IN ('ConfirmActivation','Restore') THEN
  PERFORM 1 FROM control.platform_context root JOIN control.platform_scope_replacement replacement
    ON replacement.platform_context_id=root.platform_context_id
    WHERE replacement.participant_id=pid AND replacement.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND replacement.state='WITHDRAWING'
    FOR SHARE OF root;
  IF FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-PLATFORM-WITHDRAWING'; END IF;
  IF worker IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-ISSUANCE-CONTEXT'; END IF;
  proof:=CASE action WHEN 'ConfirmActivation' THEN head.activation_proof ELSE head.restoration_proof END;
  PERFORM openpc.lock_runtime_target_current_sources(target,head.binding->'source',proof,
   CASE action WHEN 'ConfirmActivation' THEN 'CONFIRM' ELSE 'RESTORE' END);
 ELSIF action='Withdraw' THEN
  IF coalesce(worker,'')='' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-ISSUANCE-CONTEXT'; END IF;
  IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock_shared(hashtextextended('module-admission:'||pid::text||':'||privacy::text,0))
   OR NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock_shared(hashtextextended('openpc-policy-generations:'||pid::text||':'||privacy::text,0))
   OR NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('evidence-lifecycle:'||pid::text,0))
   OR NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('runtime-target-disposition:'||pid::text||':'||privacy::text||':'||target::text,0))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-ISSUANCE-ACTION'; END IF;
 -- Re-read only after the original Control fences have been reacquired.
 SELECT admission_digest INTO STRICT latest FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission a
  WHERE a.participant_id=pid AND a.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND a.runtime_target_id=target
  ORDER BY a.revision DESC LIMIT 1;
 IF latest IS DISTINCT FROM wanted_digest THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-ISSUANCE-HEAD'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT authority FROM openpc.lock_runtime_discovery_authority(target,
  'sha256:'||(head.binding->'target'->>'certificate_digest'));
 SELECT c.principal_id INTO STRICT principal FROM control.credential c
  WHERE c.participant_id=pid AND c.credential_id=authority.credential_id;
 IF head.binding->'target' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('participant_id',pid::text,'privacy_domain_id',privacy::text,
  'target_id',target::text,'credential_id',authority.credential_id::text,'principal_id',principal::text,
  'credential_epoch',authority.credential_epoch,'principal_epoch',authority.principal_epoch,
  'certificate_digest',head.binding->'target'->>'certificate_digest')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-IDENTITY'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT original FROM control.configuration_work w WHERE w.participant_id=pid AND w.privacy_domain_id=privacy
  AND w.runtime_target_id=target AND w.configuration_work_id=(head.binding->'source'->>'original_work_id')::uuid FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT current_target FROM control.runtime_target t WHERE t.participant_id=pid AND t.privacy_domain_id=privacy
  AND t.runtime_target_id=target FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 IF action='ConfirmActivation' THEN
  IF NOT coalesce(((original.state='COMPLETED' AND current_target.active_generation_digest='sha256:'||(proof->>'capsuleDigest'))
   OR (original.state IN ('LEASED','RECONCILING') AND openpc.runtime_work_predecessor_matches(original.configuration_work_id)
    AND current_target.desired_generation_digest=original.generation_digest)),false)
   OR head.binding->'cause' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('kind','Activation','work_id',original.configuration_work_id::text,
    'operation_id',original.operation_id::text,'execution_attempt_id',original.execution_attempt_id::text)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-ACTIVATION-TARGET'; END IF;
 ELSIF action='Withdraw' AND (openpc.expired_denial_issuance_matches(target,wanted_revision,head.admission_digest,worker)
  OR openpc.expired_handover_issuance_matches(target,wanted_revision,head.admission_digest,worker)
  OR openpc.expired_credential_handover_issuance_matches(target,wanted_revision,head.admission_digest,worker)) THEN
  -- The separate native proof admits this exact negative source only.
  RETURN;
 ELSIF action='Withdraw' AND head.binding->'cause'->>'kind'='Dependency'
   AND head.binding->'cause'->>'owner'='Platform' THEN
  IF original.state<>'COMPLETED' OR original.work_kind<>'RUNTIME_ACTIVATION'
    OR original.operation_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM head.binding->'source'->>'original_operation_id'
    OR original.execution_attempt_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM head.binding->'source'->>'original_execution_attempt_id'
    OR current_target.active_generation_digest IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||(head.binding->'source'->>'capsule_digest')
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_scope_target_withdrawal q
      JOIN control.platform_scope_replacement r ON r.replacement_id=q.replacement_id
        AND r.participant_id=q.participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=q.privacy_domain_id
      JOIN control.platform_context p ON p.platform_context_id=r.platform_context_id
        AND p.owner_participant_id=r.participant_id AND p.authority_epoch=r.predecessor_epoch
        AND p.row_version=r.expected_root_revision AND p.state='ACTIVE'
      WHERE q.participant_id=pid AND q.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND q.runtime_target_id=target
        AND q.replacement_id::text=head.binding->'cause'->>'resource_id'
        AND r.state='WITHDRAWING' AND r.row_version=1
        AND head.binding->'cause'=jsonb_build_object('kind','Dependency','owner','Platform',
          'resource_id',r.replacement_id::text,'operation_id',r.prepare_operation_id::text,'revision',1)
        AND q.source->>'originalWorkId'=original.configuration_work_id::text
        AND q.source->>'originalAttemptId'=original.execution_attempt_id::text
        AND q.source->>'capsuleDigest'=current_target.active_generation_digest
        AND q.source->>'activationReceiptDigest'=original.result_receipt_digest)
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.configuration_work w WHERE w.participant_id=pid AND w.privacy_domain_id=privacy
      AND w.runtime_target_id=target AND w.work_kind='RUNTIME_ACTIVATION' AND w.state IN('PENDING','LEASED','RECONCILING'))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-CAUSE-UNAVAILABLE'; END IF;
 ELSE
  IF head.binding->'cause'->>'kind'='UnsignedWithdrawalRecovery' AND (
   action IS DISTINCT FROM 'Withdraw'
   OR head.revision IS DISTINCT FROM (head.binding->'cause'->>'abandoned_revision')::bigint+1
   OR head.binding->'previous_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(head.revision-2)
   OR NOT openpc.runtime_unsigned_withdrawal_recoverable(target,(head.revision-1)::bigint,
    'sha256:'||(head.binding->'cause'->>'abandoned_admission_digest')))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-RECOVERY-BINDING'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT cause FROM control.configuration_work w WHERE w.participant_id=pid AND w.privacy_domain_id=privacy
   AND w.runtime_target_id=target AND w.configuration_work_id=(head.binding->'cause'->>'work_id')::uuid FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
  IF cause.work_kind<>'RUNTIME_ACTIVATION' OR cause.execution_started_at IS NOT NULL OR cause.execution_attempt_id IS NOT NULL
   OR cause.operation_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM head.binding->'cause'->>'operation_id'
   OR (head.binding->'cause'->>'kind' IN ('Activation','UnsignedWithdrawalRecovery')) IS NOT TRUE
   OR (CASE WHEN head.binding->'cause'->>'kind'='UnsignedWithdrawalRecovery'
    THEN head.binding->'cause' ? 'execution_attempt_id'
    ELSE head.binding->'cause'->'execution_attempt_id' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb END)
   OR (original.state<>'COMPLETED' AND NOT coalesce((action='Withdraw' AND cause.denied_predecessor_work_id=original.configuration_work_id
    AND original.state='FAILED' AND original.result_receipt->>'outcome'='EXPIRED_OBSERVED_DENIED'
    AND openpc.runtime_work_predecessor_matches(cause.configuration_work_id)),false)) OR original.work_kind<>'RUNTIME_ACTIVATION'
   OR original.operation_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM head.binding->'source'->>'original_operation_id'
   OR original.execution_attempt_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM head.binding->'source'->>'original_execution_attempt_id'
   OR (current_target.active_generation_digest IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||(head.binding->'source'->>'capsule_digest') AND NOT coalesce((action='Withdraw' AND cause.denied_predecessor_work_id=original.configuration_work_id
    AND original.state='FAILED' AND original.result_receipt->>'outcome'='EXPIRED_OBSERVED_DENIED'
    AND openpc.runtime_work_predecessor_matches(cause.configuration_work_id)),false))
   OR current_target.desired_generation_digest IS DISTINCT FROM cause.generation_digest
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-ISSUANCE-CAUSE'; END IF;
  IF action='Restore' THEN
   IF cause.state<>'FAILED' OR cause.completed_at IS NULL OR current_target.state<>'FAILED'
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.configuration_work w WHERE w.participant_id=pid AND w.privacy_domain_id=privacy
     AND w.runtime_target_id=target AND w.work_kind='RUNTIME_ACTIVATION' AND w.state IN ('PENDING','LEASED','RECONCILING'))
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-RESTORE-CAUSE'; END IF;
  ELSIF cause.state<>'LEASED' OR cause.lease_owner IS DISTINCT FROM worker OR cause.lease_until<=clock_timestamp()
   OR NOT openpc.runtime_work_predecessor_matches(cause.configuration_work_id) OR current_target.state<>'STAGING'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-CAUSE-UNAVAILABLE'; END IF;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007';
END $function$
target uuid, expected_source jsonb, proof jsonb

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.notification_business_projection(item control.notification)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('0',(item).severity,'1',(item).state,'2',(item).message_key,
  '3',CASE WHEN (item).resource_ref IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  '5',openpc.business_bytes(decode(substr((item).candidate_digest,8),'hex')))
  || CASE WHEN (item).resource_ref IS NULL THEN '{}'::jsonb
     ELSE jsonb_build_object('4',(item).resource_ref) END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.notification_completion_phase_binding(event uuid, phase text)
 RETURNS TABLE(installation_digest text, authority_digest text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.require_notification_completion_disposition_authority(event,phase);
 RETURN QUERY SELECT a.proof->>'installationDigest',a.proof->>'authorityDigest'
 FROM control.notification_completion_phase_admission a WHERE a.database_role=session_user
  AND a.transaction_id=pg_current_xact_id()::text AND a.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid()
  AND a.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id() AND a.privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
  AND a.event_id=event AND a.phase=$2;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.notification_completion_remediation_projection(item control.notification_completion_disposition)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE r jsonb:=item.transition->'receipt';w control.installed_notification_completion_worker%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 IF item.participant_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_participant_id() OR item.privacy_domain_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
 OR item.disposition IS DISTINCT FROM 'QUARANTINED' OR r->>'workItemKind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'REMEDIATION'
 OR r->>'workItemId' IS DISTINCT FROM item.receipt_id::text OR r->>'sourceEventId' IS DISTINCT FROM item.event_id::text
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPLETION-REMEDIATION-BINDING'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT w FROM control.installed_notification_completion_worker
 WHERE participant_id=item.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=item.privacy_domain_id AND installation_digest=r->>'workerInstallationDigest';
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('0','REMEDIATION','1','OPEN','2','urn:openpc:resource:'||item.event_id::text,
 '3',openpc.business_bytes(sha256(item.receipt_payload)),
 '4',openpc.business_bytes(sha256(convert_to('Notification completion could not be processed.','UTF8'))),
 '5',openpc.business_uuid(w.principal_id),'6',0,'8',0,'10',0);
END $function$
