 'sequence',e.business_sequence::text,'aggregateSequence',e.aggregate_sequence::text,'proofKind',e.proof_kind,'namespace',e.sequence_namespace,'source',e.source,'subject',e.subject,
 'correlationId',e.correlation_id,'causationId',e.causation_id,'dataSchema',e.data_schema_uri,'payloadHex',encode(e.payload_cbor,'hex'),
 'payloadDigest',encode(e.payload_digest,'hex'),'occurredAtUs',floor(extract(epoch from e.occurred_at)*1000000)::text,
 'receiptId',e.receipt_id,'coseHex',encode(e.cose_sign1,'hex'),'authorityGenerationHex',encode(e.authority_generation,'hex'),'webauthnAssertionBindingDigest',encode(e.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest,'hex'));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.notification_occurrence_metadata_preparation(item control.notification)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE op control.notification_occurrence_preparation%ROWTYPE; dp control.notification_occurrence_preparation%ROWTYPE;
 original control.notification_occurrence_observation%ROWTYPE; proof control.notification_occurrence_observation%ROWTYPE;
 source control.evidence_export_completion%ROWTYPE; m jsonb; o jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF NOT pg_has_role(current_user,'openpc_control_runtime','USAGE')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user AND (rolsuper OR rolbypassrls))
 OR item.participant_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_participant_id()
 OR item.privacy_domain_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 SELECT p.* INTO STRICT op FROM control.notification_occurrence_preparation p
 JOIN control.notification_occurrence_observation r USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,preparation_id)
 WHERE p.participant_id=item.participant_id AND p.privacy_domain_id=item.privacy_domain_id
 AND p.family='NotificationOccurrenceReceiptV1' AND p.state='OBSERVED'
 AND openpc.business_cbor(r.receipt_payload)->'6'=openpc.business_uuid(item.notification_id);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT original FROM control.notification_occurrence_observation
 WHERE participant_id=op.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=op.privacy_domain_id AND preparation_id=op.preparation_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT dp FROM control.notification_occurrence_preparation
 WHERE participant_id=op.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=op.privacy_domain_id
 AND key_preparation_id=op.key_preparation_id AND family='NotificationDeliveryRequestedReceiptV1' AND state='OBSERVED';
 SELECT * INTO STRICT proof FROM control.notification_occurrence_observation
 WHERE participant_id=dp.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=dp.privacy_domain_id AND preparation_id=dp.preparation_id;
 m:=openpc.business_cbor(proof.receipt_payload);o:=openpc.business_cbor(original.receipt_payload);
 PERFORM openpc.archive_cose_binding(proof.receipt_payload,proof.cose_sign1,'sha256:'||(m->'24'->>'bytes'),24020,357);
 PERFORM openpc.archive_cose_binding(original.receipt_payload,original.cose_sign1,'sha256:'||(o->'24'->>'bytes'),24019,356);
 IF original.receipt_payload IS DISTINCT FROM decode(op.preparation->>'payloadHex','hex')
 OR proof.receipt_payload IS DISTINCT FROM decode(dp.preparation->>'payloadHex','hex')
 OR original.receipt_digest IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(original.receipt_payload),'hex')
 OR m->'25' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('bytes',encode(sha256(original.receipt_payload),'hex'))
 OR m->'1' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'1'
 OR m->'2' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'2'
 OR m->'3' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'3'
 OR m->'6' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'6'
 OR m->'7' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'7'
 OR m->'8' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'8'
 OR m->'9' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'9'
 OR m->'10' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'10'
 OR m->'11' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'11'
 OR m->'12' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'12'
 OR m->'13' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'13'
 OR m->'16' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'16'
 OR m->'17' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'17'
 OR m->'18' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'18'
 OR m->'19' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'19'
 OR m->'20' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'20'
 OR m->'21' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'21'
 OR m->'22' IS DISTINCT FROM o->'22'
 OR m->'4' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o->'4' OR m->'5' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o->'5'
 OR (m->>'23')::numeric<(o->>'23')::numeric
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOTIFICATION-OCCURRENCE-METADATA-PAIR'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT source FROM control.evidence_export_completion
 WHERE participant_id=op.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=op.privacy_domain_id AND event_id=op.source_event_id;

 RETURNS jsonb

 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'

 SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.operations_generation
 WHERE environment_id=p_environment AND generation_id=p_generation)
 THEN '["GENERATION:MISSING"]'::jsonb
 ELSE coalesce(jsonb_agg(requirement ORDER BY requirement),'[]'::jsonb) END
 FROM control.operations_generation g CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(g.requirements) requirement
 WHERE g.environment_id=p_environment AND g.generation_id=p_generation
 AND CASE WHEN requirement='SOURCE:C17_AUTHENTICATION'
 THEN NOT openpc.operations_generation_source_authenticated(p_environment,p_generation)
 WHEN requirement='QUALIFICATION:provider.read_retry_limit'
 THEN NOT coalesce(openpc.operations_provider_retry_qualification_bound(p_environment,p_generation),false)
 ELSE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.operations_generation_binding b
 WHERE b.environment_id=g.environment_id AND b.generation_id=g.generation_id AND b.requirement_id=requirement
 AND b.participant_id=g.participant_id AND b.privacy_domain_id=g.privacy_domain_id AND b.state='CURRENT'
 AND b.valid_until_ms>floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000)
 AND b.effective_digest=g.candidate->'configuration'->'generation'->>'contentDigest') END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.operations_generation_requirements(p_schema jsonb, p_configuration jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_agg(requirement ORDER BY requirement) FROM (
 SELECT 'SOURCE:C17_AUTHENTICATION' requirement
 UNION SELECT 'QUALIFICATION:'||key FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_configuration->'qualificationInputBindings') key
 UNION SELECT 'SECRET:'||section.key||'.'||field.key
 FROM jsonb_each(p_schema->'properties') section CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(section.value->'properties') field
 WHERE field.value->>'$ref'='#/$defs/SecretRef'
 UNION SELECT phase||':'||component
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_schema->'x-openpc-settingCatalog') setting
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(setting->'componentRefs') component
 CROSS JOIN (VALUES('CONSUMER_STAGED'),('CONSUMER_EFFECTIVE')) phases(phase)
 UNION SELECT phase||':'||unit FROM (VALUES
 ('DU-PC-WORKBENCH'),('DU-PC-CONTROL'),('DU-PC-COMPILER'),('DU-PC-FLEET-CONTROL'),
 ('DU-PC-RUNTIME'),('DU-PC-FACT-BRIDGE'),('DU-ENVOY'),('DU-OTEL-COLLECTOR')) units(unit)
 CROSS JOIN (VALUES('UNIT_STAGED'),('UNIT_EFFECTIVE')) phases(phase)
 ) required;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.operations_generation_source_authenticated(p_environment text, p_generation uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE installed control.operations_installation%ROWTYPE; candidate control.operations_generation%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 -- Source truth is also consumed by existing SECURITY DEFINER read owners
 -- (for example current_notification_delivery_limit). Do not require their
 -- current role/action to equal an installation mutation's role/action. EXECUTE
 -- grants, request scope and actual rows remain enforced; commit admission is
 -- still a separate guarded operation on its own same transaction client.
 IF current_setting('transaction_isolation') IS DISTINCT FROM 'read committed'
  OR current_setting('row_security') IS DISTINCT FROM 'on'
  OR current_setting('openpc.context_mode',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'PARTICIPANT'
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO installed FROM control.operations_installation WHERE environment_id=p_environment;
 SELECT * INTO candidate FROM control.operations_generation WHERE environment_id=p_environment AND generation_id=p_generation;
 IF installed.environment_id IS NULL OR candidate.generation_id IS NULL
  OR installed.state<>'ACTIVE' OR candidate.state<>'STAGED'
  OR installed.participant_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_participant_id()
  OR installed.privacy_domain_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
  OR candidate.participant_id IS DISTINCT FROM installed.participant_id
  OR candidate.privacy_domain_id IS DISTINCT FROM installed.privacy_domain_id
  OR installed.installation_digest IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(installed.installation_bytes),'hex')
  OR installed.installation IS DISTINCT FROM convert_from(installed.installation_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb
  OR installed.installation_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(installed.installation),'UTF8')
  OR installed.installation->'pins'->>'environmentId' IS DISTINCT FROM p_environment
  OR candidate.candidate_digest IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(candidate.candidate_bytes),'hex')
  OR candidate.candidate IS DISTINCT FROM convert_from(candidate.candidate_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb
  OR candidate.candidate_bytes IS DISTINCT FROM convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(candidate.candidate),'UTF8')
  OR candidate.candidate->'configuration'->>'environmentId' IS DISTINCT FROM p_environment
  OR candidate.candidate->'configuration'->>'profile' IS DISTINCT FROM installed.installation->'pins'->>'profile'
  OR candidate.candidate->'configuration'->'generation'->>'generationId' IS DISTINCT FROM 'urn:openpc:generation:'||p_generation::text
  OR candidate.candidate->'configuration'->'generation'->>'baseGenerationId' IS DISTINCT FROM 'urn:openpc:generation:'||candidate.base_generation_id::text
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN openpc.operations_source_authentication_valid(installed.installation);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.platform_history_approval_request_case_read(p_row jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE r control.approval_request;
BEGIN
 IF p_row IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_row)<>'object' THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 r:=jsonb_populate_record(NULL::control.approval_request,p_row);
 IF to_jsonb(r) IS DISTINCT FROM p_row THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN coalesce((openpc.matches_participant(r."participant_id") and openpc.matches_privacy(r."privacy_domain_id")
      and exists(select 1 from control.platform_recovery_enrollment source
        where source.participant_id=r."participant_id" and source.privacy_domain_id=r."privacy_domain_id"
          and openpc.platform_recovery_continuation_root_matches(source.platform_context_id,source.participant_id,source.root_epoch,source.root_revision)
          and ((source.source_purpose='ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY_CONTINUATION' and source.document->>'schemaVersion'='3')
            or (source.source_purpose='PENDING_ADMINISTRATION_EXPIRY_RECOVERY' and source.document->>'schemaVersion'='4')
            or (source.source_purpose='ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY' and source.document->>'schemaVersion'='2'
              and jsonb_typeof(source.document->'uneffectedPredecessor')='object'
              and source.document#>>'{uneffectedPredecessor,schema}'='pc.identity.platform-expired-uneffected-recovery'
              and source.document#>>'{uneffectedPredecessor,schemaVersion}'='1'))
          and source.document->>'schema'='pc.identity.platform-recovery-enrollment' and source.state='ACTIVE' and source.row_version=1
          and source.document->>'assurance'='LOCAL_QA_VIRTUAL_AUTHENTICATOR'
          and current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true) is not distinct from '1'
          and source.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() and source.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
          and openpc.current_action_intent_id() in ('ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1', 'ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_READ_COLLECTION-V1', 'ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1', 'ACT-IDENTITY_CREATE_SESSION-V1', 'ACT-IDENTITY_DELETE_SESSION-V1', 'ACT-IDENTITY_UPDATE_STEP_UP-V1', 'ACT-OPERATIONS_READ_OPERATION-V1', 'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1', 'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1', 'ACT-PARTICIPANT_ACTIVATE_CONTEXT-V1', 'ACT-PARTICIPANT_CREATE_MEMBER-V1', 'ACT-POLICY_APPROVE_REQUEST-V1', 'ACT-POLICY_READ_EFFECTIVE_ACCESS-V1', 'ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1')
          and (source.source_purpose='PENDING_ADMINISTRATION_EXPIRY_RECOVERY'
      and source.document->>'schemaVersion'='4'
      and exists(select 1 from control.platform_recovery_case historical
        where historical.participant_id=source.participant_id
          and historical.privacy_domain_id=source.privacy_domain_id
          and ((not (source.document#>'{source}' ? 'closedApproval')
    and historical.enrollment_id=source.enrollment_id
    and historical.enrollment_revision=source.row_version and historical.enrollment_digest=source.document_digest
    and historical.state='EXPIRED' and historical.valid_until<=clock_timestamp())
   or (source.document#>>'{source,closedApproval,schema}'='pc.identity.closed-platform-approval-source'
    and source.document#>>'{source,closedApproval,schemaVersion}'='1'
    and historical.enrollment_id::text=source.document#>>'{source,closedApproval,enrollmentId}'
    and historical.enrollment_id<>source.enrollment_id
    and 'sha256:'||encode(historical.enrollment_digest,'hex')=source.document#>>'{source,closedApproval,enrollmentDigest}'
    and historical.recovery_id::text=source.document#>>'{source,closedApproval,approval,recoveryId}'
    and 'sha256:'||encode(historical.intent_digest,'hex')=source.document#>>'{source,closedApproval,approval,intentDigest}'
    and historical.state in ('REVOKED','EXPIRED')
    and historical.state=source.document#>>'{source,closedApproval,closure,state}'))
          and historical.intent->'pendingExpiry'=source.document#>'{source,pendingExpiry}'
          and (not (historical.intent ? 'approvalContinuation') or (
    historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,schema}'='pc.identity.platform-prepare-approval-continuation'
    and historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,schemaVersion}'='1'
    and historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,recoveryId}'<>historical.recovery_id::text
    and historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,recoveryId}' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    and historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,candidateId}' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    and historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,approvalId}' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    and historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,candidateDigest}'='sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(historical.intent->'preparation'),'UTF8')),'hex')
    and historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,attempt}' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$'
  ))
          and historical.intent_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(historical.intent),'UTF8'))
          and historical.activation_operation_id is not null
          and historical.activation_evidence_digest=sha256(historical.activation_evidence_cbor)
          and octet_length(historical.activation_cose)>0
          and (r."subject_type"='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE'
            and r."action_intent_id"='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
            and r."maker_principal_id"::text=historical.intent#>>'{preparation,administrators,0,principalId}'
            and r."checker_principal_id"::text=historical.intent#>>'{preparation,administrators,1,principalId}'
            and exists(select 1 from control.mutation_candidate original
              where original.participant_id=historical.participant_id
                and original.privacy_domain_id=historical.privacy_domain_id
                and original.mutation_candidate_id=r."subject_id"
                and original.candidate_document=historical.intent->'preparation'
                and original.candidate_digest=r."subject_digest"
                and original.expected_revision=r."subject_version"
                and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(historical.lease_bindings) binding
                  where binding->>'envelopeId'=original.maker_authority_envelope_id::text
                    and binding->>'assignmentId'=original.maker_assignment_id::text
                    and binding->>'principalId'=original.maker_principal_id::text
                    and binding->>'principalEpoch'=original.maker_principal_epoch::text))))))),false);
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range OR invalid_datetime_format THEN RETURN false;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.platform_history_approval_request_pending_effect_read(p_row jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE r control.approval_request;candidate_resource uuid; pending_document jsonb; binding_found boolean:=false;
BEGIN
 IF p_row IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_row)<>'object' THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 r:=jsonb_populate_record(NULL::control.approval_request,p_row);
 IF to_jsonb(r) IS DISTINCT FROM p_row THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF (r.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE'
  AND openpc.matches_participant(r.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(r.privacy_domain_id)
  AND openpc.current_action_intent_id()='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
  AND current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM '1') IS NOT TRUE THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 <<candidate_binding>>
 FOR candidate_resource IN SELECT c.resource_id FROM control.mutation_candidate c
  WHERE c.participant_id=r.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id
   AND c.mutation_candidate_id=r.subject_id LOOP
  FOR pending_document IN SELECT pending.candidate FROM control.platform_scope_replacement pending
   WHERE pending.participant_id=r.participant_id AND pending.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id
    AND pending.state='WITHDRAWING' AND pending.row_version=1 AND pending.superseded_by IS NULL
    AND num_nonnulls(pending.commit_operation_id,pending.commit_candidate_id,pending.commit_approval_id,pending.readiness_digest,pending.committed_at)=0 LOOP
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(pending_document->'administrators')='array'
       THEN pending_document->'administrators' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) administrator
      WHERE candidate_resource::text=administrator->>'envelopeId') THEN
    binding_found:=true; EXIT candidate_binding;
   END IF;
  END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
 IF NOT binding_found THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN coalesce((openpc.matches_participant(r."participant_id") and openpc.matches_privacy(r."privacy_domain_id")
      and openpc.current_action_intent_id()='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
      and current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true) is not distinct from '1'
      and exists(select 1 from control.platform_scope_replacement pending
        join control.platform_context root on root.platform_context_id=pending.platform_context_id
          and root.owner_participant_id=pending.participant_id and root.state='ACTIVE'
          and ((root.authority_epoch=pending.predecessor_epoch and root.row_version=pending.expected_root_revision)
            or openpc.root_expiry_pending_ancestry(pending.platform_context_id,to_jsonb(pending)) is not null)
        join (select platform_context_id,platform_authority_epoch,scope_cbor,admission_digest from control.platform_envelope_scope
          union all select platform_context_id,platform_authority_epoch,scope_cbor,admission_digest from control.platform_envelope_scope_successor
          union all select platform_context_id,platform_authority_epoch,scope_cbor,admission_digest from control.root_expiry_recovery_scope) scope
          on scope.platform_context_id=root.platform_context_id and scope.platform_authority_epoch=pending.predecessor_epoch
            and scope.admission_digest=pending.predecessor_digest
        where pending.participant_id=r."participant_id" and pending.privacy_domain_id=r."privacy_domain_id"
          and pending.state='WITHDRAWING' and pending.row_version=1 and pending.superseded_by is null
          and num_nonnulls(pending.commit_operation_id,pending.commit_candidate_id,pending.commit_approval_id,pending.readiness_digest,pending.committed_at)=0
          and pending.candidate_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(pending.candidate),'UTF8'))
          and pending.successor_digest=sha256(pending.successor_preimage)
          and (openpc.business_cbor(scope.scope_cbor)->>'4')::numeric<=floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000000)
          and pending.candidate#>'{successorScope,runtime}'=openpc.platform_scope_document(scope.scope_cbor)->'runtime'
          and jsonb_array_length(pending.candidate->'administrators')=2
          and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(pending.candidate->'administrators') administrator
            where (administrator#>>'{usable,validUntilNs}')::numeric>floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000000)
              or (administrator#>>'{grantable,validUntilNs}')::numeric>floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000000))
          and r."subject_type"='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE'
            and exists(select 1 from control.mutation_candidate partial_candidate
              where partial_candidate.participant_id=pending.participant_id
                and partial_candidate.privacy_domain_id=pending.privacy_domain_id
                and partial_candidate.mutation_candidate_id=r."subject_id"
                and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(pending.candidate->'administrators') administrator
                  where partial_candidate.resource_id::text=administrator->>'envelopeId')))),false);
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range OR invalid_datetime_format THEN RETURN false;
END $function$

    and historical.enrollment_id=source.enrollment_id
    and historical.enrollment_revision=source.row_version and historical.enrollment_digest=source.document_digest
    and historical.state='EXPIRED' and historical.valid_until<=clock_timestamp())
   or (source.document#>>'{source,closedApproval,schema}'='pc.identity.closed-platform-approval-source'

            and binding->>'assignmentId'=resume_candidate.maker_assignment_id::text

    and historical.enrollment_id<>source.enrollment_id
    and 'sha256:'||encode(historical.enrollment_digest,'hex')=source.document#>>'{source,closedApproval,enrollmentDigest}'
    and historical.recovery_id::text=source.document#>>'{source,closedApproval,approval,recoveryId}'
    and 'sha256:'||encode(historical.intent_digest,'hex')=source.document#>>'{source,closedApproval,approval,intentDigest}'
    and historical.state in ('REVOKED','EXPIRED')
    and historical.state=source.document#>>'{source,closedApproval,closure,state}'))
          and historical.intent->'pendingExpiry'=source.document#>'{source,pendingExpiry}'
          and (not (historical.intent ? 'approvalContinuation') or (
    historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,schema}'='pc.identity.platform-prepare-approval-continuation'
    and historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,schemaVersion}'='1'
    and historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,recoveryId}'<>historical.recovery_id::text
    and historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,recoveryId}' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    and historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,candidateId}' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    and historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,approvalId}' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    and historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,candidateDigest}'='sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(historical.intent->'preparation'),'UTF8')),'hex')
    and historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,attempt}' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$'
  ))
          and historical.intent_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(historical.intent),'UTF8'))
          and historical.activation_operation_id is not null
          and historical.activation_evidence_digest=sha256(historical.activation_evidence_cbor)
          and octet_length(historical.activation_cose)>0
          and (r."aggregate_type"='platform-recovery' and r."aggregate_id"=historical.recovery_id
          and ((r."aggregate_sequence"=1 and r."event_type"='openpc.identity.platform-recovery.activated.v1'
          and r."payload_cbor"=historical.activation_evidence_cbor
          and r."payload_digest"=historical.activation_evidence_digest
          and r."cose_sign1"=historical.activation_cose)
          or (r."event_type"='openpc.identity.platform-recovery.closed.v1'
            and r."event_id"::text=source.document#>>'{source,closedApproval,closure,eventId}'
            and 'sha256:'||encode(r."payload_digest",'hex')=source.document#>>'{source,closedApproval,closure,evidenceDigest}'
            and r."payload_digest"=sha256(r."payload_cbor") and octet_length(r."cose_sign1")>0))))))) else false end),false);
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range OR invalid_datetime_format THEN RETURN false;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.platform_history_outbox_event_pending_preparation_read(p_row jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE r control.outbox_event;
BEGIN
 IF p_row IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_row)<>'object' THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 r:=jsonb_populate_record(NULL::control.outbox_event,p_row);
 IF to_jsonb(r) IS DISTINCT FROM p_row THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN coalesce((openpc.matches_participant(r."participant_id") and openpc.matches_privacy(r."privacy_domain_id")
      and openpc.current_action_intent_id()='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
      and current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true) is not distinct from '1'
      and exists(select 1 from control.platform_scope_replacement pending
        join control.platform_context root on root.platform_context_id=pending.platform_context_id
          and root.owner_participant_id=pending.participant_id and root.state='ACTIVE'
          and ((root.authority_epoch=pending.predecessor_epoch and root.row_version=pending.expected_root_revision)
            or openpc.root_expiry_pending_ancestry(pending.platform_context_id,to_jsonb(pending)) is not null)
        join (select platform_context_id,platform_authority_epoch,scope_cbor,admission_digest from control.platform_envelope_scope
          union all select platform_context_id,platform_authority_epoch,scope_cbor,admission_digest from control.platform_envelope_scope_successor
          union all select platform_context_id,platform_authority_epoch,scope_cbor,admission_digest from control.root_expiry_recovery_scope) scope
          on scope.platform_context_id=root.platform_context_id and scope.platform_authority_epoch=pending.predecessor_epoch
            and scope.admission_digest=pending.predecessor_digest
        join control.mutation_candidate candidate on candidate.participant_id=pending.participant_id
          and candidate.privacy_domain_id=pending.privacy_domain_id and candidate.mutation_candidate_id=pending.prepare_candidate_id
          and candidate.candidate_document=pending.candidate and candidate.candidate_digest=pending.candidate_digest
          and candidate.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-PLATFORM-SCOPE-PREPARE'
          and candidate.action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
          and candidate.resource_id=pending.replacement_id and candidate.expected_revision=0
          and candidate.state='CONSUMED' and candidate.consumed_operation_id=pending.prepare_operation_id
        join control.approval_request approval on approval.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
          and approval.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id and approval.approval_request_id=pending.prepare_approval_id
          and approval.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE' and approval.subject_id=candidate.mutation_candidate_id
          and approval.subject_digest=candidate.candidate_digest and approval.subject_version=candidate.expected_revision
          and approval.state='APPROVED' and approval.maker_principal_id=candidate.maker_principal_id
          and approval.checker_principal_id<>approval.maker_principal_id
        join control.mutation_evidence evidence on evidence.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
          and evidence.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id and evidence.operation_id=pending.prepare_operation_id
          and evidence.catalog_operation_id=candidate.catalog_operation_id and evidence.action_intent_id=candidate.action_intent_id
          and evidence.aggregate_type='platform-scope-replacement' and evidence.aggregate_id=pending.replacement_id
          and evidence.candidate_digest=candidate.candidate_digest and evidence.principal_id=candidate.maker_principal_id
          and evidence.checker_principal_id=approval.checker_principal_id and evidence.approval_request_id=approval.approval_request_id
          and evidence.evidence_digest=sha256(evidence.evidence_cbor) and octet_length(evidence.cose_sign1)>0
          and evidence.mfa_challenge_id is not null and evidence.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest is not null
        join control.idempotency_record committed on committed.participant_id=evidence.participant_id
          and committed.privacy_domain_id=evidence.privacy_domain_id and committed.operation_id=evidence.operation_id
          and committed.terminal_state='COMMITTED' and committed.principal_id=evidence.principal_id
          and committed.catalog_operation_id=evidence.catalog_operation_id and committed.action_intent_id=evidence.action_intent_id
          and committed.idempotency_key=candidate.idempotency_key and committed.input_digest=candidate.candidate_digest
          and committed.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=evidence.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
          and committed.result_payload->>'replacementId'=pending.replacement_id::text
          and committed.result_payload->>'successorDigest'='sha256:'||encode(pending.successor_digest,'hex')
        where pending.participant_id=r."participant_id" and pending.privacy_domain_id=r."privacy_domain_id"
          and pending.state='WITHDRAWING' and pending.row_version=1 and pending.superseded_by is null
          and num_nonnulls(pending.commit_operation_id,pending.commit_candidate_id,pending.commit_approval_id,pending.readiness_digest,pending.committed_at)=0
          and pending.candidate_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(pending.candidate),'UTF8'))
          and pending.successor_digest=sha256(pending.successor_preimage)
          and (openpc.business_cbor(scope.scope_cbor)->>'4')::numeric<=floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000000)
          and pending.candidate#>'{successorScope,runtime}'=openpc.platform_scope_document(scope.scope_cbor)->'runtime'
          and jsonb_array_length(pending.candidate->'administrators')=2
          and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(pending.candidate->'administrators') administrator
            where (administrator#>>'{usable,validUntilNs}')::numeric>floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000000)
              or (administrator#>>'{grantable,validUntilNs}')::numeric>floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000000))
          and r."aggregate_type"='platform-scope-replacement' and r."aggregate_id"=pending.replacement_id
          and r."event_type"='openpc.platform-scope-replacement.mutation.committed.v1'
          and r."aggregate_sequence"=1 and r."sequence_namespace"='LEGACY'
          and r."payload_cbor"=evidence.evidence_cbor and r."payload_digest"=evidence.evidence_digest
          and r."cose_sign1"=evidence.cose_sign1)),false);
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range OR invalid_datetime_format THEN RETURN false;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.platform_history_outbox_event_resume_read(p_row jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE r control.outbox_event;
BEGIN
 IF p_row IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_row)<>'object' THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 r:=jsonb_populate_record(NULL::control.outbox_event,p_row);
 IF to_jsonb(r) IS DISTINCT FROM p_row THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN coalesce((case when (r."aggregate_type"='webauthn-verification' and r."event_type"='openpc.identity.webauthn-verification.mutation.committed.v1') then (openpc.matches_participant(r."participant_id") and openpc.matches_privacy(r."privacy_domain_id")
      and exists(select 1 from control.platform_recovery_enrollment source
        where source.participant_id=r."participant_id" and source.privacy_domain_id=r."privacy_domain_id"
          and openpc.platform_recovery_continuation_root_matches(source.platform_context_id,source.participant_id,source.root_epoch,source.root_revision)
          and ((source.source_purpose='ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY_CONTINUATION' and source.document->>'schemaVersion'='3')
            or (source.source_purpose='PENDING_ADMINISTRATION_EXPIRY_RECOVERY' and source.document->>'schemaVersion'='4')
            or (source.source_purpose='ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY' and source.document->>'schemaVersion'='2'
              and jsonb_typeof(source.document->'uneffectedPredecessor')='object'
              and source.document#>>'{uneffectedPredecessor,schema}'='pc.identity.platform-expired-uneffected-recovery'
              and source.document#>>'{uneffectedPredecessor,schemaVersion}'='1'))
          and source.document->>'schema'='pc.identity.platform-recovery-enrollment' and source.state='ACTIVE' and source.row_version=1
          and source.document->>'assurance'='LOCAL_QA_VIRTUAL_AUTHENTICATOR'
          and current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true) is not distinct from '1'
          and source.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() and source.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
          and openpc.current_action_intent_id() in ('ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1', 'ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_READ_COLLECTION-V1', 'ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1', 'ACT-IDENTITY_CREATE_SESSION-V1', 'ACT-IDENTITY_DELETE_SESSION-V1', 'ACT-IDENTITY_UPDATE_STEP_UP-V1', 'ACT-OPERATIONS_READ_OPERATION-V1', 'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1', 'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1', 'ACT-PARTICIPANT_ACTIVATE_CONTEXT-V1', 'ACT-PARTICIPANT_CREATE_MEMBER-V1', 'ACT-POLICY_APPROVE_REQUEST-V1', 'ACT-POLICY_READ_EFFECTIVE_ACCESS-V1', 'ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1')
          and (source.source_purpose='PENDING_ADMINISTRATION_EXPIRY_RECOVERY'
      and source.document->>'schemaVersion'='4'
      and exists(select 1 from control.platform_recovery_case historical
        where historical.participant_id=source.participant_id
          and historical.privacy_domain_id=source.privacy_domain_id
          and ((not (source.document#>'{source}' ? 'closedApproval')
    and historical.enrollment_id=source.enrollment_id
    and historical.enrollment_revision=source.row_version and historical.enrollment_digest=source.document_digest
    and historical.state='EXPIRED' and historical.valid_until<=clock_timestamp())
   or (source.document#>>'{source,closedApproval,schema}'='pc.identity.closed-platform-approval-source'
    and source.document#>>'{source,closedApproval,schemaVersion}'='1'
    and historical.enrollment_id::text=source.document#>>'{source,closedApproval,enrollmentId}'
    and historical.enrollment_id<>source.enrollment_id
    and 'sha256:'||encode(historical.enrollment_digest,'hex')=source.document#>>'{source,closedApproval,enrollmentDigest}'
    and historical.recovery_id::text=source.document#>>'{source,closedApproval,approval,recoveryId}'
    and 'sha256:'||encode(historical.intent_digest,'hex')=source.document#>>'{source,closedApproval,approval,intentDigest}'
    and historical.state in ('REVOKED','EXPIRED')
    and historical.state=source.document#>>'{source,closedApproval,closure,state}'))
          and historical.intent->'pendingExpiry'=source.document#>'{source,pendingExpiry}'
          and (not (historical.intent ? 'approvalContinuation') or (
    historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,schema}'='pc.identity.platform-prepare-approval-continuation'
    and historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,schemaVersion}'='1'
    and historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,recoveryId}'<>historical.recovery_id::text
    and historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,recoveryId}' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    and historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,candidateId}' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    and historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,approvalId}' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    and historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,candidateDigest}'='sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(historical.intent->'preparation'),'UTF8')),'hex')
    and historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,attempt}' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}$'
  ))
          and historical.intent_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(historical.intent),'UTF8'))
          and historical.activation_operation_id is not null
          and historical.activation_evidence_digest=sha256(historical.activation_evidence_cbor)
          and octet_length(historical.activation_cose)>0
          and (exists(select 1 from control.mutation_candidate resume_candidate
      where resume_candidate.participant_id=historical.participant_id
        and resume_candidate.privacy_domain_id=historical.privacy_domain_id
        and resume_candidate.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-PLATFORM-SCOPE-PREPARE'
        and resume_candidate.action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
        and resume_candidate.resource_type='participant' and resume_candidate.operation_class='UPDATE'
        and resume_candidate.expected_revision=0
        and resume_candidate.resource_id::text=historical.intent#>>'{preparation,replacementId}'
        and resume_candidate.candidate_document=historical.intent->'preparation'
        and resume_candidate.candidate_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(resume_candidate.candidate_document),'UTF8'))
        and resume_candidate.maker_principal_id::text=historical.intent#>>'{preparation,administrators,0,principalId}'
        and resume_candidate.predecessor_candidate_id::text=historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,candidateId}'
        and resume_candidate.predecessor_approval_id::text=historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,approvalId}'
        and resume_candidate.idempotency_key=historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,businessKey}'
        and resume_candidate.attempt=(historical.intent#>>'{approvalContinuation,attempt}')::numeric+1
        and resume_candidate.state in ('PROPOSED','APPROVAL_REQUESTED','APPROVED')
        and resume_candidate.expires_at<=clock_timestamp() and resume_candidate.consumed_operation_id is null
        and resume_candidate.resume_operation_id is not null
        and resume_candidate.resume_request->>'command'='RESUME'
        and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(historical.lease_bindings) binding
          where binding->>'envelopeId'=resume_candidate.maker_authority_envelope_id::text
            and binding->>'assignmentId'=resume_candidate.maker_assignment_id::text
            and binding->>'principalId'=resume_candidate.maker_principal_id::text
            and binding->>'principalEpoch'=resume_candidate.maker_principal_epoch::text)
        and (r."aggregate_type"='webauthn-verification' and r."aggregate_id"=resume_candidate.maker_session_id
          and r."event_type"='openpc.identity.webauthn-verification.mutation.committed.v1'
          and exists(select 1 from control.mutation_evidence receiving_verification
            join control.mfa_challenge receiving_challenge on receiving_challenge.participant_id=receiving_verification.participant_id
              and receiving_challenge.mfa_challenge_id=receiving_verification.mfa_challenge_id
            where receiving_verification.participant_id=resume_candidate.participant_id
              and receiving_verification.privacy_domain_id=resume_candidate.privacy_domain_id
              and receiving_verification.evidence_cbor=r."payload_cbor"
              and receiving_verification.evidence_digest=r."payload_digest"
              and receiving_verification.cose_sign1=r."cose_sign1"
              and receiving_verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=r."webauthn_assertion_binding_digest"
              and ((receiving_challenge.used_at is null and receiving_challenge.used_operation_id is null)
                or (receiving_challenge.used_operation_id=resume_candidate.resume_operation_id and receiving_challenge.used_at is not null))
              and receiving_challenge.resource_id=resume_candidate.predecessor_approval_id::text
              and receiving_challenge.action_intent_id='ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
              and receiving_challenge.resource_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(resume_candidate.resume_request),'UTF8'))
              and receiving_challenge.principal_id=resume_candidate.maker_principal_id
              and receiving_challenge.session_id=resume_candidate.maker_session_id)
          and r."payload_digest"=sha256(r."payload_cbor") and r."cose_sign1" is not null
          and r."webauthn_assertion_binding_digest" is not null))))))) else false end),false);
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range OR invalid_datetime_format THEN RETURN false;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.platform_history_outbox_event_root_installation_read(p_row jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE r control.outbox_event;
BEGIN
 IF p_row IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_row)<>'object' THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 r:=jsonb_populate_record(NULL::control.outbox_event,p_row);
 IF to_jsonb(r) IS DISTINCT FROM p_row THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN coalesce((openpc.matches_participant(r."participant_id") and openpc.matches_privacy(r."privacy_domain_id")
        and openpc.current_action_intent_id()='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
        and current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true) is not distinct from '1'
        and exists(with recursive ancestry as (
          select completed.recovery_id,completed.participant_id,completed.privacy_domain_id,
            completed.intent,completed.result,1 as depth
          from control.root_expiry_recovery_case completed
          join control.root_expiry_recovery_scope scope on scope.recovery_id=completed.recovery_id
            and scope.owner_participant_id=completed.participant_id
            and scope.installation_privacy_domain_id=completed.privacy_domain_id
            and scope.activation_operation_id=completed.operation_id
            and scope.intent_digest=completed.intent_digest and scope.enrollment_digest=completed.enrollment_digest
            and scope.admission_digest=sha256(scope.admission_preimage)
          join control.platform_context root on root.platform_context_id=scope.platform_context_id
            and root.owner_participant_id=scope.owner_participant_id and root.state='ACTIVE'
            and root.authority_epoch=scope.platform_authority_epoch
          join control.root_expiry_recovery_enrollment custody on custody.enrollment_id=completed.enrollment_id
            and custody.participant_id=completed.participant_id and custody.privacy_domain_id=completed.privacy_domain_id
            and custody.document_digest=completed.enrollment_digest and custody.row_version=completed.enrollment_revision
            and custody.state='ACTIVE' and custody.document->>'schemaVersion'='2'
            and custody.document->>'purpose'='pc.installation.local-root-expiry-pending-recovery-custody.v2'
            and custody.document_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(custody.document),'UTF8'))
          join control.root_expiry_recovery_trust trust on trust.custody_trust_id=custody.custody_trust_id
            and trust.participant_id=custody.participant_id and trust.privacy_domain_id=custody.privacy_domain_id
            and trust.document_digest=custody.custody_trust_digest and trust.state='ACTIVE' and trust.row_version=1
            and trust.document_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(trust.document),'UTF8'))
            and trust.document->>'schemaVersion'='2' and trust.document->>'purpose'=custody.document->>'purpose'
            and trust.document->'pending'=custody.document->'pending'
          join control.platform_scope_replacement pending on pending.participant_id=custody.participant_id
            and pending.privacy_domain_id=custody.privacy_domain_id and pending.platform_context_id=scope.platform_context_id
            and pending.replacement_id::text=custody.document#>>'{pending,replacementId}'
          where completed.participant_id=r."participant_id" and completed.privacy_domain_id=r."privacy_domain_id"
            and completed.state='COMPLETED' and completed.intent->>'schemaVersion'='2'
            and completed.intent->>'purpose'='LOCAL_ROOT_EXPIRY_PENDING_RECOVERY_ONLY'
            and completed.intent->'pending'=custody.document->'pending'
            and completed.intent_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(completed.intent),'UTF8'))
            and completed.evidence_digest=sha256(completed.evidence_cbor) and octet_length(completed.evidence_cose)>0
            and completed.result=jsonb_build_object('rootEpoch',root.authority_epoch::text,
              'rootRevision',root.row_version::text,'rootDigest','sha256:'||encode(scope.admission_digest,'hex'),
              'operationId',completed.operation_id::text)
            and (openpc.business_cbor(scope.scope_cbor)->>'4')::numeric>floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000000)
            and root.authority_epoch=pending.predecessor_epoch+1 and root.row_version=pending.expected_root_revision+1
            and scope.predecessor_epoch=pending.predecessor_epoch and scope.predecessor_digest=pending.predecessor_digest
            and pending.state='WITHDRAWING' and pending.row_version=1 and pending.superseded_by is null
            and num_nonnulls(pending.commit_operation_id,pending.commit_candidate_id,pending.commit_approval_id,pending.readiness_digest,pending.committed_at)=0
            and custody.document#>>'{pending,preparationCandidateId}'=pending.prepare_candidate_id::text
            and custody.document#>>'{pending,preparationOperationId}'=pending.prepare_operation_id::text
            and custody.document#>>'{pending,preparationApprovalId}'=pending.prepare_approval_id::text
            and custody.document#>>'{pending,preparationDigest}'='sha256:'||encode(pending.candidate_digest,'hex')
            and custody.document#>>'{pending,successorDigest}'='sha256:'||encode(pending.successor_digest,'hex')
            and custody.document#>>'{pending,pendingRecordDigest}'='sha256:'||encode(openpc.platform_scope_pending_record_digest(pending),'hex')
            and (select count(*) from control.root_expiry_recovery_proof proof
              where proof.recovery_id=completed.recovery_id and proof.participant_id=completed.participant_id
                and proof.privacy_domain_id=completed.privacy_domain_id and proof.intent_digest=completed.intent_digest)=4
          union all
          select predecessor.recovery_id,predecessor.participant_id,predecessor.privacy_domain_id,
            predecessor.intent,predecessor.result,ancestry.depth+1
          from ancestry join control.root_expiry_recovery_case predecessor
            on predecessor.participant_id=ancestry.participant_id and predecessor.privacy_domain_id=ancestry.privacy_domain_id
            and predecessor.result->>'rootEpoch'=ancestry.intent->>'predecessorEpoch'
            and predecessor.result->>'rootRevision'=ancestry.intent->>'predecessorRevision'
            and predecessor.result->>'rootDigest'=ancestry.intent->>'predecessorDigest'
          where ancestry.depth<32 and predecessor.state='COMPLETED'
            and predecessor.intent_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(predecessor.intent),'UTF8'))
            and predecessor.evidence_digest=sha256(predecessor.evidence_cbor) and octet_length(predecessor.evidence_cose)>0
            and (predecessor.result->>'rootEpoch')::numeric=(predecessor.intent->>'predecessorEpoch')::numeric+1
            and (predecessor.result->>'rootRevision')::numeric=(predecessor.intent->>'predecessorRevision')::numeric+1
        ) select 1 from ancestry join control.root_expiry_recovery_case receipt
          on receipt.recovery_id=ancestry.recovery_id and receipt.participant_id=ancestry.participant_id
            and receipt.privacy_domain_id=ancestry.privacy_domain_id
          where r."aggregate_type"='local-root-expiry-recovery' and r."aggregate_id"=receipt.recovery_id
          and r."aggregate_sequence"=1 and r."event_id"=receipt.operation_id
          and r."event_type"='openpc.identity.local-root-expiry-recovery.completed.v1'
          and r."payload_cbor"=receipt.evidence_cbor and r."payload_digest"=receipt.evidence_digest
          and r."cose_sign1"=receipt.evidence_cose)),false);
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range OR invalid_datetime_format THEN RETURN false;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.platform_history_outbox_event_root_source_read(p_row jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE r control.outbox_event;
BEGIN
 IF p_row IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_row)<>'object' THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 r:=jsonb_populate_record(NULL::control.outbox_event,p_row);
 IF to_jsonb(r) IS DISTINCT FROM p_row THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN coalesce((openpc.matches_participant(r."participant_id") and openpc.matches_privacy(r."privacy_domain_id")
        and openpc.current_action_intent_id()='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
        and current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true) is not distinct from '1'
        and exists(select 1 from control.platform_recovery_enrollment source
          join control.root_expiry_recovery_case receipt on (receipt.recovery_id=source.root_expiry_recovery_id
            or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(source.document#>'{source,ancestorReceipts}','[]'::jsonb)) declared
              where declared->>'recoveryId'=receipt.recovery_id::text
                and declared->>'enrollmentId'=receipt.enrollment_id::text
                and declared->>'activationOperationId'=receipt.operation_id::text
                and declared->>'receiptDigest'='sha256:'||encode(receipt.evidence_digest,'hex')))
            and receipt.participant_id=source.participant_id and receipt.privacy_domain_id=source.privacy_domain_id
          join control.platform_context root on root.platform_context_id=source.platform_context_id
            and root.owner_participant_id=source.participant_id and root.state='ACTIVE'
            and root.authority_epoch=source.root_epoch and root.row_version=source.root_revision
          where source.participant_id=r."participant_id" and source.privacy_domain_id=r."privacy_domain_id"
            and source.source_purpose in ('ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY','ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY_CONTINUATION','PENDING_ADMINISTRATION_EXPIRY_RECOVERY') and source.expired_replacement_id is null
            and source.state='ACTIVE' and source.row_version=1
            and source.document->>'schema' in ('pc.identity.platform-recovery-enrollment','pc.identity.discovery-certificate-recovery-enrollment')
            and ((source.source_purpose='ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY' and source.document->>'schemaVersion'='2')
              or (source.source_purpose='ROOT_EXPIRY_RECOVERY_CONTINUATION' and source.document->>'schema'='pc.identity.platform-recovery-enrollment' and source.document->>'schemaVersion'='3')
              or (source.source_purpose='PENDING_ADMINISTRATION_EXPIRY_RECOVERY' and source.document->>'schema'='pc.identity.platform-recovery-enrollment' and source.document->>'schemaVersion'='4' and jsonb_typeof(source.document#>'{source,pendingExpiry}')='object'))
            and source.document->>'assurance'='LOCAL_QA_VIRTUAL_AUTHENTICATOR'
            and source.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() and source.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
            and receipt.state='COMPLETED'
            and ((receipt.recovery_id=source.root_expiry_recovery_id
              and source.document#>>'{source,enrollmentId}'=receipt.enrollment_id::text
              and source.document#>>'{source,activationOperationId}'=receipt.operation_id::text
              and source.document#>>'{source,receiptDigest}'='sha256:'||encode(receipt.evidence_digest,'hex')
              and receipt.result->>'rootEpoch'=source.root_epoch::text
              and receipt.result->>'rootRevision'=source.root_revision::text
              and receipt.result->>'rootDigest'='sha256:'||encode(source.root_digest,'hex'))
            or (jsonb_array_length(source.document#>'{source,ancestorReceipts}') between 1 and 31
              and (receipt.result->>'rootEpoch')::numeric<source.root_epoch
              and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(source.document#>'{source,ancestorReceipts}') declared
                where declared->>'recoveryId'=receipt.recovery_id::text
                  and declared->>'enrollmentId'=receipt.enrollment_id::text
                  and declared->>'activationOperationId'=receipt.operation_id::text
                  and declared->>'receiptDigest'='sha256:'||encode(receipt.evidence_digest,'hex'))))
            and r."aggregate_type"='local-root-expiry-recovery' and r."aggregate_id"=receipt.recovery_id
          and r."aggregate_sequence"=1 and r."event_id"=receipt.operation_id
          and r."event_type"='openpc.identity.local-root-expiry-recovery.completed.v1'
          and r."payload_cbor"=receipt.evidence_cbor and r."payload_digest"=receipt.evidence_digest
          and r."cose_sign1"=receipt.evidence_cose)),false);
EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range OR invalid_datetime_format THEN RETURN false;
END $function$
participant uuid, enrollment uuid, link jsonb, preparation jsonb
