 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('objectRef',plan->'selection'->'objectRef','objectVersion',plan->'selection'->'objectVersion',
  'objectDigest',plan->'selection'->'objectDigest','payloadDigest',plan->'selection'->'payloadDigest',
  'ciphertextBytes',plan->'selection'->'ciphertextBytes','beforeDigest',plan->'beforeDigest')
$function$
p_predecessor uuid, p_predecessor_epoch numeric, p_successor uuid, p_successor_epoch numeric, p_principal uuid

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.read_identity_envelope_credential_continuation(p_predecessor uuid, p_predecessor_epoch numeric, p_successor uuid, p_successor_epoch numeric, p_principal uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE("principalId" text, "checkerPrincipalId" text, "credentialPublicKey" bytea, "credentialPublicKeyDigest" bytea, "evidenceCbor" bytea, "evidenceDigest" bytea, "coseSign1" bytea, "verificationCandidateDigest" bytea, "verificationSessionId" text, "verificationOccurredAt" timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
 SET jit TO 'off'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1' OR p_predecessor=p_successor
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_recovery_enrollment enrollment
   JOIN control.business_signing_key key ON key.participant_id=enrollment.participant_id
    AND key.privacy_domain_id=enrollment.privacy_domain_id AND key.signing_purpose_code=371
    AND key.signer_id=enrollment.document#>>'{request,oldFingerprint}'
    AND key.secret_reference=enrollment.document#>>'{request,oldReference}'
    AND 'sha256:'||encode(key.trust_digest,'hex')=enrollment.document->>'oldTrustDigest'
    AND key.workload_credential_id=p_predecessor AND key.workload_credential_epoch=p_predecessor_epoch
   WHERE openpc.matches_participant(enrollment.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(enrollment.privacy_domain_id)
    AND enrollment.state='ACTIVE' AND enrollment.row_version=1
    AND openpc.identity_envelope_recovery_source_current(enrollment.enrollment_id)
    AND enrollment.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND enrollment.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
    AND enrollment.document#>>'{request,workloadCredentialId}'=p_successor::text
    AND enrollment.document->>'issuerCredentialEpoch'=p_successor_epoch::text
    AND enrollment.document->>'issuerPrincipalId'=p_principal::text)
 THEN RETURN; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY WITH
 continuation_mutation_candidate AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT candidate.* FROM control.mutation_candidate candidate WHERE candidate.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id()
   AND candidate.privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id() AND candidate.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE'
   AND candidate.resource_id=p_predecessor AND candidate.candidate_document->>'credentialId'=p_successor::text),
 continuation_approval_request AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT approval.* FROM control.approval_request approval WHERE approval.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id()
   AND approval.privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
   AND approval.subject_id IN(SELECT candidate.mutation_candidate_id FROM continuation_mutation_candidate candidate)),
 continuation_approval_decision_record AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT decision.* FROM control.approval_decision_record decision WHERE decision.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id()
   AND decision.privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
   AND decision.approval_request_id IN(SELECT approval.approval_request_id FROM continuation_approval_request approval)),
 continuation_credential AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT credential.* FROM control.credential credential WHERE credential.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id()
   AND (credential.credential_id IN(p_predecessor,p_successor)
    OR credential.credential_id IN(SELECT decision.signer_credential_id FROM continuation_approval_decision_record decision))),
 continuation_mfa_challenge AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT challenge.* FROM control.mfa_challenge challenge WHERE challenge.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id()
   AND challenge.mfa_challenge_id IN(SELECT decision.mfa_challenge_id FROM continuation_approval_decision_record decision)),
 continuation_mutation_evidence AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT history.* FROM control.mutation_evidence history WHERE history.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id()
   AND history.privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
   AND ((history.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE' AND history.aggregate_id=p_predecessor)
    OR (history.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WEBAUTHN-VERIFY' AND EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM continuation_approval_decision_record decision WHERE decision.approver_principal_id=history.principal_id
      AND decision.signer_credential_id=history.signer_credential_id AND decision.mfa_challenge_id=history.mfa_challenge_id
      AND decision.evidence_cbor=history.evidence_cbor AND decision.cose_sign1=history.cose_sign1)))),
 continuation_idempotency_record AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT committed.* FROM control.idempotency_record committed WHERE committed.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id()
   AND committed.privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
   AND committed.operation_id IN(SELECT history.operation_id FROM continuation_mutation_evidence history)),
 continuation_outbox_event AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT event.* FROM control.outbox_event event WHERE event.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id()
   AND event.privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id() AND EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM continuation_mutation_evidence history WHERE event.aggregate_type=history.aggregate_type
     AND event.aggregate_id=history.aggregate_id AND event.payload_cbor=history.evidence_cbor
     AND event.payload_digest=history.evidence_digest AND event.cose_sign1=history.cose_sign1))
 SELECT successor.principal_id::text,history.checker_principal_id::text,
  credential.public_key_spki_der,credential.public_key_digest,
  history.evidence_cbor,history.evidence_digest,history.cose_sign1,
  verified.candidate_digest,verified.session_id::text,verified.occurred_at
 FROM continuation_credential successor JOIN continuation_mutation_evidence history
  ON history.participant_id=successor.participant_id AND openpc.matches_privacy(history.privacy_domain_id)
   AND history.aggregate_id=p_predecessor AND history.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE'
 JOIN continuation_mutation_candidate candidate ON candidate.participant_id=history.participant_id
  AND candidate.privacy_domain_id=history.privacy_domain_id AND candidate.consumed_operation_id=history.operation_id
  AND candidate.candidate_document->>'credentialId'=successor.credential_id::text
 JOIN continuation_approval_decision_record decision ON decision.participant_id=history.participant_id
  AND decision.privacy_domain_id=history.privacy_domain_id AND decision.approval_request_id=history.approval_request_id
  AND decision.approver_principal_id=history.checker_principal_id AND decision.decision='APPROVE'
  AND decision.evidence_cbor=history.evidence_cbor AND decision.cose_sign1=history.cose_sign1
 JOIN continuation_credential credential ON credential.participant_id=decision.participant_id
  AND credential.credential_id=decision.signer_credential_id AND credential.principal_id=decision.approver_principal_id
  AND credential.kind='WEBAUTHN' AND credential.valid_from<=decision.decided_at
  AND (credential.valid_until IS NULL OR credential.valid_until>decision.decided_at)
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT verification.candidate_digest,challenge.session_id,verification.occurred_at
  FROM continuation_mutation_evidence verification JOIN continuation_mfa_challenge challenge
   ON challenge.participant_id=verification.participant_id AND challenge.mfa_challenge_id=verification.mfa_challenge_id
   AND challenge.principal_id=verification.principal_id AND challenge.session_id=verification.aggregate_id
   AND challenge.consumed_at IS NOT NULL AND challenge.mfa_challenge_id=decision.mfa_challenge_id
   AND challenge.action_intent_id='ACT-POLICY_APPROVE_REQUEST-V1' AND challenge.resource_digest=decision.decision_digest
  JOIN continuation_idempotency_record committed ON committed.participant_id=verification.participant_id
   AND committed.privacy_domain_id=verification.privacy_domain_id AND committed.principal_id=verification.principal_id
   AND committed.operation_id=verification.operation_id AND committed.catalog_operation_id=verification.catalog_operation_id
   AND committed.input_digest=verification.candidate_digest AND committed.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
   AND committed.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
  JOIN continuation_outbox_event event ON event.participant_id=verification.participant_id AND event.privacy_domain_id=verification.privacy_domain_id
   AND event.aggregate_type=verification.aggregate_type AND event.aggregate_id=verification.aggregate_id
   AND event.event_type='openpc.identity.webauthn-verification.mutation.committed.v1'
   AND event.payload_cbor=verification.evidence_cbor AND event.payload_digest=verification.evidence_digest
   AND event.cose_sign1=verification.cose_sign1 AND event.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
  WHERE verification.participant_id=decision.participant_id AND verification.privacy_domain_id=decision.privacy_domain_id
   AND verification.principal_id=decision.approver_principal_id AND verification.signer_credential_id=decision.signer_credential_id
   AND verification.evidence_cbor=decision.evidence_cbor AND verification.cose_sign1=decision.cose_sign1
   AND verification.action_intent_id='ACT-IDENTITY_UPDATE_STEP_UP-V1' AND verification.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WEBAUTHN-VERIFY'
   AND verification.aggregate_type='webauthn-verification' AND verification.evidence_digest=sha256(verification.evidence_cbor)
   AND verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest IS NOT NULL AND verification.occurred_at>=challenge.consumed_at
   AND verification.occurred_at<=decision.decided_at
 ) verified ON true
 WHERE openpc.matches_participant(successor.participant_id) AND successor.credential_id=p_successor
  AND successor.principal_id=p_principal
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM continuation_credential predecessor
    JOIN continuation_credential successor ON successor.participant_id=predecessor.participant_id
      AND successor.rotated_from_credential_id=predecessor.credential_id
      AND successor.principal_id=predecessor.principal_id AND successor.audience=predecessor.audience
    JOIN continuation_mutation_candidate candidate ON candidate.participant_id=predecessor.participant_id
      AND candidate.privacy_domain_id=history.privacy_domain_id
      AND candidate.resource_id=predecessor.credential_id
      AND candidate.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE'
      AND candidate.action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
      AND candidate.state='CONSUMED' AND candidate.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL
      AND candidate.candidate_document=jsonb_build_object('replacedCredentialId',predecessor.credential_id::text,
        'credentialId',successor.credential_id::text,
        'publicKeySpkiDer',replace(encode(successor.public_key_spki_der,'base64'),E'\n',''))
      AND candidate.candidate_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(candidate.candidate_document),'UTF8'))
    JOIN continuation_approval_request approval ON approval.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
      AND approval.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id AND approval.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE'
      AND approval.subject_id=candidate.mutation_candidate_id AND approval.subject_digest=candidate.candidate_digest
      AND approval.maker_principal_id=candidate.maker_principal_id AND approval.state='APPROVED'
      AND approval.subject_version=candidate.expected_revision AND approval.action_intent_id=candidate.action_intent_id
    JOIN continuation_approval_decision_record decision ON decision.participant_id=approval.participant_id
      AND decision.privacy_domain_id=approval.privacy_domain_id AND decision.approval_request_id=approval.approval_request_id
      AND decision.decision='APPROVE' AND decision.candidate_digest=candidate.candidate_digest
      AND decision.approver_principal_id<>approval.maker_principal_id AND decision.cose_sign1 IS NOT NULL
      AND decision.aggregate_version=approval.subject_version
    JOIN continuation_mutation_evidence evidence ON evidence.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
      AND evidence.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id AND evidence.operation_id=candidate.consumed_operation_id
      AND evidence.action_intent_id=candidate.action_intent_id AND evidence.catalog_operation_id=candidate.catalog_operation_id
      AND evidence.aggregate_type='workload-credential' AND evidence.aggregate_id=predecessor.credential_id
      AND evidence.candidate_digest=candidate.candidate_digest AND evidence.principal_id=approval.maker_principal_id
      AND evidence.checker_principal_id=decision.approver_principal_id AND evidence.approval_request_id=approval.approval_request_id
      AND evidence.evidence_digest=sha256(evidence.evidence_cbor) AND evidence.cose_sign1 IS NOT NULL
      AND evidence.evidence_cbor=decision.evidence_cbor AND evidence.cose_sign1=decision.cose_sign1
      AND evidence.signer_credential_id=decision.signer_credential_id
      AND evidence.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest IS NOT NULL AND evidence.mfa_challenge_id IS NOT NULL
    JOIN continuation_idempotency_record committed ON committed.participant_id=evidence.participant_id
      AND committed.privacy_domain_id=evidence.privacy_domain_id AND committed.operation_id=evidence.operation_id
      AND committed.action_intent_id=evidence.action_intent_id AND committed.catalog_operation_id=evidence.catalog_operation_id
      AND committed.principal_id=evidence.principal_id
      AND committed.terminal_state='COMMITTED' AND committed.input_digest=evidence.candidate_digest
      AND committed.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=evidence.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
      AND committed.result_payload->>'credentialId'=successor.credential_id::text
      AND committed.result_payload->>'replacedCredentialId'=predecessor.credential_id::text
      AND committed.result_payload->>'principalId'=successor.principal_id::text
      AND committed.result_payload->>'workloadId'=successor.audience
      AND committed.result_payload->>'workloadEpoch'=successor.credential_epoch::text
      AND committed.result_payload->>'state'='ACTIVE'
    JOIN continuation_outbox_event event ON event.participant_id=evidence.participant_id
      AND event.privacy_domain_id=evidence.privacy_domain_id AND event.aggregate_type=evidence.aggregate_type
      AND event.aggregate_id=evidence.aggregate_id AND event.payload_cbor=evidence.evidence_cbor
      AND event.event_type='openpc.identity.workload-credential.mutation.committed.v1'
      AND event.payload_digest=evidence.evidence_digest AND event.cose_sign1=evidence.cose_sign1
      AND event.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=evidence.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
    WHERE predecessor.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id()
      AND predecessor.credential_id=p_predecessor AND successor.credential_id=p_successor
      AND predecessor.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND predecessor.state='REVOKED'
      AND successor.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND successor.state='ACTIVE'
      AND predecessor.credential_epoch=p_predecessor_epoch+1
      AND successor.credential_epoch=predecessor.credential_epoch
      AND successor.credential_epoch=p_successor_epoch
      AND successor.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND successor.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
      AND evidence.operation_id=history.operation_id
  )
 LIMIT 2;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.read_platform_scope_affected_targets(root_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(target jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE pid uuid; privacy uuid; root control.platform_context; missing integer;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 pid:=openpc.current_participant_id(); privacy:=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id();
 IF root_id IS NULL OR openpc.current_action_intent_id() NOT IN('ACT-PARTICIPANTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-SCOPE-CONTEXT'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT root FROM control.platform_context p
  WHERE p.platform_context_id=root_id AND p.owner_participant_id=pid AND p.state='ACTIVE' FOR SHARE;
 PERFORM 1 FROM control.platform_envelope_scope s WHERE s.platform_context_id=root_id
  AND s.owner_participant_id=pid AND s.installation_privacy_domain_id=privacy;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-SCOPE-CONTEXT'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.configuration_work w WHERE w.participant_id=pid AND w.privacy_domain_id=privacy
   AND w.work_kind='RUNTIME_ACTIVATION' AND w.state IN('PENDING','LEASED','RECONCILING'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-SCOPE-WORK-PENDING'; END IF;
 SELECT count(*) INTO missing FROM control.runtime_target t
  WHERE t.participant_id=pid AND t.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND t.active_generation_digest IS NOT NULL
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_activation_observation o JOIN control.configuration_work w
    ON w.participant_id=o.participant_id AND w.privacy_domain_id=o.privacy_domain_id
      AND w.configuration_work_id=o.configuration_work_id AND w.execution_attempt_id=o.execution_attempt_id
      AND w.operation_id=o.operation_id AND w.runtime_target_id=o.runtime_target_id
      AND w.runtime_configuration_generation_id=o.runtime_configuration_generation_id
      AND w.generation_digest=o.generation_digest AND w.xds_version_digest=o.xds_version_digest
      AND w.state='COMPLETED' AND w.result_receipt_digest=o.activation_receipt_digest
    WHERE o.participant_id=pid AND o.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND o.runtime_target_id=t.runtime_target_id
      AND o.capsule_digest=t.active_generation_digest);
 IF missing<>0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-SCOPE-ORIGINAL-AMBIGUITY'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT jsonb_build_object('participantId',pid::text,'privacyDomainId',privacy::text,
    'targetId',t.runtime_target_id::text,'expectedRevision',t.revision::text,
    'capsuleDigest',o.capsule_digest,'originalWorkId',o.configuration_work_id::text,
    'originalAttemptId',o.execution_attempt_id::text,'activationReceiptDigest',o.activation_receipt_digest)
  FROM control.runtime_target t JOIN control.runtime_activation_observation o
    ON o.participant_id=t.participant_id AND o.privacy_domain_id=t.privacy_domain_id
      AND o.runtime_target_id=t.runtime_target_id AND o.capsule_digest=t.active_generation_digest
  WHERE t.participant_id=pid AND t.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND t.active_generation_digest IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY t.runtime_target_id;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.read_platform_scope_replacement_readiness(wanted uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE r control.platform_scope_replacement; root control.platform_context; targets jsonb; admins jsonb; bindings jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 PERFORM openpc.assert_runtime_target_disposition_owner();
 IF openpc.current_action_intent_id() NOT IN('ACT-PARTICIPANTS_READ_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-SCOPE-CONTEXT'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM control.platform_scope_replacement WHERE replacement_id=wanted
  AND participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id() AND privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id();
 SELECT * INTO STRICT root FROM control.platform_context p WHERE p.platform_context_id=r.platform_context_id
  AND p.owner_participant_id=r.participant_id AND p.state='ACTIVE';
 IF r.state<>'WITHDRAWING' OR r.row_version<>1 OR root.authority_epoch<>r.predecessor_epoch
  OR root.row_version<>r.expected_root_revision THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-SCOPE-PREDECESSOR'; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('targetId',q.runtime_target_id::text,'source',q.source,
  'revision',head.revision::text,'deliveryDigest',d.delivery_digest,'acknowledgementDigest',a.acknowledgement_digest,
  'journalSequence',a.claims->>'journal_sequence','ready',coalesce(
    head.binding->>'action'='Withdraw' AND head.binding->'cause'=jsonb_build_object('kind','Dependency','owner','Platform',
      'resource_id',r.replacement_id::text,'operation_id',r.prepare_operation_id::text,'revision',1)
    AND 'sha256:'||(head.binding#>>'{source,capsule_digest}')=q.source->>'capsuleDigest'
    AND head.binding#>>'{source,original_work_id}'=q.source->>'originalWorkId'
    AND head.binding#>>'{source,original_execution_attempt_id}'=q.source->>'originalAttemptId'
    AND d.claims=head.binding||jsonb_build_object('committed_admission_digest',substring(head.admission_digest from 8))
    AND a.claims->>'installed_state'='NewUseDenied' AND a.claims->'target'=head.binding->'target'
    AND a.claims->>'delivery_digest'=substring(d.delivery_digest from 8)
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.credential credential JOIN control.principal principal
      ON principal.participant_id=credential.participant_id AND principal.principal_id=credential.principal_id
      WHERE credential.participant_id=q.participant_id AND credential.credential_id=(head.binding#>>'{target,credential_id}')::uuid
        AND credential.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND credential.state='ACTIVE' AND principal.state='ACTIVE'
        AND credential.principal_id=(head.binding#>>'{target,principal_id}')::uuid
        AND credential.credential_epoch::text=head.binding#>>'{target,credential_epoch}'
        AND principal.authority_epoch::text=head.binding#>>'{target,principal_epoch}'
        AND credential.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND (credential.valid_until IS NULL OR credential.valid_until>clock_timestamp()))
    AND (a.claims->>'disposition_revision')::bigint=head.revision
    AND d.delivery_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(d.signed_delivery),'hex')
    AND a.acknowledgement_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(a.signed_acknowledgement),'hex'),false))
    ORDER BY q.runtime_target_id),'[]') INTO targets
 FROM control.platform_scope_target_withdrawal q
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT h.* FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission h WHERE h.participant_id=q.participant_id
  AND h.privacy_domain_id=q.privacy_domain_id AND h.runtime_target_id=q.runtime_target_id ORDER BY h.revision DESC LIMIT 1) head ON true
 LEFT JOIN control.runtime_target_disposition_delivery d ON d.participant_id=q.participant_id AND d.privacy_domain_id=q.privacy_domain_id
  AND d.runtime_target_id=q.runtime_target_id AND d.revision=head.revision
 LEFT JOIN control.runtime_target_disposition_acknowledgement a ON a.participant_id=q.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=q.privacy_domain_id
  AND a.runtime_target_id=q.runtime_target_id AND a.delivery_digest=d.delivery_digest
 WHERE q.participant_id=r.participant_id AND q.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND q.replacement_id=r.replacement_id;
 IF jsonb_array_length(targets)<>jsonb_array_length(r.candidate->'affectedTargets')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-SCOPE-COHORT'; END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('principalId',plan->>'principalId','envelopeId',plan->>'envelopeId',
  'assignmentId',plan->>'assignmentId','envelopeDigest','sha256:'||encode(e.semantic_digest,'hex'),
  'signatureDigest','sha256:'||encode(sha256(e.cose_sign1),'hex'),'assignmentRevision',a.row_version::text,
  'roleRevision',role.row_version::text,'ready',coalesce(
    e.state='ACTIVE' AND e.representation='TYPED_V1' AND e.platform_context_id=r.platform_context_id
    AND e.platform_authority_epoch=r.predecessor_epoch+1 AND e.maker_checker_required AND e.step_up_required
    AND e.onward_delegation_depth=0 AND cardinality(e.runtime_capability_ids)=0
    AND e.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND e.valid_until>clock_timestamp() AND octet_length(e.cose_sign1)>0
    AND p.state='APPROVED' AND p.row_version=3 AND p.proposal_cbor=e.semantic_cbor
    AND create_intent.state='CONSUMED' AND create_intent.candidate_document->>'platformScopeReplacementId'=r.replacement_id::text
    AND create_intent.candidate_document->'usable'=plan->'usable' AND create_intent.candidate_document->'grantable'=plan->'grantable'
    AND openpc.platform_scope_document_value(openpc.business_cbor(p.proposal_cbor)->'8')=plan->'usable'
    AND openpc.platform_scope_document_value(openpc.business_cbor(p.proposal_cbor)->'9')=plan->'grantable'
    AND activation.state='COMMITTED' AND activation.row_version=4 AND activation.cose_sign1=e.cose_sign1
    AND principal.state='ACTIVE' AND principal.kind IN('USER','PLATFORM_OPERATOR')
    AND role.state='ACTIVE' AND role.row_version::text=plan->>'expectedRoleRevision'
    AND plan->>'roleDigest'='sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(jsonb_build_object(
      'domain','pc.identity.envelope-role-binding.v1','participantId',r.participant_id::text,
      'role',jsonb_build_object('roleId',role.role_id,'version',role.row_version::text,'actions',role.action_intent_ids,
       'origin',role.origin,'createdByPrincipalId',role.created_by_principal_id::text,'creatorParticipantId',role.creator_participant_id::text,
       'bootstrapMandateId',role.bootstrap_mandate_id::text,'bootstrapPlatformParticipantId',role.bootstrap_platform_participant_id::text))),'UTF8')),'hex')
    AND a.state='ACTIVE' AND a.principal_id=principal.principal_id AND a.authority_envelope_id=e.authority_envelope_id
    AND a.role_id=role.role_id AND a.authority_group_id IS NULL AND a.delegation_epoch=e.delegation_epoch
    AND a.valid_during=tstzrange(e.valid_from,e.valid_until,'[)') AND a.valid_during @> clock_timestamp()
    AND a.privacy_domain_ids=e.privacy_domain_ids AND a.action_intent_ids=e.action_intent_ids AND a.resource_ids=e.resource_ids
    AND a.risk_classes=e.risk_classes AND cardinality(a.runtime_capability_ids)=0
    AND a.maker_checker_required AND a.step_up_required AND a.onward_delegation_depth=0,false))
    ORDER BY plan->>'principalId') INTO admins
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.candidate->'administrators') plan
 LEFT JOIN control.authority_envelope e ON e.participant_id=r.participant_id AND e.authority_envelope_id=(plan->>'envelopeId')::uuid
 LEFT JOIN control.identity_envelope_proposal p ON p.participant_id=r.participant_id AND p.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND p.envelope_id=e.authority_envelope_id
 LEFT JOIN control.mutation_candidate create_intent ON create_intent.participant_id=r.participant_id AND create_intent.mutation_candidate_id=p.create_candidate_id
 LEFT JOIN control.identity_envelope_activation activation ON activation.participant_id=r.participant_id AND activation.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id
  AND activation.envelope_id=e.authority_envelope_id AND activation.operation_id=e.last_mutation_operation_id
 LEFT JOIN control.assignment a ON a.participant_id=r.participant_id AND a.assignment_id=(plan->>'assignmentId')::uuid
 LEFT JOIN control.authority_role role ON role.participant_id=r.participant_id AND role.authority_role_id=(plan->>'roleId')::uuid
 LEFT JOIN control.principal principal ON principal.participant_id=r.participant_id AND principal.principal_id=(plan->>'principalId')::uuid;
 bindings:=jsonb_build_object('replacementId',r.replacement_id::text,'platformContextId',r.platform_context_id::text,
  'rootRevision',root.row_version::text,'predecessorEpoch',r.predecessor_epoch::text,'predecessorDigest','sha256:'||encode(r.predecessor_digest,'hex'),
  'successorDigest','sha256:'||encode(r.successor_digest,'hex'),'replacementRevision',r.row_version::text,'state',r.state,
  'targets',targets,'administrators',admins,'sourceExpiresAtNs',openpc.business_cbor(r.successor_scope_cbor)->>'4');
 RETURN bindings||jsonb_build_object('readinessDigest','sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(
  jsonb_build_object('domain','pc.identity.platform-scope-readiness.v1','source',bindings)),'UTF8')),'hex'),
  'unacknowledgedTargets',(SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(targets) t WHERE t->>'ready' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'),
  'unpreparedAdministrators',(SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(admins) a WHERE a->>'ready' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'),
  'nowNs',(floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000)::text);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.read_provider_retry_probe_source(p_reference jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE p control.provider_profile; o control.provider_probe_observation; w control.configuration_work;
 e control.outbox_event; a control.mutation_evidence;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF current_setting('role') NOT IN ('openpc_control_owner','openpc_operations_qualification_owner')
  OR current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed' OR current_setting('row_security')<>'on'
  OR current_setting('session_replication_role')<>'origin'
  OR current_setting('openpc.context_mode',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'PARTICIPANT'
  OR NOT (openpc.current_action_intent_id()='ACT-POLICY_READ_EFFECTIVE_ACCESS-V1')
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user AND (rolsuper OR rolbypassrls))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OPS_PROVIDER_PROBE_SOURCE_CONTEXT'; END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(p_reference) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR octet_length(p_reference::text)>4096
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_reference))<>10
  OR NOT p_reference ?& ARRAY['providerProfileId','observationId','qualificationWorkId','operationId','resultEventId','artifactDigest','configurationDigest','observationDigest','resultReceiptDigest','authorizationEvidenceDigest']
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(p_reference) item WHERE jsonb_typeof(item.value)<>'string')
  OR coalesce(p_reference->>'providerProfileId','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  OR coalesce(p_reference->>'observationId','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  OR coalesce(p_reference->>'qualificationWorkId','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  OR coalesce(p_reference->>'operationId','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  OR coalesce(p_reference->>'resultEventId','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  OR coalesce(p_reference->>'artifactDigest','') !~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR coalesce(p_reference->>'configurationDigest','') !~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR coalesce(p_reference->>'observationDigest','') !~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR coalesce(p_reference->>'resultReceiptDigest','') !~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  OR coalesce(p_reference->>'authorizationEvidenceDigest','') !~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OPS_PROVIDER_PROBE_SOURCE_REFERENCE'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT p FROM control.provider_profile
  WHERE provider_profile_id=(p_reference->>'providerProfileId')::uuid
   AND openpc.matches_participant(participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(privacy_domain_id);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT o FROM control.provider_probe_observation
  WHERE observation_id=(p_reference->>'observationId')::uuid AND provider_profile_id=p.provider_profile_id
   AND participant_id=p.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=p.privacy_domain_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT w FROM control.configuration_work
  WHERE configuration_work_id=(p_reference->>'qualificationWorkId')::uuid AND resource_id=p.provider_profile_id
   AND participant_id=p.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=p.privacy_domain_id;
 IF o.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'OBSERVED' OR o.observed_revision IS DISTINCT FROM o.source_revision+1
  OR o.input_digest IS DISTINCT FROM p_reference->>'artifactDigest'
  OR o.configuration_digest IS DISTINCT FROM p_reference->>'configurationDigest'
  OR o.observation_digest IS DISTINCT FROM p_reference->>'observationDigest'
  OR o.completed_at IS NULL OR o.valid_until IS NULL OR o.valid_until<=o.completed_at
  OR w.work_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'PROVIDER_QUALIFICATION' OR w.state NOT IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED')
  OR w.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM (p_reference->>'operationId')::uuid
  OR w.input_digest IS DISTINCT FROM o.input_digest OR w.configuration_digest IS DISTINCT FROM o.configuration_digest
  OR w.result_receipt_digest IS DISTINCT FROM p_reference->>'resultReceiptDigest'
  OR w.result_event_id IS DISTINCT FROM (p_reference->>'resultEventId')::uuid
  OR w.completed_at IS NULL OR w.result_receipt IS NULL OR w.completed_at<o.completed_at
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OPS_PROVIDER_PROBE_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT e FROM control.outbox_event WHERE event_id=w.result_event_id
  AND participant_id=w.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=w.privacy_domain_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM control.mutation_evidence WHERE operation_id=w.operation_id
  AND participant_id=w.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=w.privacy_domain_id;
 IF e.aggregate_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'provider-profile' OR e.aggregate_id IS DISTINCT FROM p.provider_profile_id
  OR e.event_type IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE w.state WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN 'provider-profile.qualified.v1' ELSE 'provider-profile.qualification-failed.v1' END)
  OR e.payload_cbor IS DISTINCT FROM convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(w.result_receipt),'UTF8')
  OR e.payload_digest IS DISTINCT FROM sha256(e.payload_cbor)
  OR 'sha256:'||encode(e.payload_digest,'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM w.result_receipt_digest
  OR a.action_intent_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'ACT-PROVIDER_APPROVE_QUALIFICATION-V1'
  OR a.catalog_operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'CFG-OP-QUALIFY-PROVIDER-PROFILE'
  OR a.aggregate_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'provider-profile'
  OR a.aggregate_id IS DISTINCT FROM p.provider_profile_id OR a.aggregate_version IS DISTINCT FROM o.observed_revision+1
  OR a.evidence_digest IS DISTINCT FROM sha256(a.evidence_cbor)
  OR 'sha256:'||encode(a.evidence_digest,'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM p_reference->>'authorizationEvidenceDigest'
  OR octet_length(a.cose_sign1) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4194304 OR e.cose_sign1 IS DISTINCT FROM a.cose_sign1
  OR octet_length(a.evidence_cbor) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4194304
  OR octet_length(e.payload_cbor) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 4194304
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OPS_PROVIDER_PROBE_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE'; END IF;
 IF w.state='COMPLETED' AND (
  w.result_receipt->>'liveObservationId' IS DISTINCT FROM o.observation_id::text
  OR w.result_receipt->>'liveObservationDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM o.observation_digest
  OR w.result_receipt->'liveObservation' IS DISTINCT FROM o.observation
  OR w.result_receipt->>'artifactDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM o.input_digest
  OR w.result_receipt->>'resourceId' IS DISTINCT FROM p.provider_profile_id::text
  OR w.result_receipt->>'workKind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'PROVIDER_QUALIFICATION'
  OR w.result_receipt->>'consumer' IS DISTINCT FROM 'LS-MULTI-RPC'
  OR jsonb_typeof(w.result_receipt->'artifactCbor') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OPS_PROVIDER_PROBE_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE'; END IF;
 IF w.state='FAILED' AND (w.result_receipt->>'resourceId' IS DISTINCT FROM p.provider_profile_id::text
  OR w.result_receipt->>'workKind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'PROVIDER_QUALIFICATION'
  OR w.result_receipt->'terminal' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
  OR w.result_receipt->>'errorCode' IS DISTINCT FROM w.last_error_code)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OPS_PROVIDER_PROBE_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE'; END IF;
 -- The retained COSE authorizes the original mutation. It is NOT a signature
 -- over this result payload or an operations qualification receipt.
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('reference',p_reference,'participantId',p.participant_id,'privacyDomainId',p.privacy_domain_id,
  'workState',w.state,'sourceRevision',o.source_revision::text,'observedRevision',o.observed_revision::text,
  'validUntilMs',floor(extract(epoch from o.valid_until)*1000)::text,
  'completedAtMs',floor(extract(epoch from w.completed_at)*1000)::text,
  'observation',o.observation,'resultReceipt',w.result_receipt,
  'resultPayloadHex',encode(e.payload_cbor,'hex'),'authorizationEvidenceHex',encode(a.evidence_cbor,'hex'),
  'authorizationCoseHex',encode(a.cose_sign1,'hex'));
EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND OR TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OPS_PROVIDER_PROBE_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE';
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.read_root_expiry_pending_ancestry_readiness(wanted uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE r control.platform_scope_replacement; root control.platform_context; targets jsonb; admins jsonb; bindings jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 PERFORM openpc.assert_runtime_target_disposition_owner();
 IF current_user<>'openpc_control_owner' OR current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true) IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
  OR openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-SCOPE-CONTEXT'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM control.platform_scope_replacement WHERE replacement_id=wanted
  AND participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id() AND privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id();
 SELECT * INTO STRICT root FROM control.platform_context p WHERE p.platform_context_id=r.platform_context_id
  AND p.owner_participant_id=r.participant_id AND p.state='ACTIVE';
 IF (r.state<>'WITHDRAWING' OR r.row_version<>1 OR r.superseded_by IS NOT NULL
  OR num_nonnulls(r.commit_operation_id,r.commit_candidate_id,r.commit_approval_id,r.readiness_digest,r.committed_at)<>0
  OR openpc.root_expiry_pending_ancestry(r.platform_context_id,to_jsonb(r)) IS NULL
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_scope head
    WHERE head.platform_context_id=r.platform_context_id AND head.owner_participant_id=r.participant_id
      AND head.installation_privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND head.platform_authority_epoch=root.authority_epoch
      AND (openpc.business_cbor(head.scope_cbor)->>'4')::numeric<=floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp())*1000000000)))
  IS DISTINCT FROM FALSE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-SCOPE-PREDECESSOR'; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('targetId',q.runtime_target_id::text,'source',q.source,
  'revision',head.revision::text,'deliveryDigest',d.delivery_digest,'acknowledgementDigest',a.acknowledgement_digest,
  'journalSequence',a.claims->>'journal_sequence','ready',coalesce(
    head.binding->>'action'='Withdraw' AND head.binding->'cause'=jsonb_build_object('kind','Dependency','owner','Platform',
      'resource_id',r.replacement_id::text,'operation_id',r.prepare_operation_id::text,'revision',1)
    AND 'sha256:'||(head.binding#>>'{source,capsule_digest}')=q.source->>'capsuleDigest'
    AND head.binding#>>'{source,original_work_id}'=q.source->>'originalWorkId'
    AND head.binding#>>'{source,original_execution_attempt_id}'=q.source->>'originalAttemptId'
    AND d.claims=head.binding||jsonb_build_object('committed_admission_digest',substring(head.admission_digest from 8))
    AND a.claims->>'installed_state'='NewUseDenied' AND a.claims->'target'=head.binding->'target'
    AND a.claims->>'delivery_digest'=substring(d.delivery_digest from 8)
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.credential credential JOIN control.principal principal
      ON principal.participant_id=credential.participant_id AND principal.principal_id=credential.principal_id
      WHERE credential.participant_id=q.participant_id AND credential.credential_id=(head.binding#>>'{target,credential_id}')::uuid
        AND credential.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND credential.state='ACTIVE' AND principal.state='ACTIVE'
        AND credential.principal_id=(head.binding#>>'{target,principal_id}')::uuid
        AND credential.credential_epoch::text=head.binding#>>'{target,credential_epoch}'
        AND principal.authority_epoch::text=head.binding#>>'{target,principal_epoch}'
        AND credential.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND (credential.valid_until IS NULL OR credential.valid_until>clock_timestamp()))
    AND (a.claims->>'disposition_revision')::bigint=head.revision
    AND d.delivery_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(d.signed_delivery),'hex')
    AND a.acknowledgement_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(a.signed_acknowledgement),'hex'),false))
    ORDER BY q.runtime_target_id),'[]') INTO targets
 FROM control.platform_scope_target_withdrawal q
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT h.* FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission h WHERE h.participant_id=q.participant_id
  AND h.privacy_domain_id=q.privacy_domain_id AND h.runtime_target_id=q.runtime_target_id ORDER BY h.revision DESC LIMIT 1) head ON true
 LEFT JOIN control.runtime_target_disposition_delivery d ON d.participant_id=q.participant_id AND d.privacy_domain_id=q.privacy_domain_id
  AND d.runtime_target_id=q.runtime_target_id AND d.revision=head.revision
 LEFT JOIN control.runtime_target_disposition_acknowledgement a ON a.participant_id=q.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=q.privacy_domain_id
  AND a.runtime_target_id=q.runtime_target_id AND a.delivery_digest=d.delivery_digest
 WHERE q.participant_id=r.participant_id AND q.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND q.replacement_id=r.replacement_id;
 IF jsonb_array_length(targets)<>jsonb_array_length(r.candidate->'affectedTargets')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-SCOPE-COHORT'; END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('principalId',plan->>'principalId','envelopeId',plan->>'envelopeId',
  'assignmentId',plan->>'assignmentId','envelopeDigest','sha256:'||encode(e.semantic_digest,'hex'),
  'signatureDigest','sha256:'||encode(sha256(e.cose_sign1),'hex'),'assignmentRevision',a.row_version::text,
  'roleRevision',role.row_version::text,'ready',coalesce(
    e.state='ACTIVE' AND e.representation='TYPED_V1' AND e.platform_context_id=r.platform_context_id
    AND e.platform_authority_epoch=r.predecessor_epoch+1 AND e.maker_checker_required AND e.step_up_required
    AND e.onward_delegation_depth=0 AND cardinality(e.runtime_capability_ids)=0
    AND e.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND e.valid_until>clock_timestamp() AND octet_length(e.cose_sign1)>0
    AND p.state='APPROVED' AND p.row_version=3 AND p.proposal_cbor=e.semantic_cbor
    AND create_intent.state='CONSUMED' AND create_intent.candidate_document->>'platformScopeReplacementId'=r.replacement_id::text
    AND create_intent.candidate_document->'usable'=plan->'usable' AND create_intent.candidate_document->'grantable'=plan->'grantable'
    AND openpc.platform_scope_document_value(openpc.business_cbor(p.proposal_cbor)->'8')=plan->'usable'
    AND openpc.platform_scope_document_value(openpc.business_cbor(p.proposal_cbor)->'9')=plan->'grantable'
    AND activation.state='COMMITTED' AND activation.row_version=4 AND activation.cose_sign1=e.cose_sign1
    AND principal.state='ACTIVE' AND principal.kind IN('USER','PLATFORM_OPERATOR')
    AND role.state='ACTIVE' AND role.row_version::text=plan->>'expectedRoleRevision'
    AND plan->>'roleDigest'='sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(jsonb_build_object(
      'domain','pc.identity.envelope-role-binding.v1','participantId',r.participant_id::text,
      'role',jsonb_build_object('roleId',role.role_id,'version',role.row_version::text,'actions',role.action_intent_ids,
       'origin',role.origin,'createdByPrincipalId',role.created_by_principal_id::text,'creatorParticipantId',role.creator_participant_id::text,
       'bootstrapMandateId',role.bootstrap_mandate_id::text,'bootstrapPlatformParticipantId',role.bootstrap_platform_participant_id::text))),'UTF8')),'hex')
    AND a.state='ACTIVE' AND a.principal_id=principal.principal_id AND a.authority_envelope_id=e.authority_envelope_id
    AND a.role_id=role.role_id AND a.authority_group_id IS NULL AND a.delegation_epoch=e.delegation_epoch
    AND a.valid_during=tstzrange(e.valid_from,e.valid_until,'[)') AND a.valid_during @> clock_timestamp()
    AND a.privacy_domain_ids=e.privacy_domain_ids AND a.action_intent_ids=e.action_intent_ids AND a.resource_ids=e.resource_ids
    AND a.risk_classes=e.risk_classes AND cardinality(a.runtime_capability_ids)=0
    AND a.maker_checker_required AND a.step_up_required AND a.onward_delegation_depth=0,false))
    ORDER BY plan->>'principalId') INTO admins
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.candidate->'administrators') plan
 LEFT JOIN control.authority_envelope e ON e.participant_id=r.participant_id AND e.authority_envelope_id=(plan->>'envelopeId')::uuid
 LEFT JOIN control.identity_envelope_proposal p ON p.participant_id=r.participant_id AND p.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND p.envelope_id=e.authority_envelope_id
 LEFT JOIN control.mutation_candidate create_intent ON create_intent.participant_id=r.participant_id AND create_intent.mutation_candidate_id=p.create_candidate_id
 LEFT JOIN control.identity_envelope_activation activation ON activation.participant_id=r.participant_id AND activation.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id
  AND activation.envelope_id=e.authority_envelope_id AND activation.operation_id=e.last_mutation_operation_id
 LEFT JOIN control.assignment a ON a.participant_id=r.participant_id AND a.assignment_id=(plan->>'assignmentId')::uuid
 LEFT JOIN control.authority_role role ON role.participant_id=r.participant_id AND role.authority_role_id=(plan->>'roleId')::uuid
 LEFT JOIN control.principal principal ON principal.participant_id=r.participant_id AND principal.principal_id=(plan->>'principalId')::uuid;
 bindings:=jsonb_build_object('replacementId',r.replacement_id::text,'platformContextId',r.platform_context_id::text,
  'rootRevision',root.row_version::text,'predecessorEpoch',r.predecessor_epoch::text,'predecessorDigest','sha256:'||encode(r.predecessor_digest,'hex'),
  'successorDigest','sha256:'||encode(r.successor_digest,'hex'),'replacementRevision',r.row_version::text,'state',r.state,
  'targets',targets,'administrators',admins,'sourceExpiresAtNs',openpc.business_cbor(r.successor_scope_cbor)->>'4');
 RETURN bindings||jsonb_build_object('readinessDigest','sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(
  jsonb_build_object('domain','pc.identity.platform-scope-readiness.v1','source',bindings)),'UTF8')),'hex'),
  'unacknowledgedTargets',(SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(targets) t WHERE t->>'ready' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'),
  'unpreparedAdministrators',(SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(admins) a WHERE a->>'ready' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'),
  'nowNs',(floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000)*1000)::text);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.read_root_expiry_pending_ancestry_witness(context_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE r control.platform_scope_replacement; root control.platform_context; current_scope bytea;
 current_digest bytea; evidence_digest bytea; readiness jsonb; effects jsonb; pending_witness jsonb; ancestry jsonb; declared record; historical_pending jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true) IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
  OR openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT root FROM control.platform_context p WHERE p.platform_context_id=context_id
  AND p.owner_participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id() AND p.state='ACTIVE';
 SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM control.platform_scope_replacement p WHERE p.platform_context_id=context_id
  AND openpc.matches_participant(p.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(p.privacy_domain_id) AND p.state='WITHDRAWING';
 SELECT s.scope_cbor,s.admission_digest INTO STRICT current_scope,current_digest FROM (
  SELECT platform_context_id,platform_authority_epoch,scope_cbor,admission_digest FROM control.platform_envelope_scope
  UNION ALL SELECT platform_context_id,platform_authority_epoch,scope_cbor,admission_digest FROM control.platform_envelope_scope_successor
  UNION ALL SELECT platform_context_id,platform_authority_epoch,scope_cbor,admission_digest FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_scope
 ) s WHERE s.platform_context_id=context_id AND s.platform_authority_epoch=r.predecessor_epoch;
 IF r.row_version<>1 OR r.superseded_by IS NOT NULL OR r.commit_operation_id IS NOT NULL
  OR r.predecessor_digest<>current_digest
  OR openpc.root_expiry_pending_ancestry(context_id,to_jsonb(r)) IS NULL
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_scope head
    WHERE head.platform_context_id=context_id AND head.owner_participant_id=r.participant_id
      AND head.installation_privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND head.platform_authority_epoch=root.authority_epoch
      AND (openpc.business_cbor(head.scope_cbor)->>'4')::numeric<=floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp())*1000000000)) OR r.candidate_digest<>sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(r.candidate),'UTF8'))
  OR r.successor_digest<>sha256(r.successor_preimage)
  OR (openpc.business_cbor(current_scope)->>'4')::numeric>floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp())*1000000000)
  OR r.candidate#>'{successorScope,runtime}' IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.platform_scope_document(current_scope)->'runtime'
  OR jsonb_array_length(r.candidate->'administrators')<>2
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.candidate->'administrators') a
    WHERE (a#>>'{usable,validUntilNs}')::numeric>floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp())*1000000000)
      OR (a#>>'{grantable,validUntilNs}')::numeric>floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp())*1000000000))
  OR jsonb_array_length(r.candidate->'affectedTargets')>128 THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 SELECT e.evidence_digest INTO STRICT evidence_digest FROM control.mutation_candidate m
 JOIN control.approval_request a ON a.participant_id=m.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=m.privacy_domain_id
  AND a.approval_request_id=r.prepare_approval_id AND a.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE'
  AND a.subject_id=m.mutation_candidate_id AND a.subject_digest=m.candidate_digest AND a.subject_version=m.expected_revision
  AND a.state='APPROVED' AND a.maker_principal_id=m.maker_principal_id AND a.checker_principal_id<>a.maker_principal_id
 JOIN control.mutation_evidence e ON e.participant_id=m.participant_id AND e.privacy_domain_id=m.privacy_domain_id
  AND e.operation_id=r.prepare_operation_id AND e.catalog_operation_id=m.catalog_operation_id AND e.action_intent_id=m.action_intent_id
  AND e.aggregate_type='platform-scope-replacement' AND e.aggregate_id=r.replacement_id AND e.candidate_digest=m.candidate_digest
  AND e.principal_id=m.maker_principal_id AND e.checker_principal_id=a.checker_principal_id AND e.approval_request_id=a.approval_request_id
  AND e.evidence_digest=sha256(e.evidence_cbor) AND octet_length(e.cose_sign1)>0
  AND e.mfa_challenge_id IS NOT NULL AND e.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest IS NOT NULL
 JOIN control.idempotency_record committed ON committed.participant_id=e.participant_id AND committed.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
  AND committed.operation_id=e.operation_id AND committed.terminal_state='COMMITTED' AND committed.principal_id=e.principal_id
  AND committed.catalog_operation_id=e.catalog_operation_id AND committed.action_intent_id=e.action_intent_id
  AND committed.idempotency_key=m.idempotency_key AND committed.input_digest=m.candidate_digest
  AND committed.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=e.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
  AND committed.result_payload->>'replacementId'=r.replacement_id::text
  AND committed.result_payload->>'successorDigest'='sha256:'||encode(r.successor_digest,'hex')
 WHERE m.participant_id=r.participant_id AND m.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id
  AND m.mutation_candidate_id=r.prepare_candidate_id AND m.candidate_document=r.candidate AND m.candidate_digest=r.candidate_digest
  AND m.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-PLATFORM-SCOPE-PREPARE' AND m.action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
  AND m.resource_id=r.replacement_id AND m.expected_revision=0 AND m.state='CONSUMED' AND m.consumed_operation_id=r.prepare_operation_id
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event event WHERE event.participant_id=e.participant_id AND event.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
    AND event.aggregate_type=e.aggregate_type AND event.aggregate_id=e.aggregate_id AND event.payload_cbor=e.evidence_cbor
    AND event.payload_digest=e.evidence_digest AND event.cose_sign1=e.cose_sign1);
 readiness:=openpc.read_root_expiry_pending_ancestry_readiness(r.replacement_id);
 IF jsonb_array_length(readiness->'targets')<>jsonb_array_length(r.candidate->'affectedTargets')
  OR (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(q.source ORDER BY q.runtime_target_id),'[]') FROM control.platform_scope_target_withdrawal q
    WHERE q.replacement_id=r.replacement_id AND q.participant_id=r.participant_id AND q.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id)
   IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(t ORDER BY t->>'targetId'),'[]') FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.candidate->'affectedTargets') t)
 THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('plan',plan,'envelope',to_jsonb(e),'proposal',to_jsonb(p),
  'candidates',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m) ORDER BY m.mutation_candidate_id),'[]') FROM control.mutation_candidate m
    WHERE m.participant_id=r.participant_id AND m.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND m.resource_id=(plan->>'envelopeId')::uuid),
  'approvals',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.approval_request_id),'[]') FROM control.approval_request a
    JOIN control.mutation_candidate m ON m.participant_id=a.participant_id AND m.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id
      AND m.mutation_candidate_id=a.subject_id AND a.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE'
    WHERE m.participant_id=r.participant_id AND m.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND m.resource_id=(plan->>'envelopeId')::uuid),
  'assignment',to_jsonb(a),'activations',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.operation_id),'[]')
    FROM control.identity_envelope_activation x WHERE x.participant_id=r.participant_id AND x.envelope_id=(plan->>'envelopeId')::uuid))
   ORDER BY plan->>'principalId') INTO effects
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.candidate->'administrators') plan
 LEFT JOIN control.authority_envelope e ON e.participant_id=r.participant_id AND e.authority_envelope_id=(plan->>'envelopeId')::uuid
 LEFT JOIN control.identity_envelope_proposal p ON p.participant_id=r.participant_id AND p.envelope_id=(plan->>'envelopeId')::uuid
 LEFT JOIN control.assignment a ON a.participant_id=r.participant_id AND a.assignment_id=(plan->>'assignmentId')::uuid;
 pending_witness:=jsonb_build_object('schema','pc.identity.local-root-expiry-pending-witness','schemaVersion',1,
  'replacementId',r.replacement_id::text,'replacementRevision',r.row_version::text,'predecessorEpoch',r.predecessor_epoch::text,
  'expectedRootRevision',r.expected_root_revision::text,'predecessorDigest','sha256:'||encode(r.predecessor_digest,'hex'),
  'preparationCandidateId',r.prepare_candidate_id::text,'preparationOperationId',r.prepare_operation_id::text,
  'preparationApprovalId',r.prepare_approval_id::text,'preparationDigest','sha256:'||encode(r.candidate_digest,'hex'),
  'preparationReceiptDigest','sha256:'||encode(evidence_digest,'hex'),'successorDigest','sha256:'||encode(r.successor_digest,'hex'),
  'pendingRecordDigest','sha256:'||encode(openpc.platform_scope_pending_record_digest(r),'hex'),
  'administrationEffectsDigest','sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(effects),'UTF8')),'hex'),
  'affectedTargetCount',jsonb_array_length(r.candidate->'affectedTargets'),'readinessDigest',readiness->>'readinessDigest');
 ancestry:=openpc.root_expiry_pending_ancestry(context_id,to_jsonb(r));
 IF ancestry IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 FOR declared IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(ancestry->'receipts') LOOP
  SELECT intent->'pending' INTO STRICT historical_pending FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_case c
   WHERE c.recovery_id=(declared.value->>'recoveryId')::uuid AND c.participant_id=r.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id;
  IF (historical_pending-ARRAY['administrationEffectsDigest','readinessDigest']) IS DISTINCT FROM
    (pending_witness-ARRAY['administrationEffectsDigest','readinessDigest']) THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('pending',pending_witness,'rootAncestry',ancestry);
EXCEPTION WHEN no_data_found OR too_many_rows OR invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range THEN RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.read_root_expiry_pending_witness(context_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE r control.platform_scope_replacement; root control.platform_context; current_scope bytea;
 current_digest bytea; evidence_digest bytea; readiness jsonb; effects jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true) IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
  OR openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT root FROM control.platform_context p WHERE p.platform_context_id=context_id
  AND p.owner_participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id() AND p.state='ACTIVE';
 SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM control.platform_scope_replacement p WHERE p.platform_context_id=context_id
  AND openpc.matches_participant(p.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(p.privacy_domain_id) AND p.state='WITHDRAWING';
 SELECT s.scope_cbor,s.admission_digest INTO STRICT current_scope,current_digest FROM (
  SELECT platform_context_id,platform_authority_epoch,scope_cbor,admission_digest FROM control.platform_envelope_scope
  UNION ALL SELECT platform_context_id,platform_authority_epoch,scope_cbor,admission_digest FROM control.platform_envelope_scope_successor
  UNION ALL SELECT platform_context_id,platform_authority_epoch,scope_cbor,admission_digest FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_scope
 ) s WHERE s.platform_context_id=context_id AND s.platform_authority_epoch=root.authority_epoch;
 IF r.row_version<>1 OR r.superseded_by IS NOT NULL OR r.commit_operation_id IS NOT NULL
  OR r.predecessor_epoch<>root.authority_epoch OR r.expected_root_revision<>root.row_version
  OR r.predecessor_digest<>current_digest OR r.candidate_digest<>sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(r.candidate),'UTF8'))
  OR r.successor_digest<>sha256(r.successor_preimage)
  OR (openpc.business_cbor(current_scope)->>'4')::numeric>floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp())*1000000000)
  OR r.candidate#>'{successorScope,runtime}' IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.platform_scope_document(current_scope)->'runtime'
  OR jsonb_array_length(r.candidate->'administrators')<>2
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.candidate->'administrators') a
    WHERE (a#>>'{usable,validUntilNs}')::numeric>floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp())*1000000000)
      OR (a#>>'{grantable,validUntilNs}')::numeric>floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp())*1000000000))
  OR jsonb_array_length(r.candidate->'affectedTargets')>128 THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 SELECT e.evidence_digest INTO STRICT evidence_digest FROM control.mutation_candidate m
 JOIN control.approval_request a ON a.participant_id=m.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=m.privacy_domain_id
  AND a.approval_request_id=r.prepare_approval_id AND a.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE'
  AND a.subject_id=m.mutation_candidate_id AND a.subject_digest=m.candidate_digest AND a.subject_version=m.expected_revision
  AND a.state='APPROVED' AND a.maker_principal_id=m.maker_principal_id AND a.checker_principal_id<>a.maker_principal_id
 JOIN control.mutation_evidence e ON e.participant_id=m.participant_id AND e.privacy_domain_id=m.privacy_domain_id
  AND e.operation_id=r.prepare_operation_id AND e.catalog_operation_id=m.catalog_operation_id AND e.action_intent_id=m.action_intent_id
  AND e.aggregate_type='platform-scope-replacement' AND e.aggregate_id=r.replacement_id AND e.candidate_digest=m.candidate_digest
  AND e.principal_id=m.maker_principal_id AND e.checker_principal_id=a.checker_principal_id AND e.approval_request_id=a.approval_request_id
  AND e.evidence_digest=sha256(e.evidence_cbor) AND octet_length(e.cose_sign1)>0
  AND e.mfa_challenge_id IS NOT NULL AND e.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest IS NOT NULL
 JOIN control.idempotency_record committed ON committed.participant_id=e.participant_id AND committed.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
  AND committed.operation_id=e.operation_id AND committed.terminal_state='COMMITTED' AND committed.principal_id=e.principal_id
  AND committed.catalog_operation_id=e.catalog_operation_id AND committed.action_intent_id=e.action_intent_id
  AND committed.idempotency_key=m.idempotency_key AND committed.input_digest=m.candidate_digest
  AND committed.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=e.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
  AND committed.result_payload->>'replacementId'=r.replacement_id::text
  AND committed.result_payload->>'successorDigest'='sha256:'||encode(r.successor_digest,'hex')
 WHERE m.participant_id=r.participant_id AND m.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id
  AND m.mutation_candidate_id=r.prepare_candidate_id AND m.candidate_document=r.candidate AND m.candidate_digest=r.candidate_digest
  AND m.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-PLATFORM-SCOPE-PREPARE' AND m.action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
  AND m.resource_id=r.replacement_id AND m.expected_revision=0 AND m.state='CONSUMED' AND m.consumed_operation_id=r.prepare_operation_id
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event event WHERE event.participant_id=e.participant_id AND event.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
    AND event.aggregate_type=e.aggregate_type AND event.aggregate_id=e.aggregate_id AND event.payload_cbor=e.evidence_cbor
    AND event.payload_digest=e.evidence_digest AND event.cose_sign1=e.cose_sign1);
 readiness:=openpc.read_platform_scope_replacement_readiness(r.replacement_id);
 IF jsonb_array_length(readiness->'targets')<>jsonb_array_length(r.candidate->'affectedTargets')
  OR (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(q.source ORDER BY q.runtime_target_id),'[]') FROM control.platform_scope_target_withdrawal q
    WHERE q.replacement_id=r.replacement_id AND q.participant_id=r.participant_id AND q.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id)
   IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(t ORDER BY t->>'targetId'),'[]') FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.candidate->'affectedTargets') t)
 THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('plan',plan,'envelope',to_jsonb(e),'proposal',to_jsonb(p),
  'candidates',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m) ORDER BY m.mutation_candidate_id),'[]') FROM control.mutation_candidate m
    WHERE m.participant_id=r.participant_id AND m.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND m.resource_id=(plan->>'envelopeId')::uuid),
  'approvals',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.approval_request_id),'[]') FROM control.approval_request a
    JOIN control.mutation_candidate m ON m.participant_id=a.participant_id AND m.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id
      AND m.mutation_candidate_id=a.subject_id AND a.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE'
    WHERE m.participant_id=r.participant_id AND m.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND m.resource_id=(plan->>'envelopeId')::uuid),
  'assignment',to_jsonb(a),'activations',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.operation_id),'[]')
    FROM control.identity_envelope_activation x WHERE x.participant_id=r.participant_id AND x.envelope_id=(plan->>'envelopeId')::uuid))
   ORDER BY plan->>'principalId') INTO effects
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.candidate->'administrators') plan
 LEFT JOIN control.authority_envelope e ON e.participant_id=r.participant_id AND e.authority_envelope_id=(plan->>'envelopeId')::uuid
 LEFT JOIN control.identity_envelope_proposal p ON p.participant_id=r.participant_id AND p.envelope_id=(plan->>'envelopeId')::uuid
 LEFT JOIN control.assignment a ON a.participant_id=r.participant_id AND a.assignment_id=(plan->>'assignmentId')::uuid;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema','pc.identity.local-root-expiry-pending-witness','schemaVersion',1,
  'replacementId',r.replacement_id::text,'replacementRevision',r.row_version::text,'predecessorEpoch',r.predecessor_epoch::text,
  'expectedRootRevision',r.expected_root_revision::text,'predecessorDigest','sha256:'||encode(r.predecessor_digest,'hex'),
  'preparationCandidateId',r.prepare_candidate_id::text,'preparationOperationId',r.prepare_operation_id::text,
  'preparationApprovalId',r.prepare_approval_id::text,'preparationDigest','sha256:'||encode(r.candidate_digest,'hex'),
  'preparationReceiptDigest','sha256:'||encode(evidence_digest,'hex'),'successorDigest','sha256:'||encode(r.successor_digest,'hex'),
  'pendingRecordDigest','sha256:'||encode(openpc.platform_scope_pending_record_digest(r),'hex'),
  'administrationEffectsDigest','sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(effects),'UTF8')),'hex'),
  'affectedTargetCount',jsonb_array_length(r.candidate->'affectedTargets'),'readinessDigest',readiness->>'readinessDigest');
EXCEPTION WHEN no_data_found OR too_many_rows OR invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range THEN RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.read_root_expiry_recovery_source(p_enrollment uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(root_revision numeric, participant_epoch numeric, server_now timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF openpc.root_expiry_recovery_source_current(p_enrollment) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ROOT-EXPIRY-RECOVERY'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT p.row_version,participant.authority_epoch,clock_timestamp()
  FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_enrollment e
  JOIN control.platform_context p ON p.platform_context_id=e.platform_context_id AND p.owner_participant_id=e.participant_id
  JOIN control.participant participant ON participant.participant_id=e.participant_id
  WHERE e.enrollment_id=p_enrollment AND openpc.matches_participant(e.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(e.privacy_domain_id);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.read_workload_credential_continuation_evidence(p_enrollment uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE scope jsonb; approvals uuid[]; decisions jsonb; result jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF current_user<>'openpc_control_owner' OR openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
 THEN RETURN '[]'::jsonb; END IF;
 SELECT source INTO scope FROM jsonb_array_elements(openpc.read_workload_credential_continuation_scope()) source
  WHERE source->>'enrollment_id'=p_enrollment::text;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN '[]'::jsonb; END IF;
 approvals:=openpc.read_workload_credential_continuation_ids(p_enrollment,'APPROVAL');
 SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('principal',decision.approver_principal_id,'signer',decision.signer_credential_id,
  'mfa',decision.mfa_challenge_id,'cbor',encode(decision.evidence_cbor,'hex'),'cose',encode(decision.cose_sign1,'hex'))) INTO decisions
 FROM control.approval_decision_record decision
 WHERE decision.participant_id=(scope->>'participant_id')::uuid AND decision.privacy_domain_id=(scope->>'privacy_domain_id')::uuid
  AND decision.decision='APPROVE' AND decision.approval_request_id=ANY(approvals);
 SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('operation_id',history.operation_id,'aggregate_type',history.aggregate_type,
  'aggregate_id',history.aggregate_id,'evidence_cbor',encode(history.evidence_cbor,'hex'),
  'evidence_digest',encode(history.evidence_digest,'hex'),'cose_sign1',encode(history.cose_sign1,'hex'))) INTO result
 FROM control.mutation_evidence history
 WHERE history.participant_id=(scope->>'participant_id')::uuid AND history.privacy_domain_id=(scope->>'privacy_domain_id')::uuid
  AND ((history.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE' AND history.aggregate_id=(scope->>'workload_credential_id')::uuid)
   OR (history.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WEBAUTHN-VERIFY' AND EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(decisions) decision WHERE decision->>'principal'=history.principal_id::text
     AND decision->>'signer'=history.signer_credential_id::text AND decision->>'mfa'=history.mfa_challenge_id::text
     AND decision->>'cbor'=encode(history.evidence_cbor,'hex') AND decision->>'cose'=encode(history.cose_sign1,'hex'))));
 RETURN coalesce(result,'[]'::jsonb);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.read_workload_credential_continuation_scope()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF current_user<>'openpc_control_owner' OR openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
 THEN RETURN '[]'::jsonb; END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('enrollment_id',enrollment.enrollment_id,
  'participant_id',enrollment.participant_id,'privacy_domain_id',enrollment.privacy_domain_id,
  'document',enrollment.document,'workload_credential_id',source_key.workload_credential_id)) INTO result
 FROM control.identity_envelope_recovery_enrollment enrollment
 JOIN control.business_signing_key source_key ON source_key.participant_id=enrollment.participant_id
  AND source_key.privacy_domain_id=enrollment.privacy_domain_id AND source_key.signing_purpose_code=371
  AND source_key.signer_id=enrollment.document#>>'{request,oldFingerprint}'
  AND source_key.secret_reference=enrollment.document#>>'{request,oldReference}'
  AND 'sha256:'||encode(source_key.trust_digest,'hex')=enrollment.document->>'oldTrustDigest'
 WHERE openpc.matches_participant(enrollment.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(enrollment.privacy_domain_id)
  AND enrollment.state='ACTIVE' AND enrollment.row_version=1
  AND enrollment.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND enrollment.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
  AND openpc.identity_envelope_recovery_source_current(enrollment.enrollment_id);
 RETURN coalesce(result,'[]'::jsonb);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.record_evidence_payload_deletion(payload control.evidence_segment_payload)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE job control.deletion_job%ROWTYPE; plan jsonb;
BEGIN
 -- Only the actual payload BEFORE DELETE trigger can attest this local effect.
 IF pg_trigger_depth()<>1 OR current_setting('openpc.action_intent_id') NOT IN ('ACT-EVIDENCE_DELETIONS_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-EVIDENCE_DELETIONS_CREATE_BATCH-V1')
  OR payload.participant_id<>current_setting('openpc.participant_id')::uuid
  OR payload.privacy_domain_id<>current_setting('openpc.privacy_domain_id')::uuid THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('evidence-lifecycle:'||payload.participant_id::text,0));
 SELECT * INTO STRICT job FROM control.deletion_job WHERE participant_id=payload.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=payload.privacy_domain_id AND operation_id=current_setting('openpc.operation_id')::uuid
  AND state='EXECUTING' AND revision=0 AND segment_id=payload.segment_id AND stream_id=payload.stream_id FOR UPDATE;
 plan:=openpc.evidence_deletion_selection_plan(job.selection);
 IF plan IS NULL OR NOT (plan->>'eligible')::boolean OR plan->'selection' IS DISTINCT FROM job.selection
  OR plan->>'beforeDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM job.before_digest
  OR payload.ciphertext_bytes<>(job.selection->>'ciphertextBytes')::integer
  OR 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(payload.encrypted_segment),'hex')<>job.selection->>'objectDigest'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 INSERT INTO control.evidence_deletion_item(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,deletion_job_id,segment_id,object_digest,ciphertext_bytes)
 VALUES(payload.participant_id,payload.privacy_domain_id,job.deletion_job_id,payload.segment_id,job.selection->>'objectDigest',payload.ciphertext_bytes);
END $function$
c control.evidence_catalogue, data_class text, projection jsonb

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.record_signing_observation(p_attempt uuid, p_kind text)

DECLARE a control.signing_provider_attempt%ROWTYPE; preimage bytea;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM control.signing_provider_attempt WHERE attempt_id=p_attempt
  AND participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id() AND privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id();
 preimage:=openpc.signing_observation_preimage(a,p_kind);
 INSERT INTO control.signing_rotation_observation(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,rotation_id,operation_id,attempt_id,kind,observation_preimage,observation_digest)
 VALUES(a.participant_id,a.privacy_domain_id,a.rotation_id,a.operation_id,a.attempt_id,p_kind,preimage,sha256(preimage))
 ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT signing_observation_material_uq DO NOTHING;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT o.observation_id,o.observation_digest FROM control.signing_rotation_observation o
 WHERE o.participant_id=a.participant_id AND o.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND o.attempt_id=a.attempt_id
  AND o.observation_digest=sha256(preimage);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.remote_archive_covers(pid uuid, privacy uuid, stream text, segment uuid, sink text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.evidence_remote_archive_intent i
  JOIN control.evidence_remote_archive_attempt a USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,intent_id)
  JOIN control.evidence_archive_receipt r USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,attempt_id)
  JOIN control.evidence_archive_outbox o USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,receipt_id)
  WHERE i.participant_id=pid AND i.privacy_domain_id=privacy
   AND i.stream_id=stream AND i.segment_id=segment AND i.sink_id=sink
   AND a.state='OBSERVED' AND a.binding->'protection'->'rules'=openpc.remote_archive_rules(pid,privacy,stream,segment)
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.evidence_remote_archive_attempt newer
    WHERE newer.participant_id=i.participant_id AND newer.privacy_domain_id=i.privacy_domain_id
     AND newer.intent_id=i.intent_id AND (newer.binding->'protection'->>'revision')::numeric>(a.binding->'protection'->>'revision')::numeric))
$function$

 LANGUAGE sql

  'releaseOperationId',h.release_operation_id::text,'state',h.state,'revision',h.revision::text)

 FROM control.retention_hold h WHERE h.participant_id=pid
