CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.require_explorer_profile_evidence()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE
 operation uuid; catalog text; action text; expected_event_type text; expected bigint;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
  operation:=NEW.publication_operation_id; catalog:='CFG-OP-CREATE-EXPLORER-PROFILE';
  action:='ACT-PRIVACY_EXPLORER_PROFILES_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1'; expected_event_type:='openpc.privacy-explorer.profile.registered.v1'; expected:=0;
 ELSE
  operation:=NEW.revocation_operation_id; catalog:='CFG-OP-REVOKE-EXPLORER-PROFILE';
  action:='ACT-PRIVACY_EXPLORER_PROFILES_REVOKE_RESOURCE-V1'; expected_event_type:='openpc.privacy-explorer.profile.revoked.v1'; expected:=OLD.revision;
 END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_evidence evidence
  JOIN control.idempotency_record receipt ON receipt.participant_id=evidence.participant_id
   AND receipt.privacy_domain_id=evidence.privacy_domain_id AND receipt.operation_id=evidence.operation_id
   AND receipt.catalog_operation_id=evidence.catalog_operation_id AND receipt.input_digest=evidence.candidate_digest
  JOIN control.mutation_candidate candidate ON candidate.participant_id=evidence.participant_id
   AND candidate.privacy_domain_id=evidence.privacy_domain_id AND candidate.consumed_operation_id=evidence.operation_id
   AND candidate.catalog_operation_id=evidence.catalog_operation_id AND candidate.candidate_digest=evidence.candidate_digest
  WHERE evidence.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND evidence.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
   AND evidence.operation_id=operation AND evidence.aggregate_type='privacy-explorer-profile'
   AND evidence.aggregate_id=NEW.registration_id AND evidence.catalog_operation_id=catalog AND evidence.action_intent_id=action
   AND candidate.resource_id=NEW.registration_id AND candidate.state='CONSUMED' AND candidate.expected_revision=expected
   AND (TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR (candidate.candidate_document->'profile'=NEW.profile
    AND NEW.publication_authority_digest='sha256:'||encode(evidence.evidence_digest,'hex')))
   AND receipt.terminal_state='COMMITTED' AND receipt.result_payload->>'resourceRef'='urn:openpc:resource:'||NEW.registration_id::text
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event event WHERE event.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
    AND event.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND event.aggregate_id=NEW.registration_id
    AND event.aggregate_type='privacy-explorer-profile' AND event.event_type=expected_event_type)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0002-EXPLORER-PROFILE-PROVENANCE';
 END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.require_first_admin_handoff()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.state='ACCEPTED' AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM control.participant participant
  JOIN control.principal principal ON principal.participant_id=participant.participant_id AND principal.principal_id=NEW.accepted_membership_id AND principal.state='ACTIVE'
  JOIN control.participant_membership member ON member.participant_id=principal.participant_id AND member.membership_id=principal.principal_id
  JOIN control.assignment assignment ON assignment.participant_id=participant.participant_id AND assignment.principal_id=principal.principal_id
    AND assignment.bootstrap_mandate_id=NEW.mandate_id AND assignment.state='ACTIVE' AND assignment.last_mutation_operation_id=NEW.accepted_operation_id
  JOIN control.authority_envelope envelope ON envelope.participant_id=assignment.participant_id AND envelope.authority_envelope_id=assignment.authority_envelope_id
    AND envelope.state='ACTIVE' AND envelope.bootstrap_mandate_id=NEW.mandate_id AND envelope.last_mutation_operation_id=NEW.accepted_operation_id
  JOIN control.mutation_evidence evidence ON evidence.participant_id=participant.participant_id AND evidence.operation_id=NEW.accepted_operation_id
    AND evidence.principal_id=NEW.accepted_membership_id AND evidence.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-PARTICIPANT-FIRST-ADMIN-ACCEPT'
    AND evidence.candidate_digest=NEW.accepted_intent_digest
  JOIN control.outbox_event event ON event.participant_id=participant.participant_id AND event.aggregate_id=participant.participant_id
    AND event.event_type='openpc.identity.first-administrator.accepted.v1' AND event.payload_digest=evidence.evidence_digest
  WHERE participant.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND participant.state='ACTIVE' AND participant.authority_epoch=NEW.participant_epoch+1
    AND NEW.acceptance_result IS NOT NULL AND NEW.closed_at IS NOT NULL
 ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0002'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.require_generated_cigl_grant()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.origin<>'GENERATED' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 IF NEW.status='ACTIVE' THEN
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.cigl_method_grant_dependency_claims claim
    JOIN control.cigl_profile_dependency_path path ON path.profile_id=claim.profile_id AND path.profile_revision=claim.profile_revision AND path.ordinal=claim.ordinal
    JOIN control.mutation_candidate candidate ON candidate.participant_id=claim.participant_id AND candidate.privacy_domain_id=claim.privacy_domain_id
     AND candidate.resource_id=claim.source_grant_id AND candidate.consumed_operation_id=claim.publication_operation_id AND candidate.state='CONSUMED'
     AND candidate.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-UPDATE-CIGL-GRANT'
    WHERE claim.required_grant_id=NEW.grant_id AND claim.state='ACTIVE'
     AND claim.publication_operation_id=NEW.publication_operation_id AND claim.source_grant_id=NEW.generated_by_grant_id
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(candidate.candidate_document->'dependencyBundle'->'dependencies') item
       WHERE item->'grant'='{"kind":"GENERATE"}'::jsonb AND item->>'actionDigest'='sha256:'||(path.document->>'actionDigest'))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0002-CIGL-GENERATED-UNOWNED'; END IF;
 ELSE
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.cigl_method_grant_dependency_claims WHERE required_grant_id=NEW.grant_id AND state='ACTIVE')
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.cigl_method_grant_dependency_claims WHERE required_grant_id=NEW.grant_id AND released_operation_id=NEW.publication_operation_id)
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_evidence WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
     AND operation_id=NEW.publication_operation_id AND catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-UPDATE-CIGL-GRANT') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0002-CIGL-GENERATED-RELEASE'; END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.require_identity_envelope_proposal()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE original_mode text; original_participant uuid; original_privacy uuid;
 operation uuid; action text;
	 p control.identity_envelope_proposal%ROWTYPE; envelope control.authority_envelope%ROWTYPE;
	 valid_source boolean; activation_cose bytea;
BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='authority_envelope' THEN
  -- Recovery provenance is enforced by guard_platform_recovery_envelope and
  -- its immutable signed case bindings. It has no ordinary typed issuer or
  -- proposal sidecar; typed envelopes must retain the checks below.
  IF NEW.representation IN ('LEGACY','RECOVERY_V1') THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 END IF;
 -- Legacy initialization has no typed governance context. Typed rows still
 -- require every ordinary context field before any scoped lookup or switch.
 original_mode:=current_setting('openpc.context_mode');
 original_participant:=openpc.current_participant_id(); original_privacy:=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id();
 operation:=openpc.current_operation_id(); action:=openpc.current_action_intent_id();
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='authority_envelope' THEN
  -- Resolve only the envelope's immutable original issuer; no tenant OR-policy.
  PERFORM openpc.set_request_context('PARTICIPANT',NEW.issuer_participant_id,NEW.issuer_privacy_domain_id,operation,action,true);
  SELECT * INTO p FROM control.identity_envelope_proposal WHERE participant_id=NEW.issuer_participant_id
    AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.issuer_privacy_domain_id AND envelope_id=NEW.authority_envelope_id;
 ELSE
  PERFORM openpc.set_request_context('PARTICIPANT',NEW.participant_id,NEW.privacy_domain_id,operation,action,true);
  SELECT * INTO p FROM control.identity_envelope_proposal WHERE participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND envelope_id=NEW.envelope_id;
 END IF;
 IF p.envelope_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-SIDECAR'; END IF;
 PERFORM openpc.set_request_context('PARTICIPANT',p.participant_id,p.privacy_domain_id,operation,action,true);
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_candidate candidate
   JOIN control.mutation_evidence evidence ON evidence.participant_id=candidate.participant_id AND evidence.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id
     AND evidence.operation_id=candidate.consumed_operation_id AND evidence.candidate_digest=candidate.candidate_digest
     AND evidence.principal_id=p.maker_principal_id AND evidence.approval_request_id=p.create_approval_id
   JOIN control.idempotency_record receipt ON receipt.participant_id=candidate.participant_id AND receipt.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id
     AND receipt.operation_id=candidate.consumed_operation_id AND receipt.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
     AND receipt.result_payload->>'id'=p.envelope_id::text
     AND receipt.result_payload->>'semanticDigest'='sha256:'||encode(p.proposal_digest,'hex')
   WHERE candidate.participant_id=p.participant_id AND candidate.privacy_domain_id=p.privacy_domain_id
     AND candidate.mutation_candidate_id=p.create_candidate_id AND candidate.consumed_operation_id=p.create_operation_id
     AND candidate.state='CONSUMED' AND candidate.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-ENVELOPE-CREATE'
     AND candidate.resource_id=p.envelope_id AND candidate.maker_principal_id=p.maker_principal_id
     AND candidate.candidate_document->>'schema'='pc.identity.authority-envelope-proposal'
     AND candidate.candidate_document->>'envelopeId'=p.envelope_id::text
     AND candidate.candidate_document->>'participantId'=p.target_participant_id::text
     AND candidate.maker_session_id::text=p.issuer_authority#>>'{binding,sessionId}'
     AND candidate.maker_session_epoch::text=p.issuer_authority#>>'{binding,sessionEpoch}'
     AND candidate.maker_participant_epoch::text=p.issuer_authority#>>'{binding,participantEpoch}'
     AND candidate.maker_principal_epoch::text=p.issuer_authority#>>'{binding,principalEpoch}'
     AND candidate.maker_assignment_id::text=p.issuer_authority#>>'{binding,assignmentId}'
     AND candidate.maker_assignment_row_version::text=p.issuer_authority#>>'{binding,assignmentVersion}'
     AND candidate.maker_authority_envelope_id::text=p.issuer_authority#>>'{binding,authorityEnvelopeId}'
     AND candidate.maker_authority_epoch::text=p.issuer_authority#>>'{binding,authorityEpoch}'
     AND candidate.maker_delegation_epoch::text=p.issuer_authority#>>'{binding,delegationEpoch}') INTO valid_source;
 IF NOT coalesce(valid_source,false) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-CREATE-PROVENANCE'; END IF;
 IF p.state<>'DRAFT' THEN
  SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.approval_request request
    JOIN control.idempotency_record receipt ON receipt.participant_id=request.participant_id AND receipt.privacy_domain_id=request.privacy_domain_id
      AND receipt.operation_id=p.submission_operation_id AND receipt.input_digest=p.submission_intent_digest
      AND receipt.action_intent_id='ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1' AND receipt.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
      AND receipt.principal_id=p.maker_principal_id AND receipt.result_payload->>'resourceRef'='urn:openpc:resource:'||request.approval_request_id::text
    JOIN control.mfa_challenge challenge ON challenge.participant_id=request.participant_id AND challenge.principal_id=p.maker_principal_id
      AND challenge.mfa_challenge_id=(p.submission_maker->>'stepUpChallengeId')::uuid
      AND challenge.session_id=(p.submission_maker#>>'{authority,sessionId}')::uuid
      AND challenge.action_intent_id='ACT-APPROVAL_REQUESTS_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1' AND challenge.resource_digest=p.submission_intent_digest
      AND challenge.resource_id=p.envelope_id::text
      AND challenge.used_operation_id=p.submission_operation_id AND challenge.used_at IS NOT NULL
      AND challenge.used_at>=challenge.consumed_at AND challenge.used_at<challenge.expires_at
      AND challenge.used_at<challenge.consumed_at+interval '5 minutes'
    JOIN control.mutation_evidence verification ON verification.participant_id=challenge.participant_id
      AND verification.privacy_domain_id=p.privacy_domain_id AND verification.principal_id=p.maker_principal_id
      AND verification.mfa_challenge_id=challenge.mfa_challenge_id AND verification.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WEBAUTHN-VERIFY'
      AND verification.evidence_digest=decode(substr(p.submission_maker->>'stepUpEvidenceDigest',8),'hex')
      AND verification.signer_credential_id=(p.submission_maker->>'signerCredentialId')::uuid
      AND challenge.signer_credential_id=verification.signer_credential_id
      AND challenge.signer_credential_epoch::text=p.submission_maker->>'signerCredentialEpoch'
    WHERE request.participant_id=p.participant_id AND request.privacy_domain_id=p.privacy_domain_id
      AND request.approval_request_id=p.submission_approval_id AND request.subject_type='AUTHORITY_ENVELOPE'
      AND request.subject_id=p.envelope_id AND request.subject_digest=p.proposal_digest AND request.subject_version=1
      AND request.action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1' AND request.maker_principal_id=p.maker_principal_id
      AND p.submission_maker->'authority'=p.issuer_authority->'binding'
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event event WHERE event.participant_id=p.participant_id AND event.privacy_domain_id=p.privacy_domain_id
        AND event.aggregate_type='authority-envelope' AND event.aggregate_id=p.envelope_id
        AND event.event_type='openpc.identity.authority-envelope.submitted.v1' AND event.payload_digest=verification.evidence_digest
        AND event.payload_cbor=verification.evidence_cbor AND event.cose_sign1=verification.cose_sign1)
      AND ((p.state='SUBMITTED' AND request.state='OPEN') OR (p.state='APPROVED' AND request.state='APPROVED'))) INTO valid_source;
  IF NOT coalesce(valid_source,false) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-SUBMISSION-PROVENANCE'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF p.state='APPROVED' THEN
  SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.approval_decision_record decision
    JOIN control.mfa_challenge challenge ON challenge.participant_id=decision.participant_id AND challenge.mfa_challenge_id=decision.mfa_challenge_id
      AND challenge.principal_id=decision.approver_principal_id AND challenge.action_intent_id='ACT-POLICY_APPROVE_REQUEST-V1'
      AND challenge.session_id=decision.approver_session_id
      AND challenge.resource_digest=decision.decision_digest AND challenge.used_at IS NOT NULL
      AND challenge.resource_id=decision.approval_request_id::text
      AND challenge.signer_credential_id=decision.signer_credential_id
      AND challenge.signer_credential_epoch=decision.signer_credential_epoch
      AND challenge.used_at>=challenge.consumed_at AND challenge.used_at<challenge.expires_at
      AND challenge.used_at<challenge.consumed_at+interval '5 minutes'
    JOIN control.mutation_evidence verification ON verification.participant_id=decision.participant_id
      AND verification.privacy_domain_id=decision.privacy_domain_id AND verification.principal_id=decision.approver_principal_id
      AND verification.mfa_challenge_id=challenge.mfa_challenge_id AND verification.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WEBAUTHN-VERIFY'
      AND verification.bound_participant_epoch=decision.approver_participant_epoch
      AND verification.bound_principal_epoch=decision.approver_principal_epoch
      AND verification.signer_credential_id=decision.signer_credential_id
      AND verification.evidence_cbor=decision.evidence_cbor AND verification.cose_sign1=decision.cose_sign1
    WHERE decision.participant_id=p.participant_id AND decision.privacy_domain_id=p.privacy_domain_id
      AND decision.approval_request_id=p.submission_approval_id AND decision.decision='APPROVE'
      AND decision.candidate_digest=p.proposal_digest AND decision.aggregate_version=1
      AND decision.approver_principal_id<>p.maker_principal_id
      AND decision.approver_principal_id::text=p.submission_checker#>>'{authority,principalId}'
      AND decision.participant_id::text=p.submission_checker#>>'{authority,participantId}'
      AND decision.approver_participant_epoch::text=p.submission_checker#>>'{authority,participantEpoch}'
      AND decision.approver_principal_epoch::text=p.submission_checker#>>'{authority,principalEpoch}'
      AND decision.approver_session_id::text=p.submission_checker#>>'{authority,sessionId}'
      AND decision.approver_session_epoch::text=p.submission_checker#>>'{authority,sessionEpoch}'
      AND decision.approver_assignment_id::text=p.submission_checker#>>'{authority,assignmentId}'
      AND decision.approver_assignment_row_version::text=p.submission_checker#>>'{authority,assignmentVersion}'
      AND decision.approver_authority_envelope_id::text=p.submission_checker#>>'{authority,authorityEnvelopeId}'
      AND decision.approver_envelope_epoch::text=p.submission_checker#>>'{authority,authorityEpoch}'
      AND decision.approver_delegation_epoch::text=p.submission_checker#>>'{authority,delegationEpoch}'
      AND p.submission_checker_authority->'binding'=p.submission_checker->'authority'
      AND p.submission_checker_authority#>'{durable,grant}' @> jsonb_build_object(
        'principalId',decision.approver_principal_id::text,'participantEpoch',decision.approver_participant_epoch::text,
        'principalEpoch',decision.approver_principal_epoch::text,'assignmentId',decision.approver_assignment_id::text,
        'assignmentRowVersion',decision.approver_assignment_row_version::text,'authorityEnvelopeId',decision.approver_authority_envelope_id::text,
        'authorityEpoch',decision.approver_envelope_epoch::text,'delegationEpoch',decision.approver_delegation_epoch::text,
        'privacyDomainId',p.privacy_domain_id::text,'actionIntentId','ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1','resourceId',p.envelope_id::text)
      AND decision.mfa_challenge_id::text=p.submission_checker->>'stepUpChallengeId'
      AND decision.mfa_challenge_id::text<>p.submission_maker->>'stepUpChallengeId'
      AND decision.signer_credential_id::text=p.submission_checker->>'signerCredentialId'
      AND decision.signer_credential_epoch::text=p.submission_checker->>'signerCredentialEpoch'
      AND sha256(decision.evidence_cbor)=decode(substr(p.submission_checker->>'stepUpEvidenceDigest',8),'hex')
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event event WHERE event.participant_id=p.participant_id AND event.privacy_domain_id=p.privacy_domain_id
        AND event.aggregate_type='authority-envelope' AND event.aggregate_id=p.envelope_id
        AND event.event_type='openpc.identity.authority-envelope.approved.v1' AND event.payload_digest=sha256(decision.evidence_cbor)
        AND event.payload_cbor=decision.evidence_cbor AND event.cose_sign1=decision.cose_sign1)) INTO valid_source;
	  IF NOT coalesce(valid_source,false) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-APPROVAL-PROVENANCE'; END IF;
	 END IF;
	 IF p.state='APPROVED' THEN
	  SELECT activation.cose_sign1 INTO activation_cose
	    FROM control.identity_envelope_activation activation
	   WHERE activation.participant_id=p.participant_id AND activation.privacy_domain_id=p.privacy_domain_id
	     AND activation.envelope_id=p.envelope_id AND activation.operation_id=operation
	     AND activation.state='COMMITTED' AND activation.row_version=4;
	 END IF;
	 PERFORM openpc.set_request_context('PARTICIPANT',p.target_participant_id,NULL,operation,action,false);
 SELECT * INTO envelope FROM control.authority_envelope WHERE participant_id=p.target_participant_id AND authority_envelope_id=p.envelope_id;
 IF envelope.representation IS DISTINCT FROM 'TYPED_V1' OR envelope.issuer_participant_id IS DISTINCT FROM p.participant_id
   OR envelope.issuer_privacy_domain_id IS DISTINCT FROM p.privacy_domain_id
	 OR envelope.maker_principal_id IS DISTINCT FROM p.maker_principal_id OR envelope.semantic_cbor IS DISTINCT FROM p.proposal_cbor
	 OR envelope.semantic_digest IS DISTINCT FROM p.proposal_digest
	 OR NOT (
	   (envelope.state::text=p.state AND envelope.row_version=p.row_version)
	   OR (p.state='APPROVED' AND envelope.state='ACTIVE' AND envelope.row_version=p.row_version+1
	     AND octet_length(envelope.cose_sign1)>0
	     AND activation_cose=envelope.cose_sign1)
	 )
	 OR (p.state='APPROVED' AND envelope.checker_principal_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM p.submission_checker#>>'{authority,principalId}')
   THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-TARGET-BINDING'; END IF;
 PERFORM openpc.set_request_context(original_mode,original_participant,original_privacy,operation,action,original_privacy IS NOT NULL);
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.require_invitation_acceptance_evidence()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_evidence evidence
   JOIN control.participant_invitation invitation ON invitation.invitation_id=NEW.invitation_id
   JOIN control.outbox_event event ON event.participant_id=evidence.participant_id AND event.privacy_domain_id=evidence.privacy_domain_id
    AND event.aggregate_type='invitation-redemption' AND event.aggregate_id=NEW.invitation_id
    AND event.event_type='openpc.identity.invitation.accepted.v1'
    AND event.payload_cbor=NEW.evidence_cbor AND event.payload_digest=NEW.evidence_digest AND event.cose_sign1=NEW.cose_sign1
   WHERE evidence.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND evidence.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
    AND evidence.operation_id=NEW.operation_id AND evidence.principal_id=NEW.membership_id
    AND evidence.action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANT_CREATE_MEMBER-V1' AND evidence.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-INVITATION-ACCEPT'
    AND evidence.aggregate_type='invitation-redemption' AND evidence.aggregate_id=NEW.invitation_id
    AND evidence.aggregate_version=invitation.row_version-CASE WHEN invitation.bootstrap_mandate_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    AND evidence.candidate_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(NEW.result),'UTF8'))
    AND evidence.evidence_role='IDENTITY_PROOF_INPUT' AND evidence.evidence_format='IDENTITY_RUNTIME_ASSERTION_3002_2_13'
    AND evidence.evidence_cbor=NEW.evidence_cbor AND evidence.evidence_digest=NEW.evidence_digest AND evidence.cose_sign1=NEW.cose_sign1) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0002';
 END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.require_invitation_current_token()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM control.participant_invitation invitation
   JOIN control.participant_invitation_token token
    ON token.participant_id=invitation.participant_id AND token.privacy_domain_id=invitation.privacy_domain_id
     AND token.invitation_id=invitation.invitation_id AND token.token_version=invitation.token_version
     AND token.expires_at=invitation.expires_at
   WHERE invitation.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND invitation.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
    AND invitation.invitation_id=NEW.invitation_id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-IDENTITY-1002-INVITATION-CURRENT-TOKEN';
 END IF;
 IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM control.participant_invitation invitation WHERE invitation.invitation_id=NEW.invitation_id AND invitation.state='ACCEPTED'
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM control.participant_invitation_acceptance acceptance
    WHERE acceptance.participant_id=invitation.participant_id AND acceptance.privacy_domain_id=invitation.privacy_domain_id
      AND acceptance.invitation_id=invitation.invitation_id AND acceptance.token_version=invitation.token_version
      AND (acceptance.operation_id=invitation.last_mutation_operation_id OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM control.participant_bootstrap_custody custody WHERE custody.participant_id=invitation.participant_id
          AND custody.invitation_id=invitation.invitation_id AND custody.mandate_id=invitation.bootstrap_mandate_id
          AND custody.state='ACCEPTED' AND custody.accepted_membership_id=acceptance.membership_id
          AND custody.accepted_operation_id=invitation.last_mutation_operation_id)))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0002';
 END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.require_native_value_issuance()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE document jsonb:=convert_from(NEW.document_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_evidence evidence
  JOIN control.idempotency_record receipt ON receipt.participant_id=evidence.participant_id
   AND receipt.privacy_domain_id=evidence.privacy_domain_id AND receipt.operation_id=evidence.operation_id
   AND receipt.catalog_operation_id=evidence.catalog_operation_id AND receipt.input_digest=evidence.candidate_digest
  JOIN control.mutation_candidate candidate ON candidate.participant_id=evidence.participant_id
   AND candidate.privacy_domain_id=evidence.privacy_domain_id AND candidate.consumed_operation_id=evidence.operation_id
   AND candidate.catalog_operation_id=evidence.catalog_operation_id AND candidate.candidate_digest=evidence.candidate_digest
  JOIN control.wallet_binding wallet ON wallet.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND wallet.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
   AND wallet.wallet_binding_id=NEW.wallet_binding_id AND wallet.binding_epoch=NEW.wallet_binding_epoch
   AND wallet.subject_id=NEW.actor_principal_id AND wallet.state='ACTIVE' AND wallet.chain_id::text=document->>'chainId'
  JOIN control.participant participant ON participant.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
   AND participant.authority_epoch=(document->>'participantEpoch')::numeric
  WHERE evidence.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND evidence.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
   AND evidence.operation_id=NEW.creation_operation_id AND evidence.aggregate_type='native-value-authorization'
   AND evidence.aggregate_id=NEW.native_value_authorization_id AND evidence.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-CREATE-NATIVE-VALUE-AUTHORIZATION'
   AND evidence.action_intent_id='ACT-NATIVE_VALUE_AUTHORIZATIONS_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1'
   AND NEW.creation_authority_digest='sha256:'||encode(evidence.evidence_digest,'hex')
   AND candidate.resource_id=NEW.native_value_authorization_id AND candidate.state='CONSUMED' AND candidate.expected_revision=0
   AND ((NEW.execution_workload_id IS NULL AND candidate.maker_principal_id=NEW.actor_principal_id)
    OR (NEW.execution_workload_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM control.principal principal JOIN control.credential credential USING(participant_id,principal_id)
     WHERE principal.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND principal.principal_id=NEW.actor_principal_id
      AND principal.kind='WORKLOAD' AND principal.state='ACTIVE' AND credential.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS'
      AND credential.audience=NEW.execution_workload_id AND credential.state='ACTIVE'
      AND credential.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND credential.valid_until>clock_timestamp())
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.principal other JOIN control.credential credential USING(participant_id,principal_id)
      WHERE other.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND other.principal_id<>NEW.actor_principal_id
       AND other.kind='WORKLOAD' AND other.state='ACTIVE' AND credential.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS'
       AND credential.audience=NEW.execution_workload_id AND credential.state='ACTIVE'
       AND credential.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND credential.valid_until>clock_timestamp())))
   AND candidate.candidate_document->>'walletBindingId'='urn:openpc:resource:'||NEW.wallet_binding_id::text
   AND (candidate.candidate_document->>'executionWorkloadId') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.execution_workload_id
   AND candidate.candidate_document->>'chainId'=document->>'chainId'
   AND concat(candidate.candidate_document->>'chainId',':',candidate.candidate_document->>'networkId',':',candidate.candidate_document->>'genesisDigest')=document->>'chainEnvironmentId'
   AND candidate.candidate_document->>'genesisDigest'='sha256:'||(document->>'genesisHash')
   AND candidate.candidate_document->>'amountMode'=document->>'amountMode'
   AND candidate.candidate_document->>'maxAmountWei'=document->>'maxAmountWei'
   AND candidate.candidate_document->>'validUntil'=document->>'validUntil'
   AND receipt.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
   AND receipt.result_payload->>'resourceRef'='urn:openpc:resource:'||NEW.native_value_authorization_id::text
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event event WHERE event.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
    AND event.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND event.aggregate_id=NEW.native_value_authorization_id
    AND event.aggregate_type='native-value-authorization' AND event.event_type='openpc.native-value.authorization.issued.v1')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0002-NATIVE-VALUE-PROVENANCE';
 END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.require_notification_completion_disposition_authority(event uuid, phase text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE original jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_notification_completion_admission_owner();
 SELECT a.proof INTO STRICT original FROM control.notification_completion_phase_admission a
 WHERE a.database_role=session_user AND a.transaction_id=pg_current_xact_id()::text AND a.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid()
  AND a.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id() AND a.privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
  AND a.event_id=event AND a.phase=$2;
 PERFORM openpc.check_notification_completion_phase_proof(original);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.require_platform_scope_replacement_provenance()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE r control.platform_scope_replacement; phase text; operation uuid; candidate uuid; approval uuid; valid boolean;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM control.platform_scope_replacement WHERE replacement_id=NEW.replacement_id;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND NEW.state='SUPERSEDED' THEN
  -- Deferred: both rows and the successor's ordinary PREPARE provenance must
  -- commit together. The old intent, approvals and target evidence stay intact.
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_scope_replacement successor
    WHERE successor.replacement_id=r.superseded_by AND successor.participant_id=r.participant_id
      AND successor.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND successor.platform_context_id=r.platform_context_id
      AND ((successor.predecessor_epoch=r.predecessor_epoch AND successor.expected_root_revision=r.expected_root_revision
        AND successor.predecessor_digest=r.predecessor_digest)
        OR openpc.platform_scope_pending_root_bridge_current(r,successor.predecessor_epoch,successor.expected_root_revision,successor.predecessor_digest))
      AND successor.prepare_operation_id=openpc.current_operation_id()
      AND successor.candidate->'supersedes'=jsonb_build_object('replacementId',r.replacement_id::text,
        'expectedRevision','1','successorDigest','sha256:'||encode(r.successor_digest,'hex')))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-SCOPE-SUPERSESSION-PROVENANCE'; END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
 END IF;
 phase:=CASE WHEN TG_OP='INSERT' THEN 'PREPARE' ELSE 'COMMIT' END;
 operation:=CASE WHEN phase='PREPARE' THEN r.prepare_operation_id ELSE r.commit_operation_id END;
 candidate:=CASE WHEN phase='PREPARE' THEN r.prepare_candidate_id ELSE r.commit_candidate_id END;
 approval:=CASE WHEN phase='PREPARE' THEN r.prepare_approval_id ELSE r.commit_approval_id END;
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_candidate c
  JOIN control.approval_request a ON a.participant_id=c.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
    AND a.approval_request_id=approval AND a.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE'
    AND a.subject_id=c.mutation_candidate_id AND a.subject_digest=c.candidate_digest
    AND a.subject_version=c.expected_revision AND a.state='APPROVED'
  JOIN control.mutation_evidence e ON e.participant_id=c.participant_id AND e.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
    AND e.operation_id=operation AND e.catalog_operation_id=c.catalog_operation_id
    AND e.aggregate_type='platform-scope-replacement' AND e.aggregate_id=r.replacement_id
    AND e.candidate_digest=c.candidate_digest AND e.approval_request_id=approval
    AND e.principal_id=c.maker_principal_id AND e.checker_principal_id<>e.principal_id
    AND e.mfa_challenge_id IS NOT NULL AND e.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest IS NOT NULL
  JOIN control.idempotency_record receipt ON receipt.participant_id=c.participant_id AND receipt.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
    AND receipt.operation_id=operation AND receipt.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
    AND receipt.result_payload->>'replacementId'=r.replacement_id::text
    AND receipt.result_payload->>'successorDigest'='sha256:'||encode(r.successor_digest,'hex')
  WHERE c.participant_id=r.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id
    AND c.mutation_candidate_id=candidate AND c.consumed_operation_id=operation AND c.state='CONSUMED'
    AND c.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-PLATFORM-SCOPE-'||phase AND c.action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
    AND c.resource_id=r.replacement_id AND c.expected_revision=CASE WHEN phase='PREPARE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    AND ((phase='PREPARE' AND c.candidate_document=r.candidate AND c.candidate_digest=r.candidate_digest)
      OR (phase='COMMIT' AND c.candidate_document->>'readinessDigest'='sha256:'||encode(r.readiness_digest,'hex')
        AND c.candidate_document->>'successorDigest'='sha256:'||encode(r.successor_digest,'hex')
        AND c.candidate_document->>'predecessorEpoch'=r.predecessor_epoch::text
        AND c.candidate_document->>'expectedRootRevision'=r.expected_root_revision::text))) INTO valid;
 IF NOT coalesce(valid,false) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-SCOPE-PROVENANCE'; END IF;
 IF phase='PREPARE' AND (
  (SELECT count(*) FROM control.platform_scope_target_withdrawal q WHERE q.replacement_id=r.replacement_id
    AND q.participant_id=r.participant_id AND q.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id)<>jsonb_array_length(r.candidate->'affectedTargets')
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_scope_target_withdrawal q WHERE q.replacement_id=r.replacement_id
    AND NOT (r.candidate->'affectedTargets' @> jsonb_build_array(q.source))))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-SCOPE-COHORT'; END IF;
 IF phase='COMMIT' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_context p
    JOIN control.platform_envelope_scope_successor s ON s.platform_context_id=p.platform_context_id
      AND s.platform_authority_epoch=p.authority_epoch AND s.replacement_id=r.replacement_id
    WHERE p.platform_context_id=r.platform_context_id AND p.owner_participant_id=r.participant_id AND p.state='ACTIVE'
      AND p.authority_epoch=r.predecessor_epoch+1 AND p.row_version=r.expected_root_revision+1)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-PLATFORM-SCOPE-EFFECT'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$
p_environment text, p_generation uuid, p_input text, p_receipt text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.require_retention_policy_command()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE operation uuid; approval uuid; catalog text; action text; expected numeric;
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
  operation:=NEW.activation_operation_id;approval:=NEW.approval_request_id;catalog:='CFG-OP-ACTIVATE-RETENTION-POLICY';
  action:='ACT-RETENTION_POLICIES_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1';expected:=0;
 ELSE
  operation:=NEW.retirement_operation_id;approval:=NEW.retirement_approval_request_id;catalog:='CFG-OP-RETIRE-RETENTION-POLICY';
  action:='ACT-RETENTION_POLICIES_RETIRE_RESOURCE-V1';expected:=1;
 END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_evidence e JOIN control.mutation_candidate c
  ON c.participant_id=e.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
   AND c.resource_id=e.aggregate_id AND c.consumed_operation_id=e.operation_id AND c.candidate_digest=e.candidate_digest
  JOIN control.audit_occurrence receipt ON receipt.participant_id=e.participant_id AND receipt.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
   AND receipt.operation_id=e.operation_id AND receipt.aggregate_id=e.aggregate_id AND receipt.aggregate_type='retention-policy'
  WHERE e.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND e.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND e.operation_id=operation
   AND e.approval_request_id=approval AND e.aggregate_type='retention-policy' AND e.aggregate_id=NEW.retention_policy_id
   AND e.catalog_operation_id=catalog AND e.action_intent_id=action
   AND c.catalog_operation_id=catalog AND c.action_intent_id=action AND c.state='CONSUMED' AND c.expected_revision=expected
   AND (TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR (c.candidate_document->'policy'=openpc.retention_policy_definition(NEW)
    AND c.candidate_document->'predecessorPolicyId'=coalesce(to_jsonb('urn:openpc:resource:'||NEW.predecessor_policy_id::text),'null'::jsonb)))
   AND receipt.catalog_operation_id=catalog AND receipt.action_intent_id=action
   AND receipt.before_existence=CASE WHEN TG_OP='INSERT' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
   AND receipt.before_revision=expected AND receipt.after_existence=1 AND receipt.after_revision=NEW.revision
   AND openpc.business_cbor(receipt.before_state_preimage)->8=CASE WHEN TG_OP='INSERT' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE openpc.retention_policy_state_projection(OLD) END
   AND openpc.business_cbor(receipt.after_state_preimage)->8=openpc.retention_policy_state_projection(NEW)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event event WHERE event.participant_id=receipt.participant_id
    AND event.privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND event.receipt_id=receipt.receipt_id
    AND event.aggregate_type=receipt.aggregate_type AND event.aggregate_id=receipt.aggregate_id
    AND event.event_type='io.openpc.control.command.committed.v1' AND event.proof_kind='BUSINESS_RECEIPT_REFERENCE'
    AND event.sequence_namespace='CONTROL_BUSINESS_TRANSITION_V1' AND event.payload_digest=sha256(event.payload_cbor)))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0002-RETENTION-SIGNED-TRANSITION'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.require_runtime_target_profile_binding()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_evidence evidence
  JOIN control.idempotency_record receipt ON receipt.participant_id=evidence.participant_id
   AND receipt.privacy_domain_id=evidence.privacy_domain_id AND receipt.operation_id=evidence.operation_id
   AND receipt.catalog_operation_id=evidence.catalog_operation_id AND receipt.input_digest=evidence.candidate_digest
  JOIN control.mutation_candidate candidate ON candidate.participant_id=evidence.participant_id
   AND candidate.privacy_domain_id=evidence.privacy_domain_id AND candidate.consumed_operation_id=evidence.operation_id
   AND candidate.catalog_operation_id=evidence.catalog_operation_id AND candidate.candidate_digest=evidence.candidate_digest
  WHERE evidence.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND evidence.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
   AND evidence.operation_id=NEW.publication_operation_id AND evidence.aggregate_id=NEW.binding_id
   AND evidence.aggregate_type='runtime-target-profile-binding' AND evidence.aggregate_version=1
   AND evidence.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-CREATE-RUNTIME-TARGET-PROFILE'
   AND evidence.action_intent_id='ACT-RUNTIME_TARGET_PROFILES_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1'
   AND NEW.publication_authority_digest='sha256:'||encode(evidence.evidence_digest,'hex')
   AND candidate.resource_id=NEW.binding_id AND candidate.state='CONSUMED' AND candidate.expected_revision=0
   AND candidate.action_intent_id=evidence.action_intent_id AND receipt.action_intent_id=evidence.action_intent_id
   AND receipt.expected_aggregate_version=0 AND receipt.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
   AND candidate.candidate_document->>'runtimeTargetRef'='urn:openpc:resource:'||NEW.runtime_target_id::text
   AND candidate.candidate_document->>'targetRevision'=NEW.target_revision::text
   AND candidate.candidate_document->>'targetProfileId'=NEW.target_profile_id
   AND receipt.result_payload->>'resourceRef'='urn:openpc:resource:'||NEW.binding_id::text
   AND receipt.result_payload->>'revision'='1'
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.approval_request approval
    WHERE approval.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND approval.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
     AND approval.subject_id=candidate.mutation_candidate_id AND approval.subject_digest=candidate.candidate_digest
     AND approval.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE' AND approval.state='APPROVED'
     AND approval.maker_principal_id<>approval.checker_principal_id)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event event WHERE event.participant_id=NEW.participant_id
    AND event.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND event.aggregate_id=NEW.binding_id
    AND event.aggregate_type='runtime-target-profile-binding' AND event.aggregate_sequence=1
    AND event.event_type='openpc.runtime-target.profile-bound.v1'
    AND convert_from(event.payload_cbor,'UTF8')::jsonb->>'authorizationEvidenceDigest'=NEW.publication_authority_digest
    AND convert_from(event.payload_cbor,'UTF8')::jsonb->>'candidateDigest'='sha256:'||encode(candidate.candidate_digest,'hex')))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-RUNTIME-PROFILE-PROVENANCE'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.require_store_retirement_command()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE matched integer;
BEGIN
 SELECT count(*) INTO matched FROM control.mutation_evidence e JOIN control.mutation_candidate c
  ON c.participant_id=e.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
   AND c.resource_id=e.aggregate_id AND c.consumed_operation_id=e.operation_id AND c.candidate_digest=e.candidate_digest
  JOIN control.audit_occurrence receipt ON receipt.participant_id=e.participant_id AND receipt.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
   AND receipt.operation_id=e.operation_id AND receipt.aggregate_id=e.aggregate_id AND receipt.aggregate_type='store-retirement'
  JOIN control.idempotency_record i ON i.participant_id=e.participant_id AND i.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
   AND i.operation_id=e.operation_id AND i.catalog_operation_id=e.catalog_operation_id AND i.input_digest=e.candidate_digest
 WHERE e.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND e.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id AND e.operation_id=NEW.operation_id
  AND e.approval_request_id=NEW.approval_request_id AND e.aggregate_type='store-retirement' AND e.aggregate_id=NEW.attempt_id
  AND e.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-ADMIT-STORE-RETIREMENT' AND e.action_intent_id='ACT-EVIDENCE_DELETIONS_ADMIT_STORE_BATCH-V1'
  AND c.catalog_operation_id=e.catalog_operation_id AND c.action_intent_id=e.action_intent_id AND c.state='CONSUMED' AND c.expected_revision=0
  AND c.candidate_document->'sourceBinding'=NEW.source_binding AND c.candidate_document->>'hostDigest'=NEW.host_digest
  AND c.candidate_document->>'retentionPolicyId'='urn:openpc:resource:'||NEW.retention_policy_id::text
  AND c.candidate_document->'previousAttemptId'=coalesce(to_jsonb('urn:openpc:resource:'||NEW.previous_attempt_id::text),'null'::jsonb)
  AND i.terminal_state='COMMITTED' AND i.expected_aggregate_version=0
  AND receipt.profile_id='pc.control.store-retirement.admit' AND receipt.catalog_operation_id=e.catalog_operation_id
  AND receipt.action_intent_id=e.action_intent_id AND receipt.before_existence=0 AND receipt.before_revision=0
  AND receipt.after_existence=1 AND receipt.after_revision=1
  AND openpc.business_cbor(receipt.before_state_preimage)->8='{}'::jsonb
  AND openpc.business_cbor(receipt.after_state_preimage)->8=openpc.store_retirement_state_projection(NEW)
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM control.outbox_event event WHERE event.participant_id=receipt.participant_id
    AND event.privacy_domain_id=receipt.privacy_domain_id AND event.receipt_id=receipt.receipt_id
    AND event.aggregate_type=receipt.aggregate_type AND event.aggregate_id=receipt.aggregate_id
    AND event.event_type='io.openpc.control.command.committed.v1' AND event.proof_kind='BUSINESS_RECEIPT_REFERENCE'
    AND event.sequence_namespace='CONTROL_BUSINESS_TRANSITION_V1' AND event.payload_digest=sha256(event.payload_cbor))=1;
 IF matched<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0002-STORE-RETIREMENT-SIGNED-ADMISSION'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.require_wallet_binding_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
AS $function$
DECLARE mutation text:=CASE WHEN TG_OP='INSERT' THEN 'CREATE' ELSE 'REVOKE' END;
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.mutation_evidence evidence
  JOIN control.idempotency_record receipt ON receipt.participant_id=evidence.participant_id
   AND receipt.privacy_domain_id=evidence.privacy_domain_id AND receipt.operation_id=evidence.operation_id
   AND receipt.catalog_operation_id=evidence.catalog_operation_id AND receipt.input_digest=evidence.candidate_digest
  JOIN control.mutation_candidate candidate ON candidate.participant_id=evidence.participant_id
   AND candidate.privacy_domain_id=evidence.privacy_domain_id AND candidate.consumed_operation_id=evidence.operation_id
   AND candidate.catalog_operation_id=evidence.catalog_operation_id AND candidate.candidate_digest=evidence.candidate_digest
  WHERE evidence.participant_id=NEW.participant_id AND evidence.privacy_domain_id=NEW.privacy_domain_id
   AND evidence.operation_id=NEW.last_operation_id AND evidence.aggregate_type='wallet-binding'
   AND evidence.aggregate_id=NEW.wallet_binding_id AND evidence.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WALLET-BINDING-'||mutation
   AND evidence.action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
   AND candidate.resource_id=NEW.wallet_binding_id AND candidate.state='CONSUMED'
   AND candidate.expected_revision=NEW.row_version-1
   AND candidate.candidate_document->>'walletBindingId'=NEW.wallet_binding_id::text
   AND (CASE WHEN mutation='CREATE' THEN
    candidate.candidate_document->>'participantId'=NEW.participant_id::text
    AND candidate.candidate_document->>'subjectId'=NEW.subject_id::text
    AND candidate.candidate_document->>'chainId'=NEW.chain_id::text
    AND candidate.candidate_document->>'walletAddress'=NEW.wallet_address
    ELSE candidate.candidate_document->>'state'='REVOKED' END)
   AND receipt.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
   AND receipt.result_payload->>'walletBindingId'=NEW.wallet_binding_id::text
   AND receipt.result_payload->>'participantId'=NEW.participant_id::text
   AND receipt.result_payload->>'privacyDomainId'=NEW.privacy_domain_id::text
   AND receipt.result_payload->>'subjectId'=NEW.subject_id::text
   AND receipt.result_payload->>'chainId'=NEW.chain_id::text
   AND receipt.result_payload->>'walletAddress'=NEW.wallet_address
   AND receipt.result_payload->>'operationId'=NEW.last_operation_id::text
   AND receipt.result_payload->>'state'=NEW.state
   AND receipt.result_payload->>'bindingEpoch'=NEW.binding_epoch::text
   AND receipt.result_payload->>'revision'=NEW.row_version::text
   AND receipt.result_payload->>'permissionEffect'='NONE_WITHOUT_EFFECTIVE_AUTHORITY') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0002-WALLET-BINDING-PROVENANCE';
 END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$
