CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.retention_policy_receipt_hold_metadata(source control.evidence_catalogue)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF (source).evidence_class<>'BUSINESS_TRANSITION' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  -- A retention policy governs a class and references only its own policy,
  -- approval and operation identities. It does not name a Fact, projection,
  -- block or runtime generation. This statement is specific to these two
  -- admitted profiles; other business families retain UNKNOWN lineage.
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.evidence_record e
   JOIN control.audit_occurrence a ON a.participant_id=e.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
    AND a.receipt_id=e.receipt_id AND a.receipt_digest=e.receipt_digest
   JOIN control.idempotency_record i ON i.participant_id=a.participant_id AND i.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id
    AND i.idempotency_record_id=a.idempotency_record_id AND i.operation_id=a.operation_id
   JOIN control.retention_policy p ON p.participant_id=a.participant_id AND p.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id
    AND p.retention_policy_id=a.aggregate_id
   WHERE e.participant_id=(source).participant_id AND e.privacy_domain_id=(source).privacy_domain_id
    AND e.evidence_record_id::text=(source).record_id AND e.evidence_role='BUSINESS_TRANSITION_RECEIPT'
    AND e.custody='CONTROL_STORE' AND e.evidence_format=(source).source_format
    AND (source).receipt_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(a.cose_sign1),'hex')
    AND a.receipt_digest=sha256(a.receipt_cbor)
    AND floor(a.recorded_at_ns/1000)=extract(epoch FROM (source).occurred_at)*1000000
    AND a.aggregate_type='retention-policy' AND a.profile_version=1
    AND ((a.profile_id='pc.control.retention-policy.activate' AND a.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-ACTIVATE-RETENTION-POLICY'
      AND a.action_intent_id='ACT-RETENTION_POLICIES_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1' AND a.operation_id=p.activation_operation_id)
     OR (a.profile_id='pc.control.retention-policy.retire' AND a.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-RETIRE-RETENTION-POLICY'
      AND a.action_intent_id='ACT-RETENTION_POLICIES_RETIRE_RESOURCE-V1' AND a.operation_id=p.retirement_operation_id))
    AND i.terminal_state='COMMITTED' AND i.input_digest=a.candidate_digest
    AND i.action_intent_id=a.action_intent_id AND i.catalog_operation_id=a.catalog_operation_id
    AND sha256(a.before_state_preimage)=a.before_state_digest AND sha256(a.after_state_preimage)=a.after_state_digest
    AND sha256(a.authority_snapshot)=a.pre_commit_authority_digest) THEN
   RETURN jsonb_build_object('projections','[]'::jsonb,'facts','[]'::jsonb,'blocks','[]'::jsonb,
    'generations',jsonb_build_object('RUNTIME_CONFIGURATION','[]'::jsonb,'CANONICAL_FACT','[]'::jsonb));
  END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege OR no_data_found OR too_many_rows THEN RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.retention_policy_state_projection(rule control.retention_policy)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('0',openpc.business_bytes(decode(substring((rule).policy_digest from 8),'hex')),
  '1',CASE WHEN (rule).predecessor_policy_id IS NULL THEN openpc.business_bytes(''::bytea) ELSE openpc.business_uuid((rule).predecessor_policy_id) END,
  '2',openpc.business_uuid((rule).approval_request_id),'3',openpc.business_uuid((rule).activation_operation_id),
  '4',CASE WHEN (rule).retirement_approval_request_id IS NULL THEN openpc.business_bytes(''::bytea) ELSE openpc.business_uuid((rule).retirement_approval_request_id) END,
  '5',CASE WHEN (rule).retirement_operation_id IS NULL THEN openpc.business_bytes(''::bytea) ELSE openpc.business_uuid((rule).retirement_operation_id) END,
  '6',floor(extract(epoch from (rule).active_from)*1000000)*1000,
  '7',CASE WHEN (rule).active_until IS NULL THEN openpc.business_bytes(''::bytea) ELSE to_jsonb(floor(extract(epoch from (rule).active_until)*1000000)*1000) END)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.revoke_identity_envelope_recovery_trust()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE step control.identity_envelope_rotation_step; old_key control.business_signing_key; prior control.business_signing_key_state;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT step FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_step s WHERE s.operation_id=openpc.current_operation_id()
 AND s.from_revision=7 AND s.from_state='OBSERVING' AND s.to_state='OLD_REVOKED' AND s.state='COMMITTED';
 IF openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1' OR NOT openpc.identity_envelope_rotation_step_current(step)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_key_rotation r WHERE r.participant_id=step.participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=step.privacy_domain_id
 AND r.rotation_id=step.rotation_id AND r.recovery_case_id=step.recovery_id AND r.state='OLD_REVOKED' AND r.revision=8 AND r.old_signer_id=step.result->>'predecessorSignerId')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ROTATION-REVOCATION'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT old_key FROM control.business_signing_key WHERE participant_id=step.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=step.privacy_domain_id
 AND signer_id=step.result->>'predecessorSignerId' AND signing_purpose_code=371;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT prior FROM control.business_signing_key_state WHERE participant_id=old_key.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=old_key.privacy_domain_id AND signer_id=old_key.signer_id FOR UPDATE;
 IF prior.state<>'ACTIVE' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_attempt a WHERE a.operation_id=step.operation_id AND a.slot='old'
 AND a.participant_id=step.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=step.privacy_domain_id AND a.rotation_id=step.rotation_id AND a.state='OBSERVED'
 AND a.request->>'method'='REVOKE' AND a.request->>'reference'=old_key.secret_reference AND a.request->>'expectedFingerprint'=old_key.signer_id
 AND a.observation=a.first_observation AND a.observation->>'outcome'='SUCCEEDED' AND a.observation#>>'{descriptor,state}'='REVOKED'
 AND a.observation#>>'{descriptor,fingerprint}'=old_key.signer_id AND a.observation#>>'{descriptor,publicKeySpkiHex}'=encode(old_key.public_key_spki_der,'hex')
 AND a.observation#>>'{descriptor,revokedAtNs}'=step.result->>'oldPrivateKeyRevokedAtNs')
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_step consumer WHERE consumer.operation_id=step.consumer_observation_operation_id
 AND consumer.participant_id=step.participant_id AND consumer.privacy_domain_id=step.privacy_domain_id AND consumer.rotation_id=step.rotation_id
 AND consumer.recovery_id=step.recovery_id AND consumer.state='COMMITTED' AND consumer.from_revision=6 AND consumer.to_state='OBSERVING'
 AND consumer.authority_binding=step.authority_binding AND consumer.authority_digest=step.authority_digest
 AND consumer.result->>'consumerActivationOperationId'=step.result->>'consumerActivationOperationId'
 AND consumer.result->>'consumerReceiptDigest'=step.result->>'consumerReceiptDigest')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ROTATION-REVOCATION'; END IF;
 UPDATE control.business_signing_key_state SET state='REVOKED',row_version=prior.row_version+1,
 changed_at_ns=floor(extract(epoch from step.completed_at)*1000000)*1000,change_reference='urn:openpc:resource:'||step.rotation_id::text,change_digest=step.evidence_digest
 WHERE participant_id=old_key.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=old_key.privacy_domain_id AND signer_id=old_key.signer_id AND state='ACTIVE' AND row_version=prior.row_version;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ROTATION-REVOCATION'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.identity_envelope_rotation_step consumer
 JOIN control.signing_key_rotation r ON r.participant_id=consumer.participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=consumer.privacy_domain_id AND r.rotation_id=consumer.rotation_id AND r.recovery_case_id=consumer.recovery_id
 JOIN control.identity_envelope_signing_selection selection ON selection.participant_id=r.participant_id AND selection.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND selection.environment_id=r.environment_id AND selection.signer_id=r.new_signer_id
 JOIN control.business_signing_key next ON next.participant_id=selection.participant_id AND next.privacy_domain_id=selection.privacy_domain_id AND next.signer_id=selection.signer_id
 JOIN control.identity_envelope_signing_grant next_grant ON next_grant.participant_id=next.participant_id AND next_grant.privacy_domain_id=next.privacy_domain_id AND next_grant.signer_id=next.signer_id AND next_grant.profile_digest=selection.profile_digest AND next_grant.signing_purpose_code=371
 JOIN control.business_signing_key_state next_life ON next_life.participant_id=next.participant_id AND next_life.privacy_domain_id=next.privacy_domain_id AND next_life.signer_id=next.signer_id
 JOIN control.business_signing_key old_key ON old_key.participant_id=r.participant_id AND old_key.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND old_key.signer_id=r.old_signer_id
 JOIN control.business_signing_key_state old_life ON old_life.participant_id=old_key.participant_id AND old_life.privacy_domain_id=old_key.privacy_domain_id AND old_life.signer_id=old_key.signer_id
 JOIN control.identity_envelope_activation a ON a.participant_id=consumer.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=consumer.privacy_domain_id AND a.operation_id=consumer.consumer_activation_operation_id
 WHERE consumer.operation_id=step.consumer_observation_operation_id AND consumer.participant_id=step.participant_id AND consumer.privacy_domain_id=step.privacy_domain_id
 AND consumer.rotation_id=step.rotation_id AND consumer.recovery_id=step.recovery_id AND consumer.principal_id=step.principal_id
 AND consumer.from_revision=6 AND consumer.from_state='CUTOVER_FENCED' AND consumer.to_state='OBSERVING' AND consumer.state='COMMITTED'
 AND consumer.authority_binding=step.authority_binding AND consumer.authority_digest=step.authority_digest
 AND consumer.evidence_digest=sha256(consumer.evidence_cbor) AND octet_length(consumer.cose_sign1)>0
 AND a.state='COMMITTED' AND a.row_version=4 AND a.payload_digest=sha256(a.payload_cbor)
 AND a.operation_id::text=consumer.result->>'consumerActivationOperationId' AND a.envelope_id::text=consumer.result->>'consumerEnvelopeId'
 AND 'sha256:'||encode(a.payload_digest,'hex')=consumer.result->>'consumerPayloadDigest'
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.business_signing_grant ordinary WHERE ordinary.participant_id=next.participant_id AND ordinary.privacy_domain_id=next.privacy_domain_id AND ordinary.signer_id IN(next.signer_id,old_key.signer_id))
 AND next_life.state='ACTIVE' AND next.signing_purpose_code=371 AND old_key.signing_purpose_code=371
 AND selection.profile_digest=decode('54d85c86019a4475f8207f375fa571565e9e6e0adb5b0bd55abc03e4beb81f74','hex')
 AND selection.admission_version=(step.authority_binding#>>'{lease,selectionAdmissionVersion}')::numeric+1
 AND selection.admission_version::text=consumer.result->>'selectionAdmissionVersion'
 AND 'sha256:'||encode(next.trust_digest,'hex')=consumer.result->>'trustDigest' AND next.signer_id=consumer.result->>'signerId'
 AND old_key.trust_digest=decode(substr(step.authority_binding#>>'{lease,oldTrustDigest}',8),'hex')
 AND old_life.state=(CASE WHEN step.from_state='OBSERVING' AND false THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'REVOKED' END)
 AND (step.result IS NULL OR (step.result->>'consumerObservationOperationId'=consumer.operation_id::text
 AND step.result->>'consumerActivationOperationId'=consumer.result->>'consumerActivationOperationId'
 AND step.result->>'consumerEnvelopeId'=consumer.result->>'consumerEnvelopeId' AND step.result->>'consumerPayloadDigest'=consumer.result->>'consumerPayloadDigest'
 AND step.result->>'consumerReceiptDigest'=consumer.result->>'consumerReceiptDigest' AND step.result->>'signerId'=consumer.result->>'signerId'
 AND step.result->>'trustDigest'=consumer.result->>'trustDigest' AND step.result->>'selectionAdmissionVersion'=consumer.result->>'selectionAdmissionVersion'
 AND step.result->>'predecessorSignerId'=old_key.signer_id AND step.result->>'permissionEffect'='NONE'))) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005-ENVELOPE-ROTATION-REVOCATION'; END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('signerId',old_key.signer_id,'operationId',step.operation_id,'state','REVOKED');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.root_expiry_pending_ancestry(context_id uuid, p_pending jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE pending control.platform_scope_replacement; root control.platform_context;
 scope control.root_expiry_recovery_scope; completed control.root_expiry_recovery_case;
 custody control.root_expiry_recovery_enrollment; trust control.root_expiry_recovery_trust;
 cursor_epoch numeric; cursor_revision numeric; cursor_digest bytea; previous_scope bytea; previous_digest bytea;
 installation record; link_row record; receipts jsonb:='[]'; visited uuid[]:=ARRAY[]::uuid[]; depth integer:=0; declared record; prefix jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true) IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
  OR openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
  OR p_pending IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_pending)<>'object' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 pending:=jsonb_populate_record(NULL::control.platform_scope_replacement,p_pending);
 IF to_jsonb(pending) IS DISTINCT FROM p_pending OR NOT openpc.matches_participant(pending.participant_id)
  OR NOT openpc.matches_privacy(pending.privacy_domain_id) OR pending.platform_context_id<>context_id
  OR pending.state<>'WITHDRAWING' OR pending.row_version<>1 OR pending.superseded_by IS NOT NULL
  OR num_nonnulls(pending.commit_operation_id,pending.commit_candidate_id,pending.commit_approval_id,pending.readiness_digest,pending.committed_at)<>0
  OR pending.candidate_digest<>sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(pending.candidate),'UTF8'))
  OR pending.successor_digest<>sha256(pending.successor_preimage) THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_scope_replacement actual WHERE actual.replacement_id=pending.replacement_id
  AND actual.participant_id=pending.participant_id AND actual.privacy_domain_id=pending.privacy_domain_id AND to_jsonb(actual)=p_pending)
 THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT root FROM control.platform_context p WHERE p.platform_context_id=context_id
  AND p.owner_participant_id=pending.participant_id AND p.state='ACTIVE';
 IF root.authority_epoch-pending.predecessor_epoch NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 32
  OR root.row_version-pending.expected_root_revision<>root.authority_epoch-pending.predecessor_epoch THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 SELECT i.installation_digest,i.environment_id INTO STRICT installation FROM control.operations_installation i
  WHERE i.participant_id=pending.participant_id AND i.privacy_domain_id=pending.privacy_domain_id AND i.state='ACTIVE'
   AND i.installation#>>'{pins,profile}' IN ('local','development','test')
   AND i.installation_bytes=convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(i.installation),'UTF8')
   AND i.installation_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(i.installation_bytes),'hex')
   AND openpc.operations_source_authentication_valid(i.installation);
 SELECT s.admission_digest INTO STRICT cursor_digest FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_scope s
  WHERE s.platform_context_id=context_id AND s.owner_participant_id=pending.participant_id
   AND s.installation_privacy_domain_id=pending.privacy_domain_id AND s.platform_authority_epoch=root.authority_epoch;
 cursor_epoch:=root.authority_epoch;cursor_revision:=root.row_version;
 WHILE cursor_epoch>pending.predecessor_epoch LOOP
  depth:=depth+1;IF depth>32 THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  SELECT s AS scope,c AS completed,e AS custody,t AS trust INTO STRICT link_row FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_scope s
   JOIN control.root_expiry_recovery_case c ON c.recovery_id=s.recovery_id AND c.participant_id=s.owner_participant_id
    AND c.privacy_domain_id=s.installation_privacy_domain_id AND c.operation_id=s.activation_operation_id
    AND c.enrollment_digest=s.enrollment_digest AND c.intent_digest=s.intent_digest
   JOIN control.root_expiry_recovery_enrollment e ON e.enrollment_id=c.enrollment_id AND e.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND e.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND e.document_digest=c.enrollment_digest AND e.row_version=c.enrollment_revision
   JOIN control.root_expiry_recovery_trust t ON t.custody_trust_id=e.custody_trust_id AND t.participant_id=e.participant_id
    AND t.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id AND t.document_digest=e.custody_trust_digest
   WHERE s.platform_context_id=context_id AND s.owner_participant_id=pending.participant_id
    AND s.installation_privacy_domain_id=pending.privacy_domain_id AND s.platform_authority_epoch=cursor_epoch;
  scope:=link_row.scope;completed:=link_row.completed;custody:=link_row.custody;trust:=link_row.trust;
  IF (completed.state<>'COMPLETED' OR scope.admission_digest<>cursor_digest OR scope.admission_digest<>sha256(scope.admission_preimage)
   OR scope.predecessor_epoch<>cursor_epoch-1 OR scope.environment_id<>installation.environment_id OR scope.installation_digest<>installation.installation_digest
   OR custody.state<>'ACTIVE' OR custody.row_version<>1 OR trust.state<>'ACTIVE' OR trust.row_version<>1
   OR custody.platform_context_id<>context_id OR trust.platform_context_id<>context_id
   OR custody.document_digest<>sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(custody.document),'UTF8'))
   OR trust.document_digest<>sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(trust.document),'UTF8'))
   OR completed.intent_digest<>sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(completed.intent),'UTF8'))
   OR completed.evidence_digest<>sha256(completed.evidence_cbor) OR octet_length(completed.evidence_cose)=0
   OR octet_length(custody.signature)<>64 OR custody.document->>'schemaVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM completed.intent->>'schemaVersion'
   OR custody.document->>'schemaVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM trust.document->>'schemaVersion'
   OR custody.document->>'purpose' IS DISTINCT FROM trust.document->>'purpose'
   OR custody.document->'pending' IS DISTINCT FROM trust.document->'pending'
   OR custody.document->'pending' IS DISTINCT FROM completed.intent->'pending'
   OR custody.document->>'rootEpoch' IS DISTINCT FROM scope.predecessor_epoch::text
   OR custody.document->>'rootRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM (cursor_revision-1)::text
   OR custody.document->>'rootDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(scope.predecessor_digest,'hex')
   OR completed.intent->>'predecessorEpoch' IS DISTINCT FROM custody.document->>'rootEpoch'
   OR completed.intent->>'predecessorRevision' IS DISTINCT FROM custody.document->>'rootRevision'
   OR completed.intent->>'predecessorDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM custody.document->>'rootDigest'
   OR completed.intent->'successorScope' IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.platform_scope_document(scope.scope_cbor)
   OR custody.document->>'installationDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM installation.installation_digest
   OR custody.document->>'installationEnvironmentId' IS DISTINCT FROM installation.environment_id
   OR completed.result IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('rootEpoch',cursor_epoch::text,'rootRevision',cursor_revision::text,
    'rootDigest','sha256:'||encode(scope.admission_digest,'hex'),'operationId',completed.operation_id::text)
   OR custody.document#>>'{pending,replacementId}' IS DISTINCT FROM pending.replacement_id::text
   OR custody.document#>>'{pending,replacementRevision}' IS DISTINCT FROM pending.row_version::text
   OR custody.document#>>'{pending,predecessorEpoch}' IS DISTINCT FROM pending.predecessor_epoch::text
   OR custody.document#>>'{pending,expectedRootRevision}' IS DISTINCT FROM pending.expected_root_revision::text
   OR custody.document#>>'{pending,predecessorDigest}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(pending.predecessor_digest,'hex')
   OR custody.document#>>'{pending,preparationCandidateId}' IS DISTINCT FROM pending.prepare_candidate_id::text
   OR custody.document#>>'{pending,preparationOperationId}' IS DISTINCT FROM pending.prepare_operation_id::text
   OR custody.document#>>'{pending,preparationApprovalId}' IS DISTINCT FROM pending.prepare_approval_id::text
   OR custody.document#>>'{pending,preparationDigest}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(pending.candidate_digest,'hex')
   OR custody.document#>>'{pending,successorDigest}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(pending.successor_digest,'hex')
   OR custody.document#>>'{pending,pendingRecordDigest}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(openpc.platform_scope_pending_record_digest(pending),'hex')
   OR (custody.document#>>'{pending,affectedTargetCount}')::integer<>jsonb_array_length(pending.candidate->'affectedTargets')
   OR completed.recovery_id=completed.operation_id OR completed.recovery_id=custody.enrollment_id OR completed.operation_id=custody.enrollment_id
   OR completed.recovery_id=ANY(visited) OR completed.operation_id=ANY(visited) OR custody.enrollment_id=ANY(visited)) IS DISTINCT FROM FALSE
   THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  IF cursor_epoch=pending.predecessor_epoch+1 THEN
   IF custody.document->>'schemaVersion'<>'2' OR custody.document->>'purpose'<>'pc.installation.local-root-expiry-pending-recovery-custody.v2'
    OR completed.intent->>'purpose'<>'LOCAL_ROOT_EXPIRY_PENDING_RECOVERY_ONLY' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  ELSE
   IF custody.document->>'schemaVersion'<>'3' OR custody.document->>'purpose'<>'pc.installation.local-root-expiry-pending-ancestry-custody.v3'
    OR completed.intent->>'purpose'<>'LOCAL_ROOT_EXPIRY_PENDING_ANCESTRY_RECOVERY_ONLY'
    OR custody.document->'rootAncestry' IS DISTINCT FROM trust.document->'rootAncestry'
    OR custody.document->'rootAncestry' IS DISTINCT FROM completed.intent->'rootAncestry' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  END IF;
  SELECT s.scope_cbor,s.admission_digest INTO STRICT previous_scope,previous_digest FROM (
   SELECT platform_context_id,owner_participant_id,installation_privacy_domain_id,platform_authority_epoch,scope_cbor,admission_digest FROM control.platform_envelope_scope
   UNION ALL SELECT platform_context_id,owner_participant_id,installation_privacy_domain_id,platform_authority_epoch,scope_cbor,admission_digest FROM control.platform_envelope_scope_successor
   UNION ALL SELECT platform_context_id,owner_participant_id,installation_privacy_domain_id,platform_authority_epoch,scope_cbor,admission_digest FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_scope
  ) s WHERE s.platform_context_id=context_id AND s.owner_participant_id=pending.participant_id
   AND s.installation_privacy_domain_id=pending.privacy_domain_id AND s.platform_authority_epoch=scope.predecessor_epoch;
  IF previous_digest<>scope.predecessor_digest OR (openpc.platform_scope_document(previous_scope)-ARRAY['validFromNs','validUntilNs'])
    IS DISTINCT FROM (openpc.platform_scope_document(scope.scope_cbor)-ARRAY['validFromNs','validUntilNs']) THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  receipts:=jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('enrollmentId',custody.enrollment_id::text,'recoveryId',completed.recovery_id::text,
   'activationOperationId',completed.operation_id::text,'enrollmentDigest','sha256:'||encode(completed.enrollment_digest,'hex'),
   'intentDigest','sha256:'||encode(completed.intent_digest,'hex'),'receiptDigest','sha256:'||encode(completed.evidence_digest,'hex'),
   'predecessorEpoch',scope.predecessor_epoch::text,'predecessorRevision',(cursor_revision-1)::text,
   'predecessorDigest','sha256:'||encode(scope.predecessor_digest,'hex'),'rootEpoch',cursor_epoch::text,
   'rootRevision',cursor_revision::text,'rootDigest','sha256:'||encode(scope.admission_digest,'hex')))||receipts;
  visited:=visited||ARRAY[completed.recovery_id,completed.operation_id,custody.enrollment_id];
  cursor_epoch:=scope.predecessor_epoch;cursor_revision:=cursor_revision-1;cursor_digest:=scope.predecessor_digest;
 END LOOP;
 IF cursor_epoch<>pending.predecessor_epoch OR cursor_revision<>pending.expected_root_revision OR cursor_digest<>pending.predecessor_digest THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 FOR declared IN SELECT value,ordinality FROM jsonb_array_elements(receipts) WITH ORDINALITY LOOP
  IF declared.ordinality>1 THEN
   SELECT intent->'rootAncestry' INTO STRICT prefix FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_case c
    WHERE c.recovery_id=(declared.value->>'recoveryId')::uuid AND c.participant_id=pending.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=pending.privacy_domain_id;
   IF prefix IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('schema','pc.identity.local-root-expiry-pending-ancestry','schemaVersion',1,
    'rootEpoch',declared.value->>'predecessorEpoch','rootRevision',declared.value->>'predecessorRevision','rootDigest',declared.value->>'predecessorDigest',
    'receipts',(SELECT jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY ordinality) FROM jsonb_array_elements(receipts) WITH ORDINALITY WHERE ordinality<declared.ordinality))
   THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema','pc.identity.local-root-expiry-pending-ancestry','schemaVersion',1,
  'rootEpoch',root.authority_epoch::text,'rootRevision',root.row_version::text,
  'rootDigest',receipts->(jsonb_array_length(receipts)-1)->>'rootDigest','receipts',receipts);
EXCEPTION WHEN no_data_found OR too_many_rows OR invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range OR invalid_datetime_format THEN RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.root_expiry_recovery_executor_has_grants(p_enrollment uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_enrollment e JOIN control.assignment a
  ON a.participant_id=e.participant_id AND a.principal_id::text=e.document#>>'{recoveryPrincipal,principalId}'
  WHERE e.enrollment_id=p_enrollment AND openpc.matches_participant(e.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(e.privacy_domain_id)
   AND a.state='ACTIVE' AND (upper_inf(a.valid_during) OR upper(a.valid_during)>clock_timestamp()))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.root_expiry_recovery_installation_source_current(p_enrollment uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF current_user<>'openpc_control_owner' THEN RETURN FALSE; END IF;
 -- A failed prerequisite denies before planning the full witness. The complete
 -- original check below remains authoritative whenever this precheck passes.
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_enrollment e
  WHERE e.enrollment_id=p_enrollment AND openpc.matches_participant(e.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(e.privacy_domain_id)
   AND e.state='ACTIVE' AND e.row_version=1 AND e.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND e.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_context p
    WHERE p.platform_context_id=e.platform_context_id AND p.owner_participant_id=e.participant_id
     AND p.state='ACTIVE' AND p.authority_epoch::text=e.document->>'rootEpoch' AND p.row_version::text=e.document->>'rootRevision')) THEN RETURN FALSE; END IF;
 RETURN current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM '1'
 AND openpc.current_action_intent_id()='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_enrollment e
  JOIN control.root_expiry_recovery_trust t ON t.custody_trust_id=e.custody_trust_id AND t.participant_id=e.participant_id
   AND t.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id AND t.document_digest=e.custody_trust_digest
   AND t.state='ACTIVE' AND t.row_version=1 AND t.valid_from<=e.valid_from AND t.valid_until>=e.valid_until
  JOIN control.platform_context p ON p.platform_context_id=e.platform_context_id AND p.owner_participant_id=e.participant_id
   AND p.state='ACTIVE' AND p.authority_epoch::text=e.document->>'rootEpoch' AND p.row_version::text=e.document->>'rootRevision'
  JOIN (SELECT platform_context_id,platform_authority_epoch,admission_digest,scope_cbor FROM control.platform_envelope_scope
   UNION ALL SELECT platform_context_id,platform_authority_epoch,admission_digest,scope_cbor FROM control.platform_envelope_scope_successor
   UNION ALL SELECT platform_context_id,platform_authority_epoch,admission_digest,scope_cbor FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_scope) s
   ON s.platform_context_id=p.platform_context_id AND s.platform_authority_epoch=p.authority_epoch
    AND 'sha256:'||encode(s.admission_digest,'hex')=e.document->>'rootDigest'
  JOIN control.operations_installation i ON i.participant_id=e.participant_id AND i.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
   AND i.environment_id=e.document->>'installationEnvironmentId' AND i.installation_digest=e.document->>'installationDigest' AND i.state='ACTIVE'
  WHERE e.enrollment_id=p_enrollment AND openpc.matches_participant(e.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(e.privacy_domain_id)
   AND e.state='ACTIVE' AND e.row_version=1 AND e.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND e.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
   AND (e.document->>'successorValidFrom')::timestamptz>=greatest(e.created_at,t.created_at)-interval '30 seconds'
   AND e.document->>'schema'='pc.identity.local-root-expiry-recovery-enrollment'
   AND ((e.document->>'schemaVersion'='1' AND t.document->>'schemaVersion'='1' AND e.document->>'purpose'='pc.installation.local-root-expiry-recovery-custody.v1'
     AND NOT (e.document ? 'pending') AND NOT (t.document ? 'pending')
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_scope_replacement r WHERE r.platform_context_id=p.platform_context_id AND r.state='WITHDRAWING'))
    OR (e.document->>'schemaVersion'='2' AND e.document->>'purpose'='pc.installation.local-root-expiry-pending-recovery-custody.v2'
      AND t.document->>'schemaVersion'='2' AND e.document->'pending'=t.document->'pending'
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_scope_replacement pending
       JOIN control.mutation_evidence preparation ON preparation.participant_id=pending.participant_id
        AND preparation.privacy_domain_id=pending.privacy_domain_id AND preparation.operation_id=pending.prepare_operation_id
        AND preparation.aggregate_type='platform-scope-replacement' AND preparation.aggregate_id=pending.replacement_id
        AND preparation.candidate_digest=pending.candidate_digest AND preparation.evidence_digest=sha256(preparation.evidence_cbor)
        AND octet_length(preparation.cose_sign1)>0
       WHERE pending.platform_context_id=p.platform_context_id AND pending.participant_id=e.participant_id
        AND pending.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id AND pending.state='WITHDRAWING' AND pending.row_version=1
        AND pending.superseded_by IS NULL AND num_nonnulls(pending.commit_operation_id,pending.commit_candidate_id,
          pending.commit_approval_id,pending.readiness_digest,pending.committed_at)=0
        AND pending.predecessor_epoch=p.authority_epoch AND pending.expected_root_revision=p.row_version
        AND pending.predecessor_digest=s.admission_digest
        AND pending.candidate_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(pending.candidate),'UTF8'))
        AND pending.successor_digest=sha256(pending.successor_preimage)
        AND pending.candidate#>'{successorScope,runtime}'=openpc.platform_scope_document(s.scope_cbor)->'runtime'
        AND jsonb_array_length(pending.candidate->'administrators')=2
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(pending.candidate->'administrators') administrator
          WHERE (administrator#>>'{usable,validUntilNs}')::numeric>floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp())*1000000000)
           OR (administrator#>>'{grantable,validUntilNs}')::numeric>floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp())*1000000000))
        AND e.document#>>'{pending,replacementId}'=pending.replacement_id::text
        AND e.document#>>'{pending,replacementRevision}'=pending.row_version::text
        AND e.document#>>'{pending,predecessorEpoch}'=pending.predecessor_epoch::text
        AND e.document#>>'{pending,expectedRootRevision}'=pending.expected_root_revision::text
        AND e.document#>>'{pending,predecessorDigest}'='sha256:'||encode(pending.predecessor_digest,'hex')
        AND e.document#>>'{pending,preparationCandidateId}'=pending.prepare_candidate_id::text
        AND e.document#>>'{pending,preparationOperationId}'=pending.prepare_operation_id::text
        AND e.document#>>'{pending,preparationApprovalId}'=pending.prepare_approval_id::text
        AND e.document#>>'{pending,preparationDigest}'='sha256:'||encode(pending.candidate_digest,'hex')
        AND e.document#>>'{pending,preparationReceiptDigest}'='sha256:'||encode(preparation.evidence_digest,'hex')
        AND e.document#>>'{pending,successorDigest}'='sha256:'||encode(pending.successor_digest,'hex')
        AND e.document#>>'{pending,pendingRecordDigest}'='sha256:'||encode(openpc.platform_scope_pending_record_digest(pending),'hex')
        AND (e.document#>>'{pending,affectedTargetCount}')::integer=jsonb_array_length(pending.candidate->'affectedTargets')))
    OR (e.document->>'schemaVersion'='3' AND t.document->>'schemaVersion'='3'
      AND e.document->>'purpose'='pc.installation.local-root-expiry-pending-ancestry-custody.v3'
      AND e.document->'pending'=t.document->'pending' AND e.document->'rootAncestry'=t.document->'rootAncestry'
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_scope_replacement pending
        WHERE pending.platform_context_id=p.platform_context_id AND pending.participant_id=e.participant_id
          AND pending.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
          AND pending.replacement_id::text=e.document#>>'{pending,replacementId}'
          AND e.document->'rootAncestry'=openpc.root_expiry_pending_ancestry(p.platform_context_id,to_jsonb(pending)))))
   AND t.document->>'purpose'=e.document->>'purpose' AND t.document->>'profile'='LOCAL_QA' AND e.document->>'profile'='LOCAL_QA'
   AND i.installation#>>'{pins,profile}' IN ('local','development','test')
   AND e.document_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(e.document),'UTF8'))
   AND t.document_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(t.document),'UTF8'))
   AND i.installation_bytes=convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(i.installation),'UTF8')
   AND i.installation_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(i.installation_bytes),'hex')
   AND openpc.operations_source_authentication_valid(i.installation)
   AND (openpc.business_cbor(s.scope_cbor)->>'4')::numeric<=floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000000)
  );
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.root_expiry_recovery_proofs_current(p_case control.root_expiry_recovery_case, p_activation uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
 SET jit TO 'off'
AS $function$
 SELECT p_case.enrollment_id IS NOT NULL
 AND openpc.matches_participant(p_case.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(p_case.privacy_domain_id)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_enrollment e
  WHERE e.enrollment_id=p_case.enrollment_id AND e.participant_id=p_case.participant_id
   AND e.privacy_domain_id=p_case.privacy_domain_id AND e.state='ACTIVE' AND e.row_version=p_case.enrollment_revision
   AND e.document_digest=p_case.enrollment_digest AND openpc.root_expiry_recovery_source_current(e.enrollment_id)
   AND jsonb_array_length(e.document->'custodians')=2
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_proof proof WHERE proof.participant_id=e.participant_id
    AND proof.recovery_id=p_case.recovery_id)=4
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(
    jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('signer',e.document->'recoveryPrincipal','phase','REQUEST'),
     jsonb_build_object('signer',e.document->'recoveryPrincipal','phase','ACTIVATE')) ||
     (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signer',custodian,'phase','APPROVE')) FROM jsonb_array_elements(e.document->'custodians') custodian)) required
    WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_proof proof
     JOIN control.root_expiry_recovery_challenge h ON h.participant_id=proof.participant_id AND h.recovery_id=proof.recovery_id
      AND h.challenge_id=proof.challenge_id AND h.proof_id=proof.proof_id AND h.consumed_at IS NOT NULL
     JOIN control.principal p ON p.participant_id=proof.participant_id AND p.principal_id=proof.principal_id
      AND p.state='ACTIVE' AND p.kind IN ('USER','PLATFORM_OPERATOR') AND p.authority_epoch=proof.principal_epoch
     JOIN control.credential c ON c.participant_id=p.participant_id AND c.principal_id=p.principal_id
      AND c.credential_id=proof.credential_id AND c.credential_epoch=proof.credential_epoch AND c.kind='WEBAUTHN' AND c.state='ACTIVE'
      AND c.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND (c.valid_until IS NULL OR c.valid_until>clock_timestamp())
     JOIN control.session s ON s.participant_id=p.participant_id AND s.principal_id=p.principal_id
      AND s.session_id=proof.session_id AND s.session_epoch=proof.session_epoch AND s.authority_epoch=p.authority_epoch
      AND s.participant_epoch=(p_case.intent->>'sourceParticipantEpoch')::numeric AND s.state='ACTIVE'
      AND s.context_mode='PLATFORM' AND s.privacy_domain_id IS NULL
      AND s.idle_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND s.absolute_expires_at>clock_timestamp()
     WHERE proof.participant_id=p_case.participant_id AND proof.privacy_domain_id=p_case.privacy_domain_id
      AND proof.recovery_id=p_case.recovery_id AND proof.intent_digest=p_case.intent_digest
      AND proof.phase=required->>'phase' AND proof.principal_id::text=required#>>'{signer,principalId}'
      AND proof.credential_id::text=required#>>'{signer,credentialId}'
      AND proof.principal_epoch::text=required#>>'{signer,principalEpoch}' AND proof.credential_epoch::text=required#>>'{signer,credentialEpoch}'
      AND (proof.phase<>'ACTIVATE' OR proof.proof_id=p_activation)
      AND proof.verified_at>=p_case.valid_from AND proof.verified_at<=clock_timestamp()
      AND proof.verified_at>clock_timestamp()-make_interval(secs=>h.verified_proof_max_age_ms/1000.0)
      AND (h.verified_proof_max_age_ms=300000 OR (h.verified_proof_max_age_ms=3000000
        AND h.duration_profile='LOCAL_QA_10X' AND s.duration_profile='LOCAL_QA_10X' AND h.expires_at>clock_timestamp()))
      AND (e.document->>'assurance'='LOCAL_QA_VIRTUAL_AUTHENTICATOR' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.hardware_authenticator hardware
        WHERE hardware.participant_id=c.participant_id AND hardware.principal_id=c.principal_id AND hardware.credential_id=c.credential_id))))
 );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.root_expiry_recovery_source_current(p_enrollment uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 RETURN current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM '1'
 AND openpc.current_action_intent_id()='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_enrollment e
  JOIN control.root_expiry_recovery_trust t ON t.custody_trust_id=e.custody_trust_id AND t.participant_id=e.participant_id
   AND t.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id AND t.document_digest=e.custody_trust_digest
   AND t.state='ACTIVE' AND t.row_version=1 AND t.valid_from<=e.valid_from AND t.valid_until>=e.valid_until
  JOIN control.platform_context p ON p.platform_context_id=e.platform_context_id AND p.owner_participant_id=e.participant_id
   AND p.state='ACTIVE' AND p.authority_epoch::text=e.document->>'rootEpoch' AND p.row_version::text=e.document->>'rootRevision'
  JOIN (SELECT platform_context_id,platform_authority_epoch,admission_digest,scope_cbor FROM control.platform_envelope_scope
   UNION ALL SELECT platform_context_id,platform_authority_epoch,admission_digest,scope_cbor FROM control.platform_envelope_scope_successor
   UNION ALL SELECT platform_context_id,platform_authority_epoch,admission_digest,scope_cbor FROM control.root_expiry_recovery_scope) s
   ON s.platform_context_id=p.platform_context_id AND s.platform_authority_epoch=p.authority_epoch
    AND 'sha256:'||encode(s.admission_digest,'hex')=e.document->>'rootDigest'
  JOIN control.operations_installation i ON i.participant_id=e.participant_id AND i.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
   AND i.environment_id=e.document->>'installationEnvironmentId' AND i.installation_digest=e.document->>'installationDigest' AND i.state='ACTIVE'
  WHERE e.enrollment_id=p_enrollment AND openpc.matches_participant(e.participant_id) AND openpc.matches_privacy(e.privacy_domain_id)
   AND e.state='ACTIVE' AND e.row_version=1 AND e.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND e.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
   AND (e.document->>'successorValidFrom')::timestamptz>=greatest(e.created_at,t.created_at)-interval '30 seconds'
   AND e.document->>'schema'='pc.identity.local-root-expiry-recovery-enrollment'
   AND ((e.document->>'schemaVersion'='1' AND t.document->>'schemaVersion'='1' AND e.document->>'purpose'='pc.installation.local-root-expiry-recovery-custody.v1'
     AND NOT (e.document ? 'pending') AND NOT (t.document ? 'pending')
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.platform_scope_replacement r WHERE r.platform_context_id=p.platform_context_id AND r.state='WITHDRAWING'))
    OR (e.document->>'schemaVersion'='2' AND e.document->>'purpose'='pc.installation.local-root-expiry-pending-recovery-custody.v2'
      AND t.document->>'schemaVersion'='2' AND e.document->'pending'=t.document->'pending'
      AND e.document->'pending'=openpc.read_root_expiry_pending_witness(p.platform_context_id))
    OR (e.document->>'schemaVersion'='3' AND t.document->>'schemaVersion'='3'
      AND e.document->>'purpose'='pc.installation.local-root-expiry-pending-ancestry-custody.v3'
      AND e.document->'pending'=t.document->'pending' AND e.document->'rootAncestry'=t.document->'rootAncestry'
      AND jsonb_build_object('pending',e.document->'pending','rootAncestry',e.document->'rootAncestry')=
        openpc.read_root_expiry_pending_ancestry_witness(p.platform_context_id)))
   AND t.document->>'purpose'=e.document->>'purpose' AND t.document->>'profile'='LOCAL_QA' AND e.document->>'profile'='LOCAL_QA'
   AND i.installation#>>'{pins,profile}' IN ('local','development','test')
   AND e.document_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(e.document),'UTF8'))
   AND t.document_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(t.document),'UTF8'))
   AND i.installation_bytes=convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(i.installation),'UTF8')
   AND i.installation_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(i.installation_bytes),'hex')
   AND openpc.operations_source_authentication_valid(i.installation)
   AND (openpc.business_cbor(s.scope_cbor)->>'4')::numeric<=floor(extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000000000)
  );
END $function$
p_rotation control.signing_key_rotation, p_prior_state text, p_operation uuid, p_event uuid, p_receipt uuid, p_evidence uuid, p_attester jsonb, p_receipt_ordinal numeric

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.rotation_history_preimage(p_rotation control.signing_key_rotation, p_prior_state text, p_operation uuid, p_event uuid, p_receipt uuid, p_evidence uuid, p_attester jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, p_receipt_ordinal numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE prior bytea; candidate jsonb; approval jsonb; attempts jsonb; selections jsonb; acknowledgements jsonb; command jsonb; retained_selections jsonb; effects jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF p_receipt IS NOT NULL AND p_attester IS NULL THEN
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('signerId',a.signer_id,'keyEpoch',a.key_epoch,'trustDigest',encode(a.signer_trust_digest,'hex'),
   'selectionVersion',a.selection_version,'admissionVersion',a.admission_version,'fenceGeneration',a.fence_generation),s.receipt_ordinal
  INTO STRICT p_attester,p_receipt_ordinal FROM control.receipt_signing_attempt a
  JOIN control.signing_rotation_attestation s ON s.attempt_id=a.attempt_id
  WHERE a.participant_id=p_rotation.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=p_rotation.privacy_domain_id
   AND a.operation_id=p_operation AND a.attempt_id=p_receipt AND s.from_revision=p_rotation.revision-1;
 END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('operationId',c.operation_id,'actionIntentId',c.action_intent_id,'actionIntentDigest',encode(c.action_intent_digest,'hex'),
  'inputDigest',encode(c.input_digest,'hex'),'fromRevision',c.from_revision,'toState',c.to_state,
  'authorizationEvidenceId',c.authorization_evidence_id,'authorizationSnapshotDigest',encode(c.authorization_snapshot_digest,'hex'),
  'consumerReceiptId',c.consumer_receipt_id,'originalOperationId',c.original_operation_id,'recoveryAttemptId',c.recovery_attempt_id,
  'authorizationGenerationId',c.authorization_generation_id,'approvalRequestId',c.approval_request_id,'approvalCandidateDigest',encode(c.approval_candidate_digest,'hex'),
  'priorObservationDigest',encode(c.prior_observation_digest,'hex'),'recoveryObservationDigest',encode(c.recovery_observation_digest,'hex'))
 INTO command FROM control.signing_rotation_command c WHERE c.participant_id=p_rotation.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=p_rotation.privacy_domain_id AND c.operation_id=p_operation;
 IF command IS NOT NULL THEN
  effects:=openpc.signing_transition_effects(command->>'actionIntentId',p_prior_state,p_rotation.state);
  IF effects IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6022-SIGNING-HISTORY-MATRIX'; END IF;
 END IF;
 SELECT history_digest INTO prior FROM control.signing_rotation_history
 WHERE participant_id=p_rotation.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=p_rotation.privacy_domain_id
  AND rotation_id=p_rotation.rotation_id AND revision=p_rotation.revision-1;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',c.mutation_candidate_id,'digest',encode(c.candidate_digest,'hex'),
  'maker',c.maker_principal_id,'session',c.maker_session_id,'sessionEpoch',c.maker_session_epoch,
  'participantEpoch',c.maker_participant_epoch,'principalEpoch',c.maker_principal_epoch,
  'assignment',c.maker_assignment_id,'assignmentVersion',c.maker_assignment_row_version,
  'envelope',c.maker_authority_envelope_id,'authorityEpoch',c.maker_authority_epoch,'delegationEpoch',c.maker_delegation_epoch)
 INTO STRICT candidate FROM control.mutation_candidate c WHERE c.participant_id=p_rotation.participant_id
  AND c.privacy_domain_id=p_rotation.privacy_domain_id AND c.resource_id=p_rotation.rotation_id
  AND c.candidate_digest=p_rotation.candidate_digest AND c.action_intent_id='ACT-SIGNING_KEY_ROTATIONS_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1';
 IF p_rotation.approval_request_id IS NOT NULL THEN
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',a.approval_request_id,'candidateDigest',encode(a.subject_digest,'hex'),
   'maker',a.maker_principal_id,'makerAuthority',a.maker_authority,'approvedOperation',p_rotation.approved_operation_id,
   'checker',d.approver_principal_id,'decision',d.approval_decision_id,'session',d.approver_session_id,
   'sessionEpoch',d.approver_session_epoch,'participantEpoch',d.approver_participant_epoch,
   'principalEpoch',d.approver_principal_epoch,'assignment',d.approver_assignment_id,
   'assignmentVersion',d.approver_assignment_row_version,'envelope',d.approver_authority_envelope_id,
   'authorityEpoch',d.approver_envelope_epoch,'delegationEpoch',d.approver_delegation_epoch,
   'signerCredential',d.signer_credential_id,'signerEpoch',d.signer_credential_epoch)
  INTO STRICT approval FROM control.approval_request a JOIN control.approval_decision_record d
   ON d.participant_id=a.participant_id AND d.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND d.approval_request_id=a.approval_request_id
  WHERE a.participant_id=p_rotation.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=p_rotation.privacy_domain_id
   AND a.approval_request_id=p_rotation.approval_request_id AND d.decision='APPROVE';
 END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('attemptId',a.attempt_id,'operationId',a.operation_id,'revision',a.from_revision,
  'fromState',a.from_state,'toState',a.to_state,'slot',a.slot,'method',a.request->>'method',
  'requestDigest',encode(a.request_digest,'hex'),'observationDigest',encode(a.observation_digest,'hex'),
  'state',CASE WHEN a.operation_id=p_operation AND a.state='OBSERVED' AND effects->>'kind' IN ('ADVANCE','FAILURE')
   THEN CASE WHEN effects->>'kind'='FAILURE' THEN 'REJECTED' ELSE 'ACCEPTED' END ELSE a.state END)
  ORDER BY a.from_revision,a.slot),'[]'::jsonb) INTO attempts FROM control.signing_provider_attempt a
 WHERE a.participant_id=p_rotation.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=p_rotation.privacy_domain_id AND a.rotation_id=p_rotation.rotation_id
  AND a.request->>'method'<>'SIGN_RECEIPT';
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('profileDigest',encode(s.profile_digest,'hex'),'fingerprint',k.signer_id,
  'epoch',k.key_epoch,'selectionVersion',s.row_version+CASE WHEN s.signer_id<>k.signer_id THEN CASE WHEN s.fenced_operation_id IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE 1 END ELSE 0 END,
  'admissionVersion',s.admission_version,'fenceGeneration',s.fence_generation+CASE WHEN s.signer_id<>k.signer_id AND s.fenced_operation_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,'trustDigest',encode(k.trust_digest,'hex'),
  'admissionReference',k.admission_reference,'admissionDigest',encode(k.admission_digest,'hex')) ORDER BY s.profile_digest),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO selections FROM control.business_signing_selection s JOIN control.business_signing_key k
  ON k.participant_id=s.participant_id AND k.privacy_domain_id=s.privacy_domain_id
   AND k.signer_id=CASE WHEN coalesce((effects->>'cutover')::boolean,false) AND s.signer_id=p_rotation.old_signer_id THEN p_rotation.new_signer_id ELSE s.signer_id END
 WHERE s.participant_id=p_rotation.participant_id AND s.privacy_domain_id=p_rotation.privacy_domain_id
  AND s.environment_id=p_rotation.environment_id AND k.workload_credential_id=p_rotation.workload_credential_id;
 -- Preserve the already signed admission snapshot across this operation's own ambiguity fence.
 -- Every other selection field must still match the actual/prospective selected key exactly.
 IF p_receipt IS NOT NULL THEN
  SELECT convert_from(a.history_preimage,'UTF8')::jsonb->'selections' INTO STRICT retained_selections
   FROM control.signing_rotation_attestation a WHERE a.participant_id=p_rotation.participant_id
    AND a.privacy_domain_id=p_rotation.privacy_domain_id AND a.operation_id=p_operation AND a.attempt_id=p_receipt;
  IF jsonb_typeof(retained_selections) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR
   jsonb_array_length(retained_selections)<>jsonb_array_length(selections) OR EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(selections) WITH ORDINALITY live(value,ordinal)
    LEFT JOIN jsonb_array_elements(retained_selections) WITH ORDINALITY retained(value,ordinal) USING(ordinal)
    WHERE (live.value-'admissionVersion') IS DISTINCT FROM (retained.value-'admissionVersion') OR
     NOT coalesce(openpc.retained_signing_admission_matches(p_rotation.participant_id,p_rotation.privacy_domain_id,
      live.value->>'fingerprint',p_operation,(retained.value->>'admissionVersion')::numeric,
      (live.value->>'admissionVersion')::numeric),false))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-ROTATION-HISTORY-ADMISSION'; END IF;
  selections:=retained_selections;
 END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('namespace',i.namespace,'aggregateType',i.aggregate_type,'aggregateId',i.aggregate_id,
  'sequence',i.sequence,'receiptId',i.receipt_id,'receiptDigest',encode(i.receipt_digest,'hex'),'fingerprint',i.signer_id,'keyEpoch',i.key_epoch)
  ORDER BY i.receipt_id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO acknowledgements FROM control.qualified_receipt_inbox i
  JOIN control.signing_rotation_command c ON c.participant_id=i.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=i.privacy_domain_id
   AND c.consumer_receipt_id=i.receipt_id
  WHERE c.participant_id=p_rotation.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=p_rotation.privacy_domain_id AND c.operation_id=p_operation;
 RETURN convert_to(jsonb_build_object('schema','pc.control.signing-rotation-history.v1','participantId',p_rotation.participant_id,
  'privacyDomainId',p_rotation.privacy_domain_id,'rotationId',p_rotation.rotation_id,'revision',p_rotation.revision,
  'priorState',p_prior_state,'state',p_rotation.state,'operationId',p_operation,'priorDigest',encode(prior,'hex'),
  'candidate',candidate,'approval',approval,'command',command,'signerRole',p_rotation.request->>'signerRole','attempts',attempts,'selections',selections,'consumerAcknowledgements',acknowledgements,
  'oldTrustDigest',encode(p_rotation.old_trust_digest,'hex'),'newFingerprint',p_rotation.new_signer_id,
  'cutoverAtNs',p_rotation.cutover_at_ns,'recoveryFromState',p_rotation.recovery_from_state,
  'recoveryFromRevision',p_rotation.recovery_from_revision,'eventId',p_event,'evidenceId',p_evidence,
  'attester',p_attester,'receiptNamespace',CASE WHEN p_receipt_ordinal IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'CONTROL_SIGNING_LIFECYCLE_V1' END,
  'receiptOrdinal',p_receipt_ordinal)::text,'UTF8');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.rpc_projection_closed_by(p jsonb, w jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(w->>'identityDigest'=openpc.rpc_retirement_identity(p)
  AND (w->>'terminalSequence')::numeric>=(p->>'sourceSequence')::numeric
  AND (w->>'terminalOccurredAtNs')::numeric>=(p->>'occurredAtNs')::numeric
  AND CASE p->'transition'->>'phase'
   WHEN 'RESERVED' THEN w->>'terminalPhase' IN ('INTERRUPTED','RELEASED')
    OR (w->>'terminalPhase'='COMMITTED' AND w->>'terminalEffect' IN ('DENY_TERMINAL','AUTHORIZED_EMPTY','WITHHOLD_STALE'))
   WHEN 'SOURCE_READ_STARTED' THEN w->>'terminalPhase'='SOURCE_READ_RELEASED'
    AND w->'sourceScopeDigest'=p->'transition'->'sourceScopeDigest'
    AND w->'authorityBindingDigest'=p->'transition'->'authorityBindingDigest'
   WHEN 'COMMITTED' THEN CASE WHEN p->'transition'->>'decisionEffect'='ALLOW_FORWARD'
    THEN w->>'terminalPhase'='RELEASED' AND w->'terminalDecisionDigest'=p->'transition'->'decisionDigest'
    ELSE openpc.rpc_retirement_terminal(p) AND w->>'terminalSourceDigest'=p->>'sourceDigest'
     AND w->>'terminalPhase'=p->'transition'->>'phase' AND w->'terminalEffect'=p->'transition'->'decisionEffect'
     AND w->>'terminalSequence'=p->>'sourceSequence'
     AND w->>'terminalProjectionDigest'='sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(p),'UTF8')),'hex') END
   ELSE openpc.rpc_retirement_terminal(p) AND w->>'terminalSourceDigest'=p->>'sourceDigest'
    AND w->>'terminalPhase'=p->'transition'->>'phase' AND w->>'terminalSequence'=p->>'sourceSequence'
    AND w->>'terminalProjectionDigest'='sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(p),'UTF8')),'hex') END,false)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.rpc_projection_retirement_witness(c control.evidence_catalogue, p jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE witnesses jsonb;
BEGIN
 -- Custody authenticates the contiguous original journal. Both live witnesses
 -- and intentionally retired witnesses retain the original catalogue anchor.
 -- A missing/corrupt projection cannot masquerade as a successful retirement.
 SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT witness) INTO witnesses FROM (
  SELECT openpc.rpc_retirement_witness(s,r.projection) witness
   FROM control.evidence_rpc_provenance r JOIN control.evidence_catalogue s USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,stream_id,record_id)
   WHERE r.participant_id=(c).participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=(c).privacy_domain_id AND r.stream_id=(c).stream_id
    AND r.projection->>'decisionId'=p->>'decisionId' AND openpc.rpc_retirement_terminal(r.projection)
    AND r.projection->>'sourceSequence'=s.sequence::text AND r.projection->>'sourceDigest'=s.receipt_digest
    AND s.source_format='OPENPC_RPC_DECISION_TRANSITION_V1'
    AND r.projection_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(r.projection),'UTF8')),'hex')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT (j.selection->'rpcClosure')-'archive' FROM control.evidence_projection_retirement r
   JOIN control.deletion_job j USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,deletion_job_id)
   JOIN control.evidence_catalogue s ON s.participant_id=r.participant_id AND s.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id
    AND s.stream_id=r.stream_id AND s.record_id=r.record_id
   WHERE r.participant_id=(c).participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=(c).privacy_domain_id AND r.stream_id=(c).stream_id
    AND r.data_class='NORMALIZED_JSON_PROJECTION' AND j.state='SUCCEEDED'
    AND j.selection->>'sourceKind'='RPC_CLOSED_TRANSITION'
    AND j.selection->'rpcClosure'->>'terminalRecordId'=r.record_id
    AND j.selection->'rpcClosure'->>'terminalSourceDigest'=r.source_receipt_digest AND s.receipt_digest=r.source_receipt_digest
    AND j.selection->'rpcClosure'->>'terminalProjectionDigest'=r.projection_digest
    AND r.retirement_digest=openpc.projection_retirement_digest(r)
 ) candidates WHERE openpc.rpc_projection_closed_by(p,witness);
 IF jsonb_array_length(witnesses)<>1 THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 RETURN witnesses->0;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.rpc_retired_catalogue_has_references(source control.evidence_catalogue)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE proof jsonb;
BEGIN
 proof:=openpc.rpc_retired_catalogue_proof(source);
 IF proof IS NULL THEN RETURN true; END IF;
 -- A pre-admission denial had no admitted request or terminal successor. Its
 -- governed normalized-retirement owner already verified that exact phase and
 -- null request/response. Do not fabricate a closed-transition identity/witness.
 -- Preserve any still-live exact projection; the common search owner separately
 -- checks custody, export, protected-object and catalogue references.
 IF proof->>'sourceKind'='RPC_PRE_ADMISSION_DENIAL' THEN
  RETURN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.evidence_rpc_provenance sibling
   WHERE sibling.participant_id=(source).participant_id AND sibling.privacy_domain_id=(source).privacy_domain_id
    AND sibling.stream_id=(source).stream_id AND sibling.record_id=(source).record_id);
 END IF;
 RETURN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.evidence_rpc_provenance sibling WHERE sibling.participant_id=(source).participant_id
  AND sibling.privacy_domain_id=(source).privacy_domain_id AND sibling.stream_id=(source).stream_id
  AND openpc.rpc_retirement_identity(sibling.projection)=proof->>'identityDigest');
EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN RETURN true;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.rpc_retired_catalogue_proof(source control.evidence_catalogue)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE proof jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF (source).evidence_class<>'EFFECT' OR (source).source_format<>'OPENPC_RPC_DECISION_TRANSITION_V1' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('recordId',e.evidence_record_id::text,'recordDigest','sha256:'||encode(sha256(a.cose_sign1),'hex'),
  'recordedAtNs',a.recorded_at_ns::text,'sourceEvidenceId','urn:openpc:resource:'||(source).evidence_id::text,
  'sourceRecordId',(source).record_id,'sourceReceiptDigest',(source).receipt_digest,'retirementDigest',r.retirement_digest,
  'sourceFormat',e.evidence_format,'deletionJobId',j.deletion_job_id::text,'operationId',j.operation_id::text,
  'sourceKind',j.selection->>'sourceKind','identityDigest',j.selection->'rpcClosure'->>'identityDigest') INTO STRICT proof
 FROM control.evidence_projection_retirement r
 JOIN control.deletion_job j USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,deletion_job_id)
 JOIN control.audit_occurrence a ON a.participant_id=j.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=j.privacy_domain_id
  AND a.operation_id=j.operation_id AND a.aggregate_id=j.deletion_job_id AND a.aggregate_type='evidence-deletion'
 JOIN control.evidence_record e ON e.participant_id=a.participant_id AND e.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id
  AND e.receipt_id=a.receipt_id AND e.receipt_digest=a.receipt_digest AND e.evidence_role='BUSINESS_TRANSITION_RECEIPT' AND e.custody='CONTROL_STORE'
 JOIN control.mutation_candidate candidate ON candidate.participant_id=j.participant_id AND candidate.privacy_domain_id=j.privacy_domain_id
  AND candidate.resource_id=j.deletion_job_id AND candidate.consumed_operation_id=j.operation_id AND candidate.candidate_digest=a.candidate_digest
 WHERE r.participant_id=(source).participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=(source).privacy_domain_id
  AND r.evidence_id=(source).evidence_id AND r.stream_id=(source).stream_id AND r.record_id=(source).record_id
  AND r.segment_id=(source).segment_id AND r.sequence=(source).sequence AND r.source_receipt_digest=(source).receipt_digest
  AND r.data_class='NORMALIZED_JSON_PROJECTION' AND r.retirement_digest=openpc.projection_retirement_digest(r)
  AND j.state='SUCCEEDED' AND j.revision=1 AND j.target_data_class='NORMALIZED_JSON_PROJECTION'
  AND ((j.selection->>'sourceKind'='RPC_CLOSED_TRANSITION'
    AND j.selection->'rpcClosure'->>'identityDigest' ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$')
   OR (j.selection->>'sourceKind'='RPC_PRE_ADMISSION_DENIAL' AND NOT j.selection ? 'rpcClosure'))
  AND openpc.projection_deletion_effect_matches(j,r)
  AND candidate.state='CONSUMED' AND candidate.candidate_document->'selection'=j.selection
  AND candidate.candidate_document->>'beforeDigest'=j.before_digest
  AND a.profile_id='pc.control.evidence-deletion.projection' AND a.profile_version=1
  AND a.action_intent_id='ACT-EVIDENCE_DELETIONS_CREATE_PROJECTION_BATCH-V1' AND a.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-DELETE-PROJECTION-BATCH'
  AND a.before_existence=0 AND a.before_revision=0 AND a.after_existence=1 AND a.after_revision=1
  AND openpc.business_cbor(a.after_state_preimage)->8=openpc.evidence_deletion_state_projection(j)
  AND sha256(a.receipt_cbor)=a.receipt_digest AND sha256(a.after_state_preimage)=a.after_state_digest;
 RETURN proof;
EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege OR no_data_found OR too_many_rows THEN RETURN NULL;
END $function$

 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql

 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'

  p->'decisionId',p->'targetRuntimeId',p->'spoolId',p->'capsuleDigest',p->'reservedAtNs',
  p->'transition'->'requestDigest',p->'activation')),'UTF8')),'hex')

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.rpc_retirement_terminal(p jsonb)

   IN ('DENY_TERMINAL','AUTHORIZED_EMPTY','WITHHOLD_STALE')),false)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.runtime_artifact_archive_challenge(input_id uuid, stream text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE s control.runtime_artifact_source; input control.runtime_configuration_input; wire bytea; secret bytea;
BEGIN
 s:=openpc.runtime_artifact_archive_owner(stream);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT input FROM control.runtime_configuration_input WHERE participant_id=s.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=s.privacy_domain_id
  AND runtime_configuration_input_id=input_id;
 IF NOT openpc.runtime_artifact_new_use_allowed(input.participant_id,input.privacy_domain_id,input.configuration_digest)
  OR input.configuration_digest IS DISTINCT FROM sha256(input.configuration_cbor)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.evidence_runtime_artifact_archive WHERE participant_id=s.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=s.privacy_domain_id AND runtime_configuration_input_id=input_id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RUNTIME-ARTIFACT-ARCHIVE-READ-DENIED'; END IF;
 wire:=convert_to(jsonb_build_object('version',1,'installation',jsonb_build_object('participant_id',s.participant_id::text,
 'privacy_domain_id',s.privacy_domain_id::text,'source_owner_id',s.source_owner_id::text,
 'source_file_binding',encode(s.source_file_binding,'hex')),'binding',s.custody_root,
  'archive',jsonb_build_object('stream_id',stream,'materialization',jsonb_build_object('input',jsonb_build_object('input_id',input.runtime_configuration_input_id::text,
 'module_installation_id',input.module_installation_id::text,
 'module_configuration_generation_id',input.module_configuration_generation_id::text,
 'configuration_digest',encode(input.configuration_digest,'hex')),'reader_role',session_user::text,
   'transaction_id',pg_current_xact_id()::text,'backend_id',pg_backend_pid()::text||':'||extract(epoch FROM pg_postmaster_start_time())::text,'request_id',uuidv7()::text)))::text,'UTF8');
 SELECT verifier_secret INTO STRICT secret FROM control.runtime_artifact_source_verifier_key WHERE participant_id=s.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=s.privacy_domain_id AND source_owner_id=s.source_owner_id;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('wire',(SELECT jsonb_agg(get_byte(wire,n) ORDER BY n) FROM generate_series(0,octet_length(wire)-1) n),
  'mac',(SELECT jsonb_agg(get_byte(mac,n) ORDER BY n) FROM (SELECT public.hmac(convert_to('OPENPC_RUNTIME_ARTIFACT_ARCHIVE_REQUEST_V1','UTF8')||wire,secret,'sha256') mac) m,generate_series(0,31) n));
END $function$
pid uuid, privacy uuid, stream text, record_ref text, sinks text[]

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.runtime_artifact_archive_hold_metadata(source control.evidence_catalogue)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE identity jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT a.manifest->'identity' INTO STRICT identity FROM control.evidence_runtime_artifact_archive a
  JOIN control.evidence_runtime_artifact_archive_part part ON part.participant_id=a.participant_id AND part.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id
   AND part.stream_id=a.stream_id AND part.manifest_record_id=a.record_id
  JOIN control.evidence_catalogue c ON c.participant_id=part.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=part.privacy_domain_id
   AND c.stream_id=part.stream_id AND c.record_id=part.record_id
  WHERE c IS NOT DISTINCT FROM source AND a.manifest_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(a.manifest),'UTF8')),'hex');
 -- Module configuration is not a runtime generation. Preserve unknown
 -- cross-owner lineage; metadata cannot declare those references absent.
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('unresolvedReferences',true);
EXCEPTION WHEN no_data_found OR too_many_rows OR insufficient_privilege THEN RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.runtime_artifact_archive_owner(stream text)
 RETURNS control.runtime_artifact_source
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE s control.runtime_artifact_source; owner oid; pin jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 s:=openpc.runtime_artifact_materialization_source();
 IF NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=session_user
 AND NOT rolsuper AND NOT rolbypassrls AND NOT rolcreaterole AND NOT rolcreatedb AND NOT rolreplication
 AND NOT pg_has_role(oid,'openpc_control_owner','MEMBER')
 AND NOT pg_has_role(oid,'openpc_control_key_governor','MEMBER'))
 AND (pg_has_role(session_user,'openpc_control_worker','USAGE')
  OR pg_has_role(session_user,'openpc_control_runtime','USAGE')
  OR pg_has_role(session_user,'openpc_control_reader','USAGE'))) OR current_user=session_user
  OR openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>'ACT-EVIDENCE_EXPORT_RECORDS-V1'
  OR current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed' OR current_setting('session_replication_role')<>'origin'
  OR s.custody_root->>'consumer_profile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'openpc:local-runtime-source-consumers:v2'
  OR s.custody_root->'database' IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.runtime_artifact_database_identity()
  OR s.archive_custody->>'stream_id' IS DISTINCT FROM stream
  OR s.archive_custody->>'database_role' IS DISTINCT FROM session_user
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RUNTIME-ARTIFACT-ARCHIVE-OWNER-UNAVAILABLE'; END IF;
 SELECT oid INTO STRICT owner FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=session_user AND rolcanlogin;
 pin:=shobj_description(owner,'pg_authid')::jsonb;
 IF pin IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('installation',jsonb_build_object('participant_id',s.participant_id::text,
 'privacy_domain_id',s.privacy_domain_id::text,'source_owner_id',s.source_owner_id::text,
 'source_file_binding',encode(s.source_file_binding,'hex')),'root',s.custody_root,'archive',s.archive_custody)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_auth_members WHERE roleid=owner)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_auth_members m JOIN pg_roles parent ON parent.oid=m.roleid JOIN pg_roles grantor ON grantor.oid=m.grantor
   WHERE m.member=owner AND (parent.rolname<>'openpc_control_worker' OR m.admin_option OR NOT grantor.rolsuper))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RUNTIME-ARTIFACT-ARCHIVE-OWNER-UNAVAILABLE'; END IF;
 PERFORM openpc.assert_runtime_artifact_materialization_boundary();
 RETURN s;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.runtime_artifact_archive_payloads_match(input_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE s control.runtime_artifact_source; a control.evidence_runtime_artifact_archive; input record;
 p uuid:=openpc.current_participant_id(); d uuid:=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id();
 lock_key text; expected_mode text; part_count integer;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=session_user
 AND NOT rolsuper AND NOT rolbypassrls AND NOT rolcreaterole AND NOT rolcreatedb AND NOT rolreplication
 AND NOT pg_has_role(oid,'openpc_control_owner','MEMBER')
 AND NOT pg_has_role(oid,'openpc_control_key_governor','MEMBER'))
 AND pg_has_role(session_user,'openpc_control_runtime','USAGE')
 AND openpc.current_action_intent_id() IN
 ('ACT-EVIDENCE_DELETIONS_READ_RUNTIME_SOURCE-V1','ACT-EVIDENCE_DELETIONS_DISPOSE_RUNTIME_SOURCE-V1',
  'ACT-EVIDENCE_DELETIONS_READ_RESOURCE-V1','ACT-EVIDENCE_DELETIONS_CREATE_RUNTIME_BATCH-V1')) IS DISTINCT FROM true
  OR current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed' OR current_setting('session_replication_role')<>'origin'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user AND NOT rolsuper AND NOT rolbypassrls)
  OR (current_setting('role')<>'none' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_setting('role')
   AND NOT rolsuper AND NOT rolbypassrls AND pg_has_role(oid,'openpc_control_runtime','USAGE')))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;
 -- SECURITY DEFINER changes current_user. Inspect the actual session and the
 -- existing producer fences; never call the invoker role-checking lock owner.
 FOREACH lock_key IN ARRAY ARRAY['evidence-lifecycle:'||p::text,'module-release-catalog',
  'module-admission:'||p::text||':'||d::text,'openpc-policy-generations:'||p::text||':'||d::text] LOOP
  expected_mode:=CASE WHEN lock_key LIKE 'module-admission:%' OR lock_key LIKE 'evidence-lifecycle:%' THEN 'ExclusiveLock' ELSE 'ShareLock' END;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_locks l WHERE l.pid=pg_backend_pid() AND l.locktype='advisory' AND l.granted AND l.mode=expected_mode
   AND l.database=(SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database())
   AND l.classid=((hashtextextended(lock_key,0)>>32)&4294967295)::oid AND l.objid=(hashtextextended(lock_key,0)&4294967295)::oid AND l.objsubid=1)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RUNTIME-ARTIFACT-OBSERVATION-FENCE'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF input_id IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 s:=openpc.runtime_artifact_materialization_source();
 IF s.custody_root->>'consumer_profile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'openpc:local-runtime-source-consumers:v2' OR s.archive_custody IS NULL
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 SELECT runtime_configuration_input_id,module_installation_id,module_configuration_generation_id,configuration_digest,resource_bindings,created_at,
  openpc.runtime_artifact_input_information(runtime_configuration_input_id) info INTO STRICT input
  FROM control.runtime_configuration_input WHERE participant_id=p AND privacy_domain_id=d AND runtime_configuration_input_id=input_id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM control.evidence_runtime_artifact_archive WHERE participant_id=p AND privacy_domain_id=d
  AND runtime_configuration_input_id=input_id AND stream_id=s.archive_custody->>'stream_id';
 IF a.source_pending_original IS NULL OR input.info->'bytesMatch' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
  OR jsonb_typeof(a.manifest->'chunks') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR a.manifest->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'OPENPC_RUNTIME_ARTIFACT_MANIFEST_V1'
  OR a.manifest_digest IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(a.manifest),'UTF8')),'hex')
  OR a.manifest->'identity' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('participantId',p::text,'privacyDomainId',d::text,
   'runtimeConfigurationInputId',input_id::text,'moduleInstallationId',input.module_installation_id::text,
   'moduleConfigurationGenerationId',input.module_configuration_generation_id::text,'configurationDigest','sha256:'||encode(input.configuration_digest,'hex'),
   'configurationBytes',(input.info->>'byteLength')::integer,'resourceBindingsDigest','sha256:'||encode(sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(input.resource_bindings),'UTF8')),'hex'),
   'createdAt',to_char(input.created_at at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'))
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 part_count:=jsonb_array_length(a.manifest->'chunks');
 IF part_count NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 64 OR
  (SELECT count(*) FROM control.evidence_runtime_artifact_archive_part entry WHERE entry.participant_id=p AND entry.privacy_domain_id=d
   AND entry.stream_id=a.stream_id AND entry.manifest_record_id=a.record_id)<>part_count+1
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 -- Only stored hashes and complete stored membership are compared. There is no
 -- caller-selected segment or expected digest, and no payload leaves this owner.
 RETURN (SELECT count(*) FROM control.evidence_runtime_artifact_archive_part entry
  JOIN control.evidence_catalogue c USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,stream_id,record_id)
  JOIN control.evidence_segment seg USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,stream_id,segment_id)
  JOIN control.evidence_segment_payload payload USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,stream_id,segment_id)
  WHERE entry.participant_id=p AND entry.privacy_domain_id=d AND entry.stream_id=a.stream_id AND entry.manifest_record_id=a.record_id
   AND entry.ordinal BETWEEN 0 AND part_count
   AND entry.record_id=CASE WHEN entry.ordinal=part_count THEN a.record_id ELSE a.manifest->'chunks'->entry.ordinal->>'recordId' END
   AND c.receipt_digest=CASE WHEN entry.ordinal=part_count THEN a.manifest_digest ELSE a.manifest->'chunks'->entry.ordinal->>'digest' END
   AND c.evidence_class='EFFECT' AND c.source_format=CASE WHEN entry.ordinal=part_count
    THEN 'OPENPC_RUNTIME_ARTIFACT_MANIFEST_V1' ELSE 'OPENPC_RUNTIME_ARTIFACT_CHUNK_V1' END
   AND c.occurred_at=input.created_at AND c.sequence BETWEEN seg.first_sequence AND seg.through_sequence
   AND seg.object_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(payload.encrypted_segment),'hex'))=part_count+1;
EXCEPTION WHEN no_data_found OR too_many_rows THEN RETURN false;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.runtime_artifact_materialization_challenge(input_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE input control.runtime_configuration_input; s control.runtime_artifact_source; wire bytea; secret bytea;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=session_user
 AND NOT rolsuper AND NOT rolbypassrls AND NOT rolcreaterole AND NOT rolcreatedb AND NOT rolreplication
 AND NOT pg_has_role(oid,'openpc_control_owner','MEMBER')
 AND NOT pg_has_role(oid,'openpc_control_key_governor','MEMBER'))

  OR pg_has_role(session_user,'openpc_control_runtime','USAGE')
  OR pg_has_role(session_user,'openpc_control_reader','USAGE'))) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;

  AND privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id() AND runtime_configuration_input_id=input_id;

 IF s.custody_root IS NULL OR s.custody_root->>'consumer_profile'='openpc:local-runtime-source-consumers:v1'

 IF NOT openpc.runtime_artifact_new_use_allowed(input.participant_id,input.privacy_domain_id,input.configuration_digest)

  OR s.custody_root->'database' IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.runtime_artifact_database_identity()
  OR input.configuration_digest IS DISTINCT FROM sha256(input.configuration_cbor)

 'privacy_domain_id',s.privacy_domain_id::text,'source_owner_id',s.source_owner_id::text,
 'source_file_binding',encode(s.source_file_binding,'hex')),'binding',s.custody_root,
  'materialization',jsonb_build_object('input',jsonb_build_object('input_id',input.runtime_configuration_input_id::text,
 'module_installation_id',input.module_installation_id::text,
 'module_configuration_generation_id',input.module_configuration_generation_id::text,
 'configuration_digest',encode(input.configuration_digest,'hex')),'reader_role',session_user::text,
   'transaction_id',pg_current_xact_id()::text,'backend_id',pg_backend_pid()::text||':'||extract(epoch FROM pg_postmaster_start_time())::text,'request_id',uuidv7()::text))::text,'UTF8');
 SELECT verifier_secret INTO STRICT secret FROM control.runtime_artifact_source_verifier_key WHERE participant_id=s.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=s.privacy_domain_id AND source_owner_id=s.source_owner_id;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('wire',(SELECT jsonb_agg(get_byte(wire,n) ORDER BY n) FROM generate_series(0,octet_length(wire)-1) n),
  'mac',(SELECT jsonb_agg(get_byte(mac,n) ORDER BY n) FROM
   (SELECT public.hmac(convert_to('OPENPC_RUNTIME_ARTIFACT_MATERIALIZATION_REQUEST_V2','UTF8')||wire,secret,'sha256') mac) m,
   generate_series(0,31) n));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.runtime_artifact_new_use_allowed(pid uuid, privacy uuid, configuration bytea)
 RETURNS boolean

 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF pid IS NULL OR privacy IS NULL OR pid IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_participant_id()
  OR privacy IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
  OR configuration IS NULL OR octet_length(configuration)<>32
  OR current_setting('transaction_isolation') NOT IN ('read committed','serializable')
  OR current_setting('row_security')<>'on' OR current_setting('session_replication_role')<>'origin'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user AND NOT rolsuper AND NOT rolbypassrls)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-AUTH-0005'; END IF;

 THEN
  -- API transactions retry only known serialization failures after rollback.
  -- Native READ COMMITTED consumers retain their existing BUSY signal.
  IF current_setting('transaction_isolation')='serializable' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001', MESSAGE='PC-DATA-6007';
  END IF;

   WHERE t.tgrelid='control.runtime_artifact_retirement'::regclass AND t.tgname=expected.name
    AND t.tgfoid=to_regprocedure(expected.signature) AND t.tgtype=expected.kind AND t.tgenabled='O'
    AND t.tgdeferrable=expected.deferred AND t.tginitdeferred=expected.deferred AND NOT t.tgisinternal
    AND t.tgnargs=0 AND t.tgqual IS NULL AND r.rolname='openpc_control_owner' AND NOT p.prosecdef))
