  WHERE c.oid='control.runtime_artifact_source_disposition'::regclass AND c.relkind='r'
   AND c.relrowsecurity AND c.relforcerowsecurity AND r.rolname='openpc_control_owner')
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=t.tgfoid JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=p.proowner
   WHERE t.tgrelid='control.runtime_artifact_source_disposition'::regclass
    AND t.tgname='runtime_artifact_source_disposition_guard'
    AND t.tgfoid=to_regprocedure('openpc.guard_runtime_artifact_source_disposition_immutable()')
    AND t.tgtype=62 AND t.tgenabled='O' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND NOT t.tgdeferrable
    AND NOT t.tginitdeferred AND t.tgnargs=0 AND t.tgqual IS NULL AND NOT p.prosecdef
    AND r.rolname='openpc_control_owner')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RUNTIME-ARTIFACT-SOURCE-OWNER-UNAVAILABLE'; END IF;
 IF current_setting('transaction_isolation')='serializable' THEN
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=p.proowner
   WHERE p.oid=to_regprocedure('openpc.lock_runtime_artifact_originals(uuid,uuid,bytea)')
    AND r.rolname='openpc_control_owner' AND p.prosecdef AND p.provolatile='v'
    AND p.proconfig=ARRAY['search_path=pg_catalog','row_security=on']::text[]
    AND p.prosrc='
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 IF pid IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_participant_id() OR privacy IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
  OR pid IS NULL OR privacy IS NULL OR configuration IS NULL OR octet_length(configuration)<>32
  OR current_setting(''transaction_isolation'')<>''serializable''
  OR current_setting(''session_replication_role'')<>''origin''
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION ''PC-AUTH-0005''; END IF;
 IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(''evidence-lifecycle:''||pid::text,0))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE=''40001'', MESSAGE=''PC-DATA-6007''; END IF;
 PERFORM input.runtime_configuration_input_id FROM control.runtime_configuration_input input
  WHERE input.participant_id=pid AND input.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND input.configuration_digest=configuration
  ORDER BY input.runtime_configuration_input_id FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE=''40001'', MESSAGE=''PC-DATA-6007'';
END ')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RUNTIME-ARTIFACT-RETIREMENT-OWNER-UNAVAILABLE'; END IF;
  PERFORM openpc.lock_runtime_artifact_originals(pid,privacy,configuration);
 END IF;
 -- Retirement mutations keep their stricter read-committed context owner.
 -- This read uses the lifecycle fence plus, for serializable callers, locked
 -- original rows above. It grants no deletion, source write or serving authority.
 RETURN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_artifact_retirement r
  WHERE r.participant_id=pid AND r.privacy_domain_id=privacy
   AND r.configuration_digest='sha256:'||encode(configuration,'hex'))
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_artifact_source_disposition d
   WHERE d.participant_id=pid AND d.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND d.configuration_digest=configuration);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.runtime_artifact_source_admission(a control.runtime_artifact_source_disposition)

BEGIN

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.runtime_artifact_source_key_installed(source_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_artifact_source_verifier_key k JOIN control.runtime_artifact_source s
  USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,source_owner_id) WHERE k.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id()
  AND k.privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id() AND k.source_owner_id=source_id AND s.database_role=session_user)
$function$
p_participant uuid, p_privacy uuid, p_bindings jsonb

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.runtime_configuration_bindings_current(p_participant uuid, p_privacy uuid, p_bindings jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control', 'openpc'
AS $function$
 SELECT openpc.matches_participant(p_participant) AND openpc.matches_privacy(p_privacy)
   AND jsonb_typeof(p_bindings)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(p_bindings)>0
   AND NOT EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_bindings) binding
     WHERE CASE binding->>'kind'
       WHEN 'ProviderProfile' THEN NOT EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM control.provider_profile p WHERE p.participant_id=p_participant
           AND p.privacy_domain_id=p_privacy AND p.provider_profile_id::text=binding->>'id'
           AND p.behavior_fingerprint=binding->>'digest' AND p.chain_id=binding->>'chainId' AND p.state<>'RETIRED')
       WHEN 'ClientIndexerProfile' THEN NOT EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM control.indexer_profile p WHERE p.participant_id=p_participant
           AND p.privacy_domain_id=p_privacy AND p.indexer_profile_id::text=binding->>'id'
           AND p.method_profile_digest=binding->>'digest' AND p.engine_version=binding->>'engineVersion' AND p.state<>'RETIRED')
       WHEN 'ProjectionPlan' THEN NOT EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM control.projection_plan p WHERE p.participant_id=p_participant
           AND p.privacy_domain_id=p_privacy AND p.projection_plan_id::text=binding->>'id'
           AND p.plan_digest=binding->>'digest' AND p.state<>'RETIRED')
       WHEN 'CiglSettings' THEN NOT EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM control.cigl_settings p WHERE p.participant_id=p_participant
           AND p.privacy_domain_id=p_privacy AND p.cigl_settings_id::text=binding->>'id')
       ELSE true END
   )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.runtime_denied_predecessor(target uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF control.runtime_denied_predecessor
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE result control.runtime_denied_predecessor; found_count integer:=0;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(false);
 FOR result IN SELECT c.* FROM control.runtime_denied_predecessor c
 JOIN control.runtime_target t USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,runtime_target_id)
 JOIN control.configuration_work w ON w.configuration_work_id=c.configuration_work_id
  AND w.participant_id=c.participant_id AND w.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
 JOIN control.runtime_target_disposition_admission a ON a.participant_id=c.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
  AND a.runtime_target_id=c.runtime_target_id AND a.revision=(SELECT max(h.revision)
   FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission h WHERE h.participant_id=c.participant_id
    AND h.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND h.runtime_target_id=c.runtime_target_id)
 WHERE c.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id() AND c.privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
  AND c.runtime_target_id=target AND t.active_generation_digest=c.last_confirmed_capsule_digest AND w.state='FAILED'
  AND w.result_receipt->>'outcome'='EXPIRED_OBSERVED_DENIED'
  AND a.binding->>'action'='Withdraw' AND a.binding->'source'->>'capsule_digest'=substring(c.capsule_digest from 8)
  AND a.binding->'source'->>'original_work_id'=w.configuration_work_id::text
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_activation_observation newer
   WHERE newer.participant_id=c.participant_id AND newer.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
    AND newer.runtime_target_id=c.runtime_target_id AND newer.configuration_work_id<>c.configuration_work_id
    AND newer.observed_at>c.created_at)
 LOOP
  found_count:=found_count+1;
  IF found_count>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DENIED-PREDECESSOR-CARDINALITY'; END IF;
  RETURN NEXT result;
 END LOOP;
END $function$
target uuid, certificate text, source jsonb

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.runtime_discovery_credential_predecessor(target uuid, certificate text, source jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE pid uuid; privacy uuid; authority record; current_credential control.credential; head jsonb;
 previous jsonb; predecessor_identity jsonb; matches integer;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_runtime_target_disposition_owner();
 SELECT * INTO STRICT authority FROM openpc.lock_runtime_discovery_authority(target,certificate);
 pid:=openpc.current_participant_id(); privacy:=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id();
 SELECT * INTO STRICT current_credential FROM control.credential c WHERE c.participant_id=pid AND c.credential_id=authority.credential_id;
 SELECT a.binding->'target' INTO head FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission a
  WHERE a.participant_id=pid AND a.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND a.runtime_target_id=target ORDER BY a.revision DESC LIMIT 1;
 IF head IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 matches:=0;
 FOR predecessor_identity IN SELECT jsonb_build_object('participant_id',pid::text,'privacy_domain_id',privacy::text,
  'target_id',target::text,'credential_id',predecessor.credential_id::text,'principal_id',predecessor.principal_id::text,
  'credential_epoch',(recovery.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorEpoch}')::numeric,
  'principal_epoch',(recovery.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,workloadPrincipalEpoch}')::numeric,
  'certificate_digest',encode(predecessor.secret_fingerprint,'hex'))
 FROM control.discovery_certificate_issuance issuance
 JOIN control.platform_recovery_case recovery ON recovery.participant_id=issuance.participant_id
  AND recovery.privacy_domain_id=issuance.privacy_domain_id AND recovery.recovery_id=issuance.recovery_id
  AND recovery.state='COMPLETED' AND recovery.completion_operation_id=issuance.committed_operation_id
  AND recovery.intent->>'schema'='pc.identity.discovery-certificate-recovery-intent'
 JOIN control.platform_recovery_enrollment enrollment ON enrollment.participant_id=recovery.participant_id
  AND enrollment.privacy_domain_id=recovery.privacy_domain_id AND enrollment.enrollment_id=recovery.enrollment_id
  AND enrollment.document->>'schema'='pc.identity.discovery-certificate-recovery-enrollment'
  AND enrollment.document->'certificateRecovery'=recovery.intent->'certificateRecovery'
  AND enrollment.document_digest=recovery.enrollment_digest
  AND enrollment.document_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(enrollment.document),'UTF8'))
 JOIN control.credential predecessor ON predecessor.participant_id=issuance.participant_id
  AND predecessor.credential_id=issuance.predecessor_credential_id
  AND predecessor.credential_id=current_credential.rotated_from_credential_id
  AND predecessor.principal_id=current_credential.principal_id AND predecessor.audience=current_credential.audience
  -- The old source issuer stays immutable. The enrolled key's new certificate
  -- is verified by the current installed issuer/profile at claim and commit;
  -- an expired predecessor CA cannot become current through equality here.
  AND predecessor.issuer=recovery.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,issuer}'
  AND predecessor.certificate_der IS NOT NULL AND sha256(predecessor.certificate_der)=predecessor.secret_fingerprint
  AND 'sha256:'||encode(predecessor.secret_fingerprint,'hex')=recovery.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorFingerprint}'
  AND 'sha256:'||encode(predecessor.public_key_digest,'hex')=recovery.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorPublicKeyDigest}'
 JOIN control.discovery_certificate_issuer_attempt attempt ON attempt.participant_id=issuance.participant_id
  AND attempt.privacy_domain_id=issuance.privacy_domain_id AND attempt.issuance_id=issuance.issuance_id
  AND attempt.state='OBSERVED' AND attempt.certificate_fingerprint=issuance.certificate_fingerprint
 JOIN control.mutation_candidate mutation ON mutation.participant_id=issuance.participant_id
  AND mutation.privacy_domain_id=issuance.privacy_domain_id AND mutation.mutation_candidate_id=issuance.mutation_candidate_id
  AND mutation.state='CONSUMED' AND mutation.consumed_operation_id=issuance.committed_operation_id
  AND mutation.candidate_digest=issuance.candidate_digest AND mutation.idempotency_key=attempt.idempotency_key
  AND mutation.maker_principal_id=attempt.maker_principal_id AND mutation.maker_session_id=attempt.maker_session_id
  AND mutation.maker_principal_id::text=recovery.intent#>>'{administrators,0,principalId}'
 JOIN control.approval_request approval ON approval.participant_id=mutation.participant_id
  AND approval.privacy_domain_id=mutation.privacy_domain_id AND approval.approval_request_id=issuance.approval_request_id
  AND approval.subject_id=mutation.mutation_candidate_id AND approval.subject_digest=mutation.candidate_digest
  AND approval.subject_version=mutation.expected_revision AND approval.state='APPROVED'
 JOIN control.approval_decision_record decision ON decision.participant_id=approval.participant_id
  AND decision.privacy_domain_id=approval.privacy_domain_id AND decision.approval_request_id=approval.approval_request_id
  AND decision.decision='APPROVE' AND decision.approver_principal_id::text=recovery.intent#>>'{administrators,1,principalId}'
  AND decision.approver_principal_id<>mutation.maker_principal_id AND decision.candidate_digest=mutation.candidate_digest
  AND decision.evidence_cbor=attempt.authorization_evidence_cbor AND decision.cose_sign1=attempt.authorization_cose
  AND sha256(attempt.authorization_evidence_cbor)=attempt.authorization_evidence_digest
 JOIN control.mfa_challenge challenge ON challenge.participant_id=mutation.participant_id
  AND challenge.principal_id=mutation.maker_principal_id AND challenge.session_id=mutation.maker_session_id
  AND challenge.resource_digest=mutation.candidate_digest AND challenge.action_intent_id=mutation.action_intent_id
  AND challenge.consumed_at IS NOT NULL AND challenge.used_operation_id=issuance.committed_operation_id
 JOIN control.mutation_evidence verification ON verification.participant_id=challenge.participant_id
  AND verification.privacy_domain_id=mutation.privacy_domain_id AND verification.principal_id=challenge.principal_id
  AND verification.mfa_challenge_id=challenge.mfa_challenge_id AND verification.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WEBAUTHN-VERIFY'
  AND verification.aggregate_type='webauthn-verification' AND verification.aggregate_id=challenge.session_id
  AND verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=attempt.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
 JOIN control.idempotency_record verified ON verified.participant_id=verification.participant_id
  AND verified.privacy_domain_id=verification.privacy_domain_id AND verified.operation_id=verification.operation_id
  AND verified.input_digest=verification.candidate_digest AND verified.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
  AND verified.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
 JOIN control.outbox_event verified_event ON verified_event.participant_id=verification.participant_id
  AND verified_event.privacy_domain_id=verification.privacy_domain_id AND verified_event.aggregate_type=verification.aggregate_type
  AND verified_event.aggregate_id=verification.aggregate_id AND verified_event.payload_cbor=verification.evidence_cbor
  AND verified_event.payload_digest=verification.evidence_digest AND verified_event.cose_sign1=verification.cose_sign1
  AND verified_event.event_type='openpc.identity.webauthn-verification.mutation.committed.v1'
  AND verified_event.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=verification.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
 WHERE issuance.participant_id=pid AND issuance.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND issuance.state='COMMITTED'
  AND issuance.successor_credential_id=current_credential.credential_id AND issuance.certificate_der=current_credential.certificate_der
  AND issuance.certificate_fingerprint=current_credential.secret_fingerprint AND sha256(issuance.certificate_der)=issuance.certificate_fingerprint
  AND octet_length(issuance.issuer_profile_digest)=32 AND issuance.replay_profile IN ('READBACK_REQUIRED','IMMUTABLE_REQUEST_RESPONSE')
  AND (issuance.replay_profile<>'IMMUTABLE_REQUEST_RESPONSE' OR (current_setting('openpc.local_qa_runtime',true)='1'
    AND enrollment.document->>'assurance'='LOCAL_QA_VIRTUAL_AUTHENTICATOR'))
  AND issuance.request_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(issuance.request),'UTF8'))
  AND issuance.request=jsonb_build_object('credentialId',current_credential.credential_id::text,'participantId',pid::text,
   'principalId',current_credential.principal_id::text,'workloadId','urn:openpc:workload:'||target::text,
   'publicKeySpkiDer',replace(encode(current_credential.public_key_spki_der,'base64'),E'
',''))
  AND recovery.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,targetId}'=target::text
  AND recovery.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,workloadPrincipalId}'=current_credential.principal_id::text
  AND (recovery.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,workloadPrincipalEpoch}')::numeric=authority.principal_epoch
  AND recovery.completion_result=jsonb_build_object('issuanceId',issuance.issuance_id::text,'operationId',issuance.committed_operation_id::text,
   'predecessorCredentialId',predecessor.credential_id::text,'successorCredentialId',current_credential.credential_id::text,
   'certificateFingerprint','sha256:'||encode(current_credential.secret_fingerprint,'hex'))
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM control.credential predecessor
    JOIN control.credential successor ON successor.participant_id=predecessor.participant_id
      AND successor.rotated_from_credential_id=predecessor.credential_id
      AND successor.principal_id=predecessor.principal_id AND successor.audience=predecessor.audience
    JOIN control.mutation_candidate candidate ON candidate.participant_id=predecessor.participant_id
      AND candidate.privacy_domain_id=privacy
      AND candidate.resource_id=predecessor.credential_id
      AND candidate.catalog_operation_id='ID-OP-WORKLOAD-ROTATE'
      AND candidate.action_intent_id='ACT-PARTICIPANTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
      AND candidate.state='CONSUMED' AND candidate.consumed_operation_id IS NOT NULL
      AND candidate.candidate_document=jsonb_build_object('replacedCredentialId',predecessor.credential_id::text,
        'credentialId',successor.credential_id::text,
        'publicKeySpkiDer',replace(encode(successor.public_key_spki_der,'base64'),E'\n',''))
      AND candidate.candidate_digest=sha256(convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(candidate.candidate_document),'UTF8'))
    JOIN control.approval_request approval ON approval.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
      AND approval.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id AND approval.subject_type='CONFIGURATION_CANDIDATE'
      AND approval.subject_id=candidate.mutation_candidate_id AND approval.subject_digest=candidate.candidate_digest
      AND approval.maker_principal_id=candidate.maker_principal_id AND approval.state='APPROVED'
      AND approval.subject_version=candidate.expected_revision AND approval.action_intent_id=candidate.action_intent_id
    JOIN control.approval_decision_record decision ON decision.participant_id=approval.participant_id
      AND decision.privacy_domain_id=approval.privacy_domain_id AND decision.approval_request_id=approval.approval_request_id
      AND decision.decision='APPROVE' AND decision.candidate_digest=candidate.candidate_digest
      AND decision.approver_principal_id<>approval.maker_principal_id AND decision.cose_sign1 IS NOT NULL
      AND decision.aggregate_version=approval.subject_version
    JOIN control.mutation_evidence evidence ON evidence.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
      AND evidence.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id AND evidence.operation_id=candidate.consumed_operation_id
      AND evidence.action_intent_id=candidate.action_intent_id AND evidence.catalog_operation_id=candidate.catalog_operation_id
      AND evidence.aggregate_type='workload-credential' AND evidence.aggregate_id=predecessor.credential_id
      AND evidence.candidate_digest=candidate.candidate_digest AND evidence.principal_id=approval.maker_principal_id
      AND evidence.checker_principal_id=decision.approver_principal_id AND evidence.approval_request_id=approval.approval_request_id
      AND evidence.evidence_digest=sha256(evidence.evidence_cbor) AND evidence.cose_sign1 IS NOT NULL
      AND evidence.evidence_cbor=decision.evidence_cbor AND evidence.cose_sign1=decision.cose_sign1
      AND evidence.signer_credential_id=decision.signer_credential_id
      AND evidence.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest IS NOT NULL AND evidence.mfa_challenge_id IS NOT NULL
    JOIN control.idempotency_record committed ON committed.participant_id=evidence.participant_id
      AND committed.privacy_domain_id=evidence.privacy_domain_id AND committed.operation_id=evidence.operation_id
      AND committed.action_intent_id=evidence.action_intent_id AND committed.catalog_operation_id=evidence.catalog_operation_id
      AND committed.principal_id=evidence.principal_id
      AND committed.terminal_state='COMMITTED' AND committed.input_digest=evidence.candidate_digest
      AND committed.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=evidence.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
      AND committed.result_payload->>'credentialId'=successor.credential_id::text
      AND committed.result_payload->>'replacedCredentialId'=predecessor.credential_id::text
      AND committed.result_payload->>'principalId'=successor.principal_id::text
      AND committed.result_payload->>'workloadId'=successor.audience
      AND committed.result_payload->>'workloadEpoch'=successor.credential_epoch::text
      AND committed.result_payload->>'state'='ACTIVE'
    JOIN control.outbox_event event ON event.participant_id=evidence.participant_id
      AND event.privacy_domain_id=evidence.privacy_domain_id AND event.aggregate_type=evidence.aggregate_type
      AND event.aggregate_id=evidence.aggregate_id AND event.payload_cbor=evidence.evidence_cbor
      AND event.event_type='openpc.identity.workload-credential.mutation.committed.v1'
      AND event.payload_digest=evidence.evidence_digest AND event.cose_sign1=evidence.cose_sign1
      AND event.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest=evidence.webauthn_assertion_binding_digest
    WHERE predecessor.participant_id=pid
      AND predecessor.credential_id=issuance.predecessor_credential_id AND successor.credential_id=issuance.successor_credential_id
      AND predecessor.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND predecessor.state='REVOKED'
      AND successor.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND successor.state='ACTIVE'
      AND predecessor.credential_epoch=(recovery.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorEpoch}')::numeric+1
      AND successor.credential_epoch=predecessor.credential_epoch
      AND successor.credential_epoch=authority.credential_epoch
      AND successor.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND successor.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
      AND evidence.operation_id=issuance.committed_operation_id
  )
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission original
   JOIN control.runtime_target_disposition_delivery delivery ON delivery.participant_id=original.participant_id
    AND delivery.privacy_domain_id=original.privacy_domain_id AND delivery.runtime_target_id=original.runtime_target_id
    AND delivery.revision=original.revision
    AND delivery.claims=original.binding||jsonb_build_object('committed_admission_digest',substring(original.admission_digest from 8))
    AND delivery.delivery_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(delivery.signed_delivery),'hex')
   JOIN control.runtime_target_disposition_acknowledgement ack ON ack.participant_id=delivery.participant_id
    AND ack.privacy_domain_id=delivery.privacy_domain_id AND ack.runtime_target_id=delivery.runtime_target_id
    AND ack.delivery_digest=delivery.delivery_digest AND ack.claims->'target'=original.binding->'target'
    AND ack.acknowledgement_digest='sha256:'||encode(sha256(ack.signed_acknowledgement),'hex')
   WHERE original.participant_id=pid AND original.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND original.runtime_target_id=target
    AND original.binding->'source'=runtime_discovery_credential_predecessor.source
    AND original.binding->'target'=jsonb_build_object('participant_id',pid::text,'privacy_domain_id',privacy::text,
     'target_id',target::text,'credential_id',predecessor.credential_id::text,'principal_id',predecessor.principal_id::text,
     'credential_epoch',(recovery.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,predecessorEpoch}')::numeric,
     'principal_epoch',(recovery.intent#>>'{certificateRecovery,workloadPrincipalEpoch}')::numeric,
     'certificate_digest',encode(predecessor.secret_fingerprint,'hex')))
 LOOP
  matches:=matches+1; previous:=predecessor_identity;
 END LOOP;
 IF matches=1 THEN RETURN previous; END IF;
 IF matches<>0 OR head IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('participant_id',pid::text,'privacy_domain_id',privacy::text,
  'target_id',target::text,'credential_id',current_credential.credential_id::text,'principal_id',current_credential.principal_id::text,
  'credential_epoch',authority.credential_epoch,'principal_epoch',authority.principal_epoch,
  'certificate_digest',substring(certificate from 8))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET-DISPOSITION-CREDENTIAL-SUCCESSOR'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.runtime_generation_retry_failure_payload(prior control.runtime_configuration_generation, work control.configuration_work)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE payload bytea;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(false);
 IF prior.runtime_configuration_generation_id IS NULL OR work.configuration_work_id IS NULL
  OR prior.runtime_target_id IS NULL OR prior.generation_digest IS NULL
  OR prior.participant_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_participant_id()
  OR prior.privacy_domain_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
  OR prior.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'FAILED' OR prior.activated_at IS NOT NULL OR prior.cigl_profile_selection IS NOT NULL
  OR work.participant_id IS DISTINCT FROM prior.participant_id
  OR work.privacy_domain_id IS DISTINCT FROM prior.privacy_domain_id
  OR work.runtime_configuration_generation_id IS DISTINCT FROM prior.runtime_configuration_generation_id
  OR work.operation_id IS NULL OR work.last_error_code IS NULL
  OR work.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'FAILED' OR work.work_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'RUNTIME_ACTIVATION'
  OR work.runtime_target_id IS DISTINCT FROM prior.runtime_target_id OR work.resource_id IS DISTINCT FROM prior.runtime_target_id
  OR work.generation_digest IS DISTINCT FROM prior.generation_digest
  OR work.predecessor_digest IS DISTINCT FROM prior.predecessor_digest
  OR work.execution_started_at IS NOT NULL OR work.execution_attempt_id IS NOT NULL
  OR work.lease_owner IS NOT NULL OR work.lease_until IS NOT NULL OR work.reconcile_after IS NOT NULL
  OR work.completed_at IS NULL OR work.result_event_id IS NULL
  OR work.result_receipt IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('errorCode',work.last_error_code,
    'resourceId',work.resource_id::text,'terminal',true,'workKind','RUNTIME_ACTIVATION')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007-RUNTIME-RETRY'; END IF;
 payload:=convert_to(openpc.signing_canonical_json(work.result_receipt),'UTF8');
 IF work.result_receipt_digest IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||encode(sha256(payload),'hex')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007-RUNTIME-RETRY'; END IF;
 RETURN payload;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.runtime_installed_predecessor(target uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE installed text; confirmed text;
BEGIN
 SELECT c.capsule_digest INTO installed FROM openpc.runtime_denied_predecessor(target) c;
 IF FOUND THEN RETURN installed; END IF;
 SELECT t.active_generation_digest INTO STRICT confirmed FROM control.runtime_target t
  WHERE t.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id() AND t.privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
   AND t.runtime_target_id=target;
 -- A missing current cursor is not proof the old confirmed capsule is installed.
 -- Only a genuinely completed later effect can supersede the physical denial.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_denied_predecessor c
  WHERE c.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id() AND c.privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
   AND c.runtime_target_id=target AND NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM control.configuration_work w JOIN control.runtime_activation_observation o
     USING(configuration_work_id,participant_id,privacy_domain_id,runtime_target_id,execution_attempt_id)
    WHERE w.participant_id=c.participant_id AND w.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND w.runtime_target_id=c.runtime_target_id
     AND w.state='COMPLETED' AND w.completed_at>c.created_at AND o.observed_at>c.created_at
     AND o.capsule_digest=confirmed AND w.result_event_id IS NOT NULL))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DENIED-PREDECESSOR-UNAVAILABLE'; END IF;
 RETURN confirmed;
END $function$
pid uuid, privacy uuid, target uuid

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.runtime_target_discovery_current(pid uuid, privacy uuid, target uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce((SELECT NOT t.requires_authenticated_discovery OR EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_target_connection observation
  JOIN control.credential credential ON credential.participant_id=observation.participant_id
   AND credential.credential_id=observation.credential_id
  JOIN control.principal principal ON principal.participant_id=credential.participant_id
   AND principal.principal_id=credential.principal_id
  JOIN control.participant participant ON participant.participant_id=principal.participant_id
  JOIN control.privacy_domain privacy_domain ON privacy_domain.participant_id=observation.participant_id
   AND privacy_domain.privacy_domain_id=observation.privacy_domain_id
  WHERE observation.participant_id=pid AND observation.privacy_domain_id=privacy
   AND observation.runtime_target_id=target AND observation.connected
   AND observation.observed_at<=clock_timestamp() AND observation.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
   AND credential.kind='WORKLOAD_MTLS' AND credential.state='ACTIVE'
   AND credential.credential_epoch=observation.credential_epoch
   AND credential.valid_from<=clock_timestamp() AND credential.valid_until>clock_timestamp()
   AND credential.subject='urn:openpc:participant:'||pid::text||':workload:'||target::text
   AND credential.audience='urn:openpc:workload:'||target::text
   AND credential.secret_fingerprint=decode(substring(observation.certificate_digest from 8),'hex')
   AND credential.certificate_der IS NOT NULL AND sha256(credential.certificate_der)=credential.secret_fingerprint
   AND principal.kind='WORKLOAD' AND principal.state='ACTIVE' AND principal.authority_epoch=observation.principal_epoch
   AND participant.state='ACTIVE' AND participant.archived_at IS NULL AND privacy_domain.state='ACTIVE')
  FROM control.runtime_target t WHERE t.participant_id=pid AND t.privacy_domain_id=privacy
   AND t.runtime_target_id=target AND pid=openpc.current_participant_id() AND privacy=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()),false)
$function$
target uuid, wanted_revision bigint, wanted_digest text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.runtime_unsigned_withdrawal_recoverable(target uuid, wanted_revision bigint, wanted_digest text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE pid uuid; privacy uuid; abandoned control.runtime_target_disposition_admission;
 previous control.runtime_target_disposition_admission; delivery control.runtime_target_disposition_delivery;
 failed control.configuration_work; generation control.runtime_configuration_generation; payload bytea;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 pid:=openpc.current_participant_id(); privacy:=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id();
 IF target IS NULL OR wanted_revision IS NULL OR wanted_revision<2 OR wanted_digest IS NULL
  OR openpc.current_action_intent_id() NOT IN ('ACT-RUNTIME_TARGETS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1',
   'ACT-RUNTIME_CONFIGURATION_GENERATIONS_ACTIVATE_RESOURCE-V1') THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('evidence-lifecycle:'||pid::text,0))
  OR NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('runtime-target-disposition:'||pid::text||':'||privacy::text||':'||target::text,0))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007'; END IF;
 SELECT a.* INTO abandoned FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission a
  WHERE a.participant_id=pid AND a.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND a.runtime_target_id=target
   AND a.revision=wanted_revision AND a.admission_digest=wanted_digest FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 IF NOT FOUND OR abandoned.binding->>'action' IS DISTINCT FROM 'Withdraw'
  OR abandoned.activation_proof IS NOT NULL OR abandoned.restoration_proof IS NOT NULL
  OR abandoned.binding->'cause'->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'Activation'
  OR abandoned.binding->'cause'->'execution_attempt_id' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_delivery d WHERE d.participant_id=pid
   AND d.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND d.runtime_target_id=target AND d.revision=wanted_revision)
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 SELECT a.* INTO previous FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission a
  WHERE a.participant_id=pid AND a.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND a.runtime_target_id=target
   AND a.revision=wanted_revision-1 FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 IF NOT FOUND OR previous.binding->>'action' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ConfirmActivation'
  OR previous.binding->'target' IS DISTINCT FROM abandoned.binding->'target'
  OR previous.binding->'source' IS DISTINCT FROM abandoned.binding->'source'
  OR abandoned.binding->'previous_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(previous.revision)
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 SELECT d.* INTO delivery FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_delivery d
  WHERE d.participant_id=pid AND d.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND d.runtime_target_id=target
   AND d.revision=previous.revision;
 IF NOT FOUND OR abandoned.binding->>'previous_delivery_digest' IS DISTINCT FROM substring(delivery.delivery_digest from 8)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_acknowledgement k
   WHERE k.participant_id=pid AND k.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND k.runtime_target_id=target
    AND k.delivery_digest=delivery.delivery_digest AND k.claims->>'installed_state'='ActivationConfirmed')
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 SELECT w.* INTO failed FROM control.configuration_work w WHERE w.participant_id=pid AND w.privacy_domain_id=privacy
  AND w.runtime_target_id=target AND w.configuration_work_id::text=abandoned.binding->'cause'->>'work_id' FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 IF NOT FOUND OR abandoned.binding->'cause' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('kind','Activation',
  'work_id',failed.configuration_work_id::text,'operation_id',failed.operation_id::text,'execution_attempt_id',NULL)
  OR failed.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'FAILED' OR failed.work_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'RUNTIME_ACTIVATION'
  OR failed.execution_started_at IS NOT NULL OR failed.execution_attempt_id IS NOT NULL
  OR failed.predecessor_digest IS DISTINCT FROM 'sha256:'||(abandoned.binding->'source'->>'capsule_digest')
  OR failed.configuration_work_id::text=abandoned.binding->'source'->>'original_work_id'
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 SELECT g.* INTO generation FROM control.runtime_configuration_generation g
  WHERE g.participant_id=pid AND g.privacy_domain_id=privacy
   AND g.runtime_configuration_generation_id=failed.runtime_configuration_generation_id FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 payload:=openpc.runtime_generation_retry_failure_payload(generation,failed);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.outbox_event e JOIN control.mutation_evidence a
  ON a.participant_id=e.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=e.privacy_domain_id
   AND a.operation_id=failed.operation_id AND a.aggregate_id=target
   AND a.action_intent_id='ACT-RUNTIME_TARGETS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1'
   AND a.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-UPDATE-RUNTIME-TARGET'
   AND a.evidence_role='AUTHORIZATION_INPUT' AND a.evidence_format='IDENTITY_RUNTIME_ASSERTION_3002_2_13'
  JOIN control.idempotency_record i ON i.participant_id=a.participant_id AND i.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id
   AND i.operation_id=a.operation_id AND i.input_digest=a.candidate_digest AND i.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
   AND i.result_payload->>'state'='FAILED' AND i.result_payload->>'truthState'='FAILED'
  WHERE e.participant_id=pid AND e.privacy_domain_id=privacy AND e.event_id=failed.result_event_id
   AND e.aggregate_id=target AND e.aggregate_type='runtime-targets' AND e.event_type='runtime-target.activation-failed.v1'
   AND e.payload_cbor=payload AND e.payload_digest=sha256(payload) AND e.cose_sign1=a.cose_sign1
   AND octet_length(a.cose_sign1)>0 AND a.evidence_digest=sha256(a.evidence_cbor))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_activation_observation o
   WHERE o.configuration_work_id=failed.configuration_work_id OR o.runtime_configuration_generation_id=generation.runtime_configuration_generation_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.policy_activation_occurrence_target o
   WHERE o.configuration_work_id=failed.configuration_work_id OR o.runtime_configuration_generation_id=generation.runtime_configuration_generation_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission a
   WHERE a.runtime_target_id=target AND (a.binding->'source'->>'original_work_id'=failed.configuration_work_id::text
    OR a.binding->'source'->>'runtime_configuration_generation_id'=generation.runtime_configuration_generation_id::text))
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN true;
EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6007';
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.runtime_work_predecessor_matches(wanted uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN w.denied_predecessor_work_id IS NULL THEN t.active_generation_digest IS NOT DISTINCT FROM w.predecessor_digest
 ELSE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_denied_predecessor c
  JOIN control.configuration_work original ON original.configuration_work_id=c.configuration_work_id
   AND original.participant_id=c.participant_id AND original.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
  WHERE c.configuration_work_id=w.denied_predecessor_work_id AND c.participant_id=w.participant_id
   AND c.privacy_domain_id=w.privacy_domain_id AND c.runtime_target_id=w.runtime_target_id
   AND c.capsule_digest=w.predecessor_digest AND c.last_confirmed_capsule_digest=t.active_generation_digest
   AND w.created_at>=c.created_at AND original.state='FAILED'
   AND original.result_receipt->>'outcome'='EXPIRED_OBSERVED_DENIED'
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_activation_observation newer
    WHERE newer.participant_id=c.participant_id AND newer.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id
     AND newer.runtime_target_id=c.runtime_target_id AND newer.observed_at>c.created_at
     AND newer.configuration_work_id<>w.configuration_work_id)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission a
    WHERE a.participant_id=c.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND a.runtime_target_id=c.runtime_target_id
     AND a.revision=(SELECT max(h.revision) FROM control.runtime_target_disposition_admission h
      WHERE h.participant_id=c.participant_id AND h.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND h.runtime_target_id=c.runtime_target_id)
     AND ((a.binding->>'action'='Withdraw' AND a.binding->'source'->>'capsule_digest'=substring(c.capsule_digest from 8)
       AND a.binding->'source'->>'original_work_id'=c.configuration_work_id::text
       AND (a.revision=c.denial_revision OR a.binding->'cause'->>'work_id'=w.configuration_work_id::text))
      OR(a.binding->>'action'='ConfirmActivation' AND a.binding->'source'->>'original_work_id'=w.configuration_work_id::text
       AND a.binding->'cause'->>'execution_attempt_id'=w.execution_attempt_id::text)))) END
 FROM control.configuration_work w JOIN control.runtime_target t USING(participant_id,privacy_domain_id,runtime_target_id)
 WHERE w.configuration_work_id=wanted AND w.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id()
  AND w.privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
$function$
p_participant uuid, p_session uuid, p_principal uuid

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.session_step_up_valid_until(p_participant uuid, p_session uuid, p_principal uuid)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN session.step_up_mfa_challenge_id IS NULL THEN session.step_up_verified_at+interval '5 minutes'
  ELSE (SELECT least(challenge.consumed_at+make_interval(secs=>challenge.verified_proof_max_age_ms/1000.0),
    challenge.expires_at,session.idle_expires_at,session.absolute_expires_at,credential.valid_until)
   FROM control.mfa_challenge challenge JOIN control.credential credential
    ON credential.participant_id=challenge.participant_id AND credential.principal_id=challenge.principal_id
    AND credential.credential_id=challenge.signer_credential_id AND credential.credential_epoch=challenge.signer_credential_epoch
    AND credential.kind='WEBAUTHN' AND credential.state='ACTIVE' AND credential.valid_from<=clock_timestamp()
    AND (credential.valid_until IS NULL OR credential.valid_until>clock_timestamp())
   WHERE challenge.participant_id=session.participant_id AND challenge.principal_id=session.principal_id
    AND challenge.session_id=session.session_id AND challenge.mfa_challenge_id=session.step_up_mfa_challenge_id
    AND challenge.consumed_at=session.step_up_verified_at AND challenge.created_at<=challenge.consumed_at
    AND challenge.consumed_at<=clock_timestamp()
    AND (challenge.verified_proof_max_age_ms=300000 OR
      (challenge.verified_proof_max_age_ms=3000000 AND session.duration_profile='LOCAL_QA_10X'))) END
 FROM control.session session
 JOIN control.participant participant ON participant.participant_id=session.participant_id
  AND participant.state='ACTIVE' AND participant.authority_epoch=session.participant_epoch
 JOIN control.principal principal ON principal.participant_id=session.participant_id
  AND principal.principal_id=session.principal_id AND principal.state='ACTIVE'
  AND principal.authority_epoch=session.authority_epoch
 WHERE session.participant_id=p_participant AND session.session_id=p_session AND session.principal_id=p_principal
  AND session.state='ACTIVE' AND session.idle_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND session.absolute_expires_at>clock_timestamp()
$function$
p_mode text, p_participant_id uuid, p_privacy_domain_id uuid, p_operation_id uuid, p_action_intent_id text, p_require_privacy boolean
p_participant uuid, p_privacy uuid, p_signer text, p_operation uuid

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.signing_admission_open(p_participant uuid, p_privacy uuid, p_signer text, p_operation uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_key_rotation r JOIN control.signing_rotation_command c
  ON c.participant_id=r.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND c.rotation_id=r.rotation_id
  WHERE r.participant_id=p_participant AND r.privacy_domain_id=p_privacy AND p_signer IN(r.old_signer_id,r.new_signer_id)
   AND c.state='WRITE_AMBIGUITY' AND c.operation_id<>p_operation AND NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_rotation_command recovery WHERE recovery.participant_id=c.participant_id
     AND recovery.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND recovery.rotation_id=c.rotation_id
     AND recovery.operation_id=p_operation AND recovery.original_operation_id=c.operation_id
     AND recovery.action_intent_id='ACT-SIGNING_KEY_ROTATIONS_RECOVER_RESOURCE-V1' AND recovery.state='ACCEPTED'))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.signing_attempt_authority_status(p_attempt uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE command control.signing_rotation_command%ROWTYPE; snapshot jsonb; dependency record;
 actual jsonb; current_rows jsonb:='{}'::jsonb; unchanged boolean:=true; live boolean; approval jsonb; locked_count bigint;
BEGIN
 SELECT c.* INTO STRICT command FROM control.signing_rotation_command c JOIN control.signing_provider_attempt a
  ON a.participant_id=c.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND a.operation_id=c.operation_id
  WHERE a.attempt_id=p_attempt AND c.participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id()
   AND c.privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id()
   AND c.action_intent_id='ACT-SIGNING_KEY_ROTATIONS_ADVANCE_RESOURCE-V1';
 snapshot:=convert_from(command.authorization_snapshot,'UTF8')::jsonb;
 IF sha256(command.authorization_snapshot)<>command.authorization_snapshot_digest
  OR snapshot->>'schema'<>'pc.control.precommit-authority-snapshot.v1'
  OR snapshot->>'operationId'<>command.operation_id::text OR snapshot->>'decision'<>'ALLOW'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-CONTINUATION-RETAINED-AUTHORITY'; END IF;
 FOR dependency IN SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'assignment'::text table_name,'assignment_id'::text column_name,
 2 rank,(d->>'assignment_id')::uuid id
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'assignment') d
UNION ALL
SELECT 'authority_envelope'::text table_name,'authority_envelope_id'::text column_name,
 2 rank,(d->>'authority_envelope_id')::uuid id
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'authority_envelope') d
UNION ALL
SELECT 'authority_role'::text table_name,'authority_role_id'::text column_name,
 undefined rank,(d->>'authority_role_id')::uuid id
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'authority_role') d
UNION ALL
SELECT 'credential'::text table_name,'credential_id'::text column_name,
 3 rank,(d->>'credential_id')::uuid id
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'credential') d
UNION ALL
SELECT 'delegation'::text table_name,'delegation_id'::text column_name,
 3 rank,(d->>'delegation_id')::uuid id
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'delegation') d
UNION ALL
SELECT 'participant'::text table_name,'participant_id'::text column_name,
 0 rank,(d->>'participant_id')::uuid id
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'participant') d
UNION ALL
SELECT 'principal'::text table_name,'principal_id'::text column_name,
 2 rank,(d->>'principal_id')::uuid id
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'principal') d
UNION ALL
SELECT 'privacy_domain'::text table_name,'privacy_domain_id'::text column_name,
 1 rank,(d->>'privacy_domain_id')::uuid id
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'privacy_domain') d
UNION ALL
SELECT 'session'::text table_name,'session_id'::text column_name,
 3 rank,(d->>'session_id')::uuid id
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'session') d) dependencies ORDER BY rank,id,table_name LOOP
  EXECUTE format('SELECT %I FROM control.%I WHERE participant_id=$1 AND %I=$2 FOR SHARE',
   dependency.column_name,dependency.table_name,dependency.column_name) USING command.participant_id,dependency.id;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS locked_count=ROW_COUNT;
  IF locked_count<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-CONTINUATION-MISSING-AUTHORITY'; END IF;
 END LOOP;

 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('assignment_id',owner.assignment_id::text,'participant_id',owner.participant_id::text,'principal_id',owner.principal_id::text,'authority_group_id',owner.authority_group_id::text,'role_id',owner.role_id::text,'authority_envelope_id',owner.authority_envelope_id::text,'delegation_epoch',owner.delegation_epoch::text,'scope_digest',owner.scope_digest::text,'privacy_domain_ids',owner.privacy_domain_ids::text,'action_intent_ids',owner.action_intent_ids::text,'runtime_capability_ids',owner.runtime_capability_ids::text,'resource_ids',owner.resource_ids::text,'risk_classes',owner.risk_classes::text,'maker_checker_required',owner.maker_checker_required::text,'step_up_required',owner.step_up_required::text,'onward_delegation_depth',owner.onward_delegation_depth::text,'valid_during',owner.valid_during::text,'state',owner.state::text,'created_by_principal_id',owner.created_by_principal_id::text,'row_version',owner.row_version::text) ORDER BY owner.assignment_id),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO actual FROM control.assignment owner WHERE owner.participant_id=command.participant_id
 AND owner.assignment_id IN(SELECT (d->>'assignment_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'assignment') d);

 -- An immutable pre-migration snapshot omitted runtime grants. Preserve its
 -- comparison/digest shape only while the actual owner still grants none.
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN current_row->>'runtime_capability_ids'='{}'
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'assignment') retained
     WHERE retained->>'assignment_id'=current_row->>'assignment_id' AND NOT retained ? 'runtime_capability_ids')
   THEN current_row-'runtime_capability_ids' ELSE current_row END ORDER BY current_row->>'assignment_id'),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO actual FROM jsonb_array_elements(actual) current_row;

 current_rows:=current_rows||jsonb_build_object('assignment',actual);
 IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM snapshot->'dependencies'->'assignment'
 THEN unchanged:=false; END IF;

 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('authority_envelope_id',owner.authority_envelope_id::text,'participant_id',owner.participant_id::text,'principal_id',owner.principal_id::text,'maker_principal_id',owner.maker_principal_id::text,'checker_principal_id',owner.checker_principal_id::text,'authority_epoch',owner.authority_epoch::text,'delegation_epoch',owner.delegation_epoch::text,'state',owner.state::text,'valid_from',owner.valid_from::text,'valid_until',owner.valid_until::text,'semantic_digest',owner.semantic_digest::text,'privacy_domain_ids',owner.privacy_domain_ids::text,'action_intent_ids',owner.action_intent_ids::text,'runtime_capability_ids',owner.runtime_capability_ids::text,'resource_ids',owner.resource_ids::text,'risk_classes',owner.risk_classes::text,'maker_checker_required',owner.maker_checker_required::text,'step_up_required',owner.step_up_required::text,'onward_delegation_depth',owner.onward_delegation_depth::text,'row_version',owner.row_version::text) ORDER BY owner.authority_envelope_id),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO actual FROM control.authority_envelope owner WHERE owner.participant_id=command.participant_id
 AND owner.authority_envelope_id IN(SELECT (d->>'authority_envelope_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'authority_envelope') d);

 -- An immutable pre-migration snapshot omitted runtime grants. Preserve its
 -- comparison/digest shape only while the actual owner still grants none.
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN current_row->>'runtime_capability_ids'='{}'
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'authority_envelope') retained
     WHERE retained->>'authority_envelope_id'=current_row->>'authority_envelope_id' AND NOT retained ? 'runtime_capability_ids')
   THEN current_row-'runtime_capability_ids' ELSE current_row END ORDER BY current_row->>'authority_envelope_id'),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO actual FROM jsonb_array_elements(actual) current_row;

 current_rows:=current_rows||jsonb_build_object('authority_envelope',actual);
 IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM snapshot->'dependencies'->'authority_envelope'
 THEN unchanged:=false; END IF;

 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('authority_role_id',owner.authority_role_id::text,'participant_id',owner.participant_id::text,'role_id',owner.role_id::text,'action_intent_ids',owner.action_intent_ids::text,'state',owner.state::text,'row_version',owner.row_version::text) ORDER BY owner.authority_role_id),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO actual FROM control.authority_role owner WHERE owner.participant_id=command.participant_id
 AND owner.authority_role_id IN(SELECT (d->>'authority_role_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'authority_role') d);

 current_rows:=current_rows||jsonb_build_object('authority_role',actual);
 IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM snapshot->'dependencies'->'authority_role'
 THEN unchanged:=false; END IF;

 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('credential_id',owner.credential_id::text,'participant_id',owner.participant_id::text,'principal_id',owner.principal_id::text,'kind',owner.kind::text,'state',owner.state::text,'credential_epoch',owner.credential_epoch::text,'valid_from',owner.valid_from::text,'valid_until',owner.valid_until::text,'public_key_digest',owner.public_key_digest::text,'row_version',owner.row_version::text) ORDER BY owner.credential_id),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO actual FROM control.credential owner WHERE owner.participant_id=command.participant_id
 AND owner.credential_id IN(SELECT (d->>'credential_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'credential') d);

 current_rows:=current_rows||jsonb_build_object('credential',actual);
 IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM snapshot->'dependencies'->'credential' AND NOT (
  jsonb_array_length(actual)=jsonb_array_length(snapshot->'dependencies'->'credential') AND NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'credential') retained WHERE NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(actual) current_row WHERE (retained-'row_version')=(current_row-'row_version')
     AND (current_row->>'row_version')::bigint>=(retained->>'row_version')::bigint)))
 THEN unchanged:=false; END IF;

 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('delegation_id',owner.delegation_id::text,'participant_id',owner.participant_id::text,'parent_assignment_id',owner.parent_assignment_id::text,'parent_delegation_id',owner.parent_delegation_id::text,'grantor_principal_id',owner.grantor_principal_id::text,'delegate_principal_id',owner.delegate_principal_id::text,'delegation_epoch',owner.delegation_epoch::text,'scope_digest',owner.scope_digest::text,'privacy_domain_ids',owner.privacy_domain_ids::text,'action_intent_ids',owner.action_intent_ids::text,'runtime_capability_ids',owner.runtime_capability_ids::text,'resource_ids',owner.resource_ids::text,'risk_classes',owner.risk_classes::text,'maker_checker_required',owner.maker_checker_required::text,'step_up_required',owner.step_up_required::text,'onward_delegation_depth',owner.onward_delegation_depth::text,'valid_during',owner.valid_during::text,'state',owner.state::text,'row_version',owner.row_version::text) ORDER BY owner.delegation_id),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO actual FROM control.delegation owner WHERE owner.participant_id=command.participant_id
 AND owner.delegation_id IN(SELECT (d->>'delegation_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'delegation') d);

 -- An immutable pre-migration snapshot omitted runtime grants. Preserve its
 -- comparison/digest shape only while the actual owner still grants none.
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN current_row->>'runtime_capability_ids'='{}'
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'delegation') retained
     WHERE retained->>'delegation_id'=current_row->>'delegation_id' AND NOT retained ? 'runtime_capability_ids')
   THEN current_row-'runtime_capability_ids' ELSE current_row END ORDER BY current_row->>'delegation_id'),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO actual FROM jsonb_array_elements(actual) current_row;

 current_rows:=current_rows||jsonb_build_object('delegation',actual);
 IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM snapshot->'dependencies'->'delegation'
 THEN unchanged:=false; END IF;

 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('participant_id',owner.participant_id::text,'state',owner.state::text,'authority_epoch',owner.authority_epoch::text,'row_version',owner.row_version::text) ORDER BY owner.participant_id),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO actual FROM control.participant owner WHERE owner.participant_id=command.participant_id
 AND owner.participant_id IN(SELECT (d->>'participant_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'participant') d);

 current_rows:=current_rows||jsonb_build_object('participant',actual);
 IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM snapshot->'dependencies'->'participant'
 THEN unchanged:=false; END IF;

 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('principal_id',owner.principal_id::text,'participant_id',owner.participant_id::text,'kind',owner.kind::text,'state',owner.state::text,'authority_epoch',owner.authority_epoch::text,'row_version',owner.row_version::text) ORDER BY owner.principal_id),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO actual FROM control.principal owner WHERE owner.participant_id=command.participant_id
 AND owner.principal_id IN(SELECT (d->>'principal_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'principal') d);

 current_rows:=current_rows||jsonb_build_object('principal',actual);
 IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM snapshot->'dependencies'->'principal'
 THEN unchanged:=false; END IF;

 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('privacy_domain_id',owner.privacy_domain_id::text,'participant_id',owner.participant_id::text,'state',owner.state::text,'row_version',owner.row_version::text) ORDER BY owner.privacy_domain_id),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO actual FROM control.privacy_domain owner WHERE owner.participant_id=command.participant_id
 AND owner.privacy_domain_id IN(SELECT (d->>'privacy_domain_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'privacy_domain') d);

 current_rows:=current_rows||jsonb_build_object('privacy_domain',actual);
 IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM snapshot->'dependencies'->'privacy_domain'
 THEN unchanged:=false; END IF;

 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('session_id',owner.session_id::text,'participant_id',owner.participant_id::text,'principal_id',owner.principal_id::text,'state',owner.state::text,'participant_epoch',owner.participant_epoch::text,'authority_epoch',owner.authority_epoch::text,'delegation_epoch',owner.delegation_epoch::text,'session_epoch',owner.session_epoch::text,'issued_at',owner.issued_at::text,'idle_expires_at',owner.idle_expires_at::text,'absolute_expires_at',owner.absolute_expires_at::text,'step_up_verified_at',owner.step_up_verified_at::text,'row_version',owner.row_version::text) ORDER BY owner.session_id),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO actual FROM control.session owner WHERE owner.participant_id=command.participant_id
 AND owner.session_id IN(SELECT (d->>'session_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'session') d);

 current_rows:=current_rows||jsonb_build_object('session',actual);
 IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM snapshot->'dependencies'->'session' AND NOT (
  jsonb_array_length(actual)=jsonb_array_length(snapshot->'dependencies'->'session') AND NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(snapshot->'dependencies'->'session') retained WHERE NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(actual) current_row WHERE
     (retained-ARRAY['idle_expires_at','row_version'])=(current_row-ARRAY['idle_expires_at','row_version'])
     AND (current_row->>'row_version')::bigint>=(retained->>'row_version')::bigint
     AND (current_row->>'idle_expires_at')::timestamptz>=(retained->>'idle_expires_at')::timestamptz)))
 THEN unchanged:=false; END IF;
 SELECT NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM control.session s WHERE s.participant_id=command.participant_id
   AND s.session_id IN(SELECT (d->>'session_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(current_rows->'session') d)
   AND (s.state<>'ACTIVE' OR s.issued_at>clock_timestamp() OR s.idle_expires_at<=clock_timestamp() OR s.absolute_expires_at<=clock_timestamp())
  UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM control.authority_envelope e WHERE e.participant_id=command.participant_id
   AND e.authority_envelope_id IN(SELECT (d->>'authority_envelope_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(current_rows->'authority_envelope') d)
   AND (e.state<>'ACTIVE' OR e.valid_from>clock_timestamp() OR e.valid_until<=clock_timestamp())
  UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM control.assignment a WHERE a.participant_id=command.participant_id
   AND a.assignment_id IN(SELECT (d->>'assignment_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(current_rows->'assignment') d)
   AND (a.state<>'ACTIVE' OR NOT a.valid_during @> clock_timestamp())
  UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM control.delegation d WHERE d.participant_id=command.participant_id
   AND d.delegation_id IN(SELECT (r->>'delegation_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(current_rows->'delegation') r)
   AND (d.state<>'ACTIVE' OR NOT d.valid_during @> clock_timestamp())
  UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM control.credential c WHERE c.participant_id=command.participant_id
   AND c.credential_id IN(SELECT (d->>'credential_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements(current_rows->'credential') d)
   AND (c.state<>'ACTIVE' OR c.valid_from>clock_timestamp() OR c.valid_until<=clock_timestamp())
 ) INTO live;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('approvalRequestId',a.approval_request_id::text,'state',a.state,
  'expiresAt',a.expires_at::text,'candidateDigest',encode(a.subject_digest,'hex'),
  'live',a.state='APPROVED' AND a.expires_at>clock_timestamp()) INTO STRICT approval
 FROM control.approval_request a
 WHERE a.participant_id=command.participant_id AND a.privacy_domain_id=command.privacy_domain_id
  AND a.approval_request_id=command.approval_request_id AND a.subject_digest=command.approval_candidate_digest
 FOR SHARE OF a;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('unchangedLive',unchanged AND live AND (approval->>'live')::boolean,
  'dependencies',current_rows,'approval',approval);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.signing_continuation_authority_digest(p_status jsonb)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT sha256(convert_to(jsonb_set(jsonb_set(p_status,'{dependencies,session}',
  (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value-ARRAY['idle_expires_at','row_version'] ORDER BY value->>'session_id'),'[]'::jsonb)
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_status->'dependencies'->'session') value)),'{dependencies,credential}',
  (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value-'row_version' ORDER BY value->>'credential_id'),'[]'::jsonb)
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_status->'dependencies'->'credential') value))::text,'UTF8'))
$function$
p_participant uuid, p_privacy uuid, p_rotation uuid, p_action text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.signing_governance_required(p_participant uuid, p_privacy uuid, p_rotation uuid, p_action text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_key_rotation r WHERE r.participant_id=p_participant AND r.privacy_domain_id=p_privacy
  AND r.rotation_id=p_rotation AND ((p_action='ACT-SIGNING_KEY_ROTATIONS_RECOVER_RESOURCE-V1' AND
   (r.state='FAILED' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_rotation_authority_hold h
     WHERE h.participant_id=r.participant_id AND h.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND h.rotation_id=r.rotation_id AND h.state='ACTIVE')))
   OR (p_action='ACT-SIGNING_KEY_ROTATIONS_ADVANCE_RESOURCE-V1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_rotation_command c
    WHERE c.participant_id=r.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id=r.privacy_domain_id AND c.rotation_id=r.rotation_id
     AND c.from_revision=r.revision AND c.state='FAILED' AND c.result_kind='AUTHORITY_CHANGED_BEFORE_DISPATCH'))))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.signing_observation_preimage(a control.signing_provider_attempt, p_kind text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT convert_to(jsonb_build_object('schema','pc.control.signing-observation.v1',
  'participantId',a.participant_id,'privacyDomainId',a.privacy_domain_id,'rotationId',a.rotation_id,
  'operationId',a.operation_id,'attemptId',a.attempt_id,'method',a.request->>'method',
  'requestDigest',encode(a.request_digest,'hex'),'kind',p_kind,
  'providerObservationDigest',CASE WHEN p_kind='PROVIDER_RESULT' THEN encode(a.observation_digest,'hex') ELSE NULL END)::text,'UTF8')
$function$
p_attempt uuid, p_kind text, p_assertion uuid

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.signing_operation_failure_preimage(p_attempt uuid, p_kind text, p_assertion uuid)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE a control.signing_provider_attempt%ROWTYPE; c control.signing_rotation_command%ROWTYPE;
 authority jsonb; assertion control.signing_continuation%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM control.signing_provider_attempt WHERE participant_id=openpc.current_participant_id()
  AND privacy_domain_id=openpc.current_privacy_domain_id() AND attempt_id=p_attempt;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM control.signing_rotation_command WHERE participant_id=a.participant_id
  AND privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND operation_id=a.operation_id;
 IF c.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM openpc.current_operation_id() OR c.action_intent_id<>'ACT-SIGNING_KEY_ROTATIONS_ADVANCE_RESOURCE-V1'
  OR openpc.current_action_intent_id()<>c.action_intent_id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-NO-EFFECT-CONTEXT'; END IF;
 IF p_kind='AUTHORITY_CHANGED_BEFORE_DISPATCH' THEN
  authority:=openpc.signing_attempt_authority_status(p_attempt);
  IF p_assertion IS NOT NULL OR (authority->>'unchangedLive')::boolean OR a.dispatched_at_ns IS NOT NULL
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.signing_provider_attempt other WHERE other.participant_id=a.participant_id
    AND other.privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND other.operation_id=a.operation_id
    AND (other.state NOT IN ('READY','CANCELLED') OR other.dispatched_at_ns IS NOT NULL OR other.observation IS NOT NULL))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-UNDISPATCHED-AUTHORITY-FAILURE'; END IF;
 ELSIF p_kind='NO_EFFECT_RETRYABLE' THEN
  SELECT * INTO STRICT assertion FROM control.signing_continuation WHERE participant_id=a.participant_id
   AND privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND operation_id=a.operation_id AND provider_attempt_id=a.attempt_id
   AND assertion_id=p_assertion AND state IN ('ISSUED','CONSUMED');
  IF a.state NOT IN ('OBSERVED','REJECTED') OR a.dispatched_at_ns IS NULL OR a.observation->>'outcome' IS DISTINCT FROM 'REJECTED'
   OR a.observation->>'reason' IS DISTINCT FROM 'NOT_APPLIED'
   OR convert_from(assertion.context_preimage,'UTF8')::jsonb->>'resultDisposition' IS DISTINCT FROM 'NO_EFFECT_RETRYABLE'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-PROVIDER-NO-EFFECT-GUARANTEE'; END IF;
 ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'DATA-6021-NO-EFFECT-KIND'; END IF;
 RETURN convert_to(jsonb_build_object('schema','pc.control.signing-rotation-operation-result.v1','participantId',a.participant_id,
  'privacyDomainId',a.privacy_domain_id,'rotationId',a.rotation_id,'operationId',c.operation_id,'kind',p_kind,
  'candidateDigest',encode(c.input_digest,'hex'),'revision',c.from_revision,'currentRevision',(SELECT r.revision FROM control.signing_key_rotation r WHERE r.participant_id=c.participant_id AND r.privacy_domain_id=c.privacy_domain_id AND r.rotation_id=c.rotation_id),'providerAttemptId',a.attempt_id,
  'providerRequestDigest',encode(a.request_digest,'hex'),'dispatchedAtNs',a.dispatched_at_ns,
  'providerObservationDigest',encode(a.observation_digest,'hex'),'originalAuthoritySnapshotDigest',encode(c.authorization_snapshot_digest,'hex'),

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.store_retirement_committed_digest(a control.store_retirement_admission)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE receipt text;
BEGIN
 SELECT encode(receipt_digest,'hex') INTO STRICT receipt FROM control.audit_occurrence
  WHERE participant_id=a.participant_id AND privacy_domain_id=a.privacy_domain_id AND operation_id=a.operation_id
   AND aggregate_type='store-retirement' AND aggregate_id=a.attempt_id AND profile_id='pc.control.store-retirement.admit';
 RETURN encode(sha256(convert_to('["OPENPC_STORE_RETIREMENT_COMMITTED_V1",'||to_json(a.host_digest)::text||','||
  to_json(a.attempt_digest)::text||','||to_json(receipt)::text||','||to_json(substring(a.source_binding_digest from 8))::text||','||
  a.dispatch_not_after_ms::text||']','UTF8')),'hex');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.validate_deployment_rejection(result control.deployment_result)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE claims jsonb; expected jsonb; issued_at timestamptz; expires_at timestamptz;
BEGIN
 PERFORM openpc.assert_request_context(true);
 PERFORM openpc.lock_deployment_command(result.command_id);
 claims:=convert_from(result.signed_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb->'claims';
 IF NOT openpc.matches_participant(result.participant_id) OR NOT openpc.matches_privacy(result.privacy_domain_id)
  OR result.sequence<>1 OR claims->>'schema' IS DISTINCT FROM 'PC-DEPLOYMENT-RESERVATION-REJECTION-1'
  OR NOT coalesce(claims->>'reason' IN ('CUSTODY_CONFLICT','PREPARATION_EXPIRED','MODULE_GENERATION_UNAVAILABLE'),false)
  OR NOT coalesce(claims->'binding'->>'transactionHash' ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$',false)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.deployment_address_reservation WHERE command_id=result.command_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.deployment_result prior WHERE prior.command_id=result.command_id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6004'; END IF;
 IF claims->>'reason'='MODULE_GENERATION_UNAVAILABLE' THEN
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock_shared(hashtextextended('module-admission:'||result.participant_id::text||':'||result.privacy_domain_id::text,0));
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM control.deployment_intent i WHERE i.participant_id=result.participant_id
   AND i.privacy_domain_id=result.privacy_domain_id
   AND i.preparation_digest='sha256:'||(claims->'binding'->>'preparationDigest')
   AND i.module_generation_digest IS NOT NULL
   AND i.module_generation_digest=openpc.deployment_module_generation(i.participant_id,i.privacy_domain_id))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6004'; END IF;
 END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
   'targetRuntimeId',intent.runtime_target_id::text,
   'owner',jsonb_build_object('participant_id',candidate.participant_id::text,
     'privacy_domain_id',candidate.privacy_domain_id::text,'actor_principal_id',intent.execution_principal_id::text,
     'workload_id',intent.execution_workload_id),
   'commandId',candidate.consumed_operation_id::text,'attemptId',candidate.resource_id::text,
   'intentDigest',substring(intent.intent_digest from 8),'preparationDigest',substring(intent.preparation_digest from 8),
   'chainId',prepared.document->'intent'->>'chainId','genesisDigest',prepared.document->'intent'->>'genesisHash',
   'transactionHash',claims->'binding'->>'transactionHash'),candidate.created_at,intent.expires_at
 INTO STRICT expected,issued_at,expires_at
 FROM control.mutation_candidate candidate
 JOIN control.idempotency_record receipt ON receipt.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
  AND receipt.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id AND receipt.operation_id=candidate.consumed_operation_id
  AND receipt.catalog_operation_id=candidate.catalog_operation_id AND receipt.input_digest=candidate.candidate_digest
  AND receipt.principal_id=candidate.maker_principal_id AND receipt.terminal_state='COMMITTED'
 JOIN control.mutation_evidence evidence ON evidence.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
  AND evidence.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id AND evidence.operation_id=candidate.consumed_operation_id
  AND evidence.catalog_operation_id=candidate.catalog_operation_id AND evidence.candidate_digest=candidate.candidate_digest
  AND evidence.aggregate_id=candidate.resource_id AND evidence.aggregate_type='deployment-submission'
 JOIN control.deployment_intent intent ON intent.participant_id=candidate.participant_id
  AND intent.privacy_domain_id=candidate.privacy_domain_id AND intent.actor_principal_id=candidate.maker_principal_id
  AND candidate.candidate_document->>'deploymentIntentId'='urn:openpc:resource:'||intent.deployment_intent_id::text
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT convert_from(intent.preparation_bytes,'UTF8')::jsonb document) prepared
 WHERE candidate.participant_id=result.participant_id AND candidate.privacy_domain_id=result.privacy_domain_id
  AND candidate.consumed_operation_id=result.command_id AND candidate.state='CONSUMED'
  AND candidate.catalog_operation_id='CFG-OP-SUBMIT-DEPLOYMENT'
  AND candidate.action_intent_id='ACT-DEPLOYMENT_SUBMISSIONS_CREATE_RESOURCE-V1'
  AND candidate.resource_type='deployment-submission' AND candidate.operation_class='CREATE'
  AND encode(candidate.candidate_digest,'hex')=claims->>'candidateDigest'
  AND encode(evidence.evidence_digest,'hex')=claims->>'authorizationEvidenceDigest';
 IF claims->'binding' IS DISTINCT FROM expected OR claims->>'observedAt' IS NULL
  OR (claims->>'observedAt')::timestamptz<issued_at
  OR (claims->>'observedAt')::timestamptz>clock_timestamp()+interval '5 seconds'
  OR (claims->>'reason'='PREPARATION_EXPIRED' AND
    (expires_at>clock_timestamp() OR (claims->>'observedAt')::timestamptz<expires_at))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PC-DATA-6004'; END IF;
END $function$
material bytea, nonce bytea, mac bytea, profile_digest text, purpose text
source_id uuid, wire bytea, nonce bytea, mac bytea
p uuid, d uuid, host text, domain text, binding bytea, nonce bytea, mac bytea

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION openpc.work_item_business_projection(item control.work_item)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('0',(item).kind,'1',(item).state,
  '2',(item).resource_ref,'3',openpc.business_bytes((item).payload_digest),
  '4',openpc.business_bytes(sha256(convert_to((item).reason,'UTF8'))),
  '5',openpc.business_uuid((item).created_by_principal_id),
  '6',CASE WHEN (item).assignee_principal_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  '8',CASE WHEN (item).claimed_by_principal_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  '10',CASE WHEN (item).completed_by_principal_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
  || CASE WHEN (item).assignee_principal_id IS NULL THEN '{}'::jsonb
     ELSE jsonb_build_object('7',openpc.business_uuid((item).assignee_principal_id)) END
  || CASE WHEN (item).claimed_by_principal_id IS NULL THEN '{}'::jsonb
     ELSE jsonb_build_object('9',openpc.business_uuid((item).claimed_by_principal_id)) END
  || CASE WHEN (item).completed_by_principal_id IS NULL THEN '{}'::jsonb
     ELSE jsonb_build_object('11',openpc.business_uuid((item).completed_by_principal_id)) END
$function$

SELECT runtime_configuration_input_id,
    participant_id,
    privacy_domain_id,
    module_installation_id,
    module_configuration_generation_id,
    openpc.runtime_artifact_input_payload(runtime_configuration_input_id) AS configuration_cbor,
    configuration_digest,
    resource_bindings,
    selected,
    created_at,
    active
   FROM control.runtime_configuration_input_current_metadata input;

SELECT input.runtime_configuration_input_id,
    input.participant_id,
    input.privacy_domain_id,
    input.module_installation_id,
    input.module_configuration_generation_id,
    input.configuration_digest,
    input.resource_bindings,
    input.selected,
    input.created_at,
    true AS active
   FROM control.runtime_configuration_input input
     JOIN control.module_configuration_generation c ON c.generation_id = input.module_configuration_generation_id AND c.module_installation_id = input.module_installation_id AND c.participant_id = input.participant_id AND c.privacy_domain_id = input.privacy_domain_id
     JOIN control.module_installation i ON i.module_installation_id = c.module_installation_id AND i.participant_id = c.participant_id AND i.privacy_domain_id = c.privacy_domain_id
     JOIN control.module_version v ON v.module_version_id = i.module_version_id
  WHERE openpc.runtime_artifact_new_use_allowed(input.participant_id, input.privacy_domain_id, input.configuration_digest) AND input.selected AND c.active AND i.state = 'ENABLED'::control.module_lifecycle_state AND i.lifecycle_operation_id IS NOT NULL AND v.module_id::text = 'pc.config.assets'::text AND openpc.runtime_configuration_bindings_current(input.participant_id, input.privacy_domain_id, input.resource_bindings);
